source.en: AMLO (Cap. 615) Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.9
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》（第615章）附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.9段

en.q: Under the AMLO, “money laundering” is defined as an act intended to have what effect?
options: Making property that is the proceeds of an indictable offence not appear to be, or represent, such proceeds
Concealing a customer's identity when carrying out a remittance transaction
Transferring funds out of Hong Kong without holding an MSO licence
Splitting a large transaction into several smaller transactions to avoid reporting
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, s.1 of the AMLO defines ML as an act intended to make property that is (or represents) the proceeds of an indictable offence not appear to be such proceeds. The other options describe conduct that may be unlawful but is not the statutory definition of money laundering.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，「洗錢」一詞指出於達致何種效果的意圖的行為？
options: 使屬可公訴罪行的收益（或代表該等收益）的財產，看似並非該等收益
在進行匯款交易時隱瞞客戶身分
未持有金錢服務經營者牌照而將資金匯出香港
將大額交易拆細為多宗小額交易以規避申報
tc.explain: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條將「洗錢」界定為：意圖使屬可公訴罪行收益（或代表該等收益）的財產看似並非該等收益的行為。其他選項或屬違法行為，但並非「洗錢」的法定定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10段

en.q: Which of the following correctly lists the three common stages of money laundering, in order?
options: Placement → layering → integration
Integration → placement → layering
Placement → structuring → conversion
Collection → transfer → withdrawal
en.explain: The Guideline (¶1.10) identifies three common stages: placement (disposal of cash proceeds into the financial system), layering (complex transactions to disguise the source) and integration (creating apparent legitimacy for the funds).

tc.q: 下列哪項正確依次列出洗錢的3個常見階段？
options: 存放 → 分層交易 → 整合
整合 → 存放 → 分層交易
存放 → 拆細 → 兌換
籌集 → 轉移 → 提取
tc.explain: 指引第1.10段指出洗錢有3個常見階段：存放（把非法活動的現金得益注入金融體系）、分層交易（以複雜多層交易隱藏款項來源）及整合（為犯罪得來的財富製造表面合法性）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10(b)段

en.q: In the money laundering process, “layering” refers to which of the following?
options: Separating illicit proceeds from their source through complex layers of financial transactions to disguise the source and subvert the audit trail
Disposing of cash proceeds derived from illegal activities into the financial system
Creating the impression of apparent legitimacy for criminally derived wealth
Keeping criminal proceeds in cash so that they never enter the financial system
en.explain: Layering separates illicit proceeds from their source by creating complex layers of financial transactions designed to disguise the source, subvert the audit trail and provide anonymity (¶1.10(b)). Disposing cash into the financial system is placement; creating apparent legitimacy is integration.

tc.q: 在洗錢過程中，「分層交易」是指下列哪項？
options: 透過複雜多層的金融交易，將非法得益與其來源分開，從而隱藏款項來源及掩飾審計線索
處置來自非法活動的現金得益並注入金融體系
為犯罪得來的財富製造表面的合法性
將犯罪得益保存為現金，使其永不進入金融體系
tc.explain: 分層交易指透過複雜多層的金融交易，將非法得益及其來源分開，從而隱藏款項來源、掩飾審計線索和隱藏擁有人身分（第1.10(b)段）。把現金注入金融體系是「存放」；製造表面合法性是「整合」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10(a)段

en.q: A drug trafficker brings a large amount of street cash to a money changer and converts it into another currency, moving it into the financial system for the first time. This best illustrates which stage of money laundering?
options: Placement
Layering
Integration
Refinancing
en.explain: Placement is the disposal of cash proceeds derived from illegal activities into the financial system (¶1.10(a)) — the first entry of dirty cash. Layering and integration come later; “refinancing” is not a stage of ML.

tc.q: 一名毒販攜帶大量現金到找換店兌換成另一貨幣，令該筆款項首次進入金融體系。這最能說明洗錢的哪個階段？
options: 存放
分層交易
整合
再融資
tc.explain: 「存放」指處置來自非法活動的現金得益並注入金融體系（第1.10(a)段），即黑錢首次進入金融體系。分層交易及整合屬較後階段；「再融資」並非洗錢階段。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.11
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.11段

en.q: Which statement about the statutory definition of “terrorist financing” is CORRECT?
options: It covers providing or collecting property intending or knowing it will be used to commit terrorist acts, whether or not the property is actually so used
It only applies where a terrorist act actually takes place
It only covers property derived from illegal sources
It only covers cross-border transfers made for terrorists
en.explain: TF under Sch. 1 includes the provision or collection of property with the intention or knowledge that it be used to commit terrorist acts — whether or not the property is actually so used. TF property can come from legitimate sources, and no completed terrorist act is required.

tc.q: 關於「恐怖分子資金籌集」的法定定義，下列哪項正確？
options: 涵蓋懷有將財產用於恐怖主義行為的意圖或知情而提供或籌集財產，不論該財產實際上有否被如此使用
只有在恐怖主義行為實際發生時才適用
只涵蓋來自非法來源的財產
只涵蓋為恐怖分子作出的跨境轉帳
tc.explain: 根據附表1，恐怖分子資金籌集包括懷有意圖或知道財產將用於作出恐怖主義行為而提供或籌集財產——不論該財產實際上有否被如此使用。有關財產可來自合法來源，亦無須有恐怖主義行為實際發生。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.1段

en.q: What is the key difference between money laundering (ML) and terrorist financing (TF)?
options: ML focuses on the source of the property, while TF focuses on the destination or use of the property, which may derive from legitimate sources
ML involves banks, while TF only involves money service operators
ML is a criminal offence, while TF attracts only disciplinary action
ML concerns cash only, while TF concerns electronic transfers only
en.explain: Per ¶6.1, ML is concerned with the handling of criminal proceeds — the source of property matters; the focus of TF is the destination or use of property, which may have derived from legitimate sources. Both are criminal offences.

tc.q: 洗錢與恐怖分子資金籌集的主要分別是甚麼？
options: 洗錢著重財產的來源；恐怖分子資金籌集的重心則在於財產的終點或用途，而有關財產可以來自合法來源
洗錢涉及銀行，恐怖分子資金籌集只涉及金錢服務經營者
洗錢屬刑事罪行，恐怖分子資金籌集只會招致紀律行動
洗錢只涉及現金，恐怖分子資金籌集只涉及電子轉帳
tc.explain: 根據第6.1段，洗錢著重處理犯罪得益，即財產來源是重點；恐怖分子資金籌集的重心則在於財產的終點或用途，而有關財產可以是從合法來源取得的。兩者均屬刑事罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: Which of the following best describes the Financial Action Task Force (FATF)?
options: An inter-governmental body that sets international AML/CFT standards and monitors jurisdictions' compliance through evaluations
A United Nations agency that imposes binding financial sanctions on member states
The Hong Kong regulator responsible for licensing money service operators
An international court that prosecutes money laundering offences
en.explain: The FATF, formed in 1989, is an inter-governmental body that sets standards (the FATF Recommendations) for combating ML, TF and PF, and monitors compliance by conducting evaluations of jurisdictions (¶1.13). It is not a UN agency, a licensing regulator or a court.

tc.q: 下列哪項最能描述財務行動特別組織（FATF）？
options: 一個制訂打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集國際標準，並透過評核監察各司法管轄區合規情況的跨政府組織
一個對成員國施加具約束力金融制裁的聯合國機構
負責向金錢服務經營者發牌的香港監管機構
一個檢控洗錢罪行的國際法院
tc.explain: 特別組織於1989年成立，是跨政府組織，制訂打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的標準（特別組織建議），並透過評核監察各司法管轄區的合規情況（第1.13段）。它並非聯合國機構、發牌機構或法院。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: As a member of the FATF, Hong Kong is obliged to do which of the following?
options: Implement the latest FATF Recommendations
Adopt the tax laws of other FATF members
Report all remittance transactions to the FATF
Obtain FATF approval before licensing each MSO
en.explain: As a FATF member, Hong Kong is obliged to implement the latest FATF Recommendations; complying with international AML/CFT standards helps maintain Hong Kong's status as an international financial centre (¶1.13). The FATF does not receive transaction reports or approve licences.

tc.q: 作為財務行動特別組織的成員，香港有責任做以下哪項？
options: 實施最新的特別組織建議
採納其他成員的稅務法例
向特別組織申報所有匯款交易
每次向金錢服務經營者發牌前先取得特別組織批准
tc.explain: 作為特別組織成員，香港有責任實施最新的特別組織建議；符合國際打擊洗錢標準有助維持香港作為國際金融中心的地位（第1.13段）。特別組織不接收交易申報，亦不參與發牌審批。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.14段

en.q: Which of the following correctly matches an ordinance with its chapter number?
options: Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance — Cap. 405
Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance — Cap. 575
United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance — Cap. 455
Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance — Cap. 615
en.explain: The main AML/CFT-related legislation: AMLO (Cap. 615), DTROP (Cap. 405), OSCO (Cap. 455), UNATMO (Cap. 575), UNSO (Cap. 537) and WMD(CPS)O (Cap. 526). Only the DTROP pairing is correct.

tc.q: 下列哪項條例與其章數配對正確？
options: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》— 第405章
《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》— 第575章
《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》— 第455章
《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》— 第615章
tc.explain: 相關主要法例：《打擊洗錢條例》第615章、《販毒（追討得益）條例》第405章、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第455章、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第575章、《聯合國制裁條例》第537章、《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第526章。只有《販毒（追討得益）條例》的配對正確。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.20段

en.q: Which of the following is a function of the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (OSCO)?
options: Creating an offence of money laundering in relation to the proceeds of indictable offences
Establishing the licensing regime for money service operators
Imposing customer due diligence requirements on financial institutions
Implementing United Nations sanctions against places outside the PRC
en.explain: The OSCO, among other things, creates an offence of money laundering in relation to the proceeds of indictable offences, and gives investigation and confiscation powers (¶1.20). Licensing and CDD are under the AMLO; UN sanctions are implemented under the UNSO.

tc.q: 下列哪項是《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》的功能？
options: 就來自可公訴罪行的得益增訂一項洗錢罪行
設立金錢服務經營者發牌制度
對金融機構施加客戶盡職審查規定
實施聯合國對中華人民共和國以外地方的制裁
tc.explain: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》其中一項功能是增訂一項有關來自可公訴罪行得益的洗錢罪行，並賦予調查及沒收得益的權力（第1.20段）。發牌制度及盡職審查規定載於《打擊洗錢條例》；聯合國制裁則根據《聯合國制裁條例》實施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.21段

en.q: The United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (UNATMO) is principally directed towards what?
options: Implementing UN Security Council decisions aimed at preventing the financing of terrorist acts and combating threats posed by foreign terrorist fighters
Recovering the proceeds of drug trafficking
Regulating the fees charged by money service operators
Controlling the export of strategic commodities from Hong Kong
en.explain: The UNATMO principally implements decisions in relevant UNSCRs aimed at preventing the financing of terrorist acts and combating threats posed by foreign terrorist fighters, plus pressing elements of the FATF Recommendations on TF (¶1.21).

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》主要針對甚麼？
options: 實施聯合國安理會相關決議中，關於防止向恐怖主義行為提供資金和減低外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員威脅的決定
追討販毒活動的得益
規管金錢服務經營者的收費
管制策略物品從香港出口
tc.explain: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》旨在實施安理會相關決議中關於防止向恐怖主義行為提供資金和減低外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員威脅的決定，並實施特別組織建議中與恐怖分子資金籌集有關較具逼切性的部分（第1.21段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.26及6.7段

en.q: Under the United Nations Sanctions Ordinance (UNSO), who makes regulations to implement sanctions decided by the UN Security Council, and where are designated parties published?
options: The Chief Executive makes the regulations; designations are published in the Gazette or on the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau website
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise makes the regulations; designations are published on the C&ED website
The Secretary for Justice makes the regulations; designations are published by the courts
The Monetary Authority makes the regulations; designations are published in newspapers
en.explain: The UNSO empowers the Chief Executive to make regulations implementing UNSC sanctions, including targeted financial sanctions; designated persons and entities are specified by notice in the Gazette or on the CEDB website (¶6.7). Most UNSCRs are implemented in Hong Kong under the UNSO (¶1.26).

tc.q: 根據《聯合國制裁條例》，由誰訂立規例以執行聯合國安理會決定的制裁？被指認人士名單於何處公布？
options: 由行政長官訂立規例；被指認人士透過憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站的公告指明
由海關關長訂立規例；名單於海關網站公布
由律政司司長訂立規例；名單由法院公布
由金融管理專員訂立規例；名單於報章公布
tc.explain: 《聯合國制裁條例》授權行政長官訂立規例，以執行安理會決定的制裁（包括針對性金融制裁）；被指認的個人及實體透過在憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站刊登的公告指明（第6.7段）。在香港，大部分安理會決議均根據該條例實施（第1.26段）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.27, ¶6.10; s.4 WMD(CPS)O
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.27及6.10段；《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條

en.q: Section 4 of the Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance prohibits a person from doing what?
options: Providing any services where he believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that the services may be connected to proliferation financing
Exporting any dual-use goods without a licence
Operating a money service without notifying the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
Holding funds for any customer from a high-risk jurisdiction
en.explain: s.4 WMD(CPS)O prohibits providing services where a person believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that the services may be connected to PF. “Services” is widely defined and includes lending money or other financial assistance (¶1.27, ¶6.10).

tc.q: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條禁止任何人作出甚麼行為？
options: 提供任何基於合理理由相信或懷疑可能與擴散資金籌集有關的服務
未領有許可證而出口兩用物品
未通知商務及經濟發展局而經營金錢服務
為任何來自高風險司法管轄區的客戶持有資金
tc.explain: 該條例第4條禁止任何人提供基於合理理由相信或懷疑可能與擴散資金籌集有關的服務。「提供服務」被廣泛界定，包括借出款項或以其他方式提供財政資助（第1.27及6.10段）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.22; s.25 DTROP & OSCO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.22段；《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條

en.q: Under the DTROP and the OSCO, a person who deals with property knowing or having reasonable grounds to believe it represents proceeds of drug trafficking or of an indictable offence faces what maximum penalty on conviction?
options: 14 years' imprisonment and a fine of $5 million
2 years' imprisonment and a fine of $1 million
3 years' imprisonment and a fine
3 months' imprisonment and a fine of $50,000
en.explain: The dealing offence under s.25 of the DTROP and the OSCO carries a maximum of 14 years' imprisonment and a $5 million fine (¶1.22). 2 years/$1M is the AMLO s.5 offence for knowing contravention; 3 years is tipping-off; 3 months/$50,000 is failure to disclose.

tc.q: 根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》，任何人知道或有合理理由相信財產代表販毒或可公訴罪行的得益而仍處理該財產，一經定罪，最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁14年及罰款五百萬元
監禁2年及罰款一百萬元
監禁3年及罰款
監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
tc.explain: 兩條例第25條的處理犯罪得益罪行，一經定罪最高可判監禁14年及罰款五百萬元（第1.22段）。監禁2年／罰款一百萬元是《打擊洗錢條例》第5條明知違反的刑罰；監禁3年是「通風報訊」；監禁3個月／罰款50,000元是未有披露的罪行。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.24; s.25A DTROP & OSCO, s.12 & 14 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.24段；《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A條、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12及14條

en.q: A person who fails to disclose, as soon as reasonable, his knowledge or suspicion that property represents proceeds of drug trafficking, an indictable offence or terrorist property commits an offence. What is the maximum penalty?
options: 3 months' imprisonment and a fine of $50,000
3 years' imprisonment and a fine
14 years' imprisonment and a fine of $5 million
A disciplinary fine of $10 million
en.explain: Failure to disclose knowledge or suspicion under s.25A DTROP/OSCO and s.12/14 UNATMO carries a maximum of 3 months' imprisonment and a $50,000 fine (¶1.24). This is why suspicions must be reported promptly (via the MLRO to the JFIU).

tc.q: 任何人知悉或懷疑任何財產代表販毒或可公訴罪行的得益或屬恐怖分子財產，而未能在合理範圍內盡快披露，即屬犯罪。最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
監禁3年及罰款
監禁14年及罰款五百萬元
繳付一千萬元紀律罰款
tc.explain: 根據《販毒條例》／《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A條及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12及14條，未有披露知悉或懷疑的罪行最高可判監禁3個月及罰款50,000元（第1.24段）。因此必須盡快（經洗錢報告主任向聯合財富情報組）報告可疑情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.25段

en.q: Which of the following describes the offence of “tipping off”?
options: Knowing or suspecting that a disclosure has been made, disclosing to another person any matter likely to prejudice any investigation following that disclosure
Advising a customer on how to reduce remittance fees
Reporting a suspicious transaction to the JFIU without informing the customer
Disclosing an MSO's licence number to a business counterparty
en.explain: Tipping off is committed when a person, knowing or suspecting a disclosure (e.g. an STR) has been made, discloses any matter likely to prejudice the ensuing investigation (¶1.25). Maximum penalty: 3 years' imprisonment and a fine. Reporting to the JFIU itself is a duty, not an offence.

tc.q: 下列哪項描述「通風報訊」罪行？
options: 知道或懷疑已曾作出披露，而仍向其他人披露任何相當可能損害為跟進該披露而進行的調查的事宜
建議客戶如何減省匯款手續費
在不通知客戶的情況下向聯合財富情報組報告可疑交易
向業務夥伴披露金錢服務經營者的牌照號碼
tc.explain: 任何人知道或懷疑已曾作出披露（例如可疑交易報告），而仍向其他人披露任何相當可能損害相關調查的事宜，即犯「通風報訊」罪（第1.25段），最高刑罰為監禁3年及罰款。向聯合財富情報組報告本身是責任，並非罪行。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.5(a); s.6 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(a)段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條

en.q: Under section 6 of the UNATMO, who is empowered to freeze suspected terrorist property?
options: The Secretary for Security
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise
The Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
The Financial Action Task Force
en.explain: Section 6 of the UNATMO empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze suspected terrorist property (¶6.5(a)). The S for S may also licence exceptions so frozen property can be unfrozen, e.g. for reasonable living or legal expenses (¶6.6).

tc.q: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條，誰獲授權凍結懷疑是恐怖分子的財產？
options: 保安局局長
海關關長
聯合財富情報組
財務行動特別組織
tc.explain: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條授權保安局局長凍結懷疑是恐怖分子的財產（第6.5(a)段）。保安局局長亦可批予特許，准許已凍結財產解凍，例如支付合理生活或法律開支（第6.6段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）詞彙表；第6.18段

en.q: In Hong Kong's AML/CFT regime, suspicious transaction reports (STRs) should be made to which body?
options: The Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU)
The Financial Action Task Force (FATF)
The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The Companies Registry
en.explain: STRs are made to the JFIU. The C&ED/CCE is the MSO regulator and licensing authority, and the FATF is the international standard-setter — neither receives STRs.

tc.q: 在香港的打擊洗錢制度下，可疑交易報告應向哪個機構提交？
options: 聯合財富情報組
財務行動特別組織
商務及經濟發展局
公司註冊處
tc.explain: 可疑交易報告須向聯合財富情報組提交。海關／關長是金錢服務經營者的監管及發牌機構，特別組織則是國際標準制定者——兩者均不接收可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段註57

en.q: “Targeted financial sanctions” refer to which of the following?
options: Both asset freezing and prohibitions to prevent funds or other assets from being made available for the benefit of designated persons and entities
Trade tariffs imposed on goods from sanctioned countries
Travel bans imposed on designated persons
Fines imposed by the FATF on non-compliant jurisdictions
en.explain: Targeted financial sanctions cover both asset freezing and prohibitions preventing funds or other assets from being made available, directly or indirectly, for the benefit of designated persons and entities (¶6.7, footnote 57).

tc.q: 「針對性金融制裁」指下列哪項？
options: 凍結資產，以及禁止向被指認的個人及實體的利益直接或間接提供資金或其他資產
對受制裁國家的貨物徵收貿易關稅
對被指認人士實施旅遊禁令
特別組織對不合規司法管轄區施加的罰款
tc.explain: 針對性金融制裁一併指凍結資產及禁止為被指認的個人及實體的利益而直接或間接提供資金或其他資產（第6.7段註57）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: To combat proliferation financing, the UN Security Council adopts a two-tiered approach. Which of the following correctly describes it?
options: A global approach under UNSCR 1540, and a country-specific approach against the DPRK (UNSCR 1718) and Iran (UNSCR 2231)
A global approach under UNSCR 1267, and a country-specific approach against Al-Qaida and the Taliban
A regional approach led by the FATF, and a local approach led by each member state
A voluntary approach for developed countries and a mandatory approach for developing countries
en.explain: The UNSC combats PF through (a) a global approach under UNSCR 1540 (2004) and successors, and (b) a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against Iran (¶6.9). UNSCR 1267 concerns terrorism designations, not PF.

tc.q: 為遏止擴散資金籌集，聯合國安理會採取雙層策略。下列哪項描述正確？
options: 在全球層面根據安理會第1540號決議；在國家層面根據針對朝鮮的第1718號決議及針對伊朗的第2231號決議
在全球層面根據安理會第1267號決議；在國家層面針對基地組織及塔利班
由特別組織主導的地區策略，以及由各成員國主導的本地策略
對已發展國家屬自願性質，對發展中國家屬強制性質
tc.explain: 安理會從兩個層面遏止擴散資金籌集：(a)全球層面——第1540 (2004)號決議及其後續決議；(b)國家層面——針對朝鮮的第1718 (2006)號決議及針對伊朗的第2231 (2015)號決議（第6.9段）。第1267號決議涉及恐怖分子指認，與擴散資金籌集無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.1段

en.q: Under which provision of the AMLO is the Guideline on AML/CFT for MSOs published?
options: Section 7
Section 5
Section 23
Section 30
en.explain: ¶1.1 states the Guideline is published under section 7 of the AMLO. Section 5 creates the offence of contravening a specified provision, section 23 of Schedule 2 concerns safeguards, and section 30 concerns the grant of a licence.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》是根據《打擊洗錢條例》哪一條條文發出？
options: 第7條
第5條
第23條
第30條
tc.explain: 第1.1段訂明本指引根據《打擊洗錢條例》第7條發出。第5條訂立違反指明條文的罪行，附表2第23條關乎防護措施，第30條則關乎批出牌照。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.3段

en.q: Besides disciplinary and other actions under the AMLO, what further consequence may an MSO's non-compliance with the Guideline have?
options: It may reflect adversely on the fitness and properness of its sole proprietor, partner, director and ultimate owner
It automatically cancels the MSO licence with immediate effect
It requires the MSO to be wound up by the Court of First Instance
It transfers supervision of the MSO from the CCE to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority
en.explain: ¶1.3 states that non-compliance with the Guideline may also reflect adversely on the fitness and properness of the sole proprietor, partner, director and ultimate owner (where applicable). Automatic cancellation, winding up and a change of supervisor are not consequences stated in the Guideline.

tc.q: 除《打擊洗錢條例》下的紀律行動及其他行動外，金錢服務經營者不遵從本指引還可能招致甚麼後果？
options: 可能對其獨資經營者、合夥人、董事及最終擁有人的適當人選資格有負面影響
牌照即時自動被取消
須由原訟法庭頒令將該金錢服務經營者清盤
其監管職能由海關關長轉移至香港金融管理局
tc.explain: 第1.3段訂明，金錢服務經營者不遵從本指引，亦可能對其獨資經營者、合夥人、董事及最終擁有人（如適用）的適當人選資格有負面影響。自動取消牌照、清盤及轉移監管機構均非指引所述後果。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.6段

en.q: In the Guideline, what is the effect of the words “must” and “should” when used in relation to an action, consideration or measure?
options: Both indicate a mandatory requirement
“Must” is mandatory while “should” is merely a recommendation
Both are advisory only and carry no regulatory weight
“Should” is mandatory only for MSOs assessed as high risk
en.explain: ¶1.6 states expressly that the use of the word “must” or “should” indicates that it is a mandatory requirement. The Guideline draws no distinction between the two words, and neither is merely advisory.

tc.q: 在本指引中，「必須」及「應」二詞用於某項行動、考慮或措施時，其效力為何？
options: 兩者均表示該項屬強制性規定
「必須」屬強制性，而「應」僅屬建議
兩者均僅屬指導性質，並無監管效力
「應」只對被評為高風險的金錢服務經營者具強制性
tc.explain: 第1.6段明確訂明，使用「必須」或「應」一詞，即表示該項屬強制性規定。指引並無區分兩者，亦非僅屬建議。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.6段

en.q: Why does the Guideline state that there exists no single set of universally applicable implementation measures?
options: Because of the significant differences in MSOs' organisational and legal structures and in the nature and scope of their business activities
Because the CCE has not yet finalised the statutory requirements for MSOs
Because MSOs may choose whether or not to comply with Schedule 2
Because the required measures differ according to the licence fee an MSO has paid
en.explain: ¶1.6 explains that significant differences exist in the organisational and legal structures of different MSOs and in the nature and scope of their business activities, so no single set of measures fits all. MSOs should use the Guideline as a basis to develop measures appropriate to their own structure and activities.

tc.q: 本指引為何訂明並無一套普遍適用的實施措施？
options: 因不同金錢服務經營者的組織及法律架構，以及其業務活動的性質及範圍存在重大差異
因海關關長尚未落實適用於金錢服務經營者的法定規定
因金錢服務經營者可自行選擇是否遵從附表2
因所需措施按金錢服務經營者已繳付的牌照費用而有所不同
tc.explain: 第1.6段解釋，不同金錢服務經營者的組織及法律架構，以及其業務活動的性質及範圍存在重大差異，故並無一套普遍適用的措施。金錢服務經營者應以本指引為基礎，制定切合其本身架構及業務活動的措施。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.8; s.7 AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.8段；《打擊洗錢條例》第7條

en.q: What is the legal status of the Guideline in proceedings under the AMLO before a court?
options: It is admissible in evidence, and any provision appearing relevant to a question arising must be taken into account
It is binding on the court and determines the outcome of the proceedings
It is inadmissible because it is not subsidiary legislation
It may be referred to only if both parties to the proceedings agree
en.explain: ¶1.8 provides that a failure to comply with the Guideline does not by itself render a person liable to judicial or other proceedings, but in any proceedings under the AMLO the Guideline is admissible in evidence, and any relevant provision must be taken into account by the court.

tc.q: 在法庭進行的《打擊洗錢條例》法律程序中，本指引具有甚麼法律地位？
options: 可獲接納為證據，而任何看來與所引起的問題相關的條文，法庭須予考慮
對法庭具約束力，並決定該法律程序的結果
因並非附屬法例，故不獲接納為證據
只有在法律程序雙方同意下方可援引
tc.explain: 第1.8段訂明，任何人不遵從本指引本身並不會令該人須承擔司法或其他法律程序的法律責任；但在《打擊洗錢條例》下的任何法律程序中，本指引可獲接納為證據，而任何相關條文法庭均須予以考慮。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.8段

en.q: In considering whether a person has contravened a provision of Schedule 2 to the AMLO, what must the CCE do?
options: Have regard to the relevant provision in the Guideline
Refer the matter to the Court of First Instance before reaching a view
Obtain the prior consent of the Financial Action Task Force
Disregard the Guideline, because it does not form part of the AMLO
en.explain: ¶1.8 states that in considering whether a person has contravened a provision of Schedule 2, the CCE must have regard to the relevant provision in the Guideline. There is no requirement to refer the matter to a court first or to obtain FATF consent.

tc.q: 在考慮某人是否違反《打擊洗錢條例》附表2的條文時，海關關長必須怎樣做？
options: 須顧及本指引的相關條文
須先將事宜轉交原訟法庭方可作出結論
須先取得財務行動特別組織的同意
須不予理會本指引，因其並非《打擊洗錢條例》的一部分
tc.explain: 第1.8段訂明，在考慮某人是否違反附表2的條文時，海關關長必須顧及本指引的相關條文。並無須先轉交法庭或取得財務行動特別組織同意的規定。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.11
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.11段

en.q: A person collects funds intending that they be used to commit a terrorist act, but the funds are in the event never used for that purpose. Does this fall within the statutory definition of terrorist financing?
options: Yes — the definition applies whether or not the property is actually so used
No — the definition requires the property to have been actually used
No — the definition covers only the provision of property, not its collection
Yes, but only if the amount collected exceeds HK$120,000
en.explain: Limb (a) of the definition in section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 covers the provision or collection of property with the intention that it be used, or knowing that it will be used, to commit terrorist acts, expressly “whether or not the property is actually so used”. Collection is covered, and no monetary threshold applies.

tc.q: 某人籌集資金，意圖用於進行恐怖主義行為，但該筆資金最終從未如此使用。這是否屬「恐怖分子資金籌集」的法定定義範圍？
options: 屬於——不論該財產實際上有否如此使用，定義均適用
不屬於——定義規定該財產須實際已被使用
不屬於——定義只涵蓋提供財產，不涵蓋籌集財產
屬於，但只限於所籌集款額超過120,000港元的情況
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條定義的(a)項涵蓋以任何方式提供或籌集財產，而意圖是該財產會被使用，或知道該財產將會被使用以進行恐怖主義行為，並明文訂明「不論該財產實際上是否如此使用」。籌集行為亦在涵蓋之列，且並無款額下限。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.11(b)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.11(b)段

en.q: Under limb (b) of the statutory definition of terrorist financing, what mental element suffices in relation to the recipient being a terrorist or terrorist associate?
options: Knowing that, or being reckless as to whether, the person is a terrorist or terrorist associate
Actual knowledge only; recklessness is insufficient
Negligence in failing to screen the person against a sanctions list
An intention to assist a specific terrorist act that later occurs
en.explain: Limb (b) covers making property or financial (or related) services available, directly or indirectly, to or for the benefit of a person “knowing that, or being reckless as to whether”, the person is a terrorist or terrorist associate. Recklessness therefore suffices, and no completed terrorist act is required.

tc.q: 根據「恐怖分子資金籌集」法定定義的(b)項，就接受者屬恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者一事，須具備甚麼心理要素？
options: 知道或罔顧該人是否恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者
只限實際知情；罔顧並不足夠
疏忽而未有將該人與制裁名單作篩查
意圖協助某項其後確實發生的恐怖主義行為
tc.explain: (b)項涵蓋以任何方式直接或間接向某人或為其利益提供財產或財務（或相關）服務，而知道或罔顧該人是否恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者。因此罔顧已屬足夠，亦不要求恐怖主義行為實際發生。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.12段

en.q: Why does the Guideline say terrorist groups must find ways to launder funds even where those funds come from a legitimate source?
options: So that they can use the funds without attracting the attention of the authorities, by obscuring links between themselves and their funding sources
Because funds of legitimate origin cannot lawfully be transferred across borders without being laundered
Because the AMLO exempts funds of legitimate origin from all reporting obligations
Because laundering converts legitimate funds into a higher-yielding investment
en.explain: ¶1.12 explains that terrorists need to obscure or disguise links between themselves and their funding sources, so they must launder funds regardless of whether those funds are of legitimate or illegitimate origin, in order to use them without attracting the attention of the authorities.

tc.q: 本指引為何指出，即使資金來自合法來源，恐怖分子組織仍須設法清洗該等資金？
options: 為隱藏其與資金來源之間的關連，以便在不引起當局注意的情況下使用該等資金
因合法來源的資金若不經清洗便不能合法作跨境轉移
因《打擊洗錢條例》豁免合法來源的資金的一切匯報責任
因清洗可將合法資金轉換為回報更高的投資
tc.explain: 第1.12段解釋，恐怖分子須隱藏或掩飾其本身與資金來源之間的關連，故不論資金屬合法或非法來源，均須設法清洗，以便在不引起當局注意的情況下使用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: In which year was the Financial Action Task Force formed?
en.explain: ¶1.13 states that the FATF is an inter-governmental body formed in 1989. UNSCR 1540, referred to elsewhere in the Guideline, dates from 2004.

tc.q: 財務行動特別組織於哪一年成立？
tc.explain: 第1.13段訂明，財務行動特別組織是於1989年成立的跨政府組織。指引其他部分提及的第1540號決議則為2004年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: How does the FATF seek to ensure full and effective implementation of its standards at the global level?
options: By conducting evaluations on jurisdictions and undertaking stringent follow-up, including identifying high-risk and other monitored jurisdictions
By prosecuting money launderers directly in the courts of member jurisdictions
By issuing licences to money service operators in member jurisdictions
By freezing the assets of designated persons on behalf of member jurisdictions
en.explain: ¶1.13 states that the FATF monitors compliance by conducting evaluations on jurisdictions and undertakes stringent follow-up, including identifying high-risk and other monitored jurisdictions which could be subject to enhanced scrutiny or counter-measures. The FATF is a standard-setting body; it does not prosecute, licence or freeze assets.

tc.q: 財務行動特別組織如何確保其標準在全球層面得到全面及有效的實施？
options: 透過對司法管轄區進行評估並嚴格跟進，包括識別高風險及其他受監察的司法管轄區
直接在成員司法管轄區的法院檢控洗錢者
向成員司法管轄區的金錢服務經營者發出牌照
代表成員司法管轄區凍結被指定人士的資產
tc.explain: 第1.13段訂明，財務行動特別組織透過對司法管轄區進行評估以監察遵行情況，並作出嚴格跟進，包括識別可能須接受加強審查或反制措施的高風險及其他受監察司法管轄區。該組織是訂立標準的機構，並不負責檢控、發牌或凍結資產。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.14段

en.q: Which ordinance is Cap. 526?
options: Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance
United Nations Sanctions Ordinance
Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance
Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance
en.explain: ¶1.14 identifies the WMD(CPS)O as Cap. 526. The UNSO is Cap. 537, the OSCO is Cap. 455 and the DTROP is Cap. 405.

tc.q: 第526章是哪一條條例？
options: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》
《聯合國制裁條例》
《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》
《販毒（追討得益）條例》
tc.explain: 第1.14段指出《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》為第526章。《聯合國制裁條例》為第537章，《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》為第455章，《販毒（追討得益）條例》則為第405章。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.14段

en.q: Which ordinance is Cap. 575?
options: United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance
United Nations Sanctions Ordinance
Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance
Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance
en.explain: ¶1.14 identifies the UNATMO as Cap. 575. The UNSO is Cap. 537, the AMLO is Cap. 615 and the OSCO is Cap. 455.

tc.q: 第575章是哪一條條例？
options: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》
《聯合國制裁條例》
《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》
《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》
tc.explain: 第1.14段指出《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》為第575章。《聯合國制裁條例》為第537章，《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》為第615章，《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》則為第455章。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.15; s.23 Sch. 2 AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.15段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第23條

en.q: Section 23 of Schedule 2 to the AMLO requires an MSO to take all reasonable measures to do which of the following?
options: Ensure proper safeguards exist to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2, and mitigate ML/TF risks
Guarantee that no customer of the MSO is ever convicted of an indictable offence
Recover for the Government any proceeds of crime that pass through the MSO
Obtain the CCE's prior approval for every remittance exceeding HK$8,000
en.explain: ¶1.15 summarises section 23 of Schedule 2: an MSO must take all reasonable measures (a) to ensure that proper safeguards exist to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2, and (b) to mitigate ML/TF risks. The other options state obligations that do not exist.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第23條規定金錢服務經營者須採取一切合理措施，作出下列哪項？
options: 確保設有適當防護措施，以防止違反附表2第2及第3部下的任何規定，並減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
保證其客戶永不會被裁定犯可公訴罪行
代政府追討經該金錢服務經營者流轉的犯罪得益
就每宗超過8,000港元的匯款事先取得海關關長批准
tc.explain: 第1.15段概述附表2第23條：金錢服務經營者須採取一切合理措施，(a)確保設有適當防護措施以防止違反附表2第2及第3部下的任何規定；及(b)減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。其餘選項所述並非法定責任。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.16–1.18; s.5 AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.16至1.18段；《打擊洗錢條例》第5條

en.q: An MSO knowingly contravenes a specified provision of the AMLO. What is the maximum penalty on conviction?
options: Imprisonment for 2 years and a fine of $1 million
Imprisonment for 7 years and a fine of $1 million
Imprisonment for 14 years and a fine of $5 million
A pecuniary penalty of $10 million with no term of imprisonment
en.explain: ¶1.17 provides that where an MSO knowingly contravenes a specified provision it is liable to a maximum of 2 years' imprisonment and a fine of $1 million. The 7-year maximum applies where the contravention is committed with intent to defraud the CCE; 14 years and $5 million is the section 25 DTROP/OSCO dealing offence.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者在知情下違反《打擊洗錢條例》的指明條文。一經定罪，最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁2年及罰款100萬元
監禁7年及罰款100萬元
監禁14年及罰款500萬元
罰款1,000萬元而無監禁
tc.explain: 第1.17段訂明，金錢服務經營者如在知情下違反指明條文，一經定罪，最高可處監禁2年及罰款100萬元。7年的最高刑期適用於意圖欺騙海關關長而違反的情況；監禁14年及罰款500萬元則為《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條的處理財產罪行。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.18; s.5 AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.18段；《打擊洗錢條例》第5條

en.q: An MSO contravenes a specified provision of the AMLO with the intent to defraud the CCE. What is the maximum term of imprisonment on conviction?
options: 7 years
2 years
3 years
14 years
en.explain: ¶1.18 provides that where the contravention is committed with intent to defraud the CCE, the MSO is liable to a maximum of 7 years' imprisonment and a fine of $1 million. Two years applies to a knowing contravention without that intent.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者意圖欺騙海關關長而違反《打擊洗錢條例》的指明條文。一經定罪，最高監禁刑期為何？
options: 7年
2年
3年
tc.explain: 第1.18段訂明，如屬意圖欺騙海關關長而作出的違反，該金錢服務經營者一經定罪，最高可處監禁7年及罰款100萬元。2年適用於並無該意圖的知情違反。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.19段

en.q: Under the AMLO, which persons commit an offence by knowingly causing or permitting an MSO to contravene a specified provision?
options: A person who is an employee of the MSO, is employed to work for it, or is concerned in its management
Only the sole proprietor, partners or directors of the MSO
Only the MSO's appointed compliance officer
Only persons holding a separate licence issued by the CCE
en.explain: ¶1.19 states the offence applies to a person who is an employee of an MSO, is employed to work for an MSO, or is concerned in the management of an MSO, and who knowingly, or with intent to defraud the MSO or the CCE, causes or permits the MSO to contravene a specified provision.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，哪些人如在知情下導致或准許金錢服務經營者違反指明條文，即屬犯罪？
options: 屬該金錢服務經營者的僱員、受僱為其工作或參與其管理的人
只限該金錢服務經營者的獨資經營者、合夥人或董事
只限該金錢服務經營者委任的合規主任
只限持有海關關長另行發出的牌照的人
tc.explain: 第1.19段訂明，該罪行適用於屬金錢服務經營者的僱員、受僱為金錢服務經營者工作，或參與金錢服務經營者管理的人，而該人在知情下，或意圖欺騙該金錢服務經營者或海關關長，導致或准許該金錢服務經營者違反指明條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.20段

en.q: What is the maximum pecuniary penalty the CCE may order an MSO to pay for a contravention of a specified provision?
options: The greater of $10 million or 3 times the amount of profit gained or costs avoided as a result of the contravention
A fixed sum of $10 million in every case
The greater of $1 million or 2 times the profit gained
The greater of $5 million or the value of the transactions concerned
en.explain: ¶1.20 states that the disciplinary actions available include ordering the MSO to pay a pecuniary penalty not exceeding the greater of $10 million or 3 times the amount of profit gained, or costs avoided, by the MSO as a result of the contravention.

tc.q: 就違反指明條文，海關關長可命令金錢服務經營者繳付的罰款上限為何？
options: 1,000萬元，或該違反行為為其帶來的利潤或所避免的成本的3倍，以較高者為準
在任何情況下均為定額1,000萬元
100萬元，或所獲利潤的2倍，以較高者為準
500萬元，或有關交易的價值，以較高者為準
tc.explain: 第1.20段訂明，可採取的紀律行動包括命令該金錢服務經營者繳付罰款，款額不超過1,000萬元，或該違反行為為其帶來的利潤或所避免的成本的3倍，以較高者為準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.20段

en.q: Which of the following is a disciplinary action the CCE may take against an MSO for contravening a specified provision in the AMLO?
options: Publicly reprimanding the MSO
Sentencing the MSO's directors to a term of imprisonment
Ordering the immediate liquidation of the MSO's assets
Referring the MSO to the FATF for evaluation
en.explain: ¶1.20 lists the disciplinary actions as publicly reprimanding the MSO, ordering it to take action to remedy the contravention, and ordering it to pay a pecuniary penalty. Imprisonment is a criminal sanction imposed by a court, not a disciplinary action of the CCE.

tc.q: 就違反《打擊洗錢條例》的指明條文，海關關長可對金錢服務經營者採取下列哪項紀律行動？
options: 公開譴責該金錢服務經營者
判處該金錢服務經營者的董事監禁
命令即時變賣該金錢服務經營者的資產
將該金錢服務經營者轉介財務行動特別組織進行評估
tc.explain: 第1.20段列出的紀律行動為公開譴責該金錢服務經營者、命令其採取行動糾正違反事項，以及命令其繳付罰款。監禁屬法庭判處的刑事制裁，並非海關關長的紀律行動。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.22; s.25 DTROP & OSCO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.22段；《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條

en.q: Under section 25 of the DTROP and the OSCO, what mental element is required for the offence of dealing with property that represents the proceeds of drug trafficking or of an indictable offence?
options: Knowing or having reasonable grounds to believe that the property represents such proceeds
Actual knowledge only, proved beyond reasonable doubt
An intention to permanently deprive the true owner of the property
Negligence in failing to carry out customer due diligence
en.explain: ¶1.22 states that a person commits the offence if he deals with any property knowing or having reasonable grounds to believe it to represent any person's proceeds of drug trafficking or of an indictable offence. The “reasonable grounds to believe” limb means actual knowledge is not required.

tc.q: 根據《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條，處理代表販毒得益或可公訴罪行得益的財產的罪行，須具備甚麼心理要素？
options: 知道或有合理理由相信該財產代表該等得益
只限實際知情，並須在無合理疑點下獲證明
意圖永久剝奪該財產真正擁有人的權利
疏忽而未有進行客戶盡職審查
tc.explain: 第1.22段訂明，任何人處理任何財產，而知道或有合理理由相信該財產代表任何人的販毒得益或可公訴罪行得益，即屬犯罪。「有合理理由相信」一項意味並不需要實際知情。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.22段

en.q: What is the highest penalty on conviction for the dealing offence under section 25 of the DTROP and the OSCO?
options: Imprisonment for 14 years and a fine of $5 million
Imprisonment for 7 years and a fine of $1 million
Imprisonment for 3 years and a fine of $50,000
Imprisonment for 2 years and a fine of $1 million
en.explain: ¶1.22 states the highest penalty for the section 25 dealing offence upon conviction is imprisonment for 14 years and a fine of $5 million. The lesser penalties listed relate to AMLO specified-provision offences, tipping off and failure to disclose.

tc.q: 《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條的處理財產罪行，一經定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁14年及罰款500萬元
監禁7年及罰款100萬元
監禁3年及罰款50,000元
監禁2年及罰款100萬元
tc.explain: 第1.22段訂明，第25條處理財產罪行一經定罪的最高刑罰為監禁14年及罰款500萬元。其餘較輕刑罰分別關乎《打擊洗錢條例》指明條文罪行、洩密罪行及沒有披露的罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.24段

en.q: What is the maximum penalty for failing to disclose, as soon as it is reasonable to do so, knowledge or suspicion that property represents the proceeds of drug trafficking or of an indictable offence, or is terrorist property?
options: Imprisonment for 3 months and a fine of $50,000
Imprisonment for 3 years and a fine of $50,000
Imprisonment for 14 years and a fine of $5 million
Imprisonment for 7 years and a fine of $500,000
en.explain: ¶1.24 states that this failure-to-disclose offence carries a maximum term of imprisonment of 3 months and a fine of $50,000 upon conviction. Three years is the maximum for tipping off; 14 years and $5 million is the section 25 dealing offence.

tc.q: 任何人沒有在合理範圍內盡快披露其知道或懷疑某財產代表販毒得益、可公訴罪行得益或屬恐怖分子財產，最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
監禁3年及罰款50,000元
監禁14年及罰款500萬元
監禁7年及罰款500,000元
tc.explain: 第1.24段訂明，此項沒有披露的罪行一經定罪，最高可處監禁3個月及罰款50,000元。3年為洩密罪行的最高刑期；監禁14年及罰款500萬元則為第25條處理財產罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.25段

en.q: What is the maximum penalty on conviction for the offence of “tipping off” under the DTROP, the OSCO and the UNATMO?
options: Imprisonment for 3 years and a fine
Imprisonment for 3 months and a fine of $50,000
Imprisonment for 14 years and a fine of $5 million
Imprisonment for 2 years and a fine of $1 million
en.explain: ¶1.25 states that the maximum penalty for tipping off upon conviction is imprisonment for 3 years and a fine. Three months and $50,000 is the failure-to-disclose offence; 14 years and $5 million is the section 25 dealing offence.

tc.q: 根據《販毒條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，「洩密」罪行一經定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁3年及罰款
監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
監禁14年及罰款500萬元
監禁2年及罰款100萬元
tc.explain: 第1.25段訂明，洩密罪行一經定罪的最高刑罰為監禁3年及罰款。監禁3個月及罰款50,000元屬沒有披露的罪行；監禁14年及罰款500萬元則為第25條處理財產罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.25段

en.q: A staff member of an MSO, knowing that a colleague has filed a suspicious transaction report, telephones the customer and warns him that his account is being examined. Which offence does this most directly illustrate?
options: Tipping off
Failure to disclose knowledge or suspicion
Dealing with property representing the proceeds of an indictable offence
Providing services connected to proliferation financing
en.explain: ¶1.25 defines tipping off: a person commits the offence if, knowing or suspecting that a disclosure has been made, he discloses to any other person any matter likely to prejudice any investigation that might be conducted following that disclosure. Warning the customer is the paradigm case.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者的職員知道同事已提交可疑交易報告，遂致電客戶，警告其帳戶正被審查。這最直接說明哪一項罪行？
options: 洩密
沒有披露所知或所懷疑的事宜
處理代表可公訴罪行得益的財產
提供與大規模毀滅武器擴散資金籌集有關的服務
tc.explain: 第1.25段界定洩密罪行：任何人知道或懷疑已作出披露，而向另一人披露相當可能會損害因該項披露而可能進行的調查的事宜，即屬犯罪。警告客戶正是典型例子。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.26段

en.q: The United Nations Sanctions Ordinance provides for the imposition of sanctions arising from which part of the Charter of the United Nations?
options: Chapter 7
Chapter 2
Chapter 11
Chapter 15
en.explain: ¶1.26 states that the UNSO provides for the imposition of sanctions against persons and against places outside the People's Republic of China arising from Chapter 7 of the Charter of the United Nations, and that most UNSCRs are implemented in Hong Kong under the UNSO.

tc.q: 《聯合國制裁條例》就實施因《聯合國憲章》哪一章而產生的制裁作出規定？
options: 第7章
第2章
第11章
第15章
tc.explain: 第1.26段訂明，《聯合國制裁條例》就針對中華人民共和國以外的人及地方、因《聯合國憲章》第7章而產生的制裁的實施作出規定，而大部分聯合國安理會決議均透過該條例在香港實施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: Which UNSCR calls on all member states to act to prevent and suppress the financing of terrorist acts?
en.explain: ¶6.2 identifies UNSCR 1373 (2001) as the resolution calling on all member states to act to prevent and suppress the financing of terrorist acts. UNSCR 1540 is the global counter-proliferation resolution, while 1718 and 2231 are country-specific to the DPRK and Iran.

tc.q: 哪一項聯合國安理會決議呼籲所有成員國採取行動防止及制止恐怖主義行為的資金籌集？
tc.explain: 第6.2段指出第1373號決議（2001年）呼籲所有成員國採取行動防止及制止恐怖主義行為的資金籌集。第1540號決議屬全球性打擊擴散資金籌集決議，而第1718及2231號決議則分別針對朝鮮及伊朗。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: Where the UN publishes the names of individuals and organisations linked to Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban, what are all UN member states required to do?
options: Freeze any funds, other financial assets or economic resources of the named persons and report any suspected name matches to the relevant authorities
Prosecute the named persons in their domestic courts within 30 days
Expel any national of the country in which a named person resides
Report the names to the FATF for inclusion in its evaluation reports
en.explain: ¶6.2 states that all UN member states are required to freeze any funds, or other financial assets, or economic resources of any person(s) named in these lists and to report any suspected name matches to the relevant authorities.

tc.q: 當聯合國公布與蓋達組織、伊斯蘭國（Da'esh）及塔利班有關連的個人及組織名單時，所有聯合國成員國須怎樣做？
options: 凍結名單上任何人的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，並向有關當局報告任何懷疑名稱吻合的個案
於30日內在本國法院檢控名單上的人
驅逐名單上的人所居住國家的任何國民
將名單通報財務行動特別組織以載入其評估報告
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明，所有聯合國成員國須凍結該等名單上任何人的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，並須向有關當局報告任何懷疑名稱吻合的個案。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.4; s.4 & 5 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.4段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第4及5條

en.q: Under section 5 of the UNATMO, to which body may the Chief Executive apply for an order specifying a person as a terrorist or terrorist associate?
options: The Court of First Instance
The Legislative Council
The Security Bureau
The United Nations Security Council
en.explain: ¶6.4 states that under section 5 of the UNATMO the Chief Executive may apply to the Court of First Instance for an order specifying a person or property, and that any such order will also be published in the Gazette. Section 4 concerns publication of a Gazette notice following a designation by a UNSC Committee.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第5條，行政長官可向哪一機構申請頒令指明某人為恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者？
options: 原訟法庭
立法會
保安局
聯合國安全理事會
tc.explain: 第6.4段訂明，根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第5條，行政長官可向原訟法庭申請頒令指明某人或某財產，而該命令亦會在憲報公布。第4條則關乎在聯合國安理會委員會作出指定後於憲報刊登公告。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.5; s.6 & 7 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6及7條

en.q: Which section of the UNATMO prohibits the provision or collection of property for use to commit terrorist acts?
options: Section 7
Section 6
Section 8A
Section 11L
en.explain: ¶6.5 lists the relevant UNATMO provisions: section 6 empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze suspected terrorist property; section 7 prohibits the provision or collection of property for use to commit terrorist acts; section 8A prohibits dealing with specified terrorist property; and section 11L concerns financing terrorist travel.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》哪一條禁止提供或籌集財產以用於進行恐怖主義行為？
options: 第7條
第6條
第8A條
第11L條
tc.explain: 第6.5段列出相關條文：第6條授權保安局局長凍結懷疑屬恐怖分子財產的財產；第7條禁止提供或籌集財產以用於進行恐怖主義行為；第8A條禁止處理指明恐怖分子財產；第11L條則關乎資助恐怖分子旅行。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.5(e); s.11L UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(e)段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第11L條

en.q: Section 11L of the UNATMO prohibits financing the travel of a person between states for a specified purpose. Is the prohibition engaged if no terrorist act actually occurs?
options: Yes — the prohibition applies even if no terrorist act actually occurs
No — a completed terrorist act is an element of the offence
No — the section applies only to travel within Hong Kong
Yes, but only where the traveller is already a specified terrorist
en.explain: ¶6.5(e) states that section 11L prohibits providing or collecting property to finance travel between states with the intention or knowledge that the travel is for the perpetration, planning or preparation of, or participation in, terrorist acts, or for related training — expressly “even if no terrorist act actually occurs”.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第11L條禁止為指明目的資助某人於國家之間旅行。若最終並無恐怖主義行為發生，該禁止規定是否仍然適用？
options: 仍然適用——即使並無恐怖主義行為實際發生
不適用——恐怖主義行為須實際發生方構成罪行
不適用——該條只適用於香港境內的旅行
適用，但只限於該旅行者已屬指明恐怖分子的情況
tc.explain: 第6.5(e)段訂明，第11L條禁止任何人提供或籌集財產，以資助某人於國家之間旅行，而意圖或知道該旅行是為施行、策劃或籌備恐怖主義行為或參與其中，或為提供或接受有關訓練，並明文訂明「即使並無恐怖主義行為因而實際發生」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.4段

en.q: For whose use is the AML/CFT Guideline intended?
options: MSOs and their officers and staff
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise and his officers only
Authorized institutions supervised by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority
Members of the Financial Action Task Force
en.explain: ¶1.4 states the Guideline is intended for use by MSOs and their officers and staff. It provides general background on ML/TF and practical guidance to assist MSOs and their senior management in designing their own policies, procedures and controls.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》擬供何人使用？
options: 金錢服務經營者及其高級人員與員工
只供海關關長及其人員使用
受香港金融管理局監管的認可機構
財務行動特別組織的成員
tc.explain: 第1.4段訂明本指引擬供金錢服務經營者及其高級人員與員工使用，並提供洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的一般背景資料，以及協助金錢服務經營者及其高級管理層制定本身政策、程序及管控措施的實務指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.6段

en.q: How should an MSO treat the measures described in the Guideline when designing its own controls?
options: As a basis on which to develop measures appropriate to its own structure and business activities, the Guideline not being an exhaustive list
As an exhaustive checklist which, once completed, discharges every statutory obligation
As optional suggestions that need only be adopted by larger MSOs
As measures that may be applied only with the CCE's prior written approval
en.explain: ¶1.6 states that the content of the Guideline is not intended to be an exhaustive list of the means of meeting the statutory and regulatory requirements, and that MSOs should therefore use the Guideline as a basis to develop measures appropriate to their structure and business activities.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者在設計本身的管控措施時，應如何看待本指引所述的措施？
options: 應以本指引為基礎，制定切合其本身架構及業務活動的措施，因指引並非詳盡無遺的清單
視為詳盡的核對清單，一經完成即已履行所有法定責任
視為可供選擇的建議，只有規模較大的金錢服務經營者才須採納
視為須事先取得海關關長書面批准方可採用的措施
tc.explain: 第1.6段訂明本指引的內容並非符合法定及監管規定的方法的詳盡清單，故金錢服務經營者應以本指引為基礎，制定切合其架構及業務活動的措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.7段

en.q: The Guideline provides guidance in relation to the operation of the provisions of which part of the AMLO?
options: Schedule 2
Schedule 1
Part 6
Schedule 3
en.explain: ¶1.7 states that the Guideline provides guidance in relation to the operation of the provisions of Schedule 2 to the AMLO, which will assist MSOs to meet their legal and regulatory obligations when tailored to their particular business risk profile. Schedule 1 is interpretation and Schedule 3 deals with fees.

tc.q: 本指引就《打擊洗錢條例》哪一部分條文的運作提供指引？
options: 附表2
附表1
第6部
附表3
tc.explain: 第1.7段訂明本指引就《打擊洗錢條例》附表2條文的運作提供指引；金錢服務經營者按其特定業務風險狀況加以調適後，有助其履行法律及監管責任。附表1為釋義，附表3則關乎費用。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.9
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.9段

en.q: Conduct occurring outside Hong Kong generates proceeds. When do those proceeds fall within the statutory definition of money laundering in the AMLO?
options: Where the conduct, had it occurred in Hong Kong, would constitute an indictable offence under the laws of Hong Kong
Only where the conduct is also an offence in the jurisdiction where it occurred
Only where the proceeds are subsequently remitted into Hong Kong
Never — the definition is confined to offences committed in Hong Kong
en.explain: The definition in section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 covers proceeds obtained from the commission of an indictable offence under the laws of Hong Kong, or of any conduct which if it had occurred in Hong Kong would constitute an indictable offence under the laws of Hong Kong. Dual criminality and remittance into Hong Kong are not required.

tc.q: 在香港以外發生的行為產生得益。該等得益在何情況下屬《打擊洗錢條例》中「洗錢」的法定定義範圍？
options: 若該行為假使在香港發生便會構成香港法律下的可公訴罪行
只有在該行為於發生地亦屬罪行的情況下
只有在該等得益其後匯入香港的情況下
永不屬於——定義只限於在香港犯的罪行
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條的定義涵蓋因犯香港法律下的可公訴罪行而獲得的得益，或因任何行為而獲得的得益，而該行為假使在香港發生便會構成香港法律下的可公訴罪行。並不要求雙重犯罪，亦不要求得益匯入香港。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.9(b)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.9(b)段

en.q: Property that only partly and indirectly represents the proceeds of an indictable offence is dealt with so as not to appear to represent those proceeds. Is that within the statutory definition of money laundering?
options: Yes — the definition covers property that in whole or in part, directly or indirectly, represents such proceeds
No — the definition requires the property to be the proceeds themselves
No — indirect representation is covered only by the OSCO, not the AMLO
Yes, but only if the property can be traced to a single identified offence
en.explain: Limb (b) of the definition covers property that in whole or in part, directly or indirectly, represents the proceeds of an indictable offence. Partial and indirect representation therefore falls squarely within the definition.

tc.q: 某財產僅部分並間接代表可公訴罪行的得益，而有關處理令其看似並非代表該等得益。這是否屬「洗錢」的法定定義範圍？
options: 屬於——定義涵蓋全部或部分、直接或間接代表該等得益的財產
不屬於——定義規定該財產須是該等得益本身
不屬於——間接代表只受《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》規管，不受《打擊洗錢條例》規管
屬於，但只限於該財產可追溯至某一項已識別罪行的情況
tc.explain: 定義的(b)項涵蓋全部或部分、直接或間接代表可公訴罪行得益的財產。因此，部分及間接代表的情況同樣落入定義範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10(c)段

en.q: Where the layering process has succeeded, what does an integration scheme achieve?
options: It returns the laundered proceeds to the general financial system so that they appear to result from, or be connected to, legitimate business activities
It removes the proceeds permanently from the financial system and holds them as cash
It converts the proceeds into a foreign currency to avoid exchange controls
It splits the proceeds into amounts below the reporting threshold
en.explain: ¶1.10(c) describes integration as creating the impression of apparent legitimacy for criminally derived wealth: where layering succeeds, integration schemes effectively return the laundered proceeds to the general financial system so that they appear to be the result of, or connected to, legitimate business activities.

tc.q: 當分層交易過程成功後，「整合」安排達致甚麼效果？
options: 將已清洗的得益送回一般金融體系，令其看似源自合法商業活動或與之有關
將得益永久移離金融體系並以現金形式持有
將得益兌換為外幣以規避外匯管制
將得益拆細至低於申報門檻的款額
tc.explain: 第1.10(c)段將「整合」描述為為犯罪得來的財富製造表面合法性：當分層交易過程成功後，整合安排實際上把已清洗的得益送回一般金融體系，令該等得益看似源自合法商業活動或與之有關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10段

en.q: Funds already inside the banking system are moved rapidly through a chain of accounts in several jurisdictions, each transfer having no apparent commercial purpose. Which stage of money laundering does this best illustrate?
options: Layering
Placement
Integration
Structuring
en.explain: Layering separates illicit proceeds from their source by creating complex layers of financial transactions designed to disguise the source, subvert the audit trail and provide anonymity (¶1.10(b)). Placement is the first entry of cash into the system; integration gives the funds apparent legitimacy.

tc.q: 已在銀行體系內的資金，經多個司法管轄區的一連串帳戶迅速轉移，而每次轉帳均無明顯商業目的。這最能說明洗錢的哪一階段？
options: 分層交易
存放
整合
拆細
tc.explain: 分層交易透過複雜多層的金融交易，將非法得益與其來源分開，以隱藏款項來源、掩飾審計線索及提供匿名性（第1.10(b)段）。存放是現金首次進入體系；整合則為資金製造表面合法性。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10段

en.q: What does the Guideline say about the number of transactions typically involved in the laundering of money?
options: The three stages frequently involve numerous transactions, and an MSO should be alert to any such sign of potential criminal activity
Laundering is normally completed in a single high-value transaction
Only transactions above HK$120,000 are relevant to laundering
The number of transactions is irrelevant once customer due diligence has been completed
en.explain: ¶1.10 states that there are three common stages in the laundering of money and that they frequently involve numerous transactions, and that an MSO should be alert to any such sign for potential criminal activities.

tc.q: 本指引就清洗黑錢一般涉及的交易宗數有何說明？
options: 三個階段往往涉及大量交易，金錢服務經營者應對任何此等潛在犯罪活動跡象保持警覺
清洗黑錢通常以單一宗大額交易完成
只有超過120,000港元的交易與清洗黑錢有關
一旦完成客戶盡職審查，交易宗數便無關重要
tc.explain: 第1.10段訂明清洗黑錢有三個常見階段，而該等階段往往涉及大量交易；金錢服務經營者應對任何此等潛在犯罪活動的跡象保持警覺。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.21段

en.q: Which of the following does the DTROP provide for?
options: Investigation of assets suspected to be derived from drug trafficking, freezing of assets on arrest, and confiscation of proceeds upon conviction
The licensing of money service operators in Hong Kong
The implementation of United Nations Security Council Resolutions on terrorism
The control of services that may assist the development of weapons of mass destruction
en.explain: ¶1.21 states that the DTROP contains provisions for the investigation of assets suspected to be derived from drug trafficking activities, the freezing of assets on arrest and the confiscation of the proceeds from drug trafficking upon conviction. Licensing is under the AMLO; UNSCR implementation is under the UNATMO and UNSO; WMD services are controlled by the WMD(CPS)O.

tc.q: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》就下列哪項作出規定？
options: 調查懷疑源自販毒活動的資產、在拘捕時凍結資產，以及在定罪後沒收得益
香港金錢服務經營者的發牌事宜
實施聯合國安理會有關恐怖主義的決議
管制可能協助發展大規模毀滅武器的服務
tc.explain: 第1.21段訂明《販毒（追討得益）條例》載有條文，就調查懷疑源自販毒活動的資產、在拘捕時凍結資產，以及在定罪後沒收販毒得益作出規定。發牌事宜由《打擊洗錢條例》規管；實施聯合國決議由《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》及《聯合國制裁條例》處理；大規模毀滅武器服務則由《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》管制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.21段

en.q: Under the OSCO, which orders may the Courts issue in relation to the property of a defendant charged with a specified offence?
options: Restraint orders and charging orders
Freezing notices issued by the Secretary for Security
Licences permitting dealings with designated property
Gazette notices specifying terrorist property
en.explain: ¶1.21(b) states that the OSCO gives the Courts jurisdiction to confiscate the proceeds of organized and serious crimes and to issue restraint orders and charging orders in relation to the property of a defendant of an offence specified in the OSCO. Freezing by the Secretary for Security and Gazette specification are UNATMO mechanisms.

tc.q: 根據《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》，就被控犯該條例指明罪行的被告人的財產，法庭可頒發哪類命令？
options: 限制令及押記令
由保安局局長發出的凍結通知
准許處理指明財產的許可證
指明恐怖分子財產的憲報公告
tc.explain: 第1.21(b)段訂明《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予法庭司法管轄權，沒收有組織及嚴重罪行的得益，並就該條例所指明罪行的被告人的財產頒發限制令及押記令。由保安局局長凍結財產及憲報指明均屬《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》的機制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.21段

en.q: Which officers does the OSCO empower to investigate organized crime and triad activities?
options: Officers of the Hong Kong Police and the Customs and Excise Department
Officers of the Securities and Futures Commission only
Officers of the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit only
Officers of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
en.explain: ¶1.21(a) states that the OSCO gives officers of the Hong Kong Police and the Customs and Excise Department powers to investigate organized crime and triad activities.

tc.q: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》授權哪些人員調查有組織罪行及三合會活動？
options: 香港警務處及香港海關的人員
只限證券及期貨事務監察委員會的人員
只限聯合財富情報組的人員
商務及經濟發展局的人員
tc.explain: 第1.21(a)段訂明《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予香港警務處及香港海關人員權力，調查有組織罪行及三合會活動。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.21段

en.q: Under the OSCO, in what circumstances may the Courts receive information about an offender and an offence in order to consider imposing a greater sentence?
options: Where the offence amounts to an organised crime or triad-related offence, or another serious offence
Where the offender has previously been the subject of a suspicious transaction report
Where the offence involves property exceeding HK$5 million in value
Where the offender is a licensed money service operator
en.explain: ¶1.21(d) states that the OSCO enables the Courts, under appropriate circumstances, to receive information about an offender and an offence in order to determine whether a greater sentence is appropriate where the offence amounts to an organised crime/triad related offence or other serious offences.

tc.q: 根據《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》，法庭在甚麼情況下可接收有關犯罪者及罪行的資料，以考慮判處更重刑罰？
options: 當該罪行屬有組織罪行或與三合會有關的罪行，或其他嚴重罪行
當該犯罪者此前曾為可疑交易報告的對象
當該罪行涉及價值超過500萬港元的財產
當該犯罪者是持牌金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 第1.21(d)段訂明《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》使法庭在適當情況下可接收有關犯罪者及罪行的資料，以決定當該罪行屬有組織罪行／與三合會有關的罪行或其他嚴重罪行時，判處更重刑罰是否恰當。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.21及6.3段

en.q: Besides preventing the financing of terrorist acts, which further threat is the UNATMO directed towards combating?
options: The threats posed by foreign terrorist fighters
The laundering of proceeds of drug trafficking
The proliferation of weapons of mass destruction by state actors
The evasion of exchange controls by cross-border remitters
en.explain: ¶1.21 states that the UNATMO is principally directed towards implementing decisions in relevant UNSCRs aimed at preventing the financing of terrorist acts and combating the threats posed by foreign terrorist fighters. ¶6.3 adds that it implements UNSCR 2178 (2014) on travel for terrorist purposes.

tc.q: 除防止恐怖主義行為的資金籌集外，《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》還針對打擊哪一項威脅？
options: 外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員所構成的威脅
販毒得益的清洗
國家行為者擴散大規模毀滅武器
跨境匯款商規避外匯管制
tc.explain: 第1.21段訂明《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》主要旨在實施相關聯合國安理會決議中的決定，以防止恐怖主義行為的資金籌集及打擊外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員所構成的威脅。第6.3段補充該條例實施關乎恐怖主義目的旅行的第2178號決議（2014年）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.23段

en.q: What is the highest penalty on conviction under the UNATMO for the provision or collection of property, or making property or financial (or related) services available, to terrorists or terrorist associates?
options: Imprisonment for 14 years and a fine
Imprisonment for 7 years and a fine of $1 million
Imprisonment for 3 years and a fine
Imprisonment for 3 months and a fine of $50,000
en.explain: ¶1.23 states that the highest penalty for the offence upon conviction is imprisonment for 14 years and a fine, and that the UNATMO also permits terrorist property to be frozen and subsequently forfeited.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，向恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者提供或籌集財產，或提供財產或財務（或相關）服務，一經定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁14年及罰款
監禁7年及罰款100萬元
監禁3年及罰款
監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
tc.explain: 第1.23段訂明該罪行一經定罪的最高刑罰為監禁14年及罰款；該條例亦准許凍結恐怖分子財產並其後予以充公。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.6; s.6(1), 8 & 8A(1) UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.6段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6(1)、8及8A(1)條

en.q: An MSO wishes to apply for a licence permitting a payment to be made for the benefit of a designated party under the UNATMO. To whom should it write?
options: The Security Bureau
The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
The Customs and Excise Department
en.explain: ¶6.6 states that the Secretary for Security can licence exceptions to the UNATMO prohibitions, and that an MSO seeking such a licence should write to the Security Bureau. Licences under the UNSO are a matter for the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau (¶6.8).

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者擬申請許可證，以便根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》為某被指定方的利益作出付款。它應向哪一機構提出？
options: 保安局
商務及經濟發展局
聯合財富情報組
香港海關
tc.explain: 第6.6段訂明保安局局長可就該條例的禁止規定發出許可證作為例外，而尋求該等許可證的金錢服務經營者應致函保安局。《聯合國制裁條例》下的許可證則由商務及經濟發展局處理（第6.8段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.6段

en.q: Which of the following is given in the Guideline as an example of a payment that the Secretary for Security may licence in favour of a designated party under the UNATMO?
options: Reasonable living or legal expenses, and payments liable to be made under the Employment Ordinance
Repayment of a commercial loan advanced before designation
Dividends payable on shares held by the designated party
Any payment not exceeding HK$8,000 in aggregate
en.explain: ¶6.6 states that the Secretary for Security can licence exceptions to enable frozen property to be unfrozen and to allow payments to be made to or for the benefit of a designated party, giving reasonable living/legal expenses and payments liable to be made under the Employment Ordinance as examples.

tc.q: 本指引就保安局局長可根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》發出許可證，准許向被指定方作出的付款，舉出下列哪項為例？
options: 合理的生活或法律開支，以及根據《僱傭條例》須支付的款項
償還在被指定前已批出的商業貸款
被指定方所持股份應付的股息
任何合計不超過8,000港元的付款
tc.explain: 第6.6段訂明保安局局長可就禁止規定發出許可證作為例外，使被凍結財產得以解凍，並准許向被指定方或為其利益作出付款，並以合理的生活／法律開支及根據《僱傭條例》須支付的款項為例。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段

en.q: Where are persons and entities designated under the UNSO specified?
options: By notice published in the Gazette or on the website of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
In a register maintained at the Customs and Excise Department's licensing office
In the Guideline's Glossary, which is updated annually
On the website of the Financial Action Task Force
en.explain: ¶6.7 states that designated persons and entities are specified by notice published in the Gazette or on the website of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau. ¶6.15 requires an MSO to include those lists in its screening database.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國制裁條例》被指定的人及實體，在何處指明？
options: 以憲報公告或於商務及經濟發展局網站公布的公告指明
於香港海關牌照辦事處備存的登記冊內
於本指引的詞彙表內，並每年更新
於財務行動特別組織的網站
tc.explain: 第6.7段訂明被指定的人及實體是以憲報公告或於商務及經濟發展局網站公布的公告指明。第6.15段規定金錢服務經營者須將該等名單納入其篩查資料庫。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7(a)段

en.q: Under the UNSO, the prohibition on making funds available extends beyond designated persons themselves. To whom else does it apply?
options: Persons or entities acting on behalf of or at the direction of designated persons, or owned or controlled by them, and entities owned by those persons
Only to immediate family members of designated persons
Only to entities incorporated in the jurisdiction that is the subject of the sanctions
Only to persons who have been convicted of a terrorist financing offence
en.explain: ¶6.7(a) provides that, except under the authority of a licence, it is an offence to make available funds or other financial assets or economic resources to or for the benefit of designated persons or entities, persons or entities acting on their behalf or at their direction or owned or controlled by them, or entities owned by the aforementioned.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國制裁條例》，禁止提供資金的規定除適用於被指定人士本身外，還適用於何人？
options: 代被指定人士行事或按其指示行事，或由其擁有或控制的人或實體，以及由上述者所擁有的實體
只適用於被指定人士的直系親屬
只適用於在受制裁司法管轄區註冊成立的實體
只適用於曾被裁定犯恐怖分子資金籌集罪行的人
tc.explain: 第6.7(a)段訂明，除非根據許可證的授權，否則向被指定的人或實體、代其行事或按其指示行事或由其擁有或控制的人或實體，或由上述者所擁有的實體，或為其利益提供資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，即屬犯罪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7(b)段

en.q: Apart from making funds available, what second category of conduct is an offence under the UNSO absent a licence?
options: Dealing, directly or indirectly, with funds, other financial assets or economic resources belonging to or owned or controlled by designated persons or entities
Failing to report a possible name match to the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
Retaining customer records for less than five years
Establishing a business relationship without face-to-face contact
en.explain: ¶6.7(b) makes it an offence, except under the authority of a licence granted by the Chief Executive, to deal with, directly or indirectly, any funds or other financial assets or economic resources belonging to, or owned or controlled by, designated persons or entities.

tc.q: 除提供資金外，在無許可證的情況下，《聯合國制裁條例》還將哪一類行為訂為罪行？
options: 直接或間接處理屬於被指定人士或實體，或由其擁有或控制的資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源
沒有向聯合財富情報組報告可能的名稱吻合個案
保存客戶紀錄少於5年
在沒有面對面接觸的情況下建立業務關係
tc.explain: 第6.7(b)段訂明，除非根據行政長官批出的許可證的授權，否則直接或間接處理屬於被指定人士或實體，或由其擁有或控制的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，即屬犯罪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.8段

en.q: An MSO seeks a licence under a regulation made under the UNSO to deal with funds owned by a designated entity. To whom should it write?
options: The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The Security Bureau
The Customs and Excise Department
The United Nations Security Council
en.explain: ¶6.8 states that the Chief Executive may grant such a licence under the relevant regulation made under the UNSO, and that an MSO seeking such a licence should write to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau. Licences under the UNATMO are sought from the Security Bureau (¶6.6).

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者根據《聯合國制裁條例》下訂立的規例，尋求許可證以處理某被指定實體所擁有的資金。它應向哪一機構提出？
options: 商務及經濟發展局
保安局
香港海關
聯合國安全理事會
tc.explain: 第6.8段訂明行政長官可根據《聯合國制裁條例》下訂立的相關規例批出該等許可證，而尋求該等許可證的金錢服務經營者應致函商務及經濟發展局。《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》下的許可證則向保安局申請（第6.6段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: Which UNSCR represents the global limb of the UN Security Council's two-tiered approach to combating proliferation financing?
en.explain: ¶6.9 states that the UNSC adopts a two-tiered approach: a global approach under UNSCR 1540 (2004) and its successor resolutions, and a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against Iran. UNSCR 1373 concerns terrorist financing.

tc.q: 聯合國安理會打擊擴散資金籌集的雙層方針中，哪一項決議屬全球性的一環？
tc.explain: 第6.9段訂明聯合國安理會採取雙層方針：根據第1540號決議（2004年）及其後續決議的全球性方針，以及根據針對朝鮮的第1718號決議（2006年）及針對伊朗的第2231號決議（2015年）的國別方針。第1373號決議關乎恐怖分子資金籌集。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: UNSCR 1718 (2006) and its successor resolutions form the country-specific limb of the counter-proliferation approach in respect of which country?
options: The Democratic People's Republic of Korea
The Islamic Republic of Iran
The Russian Federation
The Republic of Iraq
en.explain: ¶6.9 identifies the country-specific approach as UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against Iran, together with their successor resolutions.

tc.q: 第1718號決議（2006年）及其後續決議所構成的打擊擴散資金籌集國別方針，是針對哪一個國家？
options: 朝鮮民主主義人民共和國
伊朗伊斯蘭共和國
俄羅斯聯邦
伊拉克共和國
tc.explain: 第6.9段指出國別方針為針對朝鮮的第1718號決議（2006年）及針對伊朗的第2231號決議（2015年），連同其後續決議。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: Under which Chapter of the UN Charter does the UN Security Council adopt the resolutions imposing mandatory counter-proliferation obligations on member states?
options: Chapter VII
Chapter IV
Chapter VI
Chapter IX
en.explain: ¶6.9 states that to combat PF the UNSC adopts a two-tiered approach through resolutions made under Chapter VII of the UN Charter, imposing mandatory obligations on UN member states.

tc.q: 聯合國安理會根據《聯合國憲章》哪一章通過決議，向成員國施加強制性的打擊擴散資金籌集責任？
options: 第七章
第四章
第六章
第九章
tc.explain: 第6.9段訂明，為打擊擴散資金籌集，聯合國安理會透過根據《聯合國憲章》第七章通過的決議採取雙層方針，向聯合國成員國施加強制性責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.10段

en.q: Through which legislation is Hong Kong's counter-proliferation financing regime implemented?
options: Regulations made under the UNSO specific to the DPRK and Iran, together with the WMD(CPS)O
The AMLO and its Schedule 2 alone
The OSCO and the DTROP
The UNATMO and the Employment Ordinance
en.explain: ¶6.10 states that the counter-proliferation financing regime in Hong Kong is implemented through legislation including the regulations made under the UNSO which are specific to the DPRK and Iran, and the WMD(CPS)O.

tc.q: 香港的打擊擴散資金籌集制度透過哪些法例實施？
options: 根據《聯合國制裁條例》就朝鮮及伊朗訂立的規例，連同《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》
僅《打擊洗錢條例》及其附表2
《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》及《販毒（追討得益）條例》
《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》及《僱傭條例》
tc.explain: 第6.10段訂明，香港的打擊擴散資金籌集制度透過法例實施，包括根據《聯合國制裁條例》就朝鮮及伊朗訂立的規例，以及《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.27, ¶6.10; s.4 WMD(CPS)O
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.27及6.10段；《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條

en.q: How widely is “the provision of services” defined for the purposes of section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O?
options: Widely — it includes the lending of money or other provision of financial assistance
Narrowly — it covers only the physical supply of controlled goods
It covers only services provided under a written contract
It covers only services provided to a government or state agency
en.explain: ¶1.27 and ¶6.10 both state that the provision of services is widely defined and includes the lending of money or other provision of financial assistance. Section 4 prohibits providing services where the person believes or suspects on reasonable grounds that they may be connected to PF.

tc.q: 就《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條而言，「提供服務」的定義有多廣泛？
options: 定義廣泛——包括借出款項或以其他方式提供財政資助
定義狹窄——只涵蓋實際供應受管制物品
只涵蓋根據書面合約提供的服務
只涵蓋向政府或國家機構提供的服務
tc.explain: 第1.27及6.10段均訂明「提供服務」的定義廣泛，包括借出款項或以其他方式提供財政資助。第4條禁止任何人在有合理理由相信或懷疑有關服務可能與擴散資金籌集有關連的情況下提供該等服務。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.11段

en.q: What does the Guideline say about unilateral sanctions imposed by authorities in other jurisdictions?
options: An MSO operating internationally should be aware of their scope and focus and, where they may affect its operations, consider the implications and take appropriate measures
An MSO must comply with them in full as if they were Hong Kong law
An MSO must disregard them entirely, as only Hong Kong law applies
An MSO must obtain the CCE's approval before taking any account of them
en.explain: ¶6.11 states that while MSOs do not normally have any obligation under Hong Kong laws to have regard to unilateral sanctions imposed in other jurisdictions, an MSO operating internationally will need to be aware of the scope and focus of those regimes and, where they may affect its operations, should consider the implications and take appropriate measures.

tc.q: 本指引就其他司法管轄區當局實施的單方面制裁有何說明？
options: 在國際間經營的金錢服務經營者應了解其範圍及重點，若可能影響其運作，應考慮相關影響並採取適當措施
金錢服務經營者必須全面遵從，猶如該等制裁屬香港法律
金錢服務經營者必須完全不予理會，因只有香港法律適用
金錢服務經營者在顧及該等制裁前，必須取得海關關長批准
tc.explain: 第6.11段訂明，雖然金錢服務經營者一般在香港法律下並無責任顧及其他司法管轄區實施的單方面制裁，但在國際間經營的金錢服務經營者須了解該等制裁制度的範圍及重點；若可能影響其運作，應考慮有關影響並採取適當措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.13段

en.q: An MSO subscribes to a database of terrorists and designated parties maintained by a third-party service provider. What should it do in addition?
options: Take appropriate measures, such as periodic sample testing, to ensure the completeness and accuracy of the database
Nothing further — responsibility for accuracy passes to the service provider
Notify the CCE in writing before each screening run
Restrict the database to names published in the Hong Kong Gazette
en.explain: ¶6.13 permits an MSO to subscribe to a third-party database as an alternative to maintaining its own, but requires it to take appropriate measures — the Guideline gives periodic sample testing as an example — to ensure the completeness and accuracy of the database.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者訂用由第三方服務供應商備存的恐怖分子及被指定方資料庫。它還應怎樣做？
options: 採取適當措施，例如定期抽樣測試，以確保資料庫完整及準確
無須再做——準確性的責任已轉移予服務供應商
在每次進行篩查前以書面通知海關關長
將資料庫限於香港憲報公布的名單
tc.explain: 第6.13段准許金錢服務經營者訂用第三方資料庫，以代替自行備存，但規定其須採取適當措施——指引以定期抽樣測試為例——以確保資料庫的完整性及準確性。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.13段

en.q: What is the stated purpose of an MSO maintaining a database of names and particulars of terrorists and designated parties?
options: To enable it to identify terrorist suspects and possible designated parties and to detect prohibited transactions
To satisfy the record-keeping period prescribed by Schedule 2
To allow the CCE to inspect the MSO's customer list on demand
To provide the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit with a copy of the MSO's customer records
en.explain: ¶6.13 states that it is particularly vital that an MSO should be able to identify terrorist suspects and possible designated parties, and detect prohibited transactions; to this end it should maintain a database consolidating the various lists made known to it.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者備存恐怖分子及被指定方的姓名及詳情資料庫，其訂明目的為何？
options: 使其能識別懷疑恐怖分子及可能被指定的一方，並偵測被禁止的交易
符合附表2訂明的紀錄保存期
讓海關關長可隨時查閱該金錢服務經營者的客戶名單
向聯合財富情報組提供該金錢服務經營者客戶紀錄的副本
tc.explain: 第6.13段訂明，金錢服務經營者能識別懷疑恐怖分子及可能被指定的一方並偵測被禁止的交易，尤為重要；為此，其應備存一個綜合各份已知名單的資料庫。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.14段

en.q: What may the inclusion of a country, individual, entity or activity in a UNSCR or sanctions list constitute for the purposes of the relevant ML, TF and PF laws?
options: Grounds for knowledge or suspicion, thereby triggering statutory reporting obligations and offence provisions
Conclusive proof that an offence has been committed
An automatic exemption from customer due diligence requirements
A defence to a charge of dealing with terrorist property
en.explain: ¶6.14 states that whether or not a UNSCR or sanctions list has been implemented through Hong Kong legislation, inclusion in such a list may constitute grounds for knowledge or suspicion for the purposes of relevant ML, TF and PF laws, thereby triggering statutory (including reporting) obligations as well as offence provisions.

tc.q: 就相關洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集法例而言，某國家、個人、實體或活動被列入聯合國安理會決議或制裁名單，可構成甚麼？
options: 構成知情或懷疑的理由，從而觸發法定匯報責任及罪行條文
構成罪行已經干犯的確證
自動獲豁免遵守客戶盡職審查規定
可作為被控處理恐怖分子財產的抗辯理由
tc.explain: 第6.14段訂明，不論某項聯合國安理會決議或制裁名單有否透過香港法例實施，被列入該等名單可就相關洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集法例而言構成知情或懷疑的理由，從而觸發法定責任（包括匯報責任）及罪行條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.14段

en.q: When should countries, individuals and entities newly included in UNSCRs and sanctions lists be added to an MSO's database?
options: As soon as practicable after promulgation by the UNSC, regardless of whether the sanctions have been implemented by Hong Kong legislation
Only once the relevant sanctions have been implemented by Hong Kong legislation
At the next annual review of the MSO's AML/CFT systems
Only when the CCE issues a circular expressly requiring it
en.explain: ¶6.14 requires MSOs to ensure that countries, individuals and entities included in UNSCRs and sanctions lists are included in the database as soon as practicable after promulgation by the UNSC and regardless of whether the relevant sanctions have been implemented by legislation in Hong Kong.

tc.q: 新列入聯合國安理會決議及制裁名單的國家、個人及實體，應何時加入金錢服務經營者的資料庫？
options: 在聯合國安理會公布後在切實可行範圍內盡快加入，不論有關制裁有否透過香港法例實施
只在有關制裁已透過香港法例實施後
在該金錢服務經營者下次年度檢視打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集系統時
只在海關關長發出通函明確要求時
tc.explain: 第6.14段規定金錢服務經營者須確保列入聯合國安理會決議及制裁名單的國家、個人及實體，在安理會公布後在切實可行範圍內盡快納入資料庫，而不論有關制裁有否已透過香港法例實施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.15段

en.q: Which lists should an MSO include in its screening database?
options: The lists published in the Gazette or on the website of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau, and the lists the CCE draws to MSOs' attention from time to time
Only the lists published in the Hong Kong Gazette
Only the consolidated list maintained by the Financial Action Task Force
Only lists relating to jurisdictions to which the MSO actually remits funds
en.explain: ¶6.15 states that an MSO should include in its database (a) the lists published in the Gazette or on the website of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau, and (b) the lists that the CCE draws to the attention of MSOs from time to time.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應將哪些名單納入其篩查資料庫？
options: 於憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站公布的名單，以及海關關長不時提請金錢服務經營者注意的名單
只限於香港憲報公布的名單
只限財務行動特別組織備存的綜合名單
只限與該金錢服務經營者實際匯款目的地有關的名單
tc.explain: 第6.15段訂明金錢服務經營者應在其資料庫納入：(a)於憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站公布的名單；及(b)海關關長不時提請金錢服務經營者注意的名單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.15段

en.q: Besides being kept up to date, what other quality does the Guideline require of an MSO's screening database?
options: It should be made easily accessible by relevant staff
It should be stored only in hard-copy form at the MSO's registered office
It should be encrypted so that only the compliance officer can open it
It should be filed with the CCE each time it is amended
en.explain: ¶6.15 states that the database should be subject to timely update whenever there are changes, and should be made easily accessible by relevant staff. Restricting access to a single officer would defeat the screening purpose described in ¶6.13.

tc.q: 除須及時更新外，本指引還要求金錢服務經營者的篩查資料庫具備甚麼特質？
options: 應令有關員工易於取用
應只以印本形式存放於該金錢服務經營者的註冊辦事處
應予加密，使只有合規主任方可開啟
每次修訂後應向海關關長存檔
tc.explain: 第6.15段訂明，資料庫在有任何變更時應及時更新，並應令有關員工易於取用。若只限單一人員取用，將有違第6.13段所述的篩查目的。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.16(a)段

en.q: At what point should an MSO first screen a customer and any beneficial owners against its current database?
options: At the establishment of the business relationship
At the first anniversary of the business relationship
Only when a transaction exceeds HK$8,000
Only when the customer is assessed as high risk
en.explain: ¶6.16(a) requires screening of customers and any beneficial owners against the current database at the establishment of the relationship. Footnote 58 makes clear that screening is carried out irrespective of the risk profile attributed to the customer.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應在何時首次將客戶及任何實益擁有人與其現行資料庫作篩查？
options: 在建立業務關係時
在業務關係的首個周年日
只在交易超過8,000港元時
只在該客戶被評為高風險時
tc.explain: 第6.16(a)段規定在建立業務關係時，將客戶及任何實益擁有人與現行資料庫作篩查。註腳58明確指出，不論客戶被評定的風險狀況為何，均須進行篩查。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.16段註腳58

en.q: Does the risk profile attributed to a customer affect whether screening against the sanctions database is carried out?
options: No — screening should be carried out irrespective of the risk profile attributed to the customer
Yes — only customers assessed as medium or high risk need be screened
Yes — low-risk customers may be screened once every three years instead
Yes — screening is required only for customers resident outside Hong Kong
en.explain: Footnote 58 to ¶6.16 states expressly that screening should be carried out irrespective of the risk profile attributed to the customer. Unlike the extent of CDD measures, screening is not risk-adjustable.

tc.q: 客戶被評定的風險狀況，是否影響須否與制裁資料庫進行篩查？
options: 不影響——不論客戶被評定的風險狀況為何，均應進行篩查
影響——只有被評為中或高風險的客戶才須篩查
影響——低風險客戶可改為每三年篩查一次
影響——只有居於香港以外的客戶才須篩查
tc.explain: 第6.16段的註腳58明確訂明，不論客戶被評定的風險狀況為何，均應進行篩查。與客戶盡職審查措施的程度不同，篩查並不可按風險調整。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.16(c)段

en.q: In a cross-border wire transfer, which parties should be screened against the current database, and when?
options: All relevant parties to the transfer, before executing the transfer
Only the originator, before executing the transfer
