Only the recipient, within 24 hours after execution
Only parties whose names appear in a language other than English
en.explain: ¶6.16(c) requires screening of all relevant parties in a cross-border / cross-boundary wire transfer, including a remittance transaction, against the current database before executing the transfer. Screening after execution would not prevent a prohibited transaction.

tc.q: 在跨境電匯中，應將哪些方與現行資料庫作篩查，並於何時進行？
options: 該項轉帳的所有有關各方，並須在執行轉帳前進行
只限匯款人，並須在執行轉帳前進行
只限收款人，並須在執行後24小時內進行
只限姓名以英文以外語言顯示的各方
tc.explain: 第6.16(c)段規定，在執行跨境／跨界電匯（包括匯款交易）前，須將所有有關各方與現行資料庫作篩查。在執行後才篩查將無法防止被禁止的交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.17段

en.q: Beyond customers and their beneficial owners, to whom should the screening requirements at the establishment of a relationship and on new designations extend?
options: Connected parties and persons purporting to act on behalf of a customer, using a risk-based approach
Every person who has ever received a remittance from the customer
All employees of the MSO and their immediate families
Only parties resident in a jurisdiction subject to UN sanctions
en.explain: ¶6.17 states that the screening requirements at ¶6.16(a) and (b) should extend to connected parties as defined in ¶4.3.19 and to persons purporting to act on behalf of a customer (PPTAs), using a risk-based approach.

tc.q: 除客戶及其實益擁有人外，在建立關係時及就新指定進行的篩查規定，還應延伸至何人？
options: 採用風險為本方式，延伸至有關連人士及聲稱代客戶行事的人
客戶曾匯款予的每一名收款人
該金錢服務經營者的所有僱員及其直系親屬
只限居於受聯合國制裁的司法管轄區的各方
tc.explain: 第6.17段訂明，第6.16(a)及(b)段的篩查規定應採用風險為本方式，延伸至第4.3.19段所界定的有關連人士，以及聲稱代客戶行事的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.18段

en.q: A screening run produces a possible name match. What should the MSO do next?
options: Conduct enhanced checks to determine whether the possible match is a genuine hit
Freeze the customer's funds immediately without further enquiry
Treat the match as a false positive unless the customer complains
Refer the customer to another MSO and close the relationship
en.explain: ¶6.18 states that when possible name matches are identified during screening, an MSO should conduct enhanced checks to determine whether the possible matches are genuine hits, and in case of any suspicion of TF, PF or sanctions violations should report to the JFIU.

tc.q: 篩查結果顯示可能出現名稱吻合。該金錢服務經營者接着應怎樣做？
options: 進行加強查核，以確定該可能吻合是否真正吻合
即時凍結客戶資金，無須再作查詢
除非客戶投訴，否則視作誤報處理
將客戶轉介另一金錢服務經營者並終止關係
tc.explain: 第6.18段訂明，篩查期間識別出可能的名稱吻合時，金錢服務經營者應進行加強查核，以確定該等可能吻合是否真正吻合；如懷疑涉及恐怖分子資金籌集、擴散資金籌集或違反制裁，應向聯合財富情報組作出報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.18段

en.q: What records relating to sanctions screening should an MSO keep?
options: Records of enhanced checking results together with all screening records, documented or recorded electronically
Only records of confirmed genuine hits
Only the screening records for customers assessed as high risk
No records are required once a match has been cleared as a false positive
en.explain: ¶6.18 requires that records of enhanced checking results, together with all screening records, should be documented or recorded electronically. The requirement is not limited to genuine hits or to high-risk customers.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者就制裁篩查應保存哪些紀錄？
options: 加強查核結果的紀錄連同所有篩查紀錄，以文件記錄或電子方式記錄
只限已確認為真正吻合的紀錄
只限被評為高風險客戶的篩查紀錄
一旦吻合被確認為誤報，即無須保存紀錄
tc.explain: 第6.18段規定，加強查核結果的紀錄連同所有篩查紀錄，均應以文件記錄或電子方式記錄。此規定並不限於真正吻合的個案或高風險客戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.19段

en.q: An MSO relies on its overseas office to maintain the sanctions database and undertake screening. Where does responsibility for compliance rest?
options: The ultimate responsibility for ensuring compliance remains with the MSO
Responsibility transfers to the overseas office once the arrangement is documented
Responsibility is shared equally between the MSO and the overseas office
Responsibility rests with the regulator of the jurisdiction in which the overseas office is located
en.explain: ¶6.19 permits an MSO to rely on its overseas office to maintain the database or undertake screening, but reminds the MSO that the ultimate responsibility for ensuring compliance with the relevant regulations and legislation on TF, financial sanctions and PF remains with the MSO.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者倚賴其海外辦事處備存制裁資料庫及進行篩查。合規責任由誰承擔？
options: 確保合規的最終責任仍由該金錢服務經營者承擔
一經以文件記錄該安排，責任即轉移予海外辦事處
由該金錢服務經營者與海外辦事處平均分擔
由該海外辦事處所在司法管轄區的監管機構承擔
tc.explain: 第6.19段准許金錢服務經營者倚賴其海外辦事處備存資料庫或進行篩查程序，但提醒該金錢服務經營者，確保遵從有關恐怖分子資金籌集、金融制裁及擴散資金籌集的規例及法例的最終責任，仍由該金錢服務經營者承擔。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.12段

en.q: What does the Guideline require of an MSO in relation to its staff's understanding of the obligations on TF, financial sanctions and PF?
options: The legal and regulatory obligations should be well understood, and adequate guidance and training should be provided to staff
Only the compliance officer needs to understand these obligations
Staff understanding is required only where the MSO operates internationally
Training on these obligations is required only after a genuine hit is identified
en.explain: ¶6.12 requires an MSO to establish and maintain effective policies, procedures and controls to ensure compliance with the relevant regulations and legislation on TF, financial sanctions and PF, and states that the legal and regulatory obligations of the MSO and its staff should be well understood, with adequate guidance and training provided to staff.

tc.q: 就員工對恐怖分子資金籌集、金融制裁及擴散資金籌集責任的了解，本指引對金錢服務經營者有何要求？
options: 法律及監管責任應獲充分理解，並應向員工提供足夠指引及培訓
只有合規主任須理解該等責任
只有在國際間經營的金錢服務經營者才須確保員工理解
只有在識別出真正吻合個案後才須就該等責任提供培訓
tc.explain: 第6.12段規定金錢服務經營者須建立及維持有效的政策、程序及管控措施，以確保遵從有關恐怖分子資金籌集、金融制裁及擴散資金籌集的規例及法例，並訂明該經營者及其員工的法律及監管責任應獲充分理解，且應向員工提供足夠的指引及培訓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.1段

en.q: Why can property used for terrorist financing be harder to detect than the proceeds of money laundering?
options: Because it may have been derived from legitimate sources, so what matters is the destination or use of the property rather than its source
Because terrorist financing always involves amounts below the reporting threshold
Because terrorist financing is not an offence under Hong Kong law
Because terrorist property is exempt from customer due diligence requirements
en.explain: ¶6.1 explains that, unlike ML where the focus is on the handling of criminal proceeds and the source of property is what matters, the focus of TF is on the destination or use of property, which may have derived from legitimate sources.

tc.q: 用於恐怖分子資金籌集的財產，為何可能較洗錢得益更難偵測？
options: 因該等財產可能源自合法來源，重點在於財產的去向或用途，而非其來源
因恐怖分子資金籌集所涉款額必定低於申報門檻
因恐怖分子資金籌集在香港法律下並非罪行
因恐怖分子財產獲豁免遵守客戶盡職審查規定
tc.explain: 第6.1段解釋，洗錢的重點在於處理犯罪得益，關鍵在於財產的來源；而恐怖分子資金籌集的重點則在於財產的去向或用途，該等財產可能源自合法來源。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.4; s.4 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.4段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第4條

en.q: Where a UNSC Committee designates a person as a terrorist, what may the Chief Executive do under section 4 of the UNATMO?
options: Publish a notice in the Gazette specifying the name of the person
Issue a freezing notice directly to every licensed MSO
Direct the Customs and Excise Department to revoke the person's MSO licence
Apply to the Financial Action Task Force for confirmation of the designation
en.explain: ¶6.4 states that where a person or property is designated by a UNSC Committee, the Chief Executive may publish a notice in the Gazette specifying the name of the person or the property under section 4 of the UNATMO. Section 5 provides the alternative route of applying to the Court of First Instance.

tc.q: 當聯合國安理會轄下委員會指定某人為恐怖分子時，行政長官可根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第4條作出甚麼？
options: 在憲報刊登公告，指明該人的姓名
直接向每名持牌金錢服務經營者發出凍結通知
指示香港海關撤銷該人的金錢服務經營者牌照
向財務行動特別組織申請確認該項指定
tc.explain: 第6.4段訂明，凡某人或某財產由聯合國安理會轄下委員會指定，行政長官可根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第4條在憲報刊登公告，指明該人的姓名或該財產。第5條則提供向原訟法庭申請的另一途徑。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.5(d); s.8A UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(d)段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第8A條

en.q: Section 8A of the UNATMO prohibits dealing with property in what circumstances?
options: Where the person knows that, or is reckless as to whether, the property is specified terrorist property or property of a specified terrorist or terrorist associate
Only where the person has actual knowledge that the property is terrorist property
Only where the property exceeds HK$120,000 in value
Only where the property is held in an account outside Hong Kong
en.explain: ¶6.5(d) states that section 8A prohibits any person from dealing with any property knowing that, or being reckless as to whether, the property is specified terrorist property or property of a specified terrorist or terrorist associate. Recklessness suffices and no monetary threshold applies.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第8A條在甚麼情況下禁止處理財產？
options: 當該人知道或罔顧該財產是否指明恐怖分子財產，或指明恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者的財產
只限該人實際知道該財產屬恐怖分子財產的情況
只限該財產價值超過120,000港元的情況
只限該財產存放於香港以外帳戶的情況
tc.explain: 第6.5(d)段訂明第8A條禁止任何人處理任何財產，而知道或罔顧該財產是否指明恐怖分子財產，或指明恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者的財產。罔顧已屬足夠，亦無款額下限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: What status do the FATF Recommendations have?
options: They are recognised as the international standard for combating ML, TF and PF
They are directly enforceable in Hong Kong as subsidiary legislation
They are binding only on jurisdictions that have failed a FATF evaluation
They are voluntary guidance with no bearing on national legislation
en.explain: ¶1.13 states that the FATF has developed a series of recommendations recognised as the international standard for combating ML, TF and PF, forming the basis for a co-ordinated response and helping ensure a level playing field. They are implemented through domestic legislation rather than being directly enforceable.

tc.q: 財務行動特別組織的建議具有甚麼地位？
options: 獲公認為打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的國際標準
在香港可作為附屬法例直接強制執行
只對未能通過財務行動特別組織評估的司法管轄區具約束力
屬自願性指引，與本地法例無關
tc.explain: 第1.13段訂明財務行動特別組織已制定一系列建議，獲公認為打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的國際標準，並成為協調應對措施的基礎，有助確保公平競爭環境。該等建議透過本地法例實施，而非直接強制執行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: Why does the Guideline say it is important for Hong Kong to comply with international AML/CFT standards?
options: In order to maintain its status as an international financial centre
In order to qualify for membership of the United Nations
In order to reduce the licence fees payable by money service operators
In order to permit the Chief Executive to make regulations under the UNSO
en.explain: ¶1.13 states that as a member of the FATF, Hong Kong is obliged to implement the latest FATF Recommendations, and that it is important that Hong Kong complies with international AML/CFT standards in order to maintain its status as an international financial centre.

tc.q: 本指引為何指出香港遵從國際打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集標準十分重要？
options: 以維持香港作為國際金融中心的地位
以取得聯合國成員國資格
以減低金錢服務經營者須繳付的牌照費用
以使行政長官可根據《聯合國制裁條例》訂立規例
tc.explain: 第1.13段訂明，作為財務行動特別組織成員，香港有責任實施最新的財務行動特別組織建議，而香港遵從國際打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集標準，對維持其國際金融中心地位十分重要。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.14段

en.q: The Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance is which chapter of the Laws of Hong Kong?
options: Cap. 405
Cap. 455
Cap. 537
Cap. 615
en.explain: ¶1.14 identifies the DTROP as Cap. 405. Cap. 455 is the OSCO, Cap. 537 is the UNSO and Cap. 615 is the AMLO.

tc.q: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》是香港法例第幾章？
options: 第405章
第455章
第537章
第615章
tc.explain: 第1.14段指出《販毒（追討得益）條例》為第405章。第455章為《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》，第537章為《聯合國制裁條例》，第615章則為《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.14段

en.q: The United Nations Sanctions Ordinance is which chapter of the Laws of Hong Kong?
options: Cap. 537
Cap. 575
Cap. 526
Cap. 455
en.explain: ¶1.14 identifies the UNSO as Cap. 537. Cap. 575 is the UNATMO, Cap. 526 is the WMD(CPS)O and Cap. 455 is the OSCO.

tc.q: 《聯合國制裁條例》是香港法例第幾章？
options: 第537章
第575章
第526章
第455章
tc.explain: 第1.14段指出《聯合國制裁條例》為第537章。第575章為《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，第526章為《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》，第455章則為《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.15段

en.q: Which requirements does the AMLO impose on MSOs, alongside conferring supervisory powers on the CCE?
options: Requirements relating to customer due diligence and record-keeping
Requirements to maintain a minimum level of paid-up capital
Requirements to insure against losses arising from fraud
Requirements to publish annual audited accounts
en.explain: ¶1.15 states that the AMLO imposes requirements relating to CDD and record-keeping on MSOs and provides the CCE with powers to supervise compliance with these and other requirements under the AMLO.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》除賦予海關關長監管權力外，還對金錢服務經營者施加哪些規定？
options: 有關客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存的規定
維持最低實繳股本水平的規定
就欺詐所引致損失投購保險的規定
刊發經審計周年帳目的規定
tc.explain: 第1.15段訂明《打擊洗錢條例》向金錢服務經營者施加有關客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存的規定，並賦予海關關長權力，監管其對該等規定及該條例下其他規定的遵行情況。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — TBML guidance
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——打擊以貿易進行洗錢活動指引

en.q: How does the C&ED circular of 20 January 2026 define trade-based money laundering?
options: The process of disguising the proceeds of crime and moving value through the use of trade activities to legitimise their illegal origins or finance criminal activities
The under-declaration of customs duty on imported goods
The financing of international trade by unlicensed money lenders
The use of letters of credit issued by banks outside Hong Kong
en.explain: The circular defines TBML as the process of disguising the proceeds of crime and moving value through the use of trade activities in an attempt to legitimise their illegal origins or finance criminal activities. Customs duty evasion and unlicensed lending are different matters.

tc.q: 2026年1月20日的香港海關通函如何界定「以貿易進行的洗錢活動」？
options: 透過貿易活動掩飾犯罪得益及轉移價值，藉以使其非法來源合法化或資助犯罪活動的過程
短報進口貨物應繳關稅
由無牌放債人為國際貿易提供融資
使用由香港以外銀行開立的信用證
tc.explain: 該通函將以貿易進行的洗錢活動界定為：透過貿易活動掩飾犯罪得益及轉移價值，藉以使其非法來源合法化或資助犯罪活動的過程。逃避關稅及無牌放債屬另一回事。

source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）

en.q: Which recent typology did the C&ED draw to MSOs' attention in its trade-based money laundering circular?
options: The use of falsified trade documents, such as fake contracts and invoices, to create bogus transaction records and disguise illicit money as legitimate trade income
The use of automated teller machines to withdraw structured amounts of cash
The impersonation of Customs officers to obtain customer records
The use of prepaid mobile telephone credit as a store of value
en.explain: The circular draws attention to recent TBML typologies involving the use of falsified trade documents, such as fake contracts and invoices, to create bogus transaction records and disguise illicit money as legitimate trade income.

tc.q: 香港海關在其打擊以貿易進行洗錢活動的通函中，提請金錢服務經營者注意哪一項近期手法？
options: 使用偽造貿易文件（例如虛假合約及發票）製造虛假交易紀錄，將非法資金偽裝成合法貿易收入
使用自動櫃員機提取經拆細的現金
冒充海關人員以取得客戶紀錄
以預付流動電話儲值作為價值儲存工具
tc.explain: 該通函提請注意近期以貿易進行洗錢活動的手法，涉及使用偽造貿易文件（例如虛假合約及發票）製造虛假交易紀錄，將非法資金偽裝成合法貿易收入。

source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）

en.q: Which service offered by MSOs does the C&ED identify as capable of being exploited as a conduit for transferring trade-based crime proceeds?
options: Cross-boundary remittance service
Bureau de change services for tourists
Safe deposit box services
Payroll processing services
en.explain: The circular states that cross-boundary remittance service offered by MSOs could be exploited as one of the conduits for transfer of the trade-based crime proceeds, with criminals using shell companies and fabricated documents to obscure the beneficial owner or the source of illicit funds.

tc.q: 香港海關指出金錢服務經營者提供的哪一項服務，可被利用作轉移貿易犯罪得益的渠道？
options: 跨境匯款服務
為旅客提供的貨幣兌換服務
保管箱服務
薪酬處理服務
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，金錢服務經營者提供的跨境匯款服務可被利用作轉移貿易犯罪得益的渠道之一，犯罪分子會利用空殼公司及虛構文件，以隱藏實益擁有人身分或非法資金來源。

source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）

en.q: Whose risk indicators did the C&ED provide to help MSOs identify suspicious activities associated with trade-based money laundering?
options: Those designed by the Financial Action Task Force
Those designed by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority
Those designed by the World Customs Organization
Those designed by the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
en.explain: The circular states that the risk indicators designed by the FATF are provided to enhance the ability of MSOs to identify suspicious activities associated with TBML, and gives the FATF web address for the relevant publication.

tc.q: 香港海關提供由哪一機構設計的風險指標，以協助金錢服務經營者識別與以貿易進行洗錢活動有關的可疑活動？
options: 財務行動特別組織
香港金融管理局
世界海關組織
聯合財富情報組
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，提供由財務行動特別組織設計的風險指標，以提升金錢服務經營者識別與以貿易進行洗錢活動有關的可疑活動的能力，並載列有關刊物的財務行動特別組織網址。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — Understanding of ML/TF risks
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——了解洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險

en.q: Where multiple risk indicators are present on a customer, what does the C&ED say MSOs should give particular attention to?
options: Flagging and escalating the case to the MSO's senior management
Terminating the relationship without notice to the customer
Reducing the frequency of transaction monitoring to avoid duplication
Referring the customer directly to the Financial Action Task Force
en.explain: The circular states that particular attention should be given to flagging and escalating cases to MSOs' senior management where multiple risk indicators are present on the customers, supported by adequate training and guidance for staff in both the first and second lines of defence.

tc.q: 當客戶身上出現多項風險指標時，香港海關指出金錢服務經營者應特別注意甚麼？
options: 將個案標示並向該金錢服務經營者的高級管理層呈報
不通知客戶而終止關係
減低交易監察頻率以免重複
將該客戶直接轉介財務行動特別組織
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，當客戶身上出現多項風險指標時，應特別注意將個案標示並向高級管理層呈報，並須以足夠的員工培訓及指引支援，使第一及第二道防線均具備充分的風險意識。

source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——客戶盡職審查

en.q: Which category of customer does the C&ED identify as posing much higher ML and TF risks in the trade-based money laundering context?
options: Newly established legal entities without significant assets, employees and/or active business operations
Individuals who have held an account with the MSO for more than ten years
Customers who remit only to jurisdictions within Greater China
Customers who conduct transactions exclusively in Hong Kong dollars
en.explain: The circular states that MSOs should pay attention to the much higher ML and TF risks posed by customers who are newly established legal entities without significant assets, employees and/or active business operations — the profile typical of a shell company.

tc.q: 在以貿易進行洗錢活動的情境中，香港海關指出哪一類客戶構成高得多的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險？
options: 新成立而並無重大資產、僱員及／或活躍業務營運的法人實體
在該金錢服務經營者開立帳戶超過十年的個人
只向大中華地區匯款的客戶
只以港元進行交易的客戶
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，金錢服務經營者應注意新成立而並無重大資產、僱員及／或活躍業務營運的法人實體客戶，構成高得多的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險——這正是空殼公司的典型特徵。

source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——客戶盡職審查

en.q: What does the C&ED suggest MSOs proactively consider applying in order to verify the genuineness of a transaction and assess the likelihood of shell companies being involved?
options: Anti-fraud procedures for scrutinizing information obtained from customers
A blanket prohibition on all corporate customers incorporated overseas
A requirement that all transactions be settled in cash
A fixed transaction ceiling of HK$8,000 for every customer
en.explain: The circular states that MSOs should proactively consider applying anti-fraud procedures for scrutinizing information obtained from customers, in order to verify the genuineness of the transaction and assess the likelihood of shell companies being involved as an originator or a recipient.

tc.q: 為核實交易的真確性及評估是否可能涉及空殼公司，香港海關建議金錢服務經營者主動考慮採用甚麼？
options: 反欺詐程序，以審視從客戶取得的資料
全面禁止所有在海外註冊成立的公司客戶
規定所有交易須以現金結算
為每名客戶設定8,000港元的固定交易上限
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，金錢服務經營者應主動考慮採用反欺詐程序審視從客戶取得的資料，以核實交易的真確性，並評估交易的匯款人或收款人是否可能涉及空殼公司。

source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——客戶盡職審查

en.q: Which additional information does the C&ED suggest MSOs consider obtaining to better understand a customer's profile?
options: Source of funds and source of wealth
The customer's credit rating from a licensed credit reference agency
The customer's tax residency certificate for the past ten years
The names of the customer's competitors in its industry
en.explain: The circular states that MSOs should also consider obtaining information on the Source of Funds and Source of Wealth of customers for a better understanding of their profiles, alongside applying EDD to customers with high ML/TF risks.

tc.q: 香港海關建議金錢服務經營者考慮取得哪些額外資料，以更了解客戶狀況？
options: 資金來源及財富來源
由持牌信貸資料機構提供的客戶信貸評級
客戶過去十年的稅務居民身分證明書
客戶在其行業內競爭對手的名稱
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，除對高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的客戶採取加強盡職審查外，金錢服務經營者亦應考慮取得客戶的資金來源及財富來源資料，以更了解其狀況。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — Transaction monitoring
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——交易監察

en.q: What practice does the C&ED specifically caution MSOs against when handling transaction monitoring alerts?
options: Closing generated alerts without sufficient justification and analysis
Escalating alerts to senior management before completing an analysis
Retaining alert records for longer than the statutory minimum period
Generating alerts for transactions below the reporting threshold
en.explain: The circular states that MSOs should ensure appropriate steps are taken — such as examining the background and purposes of transactions and making enquiries of the customer — to identify grounds for suspicion, instead of closing generated TM alerts without sufficient justification and analysis.

tc.q: 香港海關特別告誡金錢服務經營者在處理交易監察警示時，須避免哪種做法？
options: 在缺乏充分理據及分析的情況下關閉已產生的警示
在完成分析前先向高級管理層呈報警示
將警示紀錄保存超過法定最短年期
就低於申報門檻的交易產生警示
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，金錢服務經營者應確保採取適當步驟——例如審視交易的背景及目的，並向客戶作出查詢——以識別是否存在懷疑理由，而非在缺乏充分理據及分析下關閉已產生的交易監察警示。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — Transaction monitoring
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——交易監察

en.q: Against what should an MSO assess the reasonableness of a transaction?
options: The customer risk profile, source of funds and source of wealth, and historical transactions
The average transaction size across the MSO's whole customer base
The prevailing interbank exchange rate on the day of the transaction
The volume of trade between Hong Kong and the destination jurisdiction
en.explain: The circular states that MSOs should adequately assess the reasonableness of transactions taking into account the customer risk profiles, SoF/SoW and historical transactions.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應參照甚麼評估交易的合理性？
options: 客戶風險狀況、資金來源及財富來源，以及過往交易
該金錢服務經營者整體客戶群的平均交易金額
交易當日的現行銀行同業匯率
香港與目的地司法管轄區之間的貿易額
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，金錢服務經營者應充分評估交易的合理性，並顧及客戶風險狀況、資金來源／財富來源及過往交易。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — Filing STRs
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——提交可疑交易報告

en.q: Does the obligation to report a suspicion of ML/TF depend on the amount involved?
options: No — the reporting obligations require a person to report suspicions irrespective of the amount involved
Yes — only transactions of HK$8,000 or above must be reported
Yes — only transactions of HK$120,000 or above must be reported
Yes — the threshold is set by the MSO in its own AML/CFT policy
en.explain: The circular reiterates that the reporting obligations require a person to report suspicions of ML/TF irrespective of the amount involved, and that the obligations apply whether or not a transaction was actually conducted, covering attempted transactions.

tc.q: 匯報洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集懷疑的責任，是否取決於所涉款額？
options: 不取決於——匯報責任規定任何人不論所涉款額多少，均須匯報懷疑
取決於——只有8,000港元或以上的交易須匯報
取決於——只有120,000港元或以上的交易須匯報
取決於——門檻由該金錢服務經營者在其打擊洗錢政策中自行訂定
tc.explain: 該通函重申，匯報責任規定任何人不論所涉款額多少，均須匯報洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑；有關責任亦不論交易是否確實已進行，並涵蓋未遂交易。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — Filing STRs
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——提交可疑交易報告

en.q: A customer asks an MSO to execute a remittance, the MSO forms a suspicion, and the customer then withdraws the request before any funds move. What is the MSO's position?
options: The reporting obligation still applies, because it covers attempted transactions whether or not a transaction was actually conducted
No obligation arises, because no transaction was completed
No obligation arises, because the customer withdrew the request voluntarily
The obligation arises only if the customer later returns to attempt the same transfer
en.explain: The circular states that the reporting obligations apply whether or not a transaction was actually conducted and cover attempted transactions. An abandoned or refused transaction that has given rise to suspicion is therefore still reportable.

tc.q: 某客戶要求金錢服務經營者執行一宗匯款，該經營者形成懷疑，客戶隨後在任何資金轉移前撤回要求。該經營者的處境為何？
options: 匯報責任仍然適用，因該責任涵蓋未遂交易，並不論交易是否確實已進行
並無責任，因交易並未完成
並無責任，因客戶是自願撤回要求
只有在客戶其後再次嘗試同一轉帳時才產生責任
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，匯報責任不論交易是否確實已進行均適用，並涵蓋未遂交易。因此，已引起懷疑而被放棄或拒絕的交易，仍須予以匯報。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — Filing STRs
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——提交可疑交易報告

en.q: Where an MSO holds information concerning both the originator and the recipient of funds, what should it do when deciding whether to file an STR?
options: Take all of that information into account in determining whether an STR has to be filed
Consider only the information relating to the originator, as its own customer
Consider only the information relating to the recipient, as the ultimate beneficiary
File separate reports for the originator and the recipient in every case
en.explain: The circular states that when an MSO holds information concerning both the originator and the recipient of funds, the MSO should take into account all of this information in determining whether an STR has to be filed.

tc.q: 當金錢服務經營者同時持有匯款人及收款人的資料時，在決定是否提交可疑交易報告時應怎樣做？
options: 在決定是否須提交可疑交易報告時，顧及所有該等資料
只考慮匯款人的資料，因其為本身客戶
只考慮收款人的資料，因其為最終受益人
在任何情況下均須就匯款人及收款人分別提交報告
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，當金錢服務經營者同時持有匯款人及收款人的資料時，應在決定是否須提交可疑交易報告時顧及所有該等資料。

source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）

en.q: By what means does the C&ED circular ask MSOs to review their existing AML/CFT controls?
options: Through a gap analysis, with a view to optimising controls in the areas for enhancement identified
Through an annual external audit conducted by a certified public accountant
Through a survey of customers' satisfaction with the MSO's procedures
Through a comparison of its fee schedule with those of other licensees
en.explain: The circular states that MSOs should review their existing AML/CFT controls through a gap analysis, and give consideration to optimising their controls based on the areas for enhancement outlined, in order to mitigate the risks associated with TBML and other evolving methods.

tc.q: 香港海關的通函要求金錢服務經營者以何種方式檢視其現行打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集管控措施？
options: 透過缺口分析，並就所指出的改善範疇優化管控措施
透過由執業會計師進行的年度外部審計
透過調查客戶對該經營者程序的滿意程度
透過將其收費表與其他持牌人比較
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，金錢服務經營者應透過缺口分析檢視其現行打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集管控措施，並考慮按所述的改善範疇加以優化，以減低與以貿易進行洗錢活動及其他不斷演變手法相關的風險。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — Understanding of ML/TF risks
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——了解洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險

en.q: What does the C&ED say an MSO's customer risk assessment framework should be capable of doing?
options: Identifying customers with higher ML/TF risks, and assessing the reasonableness of customer characteristics and material changes in customer profiles
Predicting the future profitability of each customer relationship
Verifying the tax position of each customer in every jurisdiction
Replacing the need for ongoing transaction monitoring
en.explain: The circular states that MSOs' customer risk assessment frameworks should be capable of identifying customers with higher ML/TF risks, and that MSOs should adequately understand and assess the reasonableness of customer characteristics and/or material changes in customer profiles, then apply effective additional controls proportionate to those risks.

tc.q: 香港海關指出金錢服務經營者的客戶風險評估框架應具備甚麼能力？
options: 識別具較高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的客戶，並評估客戶特徵及客戶狀況重大變動的合理性
預測每段客戶關係未來的盈利能力
核實每名客戶在各司法管轄區的稅務狀況
取代持續交易監察的需要
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，金錢服務經營者的客戶風險評估框架應能識別具較高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的客戶；經營者亦應充分了解及評估客戶特徵及／或客戶狀況重大變動的合理性，繼而按其風險程度施加相稱而有效的額外管控措施。

source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——客戶盡職審查

en.q: What does the C&ED say about the frequency with which documents, data and information relating to customers should be reviewed?
options: They should be reviewed periodically to ensure that they remain up-to-date and relevant
They need be reviewed only when the customer initiates a new transaction
They need be reviewed only on the fifth anniversary of the relationship
They need never be reviewed once verified at the outset
en.explain: The circular states that an MSO should periodically review the obtained documents, data and information relating to the customers to ensure that they are up-to-date and relevant. One-off verification at onboarding is not sufficient.

tc.q: 香港海關就檢視有關客戶的文件、數據及資料的頻次有何說明？
options: 應定期檢視，以確保其保持最新及切合所需
只須在客戶展開新交易時檢視
只須在關係建立五周年時檢視
一經在開始時核實，便無須再行檢視
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，金錢服務經營者應定期檢視就客戶取得的文件、數據及資料，以確保其保持最新及切合所需。僅在建立關係時作一次性核實並不足夠。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — Understanding of ML/TF risks
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——了解洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險

en.q: Adequate training and guidance to staff is described in the circular as supporting risk awareness in which parts of the organisation?
options: Both the first and second lines of defence
The board of directors only
The internal audit function only
The MSO's overseas correspondents only
en.explain: The circular states that these efforts need to be supported by adequate training and guidance to staff to facilitate sufficient ML/TF risk awareness in both the first and second lines of defence.

tc.q: 通函指出，向員工提供足夠培訓及指引，是為支援機構中哪些部分的風險意識？
options: 第一及第二道防線
只限董事會
只限內部審計職能
只限該金錢服務經營者的海外代理行
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，上述工作須以向員工提供足夠培訓及指引作支援，使第一及第二道防線均具備充分的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險意識。

source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——客戶盡職審查

en.q: According to the circular, to which customers should an MSO apply enhanced due diligence requirements?
options: Customers with high ML/TF risks
Customers who have been with the MSO for less than one year
Customers who request remittances in foreign currency
Customers introduced by an intermediary rather than directly
en.explain: The circular states that MSOs should apply Enhanced Due Diligence requirements to customers with high ML/TF risks, and that the implementation of either CDD or EDD needs to be supported by adequate understanding and assessment of the customers' business and risk profiles and business relationship.

tc.q: 根據該通函，金錢服務經營者應對哪些客戶採取加強盡職審查規定？
options: 具高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的客戶
與該經營者建立關係少於一年的客戶
要求以外幣匯款的客戶
經中介人而非直接引介的客戶
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，金錢服務經營者應對具高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的客戶採取加強盡職審查規定；而不論實施客戶盡職審查或加強盡職審查，均須以充分了解及評估客戶的業務及風險狀況以及業務關係作支援。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: UNSCR 1267 (1999) and its successor resolutions concern the publication of names of individuals and organisations connected with which groups?
options: Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea's nuclear programme
Iran's ballistic missile programme
Organised crime syndicates operating in South-East Asia
en.explain: ¶6.2 states that the UN has published the names of individuals and organisations in relation to involvement with Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban under relevant UNSCRs, including 1267 (1999), 1988 (2011), 1989 (2011), 2253 (2015) and 2368 (2017). DPRK and Iran are addressed by the counter-proliferation resolutions.

tc.q: 第1267號決議（1999年）及其後續決議，關乎公布與哪些組織有關連的個人及組織名單？
options: 蓋達組織、伊斯蘭國（Da'esh）及塔利班
朝鮮的核計劃
伊朗的彈道導彈計劃
在東南亞活動的有組織犯罪集團
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明，聯合國已根據相關決議（包括第1267號（1999年）、1988號（2011年）、1989號（2011年）、2253號（2015年）及2368號（2017年）決議）公布與蓋達組織、伊斯蘭國（Da'esh）及塔利班有關連的個人及組織名單。朝鮮及伊朗則由打擊擴散資金籌集的決議處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.3段

en.q: Which UNSCR relating to the prevention of travel for the purpose of terrorist acts or terrorist training does the UNATMO implement?
en.explain: ¶6.3 states that the UNATMO further implements a decision under UNSCR 1373 (2001) on measures for the prevention of terrorist acts and a decision under UNSCR 2178 (2014) relating to the prevention of travel for the purpose of terrorist acts or terrorist training.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》實施哪一項有關防止為進行恐怖主義行為或接受恐怖主義訓練而旅行的決議？
tc.explain: 第6.3段訂明，《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》進一步實施第1373號決議（2001年）中有關防止恐怖主義行為措施的決定，以及第2178號決議（2014年）中有關防止為進行恐怖主義行為或接受恐怖主義訓練而旅行的決定。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.5(c); s.8 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(c)段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第8條

en.q: Section 8 of the UNATMO prohibits which conduct in relation to terrorists and terrorist associates?
options: Making available, or collecting or soliciting, property or financial (or related) services for them
Employing them in any capacity in a licensed money service business
Travelling to any jurisdiction in which they are known to reside
Publishing their names other than in the Gazette
en.explain: ¶6.5(c) states that section 8 prohibits any person from making available or collecting or soliciting property or financial (or related) services for terrorists and terrorist associates. Section 7 concerns property for use to commit terrorist acts, and section 8A dealing with specified terrorist property.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第8條就恐怖分子及恐怖分子聯繫者禁止哪種行為？
options: 為他們提供，或為他們籌集或徵求財產或財務（或相關）服務
以任何身分僱用他們於持牌金錢服務業務中工作
前往任何已知他們居住的司法管轄區
在憲報以外的途徑公布他們的姓名
tc.explain: 第6.5(c)段訂明第8條禁止任何人為恐怖分子及恐怖分子聯繫者提供、籌集或徵求財產或財務（或相關）服務。第7條關乎用於進行恐怖主義行為的財產，第8A條則關乎處理指明恐怖分子財產。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.5段

en.q: What does the Guideline say about its own future?
options: Its relevance and usefulness will be kept under review and amendments may be issued from time to time
It will remain in force unamended until the AMLO is repealed
It may be amended only with the prior approval of the Legislative Council
It expires automatically five years after the date of publication
en.explain: ¶1.5 states that the relevance and usefulness of the Guideline will be kept under review and that it may be necessary to issue amendments from time to time.

tc.q: 本指引就其本身日後的修訂有何說明？
options: 其相關性及實用性會持續檢討，並可能不時發出修訂
在《打擊洗錢條例》廢除前，將一直維持不變
只有在立法會事先批准下方可修訂
於刊發日期起五年後自動失效
tc.explain: 第1.5段訂明本指引的相關性及實用性會持續檢討，並可能有需要不時發出修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》（第615章）第1至7部結構

en.q: Which Part of the AMLO contains the licensing regime for money service operators?
options: Part 5
Part 2
Part 3
Part 7
en.explain: Part 5 of the AMLO establishes the MSO licensing regime (register of licensees, restriction on operating without a licence, grant/renewal, approvals, duties and the Commissioner's disciplinary powers). Part 2 gives effect to Schedule 2; Part 3 contains the authorities' inspection and investigation powers; Part 7 is miscellaneous provisions.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》哪一部載有金錢服務經營者的發牌制度？
options: 第5部
第2部
第3部
第7部
tc.explain: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5部設立金錢服務經營者發牌制度（持牌人登記冊、無牌經營的限制、牌照批給與續期、批准事項、持牌人責任及關長的紀律權力）。第2部使附表2具有效力；第3部載有當局的查察及調查權力；第7部為雜項條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第25條

en.q: A licensed bank (authorized institution) offers currency exchange to its customers. Does it need an MSO licence under Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: No — Part 5 does not apply to an authorized institution
Yes — everyone offering currency exchange in Hong Kong needs an MSO licence
Yes, but only if the exchange volume exceeds $8,000 per day
No, provided it notifies the C&ED annually
en.explain: s.25: Part 5 does not apply to the Government or to an authorized institution, nor to certain licensed corporations, insurers, insurance intermediaries and SVF licensees operating a money service that is ancillary to their principal business — they are regulated by their own regulators.

tc.q: 一間持牌銀行（認可機構）向客戶提供貨幣兌換服務。它是否需要根據《打擊洗錢條例》第5部領取金錢服務經營者牌照？
options: 不需要——第5部不適用於認可機構
需要——在香港提供貨幣兌換的任何人均須領取金錢服務經營者牌照
需要，但只限每日兌換額超過8,000元
不需要，但須每年通知海關
tc.explain: 第25條：第5部不適用於政府及認可機構，亦不適用於經營附帶於其主要業務的金錢服務的若干持牌法團、保險人、保險中介人及儲值支付工具持牌人——他們由本身的監管機構規管。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(5)至(6)條

en.q: An MSO KNOWINGLY contravenes a specified provision of the AMLO. On conviction on indictment, what is the maximum penalty?
options: A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine of $10,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $5,000,000 and imprisonment for 14 years
en.explain: s.5: a knowing contravention of a specified provision carries, on conviction on indictment, a fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment. The 7-year maximum applies where the contravention is committed with intent to defraud the relevant authority (the CCE for MSOs). $5M/14 years is the DTROP/OSCO dealing offence.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者「明知」而違反《打擊洗錢條例》的指明條文。循公訴程序定罪後，最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款100萬元及監禁2年
罰款100萬元及監禁7年
罰款1,000萬元及監禁2年
罰款500萬元及監禁14年
tc.explain: 第5條：明知而違反指明條文，循公訴程序定罪，最高可處罰款100萬元及監禁2年。監禁7年適用於出於詐騙有關當局（就金錢服務經營者而言即關長）的意圖而違反的情況。罰款500萬元／監禁14年是《販毒條例》／《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》的處理犯罪得益罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(6)條

en.q: When does the HIGHER maximum of 7 years' imprisonment apply to a contravention of a specified provision of the AMLO?
options: When the contravention is committed with intent to defraud the relevant authority (the CCE, for an MSO)
Whenever the amount involved exceeds $1,000,000
When the contravention is repeated more than three times
Whenever a customer suffers loss
en.explain: s.5(6): contravening a specified provision with intent to defraud the relevant authority carries a maximum of 7 years' imprisonment and a $1,000,000 fine. A merely knowing contravention carries up to 2 years.

tc.q: 在甚麼情況下，違反《打擊洗錢條例》指明條文適用監禁7年的較高刑罰上限？
options: 出於詐騙有關當局（就金錢服務經營者而言即關長）的意圖而違反指明條文
凡涉及金額超過100萬元
違反超過三次
凡有客戶蒙受損失
tc.explain: 第5(6)條：出於詐騙有關當局的意圖而違反指明條文，最高可處監禁7年及罰款100萬元。僅屬明知而違反則最高監禁2年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第7條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第1.7至1.8段

en.q: Which statement about guidelines published by the CCE under section 7 of the AMLO is CORRECT?
options: Failure to comply with a guideline is not of itself an offence, but the guideline is admissible in evidence in proceedings under the AMLO and must be taken into account by the court where relevant
Breaching a guideline is automatically a criminal offence punishable by imprisonment
Guidelines are internal C&ED documents with no legal significance
Guidelines only apply to banks, not MSOs
en.explain: s.7 empowers the CCE to publish guidelines on the operation of Schedule 2. A failure to comply does not by itself render a person liable to proceedings, but the guideline is admissible in evidence, and a court must take relevant provisions into account; the CCE must have regard to them in considering contraventions of Schedule 2 (¶1.8).

tc.q: 關於關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》第7條公布的指引，下列哪項正確？
options: 不遵守指引本身不構成罪行，但指引在根據《打擊洗錢條例》提起的法律程序中可獲接納為證據；法院覺得指引條文攸關案中問題時須加以考慮
違反指引即自動構成可判監禁的刑事罪行
指引只是海關內部文件，並無法律意義
指引只適用於銀行，不適用於金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 第7條授權關長就附表2的施行公布指引。不遵守指引本身不會令人在司法程序中被起訴，但指引可獲接納為證據；法院覺得指引條文攸關法律程序中的問題時，須在裁斷時加以考慮；關長考慮某人有否違反附表2時亦須顧及相關條文（第1.8段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9條（第3部）

en.q: Under section 9 of the AMLO, what may an authorized person do for the purpose of a ROUTINE inspection of an MSO?
options: Enter the MSO's business premises at any reasonable time, inspect and copy business records, and make inquiries concerning them
Enter the MSO director's private residence without a warrant
Arrest any staff member on the spot
Seize the MSO's entire business for auction
en.explain: s.9 allows an authorized person, at any reasonable time, to enter business premises, inspect and make copies of specified business records, and make inquiries of the inspection subject (and, subject to limits, information holders) — to ascertain compliance with prescribed requirements. Entering domestic premises or seizure generally requires a magistrate's warrant (s.17).

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》第9條，獲授權人員為對金錢服務經營者作例行查察可以怎樣做？
options: 在任何合理時間進入其營業處所，查察及複製業務紀錄，並就有關紀錄作出查訊
無手令進入經營者董事的私人住所
即場拘捕任何職員
檢取整盤生意作拍賣
tc.explain: 第9條容許獲授權人員在任何合理時間進入業務處所、查察及複製指明業務紀錄，並向查察對象（及在限制下向資料持有人）作出查訊，以確定其有否遵守訂明規定。進入住宅處所或檢取物品一般須有裁判官手令（第17條）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21條（第4部）

en.q: Under section 21 of the AMLO, if an MSO contravenes a specified provision, the maximum pecuniary penalty the CCE may order is:
options: The greater of $10,000,000 or 3 times the profit gained or costs avoided as a result of the contravention
$10,000 per day of contravention
Unlimited, at the CCE's discretion
en.explain: s.21(2)(c): the disciplinary pecuniary penalty for contravening a specified provision must not exceed the greater of $10 million or 3 times the profit gained or costs avoided. The other s.21 powers are public reprimand and remedial orders. (Contrast s.43: penalties for licence-condition/administrative contraventions are capped at $1,000,000.)

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》第21條，如金錢服務經營者違反指明條文，關長可命令繳付的罰款最高為：
options: 1,000萬元，或因違反而獲取的利潤或避免的開支的3倍，以較大者為準
劃一100萬元
每日違反10,000元
不設上限，由關長酌情決定
tc.explain: 第21(2)(c)條：就違反指明條文施加的罰款，不得超過1,000萬元或因違反而獲取的利潤／避免的開支的3倍（以較大者為準）。第21條的其他權力為公開譴責及補救令。（對照第43條：違反牌照條件／行政規定的罰款上限為100萬元。）

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第29條

en.q: A person operates a remittance business in Hong Kong without an MSO licence. Which statement is CORRECT?
options: They commit an offence — on conviction on indictment, a fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment, and the court may disqualify them from holding a licence
No offence is committed unless a customer complains
They commit an offence only if they also launder money
The only consequence is a warning letter from the C&ED
en.explain: s.29: operating a money service without a licence is an offence — on indictment, a $1,000,000 fine and 2 years' imprisonment (summary: level 6 fine and 6 months). The court may also order disqualification from holding a licence for a specified period.

tc.q: 某人未持有金錢服務經營者牌照而在香港經營匯款業務。下列哪項正確？
options: 即屬犯罪——循公訴程序定罪可處罰款100萬元及監禁2年，法院並可命令取消其持有牌照的資格
除非有客戶投訴，否則不構成罪行
只有同時洗錢才構成罪行
唯一後果是海關發出警告信
tc.explain: 第29條：無牌照經營金錢服務即屬犯罪——循公訴程序定罪可處罰款100萬元及監禁2年（循簡易程序：第6級罰款及監禁6個月）。法院並可命令該人在指明期間內喪失持有牌照的資格。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)條

en.q: Before granting an MSO licence to a corporate applicant, the Commissioner must be satisfied of what?
options: That each director is a fit and proper person to be associated with the money service business, that any ultimate owner is fit and proper, and that any particular premises are suitable
Only that the company has sufficient capital
Only that the company has passed the Competence Assessment
That the company holds a banking licence
en.explain: s.30(3): for a corporation, the CCE may grant a licence only if satisfied that each director and any ultimate owner is a fit and proper person, and — where the application covers particular premises — that the premises are suitable for operating a money service. (For individuals/partnerships, the individual or each partner must be fit and proper.)

tc.q: 向法團申請人批出金錢服務經營者牌照前，關長必須信納甚麼？
options: 每名董事均屬與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選、任何最終擁有人亦屬適當人選；如申請涉及特定處所，該處所適合用於經營金錢服務
只須信納公司有充足資本
只須信納公司已通過能力評核
公司持有銀行牌照
tc.explain: 第30(3)條：就法團而言，關長只有在信納每名董事及任何最終擁有人均屬適當人選，及（如申請涉及特定處所）該處所適合經營金錢服務時，方可批出牌照。（個人／合夥申請人則須本人／每名合夥人屬適當人選。）

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(2)(a)條

en.q: By when must an application to renew an MSO licence be made?
options: Not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire
Not later than 7 days before expiry
Any time within 30 days after expiry
Not later than 6 months before expiry
en.explain: s.31(2)(a): a renewal application must be made not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire, in the specified form and with the Schedule 3 fee. On renewal the CCE may amend, remove or impose licence conditions.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者牌照的續期申請最遲須於何時提出？
options: 牌照期滿前不少於45日
期滿前不少於7日
期滿後30日內任何時間
期滿前不少於6個月
tc.explain: 第31(2)(a)條：續期申請最遲須於牌照期滿前45日以指明格式提出，並繳付附表3訂明的費用。續期時關長可修改、取消或新增牌照條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34條

en.q: On which ground may the Commissioner revoke or suspend an MSO licence?
options: The licensee (or a partner, director or ultimate owner) is no longer a fit and proper person
The licensee's profits have declined
The licensee has changed its bank
The licensee employs fewer than five staff
en.explain: s.34: the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence where, among other grounds, the licensee — or any partner, any director, or any ultimate owner — is no longer a fit and proper person, or where consent for licensed domestic premises is revoked. Commercial performance is not a ground.

tc.q: 關長可基於下列哪項理由撤銷或暫時吊銷金錢服務經營者牌照？
options: 持牌人（或其合夥人、董事或最終擁有人）不再屬適當人選
持牌人的利潤下跌
持牌人轉用另一間銀行
持牌人僱員少於五人
tc.explain: 第34條：如持牌人——或任何合夥人、任何董事或任何最終擁有人——不再屬適當人選，或持牌住宅處所的佔用人撤回書面同意等，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照。商業表現並非理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第35至37條

en.q: A licensed MSO (a corporation) wants to appoint a new director. What does the AMLO require?
options: The person must not become a director unless the Commissioner has, on the licensee's application, given prior approval in writing
The appointment may proceed, with notification to the CCE within one month afterwards
No approval or notification is required for directors
Approval is needed only if the director will own more than 50% of shares
en.explain: s.35(1): in relation to a corporate licensee, a person must not become a director unless the CCE has given written approval on the licensee's application (fee: $945 per person under Schedule 3). Similar prior-approval requirements apply to proposed ultimate owners (s.36) and partners (s.37). This is prior approval — not mere after-the-event notification.

tc.q: 一間持牌金錢服務經營者（法團）擬委任新董事。《打擊洗錢條例》有何規定？
options: 除非關長已應持牌人的申請事先給予書面批准，否則該人不得成為董事
可先行委任，事後一個月內通知關長
董事委任無須批准或通知
只有該董事將持有超過50%股份時才須批准
tc.explain: 第35(1)條：就法團持牌人而言，除非關長已應持牌人的申請給予書面批准，否則任何人不得成為其董事（附表3訂明費用為每人945元）。擬成為最終擁有人（第36條）及合夥人（第37條）亦須事先批准。這是事先批准——並非事後通知。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第39A條

en.q: What must a licensee do with its licence at the premises specified in the licence?
options: Display the ORIGINAL of the licence in a conspicuous place at the specified premises
Keep the licence locked in a safe off-site
Display a photocopy only, keeping the original at the company secretary's office
Display it only during C&ED inspections
en.explain: s.39A: a licensee licensed to operate at specified premises must display the original of the licence in a conspicuous place at those premises. Contravention without reasonable excuse is an offence (fine at level 5).

tc.q: 持牌人在牌照指明的處所須如何處理其牌照？
options: 在指明處所的顯眼位置展示牌照正本
將牌照鎖在其他地點的夾萬內
只展示影印本，正本存放於公司秘書辦事處
只在海關查察期間展示
tc.explain: 第39A條：獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務的持牌人，必須在該處所的顯眼位置展示牌照正本。無合理辯解而違反即屬犯罪（可處第5級罰款）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第40(1)條

en.q: There is a change in the particulars a licensee provided with its licence application. Within what period must the licensee notify the Commissioner?
options: In writing within one month beginning on the date the change takes place
Orally within 48 hours
In writing within six months
No notification is needed until the next renewal
en.explain: s.40(1): the licensee must notify the CCE in writing of any change in the particulars within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place (the Licensing Guide prescribes Form 6). Contravention without reasonable excuse is an offence (level 5 fine).

tc.q: 持牌人早前隨牌照申請提供的資料有所變更。持牌人須在多久內通知關長？
options: 自變更發生當日起計一個月內以書面通知
48小時內口頭通知
六個月內以書面通知
毋須通知，待下次續期時一併處理
tc.explain: 第40(1)條：持牌人須自變更發生當日起計一個月內，以書面將資料變更通知關長（《牌照指引》訂明使用表格6）。無合理辯解而違反即屬犯罪（第5級罰款）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(1)條

en.q: A licensee intends to cease operating its money service. What does section 41 of the AMLO require?
options: Notify the Commissioner in writing of the intention and the cessation date BEFORE that date, and return the licence for cancellation within 7 days beginning on the cessation date
Simply stop operating — the licence lapses automatically
Notify the Commissioner within 3 months after ceasing
Sell the licence to another operator
en.explain: s.41(1): before the date of cessation, the licensee must notify the CCE in writing of the intention and the date (the Licensing Guide prescribes Form 7), and must return the licence for cancellation or amendment within 7 days beginning on the cessation date. Licences are not transferable.

tc.q: 持牌人有意停止經營金錢服務。《打擊洗錢條例》第41條有何規定？
options: 須在停業日期前以書面將意向及停業日期通知關長，並自停業日期起計7日內交回牌照以供註銷
直接停業即可——牌照自動失效
停業後3個月內通知關長
將牌照轉售予另一經營者
tc.explain: 第41(1)條：持牌人須在停業日期之前以書面將停業意向及日期通知關長（《牌照指引》訂明使用表格7），並自停業日期起計7日內交回牌照以供註銷或修訂。牌照不得轉讓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43條

en.q: A licensee breaches a condition of its licence (not a specified provision). Under section 43, what disciplinary actions may the Commissioner take?
options: Public reprimand, an order to take remedial action, and/or a pecuniary penalty not exceeding $1,000,000 (plus up to $10,000 daily for continued failure to remedy)
A pecuniary penalty of up to $10,000,000 or 3 times the profit gained
Immediate imprisonment of the directors
Confiscation of all the licensee's assets
en.explain: s.43: for contraventions of regulations, licence conditions or ss.35–41 duties, the CCE may publicly reprimand, order remedial action, and/or order a pecuniary penalty of up to $1,000,000 — plus a daily penalty of up to $10,000 for failing to comply with a remedial order. The $10M/3× penalty under s.21 applies to contraventions of specified provisions, not licence conditions.

tc.q: 持牌人違反牌照條件（並非指明條文）。根據第43條，關長可採取哪些紀律行動？
options: 公開譴責、命令採取補救行動，及／或命令繳付不超過100萬元的罰款（如未遵從補救令，另可每日罰款最多10,000元）
罰款最高1,000萬元或所獲利潤的3倍
立即監禁各董事
沒收持牌人全部資產
tc.explain: 第43條：就違反規例、牌照條件或第35至41條的責任，關長可公開譴責、命令補救，及／或命令繳付不超過100萬元的罰款；如未有遵從補救令，另可命令按日繳付不超過10,000元的罰款。第21條的1,000萬元／3倍利潤罰款適用於違反指明條文，而非牌照條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52條

en.q: In its licence application, a company knowingly states false information about its ultimate owner. What is the consequence under the AMLO?
options: It commits an offence — knowingly or recklessly making a materially false or misleading statement (or omitting a material particular) in connection with a licence application is criminal
Nothing, provided the licence is eventually refused
Only a civil claim by the C&ED for costs
The application fee is doubled
en.explain: s.52: a person commits an offence if, in connection with an application for the grant or renewal of a licence, they make a statement false or misleading in a material particular (or omit a material particular) knowingly or recklessly. Providing false information also reflects on fitness and properness.

tc.q: 一間公司在牌照申請中明知而就其最終擁有人提供虛假資料。根據《打擊洗錢條例》會有何後果？
options: 即屬犯罪——明知或罔顧實情地在牌照申請中作出在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性的陳述（或遺漏要項），屬刑事罪行
只要申請最終被拒絕，便無後果
海關只可循民事途徑追討費用
申請費加倍
tc.explain: 第52條：任何人在牌照批給或續期申請中，明知或罔顧實情地作出在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性的陳述（或遺漏要項），即屬犯罪。提供虛假資料亦影響其是否屬適當人選。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第53條

en.q: Within what period may proceedings for a non-indictable offence under Part 5 of the AMLO be instituted?
options: Within 12 months after the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner
Within 6 months after the offence is committed, with no exceptions
Within 7 years after the offence is committed
There is no time limit for any offence
en.explain: s.53: despite s.26 of the Magistrates Ordinance, proceedings for a non-indictable offence under Part 5 may be instituted within 12 months after the offence is discovered by or comes to the notice of the Commissioner.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部下非可公訴的罪行，可在多久內提出檢控？
options: 在關長發現該罪行或該罪行引起關長注意後12個月內
罪行發生後6個月內，並無例外
罪行發生後7年內
任何罪行均無時限
tc.explain: 第53條：即使有《裁判官條例》第26條的規定，就第5部下非可公訴的罪行，仍可在關長發現該罪行或該罪行引起其注意後12個月內提出檢控。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第6部、第59條

en.q: An applicant is aggrieved by the Commissioner's decision to refuse its MSO licence. What recourse does the AMLO provide?
options: Apply to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal for a review within 21 days after the notice of the decision is sent
Appeal directly to the Chief Executive within 7 days
No recourse — the Commissioner's decisions are final
Petition the FATF for arbitration
en.explain: Part 6 establishes the AML/CFT Review Tribunal, which reviews specified decisions. For MSO decisions the specified authority is the Commissioner. An aggrieved person may apply for review within 21 days after the notice of the decision is sent (s.59(1)); the Tribunal may extend time.

tc.q: 申請人不服關長拒絕批出金錢服務經營者牌照的決定。《打擊洗錢條例》提供甚麼救濟途徑？
options: 在決定通知發出後21日內，向打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處申請覆核
7日內直接向行政長官上訴
沒有救濟途徑——關長的決定為最終決定
請求財務行動特別組織仲裁
tc.explain: 第6部設立打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處，覆核指明決定。就金錢服務經營者的決定而言，指明當局為關長。感到受屈的人可在決定通知發出後21日內申請覆核（第59(1)條）；審裁處可延展時限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第27至28條

en.q: Which statement about the register of MSO licensees is CORRECT?
options: The Commissioner must maintain a register of licensees, and certified copies of entries can be obtained on payment of the Schedule 3 fee
The register is a confidential internal C&ED database with no public access
The register is maintained by the Companies Registry
Each MSO maintains its own register and files it annually
en.explain: s.27 requires the Commissioner to maintain a register of licensees; s.28 provides for certified copies of entries or extracts (Schedule 3 fee: $160 per copy). The register lets the public verify whether an operator is licensed — the Licensing Guide explains what it contains and where it can be inspected.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者持牌人登記冊，下列哪項正確？
options: 關長必須備存持牌人登記冊；繳付附表3訂明費用後可取得登記冊記項的核證副本
登記冊屬海關內部機密資料庫，公眾不得查閱
登記冊由公司註冊處備存
各經營者自行備存登記冊並每年提交
tc.explain: 第27條規定關長須備存持牌人登記冊；第28條訂明可取得記項或摘錄的核證副本（附表3費用：每份160元）。登記冊讓公眾查證經營者是否持牌——《牌照指引》解釋其內容及查閱途徑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第2(1)條

en.q: Which part of the AMLO contains the interpretation provisions that apply to the Ordinance?
options: Schedule 1
Schedule 2
Part 1, section 3
Schedule 3
en.explain: Section 2(1) provides that Schedule 1 contains interpretation provisions that apply to the Ordinance in accordance with their terms. Schedule 2 sets out the CDD and record-keeping requirements, and Schedule 3 specifies fees.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》哪一部分載有適用於該條例的釋義條文？
options: 附表1
附表2
第1部第3條
附表3
tc.explain: 第2(1)條訂明附表1載有按其條款適用於本條例的釋義條文。附表2訂立客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存規定，附表3則訂明費用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第2(2)條

en.q: Who may amend Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO, and by what means?
options: The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, by notice published in the Gazette
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise, by circular to licensees
The Chief Executive in Council, by regulation
The Review Tribunal, by determination
en.explain: Section 2(2) provides that the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury may, by notice published in the Gazette, amend Part 2 of Schedule 1. Section 6 confers a corresponding power to amend Schedule 2.

tc.q: 何人可以何種方式修訂《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部？
options: 財經事務及庫務局局長，以憲報公告方式
海關關長，以致持牌人的通函方式
行政長官會同行政會議，以規例方式
審裁處，以裁定方式
tc.explain: 第2(2)條訂明財經事務及庫務局局長可藉憲報公告修訂附表1第2部。第6條就修訂附表2賦予相應權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第3條

en.q: Does the AMLO apply to the Government?
options: Yes — it applies to the Government except as otherwise expressly provided
No — the Government is wholly exempt from the Ordinance
Only the provisions in Part 2 apply to the Government
It applies to the Government only with the consent of the Financial Secretary
en.explain: Section 3 states that the Ordinance applies to the Government, except as otherwise expressly provided. An example of an express exception is section 25, under which Part 5 does not apply to the Government.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》是否適用於政府？
options: 適用——除另有明文規定外，該條例適用於政府
不適用——政府完全獲豁免
只有第2部的條文適用於政府
須經財政司司長同意方適用於政府
tc.explain: 第3條訂明除另有明文規定外，本條例適用於政府。明文例外的一個例子是第25條，據此第5部並不適用於政府。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第4(1)條

en.q: In what circumstances does section 4 of the AMLO protect a relevant authority from civil liability?
options: For anything done or omitted in good faith in the performance or purported performance of a function conferred or imposed under the Ordinance
For anything done in the performance of its functions, whether in good faith or not
Only for acts done with the prior written approval of the Financial Secretary
Only for acts done in the course of a routine inspection under section 9
en.explain: Section 4(1) provides that a relevant authority or any other person does not incur civil liability for anything done or omitted to be done in good faith in the performance or purported performance of a function conferred or imposed by or under the Ordinance. Good faith is the essential condition.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》第4條在甚麼情況下保障有關當局免負民事法律責任？
options: 就其真誠地執行或看來是執行本條例所授予或委予的職能時，作出或不作出的任何事情
就其執行職能時作出的任何事情，不論是否真誠
只限經財政司司長事先書面批准而作出的作為
只限在第9條的例行視察過程中作出的作為
tc.explain: 第4(1)條訂明，有關當局或任何其他人，就其真誠地執行或看來是執行本條例所授予或委予的職能時所作出或不作出的任何事情，均不招致民事法律責任。「真誠」是必要條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第4(2)條

en.q: What is the effect of the immunity in section 4(1) on the Government's own liability for acts of a public officer?
options: It does not affect any liability of the Government for the thing done or omitted by a public officer in performing the relevant function
It extinguishes the Government's liability entirely
It transfers the Government's liability to the individual public officer
It suspends the Government's liability until the Review Tribunal has determined the matter
en.explain: Section 4(2) provides that the protection conferred by subsection (1) does not affect any liability of the Government for the thing done or omitted to be done by a public officer in the performance or purported performance of the relevant function.

tc.q: 第4(1)條的免責保障，對政府就公職人員的作為所負的法律責任有何影響？
options: 並不影響政府就公職人員在執行有關職能時作出或不作出的事情所負的任何法律責任
完全免除政府的法律責任
將政府的法律責任轉移予該名公職人員
在審裁處裁定前暫緩政府的法律責任
tc.explain: 第4(2)條訂明第(1)款所給予的保障，並不影響政府就公職人員在執行或看來是執行有關職能時作出或不作出的事情所負的任何法律責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(2)條

en.q: In relation to an authorized insurer, Schedule 2 has effect only in relation to what?
options: Long term business carried on by the insurer
General insurance business carried on by the insurer
Reinsurance contracts entered into by the insurer
Business written through licensed insurance brokers
en.explain: Section 5(2) provides that Schedule 2 has effect with respect to an authorized insurer only in relation to long term business carried on by the insurer, as defined by section 2(1) of the Insurance Ordinance (Cap. 41).

tc.q: 就認可保險人而言，附表2只就甚麼具有效力？
options: 該保險人所經營的長期業務
該保險人所經營的一般保險業務
該保險人訂立的再保險合約
透過持牌保險經紀承保的業務
tc.explain: 第5(2)條訂明，就認可保險人而言，附表2只就該保險人所經營的長期業務具有效力；「長期業務」的涵義見《保險業條例》（第41章）第2(1)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(4)條

en.q: Schedule 2 applies to the issue of a stored value facility by an SVF licensee or a bank only if which conditions are met?
options: The maximum value that can be stored exceeds $3,000, and the facility is a physical device provided by the issuer on which the value is stored
The maximum value that can be stored exceeds $8,000, and the facility is issued to a corporate customer
The facility is issued to a customer who is not ordinarily resident in Hong Kong
The facility is capable of being used for cross-border payments
en.explain: Section 5(4) provides that Schedule 2 applies to the issue of a stored value facility only if (a) the maximum value that can be stored on the facility exceeds $3,000, and (b) the facility is in the form of a physical device provided by the issuer to the user with the value stored on the device.

tc.q: 附表2只在符合哪些條件時，方適用於儲值支付工具持牌人或銀行發行儲值支付工具？
options: 該工具可儲存的最高價值超過3,000元，且該工具屬發行人提供予用戶並在其上儲存價值的實物裝置
該工具可儲存的最高價值超過8,000元，且發行予公司客戶
該工具發行予並非通常居於香港的客戶
該工具可用作跨境付款
tc.explain: 第5(4)條訂明，附表2只在下列情況下適用於發行儲值支付工具：(a)該工具可儲存的最高價值超過3,000元；及(b)該工具屬發行人提供予用戶的實物裝置，而價值儲存於該裝置上。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(5)(b)條

en.q: A financial institution knowingly contravenes a specified provision and is dealt with on summary conviction. What is the maximum penalty?
options: A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 3 months
en.explain: Section 5(5) provides two penalty limbs: on conviction on indictment, a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years; on summary conviction, a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months. The $500,000 and 1-year limb applies on summary conviction to the intent-to-defraud offence under section 5(6).

tc.q: 某金融機構在知情下違反指明條文，並循簡易程序被定罪。最高刑罰為何？
options: 第6級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款500,000元及監禁1年
第5級罰款及監禁3個月
tc.explain: 第5(5)條訂明兩項刑罰：循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年；循簡易程序定罪則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。罰款500,000元及監禁1年一項，適用於第5(6)條意圖欺騙罪行的簡易程序定罪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(6)(b)條

en.q: A financial institution contravenes a specified provision with intent to defraud a relevant authority and is dealt with on summary conviction. What is the maximum penalty?
options: A fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
en.explain: Section 5(6) provides that where the contravention is with intent to defraud a relevant authority, the penalty on conviction on indictment is a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years, and on summary conviction a fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year.

tc.q: 某金融機構意圖欺騙有關當局而違反指明條文，並循簡易程序被定罪。最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款500,000元及監禁1年
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
tc.explain: 第5(6)條訂明，如屬意圖欺騙有關當局而作出的違反，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年，循簡易程序定罪則可處罰款500,000元及監禁1年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(9)條

en.q: What statutory defence is available to an employee charged under section 5(7) with knowingly causing or permitting a financial institution to contravene a specified provision?
options: That the person acted in accordance with the policies and procedures established and maintained by the institution to ensure compliance with the relevant specified provision
That the person was not aware that the AMLO applied to the institution
That the contravention caused no actual loss to any customer
That the person reported the matter to the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit afterwards
en.explain: Section 5(9) provides that in proceedings under subsection (7) against an employee, it is a defence for the person to prove that he or she acted in accordance with the policies and procedures established and maintained by the financial institution for the purpose of ensuring compliance with the relevant specified provision.

tc.q: 僱員如被控違反第5(7)條，即在知情下導致或准許金融機構違反指明條文，可援引甚麼法定免責辯護？
options: 該人是按照該機構為確保遵守有關指明條文而制定及維持的政策及程序行事
該人並不知道《打擊洗錢條例》適用於該機構
該項違反並無對任何客戶造成實際損失
該人其後已向聯合財富情報組報告有關事宜
tc.explain: 第5(9)條訂明，在針對僱員而根據第(7)款提起的法律程序中，如該人證明其是按照該金融機構為確保遵守有關指明條文而制定及維持的政策及程序行事，即可作為免責辯護。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(10)條

en.q: Where a partnership is convicted of an offence under section 5, out of what is the fine to be paid?
options: The funds of the partnership
The personal assets of the managing partner
A statutory compensation fund maintained by the relevant authority
The partnership's licence fee deposit held by the Commissioner
en.explain: Section 5(10) provides that a fine imposed on a partnership on its conviction of an offence under that section is to be paid out of the funds of the partnership.

tc.q: 合夥被裁定犯第5條所訂罪行時，罰款須從何處支付？
options: 該合夥的資金
管理合夥人的個人資產
有關當局備存的法定補償基金
海關關長持有的該合夥牌照費按金
tc.explain: 第5(10)條訂明，合夥因犯該條所訂罪行而被定罪時所判處的罰款，須從該合夥的資金中支付。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第6條

en.q: Who may amend Schedule 2 to the AMLO?
options: The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, by notice published in the Gazette
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise, by written direction
The Review Tribunal, on the application of a licensee
The Legislative Council, by resolution only
en.explain: Section 6 provides that the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury may, by notice published in the Gazette, amend Schedule 2. This mirrors the power in section 2(2) in relation to Part 2 of Schedule 1.

tc.q: 何人可修訂《打擊洗錢條例》附表2？
options: 財經事務及庫務局局長，以憲報公告方式
海關關長，以書面指示方式
審裁處，應持牌人的申請
只有立法會，以決議方式
tc.explain: 第6條訂明財經事務及庫務局局長可藉憲報公告修訂附表2。這與第2(2)條就附表1第2部所訂的權力相對應。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第7(1)條

en.q: Under section 7(1) of the AMLO, what may a relevant authority or regulatory body publish in the Gazette?
options: Any guideline it considers appropriate for providing guidance in relation to the operation of any provision of Schedule 2
A list of every licensee that has been the subject of disciplinary action
The names of persons refused a licence in the preceding year
The minutes of Review Tribunal proceedings
en.explain: Section 7(1) provides that a relevant authority or a regulatory body may publish in the Gazette any guideline that it considers appropriate for providing guidance in relation to the operation of any provision of Schedule 2. The AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs is published under this section.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》第7(1)條，有關當局或監管團體可在憲報公布甚麼？
options: 其認為適合就附表2任何條文的運作提供指引的任何指引
曾被採取紀律行動的每名持牌人的名單
上一年度被拒發牌照的人的姓名
審裁處法律程序的紀錄
tc.explain: 第7(1)條訂明，有關當局或監管團體可在憲報公布其認為適合就附表2任何條文的運作提供指引的任何指引。《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》即根據本條發出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(1A)(a)條；第8條

en.q: At what time may an authorized person enter the business premises of an inspection subject for a routine inspection?
options: At any reasonable time
Only between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. on a business day
Only after giving the inspection subject 14 days' written notice
Only when accompanied by a police officer
en.explain: Section 9(1A) provides that, for the purpose of ascertaining compliance with a prescribed requirement, an authorized person may at any reasonable time enter the business premises of the inspection subject, inspect and copy specified business records, and make inquiries. No advance notice period is prescribed.

tc.q: 獲授權人可在甚麼時間進入視察對象的業務處所進行例行視察？
options: 任何合理時間
只限營業日上午9時至下午5時
只限向視察對象發出14日書面通知後
只限在警務人員陪同下
tc.explain: 第9(1A)條訂明，為確定是否遵從訂明規定，獲授權人可在任何合理時間進入視察對象的業務處所、視察及複製指明業務紀錄，以及作出查詢。條文並無訂明預先通知期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(15)(f)條

en.q: For the purposes of section 9, what are the “business premises” of a licensed money service operator?
options: Any premises at which the licensed MSO may operate a money service as shown in the register maintained under section 27
Any premises owned or leased by the licensee anywhere in Hong Kong
The registered office of the licensee as recorded at the Companies Registry
Only premises at which cash is physically handled
en.explain: Section 9(15)(f) defines business premises, in relation to a licensed money service operator, as any premises at which the licensed MSO may operate a money service as shown in the register maintained under section 27. The register therefore fixes the scope of the inspection power.

tc.q: 就第9條而言，持牌金錢服務經營者的「業務處所」指甚麼？
options: 根據第27條備存的登記冊所顯示，該持牌金錢服務經營者可經營金錢服務的任何處所
該持牌人在香港任何地方擁有或租用的任何處所
該持牌人在公司註冊處備案的註冊辦事處
只限實際處理現金的處所
tc.explain: 第9(15)(f)條就持牌金錢服務經營者界定「業務處所」，指根據第27條備存的登記冊所顯示，該持牌金錢服務經營者可經營金錢服務的任何處所。因此，登記冊界定了視察權力的範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(6)條

en.q: When may an authorized person make inquiries of an information holder rather than of the inspection subject itself?
options: Only where the authorized person has reasonable cause to believe the information sought cannot be obtained from the inspection subject
At any time, at the authorized person's discretion
Only where the inspection subject has already been convicted of an offence
Only with the prior written consent of the inspection subject
en.explain: Section 9(6) provides that an authorized person may only exercise the power to make inquiries of an information holder if the authorized person has reasonable cause to believe that the information sought cannot be obtained by exercising the power in respect of the inspection subject. Section 9(7) applies the same limitation to record production.

tc.q: 獲授權人在甚麼情況下方可向資料持有人（而非視察對象本身）作出查詢？
options: 只限獲授權人有合理因由相信所尋求的資料無法從視察對象取得
任何時間，由獲授權人酌情決定
只限視察對象已被裁定犯罪的情況
只限事先取得視察對象書面同意的情況
tc.explain: 第9(6)條訂明，獲授權人只有在有合理因由相信所尋求的資料無法藉對視察對象行使權力而取得時，方可行使向資料持有人作出查詢的權力。第9(7)條就交出紀錄施加相同限制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(9)條

en.q: After a person gives an answer to a requirement imposed under section 9, what further step may the authorized person require in writing?
options: That the person verify the answer by statutory declaration within a specified time
That the person repeat the answer before a magistrate
That the person publish a correction in the Gazette
That the person surrender the original records permanently
en.explain: Section 9(9) provides that if a person gives an answer in accordance with a requirement imposed under subsection (3) or (5), the authorized person may in writing require the person to verify the answer by statutory declaration within the time specified. Section 9(11) allows the declaration to be taken by the authorized person.

tc.q: 某人就第9條下施加的規定作出答覆後，獲授權人可以書面要求該人再採取甚麼步驟？
options: 在指明時間內以法定聲明核實該答覆
在裁判官席前重述該答覆
在憲報刊登更正
永久交出紀錄正本
tc.explain: 第9(9)條訂明，如某人按照第(3)或(5)款所施加的規定作出答覆，獲授權人可以書面要求該人在指明時間內以法定聲明核實該答覆。第9(11)條准許該法定聲明由獲授權人監誓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(14)條

en.q: What must an authorized person do when exercising a power under section 9?
options: Produce a copy of the relevant authority's authorization for inspection as soon as reasonably practicable
Obtain a magistrate's warrant before entering any premises
Give the inspection subject seven days to prepare the records
Notify the Review Tribunal that the power is being exercised
en.explain: Section 9(14) requires an authorized person, when exercising a power under the section, to produce a copy of the relevant authority's authorization for inspection as soon as reasonably practicable. Section 9(13) requires the relevant authority to provide the authorized person with a copy of that authorization.

tc.q: 獲授權人在行使第9條下的權力時，必須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快出示有關當局的授權書副本以供查閱
進入任何處所前取得裁判官手令
給予視察對象7日時間準備紀錄
通知審裁處正在行使該權力
tc.explain: 第9(14)條規定獲授權人在行使該條下的權力時，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快出示有關當局的授權書副本以供查閱。第9(13)條則規定有關當局須向獲授權人提供該授權書的副本。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(1)及(2)條

en.q: A person, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with a requirement imposed under section 9. On conviction on indictment, what is the maximum penalty?
options: A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
en.explain: Section 10(2)(a) sets the penalty for the section 10(1) offence at a fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year on conviction on indictment, and a fine at level 5 and 6 months' imprisonment on summary conviction. The heavier penalties apply to the false-information and intent-to-defraud offences.

tc.q: 某人無合理辯解而沒有遵從第9條下施加的規定。循公訴程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款200,000元及監禁1年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
第5級罰款及監禁6個月
tc.explain: 第10(2)(a)條就第10(1)條罪行訂明，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款200,000元及監禁1年；循簡易程序定罪則可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。較重刑罰適用於提供虛假資料及意圖欺騙的罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(3)及(4)條

en.q: A person produces a record that is false or misleading in a material particular in purported compliance with a section 9 requirement. What mental element must be proved?
options: That the person knows that, or is reckless as to whether, the record is false or misleading in a material particular
That the person intended to defraud the relevant authority
That the person acted dishonestly for personal gain
Nothing — the offence is one of strict liability
en.explain: Section 10(3) requires that the person knows that, or is reckless as to whether, the record, document or answer is false or misleading in a material particular. Intent to defraud is a separate and more serious offence under section 10(6), carrying up to 7 years' imprisonment.

tc.q: 某人在看來是遵從第9條規定的情況下，交出在要項上虛假或具誤導性的紀錄。須證明甚麼心理要素？
options: 該人知道或罔顧該紀錄是否在要項上虛假或具誤導性
該人意圖欺騙有關當局
該人為個人利益而不誠實行事
無須證明——該罪行屬嚴格責任罪行
tc.explain: 第10(3)條規定該人須知道或罔顧該紀錄、文件或答覆是否在要項上虛假或具誤導性。意圖欺騙屬第10(6)條下另一項更嚴重的罪行，最高可處監禁7年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(5)至(9)條

en.q: What is the maximum penalty on conviction on indictment for failing to comply with a section 9 requirement with intent to defraud?
options: A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
en.explain: Section 10(9) provides that a person who commits an offence under subsection (5), (6), (7) or (8) — the intent-to-defraud offences — is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years, and on summary conviction to a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 意圖欺騙而沒有遵從第9條規定，循公訴程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款500,000元及監禁1年
tc.explain: 第10(9)條訂明，犯第(5)、(6)、(7)或(8)款所訂罪行（即意圖欺騙的罪行）的人，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年，循簡易程序定罪則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(11)條

en.q: For the purposes of the section 10 offences, who is a “related person” of an obligated person?
options: A person who is an employee of, is employed to work for, or is concerned in the management of that person
Any person holding more than 25% of the shares in that person
Any customer of that person whose records are being inspected
Any person appointed as an investigator under section 11
en.explain: Section 10(11) defines a related person, in relation to a first-mentioned person, as a person who is an employee of that person, is employed to work for that person, or is concerned in the management of that person. Sections 10(7) and (8) create offences for such persons who, with intent to defraud, cause or allow non-compliance.

tc.q: 就第10條的罪行而言，何人屬有責任的人的「有關連的人」？
options: 屬該人的僱員、受僱為該人工作，或參與該人的管理的人
持有該人超過25%股份的任何人
其紀錄正被視察的該人的任何客戶
根據第11條獲委任為調查員的任何人
tc.explain: 第10(11)條就首述的人界定「有關連的人」，指屬該人的僱員、受僱為該人工作，或參與該人的管理的人。第10(7)及(8)條就該等人意圖欺騙而導致或容許不遵從規定訂立罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第11(2)(d)條

en.q: In relation to the Commissioner of Customs and Excise, who are the persons who may be directed to investigate a matter under section 11?
options: Public officers employed in the Customs and Excise Department
Employees of the Securities and Futures Commission
Persons appointed by the Financial Secretary under the Exchange Fund Ordinance
Public officers employed in the Companies Registry
en.explain: Section 11(2)(d) specifies that, in relation to the Commissioner, the persons who may be directed to investigate are public officers employed in the Customs and Excise Department. Paragraph (a) covers the Monetary Authority, (b) the SFC and (e) the Registrar.

tc.q: 就海關關長而言，根據第11條可獲指示調查事宜的是哪些人？
options: 受僱於香港海關的公職人員
證券及期貨事務監察委員會的僱員
財政司司長根據《外匯基金條例》委任的人
受僱於公司註冊處的公職人員
tc.explain: 第11(2)(d)條訂明，就海關關長而言，可獲指示進行調查的是受僱於香港海關的公職人員。(a)項關乎金融管理專員，(b)項關乎證監會，(e)項則關乎註冊處處長。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第11(1)條

en.q: Whose consent is required before a relevant authority may appoint a person other than a specified public officer to investigate a matter under section 11?
options: The Financial Secretary
The Chief Executive in Council
The Review Tribunal
The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury
en.explain: Section 11(1) provides that the relevant authority may in writing direct one or more of the persons specified in subsection (2) or, with the consent of the Financial Secretary, appoint one or more other persons to investigate the matter. Section 11(3) allows the costs of such an appointee to be met out of moneys provided by the Legislative Council.

tc.q: 有關當局根據第11條委任第(2)款所指明公職人員以外的人進行調查前，須取得何人同意？
options: 財政司司長
行政長官會同行政會議
審裁處
財經事務及庫務局局長
tc.explain: 第11(1)條訂明，有關當局可以書面指示第(2)款所指明的一名或多於一名人士，或在取得財政司司長同意下，委任一名或多於一名其他人調查有關事宜。第11(3)條准許該等獲委任者的費用由立法會撥款支付。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條（「最終擁有人」的定義）

en.q: In relation to a partnership, what threshold makes an individual an “ultimate owner” for the purposes of Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: Entitlement to or control of, directly or indirectly, more than a 25% share of the capital or profits of the partnership
Entitlement to or control of at least 10% of the capital or profits of the partnership
Being named as a partner in the partnership agreement, whatever the share
Holding a majority of the partnership's voting rights, that is more than 50%
en.explain: The definition of ultimate owner in section 24 covers, for a partnership, an individual entitled to or controlling directly or indirectly more than a 25% share of the capital or profits, or entitled to exercise or control more than 25% of the voting rights, or exercising ultimate control over the management of the partnership.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部而言，個人須符合甚麼門檻方屬合夥的「最終擁有人」？
options: 直接或間接有權享有或控制該合夥超過25%的資本或利潤份額
有權享有或控制該合夥至少10%的資本或利潤
在合夥協議中被列名為合夥人，不論份額多少
持有該合夥的過半數（即超過50%）投票權
tc.explain: 第24條「最終擁有人」的定義就合夥而言，涵蓋直接或間接有權享有或控制超過25%資本或利潤份額的個人、有權行使或控制超過25%投票權的個人，或對該合夥的管理行使最終控制權的個人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條（「最終擁有人」的定義）

en.q: In relation to a corporation, which of the following makes an individual an “ultimate owner” under Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: Owning or controlling, directly or indirectly and including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital
Holding any directorship in the corporation
Being the corporation's company secretary
Being a signatory on the corporation's bank account
en.explain: The section 24 definition covers, for a corporation, an individual who owns or controls directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital, or is entitled to exercise or control more than 25% of the voting rights at general meetings, or exercises ultimate control over the management.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部而言，下列何者令個人成為法團的「最終擁有人」？
options: 直接或間接（包括透過信託或持有不記名股份）擁有或控制超過25%的已發行股本
在該法團擔任任何董事職位
擔任該法團的公司秘書
是該法團銀行帳戶的簽署人
tc.explain: 第24條的定義就法團而言，涵蓋直接或間接（包括透過信託或持有不記名股份）擁有或控制超過25%已發行股本的個人、有權在股東大會上行使或控制超過25%投票權的個人，或對管理行使最終控制權的個人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條（「董事」的定義）

en.q: How is “director” defined for the purposes of Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: It includes any person occupying the position of director by whatever name called
It is confined to persons formally registered as directors at the Companies Registry
It excludes non-executive directors
It means only the director nominated to sit the Competence Assessment
en.explain: Section 24 provides that director includes any person occupying the position of director by whatever name called. The substance of the role, not the formal title or registration, determines whether a person is a director for Part 5 purposes.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部而言，「董事」如何界定？
options: 包括擔任董事職位的任何人，不論其職銜為何
只限在公司註冊處正式登記為董事的人
不包括非執行董事
只指獲提名參加能力評核的董事
tc.explain: 第24條訂明「董事」包括擔任董事職位的任何人，不論其職銜為何。就第5部而言，決定某人是否董事的是其職位的實質，而非正式職銜或登記。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第25條

en.q: A licensed corporation operates a money service that is ancillary to its principal business. What is its position under Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: Part 5 does not apply to it
It must obtain an MSO licence in addition to its existing licence
It must obtain the Commissioner's written exemption each year
Part 5 applies to it only in respect of remittance, not money changing
en.explain: Section 25 provides that Part 5 does not apply to the Government, nor to an authorized institution, nor to a licensed corporation, authorized insurer, licensed insurance broker company, licensed individual insurance agent, licensed insurance agency, SVF licensee or certain other bodies that operate a money service ancillary to their principal business.

tc.q: 某持牌法團經營附屬於其主要業務的金錢服務。就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部而言，其處境為何？
options: 第5部並不適用於該法團
除現有牌照外，還須取得金錢服務經營者牌照
須每年取得海關關長的書面豁免
第5部只就匯款（而非貨幣兌換）適用於該法團
tc.explain: 第25條訂明第5部並不適用於政府，亦不適用於認可機構，以及經營附屬於其主要業務的金錢服務的持牌法團、認可保險人、持牌保險經紀公司、持牌個人保險代理、持牌保險代理機構、儲值支付工具持牌人及若干其他團體。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第26條

en.q: To whom may the Commissioner of Customs and Excise delegate functions under the AMLO, and which functions may not be delegated?
options: To any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department, but the delegation power itself and the section 51 regulation-making function may not be delegated
To any person the Commissioner thinks fit, with no exceptions
To officers of the Hong Kong Police Force, but not to Customs officers
To no one — all functions must be exercised personally
en.explain: Section 26(1) permits the Commissioner to delegate in writing any function under the Ordinance to any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department, while section 26(2) prohibits delegation of the functions under section 26 itself and under section 51 (regulations).

tc.q: 海關關長可將《打擊洗錢條例》下的職能轉授何人？哪些職能不得轉授？
options: 可轉授予任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員，但轉授權本身及第51條的訂立規例職能不得轉授
可轉授予關長認為合適的任何人，並無例外
可轉授予香港警務處人員，但不可轉授予海關人員
不得轉授任何人——所有職能均須親自執行
tc.explain: 第26(1)條准許海關關長以書面將本條例下的任何職能轉授予任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員；第26(2)條則禁止轉授第26條本身及第51條（訂立規例）下的職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第27(3)及(4)條

en.q: On what terms may a member of the public inspect the register of licensees?
options: Without charge, during normal office hours, to ascertain whether he or she is dealing with a licensee
On payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3, at any time
Only with the written permission of the licensee concerned
Only if the person is a party to a transaction under investigation
