en.explain: Section 27(3) requires the register to be made available for public inspection so that a member of the public can ascertain whether he or she is dealing with a licensee, and section 27(4) entitles members of the public to inspect it without charge during normal office hours. The Schedule 3 fee under section 28 is for obtaining copies or certificates.

tc.q: 公眾人士可按甚麼條件查閱持牌人登記冊？
options: 可在正常辦公時間內免費查閱，以確定其是否正與持牌人交易
須繳付附表3訂明的費用，並可隨時查閱
須取得有關持牌人的書面許可
只限屬受調查交易一方的人方可查閱
tc.explain: 第27(3)條規定登記冊須供公眾查閱，使公眾人士能確定其是否正與持牌人交易；第27(4)條則賦予公眾人士在正常辦公時間內免費查閱的權利。第28條下的附表3費用是就取得副本或證明書而繳付。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第27(1)條

en.q: What must the register of licensees contain in respect of a licensee who is licensed to operate a money service at specified premises?
options: The address of every premises at which the licensee may operate a money service
Only the correspondence address of the licensee
The names of all the licensee's directors and ultimate owners
The conditions imposed on the licensee's licence
en.explain: Section 27(1) requires the register to contain the name of every licensee and, for a licensee licensed to operate at specified premises, the address of every premises at which it may operate a money service; in any other case, the licensee's correspondence address.

tc.q: 就獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務的持牌人而言，持牌人登記冊須載有甚麼？
options: 該持牌人可經營金錢服務的每一處所的地址
只需該持牌人的通訊地址
該持牌人所有董事及最終擁有人的姓名
施加於該持牌人牌照上的條件
tc.explain: 第27(1)條規定登記冊須載有每名持牌人的名稱，以及就獲發牌在指明處所經營的持牌人而言，其可經營金錢服務的每一處所的地址；在其他情況下則載有該持牌人的通訊地址。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第28(4)條

en.q: What evidential weight does a certificate signed by the Commissioner stating that a person's name has been entered on or removed from the register carry?
options: It is admissible on production without further proof and is conclusive evidence of the facts stated
It is admissible but may be rebutted by oral evidence
It is admissible only in civil, not criminal, proceedings
It has no evidential value unless the Commissioner attends to give evidence
en.explain: Section 28(4) provides that such a certificate is admissible in evidence in any criminal or civil proceedings on production without further proof and is conclusive evidence of the facts stated. By contrast, a certified copy of the register under section 28(2) is evidence, not conclusive evidence, of the facts stated.

tc.q: 由海關關長簽署、述明某人的姓名已列入或已從登記冊剔除的證明書，具有甚麼證據效力？
options: 一經出示即可獲接納為證據而無須再加證明，並為所述事實的確證
可獲接納為證據，但可由口頭證據推翻
只可在民事而非刑事法律程序中獲接納
除非海關關長親自出庭作證，否則並無證據價值
tc.explain: 第28(4)條訂明該等證明書在任何刑事或民事法律程序中一經出示即可獲接納為證據而無須再加證明，並為其所述事實的確證。相對而言，第28(2)條下經核證的登記冊副本只屬所述事實的證據，而非確證。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第28(3)條

en.q: A certified copy of the register does not show a particular person's name. What does that establish?
options: It is evidence that the person was not licensed at the date on which the copy was certified
It conclusively proves the person has committed an offence under section 29
It requires the Commissioner to commence disciplinary proceedings
It has no evidential effect at all
en.explain: Section 28(3) provides that the fact that a person's name does not appear on a copy of the register purporting to be certified by the Commissioner is evidence that the person was not, at the date on which the copy is so certified, licensed. It is evidence of unlicensed status, not proof of an offence.

tc.q: 經核證的登記冊副本並無顯示某人的姓名。這確立了甚麼？
options: 屬證據，證明該人在該副本獲核證當日並非持牌人
確證該人已犯第29條所訂罪行
規定海關關長須展開紀律程序
並無任何證據效力
tc.explain: 第28(3)條訂明，某人的姓名並無出現在看來是由海關關長核證的登記冊副本上，即屬證據，證明該人在該副本獲如此核證的日期並非持牌人。這是無牌狀況的證據，而非罪行的證明。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第29(3)條

en.q: In addition to any fine or imprisonment, what further order may a court make against a person convicted of operating a money service without a licence?
options: An order disqualifying the person from holding a licence for a period specified in the order
An order requiring the person to pay a pecuniary penalty to the Commissioner
An order that the person's premises be forfeited to the Government
An order requiring the person to publish an apology in the Gazette
en.explain: Section 29(3) provides that if a person is convicted of an offence under that section, the court or magistrate may order that the person is to be disqualified from holding a licence for a period specified in the order, beginning on the date of the order.

tc.q: 除罰款或監禁外，法庭可對無牌經營金錢服務而被定罪的人另行作出甚麼命令？
options: 命令該人在命令所指明的期間內被取消持有牌照的資格
命令該人向海關關長繳付罰款
命令將該人的處所充公歸政府所有
命令該人在憲報刊登道歉聲明
tc.explain: 第29(3)條訂明，如某人被裁定犯該條所訂罪行，法庭或裁判官可命令該人自命令日期起，在命令所指明的期間內被取消持有牌照的資格。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(1)條

en.q: What must accompany an application for the grant of an MSO licence?
options: The fee specified in Schedule 3, with the application made in the form and manner specified by the Commissioner
A banker's guarantee for the value of the applicant's expected annual turnover
A certificate of no criminal conviction issued by the Hong Kong Police Force
An audited balance sheet for the preceding three financial years
en.explain: Section 30(1) requires an application for the grant of a licence to be made to the Commissioner in the form and manner specified by the Commissioner and to be accompanied by the fee specified in Schedule 3. Section 31(2) imposes the same requirements for renewal applications.

tc.q: 申請批出金錢服務經營者牌照時，須連同甚麼一併提交？
options: 附表3訂明的費用，並須按海關關長指明的格式及方式提出申請
相當於申請人預期年度營業額價值的銀行擔保
由香港警務處發出的無犯罪紀錄證明書
過去三個財政年度的經審計資產負債表
tc.explain: 第30(1)條規定，批出牌照的申請須按海關關長指明的格式及方式向關長提出，並須連同附表3訂明的費用一併提交。第31(2)條就續期申請施加相同規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)(b)條

en.q: Where an applicant applies to operate a money service at domestic premises, what additional matter must the Commissioner be satisfied of?
options: That the applicant has secured the written consent of every occupant of the premises for an authorized person to enter to exercise the powers under section 9
That the applicant owns the freehold interest in the premises
That the premises are insured against fire and theft
That the premises are not used as a residence by any person under 18
en.explain: Section 30(3)(b) requires the Commissioner to be satisfied that the premises are suitable for operating a money service and, where they are domestic premises, that the applicant has secured the written consent of every occupant for an authorized person as defined by section 8 to enter for the purpose of exercising the powers under section 9.

tc.q: 如申請人申請在住宅處所經營金錢服務，海關關長須另行信納甚麼事項？
options: 申請人已取得該處所每名佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人進入該處所行使第9條下的權力
申請人擁有該處所的永久業權
該處所已投購火險及盜竊險
該處所並無18歲以下人士居住
tc.explain: 第30(3)(b)條規定海關關長須信納該處所適合用作經營金錢服務；如屬住宅處所，申請人已取得該處所每名佔用人的書面同意，讓第8條所界定的獲授權人進入該處所行使第9條下的權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(d)及(e)條

en.q: Which of the following must the Commissioner have regard to in determining whether a person is a fit and proper person under section 30?
options: Whether the person, being an individual, is an undischarged bankrupt or the subject of bankruptcy proceedings
Whether the person holds a professional accounting qualification
Whether the person has resided in Hong Kong for at least seven years
Whether the person has previously operated a money service outside Hong Kong
en.explain: Section 30(4) lists the mandatory considerations, which include convictions for specified offences, overseas convictions, persistent failure to comply with requirements under the Ordinance, whether an individual is an undischarged bankrupt or subject to bankruptcy proceedings, and whether a corporation is in liquidation or subject to a winding up order or receivership.

tc.q: 在根據第30條斷定某人是否適當人選時，海關關長須顧及下列哪項？
options: 該人如屬個人，是否未獲解除破產令的破產人，或是否正受破產法律程序所規限
該人是否持有專業會計資格
該人是否已在香港居住至少七年
該人此前有否在香港以外經營金錢服務
tc.explain: 第30(4)條列出必須顧及的事項，包括就指明罪行的定罪、海外定罪、持續沒有遵從本條例下的規定、個人是否未獲解除破產令的破產人或正受破產法律程序所規限，以及法團是否正在清盤或受清盤令或接管所規限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(b)條

en.q: Which convictions outside Hong Kong must the Commissioner have regard to when assessing fitness and propriety?
options: Convictions for acts that would have constituted specified Hong Kong offences, for offences relating to money laundering or terrorist financing, and for offences requiring a finding of fraud, corruption or dishonesty
Only convictions in jurisdictions that are members of the FATF
Only convictions carrying a sentence of imprisonment exceeding two years
No overseas convictions may be taken into account
en.explain: Section 30(4)(b) requires regard to be had to a conviction in a place outside Hong Kong for an offence in respect of an act that would have constituted a specified offence had it been done in Hong Kong, for an offence relating to money laundering or terrorist financing, or for an offence for which it was necessary to find that the person acted fraudulently, corruptly or dishonestly.

tc.q: 在評估適當人選資格時，海關關長須顧及哪些香港以外的定罪？
options: 就假使在香港作出便會構成指明罪行的作為的定罪、與洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集有關的罪行的定罪，以及須裁定該人欺詐、貪污或不誠實行事的罪行的定罪
只限財務行動特別組織成員司法管轄區的定罪
只限刑期超過兩年的定罪
不得顧及任何海外定罪
tc.explain: 第30(4)(b)條規定須顧及在香港以外地方的定罪，包括就假使在香港作出便會構成指明罪行的作為而被定罪、就與洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集有關的罪行被定罪，或就必須裁定該人欺詐地、貪污地或不誠實地行事的罪行被定罪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(10)條

en.q: For how long is a licence granted under section 30 valid?
options: 2 years, or any other period the Commissioner determines as appropriate in a particular case
1 year in every case
5 years, renewable indefinitely
Until it is revoked or suspended, with no fixed term
en.explain: Section 30(10) provides that, subject to section 34, a licence granted under the section is valid for 2 years, or if the Commissioner considers it appropriate in a particular case, any other period determined by the Commissioner, beginning on the date it is granted.

tc.q: 根據第30條批出的牌照有效期為多久？
options: 2年，或海關關長在個別情況下認為適當而決定的任何其他期間
在任何情況下均為1年
5年，並可無限次續期
直至被撤銷或暫時吊銷為止，並無固定年期
tc.explain: 第30(10)條訂明，在第34條的規限下，根據該條批出的牌照自批出日期起有效期為2年；如海關關長在個別情況下認為適當，則為關長決定的任何其他期間。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(9)條

en.q: What must a notice of the Commissioner's decision to refuse to grant a licence include?
options: A statement of the reasons for the decision and a statement that the applicant may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review
The name of the officer who made the decision and the date of the next available appeal hearing
A refund of the application fee paid under Schedule 3
A direction that the applicant must not re-apply for two years
en.explain: Section 30(9) requires a notice under subsection (6) or (8) to include a statement of the reasons for the decision and a statement that the licensee or applicant may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review of the decision. Sections 31(9), 32(3) and 34(5) impose equivalent requirements.

tc.q: 海關關長拒絕批出牌照的決定通知，須載有甚麼？
options: 決定理由的陳述，以及申請人可向審裁處申請覆核該決定的陳述
作出決定的人員姓名及下一次可供上訴聆訊的日期
退還根據附表3已繳付的申請費用
指示申請人在兩年內不得再次申請
tc.explain: 第30(9)條規定，根據第(6)或(8)款發出的通知須載有決定理由的陳述，以及持牌人或申請人（視屬何情況）可向審裁處申請覆核該決定的陳述。第31(9)、32(3)及34(5)條訂有相應規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(10)條

en.q: A licensee applies to renew its licence, but the licence expires before the Commissioner determines the application. What happens to the licence?
options: It remains in force until the licence is renewed or, if renewal is refused, until the refusal takes effect
It lapses on the expiry date and the licensee must cease operating immediately
It is automatically renewed for a further two years
It remains in force for a maximum of 14 days after expiry
en.explain: Section 31(10) provides that a licence for which a renewal application has been made and which expires before determination remains in force until the licence is renewed or, if renewal is refused, until the Commissioner's decision takes effect — unless the application is withdrawn or the licence is revoked or suspended under section 34.

tc.q: 持牌人申請續牌，但牌照在海關關長裁定申請前已屆滿。該牌照會怎樣？
options: 繼續有效，直至牌照獲續期；如續期被拒，則直至拒絕決定生效為止
於屆滿日失效，持牌人須即時停止經營
自動續期兩年
於屆滿後最多繼續有效14日
tc.explain: 第31(10)條訂明，已提出續期申請而在裁定前已屆滿的牌照，繼續有效直至牌照獲續期，或如續期被拒，直至海關關長拒絕續期的決定生效為止——除非該申請被撤回，或牌照根據第34條被撤銷或暫時吊銷。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(11)條

en.q: When does a renewal granted under section 31 take effect?
options: On the day following the expiration of the licence
On the date the Commissioner signs the renewal
On the first day of the month following renewal
Immediately on receipt of the renewal application
en.explain: Section 31(11) provides that a renewal takes effect on the day following the expiration of the licence or, where section 31(10) applies because the licence continued in force pending determination, on the day following the day on which the licence would have expired but for that subsection.

tc.q: 根據第31條批出的續期何時生效？
options: 於牌照屆滿翌日
於海關關長簽署續期文件當日
於續期後下一個月的首日
於收到續期申請時即時生效
tc.explain: 第31(11)條訂明，續期於牌照屆滿翌日生效；如因第31(10)款而牌照在裁定前繼續有效，則於若非該款牌照本應屆滿之日的翌日生效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(12)條

en.q: For how long is a licence renewed under section 31 valid?
options: 2 years, or any shorter period the Commissioner considers appropriate in a particular case
2 years in every case, with no discretion
3 years, or any longer period the Commissioner determines
The same period as the original licence, whatever that was
en.explain: Section 31(12) provides that, subject to section 34, a renewed licence is valid for 2 years or, if the Commissioner considers it appropriate in a particular case, any shorter period determined by the Commissioner. Note that on a first grant under section 30(10) the Commissioner may determine any other period, not merely a shorter one.

tc.q: 根據第31條續期的牌照有效期為多久？
options: 2年，或海關關長在個別情況下認為適當的任何較短期間
在任何情況下均為2年，並無酌情權
3年，或海關關長決定的任何較長期間
與原有牌照的期間相同，不論該期間為何
tc.explain: 第31(12)條訂明，在第34條的規限下，續期牌照的有效期為2年；如海關關長在個別情況下認為適當，則為關長決定的任何較短期間。留意根據第30(10)條首次批出牌照時，關長可決定任何其他期間，而不限於較短期間。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(5)條

en.q: What may the Commissioner do to the conditions of a licence at the point of renewal?
options: Amend or remove any condition previously imposed, or impose any new condition that the Commissioner thinks fit
Only remove conditions; new conditions may be imposed solely under section 32
Nothing — conditions are fixed for the life of the licence
Amend conditions only with the licensee's written agreement
en.explain: Section 31(5) provides that on renewing a licence the Commissioner may amend or remove any condition previously imposed on the licensee, or impose any new condition that the Commissioner thinks fit. Section 32 provides a separate power to do so at other times.

tc.q: 海關關長在牌照續期時，可對牌照條件作出甚麼處理？
options: 修訂或移除先前施加的任何條件，或施加關長認為合適的任何新條件
只可移除條件；施加新條件只能根據第32條進行
不可作任何處理——條件在牌照有效期內固定不變
只有在持牌人書面同意下方可修訂條件
tc.explain: 第31(5)條訂明，海關關長在為牌照續期時，可修訂或移除先前對持牌人施加的任何條件，或施加關長認為合適的任何新條件。第32條就在其他時間作出上述處理另設權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第32(1)條

en.q: On what basis may the Commissioner amend, remove or impose a licence condition under section 32, outside the grant or renewal process?
options: If the Commissioner is satisfied that it is reasonable to do so in the circumstances
Only if the licensee has been convicted of an offence under the Ordinance
Only if the Review Tribunal has directed the Commissioner to do so
Only at the request of the licensee concerned
en.explain: Section 32(1) permits the Commissioner, in relation to a licence, to amend or remove any condition previously imposed or impose any new condition if satisfied that it is reasonable to do so in the circumstances. No conviction or tribunal direction is required.

tc.q: 在批出或續期程序以外，海關關長可基於甚麼理由根據第32條修訂、移除或施加牌照條件？
options: 關長信納在有關情況下這樣做是合理的
只限持牌人已被裁定犯本條例所訂罪行
只限審裁處已指示關長這樣做
只限應有關持牌人的要求
tc.explain: 第32(1)條准許海關關長如信納在有關情況下這樣做是合理的，即可就某牌照修訂或移除先前施加的任何條件，或施加任何新條件。並不需要有定罪或審裁處的指示。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第32(4)條；第30(7)條

en.q: When does an amendment, removal or imposition of a licence condition take effect?
options: At the time the written notice is received by the licensee, or at the time specified in the notice, whichever is the later
Immediately on the Commissioner making the decision
Fourteen days after the notice is posted to the licensee
On the next anniversary of the grant of the licence
en.explain: Section 32(4), like sections 30(7) and 31(7), provides that the amendment, removal or imposition takes effect at the time the notice is received by the licensee, or at the time specified in the notice, whichever is the later.

tc.q: 修訂、移除或施加牌照條件何時生效？
options: 於持牌人接獲書面通知時，或通知所指明的時間，以較遲者為準
於海關關長作出決定時即時生效
於通知寄發予持牌人後14日
於牌照批出的下一個周年日
tc.explain: 第32(4)條（與第30(7)及31(7)條相同）訂明，該項修訂、移除或施加於持牌人接獲通知時，或通知所指明的時間生效，以較遲者為準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第33條

en.q: Which of the following must a licence specify or be endorsed with under section 33?
options: The conditions imposed or amended under sections 30, 31 or 32, and the period for which the licence is valid
The names of the licensee's ultimate owners and their shareholdings
The maximum value of transactions the licensee may handle in a year
The identity of the authorized officer assigned to supervise the licensee
en.explain: Section 33 requires a licence to be in a form specified by the Commissioner and to specify the address of every premises (or the correspondence address), to be endorsed with the conditions imposed or amended under sections 30, 31 or 32, and to specify the period for which the licence is valid.

tc.q: 根據第33條，牌照須指明或批註下列哪項？
options: 根據第30、31或32條施加或修訂的條件，以及牌照的有效期
持牌人最終擁有人的姓名及其持股量
持牌人每年可處理交易的最高價值
獲指派監管該持牌人的獲授權人員身分
tc.explain: 第33條規定牌照須採用海關關長指明的格式，並須指明每一處所的地址（或通訊地址）、批註根據第30、31或32條施加或修訂的條件，以及指明牌照的有效期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(1)(b)條

en.q: A licensee operates a money service at domestic premises and a new occupant refuses to give written consent for an authorized person to enter. What may the Commissioner do?
options: Revoke the licence, or suspend it for a specified period or until a specified event occurs
Nothing, because consent is required only from the original occupants
Order the licensee to pay a pecuniary penalty of up to $10 million
Apply to the Court of First Instance for an order compelling the occupant to consent
en.explain: Section 34(1)(b) makes the revocation or suspension powers in section 34(2) available where an occupant of domestic premises revokes previously given written consent, or a new occupant refuses to give such consent, for an authorized person to enter for the purposes of section 9.

tc.q: 某持牌人在住宅處所經營金錢服務，而新佔用人拒絕給予書面同意讓獲授權人進入。海關關長可怎樣做？
options: 撤銷該牌照，或在指明期間內或直至指明事件發生前暫時吊銷該牌照
無可作為，因只須取得原有佔用人的同意
命令該持牌人繳付最高1,000萬元的罰款
向原訟法庭申請命令，強制該佔用人給予同意
tc.explain: 第34(1)(b)條訂明，凡住宅處所的佔用人撤回先前給予的書面同意，或新佔用人拒絕給予該書面同意，讓獲授權人為第9條的目的進入處所，海關關長即可行使第34(2)條的撤銷或暫時吊銷權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(3)條

en.q: What procedural safeguard must the Commissioner observe before revoking or suspending a licence under section 34?
options: The Commissioner must give the licensee a reasonable opportunity to be heard
The Commissioner must obtain the prior approval of the Review Tribunal
The Commissioner must publish a notice in the Gazette 30 days in advance
The Commissioner must refer the matter to the Financial Secretary
en.explain: Section 34(3) provides that the Commissioner may only exercise a power under section 34(1) after giving the licensee a reasonable opportunity to be heard. Section 44(1) imposes the same safeguard before the exercise of disciplinary powers under section 43.

tc.q: 海關關長根據第34條撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照前，須遵守甚麼程序保障？
options: 關長須給予持牌人合理的陳述機會
關長須事先取得審裁處批准
關長須提前30日在憲報刊登公告
關長須將事宜轉交財政司司長
tc.explain: 第34(3)條訂明，海關關長只可在給予持牌人合理的陳述機會後，方可行使第34(1)條下的權力。第44(1)條就行使第43條的紀律權力前訂有相同保障。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(7)條；第41(3)條

en.q: A licence is revoked under section 34. What happens to the licence fee already paid?
options: No licence fee paid in respect of the grant or renewal is to be refunded
The unexpired portion of the fee is refunded on a pro-rata basis
The whole fee is refunded once the licence is surrendered
The fee is credited against any pecuniary penalty imposed
en.explain: Section 34(7) provides that if a licence is revoked or suspended, no licence fee paid in respect of the grant or renewal is to be refunded. Section 41(3) applies the same rule where a licence is returned for cancellation on cessation of business.

tc.q: 牌照根據第34條被撤銷。已繳付的牌照費用會怎樣？
options: 就批出或續期而繳付的牌照費用一概不獲退還
按未屆滿部分按比例退還
一經交回牌照即全數退還
用以抵銷所施加的任何罰款
tc.explain: 第34(7)條訂明，如牌照被撤銷或暫時吊銷，就批出或續期而繳付的牌照費用一概不獲退還。第41(3)條就因停止營業而交回牌照註銷的情況訂有相同規則。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(8)條

en.q: A person whose licence is revoked fails to surrender it within the time specified in the Commissioner's notice. What is the consequence?
options: The person commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5
The person is automatically disqualified from holding a licence for five years
The Commissioner may impose a pecuniary penalty of up to $1 million
The Court of First Instance may commit the person for contempt
en.explain: Section 34(8) provides that if a person whose licence is revoked does not surrender the licence within the time specified in the notice given under subsection (4), the person commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5.

tc.q: 牌照被撤銷的人沒有在海關關長通知所指明的時間內交回牌照，後果為何？
options: 該人即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款
該人自動被取消持有牌照資格五年
關長可施加最高100萬元的罰款
原訟法庭可就藐視法庭而將該人交付羈押
tc.explain: 第34(8)條訂明，如牌照被撤銷的人沒有在根據第(4)款發出的通知所指明的時間內交回牌照，該人即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第35(1)條

en.q: In relation to a licensee that is a corporation, what must happen before a person becomes a director?
options: The Commissioner must have given written approval on an application of the licensee
The licensee must notify the Commissioner within one month afterwards
The person must personally pass the Competence Assessment
The Review Tribunal must confirm the person's fitness and propriety
en.explain: Section 35(1) provides that a person must not become a director of a licensee corporation unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, given approval in writing. Prior approval is required — after-the-fact notification is not sufficient.

tc.q: 就屬法團的持牌人而言，某人成為董事前須先發生甚麼？
options: 海關關長須應持牌人的申請給予書面批准
持牌人須於其後一個月內通知關長
該人須親自通過能力評核
審裁處須確認該人的適當人選資格
tc.explain: 第35(1)條訂明，除非海關關長應持牌人的申請以書面給予批准，否則任何人不得成為持牌法團的董事。必須事先批准，事後通知並不足夠。

en.q: What is the penalty for a person who, without reasonable excuse, becomes a licensee's director, ultimate owner or partner without the Commissioner's prior approval?
options: A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 2 years
A pecuniary penalty of up to $1 million imposed by the Commissioner
A fine at level 5 only, with no possibility of imprisonment
en.explain: Sections 35(7), 36(7) and 37(7) each provide that a person who without reasonable excuse contravenes subsection (1) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 任何人無合理辯解而在未獲海關關長事先批准下成為持牌人的董事、最終擁有人或合夥人，刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款及監禁6個月
第6級罰款及監禁2年
由關長施加最高100萬元的罰款
只處第5級罰款，不可判處監禁
tc.explain: 第35(7)、36(7)及37(7)條均訂明，任何人無合理辯解而違反第(1)款，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第36(1)條

en.q: Whose prior written approval is required before a person becomes an ultimate owner of a licensee?
options: The Commissioner's, on an application made by the licensee
The Companies Registry's, on an application by the incoming owner
The Review Tribunal's, on an application by the licensee
No approval is required, provided the change is notified within one month
en.explain: Section 36(1) provides that a person must not become an ultimate owner of a licensee unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, given approval in writing. Note that the application is made by the licensee, not by the incoming ultimate owner.

tc.q: 任何人成為持牌人的最終擁有人前，須事先取得何人的書面批准？
options: 海關關長的批准，並須由持牌人提出申請
公司註冊處的批准，並須由新任擁有人提出申請
審裁處的批准，並須由持牌人提出申請
無須批准，只要於一個月內通知變更即可
tc.explain: 第36(1)條訂明，除非海關關長應持牌人的申請以書面給予批准，否則任何人不得成為持牌人的最終擁有人。留意申請須由持牌人（而非新任最終擁有人）提出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第37(3)條；第35(3)條

en.q: The fitness-and-propriety test differs slightly between the approval sections. Under section 37, of what must the Commissioner be satisfied about a proposed new partner?
options: That the person is a fit and proper person to operate a money service
That the person is a fit and proper person to be associated with the licensee's money service business
That the person has at least three years' experience in the money service industry
That the person holds no directorship in any other licensed MSO
en.explain: Section 37(3) requires satisfaction that a proposed partner is a fit and proper person to operate a money service, mirroring section 30(3)(a)(ii)(A) for partnerships. Sections 35(3) and 36(3), dealing with directors and ultimate owners, use the formula “to be associated with the licensee's money service business”.

tc.q: 各項批准條文的適當人選準則略有不同。根據第37條，海關關長須就擬任新合夥人信納甚麼？
options: 該人是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選
該人是適合與該持牌人的金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選
該人在金錢服務行業擁有至少三年經驗
該人並無在任何其他持牌金錢服務經營者擔任董事
tc.explain: 第37(3)條規定須信納擬任合夥人是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選，與第30(3)(a)(ii)(A)條就合夥的規定相對應。第35(3)及36(3)條就董事及最終擁有人則採用「適合與該持牌人的金錢服務業務有聯繫」的表述。

en.q: In deciding whether to approve a proposed director, ultimate owner or partner, which matters must the Commissioner have regard to?
options: The matters specified in section 30(4)(a) to (e), in addition to any other matter the Commissioner considers relevant
Only whether the person has been convicted of an offence under the AMLO
Only the person's financial standing and net worth
Only matters raised by the licensee in its application
en.explain: Sections 35(4), 36(4) and 37(4) each require the Commissioner, in addition to any other relevant matter, to have regard to the matters specified in section 30(4)(a), (b), (c), (d) and (e) — the same list applied on a grant or renewal of a licence.

tc.q: 海關關長在決定是否批准擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人時，須顧及哪些事項？
options: 第30(4)(a)至(e)條所指明的事項，以及關長認為相關的任何其他事項
只限該人有否被裁定犯《打擊洗錢條例》所訂罪行
只限該人的財政狀況及資產淨值
只限持牌人在申請中提出的事項
tc.explain: 第35(4)、36(4)及37(4)條均規定海關關長除顧及任何其他相關事項外，亦須顧及第30(4)(a)、(b)、(c)、(d)及(e)條所指明的事項——即批出或續期牌照時所適用的同一份清單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38(1)條

en.q: A licensee licensed to operate at premises specified in its licence wishes to open an additional branch. What must it do first?
options: Apply to the Commissioner to have the new premises added to the licence
Notify the Commissioner in writing within one month of opening
Obtain the written consent of the landlord and file it with the register
Apply for a separate second licence for the new premises
en.explain: Section 38(1) provides that such a licensee must not operate a money service at any premises other than those specified unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, added the new premises to the licence. Section 38(3) requires payment of the Schedule 3 fee.

tc.q: 獲發牌在牌照指明處所經營的持牌人擬開設額外分行。它須先怎樣做？
options: 向海關關長申請將新處所加入牌照內
於開業後一個月內以書面通知關長
取得業主的書面同意並存檔於登記冊
就新處所另行申請第二個牌照
tc.explain: 第38(1)條訂明，除非海關關長應持牌人的申請將新處所加入牌照內，否則該持牌人不得在指明處所以外的任何處所經營金錢服務。第38(3)條規定須繳付附表3的費用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38(7)條；第39(7)條

en.q: After granting an application to add new business premises, what must the Commissioner do?
options: Add the relevant particulars to the register as soon as reasonably practicable
Publish a notice of the addition in the Gazette within seven days
Issue an entirely new licence to replace the existing one
Inspect the new premises within 30 days of the grant
en.explain: Section 38(7) requires the Commissioner, as soon as reasonably practicable after granting an application, to add the relevant particulars to the register. Section 39(7) correspondingly requires the register to be amended where premises are added under that section.

tc.q: 海關關長批准新增業務處所的申請後，須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快將有關詳情加入登記冊
於七日內在憲報刊登新增公告
發出全新牌照以取代現有牌照
於批准後30日內視察新處所
tc.explain: 第38(7)條規定海關關長須在批准申請後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快將有關詳情加入登記冊。第39(7)條就根據該條新增處所的情況，相應規定須修訂登記冊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38(8)條；第39(8)條

en.q: What is the penalty for a licensee that, without reasonable excuse, operates a money service at premises that have not been added to its licence?
options: A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 5 only
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
Automatic revocation of the licence without a hearing
en.explain: Sections 38(8) and 39(8) each provide that a licensee who without reasonable excuse contravenes subsection (1) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months. Note that the section 39A display offence carries a level 5 fine only.

tc.q: 持牌人無合理辯解而在未加入其牌照的處所經營金錢服務，刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款及監禁6個月
只處第5級罰款
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
無須聆訊即自動撤銷牌照
tc.explain: 第38(8)及39(8)條均訂明，持牌人無合理辯解而違反第(1)款，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。留意第39A條的展示牌照罪行只可處第5級罰款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第39A(2)條

en.q: What is the penalty for a licensee that, without reasonable excuse, fails to display the original of its licence in a conspicuous place at the specified premises?
options: A fine at level 5, with no term of imprisonment
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A pecuniary penalty of up to $1,000,000
en.explain: Section 39A(2) provides for a fine at level 5 only. This is lighter than the sections 38(8) and 39(8) premises offences, which also carry up to 6 months' imprisonment.

tc.q: 持牌人無合理辯解而沒有在指明處所的顯眼位置展示牌照正本，刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款，並無監禁
第5級罰款及監禁6個月
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
最高1,000,000元的罰款
tc.explain: 第39A(2)條只訂明可處第5級罰款。這較第38(8)及39(8)條的處所罪行為輕，後者另可判處最高6個月監禁。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第40(2)條

en.q: Do the particulars that must be kept up to date under section 40 include particulars previously notified to the Commissioner as changes?
options: Yes — particulars provided in connection with a section 30 or 31 application include particulars notified under section 40(1)
No — only the particulars in the original application need be updated
Only if the Commissioner expressly requests a further update
Only where the change concerns a director or ultimate owner
en.explain: Section 40(2) provides that, for the purposes of subsection (1), particulars provided in connection with a licensee's application under section 30 or 31 include particulars notified under that subsection. The duty to notify therefore rolls forward to cover previously notified changes.

tc.q: 第40條下須保持更新的詳情，是否包括先前已作為變更通知海關關長的詳情？
options: 包括——就第30或31條申請所提供的詳情，包括根據第40(1)款通知的詳情
不包括——只需更新原本申請中的詳情
只有在關長明確要求進一步更新時方須更新
只限涉及董事或最終擁有人的變更
tc.explain: 第40(2)條訂明，就第(1)款而言，就持牌人根據第30或31條提出的申請所提供的詳情，包括根據該款通知的詳情。因此通知責任會延續，涵蓋先前已通知的變更。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第40(4)條

en.q: What is the penalty for a licensee that, without reasonable excuse, fails to notify the Commissioner of a change in its particulars?
options: A fine at level 5, with no term of imprisonment
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 12 months
Revocation of the licence under section 34
en.explain: Section 40(4) provides for a fine at level 5 on conviction, with no term of imprisonment — the same penalty as under sections 39A(2) and 41(4). A contravention of section 40(1) is also a ground for disciplinary action under section 43(1)(c).

tc.q: 持牌人無合理辯解而沒有將其詳情的變更通知海關關長，刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款，並無監禁
第5級罰款及監禁6個月
第6級罰款及監禁12個月
根據第34條撤銷牌照
tc.explain: 第40(4)條訂明一經定罪可處第5級罰款，並無監禁——與第39A(2)及41(4)條的刑罰相同。違反第40(1)條亦屬第43(1)(c)條下採取紀律行動的理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(1)(b)條

en.q: Within what period after the date of cessation must a licensee return its licence to the Commissioner for cancellation or amendment?
options: Within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation
Within 14 days beginning on the date of cessation
Within one month beginning on the date of cessation
Within 45 days before the date of cessation
en.explain: Section 41(1) requires the licensee to notify the Commissioner in writing of the intention and the date of cessation before that date, and to return the licence for cancellation or amendment within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation.

tc.q: 持牌人須於停止營業日期後多久內，將牌照交回海關關長註銷或修訂？
options: 自停止營業日期起計7日內
自停止營業日期起計14日內
自停止營業日期起計一個月內
於停止營業日期前45日內
tc.explain: 第41(1)條規定持牌人須在停止營業日期前以書面將該意向及日期通知海關關長，並須於自停止營業日期起計7日內將牌照交回註銷或修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(2)條

en.q: On receiving a licence returned on cessation of business, what must the Commissioner do?
options: Cancel or amend the licence and remove the relevant particulars from the register, as soon as reasonably practicable
Retain the licence for six years as a statutory record
Refund the unexpired portion of the licence fee
Publish the cessation in the Gazette before amending the register
en.explain: Section 41(2) requires the Commissioner, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving a licence under subsection (1)(b), to cancel or amend the licence and remove the relevant particulars from the register. Section 41(3) confirms that no fee is refunded.

tc.q: 海關關長接獲因停止營業而交回的牌照後，須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快註銷或修訂該牌照，並從登記冊剔除有關詳情
將該牌照作為法定紀錄保存六年
退還牌照費用中未屆滿的部分
在修訂登記冊前於憲報公布該項停業
tc.explain: 第41(2)條規定海關關長須在接獲根據第(1)(b)款交回的牌照後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快註銷或修訂該牌照，並從登記冊剔除有關詳情。第41(3)條確認費用不獲退還。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第42條

en.q: When does a licence held by a partnership cease to be valid under section 42?
options: On the dissolution of the partnership
On the retirement of any one partner
On the expiry of 12 months after any change in the partners
Only when the Commissioner formally revokes it
en.explain: Section 42 provides that a licence ceases to be valid on the death of an individual licensee, on the dissolution of a partnership, or on the commencement of winding up of a corporation. No act of the Commissioner is required.

tc.q: 根據第42條，合夥持有的牌照何時停止有效？
options: 於該合夥解散時
於任何一名合夥人退出時
於合夥人有任何變動後滿12個月時
只有在海關關長正式撤銷時
tc.explain: 第42條訂明，牌照於個人持牌人去世時、合夥解散時，或法團展開清盤時停止有效。無須海關關長作出任何行為。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第42條

en.q: A corporate licensee commences winding up. What is the effect on its MSO licence?
options: The licence ceases to be valid on the commencement of the winding up
The licence remains valid until the winding up is completed
The licence transfers to the liquidator for the duration of the winding up
The licence remains valid until its stated expiry date
en.explain: Section 42(c) provides that where the licensee is a corporation, the licence ceases to be valid on the commencement of winding up of the corporation. Note also that section 30(4)(e) makes liquidation a relevant consideration in assessing fitness and propriety.

tc.q: 某法團持牌人展開清盤。其金錢服務經營者牌照有何影響？
options: 牌照於清盤展開時停止有效
牌照維持有效直至清盤完成
牌照在清盤期間轉予清盤人
牌照維持有效直至其所述屆滿日期
tc.explain: 第42(c)條訂明，如持牌人是法團，牌照於該法團展開清盤時停止有效。另留意第30(4)(e)條將清盤列為評估適當人選資格時的相關考慮事項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(2)(c)條

en.q: What is the maximum pecuniary penalty the Commissioner may order a licensee to pay under section 43?
options: The greater of $10 million or 3 times the profit gained
en.explain: Section 43(2)(c) caps the pecuniary penalty at $1,000,000. The much larger cap — the greater of $10 million or 3 times the profit gained or costs avoided — applies under section 21 in Part 4 to contraventions of specified provisions of Schedule 2, which is a different disciplinary route.

tc.q: 根據第43條，海關關長可命令持牌人繳付的最高罰款為何？
options: 1,000萬元或所獲利潤的3倍，以較高者為準
tc.explain: 第43(2)(c)條將罰款上限訂為1,000,000元。上限高得多的款額（1,000萬元或所獲利潤或所避免成本的3倍，以較高者為準）適用於第4部第21條下違反附表2指明條文的情況，屬另一紀律途徑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(1)條

en.q: Which of the following is a ground on which the Commissioner may take disciplinary action under section 43?
options: The licensee contravenes any regulation made under section 51
The licensee's turnover falls below a level specified by the Commissioner
The licensee employs a person who has not passed the Competence Assessment
The licensee changes its auditors without prior approval
en.explain: Section 43(1) lists three grounds: contravention of any regulation made under section 51, contravention of any condition of the licence, and contravention of sections 35(1), 36(1), 37(1), 38(1), 39(1), 39A(1), 40(1) or 41(1).

tc.q: 下列何者屬海關關長可根據第43條採取紀律行動的理由？
options: 持牌人違反根據第51條訂立的任何規例
持牌人的營業額低於關長指明的水平
持牌人聘用未通過能力評核的人
持牌人未經事先批准更換核數師
tc.explain: 第43(1)條列出三項理由：違反根據第51條訂立的任何規例、違反牌照的任何條件，以及違反第35(1)、36(1)、37(1)、38(1)、39(1)、39A(1)、40(1)或41(1)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(3)條

en.q: Within what period must a licensee pay a pecuniary penalty ordered under section 43?
options: Within 30 days, or any longer period the Commissioner specifies by notice, after the order takes effect as a specified decision
Within 7 days of the order being made
Within 30 days of the order being made, with no possibility of extension
Within 12 months after the order takes effect
en.explain: Section 43(3) requires payment within 30 days or any longer period specified by the Commissioner by notice under section 44(2), running from when the order has taken effect as a specified decision under section 75.

tc.q: 持牌人須於多久內繳付根據第43條命令繳付的罰款？
options: 自命令根據第75條作為指明決定生效後30日內，或關長以通知指明的任何較長期間內
自命令作出後7日內
自命令作出後30日內，並不可延長
自命令生效後12個月內
tc.explain: 第43(3)條規定須於30日內，或海關關長根據第44(2)條以通知指明的任何較長期間內繳付；有關期間自該命令根據第75條作為指明決定生效時起計。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(4)條

en.q: A licensee fails to comply with an order to take remedial action made under section 43. What further order may the Commissioner make?
options: An order to pay a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $10,000 for each day the failure continues after the specified date
An order immediately revoking the licence without a hearing
An order doubling the original pecuniary penalty
An order referring the licensee for prosecution under section 29
en.explain: Section 43(4) empowers the Commissioner, where a licensee fails to comply with a remedial order, to further order the licensee to pay a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $10,000 for each day on which the failure continues after the date specified in the order.

tc.q: 持牌人沒有遵從根據第43條作出的採取糾正行動命令。海關關長可另行作出甚麼命令？
options: 命令就該項不遵從在指明日期後持續的每一日，繳付不超過10,000元的每日罰款
命令即時撤銷牌照而無須聆訊
命令將原有罰款加倍
命令將該持牌人轉介根據第29條檢控
tc.explain: 第43(4)條授權海關關長在持牌人沒有遵從糾正命令時，可另行命令該持牌人就該項不遵從在命令所指明日期後持續的每一日，繳付不超過10,000元的每日罰款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(5)及(6)條

en.q: How may the Commissioner enforce an unpaid pecuniary penalty ordered under section 43?
options: By applying to register the order in the Court of First Instance, whereupon it is treated as a civil judgment for the payment of money
By seizing the licensee's assets under a warrant issued by a magistrate
By instructing the licensee's bank to debit the amount directly
By suspending the licence until the penalty is paid
en.explain: Section 43(5) permits the Court of First Instance, on the Commissioner's application, to register the order, after which it is regarded for all purposes as an order of that Court made within its civil jurisdiction for the payment of money. Section 43(6) sets out the procedure before the Registrar of the High Court.

tc.q: 海關關長可如何強制執行根據第43條命令繳付而未繳付的罰款？
options: 申請將該命令在原訟法庭登記，登記後即視為該法庭在民事司法管轄權內作出的付款判令
根據裁判官發出的手令扣押持牌人的資產
指示持牌人的銀行直接扣賬
暫時吊銷牌照直至罰款繳付為止
tc.explain: 第43(5)條准許原訟法庭應海關關長的申請將該命令登記；登記後，該命令就一切目的而言，視為該法庭在其民事司法管轄權內作出的付款命令。第43(6)條訂明向高等法院司法常務官提出的程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(7)條

en.q: After exercising a disciplinary power under section 43, what may the Commissioner disclose to the public?
options: Details of the decision, the reasons for it, and any material facts relating to the case
Only the name of the licensee and the amount of any penalty
Nothing, unless the licensee consents in writing
Only the fact that a decision has been made, without any detail
en.explain: Section 43(7) provides that if the Commissioner has exercised the powers under subsection (1) in respect of a licensee, the Commissioner may disclose to the public details of the decision, the reasons for which the decision was made, and any material facts relating to the case.

tc.q: 海關關長行使第43條的紀律權力後，可向公眾披露甚麼？
options: 決定的詳情、作出該決定的理由，以及與該個案有關的任何要項事實
只限持牌人的名稱及任何罰款的款額
除非持牌人書面同意，否則不可披露任何事項
只可披露已作出決定一事，而不披露任何詳情
tc.explain: 第43(7)條訂明，海關關長如已就某持牌人行使第(1)款下的權力，可向公眾披露該決定的詳情、作出該決定的理由，以及與該個案有關的任何要項事實。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第44(3)條

en.q: Which of the following must a notice of a section 43 disciplinary decision include?
options: The terms of any reprimand, the action required, the amount of any pecuniary penalty, and a statement that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal
Only the amount of the pecuniary penalty and the date for payment
The name of the officer who investigated the contravention
A draft of the public statement the Commissioner intends to publish
en.explain: Section 44(3) requires the notice to include a statement of reasons, the terms of any reprimand, any action required, the amount of any pecuniary penalty and its payment date where different from section 43(3)(a), and a statement that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review.

tc.q: 第43條紀律決定的通知須載有下列哪項？
options: 任何譴責的措辭、所規定採取的行動、任何罰款的款額，以及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核的陳述
只限罰款款額及繳付日期
調查該項違反的人員姓名
關長擬刊登的公開聲明草稿
tc.explain: 第44(3)條規定該通知須載有決定理由的陳述、任何譴責的措辭、所規定採取的行動、任何罰款的款額及（如繳付時間有別於第43(3)(a)條所訂者）繳付時間，以及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核該決定的陳述。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第45(1)條

en.q: What must the Commissioner do before first exercising the power to impose a pecuniary penalty under section 43(2)(c)?
options: Publish in the Gazette, and in any other manner considered appropriate, guidelines indicating how the power is proposed to be exercised
Obtain the approval of the Legislative Council for a scale of penalties
Consult every licensee affected by the proposed guidelines
Apply to the Court of First Instance for directions
en.explain: Section 45(1) requires the Commissioner, before first exercising the pecuniary penalty power, to publish guidelines in the Gazette and in any other appropriate manner indicating the manner in which the power is proposed to be exercised. Section 45(2) requires the Commissioner to have regard to those guidelines when exercising the power.

tc.q: 海關關長首次行使第43(2)(c)條施加罰款的權力前，須怎樣做？
options: 在憲報及以其認為適當的任何其他方式，公布指引說明擬如何行使該權力
就罰款級別取得立法會批准
諮詢每名受擬議指引影響的持牌人
向原訟法庭申請指示
tc.explain: 第45(1)條規定海關關長在首次行使施加罰款的權力前，須在憲報及以其認為適當的任何其他方式公布指引，說明關長擬以何種方式行使該權力。第45(2)條規定關長行使該權力時須顧及該等指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第45(3)條

en.q: What is the legal status of guidelines published by the Commissioner under section 45(1)?
options: They are not subsidiary legislation
They are subsidiary legislation subject to negative vetting by the Legislative Council
They have the same force as a provision of Schedule 2
They are binding on the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 45(3) states expressly that guidelines published under subsection (1) are not subsidiary legislation. The Commissioner must nevertheless have regard to them when exercising the pecuniary penalty power, under section 45(2).

tc.q: 海關關長根據第45(1)條公布的指引具有甚麼法律地位？
options: 並非附屬法例
屬附屬法例，須經立法會先訂立後審議程序
與附表2條文具同等效力
對審裁處具約束力
tc.explain: 第45(3)條明確訂明根據第(1)款公布的指引並非附屬法例。然而，根據第45(2)條，海關關長在行使施加罰款的權力時仍須顧及該等指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第46條

en.q: Whom may the Commissioner appoint in writing to be an authorized officer for the purposes of Part 5?
options: Any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department
Any person the Commissioner considers suitably qualified, whether or not a public officer
Only officers of the rank of Superintendent or above
Only officers seconded from the Hong Kong Police Force
en.explain: Section 46 provides that the Commissioner may appoint in writing any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department to be an authorized officer for the purposes of Part 5. This is distinct from the authorized persons appointed under section 9(12) for inspection purposes.

tc.q: 就第5部而言，海關關長可以書面委任何人為獲授權人員？
options: 任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員
關長認為具備適當資格的任何人，不論是否公職人員
只限總監級或以上的人員
只限由香港警務處借調的人員
tc.explain: 第46條訂明海關關長可以書面委任任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員，就第5部而言為獲授權人員。這有別於根據第9(12)條為視察目的而委任的獲授權人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(1)條

en.q: On what basis may a magistrate issue a warrant authorising an authorized officer to enter and search premises under section 47?
options: If satisfied by information on oath that there are reasonable grounds to suspect that a section 29 offence has been or is being committed on the premises
If the Commissioner certifies that a licensee has breached a licence condition
If the licensee has failed to pay a pecuniary penalty within 30 days
If an authorized person has been refused entry during a routine inspection
en.explain: Section 47(1) empowers a magistrate, if satisfied by information on oath that there are reasonable grounds to suspect that an offence under section 29 — operating a money service without a licence — has been or is being committed on any premises, to issue a warrant to enter, search, and seize evidence.

tc.q: 裁判官可基於甚麼理由根據第47條發出手令，授權獲授權人員進入及搜查處所？
options: 經宣誓而作的告發信納有合理理由懷疑第29條所訂罪行已在或正在該處所發生
海關關長證明某持牌人已違反牌照條件
持牌人未於30日內繳付罰款
獲授權人在例行視察時被拒進入
tc.explain: 第47(1)條授權裁判官如因經宣誓而作的告發信納有合理理由懷疑第29條所訂罪行（即無牌經營金錢服務）已在或正在任何處所發生，即可發出手令進入、搜查及檢取證據。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(4)條

en.q: What is the penalty for obstructing an authorized officer exercising a power conferred by a warrant under section 47?
options: A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine at level 4 only
en.explain: Section 47(4) provides that a person who obstructs an authorized officer exercising a power conferred by a warrant or by section 47(2) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 6 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 阻礙獲授權人員行使第47條手令所授予的權力，刑罰為何？
options: 第6級罰款及監禁6個月
第5級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
只處第4級罰款
tc.explain: 第47(4)條訂明，任何人阻礙獲授權人員行使手令或第47(2)條所授予的權力，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(1)及(4)條

en.q: An authorized officer arrests a person without warrant on suspicion of an offence under section 29. For how long may that person be detained without being charged and brought before a magistrate?
options: Not more than 48 hours
Not more than 24 hours
Not more than 72 hours
Not more than 7 days
en.explain: Section 48(1) permits arrest or detention without warrant where there are reasonable grounds to suspect a section 29 offence, and section 48(4) provides that a person, whether arrested or not, must not be detained for more than 48 hours without being charged and brought before a magistrate.

tc.q: 獲授權人員因懷疑某人犯第29條所訂罪行而無手令將其拘捕。該人在未被落案控告及帶往裁判官席前的情況下，可被扣留多久？
options: 不超過48小時
不超過24小時
不超過72小時
不超過7日
tc.explain: 第48(1)條准許在有合理理由懷疑第29條罪行時無手令拘捕或扣留；第48(4)條則訂明任何人（不論是否已被拘捕）在未被落案控告及帶往裁判官席前的情況下，被扣留的時間不得超過48小時。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(7)條

en.q: What restriction applies to the searching of a person arrested under section 48?
options: A person may be searched only by an authorized officer of the same sex
A person may be searched only in the presence of a legal representative
A person may be searched only after being brought to a police station
A person may be searched only with a magistrate's written authority
en.explain: Section 48(7) provides that a person may be searched only by an authorized officer of the same sex. Section 48(6) sets out the scope of the search power following arrest, covering the person, the place of arrest and its surrounding areas.

tc.q: 根據第48條被拘捕的人接受搜查時，有何限制？
options: 只可由同性別的獲授權人員搜查
只可在法律代表在場的情況下搜查
只可在被帶往警署後搜查
只可在裁判官書面授權下搜查
tc.explain: 第48(7)條訂明只可由同性別的獲授權人員搜查有關人士。第48(6)條則訂明拘捕後搜查權力的範圍，涵蓋該人、其被拘捕的地方及周圍地方。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第11(5)條

en.q: What must an investigator do before first imposing a requirement on a person under section 12?
options: Produce a copy of the relevant authority's direction or appointment to that person for inspection
Obtain a warrant from a magistrate
Serve a notice on the person at least 14 days in advance
Notify the Review Tribunal of the intended requirement
en.explain: Section 11(5) requires an investigator, before first imposing any requirement under section 12(2), (3), (4) or (5), to produce a copy of the relevant authority's direction or appointment to that person for inspection. Section 11(4) requires the authority to provide the investigator with that copy.

tc.q: 調查員首次根據第12條向某人施加規定前，必須怎樣做？
options: 向該人出示有關當局的指示或委任書副本以供查閱
向裁判官取得手令
至少提前14日向該人送達通知
將擬施加的規定通知審裁處
tc.explain: 第11(5)條規定調查員在首次根據第12(2)、(3)、(4)或(5)款施加任何規定前，須向該人出示有關當局的指示或委任書副本以供查閱。第11(4)條則規定有關當局須向調查員提供該副本。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(1)條

en.q: Who is a “covered person” against whom an investigator may exercise powers under section 12?
options: A person under investigation, or a person the investigator reasonably believes possesses relevant records or relevant information
Only the financial institution that is the subject of the investigation
Only a person who has been charged with an offence under the Ordinance
Only a customer of the institution under investigation
en.explain: Section 12(1) defines a covered person as a person in relation to whom an investigator is directed or appointed to investigate, a person reasonably believed to be in possession of a record or document containing information relevant to the investigation, or a person reasonably believed to be otherwise in possession of relevant information.

tc.q: 調查員可根據第12條對何人行使權力（即「受涵蓋的人」）？
options: 受調查的人，或調查員合理地相信管有相關紀錄或相關資料的人
只限受調查的金融機構
只限已被控犯本條例所訂罪行的人
只限受調查機構的客戶
tc.explain: 第12(1)條界定「受涵蓋的人」為：調查員獲指示或獲委任就其調查事宜的人、調查員有合理因由相信管有載有與調查相關資料的紀錄或文件的人，或調查員有合理因由相信以其他方式管有相關資料的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(2)(d)條

en.q: Besides producing records and answering questions, what further obligation may an investigator impose on a covered person under section 12(2)?
options: To give the investigator all other assistance in connection with the investigation that the person is reasonably able to give
To pay the costs of the investigation
To suspend all business activity until the investigation concludes
To provide legal representation for other persons under investigation
en.explain: Section 12(2)(d) allows an investigator to require a covered person to give all other assistance in connection with the investigation that the person is reasonably able to give, in addition to producing records, attending to answer questions and responding to written questions.

tc.q: 除交出紀錄及回答問題外，調查員可根據第12(2)條向受涵蓋的人施加甚麼進一步責任？
options: 就該項調查向調查員提供該人合理地能提供的一切其他協助
支付調查的費用
在調查完結前暫停一切業務活動
為其他受調查的人提供法律代表
tc.explain: 第12(2)(d)條准許調查員規定受涵蓋的人就該項調查提供該人合理地能提供的一切其他協助，此外亦包括交出紀錄、出席回答問題及回應書面問題。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(3)條

en.q: After a covered person produces a record under section 12(2)(a), what further requirement may the investigator impose?
options: A requirement to give an explanation or further particulars in respect of the record
A requirement to have the record certified by an independent auditor
A requirement to translate the record into both official languages
A requirement to surrender the original record permanently
en.explain: Section 12(3) provides that if a covered person produces a record or document in accordance with a requirement under subsection (2)(a), the investigator may, subject to section 12A, require the person to give an explanation or further particulars in respect of the record or document.

tc.q: 受涵蓋的人根據第12(2)(a)條交出紀錄後，調查員可施加甚麼進一步規定？
options: 規定就該紀錄作出解釋或提供進一步詳情
規定由獨立核數師核證該紀錄
規定將該紀錄翻譯成兩種法定語文
規定永久交出該紀錄正本
tc.explain: 第12(3)條訂明，如受涵蓋的人按照第(2)(a)款的規定交出紀錄或文件，調查員可在第12A條的規限下，規定該人就該紀錄或文件作出解釋或提供進一步詳情。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(9)條

en.q: What must an investigator do after completing an investigation under section 12?
options: Make a final report on the investigation to the relevant authority as soon as reasonably practicable
Publish a summary of the findings in the Gazette
Refer the matter directly to the Secretary for Justice for prosecution
Destroy all working papers within six months
en.explain: Section 12(9) requires an investigator, as soon as reasonably practicable after completing the investigation, to make a final report to the relevant authority. Section 12(8) also provides for interim reports, which the investigator must make when required by the relevant authority.

tc.q: 調查員根據第12條完成調查後，須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快就該項調查向有關當局提交最終報告
在憲報刊登調查結果摘要
將事宜直接轉交律政司司長以作檢控
於六個月內銷毀所有工作底稿
tc.explain: 第12(9)條規定調查員須在完成調查後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快向有關當局提交最終報告。第12(8)條亦訂明中期報告；有關當局要求時，調查員須提交中期報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(10)條

en.q: Whose consent is required before a relevant authority may publish a report made under section 12?
options: The Secretary for Justice
The Financial Secretary
The Chief Executive in Council
The person who was the subject of the investigation
en.explain: Section 12(10) provides that a relevant authority may, with the consent of the Secretary for Justice, publish a report made under that section. Contrast section 11(1), where the Financial Secretary's consent is needed to appoint an outside investigator.

tc.q: 有關當局刊登根據第12條提交的報告前，須取得何人同意？
options: 律政司司長
財政司司長
行政長官會同行政會議
受調查的人
tc.explain: 第12(10)條訂明有關當局可在取得律政司司長同意下，刊登根據該條提交的報告。與此對照，第11(1)條下委任外聘調查員則須取得財政司司長同意。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第13(1)及(2)條

en.q: A person without reasonable excuse fails to comply with a requirement imposed by an investigator under section 12. On summary conviction, what is the maximum penalty?
options: A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
en.explain: Section 13(2) provides for a fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year on conviction on indictment, and a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction. This mirrors the section 10(2) penalties for non-compliance with section 9 requirements.

tc.q: 某人無合理辯解而沒有遵從調查員根據第12條施加的規定。循簡易程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款及監禁6個月
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
tc.explain: 第13(2)條訂明循公訴程序定罪可處罰款200,000元及監禁1年，循簡易程序定罪則可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。這與第10(2)條就不遵從第9條規定所訂的刑罰相對應。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第14(1)及(2)條

en.q: Where a person fails to comply with a requirement imposed under section 9 or 12, what alternative to prosecution is available?
options: An application by originating summons to the Court of First Instance for an inquiry, which may punish the person as if guilty of contempt of court
A referral to the Review Tribunal for a determination of the failure
An application to a magistrate for a warrant of committal
A direction by the relevant authority imposing an immediate pecuniary penalty
en.explain: Section 14(1) allows the authorized person or investigator to apply by originating summons to the Court of First Instance for an inquiry into the failure. Under section 14(2) the Court may order compliance and, if satisfied the failure was without reasonable excuse, punish the person and anyone knowingly involved as if guilty of contempt of court.

tc.q: 如某人沒有遵從第9或12條下施加的規定，除檢控外還有甚麼途徑？
options: 以原訟傳票向原訟法庭申請研訊；法庭可猶如該人犯藐視法庭罪般懲罰該人
將該項不遵從轉交審裁處裁定
向裁判官申請羈押手令
由有關當局作出指示，即時施加罰款
tc.explain: 第14(1)條准許獲授權人或調查員以原訟傳票向原訟法庭申請就該項不遵從進行研訊。根據第14(2)條，法庭可命令遵從，並如信納該項不遵從並無合理辯解，可猶如該人及任何在知情下涉及該項不遵從的其他人犯藐視法庭罪般懲罰他們。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第14(4)條

en.q: What prevents a person from being punished twice for the same failure to comply with a section 9 or 12 requirement?
options: No contempt proceedings may be instituted if criminal proceedings for the same conduct have previously been instituted and remain pending or bar further prosecution
The Review Tribunal must consolidate all proceedings arising from the same conduct
The Secretary for Justice must elect in advance between criminal and civil routes
The Court of First Instance must stay any contempt proceedings for six months
en.explain: Section 14(4) provides that no proceedings may be instituted for the purposes of section 14(2)(b) where criminal proceedings under section 10 or 13 have previously been instituted in respect of the same conduct and remain pending, or where their previous institution bars further prosecution. Section 10(10) provides the mirror-image protection.

tc.q: 甚麼規定防止某人就同一項不遵從第9或12條規定的行為被雙重懲罰？
options: 如先前已就同一行為提起刑事法律程序而該程序仍待決，或因該程序而不能再合法提起檢控，則不得為第14(2)(b)條的目的提起法律程序
審裁處須合併因同一行為而引起的所有法律程序
律政司司長須預先在刑事及民事途徑之間作出選擇
原訟法庭須將任何藐視法庭程序擱置六個月
tc.explain: 第14(4)條訂明，如先前已就同一行為根據第10或13條提起刑事法律程序，而該程序仍待決，或因先前已提起該程序而不能再合法提起檢控，則不得為第14(2)(b)條的目的提起法律程序。第10(10)條訂有相對應的保障。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第15(2)條

en.q: When are answers given to an investigator under compulsion inadmissible against the person in criminal proceedings?
options: Where the answer might tend to incriminate the person and the person so claims before giving it
In all circumstances, without any need for the person to raise the point
Only where the person was not legally represented at the time
Only where the investigator failed to obtain a magistrate's warrant
en.explain: Section 15(2) makes the requirement, question and answer inadmissible in criminal proceedings where the answer might tend to incriminate the person and the person so claims before giving it. Section 15(1) obliges the investigator to inform or remind the person of these limitations first.

tc.q: 在何種情況下，在強制下向調查員作出的答覆不可在刑事法律程序中用作針對該人的證據？
options: 該答覆相當可能會導致該人入罪，而該人在作出答覆前提出此項聲稱
在任何情況下均不可，無須該人提出
只限該人當時並無法律代表的情況
只限調查員未取得裁判官手令的情況
tc.explain: 第15(2)條訂明，如該答覆相當可能會導致該人入罪，而該人在作出答覆前提出此項聲稱，則該規定、問題及答覆均不可在刑事法律程序中用作針對該人的證據。第15(1)條規定調查員須先告知或提醒該人此等限制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第15(3)條

en.q: In which proceedings does the protection against use of incriminating answers under section 15(2) NOT apply?
options: Proceedings for an offence under section 13, or under Part V of the Crimes Ordinance, in respect of the answer itself
Proceedings for any offence under the AMLO whatsoever
Proceedings before the Review Tribunal
Civil proceedings brought by a customer of the institution
en.explain: Section 15(3) disapplies the protection in criminal proceedings in which the person is charged with an offence under section 13(1), (3), (5), (6), (7) or (8), or under Part V of the Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 200), in respect of the answer, response, explanation or further particulars. In other words, a false answer can still be prosecuted.

tc.q: 第15(2)條就使用會導致入罪的答覆所提供的保障，在哪類法律程序中並不適用？
options: 就該答覆本身而根據第13條或《刑事罪行條例》第V部提出的罪行的法律程序
任何《打擊洗錢條例》所訂罪行的法律程序
審裁處席前的法律程序
由該機構客戶提起的民事法律程序
tc.explain: 第15(3)條訂明，如該人被控就該答覆、回應、解釋或進一步詳情而犯第13(1)、(3)、(5)、(6)、(7)或(8)條或《刑事罪行條例》（第200章）第V部所訂罪行，該項保障即不適用。換言之，虛假答覆仍可被檢控。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第16條

en.q: A person claims a lien on a record required to be produced under Part 3. What is the effect of the lien?
options: The lien does not affect the requirement to produce, no fees are payable for the production, and the production does not affect the lien
The requirement to produce is suspended until the lien is discharged
The relevant authority must pay the amount secured by the lien before production
The lien is extinguished once the record is produced
en.explain: Section 16 provides that where a person claims a lien on a record or document required to be produced under Part 3, the lien does not affect the requirement to produce it, no fees are payable for or in respect of the production, and the production does not affect the lien.

tc.q: 某人就根據第3部須交出的紀錄申索留置權。該留置權有何效力？
options: 該留置權不影響交出紀錄的規定，交出紀錄無須繳付費用，而交出紀錄亦不影響該留置權
交出紀錄的規定暫緩執行，直至該留置權獲解除
有關當局須在交出紀錄前清償該留置權所擔保的款額
該留置權於紀錄交出後即告消滅
tc.explain: 第16條訂明，如某人就根據第3部須交出的紀錄或文件申索留置權，該留置權不影響交出該紀錄或文件的規定；就交出該紀錄或文件無須繳付費用；而交出該紀錄或文件亦不影響該留置權。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(1)條

en.q: Within what period must a warrant issued under section 17 be executed?
options: Within 7 days beginning on the date of the warrant
Within 24 hours of issue
Within 14 days beginning on the date of the warrant
Within one month of issue
en.explain: Section 17(1)(a) authorises entry to the specified premises, if necessary by force, at any time within the period of 7 days beginning on the date of the warrant. Section 47 warrants under Part 5 do not carry the same express period.

tc.q: 根據第17條發出的手令須於多久內執行？
options: 自手令日期起計7日內
發出後24小時內
自手令日期起計14日內
發出後一個月內
tc.explain: 第17(1)(a)條授權在自手令日期起計7日的期間內，隨時（如有需要可使用武力）進入指明處所。第5部第47條的手令則無同樣的明文期限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(4)條

en.q: For how long may a record removed under a section 17 warrant be retained?
options: Not exceeding 6 months from removal, or longer if required for criminal proceedings or proceedings under the Ordinance
Not exceeding 28 days from removal in every case
Indefinitely, at the discretion of the relevant authority
Not exceeding 12 months, with no possibility of extension
en.explain: Section 17(4) permits retention for a period not exceeding 6 months beginning on the day of removal, or for any longer period necessary where the record is or may be required for criminal proceedings or proceedings under the Ordinance.

tc.q: 根據第17條手令移走的紀錄可保留多久？
options: 自移走日起計不超過6個月；如刑事法律程序或本條例下的法律程序有需要，則可較長
在任何情況下均不超過自移走日起計28日
可無限期保留，由有關當局酌情決定
不超過12個月，並不可延長
tc.explain: 第17(4)條准許自移走當日起計保留不超過6個月；如該紀錄就刑事法律程序或本條例下的法律程序屬需要或可能需要，則可保留該等程序所需的較長期間。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(5)及(6)條

en.q: What must an authorized person do after removing a record under a section 17 warrant?
options: Give a receipt for the record as soon as reasonably practicable, and may permit persons otherwise entitled to inspect it to do so at all reasonable times
Lodge the record with the Registrar of the High Court within 48 hours
Provide a certified copy to the Review Tribunal
Publish a notice of the removal in the Gazette
en.explain: Section 17(5) requires a receipt to be given as soon as reasonably practicable after removal, and section 17(6) permits the authorized person to allow anyone who would be entitled to inspect the record but for the removal to inspect it and make copies at all reasonable times.

tc.q: 獲授權人根據第17條手令移走紀錄後，須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快就該紀錄發出收據，並可准許本有權查閱該紀錄的人在一切合理時間查閱
於48小時內將該紀錄存放於高等法院司法常務官處
向審裁處提供經核證的副本
在憲報刊登移走該紀錄的公告
tc.explain: 第17(5)條規定須在移走後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快發出收據；第17(6)條則准許獲授權人容許任何若非該項移走本有權查閱該紀錄的人，在一切合理時間查閱該紀錄及製作副本。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(3)條

en.q: In relation to a record required to be produced on premises entered under a section 17 warrant, what may an authorized person prohibit?
options: Removing the record from the premises, erasing, adding to or altering anything in it, or otherwise interfering with it
Any communication between persons found on the premises
The continued operation of the business at the premises
Any person from leaving the premises for 48 hours
en.explain: Section 17(3)(a) allows the authorized person to prohibit any person found on the premises from removing the record from the premises, erasing anything from, adding anything to or otherwise altering anything in it, or otherwise interfering with it or causing or permitting another to do so.

tc.q: 就根據第17條手令進入的處所內須交出的紀錄，獲授權人可禁止甚麼？
options: 將該紀錄從處所移走、刪除、增添或以其他方式更改其內容，或以其他方式干預該紀錄
在處所內發現的人之間的任何通訊
該處所業務的繼續營運
任何人於48小時內離開該處所
tc.explain: 第17(3)(a)條准許獲授權人禁止在處所內發現的任何人將該紀錄從處所移走、從中刪除、增添或以其他方式更改其內容，或以其他方式干預該紀錄，或導致或准許他人如此行事。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(9)及(10)條

en.q: What is the maximum penalty on conviction on indictment for obstructing an authorized person exercising a power under section 17(2) or (3)?
options: A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
en.explain: Section 17(10) provides for a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on conviction on indictment, and a fine at level 6 and 6 months' imprisonment on summary conviction, for failing without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement or prohibition under section 17(2) or (3) or obstructing the authorized person.

tc.q: 阻礙獲授權人行使第17(2)或(3)條下的權力，循公訴程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
tc.explain: 第17(10)條訂明，無合理辯解而沒有遵從第17(2)或(3)條下的規定或禁止，或阻礙獲授權人，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年，循簡易程序定罪則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第18條

en.q: Information required to be produced under Part 3 is held only in an information system. What may the person empowered to require production also require?
options: Production of a reproduction of the recording in a form that enables the information to be reproduced in a legible form
Surrender of the information system itself
That the information be printed and certified by a notary public
That the information be converted into a paper record within 24 hours
en.explain: Section 18(2) empowers any person who may require production of a record to require production of a reproduction of the recording, or the relevant part, in a form that enables the information to be reproduced in a legible form. Section 18(1) makes equivalent provision where information is recorded otherwise than in legible form.

tc.q: 根據第3部須交出的資料只存放於資訊系統內。有權要求交出的人還可要求甚麼？
options: 交出該項記錄的複製本，其形式須能使該資料可以可閱形式複製
交出該資訊系統本身
將該資料列印並由公證人核證
於24小時內將該資料轉換為紙本紀錄
tc.explain: 第18(2)條授權任何可要求交出紀錄的人，要求交出該項記錄或其有關部分的複製本，其形式須能使該資料可以可閱形式複製。第18(1)條就以非可閱形式記錄的資料訂有相應條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第19條

en.q: Where an investigator has taken possession of a record under Part 3, what must the investigator permit?
options: Any person who would otherwise be entitled to inspect the record to inspect it and make copies at all reasonable times, subject to any reasonable conditions as to security
Only the owner of the record to inspect it, and only in the investigator's presence
No inspection at all until the investigation is complete
Inspection only on payment of a fee specified in Schedule 3
en.explain: Section 19(1) requires the authorized person or investigator to permit any other person who would have been entitled to inspect the record to inspect it and make copies at all reasonable times. Section 19(2) allows any reasonable condition as to security or otherwise to be imposed.

tc.q: 調查員根據第3部管有某紀錄後，須准許甚麼？
options: 任何本有權查閱該紀錄的人在一切合理時間查閱及製作副本，並可施加任何合理的保安或其他條件
只准該紀錄的擁有人查閱，並只可在調查員在場時查閱
在調查完結前不准任何查閱
只在繳付附表3訂明的費用後方准查閱
tc.explain: 第19(1)條規定獲授權人或調查員須准許任何本有權查閱該紀錄的其他人，在一切合理時間查閱該紀錄及製作副本。第19(2)條准許施加任何其認為合適的合理保安或其他條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第20(1)及(2)條

en.q: What must be proved to establish the offence of destroying documents under section 20?
options: That the person destroyed, falsified, concealed or disposed of a record required to be produced, with intent to conceal facts capable of being disclosed by it
That the person destroyed a record, whatever the person's intention
That the person was under investigation at the time of the destruction
That the destruction actually prevented the investigation from concluding
en.explain: Section 20(1) requires the destruction, falsification, concealment or disposal (or causing or permitting it) of a record the person is required to produce under Part 3, with intent to conceal from the authorized person or investigator facts or matters capable of being disclosed by it. The penalty under section 20(2) is $1,000,000 and 2 years on indictment.

tc.q: 要確立第20條的銷毀文件罪行，須證明甚麼？
options: 該人銷毀、偽造、隱藏或處置須交出的紀錄，並意圖隱瞞該紀錄所能披露的事實
該人銷毀了紀錄，不論其意圖為何
該人在銷毀時正受調查
該項銷毀實際上阻止了調查完成
tc.explain: 第20(1)條規定須有銷毀、偽造、隱藏或處置（或導致或准許此等行為）該人根據第3部須交出的紀錄，並意圖向獲授權人或調查員隱瞞該紀錄所能披露的事實或事宜。第20(2)條訂明循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第20A條

en.q: Which type of institution is excluded from the meaning of “financial institution” in Part 4 of the AMLO?
options: A licensed VAS provider
A licensed money service operator
An authorized institution
A licensed corporation
en.explain: Section 20A provides that in Part 4, financial institution excludes a licensed VAS provider — so the Part 4 disciplinary regime does not apply to licensed virtual asset service providers, which are dealt with under Part 5B.

tc.q: 哪一類機構不屬《打擊洗錢條例》第4部中「金融機構」的涵義範圍？
options: 持牌虛擬資產服務提供者
持牌金錢服務經營者
認可機構
持牌法團
tc.explain: 第20A條訂明，在第4部中，「金融機構」不包括持牌虛擬資產服務提供者——故第4部的紀律制度不適用於持牌虛擬資產服務提供者，該等提供者由第5B部處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21(1)條

en.q: What triggers a relevant authority's power to take disciplinary action under section 21?
options: A financial institution contravening a specified provision as defined by section 5(11)
A financial institution breaching any condition of its licence
A financial institution failing to renew its licence on time
A financial institution being convicted of any criminal offence
en.explain: Section 21(1) makes the disciplinary powers available where a financial institution contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11) — that is, a listed provision of Schedule 2. Breaches of licence conditions by an MSO are dealt with separately under section 43 in Part 5.

tc.q: 甚麼情況會觸發有關當局根據第21條採取紀律行動的權力？
options: 金融機構違反第5(11)條所界定的指明條文
金融機構違反其牌照的任何條件
金融機構未有及時為牌照續期
金融機構被裁定犯任何刑事罪行
tc.explain: 第21(1)條訂明，凡金融機構違反第5(11)條所界定的指明條文（即附表2的列明條文），有關當局即可行使紀律權力。金錢服務經營者違反牌照條件則由第5部第43條另行處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21(4)條

en.q: A financial institution fails to comply with a remedial order made under section 21. What daily pecuniary penalty may the relevant authority order?
options: Not exceeding $100,000 for each day the failure continues after the specified date
Not exceeding $10,000 for each day the failure continues
Not exceeding $1,000,000 in total, however long the failure lasts
No daily penalty is available; only a fresh order can be made
en.explain: Section 21(4) permits a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $100,000 for each day on which the failure continues after the date specified in the remedial order. The equivalent daily cap for MSO licensees under section 43(4) is $10,000.

tc.q: 金融機構沒有遵從根據第21條作出的糾正命令。有關當局可命令繳付甚麼每日罰款？
options: 就該項不遵從在指明日期後持續的每一日，不超過100,000元
就該項不遵從持續的每一日，不超過10,000元
不論持續多久，總額不超過1,000,000元
並無每日罰款；只可另行作出新命令
tc.explain: 第21(4)條准許就該項不遵從在糾正命令所指明日期後持續的每一日，施加不超過100,000元的每日罰款。第43(4)條就金錢服務經營者持牌人的相應每日上限則為10,000元。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21(7)條

en.q: What must a relevant authority do with a pecuniary penalty it receives under a section 21 order?
options: Pay it into the general revenue
Retain it to fund its supervisory activities
Distribute it among the customers affected by the contravention
Hold it on trust pending any application to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 21(7) requires a relevant authority to pay into the general revenue any pecuniary penalty received by it under an order made under that section.

tc.q: 有關當局根據第21條的命令收取罰款後，須怎樣處理？
options: 繳入政府一般收入
保留作為其監管工作的經費
分發予受該項違反影響的客戶
以信託形式持有，直至任何向審裁處提出的申請有結果
tc.explain: 第21(7)條規定有關當局須將其根據該條所作命令而收取的任何罰款繳入政府一般收入。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21(9)條

en.q: Which of the section 21 powers are NOT exercisable in relation to the Government?
options: The power to impose a pecuniary penalty and the power to impose a daily pecuniary penalty
The power to publicly reprimand
The power to order remedial action
All of the section 21 powers are unavailable against the Government
en.explain: Section 21(9) provides that the powers specified in subsections (2)(c) and (4) — the pecuniary penalty and daily pecuniary penalty powers — are not exercisable in relation to the Government. Public reprimand and remedial orders remain available.

tc.q: 第21條下哪些權力不可就政府行使？
options: 施加罰款的權力及施加每日罰款的權力
公開譴責的權力
命令採取糾正行動的權力
第21條下的所有權力均不可就政府行使
tc.explain: 第21(9)條訂明第(2)(c)及(4)款所指明的權力（即施加罰款及每日罰款的權力）不可就政府行使。公開譴責及糾正命令的權力則仍然可用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第22(1)條

en.q: What must a relevant authority do before exercising its powers under section 21 in respect of a financial institution?
options: Give the financial institution a reasonable opportunity to be heard
Obtain the written consent of the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury
Serve a notice of intention at least 30 days beforehand
Refer the proposed action to the Review Tribunal for approval
en.explain: Section 22(1) provides that a relevant authority may only exercise its powers under section 21 after giving the financial institution a reasonable opportunity to be heard. Sections 34(3) and 44(1) impose the same requirement in the MSO context.

tc.q: 有關當局就某金融機構行使第21條下的權力前，須怎樣做？
options: 給予該金融機構合理的陳述機會
取得財經事務及庫務局局長的書面同意
至少提前30日送達擬採取行動的通知
將擬採取的行動轉交審裁處批准
tc.explain: 第22(1)條訂明有關當局只可在給予該金融機構合理的陳述機會後，方可行使第21條下的權力。第34(3)及44(1)條就金錢服務經營者訂有相同規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第23(2)條

en.q: When exercising the power to impose a pecuniary penalty under section 21(2)(c), what must a relevant authority do with its published guidelines?
options: Have regard to the guidelines it has published under section 23(1)
Apply the guidelines as if they were binding subsidiary legislation
Seek the Review Tribunal's confirmation that the guidelines were followed
Republish the guidelines in the Gazette before each exercise of the power
en.explain: Section 23(2) requires the relevant authority, in exercising the pecuniary penalty power, to have regard to the guidelines published under subsection (1). Section 23(3) confirms that those guidelines are not subsidiary legislation.

tc.q: 有關當局行使第21(2)(c)條施加罰款的權力時，須如何處理其已公布的指引？
options: 須顧及其根據第23(1)條公布的指引
須猶如該等指引屬具約束力的附屬法例般加以適用
須尋求審裁處確認已遵從該等指引
須在每次行使該權力前於憲報重新公布該等指引
tc.explain: 第23(2)條規定有關當局在行使施加罰款的權力時，須顧及其根據第(1)款公布的指引。第23(3)條確認該等指引並非附屬法例。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21(2)條與第43(2)條的比較

en.q: An MSO contravenes a condition of its licence, rather than a specified provision of Schedule 2. Under which section is disciplinary action taken, and what is the penalty cap?
options: Section 43, with a pecuniary penalty cap of $1,000,000
Section 21, with a cap of the greater of $10 million or 3 times the profit gained
Section 34, with revocation as the only available sanction
Section 29, with a fine at level 6 imposed by a court
en.explain: Section 43(1)(b) covers a contravention of a licence condition and caps the pecuniary penalty at $1,000,000 under section 43(2)(c). Section 21 applies only to a contravention of a specified provision as defined by section 5(11), and carries the much higher cap.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者違反其牌照條件（而非附表2的指明條文）。紀律行動根據哪一條採取？罰款上限為何？
options: 第43條，罰款上限為1,000,000元
第21條，上限為1,000萬元或所獲利潤的3倍，以較高者為準
第34條，撤銷牌照為唯一可用制裁
第29條，由法庭判處第6級罰款
tc.explain: 第43(1)(b)條涵蓋違反牌照條件的情況，而第43(2)(c)條將罰款上限訂為1,000,000元。第21條只適用於違反第5(11)條所界定的指明條文，其上限則高得多。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52(2)條

en.q: Besides making a false statement, what other conduct is an offence under section 52 in connection with a licence application?
options: Omitting a material particular from a statement so that the statement is rendered false or misleading, knowing that or being reckless as to whether the particular is omitted
Submitting the application after the statutory deadline
Failing to pay the Schedule 3 fee with the application
Applying for a licence while a previous application is pending
en.explain: Section 52(2) creates an offence where a person, in connection with an application for the grant or renewal of a licence, omits a material particular from a statement with the result that the statement is rendered false or misleading, and knows that or is reckless as to whether the particular is omitted.

tc.q: 除作出虛假陳述外，第52條就牌照申請還將哪種行為訂為罪行？
options: 從陳述中遺漏要項，以致該陳述變成虛假或具誤導性，而知道或罔顧該要項是否被遺漏
逾越法定期限提交申請
提交申請時沒有繳付附表3的費用
在先前的申請仍待決時再次申請牌照
tc.explain: 第52(2)條訂立罪行：任何人就批出或續期牌照的申請，從陳述中遺漏要項，以致該陳述變成虛假或具誤導性，而知道或罔顧該要項是否被遺漏，即屬犯罪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52(3)條

en.q: What is the penalty on conviction for providing false information in connection with a licence application under section 52?
options: A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
en.explain: Section 52(3) provides that a person who commits an offence under subsection (1) or (2) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 根據第52條就牌照申請提供虛假資料，一經定罪的刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款及監禁6個月
第6級罰款及監禁2年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
tc.explain: 第52(3)條訂明，犯第(1)或(2)款所訂罪行的人，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第53條

en.q: Section 53 modifies the ordinary limitation period for prosecutions. From what event does the 12-month period run?
options: From when the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner
From the date on which the offence was committed
From the date the licence was granted or renewed
From the date the Commissioner completes an investigation under section 11
en.explain: Section 53 provides that, despite section 26 of the Magistrates Ordinance (Cap. 227), proceedings may be instituted for an offence other than an indictable offence under Part 5 within 12 months after the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner.

tc.q: 第53條修改了一般的檢控時限。該12個月期間自甚麼事件起計？
options: 自海關關長發現該罪行或該罪行引起關長注意時起計
自該罪行發生之日起計
自牌照批出或續期之日起計
自關長完成第11條下的調查之日起計
tc.explain: 第53條訂明，即使《裁判官條例》（第227章）第26條另有規定，就第5部下並非可公訴罪行的罪行提起的法律程序，可在該罪行由海關關長發現或引起關長注意後12個月內提起。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第53條

en.q: To which offences under Part 5 does the special 12-month time limit in section 53 apply?
options: Offences other than indictable offences
All offences under Part 5 without exception
Only offences carrying a fine at level 5
Only offences committed by a licensee, not by an unlicensed person
en.explain: Section 53 applies to an offence “other than an indictable offence” under Part 5. Indictable offences remain subject to the ordinary position, section 26 of the Magistrates Ordinance being the provision expressly displaced for summary matters.

tc.q: 第53條的12個月特別時限適用於第5部下哪些罪行？
options: 並非可公訴罪行的罪行
第5部下所有罪行，並無例外
只限可處第5級罰款的罪行
只限持牌人所犯的罪行，不包括無牌人士
tc.explain: 第53條適用於第5部下「並非可公訴罪行」的罪行。可公訴罪行仍受一般規定規限；就簡易程序事宜而言，被明文取代的是《裁判官條例》第26條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第50條

en.q: Who may amend Schedule 3 to the AMLO, which specifies the fees payable?
options: The Commissioner, by notice published in the Gazette
The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, by notice in the Gazette
The Chief Executive in Council, by regulation
The Financial Secretary, by direction to the Commissioner
en.explain: Section 50 provides that the Commissioner may, by notice published in the Gazette, amend Schedule 3. This contrasts with Schedule 1 Part 2 and Schedule 2, which are amended by the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury under sections 2(2) and 6.

tc.q: 何人可修訂訂明應繳費用的《打擊洗錢條例》附表3？
options: 海關關長，以憲報公告方式
財經事務及庫務局局長，以憲報公告方式
行政長官會同行政會議，以規例方式
財政司司長，以向關長發出指示的方式
tc.explain: 第50條訂明海關關長可藉憲報公告修訂附表3。這與附表1第2部及附表2不同，後者由財經事務及庫務局局長根據第2(2)及6條修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第51條

en.q: What regulation-making power does section 51 confer, and on whom?
options: On the Commissioner of Customs and Excise, to make regulations for the better carrying out of the provisions and purposes of Part 5
On the Chief Executive in Council, to make regulations for the whole Ordinance
On the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, to make regulations for Schedule 2
On the Review Tribunal, to make rules of procedure
en.explain: Section 51 empowers the Commissioner of Customs and Excise to make regulations for the better carrying out of the provisions and purposes of Part 5. Section 26(2) prevents this function from being delegated, and contravening such a regulation is a ground for disciplinary action under section 43(1)(a).

tc.q: 第51條授予何人甚麼訂立規例的權力？
options: 授予海關關長，就更佳地實施第5部的條文及目的訂立規例
授予行政長官會同行政會議，就整條條例訂立規例
授予財經事務及庫務局局長，就附表2訂立規例
授予審裁處，訂立程序規則
tc.explain: 第51條授權海關關長就更佳地實施第5部的條文及目的訂立規例。第26(2)條禁止轉授此項職能，而違反該等規例是第43(1)(a)條下採取紀律行動的理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第77條（第7部）

en.q: Which Part of the AMLO contains the power of the Chief Executive in Council to make regulations for the better carrying out of the provisions and purposes of the Ordinance?
options: Part 7 — Miscellaneous Provisions
Part 5 — Regulation of Operation of Money Service
Part 4 — Disciplinary Actions by Relevant Authorities
Part 1 — Preliminary
en.explain: Section 77 sits at the start of Part 7, Miscellaneous Provisions, and confers on the Chief Executive in Council the power to make regulations for the better carrying out of the Ordinance — expressly excepting Parts 5, 5A, 5B and 5C. The Commissioner's separate power for Part 5 is in section 51.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》哪一部載有行政長官會同行政會議就更佳地實施本條例的條文及目的訂立規例的權力？
options: 第7部——雜項條文
第5部——金錢服務經營的規管
第4部——有關當局採取的紀律行動
第1部——導言
tc.explain: 第77條位於第7部（雜項條文）之首，授予行政長官會同行政會議就更佳地實施本條例訂立規例的權力，並明文剔除第5、5A、5B及5C部。海關關長就第5部的另一項權力載於第51條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第3部第2分部的結構

en.q: Which Division of Part 3 of the AMLO contains the powers to enter, inspect and investigate?
options: Division 2
Division 1
Division 3
Division 4
en.explain: Part 3 is arranged as Division 1 (Preliminary, section 8), Division 2 (Powers to Enter, Inspect and Investigate, sections 9 to 13), Division 3 (Regulatory Assistance to Non-Hong Kong Regulator Concerning VA Activities) and Division 4 (Miscellaneous Enforcement Matters, sections 14 to 20).

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》第3部哪一分部載有進入、視察及調查的權力？
options: 第2分部
第1分部
第3分部
第4分部
tc.explain: 第3部的編排為：第1分部（導言，第8條）、第2分部（進入、視察及調查的權力，第9至13條）、第3分部（就虛擬資產活動向非香港監管機構提供監管協助）及第4分部（雜項執法事宜，第14至20條）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第8條（「訂明規定」的定義）

en.q: For a non-Part 5B prescribed person such as a licensed MSO, what does the “prescribed requirement” in Part 3 mean?
options: The requirement not to contravene any provision of the Ordinance, any notice or requirement given under it, any licence or registration condition, or any other condition imposed under it
Only the requirement not to contravene Schedule 2
