Only the conditions endorsed on the person's licence
Only the requirements set out in guidelines published under section 7
en.explain: Section 8 defines prescribed requirement, in relation to a non-Part 5B prescribed person, as the requirement not to contravene any provision of the Ordinance, any notice or requirement given or imposed under it, any conditions of any licence or registration under it, or any other condition imposed under it.

tc.q: 就持牌金錢服務經營者等非第5B部訂明人士而言，第3部的「訂明規定」指甚麼？
options: 不得違反本條例任何條文、本條例下發出或施加的任何通知或規定、本條例下任何牌照或註冊的條件，或本條例下施加的任何其他條件的規定
只限不得違反附表2的規定
只限批註於該人牌照上的條件
只限根據第7條公布的指引所載的規定
tc.explain: 第8條就非第5B部訂明人士界定「訂明規定」，指不得違反本條例任何條文、本條例下發出或施加的任何通知或規定、本條例下任何牌照或註冊的任何條件，或本條例下施加的任何其他條件的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第8條（「非第5B部訂明人士」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is included in the definition of “non-Part 5B prescribed person” in section 8?
options: The Postmaster General
The Financial Secretary
The Registrar of Companies
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise
en.explain: The section 8 definition lists authorized institutions, licensed corporations, authorized insurers, licensed insurance agents, agencies and broker companies, licensed money service operators, the Postmaster General, SVF licensees, TCSP licensees, PMS registrants and stablecoin licensees. Regulators themselves are not prescribed persons.

tc.q: 下列何者包括在第8條「非第5B部訂明人士」的定義內？
options: 郵政署署長
財政司司長
公司註冊處處長
海關關長
tc.explain: 第8條的定義列出認可機構、持牌法團、認可保險人、持牌保險代理及代理機構及經紀公司、持牌金錢服務經營者、郵政署署長、儲值支付工具持牌人、信託或公司服務提供者持牌人、貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人及穩定幣持牌人。監管機構本身並非訂明人士。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9A(2)條

en.q: An authorized person authorized by a regulator other than the subject person's own relevant authority seeks records about the subject person's customers. What condition applies?
options: The other regulatory authority must be of the opinion, and certify in writing, that the disclosure or production is necessary for the purposes of section 9
The subject person's own relevant authority must first grant written approval
A magistrate's warrant must be obtained before any customer records are sought
Customer records may never be obtained by another regulatory authority
en.explain: Section 9A(2) provides that section 9 is not to be construed as requiring the subject person to disclose information or produce records relating to its customers' affairs unless the other regulatory authority is of the opinion, and certifies in writing that it is of the opinion, that the disclosure or production is necessary for the purposes of that section.

tc.q: 由並非該對象人士本身有關當局的監管機構所授權的獲授權人，尋求索取該對象人士客戶的紀錄。適用甚麼條件？
options: 該另一監管當局須認為（並以書面證明其認為）該項披露或交出就第9條的目的而言屬必需
須先取得該對象人士本身有關當局的書面批准
在索取任何客戶紀錄前，須取得裁判官手令
另一監管當局永不可取得客戶紀錄
tc.explain: 第9A(2)條訂明，第9條不得解釋為規定該對象人士須向獲授權人披露或交出關乎其客戶事務的資料或紀錄，除非該另一監管當局認為（並以書面證明其認為）該項披露或交出就該條的目的而言屬必需。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12A(2)條

en.q: Where an investigator appointed by another regulatory authority seeks records about a subject person's customers, what two conditions must both be satisfied?
options: The customer must be a person the investigator reasonably believes may give relevant information, and the other regulatory authority must certify in writing that the disclosure is necessary
The customer must consent in writing, and a magistrate must issue a warrant
The subject person must be under criminal investigation, and the Secretary for Justice must approve
The records must be more than six years old, and the customer must have been notified
en.explain: Section 12A(2) provides that neither section 11 nor 12 requires disclosure of customer information unless (a) the customer is a person whom the investigator has reasonable cause to believe may be able to give information relevant to the investigation, and (b) the other regulatory authority certifies in writing that the disclosure or production is necessary for the purposes of the investigation.

tc.q: 由另一監管當局委任的調查員尋求索取某對象人士客戶的紀錄時，須同時符合哪兩項條件？
options: 該客戶須為調查員有合理因由相信能提供相關資料的人，且該另一監管當局須以書面證明該項披露屬必需
該客戶須書面同意，且裁判官須發出手令
該對象人士須正受刑事調查，且律政司司長須批准
該等紀錄須存在超過六年，且該客戶須已獲通知
tc.explain: 第12A(2)條訂明，第11及12條均不規定披露客戶資料，除非：(a)該客戶是調查員有合理因由相信能提供與調查相關資料的人；及(b)該另一監管當局以書面證明該項披露或交出就調查的目的而言屬必需。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第55(2)條

en.q: What is the jurisdiction of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal?
options: To review specified decisions and to hear and determine any question or issue arising out of or in connection with any review
To try criminal offences under the Ordinance
To grant and renew money service operator licences
To make regulations for the better carrying out of Part 5
en.explain: Section 55(2) gives the Tribunal jurisdiction to review specified decisions and to hear and determine any question or issue arising out of or in connection with any review, in accordance with Part 6 and Schedule 4. Criminal trials are for the courts, and licensing is for the Commissioner.

tc.q: 打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集（財務行動特別組織）審裁處的司法管轄權為何？
options: 覆核指明決定，並聆訊及裁定因任何覆核而引起或與之有關的任何問題或爭論點
審理本條例下的刑事罪行
批出及續期金錢服務經營者牌照
就更佳地實施第5部訂立規例
tc.explain: 第55(2)條賦予審裁處司法管轄權，按照第6部及附表4覆核指明決定，並聆訊及裁定因任何覆核而引起或與之有關的任何問題或爭論點。刑事審訊屬法院職權，發牌則屬海關關長職權。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第56(1)條

en.q: Except as otherwise provided in Schedule 4, of whom does the Review Tribunal consist?
options: A chairperson and 2 other members, appointed by the Secretary
A single chairperson sitting alone
A chairperson and 4 other members appointed by the Chief Executive
Three judges of the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 56(1) provides that, except as otherwise provided in Schedule 4, the Tribunal consists of a chairperson and 2 other members, appointed by the Secretary.

tc.q: 除附表4另有規定外，審裁處由何人組成？
options: 一名主席及2名其他成員，由局長委任
單獨一名主席
一名主席及4名其他成員，由行政長官委任
三名原訟法庭法官
tc.explain: 第56(1)條訂明，除附表4另有規定外，審裁處由一名主席及2名其他成員組成，並由局長委任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第56(2)條

en.q: What qualification must the chairperson of the Review Tribunal have?
options: Eligibility for appointment as a judge of the High Court under section 9 of the High Court Ordinance
At least ten years' experience in financial regulation
Membership of the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants
Prior service as an officer of the Customs and Excise Department
en.explain: Section 56(2) requires the chairperson to be a person eligible for appointment as a judge of the High Court under section 9 of the High Court Ordinance (Cap. 4), and who is not a public officer (or is one only by virtue of chairing a statutory board or tribunal).

tc.q: 審裁處主席須具備甚麼資格？
options: 根據《高等法院條例》第9條符合資格獲委任為高等法院法官
在金融監管方面擁有至少十年經驗
香港會計師公會會員資格
曾任香港海關人員
tc.explain: 第56(2)條規定主席須為根據《高等法院條例》（第4章）第9條符合資格獲委任為高等法院法官的人，並且並非公職人員（或僅因擔任根據條例設立的委員會或審裁處主席而屬公職人員）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第58(2)條

en.q: Who may amend Schedule 4 to the AMLO, which has effect with respect to the Review Tribunal?
options: The Secretary, by notice published in the Gazette
The Chief Justice, by rules
The Commissioner, by notice published in the Gazette
The Chief Executive in Council, by regulation
en.explain: Section 58(1) provides that Schedule 4 has effect with respect to the Tribunal, and section 58(2) empowers the Secretary to amend Schedule 4 by notice published in the Gazette. Schedule 3 is amended by the Commissioner under section 50.

tc.q: 就審裁處具有效力的《打擊洗錢條例》附表4，可由何人修訂？
options: 局長，以憲報公告方式
終審法院首席法官，以訂立規則方式
海關關長，以憲報公告方式
行政長官會同行政會議，以規例方式
tc.explain: 第58(1)條訂明附表4就審裁處具有效力，第58(2)條則授權局長藉憲報公告修訂附表4。附表3則由海關關長根據第50條修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第59(2)及(3)條

en.q: On what conditions may the Tribunal extend the time within which an application for review may be made?
options: After the applicant and the specified authority have been given a reasonable opportunity to be heard, and if satisfied there is good cause
Only if the delay was caused by the specified authority
Only where the extension sought does not exceed a further 21 days
The time limit is absolute and cannot be extended
en.explain: Section 59(3) permits an extension only after the applicant and the specified authority have been given a reasonable opportunity to be heard, and if the Tribunal is satisfied that there is good cause for granting the extension.

tc.q: 審裁處可在甚麼條件下延展提出覆核申請的時限？
options: 在給予申請人及指明當局合理的陳述機會後，並信納有充分理由給予延展
只限延誤是由指明當局造成的情況
只限所要求的延展不超過另外21日
該時限屬絕對，不可延展
tc.explain: 第59(3)條訂明，只有在給予申請人及指明當局合理的陳述機會後，並且審裁處信納有充分理由給予延展的情況下，方可延展時限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第59(4)條

en.q: What formal requirements apply to an application to the Review Tribunal for a review?
options: It must be in writing and must state the grounds for the application
It must be made orally at a preliminary hearing
It must be accompanied by the fee specified in Schedule 3
It must be certified by a solicitor admitted in Hong Kong
en.explain: Section 59(4) requires an application for review to be in writing and to state the grounds for the application. Section 59(5) then requires the Tribunal to send a copy to the specified authority as soon as reasonably practicable.

tc.q: 向審裁處提出覆核申請，須符合甚麼形式規定？
options: 須以書面提出，並須述明申請理由
須在預備聆訊中以口頭提出
須連同附表3訂明的費用一併提交
須由在香港獲認許的律師核證
tc.explain: 第59(4)條規定覆核申請須以書面提出，並須述明申請理由。第59(5)條繼而規定審裁處須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快將副本送交指明當局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第60(1)條

en.q: In what ways may the Tribunal determine a review of a specified decision?
options: By confirming, varying or setting aside the decision and substituting another, or by remitting the matter to the specified authority with directions
Only by confirming or setting aside the decision
Only by remitting the matter to the specified authority
By referring the matter directly to the Court of Appeal
en.explain: Section 60(1) allows the Tribunal to confirm, vary or set aside the decision and, if set aside, substitute any other decision it considers appropriate; or to remit the matter to the specified authority with any directions it considers appropriate.

tc.q: 審裁處可以哪些方式裁定對指明決定的覆核？
options: 確認、更改或撤銷該決定並以另一決定取代，或將事宜發回指明當局並附加指示
只可確認或撤銷該決定
只可將事宜發回指明當局
將事宜直接轉交上訴法庭
tc.explain: 第60(1)條准許審裁處確認、更改或撤銷該決定；如予撤銷，可以其認為適當的任何其他決定取代；或將事宜連同其認為適當的任何指示發回指明當局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第60(2)條

en.q: Where the Tribunal varies or substitutes a specified decision, may the new decision be harsher than the original?
options: Yes — it may be any decision, whether more or less onerous, that the specified authority had power to make
No — the Tribunal may only confirm or reduce the original decision
Only if the applicant consents to the harsher outcome
Only where the applicant has been convicted of an offence under the Ordinance
en.explain: Section 60(2) provides that the varied or substituted decision may be any decision, whether more or less onerous than the one varied or substituted, that the specified authority had power to make in respect of the applicant, whether or not under the same provision.

tc.q: 審裁處更改或取代指明決定時，新決定可否較原決定為重？
options: 可以——可以是指明當局有權作出的任何決定，不論較原決定為重或為輕
不可以——審裁處只可確認或減輕原決定
只有在申請人同意較重結果的情況下方可
只有在申請人已被裁定犯本條例所訂罪行的情況下方可
tc.explain: 第60(2)條訂明，經更改的決定或取代的其他決定，可以是指明當局有權就該申請人作出的任何決定，不論較被更改或被取代的決定為重或為輕，亦不論是否根據同一條文作出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第60(4)條

en.q: What standard of proof applies to matters of fact in proceedings before the Review Tribunal?
options: The balance of probabilities
Beyond reasonable doubt
Clear and convincing evidence
A prima facie case
en.explain: Section 60(4) provides that for the purposes of proceedings before the Tribunal, matters of fact are to be established on a balance of probabilities — the civil standard. Note that under section 63(3) the criminal-style contempt standard applies when the Tribunal punishes for contempt.

tc.q: 在審裁處席前的法律程序中，事實事宜適用甚麼舉證標準？
options: 相對可能性的衡量
無合理疑點
清晰而令人信服的證據
表面證據
tc.explain: 第60(4)條訂明，就審裁處席前的法律程序而言，事實事宜須按相對可能性的衡量而確立，即民事標準。留意根據第63(3)條，審裁處就藐視行為施加懲罰時，須採用與原訟法庭相同的舉證標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(a)條

en.q: What material may the Tribunal receive and consider for the purposes of a review?
options: Any material by way of oral evidence, written statements or documents, whether or not it would be admissible in a court of law
Only material that would be admissible in criminal proceedings
Only documents that were before the specified authority when it made the decision
Only sworn affidavit evidence
en.explain: Section 61(1)(a) allows the Tribunal to receive and consider any material by way of oral evidence, written statements or documents, whether or not the material would be admissible in a court of law, and section 61(1)(b) lets it determine the manner in which such material is received.

tc.q: 就覆核而言，審裁處可接收及考慮甚麼材料？
options: 以口頭證據、書面陳述或文件形式提交的任何材料，不論該材料在法院是否可獲接納
只限在刑事法律程序中可獲接納的材料
只限指明當局作出決定時已備有的文件
只限經宣誓的誓章證據
tc.explain: 第61(1)(a)條准許審裁處接收及考慮以口頭證據、書面陳述或文件形式提交的任何材料，不論該材料在法院是否可獲接納為證據；第61(1)(b)條則准許其決定接收該等材料的方式。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(c)條

en.q: How does the Tribunal require a person to attend before it and give evidence?
options: By notice in writing signed by the chairperson of the Tribunal
By a warrant issued by a magistrate
By an order of the Court of First Instance
By a direction given by the specified authority
en.explain: Section 61(1)(c) empowers the Tribunal, by notice in writing signed by the chairperson, to require a person to attend before it at any sitting, give evidence and produce any article, record or document in the person's possession or control relating to the subject matter of the review.

tc.q: 審裁處如何規定某人出席其席前作證？
options: 以由審裁處主席簽署的書面通知
以裁判官發出的手令
以原訟法庭的命令
以指明當局發出的指示
tc.explain: 第61(1)(c)條授權審裁處以由主席簽署的書面通知，規定某人在任何聆訊中出席其席前作證，並交出該人管有或控制的、與覆核標的有關的任何物品、紀錄或文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(4)條

en.q: May a person refuse to comply with a Tribunal order on the ground that compliance might tend to incriminate them?
options: No — a person is not excused only on that ground, but section 62 restricts the use of the evidence in criminal proceedings
Yes — self-incrimination is a complete answer to any Tribunal order
Yes, but only with the leave of the Court of First Instance
No, and the evidence may freely be used in any later criminal prosecution
en.explain: Section 61(4) provides that a person is not excused from complying with a Tribunal order, notice, prohibition or requirement only on the ground that to do so might tend to incriminate the person. Section 62(2) then makes the evidence inadmissible against that person in criminal proceedings, subject to the section 62(3) exception.

tc.q: 某人可否以遵從審裁處命令相當可能會導致其入罪為理由而拒絕遵從？
options: 不可以——不得僅以此為理由獲免除遵從，但第62條限制該等證據在刑事法律程序中的使用
可以——自我入罪是對抗任何審裁處命令的完全理由
可以，但須取得原訟法庭的許可
不可以，而該等證據可在其後任何刑事檢控中自由使用
tc.explain: 第61(4)條訂明，任何人不得僅以遵從審裁處的命令、通知、禁止或規定相當可能會導致其入罪為理由，而獲免除遵從。第62(2)條繼而訂明該等證據不可在刑事法律程序中用作針對該人，但須受第62(3)條的例外規定所限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(2)及(3)條

en.q: Which of the following is an offence under section 61(2) in relation to the Tribunal?
options: Threatening, insulting or causing loss to a person on account of that person having attended before the Tribunal
Applying for a review without stating the grounds
Appealing to the Court of Appeal without leave
Failing to pay costs awarded by the Tribunal within 30 days
en.explain: Section 61(2) lists the offences, which include failing without reasonable excuse to comply with a Tribunal order, disrupting a sitting, leaving without permission, hindering or deterring attendance, and threatening, insulting or causing loss to a person who has attended, or to the chairperson or a member. The penalty under section 61(3) is $1,000,000 and 2 years on indictment.

tc.q: 下列何者屬第61(2)條所訂與審裁處有關的罪行？
options: 因某人曾出席審裁處席前而威脅、侮辱該人或導致該人蒙受損失
提出覆核申請而沒有述明理由
未獲許可而向上訴法庭提出上訴
沒有於30日內繳付審裁處判給的訟費
tc.explain: 第61(2)條列出各項罪行，包括無合理辯解而沒有遵從審裁處的命令、擾亂聆訊、未獲准許而離開、阻礙或阻嚇他人出席，以及因某人曾出席而威脅、侮辱該人或導致其蒙受損失，或對主席或成員作出同類行為。第61(3)條訂明循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第63(1)及(3)條

en.q: What powers does the Review Tribunal have in relation to contempt?
options: The same powers as the Court of First Instance to punish for contempt, adopting the same standard of proof
No contempt powers; contempt must be referred to the Court of First Instance
Power to fine for contempt but not to imprison
Power to punish for contempt only with the consent of the Secretary for Justice
en.explain: Section 63(1) gives the Tribunal the same powers as the Court of First Instance to punish for contempt, and section 63(3) requires it to adopt the same standard of proof as that Court when exercising those powers. Section 63(4) prevents double jeopardy with section 61(2) prosecutions.

tc.q: 審裁處就藐視行為具有甚麼權力？
options: 與原訟法庭相同的懲罰藐視行為權力，並採用相同的舉證標準
並無藐視行為權力；藐視行為須轉交原訟法庭處理
可就藐視行為判處罰款，但不可判處監禁
須經律政司司長同意方可懲罰藐視行為
tc.explain: 第63(1)條賦予審裁處與原訟法庭相同的懲罰藐視行為權力，第63(3)條則規定其行使該等權力時須採用與該法庭相同的舉證標準。第63(4)條防止與第61(2)條檢控之間出現雙重處罰。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第64條

en.q: What protection does section 64 give to an authorized institution acting as banker or financial adviser to a review applicant?
options: Part 6 and Schedule 4 do not require it to disclose information relating to the affairs of any of its customers other than that applicant
It is exempt from attending before the Tribunal in any circumstances
It may refuse to produce any document without giving reasons
Its evidence is automatically heard in private
en.explain: Section 64 provides that Part 6 and Schedule 4 do not require an authorized institution, acting as the banker or financial adviser of a person who makes an application for review, to disclose information in relation to the affairs of any of its customers other than that person.

tc.q: 第64條為擔任覆核申請人的銀行家或財務顧問的認可機構提供甚麼保障？
options: 第6部及附表4並不規定其須披露該申請人以外任何客戶事務的資料
在任何情況下均獲豁免出席審裁處席前
可拒絕交出任何文件而無須給予理由
其證據自動以非公開方式聆訊
tc.explain: 第64條訂明，第6部及附表4並不規定擔任覆核申請人的銀行家或財務顧問的認可機構，須披露關乎該人以外任何客戶事務的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第65(1)及(2)條

en.q: To whom may the Tribunal award costs in relation to a review?
options: To any party to the review, or to any person whose attendance has been necessary or required for the purposes of the review
Only to the successful party to the review
Only to the specified authority, never to the applicant
To no one — each side bears its own costs
en.explain: Section 65(1) allows the Tribunal to award costs to any person whose attendance, whether or not as a witness, has been necessary or required for the purposes of the review, or to any party to the review. Section 65(2) makes those costs recoverable as a civil debt.

tc.q: 就覆核而言，審裁處可向何人判給訟費？
options: 覆核的任何一方，或就覆核而言其出席屬必需或被規定出席的任何人
只限覆核中勝訴的一方
只限指明當局，永不判給申請人
不判給任何人——各方自行承擔訟費
tc.explain: 第65(1)條准許審裁處向就覆核而言其出席（不論是否作為證人）屬必需或被規定出席的任何人，或向覆核的任何一方判給訟費。第65(2)條訂明該等訟費可作為民事債項追討。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第66(1)條

en.q: What must the Tribunal deliver after completing a review?
options: Its determination and the reasons for it, together with any costs order and the reasons for that order
Only the operative determination, without reasons
A recommendation to the specified authority, which remains free to depart from it
A confidential report to the Secretary for Justice
en.explain: Section 66(1) requires the Tribunal, as soon as reasonably practicable after completing a review, to deliver its determination and the reasons for the determination, and any order made under section 65 in relation to the review together with the reasons for that order.

tc.q: 審裁處完成覆核後須交付甚麼？
options: 其裁定及裁定理由，連同任何訟費命令及該命令的理由
只交付有實效的裁定，而不附理由
向指明當局提出建議，該當局仍可不予採納
向律政司司長提交機密報告
tc.explain: 第66(1)條規定審裁處須在完成覆核後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快交付其裁定及裁定理由，以及就該覆核根據第65條作出的任何命令連同該命令的理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第67(2)條

en.q: What presumption attaches to a document purporting to be an order of the Tribunal signed by its chairperson?
options: In the absence of evidence to the contrary, it is presumed to be duly made and signed, without proof of its making or of the signature
It must be proved by calling the chairperson as a witness
It is conclusive and cannot be challenged on any ground
It has effect only once registered in the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 67(2) provides that such a document is, in the absence of evidence to the contrary, presumed to be an order of the Tribunal duly made and signed, without proof of its making, proof of signature, or proof that the signatory was in fact the chairperson. Section 67(1) requires orders to be recorded in writing and signed.

tc.q: 看來是由審裁處主席簽署的審裁處命令的文件，附有甚麼推定？
options: 在無相反證據的情況下，推定為妥為作出及簽署的命令，無須證明其作出或簽署
須傳召主席作證方能證明
屬確證，不得以任何理由質疑
須經在原訟法庭登記後方有效力
tc.explain: 第67(2)條訂明，在無相反證據的情況下，該文件推定為審裁處妥為作出及簽署的命令，無須證明其作出、無須證明簽署，亦無須證明簽署人事實上是主席。第67(1)條規定命令須以書面記錄並簽署。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第69(1)條

en.q: Does making an application for review automatically suspend the specified decision under challenge?
options: No — the application does not by itself operate as a stay of execution, though a stay may be applied for separately
Yes — the decision is automatically suspended until the review is determined
Yes, but only where the decision is a revocation of a licence
No, and no stay may be granted in any circumstances
en.explain: Section 69(1) provides that the making of an application for review does not by itself operate as a stay of execution of the specified decision. Section 69(2) allows the applicant to apply to the Tribunal for a stay at any time before determination, and section 69(3) requires a hearing as soon as reasonably practicable.

tc.q: 提出覆核申請是否自動暫緩執行受質疑的指明決定？
options: 不會——申請本身並不構成暫緩執行，但可另行申請暫緩執行
會——該決定在覆核裁定前自動暫緩
會，但只限該決定屬撤銷牌照的情況
不會，而在任何情況下均不可批予暫緩執行
tc.explain: 第69(1)條訂明，提出覆核申請本身並不構成暫緩執行該指明決定。第69(2)條准許申請人在裁定前隨時向審裁處申請暫緩執行，第69(3)條則規定須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快進行聆訊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第71(1)及(2)條

en.q: On what basis may a party dissatisfied with a Tribunal determination appeal to the Court of Appeal?
options: On a question of law, of fact, or of mixed law and fact, but only with the leave of the Court of Appeal
On a question of law only, and as of right
On any ground, as of right, within 21 days
Only where the Tribunal certifies that the case raises a point of general importance
en.explain: Section 71(1) allows an appeal on a question of law, a question of fact, or a question of mixed law and fact, and section 71(2) provides that no appeal may be made unless leave to appeal has been granted by the Court of Appeal.

tc.q: 對審裁處裁定感到不滿的一方，可基於甚麼理由向上訴法庭上訴？
options: 基於法律問題、事實問題或混合法律與事實的問題，但須取得上訴法庭的上訴許可
只可基於法律問題，並可作為權利提出
可基於任何理由，並可於21日內作為權利提出
只限審裁處證明該案引起一般重要性的爭論點
tc.explain: 第71(1)條准許就法律問題、事實問題或混合法律與事實的問題提出上訴；第71(2)條則訂明除非上訴法庭已批予上訴許可，否則不得提出上訴。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第71(4)條

en.q: On what basis may the Court of Appeal grant leave to appeal against a Tribunal determination?
options: Only if satisfied that the appeal has a reasonable prospect of success, or that there is some other reason in the interests of justice why it should be heard
Only if the appellant has paid the costs awarded by the Tribunal
Only if the specified authority consents to the appeal
Leave must be granted as of right on payment of the prescribed fee
en.explain: Section 71(4) provides that leave may only be granted if the Court of Appeal is satisfied that the appeal has a reasonable prospect of success, or that there is some other reason in the interests of justice why the appeal should be heard. Section 71(3) allows leave to be limited to a particular issue and made subject to conditions.

tc.q: 上訴法庭可基於甚麼理由批予針對審裁處裁定的上訴許可？
options: 只有在信納該上訴有合理機會得直，或基於司法公正的利益有其他理由應予聆訊的情況下
只限上訴人已繳付審裁處判給的訟費
只限指明當局同意該項上訴
一經繳付訂明費用，即須作為權利批予許可
tc.explain: 第71(4)條訂明，只有在上訴法庭信納該上訴有合理機會得直，或基於司法公正的利益有其他理由應予聆訊的情況下，方可批予許可。第71(3)條准許許可限於某特定爭論點，並可附加條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第72(1)條

en.q: Which powers does the Court of Appeal have on an appeal against a determination of the Tribunal?
options: To allow or dismiss the appeal, vary or set aside the determination and substitute another, or remit the matter to the Tribunal or the specified authority with directions
Only to allow or dismiss the appeal
Only to remit the matter to the Tribunal for rehearing
Only to quash the determination, with no power to substitute another
en.explain: Section 72(1) gives the Court of Appeal power to allow the appeal, dismiss it, vary or set aside the determination and substitute any other determination it considers appropriate, or remit the matter to the Tribunal or the specified authority with any directions it considers appropriate.

tc.q: 就針對審裁處裁定的上訴，上訴法庭具有哪些權力？
options: 裁定上訴得直或駁回上訴、更改或撤銷該裁定並以另一裁定取代，或將事宜連同指示發回審裁處或指明當局
只可裁定上訴得直或駁回上訴
只可將事宜發回審裁處重新聆訊
只可撤銷該裁定，無權以另一裁定取代
tc.explain: 第72(1)條賦予上訴法庭權力裁定上訴得直、駁回上訴、更改或撤銷該裁定並以其認為適當的任何其他裁定取代，或將事宜連同其認為適當的任何指示發回審裁處或指明當局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第73(1)條

en.q: Does lodging an appeal to the Court of Appeal automatically stay execution of the Tribunal's determination?
options: No — the lodging of an appeal does not by itself operate as a stay, but the Court of Appeal may order one on application
Yes — execution is automatically stayed once the appeal is lodged
Yes, but only for determinations imposing a pecuniary penalty
No, and the Court of Appeal has no power to order a stay
en.explain: Section 73(1) provides that the lodging of an appeal does not by itself operate as a stay of execution of the determination appealed against. Section 73(2) allows the Court of Appeal, on application by a party, to order a stay, subject under section 73(3) to any conditions it considers appropriate.

tc.q: 向上訴法庭提出上訴，是否自動暫緩執行審裁處的裁定？
options: 不會——提出上訴本身並不構成暫緩執行，但上訴法庭可應申請頒令暫緩
會——一經提出上訴即自動暫緩執行
會，但只限施加罰款的裁定
不會，而上訴法庭亦無權頒令暫緩
tc.explain: 第73(1)條訂明，提出上訴本身並不構成暫緩執行被上訴的裁定。第73(2)條准許上訴法庭應一方的申請頒令暫緩，並根據第73(3)條可附加其認為適當的任何條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第74條

en.q: Subject to which provisions is a determination of the Tribunal final and not subject to appeal?
options: Section 50 of the High Court Ordinance and section 71 of the AMLO
Section 26 of the Magistrates Ordinance only
Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court only
No provisions — the determination is absolutely final
en.explain: Section 74 provides that, subject to section 50 of the High Court Ordinance (Cap. 4) and section 71 of the AMLO, the determination of the Tribunal is final and is not subject to appeal.

tc.q: 審裁處的裁定在哪些條文的規限下屬最終決定而不得上訴？
options: 《高等法院條例》第50條及《打擊洗錢條例》第71條
只限《裁判官條例》第26條
只限《高等法院規則》第62號命令
並無任何條文——該裁定屬絕對最終
tc.explain: 第74條訂明，在《高等法院條例》（第4章）第50條及《打擊洗錢條例》第71條的規限下，審裁處的裁定屬最終決定，並不得上訴。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75(1)(b)條

en.q: A person neither notifies the specified authority that they will not seek a review nor applies for one within the 21-day period. When does the specified decision take effect?
options: At the time the 21-day period expires
On the date the decision was originally made
Only once the specified authority issues a further notice
Three months after the notice of the decision was sent
en.explain: Section 75(1)(b) provides that where, within the 21-day period specified in section 59(1), the person neither notifies the specified authority that they will not apply for a review nor applies for one, the decision takes effect at the time the period expires.

tc.q: 某人在21日期間內既無通知指明當局其不會申請覆核，亦無提出覆核申請。該指明決定何時生效？
options: 於該21日期間屆滿時
於該決定原本作出之日
須待指明當局發出進一步通知後
於決定通知寄發後三個月
tc.explain: 第75(1)(b)條訂明，凡在第59(1)條所指明的21日期間內，該人既無通知指明當局其不會申請覆核，亦無提出覆核申請，該決定於該期間屆滿時生效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75(1)(a)條

en.q: A person notifies the specified authority in writing, before the 21-day period expires, that they will not apply for a review. When does the decision take effect?
options: At the time the person so notifies the specified authority
At the expiry of the 21-day period regardless
On the date the notice of the decision was originally sent
Only after the specified authority confirms receipt in writing
en.explain: Section 75(1)(a) provides that where the person notifies the specified authority in writing, before the 21-day period expires, that they will not apply for a review, the decision takes effect at the time the person so notifies the authority.

tc.q: 某人在21日期間屆滿前，以書面通知指明當局其不會申請覆核。該決定何時生效？
options: 於該人如此通知指明當局時
無論如何均於21日期間屆滿時
於決定通知原本寄發之日
須待指明當局書面確認收妥後
tc.explain: 第75(1)(a)條訂明，凡該人在21日期間屆滿前以書面通知指明當局其不會申請覆核，該決定於該人如此通知該當局時生效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75(2)條

en.q: In what circumstances may a specified authority set a different time for a specified decision to take effect?
options: Where it considers it appropriate in the public interest to do so, by specifying that time in the notice of the decision
Only with the leave of the Review Tribunal
Only where the person has already applied for a review
Never — the timing rules in section 75(1) are mandatory
en.explain: Section 75(2) provides that, despite subsection (1), the specified authority may, if it considers it appropriate in the public interest, specify in the notice any other time as the time at which the decision is to take effect, in which case the decision takes effect at that specified time.

tc.q: 指明當局在甚麼情況下可訂定指明決定生效的不同時間？
options: 如其認為基於公眾利益這樣做屬恰當，可在該決定的通知內指明該時間
只限取得審裁處許可
只限該人已提出覆核申請的情況
永不可以——第75(1)條的生效時間規則屬強制性
tc.explain: 第75(2)條訂明，即使第(1)款另有規定，指明當局如認為基於公眾利益這樣做屬恰當，可在該決定的通知內指明任何其他時間為該決定生效的時間；在此情況下，該決定於所指明的時間生效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76條

en.q: Who may make rules regulating the procedure for the hearing of appeals under section 71?
options: The Chief Justice
The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury
The chairperson of the Review Tribunal
The Chief Executive in Council
en.explain: Section 76 empowers the Chief Justice to make rules providing for matters relating to the registration of a Tribunal order in the Court of First Instance under section 68(1), and regulating the procedure for the hearing of appeals under section 71.

tc.q: 何人可訂立規則規管第71條下上訴聆訊的程序？
options: 終審法院首席法官
財經事務及庫務局局長
審裁處主席
行政長官會同行政會議
tc.explain: 第76條授權終審法院首席法官訂立規則，就根據第68(1)條在原訟法庭登記審裁處命令的相關事宜作出規定，以及規管第71條下上訴聆訊的程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第68條

en.q: What is the effect of registering an order of the Tribunal in the Court of First Instance?
options: It is regarded for all purposes as an order of the Court of First Instance made within that Court's jurisdiction
It is converted into a criminal conviction
It becomes immune from any appeal to the Court of Appeal
It is stayed pending any application for review
en.explain: Section 68(1) allows the Court of First Instance, after receiving a written notice from the Tribunal in the manner prescribed by rules made by the Chief Justice under section 76, to register a Tribunal order; section 68(2) provides that a registered order is regarded for all purposes as an order of that Court made within its jurisdiction.

tc.q: 將審裁處的命令在原訟法庭登記有何效力？
options: 就一切目的而言，該命令視為原訟法庭在其司法管轄權內作出的命令
該命令轉化為刑事定罪
該命令不受任何向上訴法庭的上訴影響
該命令在任何覆核申請待決期間暫緩執行
tc.explain: 第68(1)條准許原訟法庭在按終審法院首席法官根據第76條訂立的規則所訂方式接獲審裁處的書面通知後，登記審裁處的命令；第68(2)條訂明經登記的命令就一切目的而言，視為該法庭在其司法管轄權內作出的命令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第77(1)條

en.q: The Chief Executive in Council's power to make regulations under section 77 extends to the whole Ordinance except which Parts?
options: Parts 5, 5A, 5B and 5C
Parts 1 and 2 only
Part 6 only
Parts 3 and 4
en.explain: Section 77(1) empowers the Chief Executive in Council to make regulations for the better carrying out of the provisions and purposes of the Ordinance except Parts 5, 5A, 5B and 5C. Part 5 is instead covered by the Commissioner's regulation-making power in section 51.

tc.q: 第77條下行政長官會同行政會議訂立規例的權力，涵蓋整條條例，但不包括哪幾部？
options: 第5、5A、5B及5C部
只限第1及2部
只限第6部
第3及4部
tc.explain: 第77(1)條授權行政長官會同行政會議就更佳地實施本條例的條文及目的訂立規例，但不包括第5、5A、5B及5C部。第5部改由第51條下海關關長的訂立規例權力涵蓋。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第77(2)條

en.q: What kinds of provision may regulations made under section 77 include?
options: Savings, transitional, incidental, supplemental, evidential and consequential provisions
Provisions creating new indictable offences punishable by more than 7 years' imprisonment
Provisions amending Schedule 2 to the Ordinance
Provisions altering the composition of the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 77(2) provides that, without limiting subsection (1), the regulations may include any savings, transitional, incidental, supplemental, evidential and consequential provisions, whether involving provisions of principal or subsidiary legislation. Schedule 2 is amended under section 6, and Schedule 4 under section 58(2).

tc.q: 根據第77條訂立的規例可包括哪類條文？
options: 保留、過渡、附帶、補充、關乎證據及相應的條文
訂立可判處超過7年監禁的新可公訴罪行的條文
修訂本條例附表2的條文
更改審裁處組成的條文
tc.explain: 第77(2)條訂明，在不局限第(1)款的原則下，規例可包括任何保留、過渡、附帶、補充、關乎證據及相應的條文，不論是否涉及主體法例或附屬法例的條文。附表2由第6條修訂，附表4則由第58(2)條修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第55(3)條

en.q: May more than one review tribunal exist at a time under the AMLO?
options: Yes — the Secretary may establish additional tribunals if considered appropriate, and the Ordinance applies to each with necessary modifications
No — there may only ever be one tribunal
Yes, but only with the approval of the Chief Justice
Yes, but only for reviews concerning licensed VAS providers
en.explain: Section 55(3) provides that if the Secretary considers it appropriate, the Secretary may establish additional tribunals for the purposes of any reviews, and the provisions of the Ordinance apply, with necessary modifications, to each of those additional tribunals as they apply to the Tribunal.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，同一時間可否存在多於一個審裁處？
options: 可以——局長如認為恰當，可設立額外審裁處，而本條例經必要修改後適用於每個該等審裁處
不可以——任何時候只可有一個審裁處
可以，但須取得終審法院首席法官批准
可以，但只限涉及持牌虛擬資產服務提供者的覆核
tc.explain: 第55(3)條訂明，局長如認為恰當，可為任何覆核的目的設立額外審裁處；而本條例的條文經必要的修改後，適用於每個該等額外審裁處，一如其適用於審裁處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第57(2)條

en.q: How are the fees payable to the chairperson and members of the Review Tribunal met?
options: They are a charge on the general revenue
They are paid out of pecuniary penalties collected under section 21
They are paid by the parties to the review in equal shares
They are met from licence fees paid under Schedule 3
en.explain: Section 57(1) allows the chairperson and other members to be paid a fee for their services in an amount the Secretary considers appropriate, and section 57(2) provides that the amounts payable are a charge on the general revenue.

tc.q: 應付予審裁處主席及成員的費用如何支付？
options: 由政府一般收入撥支
從根據第21條收取的罰款中支付
由覆核各方平均分擔
從根據附表3繳付的牌照費用中支付
tc.explain: 第57(1)條准許向主席及其他成員支付局長認為適當款額的服務費用，第57(2)條則訂明根據本條應付的款額由政府一般收入撥支。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(g)及(h)條

en.q: What orders may the Tribunal make about the publication of material it receives?
options: It may order a person not to publish or disclose material it receives, and prohibit publication of material received at a sitting held in private
It may prohibit publication only after the determination has been delivered
It has no power over publication; that is a matter for the Court of First Instance
It may prohibit publication only with the consent of both parties
en.explain: Section 61(1)(g) allows the Tribunal to order a person not to publish or otherwise disclose any material it receives, and section 61(1)(h) allows it to prohibit publication or disclosure of material received at a sitting, or part of a sitting, held in private.

tc.q: 審裁處就其接收的材料的發布，可作出甚麼命令？
options: 可命令某人不得發布或披露其接收的材料，並可禁止發布在非公開聆訊中接收的材料
只可在交付裁定後禁止發布
並無發布方面的權力；該事宜屬原訟法庭職權
只可在雙方同意下禁止發布
tc.explain: 第61(1)(g)條准許審裁處命令某人不得發布或以其他方式披露其接收的任何材料；第61(1)(h)條則准許其禁止發布或披露在非公開進行的聆訊（或聆訊的任何部分）中接收的任何材料。

en.q: Where a Tribunal sitting was held in private, what may the Tribunal order about its determination, and what is the penalty for breach?
options: It may prohibit publication or disclosure of the determination or reasons; breach without reasonable excuse carries a fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years on indictment
It may prohibit publication, but breach attracts no criminal sanction
It must publish the determination in full in every case
It may prohibit publication only for a maximum of six months
en.explain: Section 66(2) permits the Tribunal, where a sitting or part of it was held in private, to prohibit publication or disclosure of its determination, reasons or any costs order or part of them. Section 66(3) makes non-compliance without reasonable excuse an offence, and section 66(4) sets the penalty at $1,000,000 and 2 years on indictment.

tc.q: 如審裁處的聆訊以非公開方式進行，審裁處可就其裁定作出甚麼命令？違反的刑罰為何？
options: 可禁止發布或披露該裁定或理由；無合理辯解而違反者，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
可禁止發布，但違反並無刑事制裁
在任何情況下均須全文刊發該裁定
只可禁止發布最多六個月
tc.explain: 第66(2)條准許審裁處在聆訊或其部分以非公開方式進行的情況下，禁止發布或披露其裁定、理由或任何訟費命令或其任何部分。第66(3)條將無合理辯解而不遵從訂為罪行，第66(4)條則訂明循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第62(2)及(3)條

en.q: Evidence given to the Tribunal under compulsion is generally inadmissible against the person in criminal proceedings. In which proceedings does that protection NOT apply?
options: Proceedings for an offence under section 61(2)(a), or under Part V of the Crimes Ordinance, in respect of that evidence
Any proceedings for an offence under the AMLO
Proceedings brought by the specified authority under section 21
Proceedings for contempt before the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 62(2) makes such evidence inadmissible against the person in criminal proceedings, and section 62(3) disapplies that protection in proceedings in which the person is charged with an offence under section 61(2)(a), or under Part V of the Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 200), in respect of the evidence, answer or information.

tc.q: 在強制下向審裁處提供的證據，一般不可在刑事法律程序中用作針對該人。該保障在哪類法律程序中並不適用？
options: 就該等證據而根據第61(2)(a)條或《刑事罪行條例》第V部提出的罪行的法律程序
任何《打擊洗錢條例》所訂罪行的法律程序
指明當局根據第21條提起的法律程序
原訟法庭席前的藐視法庭法律程序
tc.explain: 第62(2)條訂明該等證據不可在刑事法律程序中用作針對該人；第62(3)條則訂明，如該人被控就該等證據、答覆或資料而犯第61(2)(a)條或《刑事罪行條例》（第200章）第V部所訂罪行，該項保障即不適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第65(3)條

en.q: Which rules apply to the award and taxation of costs by the Review Tribunal?
options: Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court
Order 14 of the Rules of the District Court
The Legal Aid Regulations
Rules made by the Secretary under section 58(2)
en.explain: Section 65(3) provides that Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court (Cap. 4 sub. leg. A) applies to the award of costs, and to the taxation of any costs awarded, by the Tribunal under section 65(1).

tc.q: 審裁處判給及評定訟費適用哪些規則？
options: 《高等法院規則》第62號命令
《區域法院規則》第14號命令
《法律援助規例》
局長根據第58(2)條訂立的規則
tc.explain: 第65(3)條訂明，《高等法院規則》（第4章，附屬法例A）第62號命令適用於審裁處根據第65(1)條判給訟費，以及評定任何獲判給的訟費。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第70條

en.q: After the Tribunal has determined a review, what may a party apply for under section 70?
options: A stay of execution of the determination, which the Tribunal may grant subject to conditions as to costs or payment of money into the Tribunal
A rehearing of the review before a differently constituted tribunal
An immediate referral of the matter to the Court of Final Appeal
A refund of the costs it has incurred in the review
en.explain: Section 70(1) allows a party to a review, at any time after the determination, to apply to the Tribunal for a stay of execution of the determination; section 70(2) permits the Tribunal to grant the stay subject to any condition as to costs, payment of money into the Tribunal, or other matters it considers appropriate.

tc.q: 審裁處裁定覆核後，一方可根據第70條申請甚麼？
options: 暫緩執行該裁定；審裁處可附加關於訟費或向審裁處繳存款項的條件而批予
由組成不同的審裁處重新聆訊該覆核
將事宜即時轉交終審法院
退還其在覆核中所招致的訟費
tc.explain: 第70(1)條准許覆核的一方在裁定後隨時向審裁處申請暫緩執行該裁定；第70(2)條准許審裁處附加其認為適當的關於訟費、向審裁處繳存款項或其他事宜的任何條件而批予暫緩。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第59(5)條

en.q: What must the Tribunal do after receiving an application for review?
options: Send a copy of the application to the specified authority as soon as reasonably practicable
Publish notice of the application in the Gazette
Stay execution of the specified decision pending the hearing
Refer the application to the Secretary for a preliminary view
en.explain: Section 59(5) requires the Tribunal, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving an application for review, to send a copy of the application to the specified authority. Note that under section 69(1) the application does not itself operate as a stay.

tc.q: 審裁處接獲覆核申請後須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快將申請副本送交指明當局
在憲報刊登該項申請的公告
在聆訊前暫緩執行該指明決定
將申請轉交局長作初步意見
tc.explain: 第59(5)條規定審裁處須在接獲覆核申請後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快將申請副本送交指明當局。留意根據第69(1)條，申請本身並不構成暫緩執行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第60(3)條

en.q: What must the Tribunal give the parties when reviewing a specified decision?
options: A reasonable opportunity to be heard
Written notice at least 28 days before the hearing
Legal representation at public expense
A written indication of its provisional view before the hearing
en.explain: Section 60(3) requires the Tribunal, in reviewing a specified decision, to give the parties to the review a reasonable opportunity to be heard. The same safeguard appears at the earlier decision-making stage in sections 22(1), 34(3) and 44(1).

tc.q: 審裁處覆核指明決定時，須給予各方甚麼？
options: 合理的陳述機會
於聆訊前至少28日發出的書面通知
由公帑支付的法律代表
於聆訊前以書面表明其暫定意見
tc.explain: 第60(3)條規定審裁處在覆核指明決定時，須給予覆核各方合理的陳述機會。同樣的保障亦見於較早階段的第22(1)、34(3)及44(1)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(2)及(3)條

en.q: An applicant satisfies every matter listed in section 30(3). Must the Commissioner grant the licence?
options: No — section 30(2) provides that the Commissioner may grant a licence; satisfaction of section 30(3) is a necessary but not sufficient condition
Yes — the Commissioner is obliged to grant a licence once section 30(3) is satisfied
Yes, provided the Schedule 3 fee has been paid
No — the Commissioner must also obtain the approval of the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 30(2) is permissive: the Commissioner may grant a licence on an application. Section 30(3) is a precondition — the Commissioner may grant a licence only if satisfied of the listed matters — so satisfying it does not compel a grant.

tc.q: 某申請人符合第30(3)條所列的每一項事宜。海關關長是否必須批出牌照？
options: 否——第30(2)條訂明關長「可」批出牌照；符合第30(3)條是必要條件，但並非充分條件
是——一旦符合第30(3)條，關長即有責任批出牌照
是，只要已繳付附表3的費用
否——關長還須取得審裁處的批准
tc.explain: 第30(2)條屬賦權性質：海關關長「可」應申請批出牌照。第30(3)條則為先決條件——關長只有在信納所列事宜的情況下方可批出牌照——故符合該條並不強制關長批出牌照。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(5)及(6)條

en.q: What may the Commissioner do on granting a licence, and what must follow?
options: Impose any condition thought fit, and inform the licensee by notice in writing at the time the licence is granted
Impose conditions only from a list prescribed in Schedule 3, with no notice required
Impose conditions at any later time, but never at the point of grant
Impose conditions only after consulting the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 30(5) allows the Commissioner, on granting a licence, to impose any condition thought fit; section 30(6) requires the Commissioner to inform the licensee by notice in writing at the time the licence is granted. Section 30(7) fixes when the condition takes effect.

tc.q: 海關關長批出牌照時可作出甚麼？其後須怎樣做？
options: 施加其認為合適的任何條件，並須於批出牌照時以書面通知告知持牌人
只可施加附表3訂明清單內的條件，並無須發出通知
只可在其後任何時間施加條件，但不可在批出時施加
須先諮詢審裁處方可施加條件
tc.explain: 第30(5)條准許海關關長在批出牌照時施加其認為合適的任何條件；第30(6)條規定關長須於批出牌照時以書面通知告知持牌人。第30(7)條則訂明該條件的生效時間。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(4)條

en.q: Do the fitness-and-propriety requirements in section 30(3) and (4) apply to an application to renew a licence?
options: Yes — section 31(4) applies them to a renewal application as they apply to an application for a licence
No — fitness and propriety is assessed only on a first grant
Only where there has been a change of directors since the licence was granted
Only where the Commissioner gives written notice that it intends to reassess them
en.explain: Section 31(4) expressly provides that section 30(3) and (4) applies to an application for renewal as it applies to an application for a licence. Fitness and propriety is therefore reassessed at every renewal.

tc.q: 第30(3)及(4)條的適當人選規定，是否適用於牌照續期申請？
options: 適用——第31(4)條訂明該等規定適用於續期申請，一如適用於牌照申請
不適用——適當人選資格只在首次批出時評估
只限自批出牌照以來董事有變動的情況
只限關長發出書面通知表示擬重新評估的情況
tc.explain: 第31(4)條明文訂明第30(3)及(4)條適用於續期申請，一如其適用於牌照申請。因此，每次續期時均會重新評估適當人選資格。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(5)(b)及(c)條

en.q: Beyond the reasons and the right of review, what must a notice suspending a licence state, and what must a notice revoking one state?
options: A suspension notice must state the duration and terms of the suspension; a revocation notice must state the time within which the licence is to be surrendered
Both must state the amount of any pecuniary penalty imposed
Both must state the date of the next licensing inspection
A suspension notice must state the appeal deadline; a revocation notice need state nothing further
en.explain: Section 34(5) requires the notice to include a statement of reasons; for a suspension, the duration and terms; for a revocation, the time within which the licence is to be surrendered; and a statement that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review.

tc.q: 除理由及覆核權利外，暫時吊銷牌照的通知須述明甚麼？撤銷牌照的通知又須述明甚麼？
options: 暫時吊銷通知須述明吊銷的期間及條款；撤銷通知須述明須於何時內交回牌照
兩者均須述明所施加的任何罰款款額
兩者均須述明下次發牌視察的日期
暫時吊銷通知須述明上訴期限；撤銷通知則無須再述明任何事項
tc.explain: 第34(5)條規定通知須載有理由陳述；如屬暫時吊銷，須載明吊銷的期間及條款；如屬撤銷，須載明須於何時內交回牌照；以及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核的陳述。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(6)條

en.q: When does a revocation or suspension of a licence under section 34 take effect?
options: At the time specified in the notice given under section 34(4)
Immediately on the Commissioner reaching the decision
Twenty-one days after the notice is sent, in every case
Only after any application to the Review Tribunal has been determined
en.explain: Section 34(6) provides that a revocation or suspension takes effect at the time specified in the notice under subsection (4). Note that this differs from the rule for licence conditions in section 30(7), which turns on receipt of the notice or the time specified, whichever is later.

tc.q: 根據第34條撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照，何時生效？
options: 於根據第34(4)條發出的通知所指明的時間
於海關關長作出決定時即時生效
在任何情況下均為通知寄發後21日
須待任何向審裁處提出的申請有裁定後
tc.explain: 第34(6)條訂明撤銷或暫時吊銷於根據第(4)款發出的通知所指明的時間生效。留意這有別於第30(7)條就牌照條件所訂的規則，後者以接獲通知時或通知所指明時間（以較遲者為準）為準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38(3)條；第39(3)條

en.q: When granting an application to add premises to a licence, what may the Commissioner do?
options: Grant it on payment of the Schedule 3 fee and impose any condition thought fit
Grant it without any fee, but impose no conditions
Grant it only on the same conditions as attach to the existing premises
Grant it only with the written agreement of the occupants of the new premises in every case
en.explain: Sections 38(3) and 39(3) each provide that the Commissioner may grant an application on payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3 and may impose any condition that the Commissioner thinks fit. Occupants' written consent is required only where the premises are domestic premises.

tc.q: 海關關長批准將處所加入牌照的申請時，可作出甚麼？
options: 在繳付附表3費用後批准，並可施加其認為合適的任何條件
無須任何費用即可批准，但不可施加條件
只可按現有處所所附的相同條件批准
在任何情況下均須取得新處所佔用人的書面同意方可批准
tc.explain: 第38(3)及39(3)條均訂明海關關長可在繳付附表3訂明的費用後批准申請，並可施加其認為合適的任何條件。佔用人的書面同意只在處所屬住宅處所時方屬必需。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(2)(b)及(c)條

en.q: Which powers does an authorized officer executing a section 47 warrant have in relation to physical entry?
options: To break into and forcibly enter the premises, and to remove by force any person or thing obstructing the exercise of those powers
To enter only through an unlocked door, and to withdraw if obstructed
To enter only when accompanied by a magistrate
To enter only between sunrise and sunset
en.explain: Section 47(2) allows the authorized officer to call on any person to assist, to break into and forcibly enter the premises, to remove by force any person or thing obstructing the exercise of those powers, and to detain persons found on the premises until the search is complete.

tc.q: 執行第47條手令的獲授權人員，在實際進入方面具有哪些權力？
options: 破門及強行進入處所，並以武力移走阻礙行使該等權力的任何人或物
只可經未上鎖的門進入，遇阻礙即須撤離
只可在裁判官陪同下進入
只可在日出至日落之間進入
tc.explain: 第47(2)條准許獲授權人員要求任何人協助、破門及強行進入處所、以武力移走阻礙行使該等權力的任何人或物，以及扣留在處所內發現的人直至搜查完成。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(2)(d)條

en.q: Whom may an authorized officer detain when executing a section 47 warrant, and for how long?
options: Any person found on the premises who appears able to give information relevant to the investigation, until the premises have been searched
Any person found on the premises, for up to 48 hours
Only the licensee's directors, until they answer all questions put to them
No one — detention requires a separate arrest under section 48
en.explain: Section 47(2)(d) allows the officer to detain any person found on the premises who appears to be, or to be likely to be, able to give information relevant to the investigation of the suspected offence, until the premises have been searched. Arrest and longer detention are governed separately by section 48.

tc.q: 獲授權人員執行第47條手令時可扣留何人？可扣留多久？
options: 在處所內發現而看來能提供與調查相關資料的任何人，直至該處所已被搜查為止
在處所內發現的任何人，最長48小時
只限持牌人的董事，直至其回答所有提問
不可扣留任何人——扣留須另行根據第48條拘捕
tc.explain: 第47(2)(d)條准許人員扣留在處所內發現、看來能或相當可能能就所懷疑罪行的調查提供相關資料的任何人，直至該處所已被搜查為止。拘捕及較長時間的扣留則由第48條另行規管。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(3)條；第48(2)條

en.q: What must an authorized officer produce on request when exercising powers under Part 5?
options: The warrant, when entering premises under section 47; and evidence of appointment as an authorized officer, when arresting or detaining under section 48
A copy of the licensee's licence in both cases
A certificate from the Review Tribunal authorising the action
Nothing — production is required only under section 9
en.explain: Section 47(3) requires an authorized officer entering premises under that section to produce the warrant for inspection if required; section 48(2) requires an officer arresting or detaining a person to produce evidence of appointment as an authorized officer if requested.

tc.q: 獲授權人員行使第5部下的權力時，經要求須出示甚麼？
options: 根據第47條進入處所時出示手令；根據第48條拘捕或扣留時出示其獲委任為獲授權人員的證據
兩種情況下均出示持牌人的牌照副本
出示審裁處批准該行動的證明書
無須出示任何東西——只有第9條下方須出示
tc.explain: 第47(3)條規定根據該條進入處所的獲授權人員，如被要求須出示手令以供查閱；第48(2)條則規定拘捕或扣留某人的人員，如被要求須出示其獲委任為獲授權人員的證據。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(3)條

en.q: Where must an authorized officer take a person arrested under section 48?
options: Immediately to a police station, or first to an office of the Customs and Excise Department if further enquiries are necessary and then to a police station
Directly before a magistrate within two hours
To the Review Tribunal for a preliminary hearing
To the licensee's business premises to continue the search
en.explain: Section 48(3) requires the officer to take the arrested person immediately to a police station or, if in the officer's opinion further enquiries are necessary, first to an office of the Customs and Excise Department and then to a police station, to be dealt with under the Police Force Ordinance (Cap. 232).

tc.q: 獲授權人員須將根據第48條被拘捕的人帶往何處？
options: 立即帶往警署；如認為有需要作進一步查訊，則先帶往香港海關辦事處，然後帶往警署
於兩小時內直接帶往裁判官席前
帶往審裁處進行預備聆訊
帶往持牌人的業務處所繼續搜查
tc.explain: 第48(3)條規定人員須立即將被拘捕的人帶往警署；如人員認為有需要作進一步查訊，則先帶往香港海關辦事處，然後帶往警署，並按《警隊條例》（第232章）處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(6)條

en.q: Following an arrest under section 48, what may the authorized officer search?
options: The person, or the place at which the person has been arrested and its surrounding areas, for anything related to the suspected offence
Only the person's pockets and any bag being carried
Any premises owned by the person anywhere in Hong Kong
Nothing further without a separate warrant from a magistrate
en.explain: Section 48(6) allows the officer to search the person, or the place of arrest and its surrounding areas, for anything that may be related to the suspected offence, and to take possession of anything found that the officer reasonably suspects is so related. Section 48(7) requires a same-sex officer to search a person.

tc.q: 根據第48條拘捕後，獲授權人員可搜查甚麼？
options: 該人，或該人被拘捕的地方及其周圍地方，以搜尋可能與所懷疑罪行有關的任何東西
只限該人的口袋及所攜帶的袋
該人在香港任何地方擁有的任何處所
未另行取得裁判官手令前不可再搜查
tc.explain: 第48(6)條准許人員搜查該人，或該人被拘捕的地方及其周圍地方，以搜尋可能與所懷疑罪行有關的任何東西，並可管有所發現而其有合理理由懷疑與該罪行有關的任何東西。第48(7)條規定搜查人身須由同性別人員進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第13(9)條

en.q: What is the maximum penalty on conviction on indictment for failing, with intent to defraud, to comply with a requirement imposed by an investigator under section 12?
options: A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
en.explain: Section 13(9) sets the penalty for the intent-to-defraud offences under section 13(5) to (8) at a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years on conviction on indictment. This mirrors section 10(9) for section 9 requirements.

tc.q: 意圖欺騙而沒有遵從調查員根據第12條施加的規定，循公訴程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
tc.explain: 第13(9)條就第13(5)至(8)款的意圖欺騙罪行訂明，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年。這與第10(9)條就第9條規定所訂者相對應。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(2)(c)及(5)條

en.q: A covered person cannot answer an investigator's question because the information is not within their knowledge. What may the investigator require?
options: That the person verify that fact and reason by statutory declaration within a specified time
That the person obtain the information from a third party at their own expense
That the person attend daily until the information is obtained
Nothing — the matter simply ends there
en.explain: Section 12(5) allows the investigator, where a covered person does not give an answer because the information is not within the person's knowledge or possession, to require in writing that the person verify that fact and reason by statutory declaration within the time specified. Section 12(6) permits the investigator to take the declaration.

tc.q: 受涵蓋的人因有關資料並非其所知而無法回答調查員的提問。調查員可要求甚麼？
options: 該人於指明時間內以法定聲明核實該事實及理由
該人自費向第三方取得該資料
該人每日出席，直至取得該資料為止
無可要求——事情就此結束
tc.explain: 第12(5)條准許調查員在受涵蓋的人因有關資料並非其所知或並非其所管有而沒有作出答覆時，以書面要求該人於指明時間內以法定聲明核實該事實及理由。第12(6)條准許該法定聲明由調查員監誓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(8)條

en.q: What is the position on interim reports by an investigator to the relevant authority?
options: The investigator may make them at any time, and must make them as soon as reasonably practicable after being required by the relevant authority to do so
Interim reports are prohibited; only a final report may be made
Interim reports must be made monthly without exception
Interim reports may be made only with the consent of the Secretary for Justice
en.explain: Section 12(8) provides that an investigator may make interim reports on the investigation to the relevant authority, and must make them as soon as reasonably practicable after being required by the relevant authority to do so. The Secretary for Justice's consent relates to publication under section 12(10).

tc.q: 調查員向有關當局提交中期報告的規定為何？
options: 調查員可隨時提交，並須在有關當局要求後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快提交
禁止提交中期報告；只可提交最終報告
必須每月提交中期報告，並無例外
須經律政司司長同意方可提交中期報告
tc.explain: 第12(8)條訂明調查員可就調查向有關當局提交中期報告，並須在有關當局要求後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快提交。律政司司長的同意則關乎第12(10)條下的刊登事宜。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第35(1)條；第43(1)(c)條

en.q: A licensed corporation appoints a new director and applies for the Commissioner's approval only two weeks afterwards. What is the position?
options: Section 35(1) has been contravened, exposing the person to prosecution and the licensee to disciplinary action under section 43(1)(c)
No contravention, provided the application is made within one month
No contravention, because approval may be given retrospectively
The appointment is automatically void and no further consequence follows
en.explain: Section 35(1) requires the Commissioner's written approval before a person becomes a director. A late application does not cure the contravention: the person is liable under section 35(7), and a contravention of section 35(1) is an express ground for disciplinary action against the licensee under section 43(1)(c).

tc.q: 某持牌法團委任新董事，並於其後兩星期才申請海關關長批准。情況為何？
options: 已違反第35(1)條，該人可被檢控，而持牌人亦可根據第43(1)(c)條被採取紀律行動
並無違反，只要於一個月內提出申請即可
並無違反，因批准可追溯生效
該項委任自動無效，並無其他後果
tc.explain: 第35(1)條規定某人成為董事前須先取得海關關長的書面批准。遲交申請並不能補救該項違反：該人須負第35(7)條的法律責任，而違反第35(1)條亦是第43(1)(c)條下針對持牌人採取紀律行動的明文理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(2)(a)條

en.q: A licence is due to expire on 30 June. The licensee lodges its renewal application on 1 June. Does the application comply with section 31(2)(a)?
options: No — the application must be made not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire
Yes — any application made before the expiry date complies
Yes — the requirement is 21 days, which is satisfied
No — the application must be made at least 90 days before expiry
en.explain: Section 31(2)(a) requires a renewal application to be made not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire. An application on 1 June for a licence expiring on 30 June leaves only 29 days and is therefore out of time.

tc.q: 某牌照將於6月30日屆滿。持牌人於6月1日遞交續期申請。該申請是否符合第31(2)(a)條？
options: 不符合——申請須於牌照屆滿前不少於45日提出
符合——只要在屆滿日前提出申請即符合
符合——規定為21日，已經符合
不符合——申請須於屆滿前至少90日提出
tc.explain: 第31(2)(a)條規定續期申請須於牌照屆滿前不少於45日提出。就6月30日屆滿的牌照而言，於6月1日提出申請僅相距29日，故已逾期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9條與第46條的比較

en.q: What is the difference between an “authorized person” under section 9 and an “authorized officer” under section 46?
options: An authorized person is authorized by a relevant authority for routine inspections under Part 3; an authorized officer is a Customs and Excise public officer appointed by the Commissioner for the purposes of Part 5
They are two names for the same office
An authorized person may arrest, whereas an authorized officer may only inspect records
An authorized officer is appointed by a magistrate; an authorized person by the Commissioner
en.explain: Section 9(12) allows a relevant authority to authorize any person as an authorized person for the section 9 routine inspection power. Section 46 allows the Commissioner to appoint any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department as an authorized officer for Part 5, which includes the section 48 arrest power.

tc.q: 第9條的「獲授權人」與第46條的「獲授權人員」有何分別？
options: 獲授權人由有關當局為第3部的例行視察而授權；獲授權人員則是關長為第5部的目的而委任的香港海關公職人員
兩者只是同一職位的兩種稱謂
獲授權人可拘捕，獲授權人員則只可視察紀錄
獲授權人員由裁判官委任；獲授權人由關長委任
tc.explain: 第9(12)條准許有關當局為第9條的例行視察權力授權任何人為獲授權人。第46條則准許海關關長為第5部的目的，委任任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員為獲授權人員，其權力包括第48條的拘捕權。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17條與第47條的比較

en.q: What distinguishes a warrant issued under section 17 from one issued under section 47?
options: A section 17 warrant is directed at records that may be required to be produced under Part 3; a section 47 warrant is directed at evidence of an offence under section 29
A section 17 warrant may be issued only by a judge, a section 47 warrant only by a magistrate
A section 17 warrant permits arrest; a section 47 warrant does not permit entry
A section 47 warrant is valid for 7 days; a section 17 warrant has no time limit
en.explain: Section 17(1) concerns premises on which there is or is likely to be a record or document that may be required to be produced under Part 3. Section 47(1) concerns premises on which an offence under section 29 — operating a money service without a licence — is suspected. Both are issued by a magistrate on information on oath, and it is the section 17 warrant that carries the 7-day period.

tc.q: 根據第17條發出的手令與根據第47條發出的手令有何分別？
options: 第17條手令針對根據第3部可能須交出的紀錄；第47條手令則針對第29條罪行的證據
第17條手令只可由法官發出，第47條手令只可由裁判官發出
第17條手令准許拘捕；第47條手令不准許進入處所
第47條手令有效期為7日；第17條手令則無時限
tc.explain: 第17(1)條關乎其內存有或相當可能存有根據第3部可能須交出的紀錄或文件的處所。第47(1)條則關乎懷疑有第29條罪行（無牌經營金錢服務）發生的處所。兩者均由裁判官因經宣誓而作的告發而發出；訂有7日期限的是第17條手令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(c)條

en.q: Which pattern of past conduct must the Commissioner have regard to under section 30(4)(c) in assessing fitness and propriety?
options: Whether the person has persistently failed to comply with any requirement imposed under the Ordinance or any regulation made under section 51
Whether the person has ever been late in filing an annual return
Whether the person has changed business premises more than twice
Whether the person has previously withdrawn a licence application
en.explain: Section 30(4)(c) requires regard to be had to whether the person has persistently failed to comply with any requirement imposed under the Ordinance or any regulation made by the Commissioner under section 51. Isolated or minor lapses are not the target; persistence is.

tc.q: 在評估適當人選資格時，海關關長須根據第30(4)(c)條顧及哪種過往行為模式？
options: 該人有否持續沒有遵從本條例或根據第51條訂立的任何規例所施加的任何規定
該人有否曾經遲交周年申報表
該人有否更換業務處所超過兩次
該人此前有否撤回牌照申請
tc.explain: 第30(4)(c)條規定須顧及該人有否持續沒有遵從本條例或海關關長根據第51條訂立的任何規例所施加的任何規定。針對的並非孤立或輕微的疏失，而是「持續」的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5A(3)條

en.q: An AML/CTF requirement applying to a DNFBP who is an accounting or legal professional is engaged only when that professional does what?
options: By way of business, in Hong Kong, prepares for or carries out for a client a transaction concerning one of the listed activities, such as the buying or selling of real estate
Gives any legal or accounting advice to a client, whatever its subject
Acts for a client who is resident outside Hong Kong
Handles any sum exceeding HK$120,000 for a client
en.explain: Section 5A(3) limits the application of AML/CTF requirements to accounting and legal professionals to circumstances where, by way of business, in Hong Kong, they prepare for or carry out for a client a transaction concerning listed activities including real estate, managing client assets, managing accounts, organising contributions, creating or managing legal persons or arrangements, buying or selling business entities, or a trust or company service.

tc.q: 適用於屬會計專業人士或法律專業人士的指定非金融企業及行業的打擊洗錢規定，只在該專業人士作出甚麼行為時方適用？
options: 在香港以業務方式為客戶籌備或進行涉及所列活動之一的交易，例如買賣不動產
向客戶提供任何法律或會計意見，不論其主題為何
為並非居於香港的客戶行事
為客戶處理任何超過120,000港元的款項
tc.explain: 第5A(3)條將適用於會計及法律專業人士的打擊洗錢規定，限於其在香港以業務方式為客戶籌備或進行涉及所列活動的交易，包括買賣不動產、管理客戶資產、管理帳戶、籌組出資、創立或管理法人或法律安排、買賣業務實體，或信託或公司服務。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5A(6)條

en.q: For the purposes of section 5A, does it matter whether the subject matter of the transaction is in Hong Kong or elsewhere?
options: No — section 5A(6) provides that it is immaterial where the subject matter is
Yes — the requirement applies only where the subject matter is in Hong Kong
Yes — the requirement applies only where the subject matter is outside Hong Kong
It depends on the type of DNFBP concerned
en.explain: Section 5A(6) states, to avoid doubt, that for the purposes of that section it is immaterial whether the subject matter of a transaction referred to in subsection (3), (4) or (5) is in Hong Kong or elsewhere. What matters is that the professional acts in Hong Kong.

tc.q: 就第5A條而言，交易的標的在香港或在其他地方，是否重要？
options: 不重要——第5A(6)條訂明標的位於何處並不重要
重要——該規定只在標的位於香港時方適用
重要——該規定只在標的位於香港以外時方適用
視乎有關指定非金融企業及行業的類別而定
tc.explain: 第5A(6)條為免生疑問訂明，就該條而言，第(3)、(4)或(5)款所提述的交易的標的位於香港或其他地方，並不重要。關鍵在於該專業人士是在香港行事。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5A(7)條

en.q: What does “AML/CTF requirement” mean for the purposes of section 5A?
options: A requirement set out in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2
Any requirement anywhere in the Ordinance
A requirement set out in a guideline published under section 7
Any condition imposed on a licence under Part 5
en.explain: Section 5A(7) defines AML/CTF requirement as a requirement set out in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2. This is narrower than the section 8 concept of a prescribed requirement, which covers the whole Ordinance and licence conditions.

tc.q: 就第5A條而言，「打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集規定」指甚麼？
options: 附表2第2、3或4部所列的規定
本條例任何部分的任何規定
根據第7條公布的指引所列的規定
第5部下施加於牌照的任何條件
tc.explain: 第5A(7)條界定「打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集規定」為附表2第2、3或4部所列的規定。這較第8條「訂明規定」的概念為窄，後者涵蓋整條條例及牌照條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第29(1)及(2)條

en.q: On summary conviction, what is the maximum penalty for operating a money service without a licence?
options: A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
en.explain: Section 29(2) provides for a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on conviction on indictment, and a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction. A disqualification order may also be made under section 29(3).

tc.q: 無牌經營金錢服務，循簡易程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 第6級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
第5級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款500,000元及監禁1年
tc.explain: 第29(2)條訂明循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年，循簡易程序定罪則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。另可根據第29(3)條作出取消資格令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條（「牌照」的定義）

en.q: What does “licence” mean for the purposes of Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: A licence granted under section 30 or renewed under section 31, including one deemed to have been granted under section 82
Only a licence granted under section 30
Any authorisation issued by the Commissioner under the Ordinance
A licence granted under section 30 that has not yet been amended under section 32
en.explain: Section 24 defines licence as a licence granted under section 30 or renewed under section 31, and includes a licence that is deemed to have been granted under section 82 — the transitional provision for operators licensed under the previous regime.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部而言，「牌照」指甚麼？
options: 根據第30條批出或根據第31條續期的牌照，包括根據第82條被當作已批出的牌照
只限根據第30條批出的牌照
海關關長根據本條例發出的任何許可
根據第30條批出而尚未按第32條修訂的牌照
tc.explain: 第24條界定「牌照」為根據第30條批出或根據第31條續期的牌照，並包括根據第82條被當作已批出的牌照——即先前制度下持牌經營者的過渡條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條（「最終擁有人」的定義——個人）

en.q: In relation to an individual licensee, who is the “ultimate owner” under section 24?
options: Another individual who ultimately owns or controls the money service business, or, if the licensee acts on behalf of another person, that other person
Any person from whom the licensee has borrowed money
The licensee's spouse in every case
The individual licensee themselves
en.explain: Section 24 defines ultimate owner, in relation to an individual, as another individual who ultimately owns or controls the money service business of the first-mentioned individual, or, if the first-mentioned individual is acting on behalf of another person, that other person.

tc.q: 就個人持牌人而言，第24條下的「最終擁有人」是誰？
options: 最終擁有或控制該金錢服務業務的另一名個人；或如該持牌人是代另一人行事，則為該另一人
該持牌人向其借款的任何人
在任何情況下均為該持牌人的配偶
該名個人持牌人本身
tc.explain: 第24條就個人界定「最終擁有人」，指最終擁有或控制首述個人的金錢服務業務的另一名個人；或如首述個人是代另一人行事，則指該另一人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第27(2)條

en.q: Where must the register of licensees be kept?
options: At the office of the Commissioner
At the Companies Registry
At each licensee's principal place of business
At the Review Tribunal's registry
en.explain: Section 27(2) provides that the register is to be kept at the office of the Commissioner. Section 27(1) allows it to be kept in any form the Commissioner thinks fit, and section 27(3) requires it to be available for public inspection.

tc.q: 持牌人登記冊須存放於何處？
options: 海關關長的辦事處
公司註冊處
每名持牌人的主要營業地點
審裁處的登記處
tc.explain: 第27(2)條訂明登記冊須存放於海關關長的辦事處。第27(1)條准許以關長認為合適的任何形式備存，第27(3)條則規定須供公眾查閱。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(3)及(4)條

en.q: What are the “specified acts” an authorized person may require in exercising the inspection power under section 9?
options: To give access to any specified business record and produce it within the time and at the place specified, and to answer any question regarding the record
To surrender the original records permanently and cease trading pending inspection
To provide a certified translation of every record into English
To deliver the records to the Customs and Excise Department within 24 hours
en.explain: Section 9(4) defines the specified acts as giving the authorized person access to any specified business record and producing the record within the time and at the place specified, and answering any question regarding the record.

tc.q: 獲授權人行使第9條的視察權力時，可要求作出哪些「指明作為」？
options: 讓獲授權人查閱任何指明業務紀錄，並於指明時間及地點交出該紀錄，以及回答關於該紀錄的任何問題
永久交出紀錄正本，並在視察期間停止營業
提供每份紀錄的英文核證譯本
於24小時內將紀錄送交香港海關
tc.explain: 第9(4)條界定「指明作為」為：讓獲授權人查閱任何指明業務紀錄，並於獲授權人指明的時間及地點交出該紀錄；以及回答關於該紀錄的任何問題。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(16)條

en.q: In relation to a licensed MSO, what is a “specified business record” for the purposes of section 9?
options: Any record or document relating to the business carried on, or any transaction carried out, by the inspection subject
Only records required to be kept under Schedule 2
Only records created within the preceding six years
Only records relating to transactions exceeding HK$8,000
en.explain: Section 9(16)(a) defines specified business record, in relation to a non-Part 5B inspection subject, as any record or document relating to the business carried on, or any transaction carried out, by the inspection subject. Section 9(16)(b) covers a specified transaction whether or not any record of it exists.

tc.q: 就第9條而言，持牌金錢服務經營者的「指明業務紀錄」指甚麼？
options: 與該視察對象所經營業務或所進行的任何交易有關的任何紀錄或文件
只限附表2規定須保存的紀錄
只限過去六年內產生的紀錄
只限與超過8,000港元交易有關的紀錄
tc.explain: 第9(16)(a)條就非第5B部視察對象界定「指明業務紀錄」，指與該視察對象所經營業務或所進行的任何交易有關的任何紀錄或文件。第9(16)(b)條則涵蓋指明交易，不論是否存在關於該交易的紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(15)(g)條

en.q: In relation to the Postmaster General, what constitutes “business premises” for the purposes of section 9?
options: Any premises at which the Postmaster General operates a remittance service, and any premises at which that service is managed
Every post office in Hong Kong without exception
Only the headquarters of Hongkong Post
No premises — the Postmaster General is not subject to section 9
en.explain: Section 9(15)(g) defines business premises, in relation to the Postmaster General, as any premises at which the Postmaster General operates a remittance service and any premises at which the remittance service operated by the Postmaster General is managed. The Postmaster General is a prescribed person under section 8.

tc.q: 就第9條而言，郵政署署長的「業務處所」指甚麼？
options: 郵政署署長經營匯款服務的任何處所，以及管理該項服務的任何處所
香港每一間郵政局，並無例外
只限香港郵政的總部
並無處所——郵政署署長不受第9條規限
tc.explain: 第9(15)(g)條就郵政署署長界定「業務處所」，指郵政署署長經營匯款服務的任何處所，以及署長所經營的匯款服務的管理處所。根據第8條，郵政署署長屬訂明人士。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第4(1A)條

en.q: Besides a relevant authority, which body is given immunity from civil liability under section 4?
options: A regulatory body, for anything done or omitted in good faith in performing a function under the Ordinance
Any licensed money service operator acting on the Commissioner's instructions
The Review Tribunal only
Any person who files a suspicious transaction report
en.explain: Section 4(1A), added in 2018, provides that a regulatory body does not incur civil liability for anything done or omitted to be done in good faith in the performance or purported performance of a function conferred or imposed on it by or under the Ordinance.

tc.q: 除有關當局外，第4條還賦予哪一機構民事法律責任的豁免？
options: 監管團體，就其真誠地執行本條例下職能時作出或不作出的任何事情
按海關關長指示行事的任何持牌金錢服務經營者
只限審裁處
提交可疑交易報告的任何人
tc.explain: 第4(1A)條（2018年加入）訂明，監管團體就其真誠地執行或看來是執行本條例所授予或委予它的職能時，作出或不作出的任何事情，不招致民事法律責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(7)及(8)條

en.q: What distinguishes the offence in section 5(7) from that in section 5(8) for an employee of a financial institution?
options: Section 5(7) requires knowingly causing or permitting the contravention; section 5(8) requires an intent to defraud the institution or a relevant authority, and carries heavier penalties
Section 5(7) applies to employees and section 5(8) to directors
Section 5(7) is triable only summarily; section 5(8) only on indictment
Section 5(8) applies only where the contravention causes actual loss
en.explain: Section 5(7) covers an employee or manager who knowingly causes or permits the institution to contravene a specified provision, punishable by $1,000,000 and 2 years on indictment. Section 5(8) covers the same conduct with intent to defraud the institution or a relevant authority, punishable by $1,000,000 and 7 years on indictment.

tc.q: 就金融機構僱員而言，第5(7)條的罪行與第5(8)條的罪行有何分別？
options: 第5(7)條須在知情下導致或准許該項違反；第5(8)條則須有欺騙該機構或有關當局的意圖，刑罰亦較重
第5(7)條適用於僱員，第5(8)條適用於董事
第5(7)條只可循簡易程序審訊；第5(8)條只可循公訴程序審訊
第5(8)條只在該項違反造成實際損失時方適用
tc.explain: 第5(7)條涵蓋在知情下導致或准許該機構違反指明條文的僱員或管理人員，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年。第5(8)條涵蓋同樣行為但具有欺騙該機構或有關當局的意圖，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(11)條

en.q: Where are the “specified provisions” referred to in section 5 to be found?
options: In Schedule 2, the listed sections being enumerated in section 5(11)
In Schedule 1, Part 1
In the guidelines published under section 7
In regulations made by the Commissioner under section 51
en.explain: Section 5(11) defines specified provision by enumerating a list of sections of Schedule 2. It is a contravention of one of those provisions that engages the section 5 offences and the section 21 disciplinary powers.

tc.q: 第5條所提述的「指明條文」載於何處？
options: 載於附表2，而第5(11)條列舉出所指的各條
載於附表1第1部
載於根據第7條公布的指引
載於海關關長根據第51條訂立的規例
tc.explain: 第5(11)條藉列舉附表2的一系列條文來界定「指明條文」。違反該等條文之一，即觸發第5條的罪行及第21條的紀律權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(f)及(j)條

en.q: Which of the following may the Tribunal do under section 61(1)?
options: Order a witness to provide evidence by affidavit, and determine the procedure to be followed in the review
Impose a pecuniary penalty in place of the specified authority's decision
Grant a licence directly to the applicant
Prosecute a person for an offence under the Ordinance
en.explain: Section 61(1)(f) allows the Tribunal to order a witness to provide evidence by affidavit, and section 61(1)(j) allows it to determine the procedure to be followed in the review. Its remedial powers over the decision itself are in section 60(1), which does not extend to prosecuting or licensing.

tc.q: 根據第61(1)條，審裁處可作出下列哪項？
options: 命令證人以誓章提供證據，並決定覆核所須遵循的程序
代替指明當局的決定而施加罰款
直接向申請人批出牌照
就本條例所訂罪行檢控某人
tc.explain: 第61(1)(f)條准許審裁處命令證人以誓章為覆核提供證據；第61(1)(j)條准許其決定覆核所須遵循的程序。其對決定本身的補救權力載於第60(1)條，並不包括檢控或發牌。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(e)條

en.q: What may the Tribunal require of a person attending before it under section 61(1)(e)?
options: To be examined on oath or otherwise, and to answer truthfully any question the Tribunal considers appropriate for the purpose of the review
To provide a written witness statement at least 14 days in advance
To be represented by counsel at the hearing
To pay a deposit towards the costs of the review
en.explain: Section 61(1)(e) allows the Tribunal to examine or cause to be examined on oath or otherwise a person attending before it, and to require the person to answer truthfully any question that the Tribunal considers appropriate for the purpose of the review. Section 61(1)(d) gives the power to administer oaths.

tc.q: 根據第61(1)(e)條，審裁處可要求出席其席前的人作出甚麼？
options: 在經宣誓或其他方式下接受訊問，並須就審裁處認為為覆核目的而屬適當的任何問題如實回答
至少提前14日提交書面證人陳述書
在聆訊中由大律師代表
就覆核費用繳付按金
tc.explain: 第61(1)(e)條准許審裁處在經宣誓或以其他方式下訊問或安排訊問出席其席前的人，並規定該人就審裁處認為為覆核目的而屬適當的任何問題如實回答。第61(1)(d)條則賦予監誓的權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(1)(a)(iii)條

en.q: A licensee is a corporation and one of its several directors ceases to be a fit and proper person. Does that engage the Commissioner's section 34 powers?
options: Yes — the powers arise where any director of the corporation is no longer a fit and proper person to be associated with the licensee's money service business
No — the powers arise only if every director ceases to be fit and proper
No — the powers arise only in relation to the ultimate owner
Only if the director concerned is also the ultimate owner
en.explain: Section 34(1)(a)(iii)(A) makes the revocation and suspension powers available where any director of the corporation is no longer a fit and proper person to be associated with the licensee's business of operating a money service. Sub-paragraph (B) makes equivalent provision for the ultimate owner.

tc.q: 某持牌人是法團，其多名董事中有一名不再是適當人選。這是否觸發海關關長第34條的權力？
options: 是——凡該法團的「任何」董事不再是適合與該持牌人的金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選，該等權力即可行使
否——須所有董事均不再是適當人選方可
否——該等權力只就最終擁有人而行使
只有在該名董事同時是最終擁有人的情況下方可
tc.explain: 第34(1)(a)(iii)(A)條訂明，凡該法團的任何董事不再是適合與該持牌人的金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的適當人選，撤銷及暫時吊銷權力即可行使。(B)節就最終擁有人訂有相應條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)(a)(iii)條

en.q: Where the applicant for a licence is a corporation, of whose fitness and propriety must the Commissioner be satisfied?
options: Each director of the corporation, and the ultimate owner if there is one
The company secretary and the ultimate owner
The corporation itself, as a legal person
Only the director nominated to sit the Competence Assessment
en.explain: Section 30(3)(a)(iii) requires the Commissioner to be satisfied that each director of the corporation is a fit and proper person to be associated with the business of operating a money service, and that any ultimate owner in relation to the corporation is likewise fit and proper.

tc.q: 如牌照申請人是法團，海關關長須信納何人的適當人選資格？
options: 該法團的每名董事，以及最終擁有人（如有）
公司秘書及最終擁有人
該法團本身，作為法人
只限獲提名參加能力評核的董事
tc.explain: 第30(3)(a)(iii)條規定海關關長須信納該法團的每名董事是適合與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的適當人選，而該法團的任何最終擁有人亦同樣是適當人選。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)(a)(i)條

en.q: Where the applicant is an individual, what must the Commissioner be satisfied of in relation to the applicant personally?
options: That the individual is a fit and proper person to operate a money service
That the individual is a fit and proper person to be associated with the business of operating a money service
That the individual has passed the Competence Assessment
That the individual holds Hong Kong permanent residency
en.explain: Section 30(3)(a)(i)(A) uses the formula “fit and proper person to operate a money service” for an individual applicant and, by sub-paragraph (B), the “associated with the business” formula for that individual's ultimate owner. The same distinction runs through sections 35 to 37.

tc.q: 如申請人是個人，海關關長須就該申請人本人信納甚麼？
options: 該個人是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選
該個人是適合與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的適當人選
該個人已通過能力評核
該個人擁有香港永久居民身分
tc.explain: 第30(3)(a)(i)(A)條就個人申請人採用「適合經營金錢服務的適當人選」的表述；而(B)節就該個人的最終擁有人則採用「適合與該業務有聯繫」的表述。同樣的區分貫穿第35至37條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第44(2)條

en.q: How must the Commissioner communicate a decision made under section 43?
options: By notice in writing informing the licensee of the decision
Orally at the hearing, with written confirmation optional
By publication in the Gazette only
By entry in the register of licensees
en.explain: Section 44(2) requires the Commissioner, on exercising a power under section 43, to inform the licensee of the decision by notice in writing. Section 44(3) prescribes what that notice must contain, and section 43(7) separately permits public disclosure of the decision.

tc.q: 海關關長須以何種方式傳達根據第43條作出的決定？
options: 以書面通知告知持牌人該決定
在聆訊中以口頭告知，書面確認屬可選
只以憲報公布方式
以在持牌人登記冊上記項的方式
tc.explain: 第44(2)條規定海關關長行使第43條的權力時，須以書面通知告知持牌人該決定。第44(3)條訂明該通知須載有的內容，而第43(7)條則另行准許公開披露該決定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第39(1)條

en.q: How does section 39 differ from section 38 in its application to licensees?
options: Section 39 applies to a licensee not required under its licence to operate at particular premises; section 38 applies to one licensed to operate at premises specified in the licence
Section 39 applies to corporations and section 38 to partnerships
Section 39 concerns domestic premises and section 38 commercial premises
Section 39 requires no fee, whereas section 38 does
en.explain: Section 38(1) addresses a licensee licensed to operate at premises specified in the licence that wishes to add new premises. Section 39(1) addresses a licensee not required under its licence to operate at particular premises, which must still have any particular premises added before operating there.

tc.q: 第39條在適用於持牌人方面與第38條有何分別？
options: 第39條適用於牌照並無規定須在特定處所經營的持牌人；第38條則適用於獲發牌在牌照指明處所經營的持牌人
第39條適用於法團，第38條適用於合夥
第39條關乎住宅處所，第38條關乎商業處所
第39條無須繳費，第38條則須繳費
tc.explain: 第38(1)條處理獲發牌在牌照指明處所經營而擬新增處所的持牌人。第39(1)條則處理牌照並無規定須在特定處所經營的持牌人；該持牌人在任何特定處所經營前，仍須先將該處所加入牌照。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第29(1)條；第25條

en.q: An authorized institution operates a currency exchange counter, and separately an unlicensed individual runs a remittance business from a shop. Which of them commits an offence under section 29?
options: Only the unlicensed individual — Part 5, including section 29, does not apply to an authorized institution
Both, because section 29 applies to every person operating a money service
Only the authorized institution, because it did not obtain a separate MSO licence
Neither, provided both notify the Commissioner within one month
en.explain: Section 25 excludes authorized institutions from Part 5 altogether, so section 29 cannot bite on them. The unlicensed individual operating a remittance business is squarely within section 29(1) and liable to the penalties in section 29(2) and a possible disqualification order under section 29(3).

tc.q: 某認可機構經營貨幣兌換櫃檯，另有一名無牌人士在店舖經營匯款業務。何者觸犯第29條所訂罪行？
options: 只有該名無牌人士——第5部（包括第29條）並不適用於認可機構
兩者皆是，因第29條適用於每名經營金錢服務的人
只有該認可機構，因其並無另行取得金錢服務經營者牌照
兩者皆否，只要兩者均於一個月內通知海關關長
tc.explain: 第25條將認可機構完全排除於第5部之外，故第29條不能適用於認可機構。無牌經營匯款業務的個人則正落入第29(1)條，須承擔第29(2)條的刑罰，並可能被第29(3)條取消資格。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76A條（「指明人士」的定義）

en.q: Who is a “specified person” bound by the confidentiality requirements in Part 6A?
options: A relevant authority, its present or former members, employees, consultants, agents or advisers, and persons appointed under or performing functions under the Ordinance
Only the Commissioner of Customs and Excise personally
Every licensed money service operator and its staff
Only members of the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 76A defines specified person as a relevant authority; a person who is or was a member, employee, consultant, agent or adviser of a relevant authority; or a person who is or was appointed under the Ordinance, performing a function under it, or assisting another person in doing so.

tc.q: 何人屬受第6A部保密規定約束的「指明人士」？
options: 有關當局、其現任或前任成員、僱員、顧問、代理人或諮詢人，以及根據本條例獲委任或執行本條例職能的人
只限海關關長本人
每名持牌金錢服務經營者及其員工
只限審裁處成員
tc.explain: 第76A條界定「指明人士」為有關當局；現時或曾經是有關當局的成員、僱員、顧問、代理人或諮詢人的人；或現時或曾經根據本條例獲委任、執行本條例下職能，或協助他人執行該等職能的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76B(2)條
