en.q: What does section 76B prohibit a specified person from doing?
options: Communicating a matter that came to their knowledge under the Ordinance to another person, and allowing another person access to a record or document that came into their possession
Retaining any record or document for more than six months
Giving evidence before the Review Tribunal
Accepting employment with a licensed MSO after leaving the relevant authority
en.explain: Section 76B(2) provides that a specified person must not communicate a matter referred to in subsection (1)(a) to a person, and must not allow another person to have access to a record or document referred to in subsection (1)(b). Sections 76C and 76D then set out the permitted disclosures.

tc.q: 第76B條禁止指明人士作出甚麼？
options: 向他人傳達其根據本條例知悉的事宜，以及容許他人查閱其管有的紀錄或文件
保留任何紀錄或文件超過六個月
在審裁處席前作證
離開有關當局後受僱於持牌金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 第76B(2)條訂明指明人士不得向他人傳達第(1)(a)款所提述的事宜，亦不得容許他人查閱第(1)(b)款所提述的紀錄或文件。第76C及76D條繼而訂明獲准許的披露。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76B(3)條

en.q: What is the maximum penalty on conviction on indictment for contravening the confidentiality requirement in section 76B(2)?
options: A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
en.explain: Section 76B(3) provides for a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on conviction on indictment, and a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction.

tc.q: 違反第76B(2)條的保密規定，循公訴程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
tc.explain: 第76B(3)條訂明循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年，循簡易程序定罪則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(b)條

en.q: Which of the following disclosures is expressly permitted to a specified person despite section 76B?
options: Disclosing information that has already been made available to the public
Disclosing information to any journalist who requests it
Disclosing information to the licensee's competitors for market monitoring
Disclosing information to any overseas authority without further condition
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(b) permits disclosure of information that has already been made available to the public. Disclosure to overseas authorities is permitted only to a relevant authority under section 76D(1)(i), and then only subject to the section 76D(2) conditions.

tc.q: 即使有第76B條的規定，下列哪項披露獲明文准許指明人士作出？
options: 披露已公開提供的資料
向任何提出要求的記者披露資料
向該持牌人的競爭對手披露資料以作市場監察
無須任何進一步條件即向任何海外當局披露資料
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(b)條准許披露已公開提供的資料。向海外當局披露則只限有關當局根據第76D(1)(i)條作出，並須符合第76D(2)條的條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(c)及(d)條

en.q: For which purposes connected with law enforcement may a specified person disclose information despite section 76B?
options: With a view to the institution of, or for the purposes of, criminal proceedings in Hong Kong, and with a view to the commencement of, or for the purposes of, an investigation in Hong Kong under Hong Kong law
For any purpose connected with law enforcement anywhere in the world
Only where a magistrate has issued a warrant requiring disclosure
Only where the person concerned has already been charged
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(c) and (d) permit disclosure with a view to the institution of, or for the purposes of, any criminal proceedings in Hong Kong, and with a view to the commencement of, or for the purposes of, an investigation carried out in Hong Kong under the laws of Hong Kong.

tc.q: 即使有第76B條的規定，指明人士可為哪些與執法有關的目的披露資料？
options: 為在香港提起或進行刑事法律程序，以及為在香港根據香港法律展開或進行調查
為世界任何地方與執法有關的任何目的
只限裁判官已發出手令規定披露的情況
只限有關人士已被落案控告的情況
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(c)及(d)條准許為在香港提起或進行任何刑事法律程序，以及為在香港根據香港法律展開或進行調查而披露資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(e)條

en.q: May a specified person disclose information to a solicitor for the purpose of obtaining legal advice?
options: Yes — disclosure for the purpose of seeking or giving advice by counsel, a solicitor or other professional adviser acting in a professional capacity in connection with a matter under the Ordinance is permitted
No — legal professional privilege does not override section 76B
Only with the written consent of the Secretary for Justice
Only where proceedings have already been commenced
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(e) permits disclosure for the purpose of seeking advice from, or the giving of advice by, counsel, a solicitor or other professional adviser who is acting or proposing to act in a professional capacity in connection with any matter arising under the Ordinance.

tc.q: 指明人士可否為取得法律意見而向律師披露資料？
options: 可以——為向就本條例所引起的事宜以專業身分行事或擬行事的大律師、律師或其他專業顧問尋求意見，或由其提供意見而作的披露，獲准許
不可以——法律專業保密權並不凌駕第76B條
須取得律政司司長的書面同意方可
只限法律程序已展開的情況
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(e)條准許為向就本條例所引起的任何事宜以專業身分行事或擬行事的大律師、律師或其他專業顧問尋求意見，或由其提供意見，而披露資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(g)條

en.q: Under what legal compulsion may a specified person disclose information despite section 76B?
options: In accordance with an order of a court, magistrate or tribunal, or in accordance with a law of Hong Kong or a requirement imposed under such a law
Only in accordance with an order of the Court of Final Appeal
Only in accordance with a direction of the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury
Only in accordance with an order of a court outside Hong Kong
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(g) permits disclosure in accordance with an order of a court, magistrate or tribunal, or in accordance with a law of Hong Kong or a requirement imposed under a law of Hong Kong.

tc.q: 即使有第76B條的規定，指明人士可在何種法律強制下披露資料？
options: 按照法院、裁判官或審裁處的命令，或按照香港法律或香港法律下施加的規定
只限按照終審法院的命令
只限按照財經事務及庫務局局長的指示
只限按照香港以外法院的命令
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(g)條准許按照法院、裁判官或審裁處的命令，或按照香港法律或香港法律下施加的規定，而披露資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(a)條

en.q: On what condition may a relevant authority disclose information in the form of a summary?
options: The summary must be compiled so as to prevent particulars relating to the business or identity, or the trading particulars, of any person from being ascertained from it
The summary must first be approved by the Review Tribunal
The summary must be published simultaneously in the Gazette
The summary must be limited to information more than five years old
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(a) permits a relevant authority to disclose information in the form of a summary compiled from information in its possession, provided the summary is so compiled as to prevent particulars relating to the business or identity, or the trading particulars, of any person from being ascertained from it.

tc.q: 有關當局可在甚麼條件下以摘要形式披露資料？
options: 該摘要的編製方式須能防止從中確定任何人的業務或身分的詳情，或其交易詳情
該摘要須先經審裁處批准
該摘要須同時在憲報刊登
該摘要須只限於五年以上的資料
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(a)條准許有關當局以其管有的資料編製摘要形式披露資料，但該摘要的編製方式須能防止從中確定任何人的業務或身分的詳情，或其交易詳情。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(f)條

en.q: Where a relevant authority discloses information with consent, whose consent is required when the information relates to a person other than its source?
options: Both the person from whom the information was obtained and the person to whom the information relates
Only the person from whom the information was obtained
Only the person to whom the information relates
Neither — consent is not a permitted basis for disclosure
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(f) permits disclosure with the consent of the person from whom the information was obtained or received and, if the information relates to a different person, with the consent also of the person to whom the information relates.

tc.q: 有關當局在取得同意下披露資料時，如該資料關乎其來源以外的另一人，須取得何人的同意？
options: 取得該資料的來源人及該資料所關乎的人兩者的同意
只需取得該資料來源人的同意
只需取得該資料所關乎的人的同意
兩者皆不需——同意並非獲准許的披露依據
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(f)條准許在取得該資料的來源人的同意下披露；如該資料關乎另一人，亦須取得該資料所關乎的人的同意。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(h)條

en.q: Where information has been obtained by an authorized person under section 9 or an investigator under section 12, to whom may a relevant authority disclose it?
options: The Secretary for Justice, the Commissioner of Police, the Commissioner of the ICAC, or the Review Tribunal
Any government bureau or department without restriction
Only the Secretary for Justice
Any overseas regulator performing a similar function
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(h) permits disclosure of information obtained under section 9 or 12 to the Secretary for Justice, the Commissioner of Police, the Commissioner of the Independent Commission Against Corruption, or the Review Tribunal.

tc.q: 如資料是由獲授權人根據第9條或調查員根據第12條取得，有關當局可向何人披露？
options: 律政司司長、警務處處長、廉政專員或審裁處
任何政府決策局或部門，並無限制
只限律政司司長
任何執行類似職能的海外監管機構
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(h)條准許將根據第9或12條取得的資料，披露予律政司司長、警務處處長、廉政公署專員或審裁處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(i)條

en.q: What two conditions must an overseas authority satisfy before a relevant authority may disclose information to it under section 76D(1)(i)?
options: It must perform a function similar to that of a relevant authority or regulate relevant financial or professional services in its jurisdiction, and be subject to adequate secrecy provisions there
It must be a member of the FATF and have a mutual legal assistance treaty with Hong Kong
It must undertake in writing never to disclose the information onwards
It must be located in a jurisdiction that is not on any FATF monitoring list
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(i) requires the relevant authority to be of the opinion that the overseas authority or regulatory organization performs a similar function or regulates, supervises or investigates banking, securities, insurance, virtual asset activities or other financial, legal or accounting services in the recipient jurisdiction, and is subject to adequate secrecy provisions there.

tc.q: 海外當局須符合哪兩項條件，有關當局方可根據第76D(1)(i)條向其披露資料？
options: 須執行與有關當局類似的職能，或在其司法管轄區規管有關金融或專業服務；並須在當地受足夠的保密條文規限
須為財務行動特別組織成員，並與香港訂有司法互助協定
須書面承諾永不轉為披露該資料
須位於並非列於任何財務行動特別組織監察名單的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(i)條規定有關當局須認為該海外當局或監管組織在接收方司法管轄區執行類似職能，或規管、監督或調查銀行、證券、保險、涉及虛擬資產的活動或其他金融服務或法律或會計服務；並須在該司法管轄區受足夠的保密條文規限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(2)條

en.q: Before disclosing information to a listed office-holder or to an overseas authority, of what must a relevant authority be satisfied?
options: That disclosure is desirable or expedient, having regard to the public interest and the interest of the investing public, and the recipient's need for the information in performing their functions
That the recipient has paid the prescribed fee for the information
That the information is more than twelve months old
That the person to whom the information relates has been notified in advance
en.explain: Section 76D(2) permits disclosure under subsection (1)(g) or (i) only if the relevant authority is satisfied that it is desirable or expedient that the information should be disclosed, having regard to the public interest and the interest of the investing public, and the recipient's need for the information in performing the recipient's functions.

tc.q: 有關當局向列明的職位持有人或海外當局披露資料前，須信納甚麼？
options: 顧及公眾利益及投資大眾的利益，以及接收方執行職能對該資料的需要，該項披露屬合宜或適當
接收方已就該資料繳付訂明費用
該資料已存在超過十二個月
該資料所關乎的人已獲事先通知
tc.explain: 第76D(2)條訂明，有關當局只有在顧及公眾利益及投資大眾的利益，以及接收方執行其職能對該資料的需要後，信納披露該資料屬合宜或適當，方可根據第(1)(g)或(i)款作出披露。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(g)條

en.q: Which of the following appears in the list of persons to whom a relevant authority may disclose information under section 76D(1)(g)?
options: The Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data
The chairman of any licensed money service operator
Any Member of the Legislative Council
Any auditor engaged in private practice
en.explain: The section 76D(1)(g) list includes the Chief Executive, the Financial Secretary, the Secretary for Justice, the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, the Monetary Authority, the Insurance Authority, the SFC, the Commissioner, the Registrar, the Official Receiver, the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data, The Ombudsman, the ICAC Commissioner, the Law Society and the Estate Agents Authority, among others.

tc.q: 下列何者列於第76D(1)(g)條有關當局可向其披露資料的人的名單內？
options: 個人資料私隱專員
任何持牌金錢服務經營者的主席
任何立法會議員
任何私人執業的核數師
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(g)條的名單包括行政長官、財政司司長、律政司司長、財經事務及庫務局局長、金融管理專員、保險業監管局、證券及期貨事務監察委員會、海關關長、註冊處處長、破產管理署署長、個人資料私隱專員、申訴專員、廉政專員、律師會及地產代理監管局等。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(c)條

en.q: May a relevant authority disclose information to the Review Tribunal despite the confidentiality requirement?
options: Yes — section 76D(1)(c) expressly permits disclosure to the Review Tribunal
No — the Tribunal must obtain the information from the parties
Only with the consent of the person to whom the information relates
Only where the Tribunal issues a notice under section 61(1)(c)
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(c) expressly permits a relevant authority to disclose information to the Review Tribunal, and section 76D(1)(d) permits disclosure to the Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal. The Tribunal also has its own compulsory powers under section 61(1).

tc.q: 即使有保密規定，有關當局可否向審裁處披露資料？
options: 可以——第76D(1)(c)條明文准許向審裁處披露
不可以——審裁處須從各方取得資料
須取得該資料所關乎的人的同意方可
只限審裁處根據第61(1)(c)條發出通知的情況
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(c)條明文准許有關當局向審裁處披露資料，第76D(1)(d)條則准許向證券及期貨事務上訴審裁處披露。審裁處根據第61(1)條亦有其本身的強制權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(b)條

en.q: To which officer appointed under the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance may a relevant authority disclose information?
options: A liquidator
A provisional receiver of the Official Receiver's Office only
A company secretary
An inspector appointed by the Registrar of Companies
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(b) permits a relevant authority to disclose information to a liquidator appointed under the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap. 32). The Official Receiver appears separately in the section 76D(1)(g) list.

tc.q: 有關當局可向根據《公司（清盤及雜項條文）條例》委任的哪一名人員披露資料？
options: 清盤人
只限破產管理署的臨時接管人
公司秘書
公司註冊處處長委任的審查員
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(b)條准許有關當局向根據《公司（清盤及雜項條文）條例》（第32章）委任的清盤人披露資料。破產管理署署長則另見於第76D(1)(g)條的名單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76B(1)條

en.q: To which matters and documents does the confidentiality requirement in section 76B apply?
options: Matters coming to a specified person's knowledge by virtue of their appointment, or in performing or assisting in the performance of a function under the Ordinance, and records coming into their possession in those circumstances
Only matters marked confidential by the relevant authority
Only records relating to licensees currently under investigation
Only information obtained under a magistrate's warrant
en.explain: Section 76B(1) applies to a matter coming to a specified person's knowledge by virtue of their appointment under the Ordinance, in the course of performing a function under or carrying into effect a provision of the Ordinance, or in the course of assisting another person in doing so — and to records or documents coming into their possession in any of those circumstances.

tc.q: 第76B條的保密規定適用於哪些事宜及文件？
options: 指明人士因其獲委任，或在執行或協助他人執行本條例下職能的過程中知悉的事宜，以及在該等情況下管有的紀錄
只限有關當局標明為機密的事宜
只限關乎正受調查持牌人的紀錄
只限憑裁判官手令取得的資料
tc.explain: 第76B(1)條適用於指明人士憑其根據本條例獲委任、在執行本條例條文下的職能或使其生效的過程中，或在協助他人執行該等職能的過程中知悉的事宜；以及在上述任何情況下歸其管有的紀錄或文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(f)條

en.q: May a specified person disclose information in connection with judicial proceedings to which they are a party?
options: Yes — section 76C(1)(f) permits disclosure in connection with any judicial or other proceedings to which the specified person is a party
No — section 76B admits of no exception for proceedings
Only where the proceedings are criminal in nature
Only with the leave of the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(f) permits a specified person to disclose information in connection with any judicial or other proceedings to which the specified person is a party. This sits alongside the separate permission in section 76C(1)(g) for disclosure in accordance with a court order.

tc.q: 指明人士可否就其作為一方的司法法律程序披露資料？
options: 可以——第76C(1)(f)條准許就指明人士作為一方的任何司法或其他法律程序披露資料
不可以——第76B條並無就法律程序訂立例外
只限該等法律程序屬刑事性質的情況
須取得原訟法庭許可方可
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(f)條准許指明人士就其作為一方的任何司法或其他法律程序披露資料。此與第76C(1)(g)條另行准許按照法院命令披露的規定並行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(a)條

en.q: For which purposes connected with the Ordinance itself may a specified person disclose information?
options: In performing a function under the Ordinance, for the purpose of carrying into effect a provision of it, or for the purpose of doing anything required or authorized under it
Only when expressly directed to do so by the Commissioner
Only when the Review Tribunal has ordered disclosure
Only after the relevant investigation has been formally closed
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(a) permits disclosure in performing a function under the Ordinance, for the purpose of carrying into effect a provision of the Ordinance, or for the purpose of doing anything required or authorized under the Ordinance.

tc.q: 指明人士可為與本條例本身有關的哪些目的披露資料？
options: 執行本條例下的職能、為使本條例條文生效，或為作出本條例所規定或授權的任何事情
只限海關關長明確指示的情況
只限審裁處已命令披露的情況
只限有關調查已正式結束後
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(a)條准許為執行本條例下的職能、為使本條例的條文生效，或為作出本條例所規定或授權的任何事情而披露資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(1)(a)條

en.q: When must a licensee notify the Commissioner of its intention to cease operating a money service?
options: Before the date of cessation, in writing, stating that intention and the date of cessation
Within 7 days after the date of cessation
Within one month after the date of cessation
At least 45 days before the date of cessation
en.explain: Section 41(1)(a) requires the licensee, before the date of cessation, to notify the Commissioner in writing of that intention and the date of cessation. The separate 7-day period in section 41(1)(b) is for returning the licence, and runs from the date of cessation.

tc.q: 持牌人須於何時將其停止經營金錢服務的意向通知海關關長？
options: 於停止營業日期前以書面通知，述明該意向及停止營業日期
於停止營業日期後7日內
於停止營業日期後一個月內
於停止營業日期前至少45日
tc.explain: 第41(1)(a)條規定持牌人須於停止營業日期前，以書面將該意向及停止營業日期通知海關關長。第41(1)(b)條另訂的7日期間是就交回牌照而言，並自停止營業日期起計。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第40(1)條

en.q: From what date does the one-month period for notifying the Commissioner of a change in particulars run?
options: The date on which the change takes place
The date on which the licensee becomes aware of the change
The date on which the Commissioner requests an update
The date of the licensee's next licence renewal
en.explain: Section 40(1) requires the licensee to notify the Commissioner in writing of the change within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place — not the date of the licensee's awareness of it.

tc.q: 將詳情變更通知海關關長的一個月期間，自哪一日起計？
options: 該項變更發生之日
持牌人知悉該項變更之日
關長要求更新之日
持牌人下次牌照續期之日
tc.explain: 第40(1)條規定持牌人須自該項變更發生之日起計一個月內，以書面將該項變更通知海關關長——而非自持牌人知悉之日起計。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(a)條

en.q: Convictions under which other ordinances must the Commissioner have regard to when assessing fitness and propriety under section 30(4)(a)?
options: The UNATMO, the DTROP and the OSCO, in each case for the specified offences listed
The Companies Ordinance and the Bankruptcy Ordinance
The Banking Ordinance and the Insurance Ordinance
The Police Force Ordinance and the Magistrates Ordinance
en.explain: Section 30(4)(a) requires regard to be had to convictions for listed offences under the AMLO itself, section 14 of the UNATMO (Cap. 575), sections 25(1), 25A(5) or (7) of or offences specified in Schedule 1 to the DTROP (Cap. 405), and sections 25(1), 25A(5) or (7) of or offences in Schedules 1 or 2 to the OSCO (Cap. 455).

tc.q: 在根據第30(4)(a)條評估適當人選資格時，海關關長須顧及哪些其他條例下的定罪？
options: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》、《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》，並各就其所列明的指明罪行
《公司條例》及《破產條例》
《銀行業條例》及《保險業條例》
《警隊條例》及《裁判官條例》
tc.explain: 第30(4)(a)條規定須顧及就《打擊洗錢條例》本身所列罪行、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》（第575章）第14條、《販毒（追討得益）條例》（第405章）第25(1)、25A(5)或(7)條或其附表1所指明罪行，以及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》（第455章）第25(1)、25A(5)或(7)條或其附表1或2所列罪行的定罪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(1)條與第34(1)條的比較

en.q: A licensee breaches a licence condition, and separately its sole director ceases to be fit and proper. Which powers are engaged?
options: Section 43 disciplinary powers for the licence-condition breach, and section 34 revocation or suspension powers for the loss of fitness and propriety
Section 43 alone, since it covers both situations
Section 34 alone, since revocation absorbs the lesser sanctions
Section 21, because both are contraventions of specified provisions
en.explain: Section 43(1)(b) covers a contravention of a licence condition, engaging public reprimand, remedial orders and a pecuniary penalty of up to $1,000,000. Loss of fitness and propriety by a director engages the separate revocation or suspension powers in section 34(1)(a)(iii).

tc.q: 某持牌人違反牌照條件，而其唯一董事亦不再是適當人選。哪些權力會被觸發？
options: 就違反牌照條件觸發第43條的紀律權力；就喪失適當人選資格觸發第34條的撤銷或暫時吊銷權力
只觸發第43條，因其已涵蓋兩種情況
只觸發第34條，因撤銷已吸納較輕的制裁
觸發第21條，因兩者均屬違反指明條文
tc.explain: 第43(1)(b)條涵蓋違反牌照條件，可觸發公開譴責、糾正命令及最高1,000,000元的罰款。董事喪失適當人選資格則觸發第34(1)(a)(iii)條另設的撤銷或暫時吊銷權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第28(1)條

en.q: What may a person obtain from the Commissioner on payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3?
options: A certified or uncertified copy of the register or of an entry or extract, or a certificate as to whether a person's name has been entered on or removed from the register
A full list of every application refused in the preceding year
The reasons for any disciplinary decision taken against a licensee
A copy of any licensee's AML/CFT policy
en.explain: Section 28(1) allows any person, on payment of the Schedule 3 fee, to obtain a certified or uncertified copy of the register or of an entry in or extract from it, or a certificate by the Commissioner stating that a person's name has been entered on, removed from, or has not been entered on the register.

tc.q: 任何人繳付附表3訂明的費用後，可從海關關長取得甚麼？
options: 登記冊或其記項或摘錄的經核證或未經核證副本，或關長就某人姓名有否列入或從登記冊剔除而發出的證明書
上一年度所有被拒申請的完整名單
針對某持牌人所作任何紀律決定的理由
任何持牌人的打擊洗錢政策副本
tc.explain: 第28(1)條准許任何人在繳付附表3費用後，取得登記冊或其中記項或摘錄的經核證或未經核證副本，或海關關長發出述明某人姓名已列入登記冊、已從登記冊剔除或並未列入登記冊的證明書。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第28(2)條

en.q: What is the evidential status of a copy of the register purporting to be certified by the Commissioner?
options: It is admissible in criminal or civil proceedings on production without further proof, and is evidence of the facts stated in it
It is conclusive evidence of the facts stated in it
It is admissible only if the Commissioner attends to prove it
It is inadmissible unless accompanied by the original register
en.explain: Section 28(2) makes such a copy admissible in any criminal or civil proceedings on production without further proof, and evidence of the facts stated. Note the contrast with section 28(4), where a certificate by the Commissioner is conclusive evidence.

tc.q: 看來是由海關關長核證的登記冊副本，具有甚麼證據地位？
options: 在刑事或民事法律程序中一經出示即可獲接納而無須再加證明，並為其所述事實的證據
為其所述事實的確證
只有在海關關長出庭證明的情況下方可獲接納
除非附同登記冊正本，否則不獲接納
tc.explain: 第28(2)條訂明該等副本在任何刑事或民事法律程序中一經出示即可獲接納而無須再加證明，並為所述事實的證據。留意與第28(4)條的對比：關長發出的證明書屬確證。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(1)條

en.q: For what purpose may an authorized person exercise the routine inspection powers in section 9?
options: To ascertain whether an inspection subject is complying, has complied, or is likely to be able to comply with a prescribed requirement
Only to investigate a suspected offence already reported to the police
Only to verify the accuracy of the register maintained under section 27
Only to collect statistics on the money service sector
en.explain: Section 9(1) states the purpose as ascertaining whether a prescribed person is complying or has complied with, or is likely to be able to comply with, a prescribed requirement. The forward-looking limb allows supervision of prospective as well as past compliance.

tc.q: 獲授權人可為甚麼目的行使第9條的例行視察權力？
options: 確定視察對象是否正在遵從、是否已經遵從，或是否相當可能有能力遵從訂明規定
只為調查已向警方報告的懷疑罪行
只為核實根據第27條備存的登記冊的準確性
只為收集金錢服務業的統計數字
tc.explain: 第9(1)條訂明其目的為確定訂明人士是否正在遵從、是否已經遵從，或是否相當可能有能力遵從訂明規定。「相當可能有能力遵從」一項使監管可涵蓋前瞻性而非僅過往的合規情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第11(1)(a)及(b)條

en.q: On what grounds may a relevant authority direct or appoint an investigator under section 11 in relation to a financial institution?
options: Where it has reasonable cause to believe an offence under the Ordinance may have been committed, or has reason to inquire whether a specified provision or a section 43(1) provision has been contravened when considering its section 21 or 43 powers
Only where a licensee has failed to renew its licence
Only on the direction of the Secretary for Justice
Only where the Review Tribunal has remitted a matter for further inquiry
en.explain: Section 11(1)(a) covers reasonable cause to believe an offence under the Ordinance may have been committed. Section 11(1)(b) covers the position where, for the purpose of considering whether to exercise a power under section 21 or 43, the authority has reason to inquire whether a specified provision as defined by section 5(11), or a provision specified in section 43(1), has been contravened.

tc.q: 就金融機構而言，有關當局可基於甚麼理由根據第11條指示或委任調查員？
options: 有合理因由相信可能已犯本條例所訂罪行；或在考慮是否行使第21或43條的權力時，有理由查究是否已違反指明條文或第43(1)條所指明的條文
只限持牌人未有為牌照續期的情況
只限律政司司長指示的情況
只限審裁處將事宜發回作進一步查究的情況
tc.explain: 第11(1)(a)條涵蓋有合理因由相信可能已犯本條例所訂罪行的情況。第11(1)(b)條則涵蓋當局為考慮是否行使第21或43條的權力，而有理由查究是否已違反第5(11)條所界定的指明條文或第43(1)條所指明的條文的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第11(3)條

en.q: How may the costs of an investigator appointed with the Financial Secretary's consent, who is not a specified public officer, be met?
options: Out of moneys provided by the Legislative Council
Out of the licence fees paid under Schedule 3
By the person under investigation, in every case
Out of pecuniary penalties collected under section 21
en.explain: Section 11(3) provides that the costs and expenses incurred by an investigator who is appointed under section 11(1) with the consent of the Financial Secretary, and who is not a person specified in section 11(2), may be paid out of moneys provided by the Legislative Council.

tc.q: 經財政司司長同意而委任、並非指明公職人員的調查員，其費用可如何支付？
options: 由立法會撥款支付
由根據附表3繳付的牌照費用支付
在任何情況下均由受調查的人支付
由根據第21條收取的罰款支付
tc.explain: 第11(3)條訂明，根據第11(1)條經財政司司長同意而委任、並非第11(2)條所指明的人的調查員，其所招致的費用及開支可由立法會撥款支付。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)(b)(i)條

en.q: Where an application relates to operating a money service at particular premises, what must the Commissioner be satisfied about the premises themselves?
options: That they are suitable to be used for the operation of a money service
That they are owned outright by the applicant
That they are located in a commercial district
That they have a floor area of at least a prescribed minimum
en.explain: Section 30(3)(b)(i) requires the Commissioner to be satisfied that the premises are suitable to be used for the operation of a money service. The additional written-consent requirement in sub-paragraph (ii) applies only to domestic premises.

tc.q: 如申請關乎在特定處所經營金錢服務，海關關長須就該處所本身信納甚麼？
options: 該處所適合用作經營金錢服務
該處所由申請人完全擁有
該處所位於商業區
該處所的樓面面積達訂明的最低標準
tc.explain: 第30(3)(b)(i)條規定海關關長須信納該處所適合用作經營金錢服務。(ii)節的額外書面同意規定只適用於住宅處所。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(2)(b)條

en.q: For how long may the Commissioner suspend a licence under section 34?
options: For a period specified by the Commissioner, or until the occurrence of an event specified by the Commissioner
For a fixed maximum of six months in every case
Until the licensee's next renewal date
Indefinitely, with no requirement to specify an end point
en.explain: Section 34(2)(b) allows suspension for a period specified by the Commissioner or until the occurrence of an event specified by the Commissioner. Section 34(5)(b) requires the notice to state the duration and terms of the suspension.

tc.q: 海關關長根據第34條可將牌照暫時吊銷多久？
options: 關長所指明的期間，或直至關長所指明的事件發生為止
在任何情況下均以六個月為上限
直至該持牌人的下一個續期日
無限期，且無須指明終結時點
tc.explain: 第34(2)(b)條准許在關長所指明的期間內，或直至關長所指明的事件發生為止，暫時吊銷牌照。第34(5)(b)條規定通知須述明吊銷的期間及條款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第42(a)條

en.q: An individual licensee dies. What happens to the licence, and must the Commissioner act first?
options: The licence ceases to be valid on the death, without any act of the Commissioner being required
The licence remains valid until the estate is administered
The licence passes to the personal representative for the remainder of its term
The licence remains valid until the Commissioner revokes it under section 34
en.explain: Section 42(a) provides that a licence ceases to be valid, where the licensee is an individual, on the death of the individual. The provision operates automatically; no revocation under section 34 is needed.

tc.q: 某個人持牌人去世。牌照會怎樣？海關關長是否須先採取行動？
options: 牌照於去世時停止有效，無須關長作出任何行為
牌照維持有效直至遺產管理完成
牌照在餘下年期內轉予遺產代理人
牌照維持有效直至關長根據第34條撤銷為止
tc.explain: 第42(a)條訂明，如持牌人是個人，牌照於該個人去世時停止有效。該條文自動生效，無須根據第34條作出撤銷。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(10)條

en.q: What bars criminal proceedings under section 10 in respect of particular conduct?
options: Where proceedings have previously been instituted for the purposes of section 14(2)(b) in respect of the same conduct and remain pending, or bar further such proceedings
Where the person has already been disciplined by the relevant authority for the same conduct
Where more than twelve months have elapsed since the conduct
Where the person has made full disclosure to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 10(10) provides that no criminal proceedings may be instituted under the listed subsections in respect of conduct where proceedings have previously been instituted for the purposes of section 14(2)(b) — the contempt route — in respect of the same conduct, and those proceedings remain pending or bar further proceedings.

tc.q: 甚麼情況會阻止就某特定行為根據第10條提起刑事法律程序？
options: 先前已就同一行為為第14(2)(b)條的目的提起法律程序，而該程序仍待決或已阻止再次提起該等程序
該人已就同一行為被有關當局施加紀律處分
距該行為已逾十二個月
該人已向審裁處作出全面披露
tc.explain: 第10(10)條訂明，如先前已就同一行為為第14(2)(b)條的目的（即藐視法庭途徑）提起法律程序，而該程序仍待決或因先前提起該程序而不能再合法提起，則不得根據所列各款提起刑事法律程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第63(4)條

en.q: How does the AMLO prevent double punishment where conduct before the Tribunal could be both a section 61(2) offence and a contempt?
options: Section 63(4) bars the contempt route where section 61(2) proceedings have been instituted and remain pending, and bars section 61(2) proceedings where the contempt power has already been exercised
The Tribunal must always elect the contempt route in preference to prosecution
The Secretary for Justice decides which route is to be taken in every case
Both routes may be pursued simultaneously, with any penalties running concurrently
en.explain: Section 63(4) operates in both directions: no contempt power may be exercised where criminal proceedings under section 61(2) have previously been instituted in respect of the same conduct and remain pending or bar further prosecution, and no section 61(2) proceedings may be instituted where the contempt power has already been exercised in respect of the same conduct.

tc.q: 如審裁處席前的行為既可構成第61(2)條罪行亦可構成藐視行為，《打擊洗錢條例》如何防止雙重處罰？
options: 第63(4)條在已提起並仍待決第61(2)條法律程序時阻止藐視途徑；在已行使藐視權力時則阻止第61(2)條法律程序
審裁處必須一律選擇藐視途徑而非檢控
在任何情況下均由律政司司長決定採取哪一途徑
兩種途徑可同時進行，任何刑罰同期執行
tc.explain: 第63(4)條雙向運作：如先前已就同一行為根據第61(2)條提起刑事法律程序而該程序仍待決或已阻止再次檢控，則不得行使藐視權力；如已就同一行為行使藐視權力，則不得根據第61(2)條提起法律程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(2)(c)及(d)條

en.q: Which of the following conduct in relation to Tribunal proceedings is an offence under section 61(2)?
options: Leaving the place where attendance was required without the Tribunal's permission, and hindering or deterring another person from attending or giving evidence
Declining to answer a question on the ground of self-incrimination after making a claim under section 62
Appealing the Tribunal's determination to the Court of Appeal
Applying for a stay of execution under section 70
en.explain: Section 61(2)(c) and (d) make it an offence to leave the place where attendance was required without the Tribunal's permission, and to hinder or deter any person from attending, giving evidence or producing anything for the purposes of a review. Claiming the section 62 protection is a right, not an offence.

tc.q: 就審裁處的法律程序而言，下列哪種行為屬第61(2)條所訂罪行？
options: 未經審裁處准許而離開被規定出席的地方，以及阻礙或阻嚇他人出席或作證
在根據第62條提出聲稱後，以自我入罪為理由拒絕回答問題
就審裁處的裁定向上訴法庭提出上訴
根據第70條申請暫緩執行
tc.explain: 第61(2)(c)及(d)條將未經審裁處准許而離開被規定出席的地方，以及阻礙或阻嚇任何人為覆核目的出席、作證或交出任何東西，訂為罪行。援引第62條的保障是一項權利，並非罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(3)條

en.q: In relation to a licensed insurance broker company, licensed individual insurance agent or licensed insurance agency, Schedule 2 has effect only in relation to what?
options: Transactions involving a contract of insurance described in column 3 of Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the Insurance Ordinance
All insurance transactions of any kind
Only transactions with customers resident outside Hong Kong
Only transactions exceeding HK$120,000 in value
en.explain: Section 5(3) provides that Schedule 2 has effect with respect to a licensed individual insurance agent, licensed insurance agency or licensed insurance broker company only in relation to any transaction carried out by that agent, agency or company involving a contract of insurance described in column 3 of Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the Insurance Ordinance (Cap. 41).

tc.q: 就持牌保險經紀公司、持牌個人保險代理或持牌保險代理機構而言，附表2只就甚麼具有效力？
options: 涉及《保險業條例》附表1第2部第3欄所述保險合約的交易
任何種類的所有保險交易
只限與並非居於香港的客戶的交易
只限價值超過120,000港元的交易
tc.explain: 第5(3)條訂明，就持牌個人保險代理、持牌保險代理機構或持牌保險經紀公司而言，附表2只就該代理、代理機構或公司所進行、涉及《保險業條例》（第41章）附表1第2部第3欄所述保險合約的任何交易，具有效力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第7(2)條

en.q: What may a guideline published by the Monetary Authority, the SFC, the Insurance Authority or a regulatory body incorporate or refer to?
options: A guideline or document, or part of one, from time to time issued or published by that body under the relevant Ordinance
Only provisions of Schedule 2 reproduced verbatim
Only material approved in advance by the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury
Only guidance issued by the Financial Action Task Force
en.explain: Section 7(2) permits a guideline published by the Monetary Authority, Securities and Futures Commission, Insurance Authority or a regulatory body to incorporate or refer to a guideline or document, or any part of one, from time to time issued or published by that body under the relevant Ordinance.

tc.q: 由金融管理專員、證監會、保險業監管局或監管團體公布的指引，可載入或提述甚麼？
options: 該機構根據有關條例不時發出或公布的指引或文件，或其任何部分
只限逐字轉載的附表2條文
只限事先經財經事務及庫務局局長批准的材料
只限財務行動特別組織發出的指引
tc.explain: 第7(2)條准許由金融管理專員、證券及期貨事務監察委員會、保險業監管局或監管團體公布的指引，載入或提述該機構根據有關條例不時發出或公布的指引或文件，或其任何部分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第60(1)(b)條

en.q: Instead of substituting its own decision, what may the Tribunal do with a matter under section 60(1)(b)?
options: Remit the matter to the specified authority with any directions it considers appropriate
Refer the matter to the Court of First Instance for determination
Refer the matter to the Secretary for a policy decision
Adjourn the review indefinitely pending further evidence
en.explain: Section 60(1)(b) allows the Tribunal to determine a review by remitting the matter to the specified authority with any directions it considers appropriate — an alternative to confirming, varying, setting aside or substituting the decision under section 60(1)(a).

tc.q: 審裁處根據第60(1)(b)條，可如何處理事宜以代替以其本身決定取代？
options: 將事宜連同其認為適當的任何指示發回指明當局
將事宜轉交原訟法庭裁定
將事宜轉交局長作政策決定
無限期押後覆核以待進一步證據
tc.explain: 第60(1)(b)條准許審裁處藉將事宜連同其認為適當的任何指示發回指明當局，以裁定覆核——這是第60(1)(a)條確認、更改、撤銷或取代決定以外的另一選擇。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(5)條

en.q: When making inquiries under section 9(1A)(c), what may an authorized person require of the person concerned?
options: To give access to any specified business record and produce it within the time and at the place specified, and to answer any question raised for the purposes of that subsection
Only to answer questions orally, with no power to require records
Only to produce records, with no power to ask questions
To attend at the Customs and Excise Department within 24 hours
en.explain: Section 9(5) provides that, subject to section 9A, an authorized person exercising the inquiry power may require the person to give access to any specified business record and produce it within the time and at the place specified, and to answer any question raised for the purposes of that subsection.

tc.q: 獲授權人根據第9(1A)(c)條作出查詢時，可要求有關人士作出甚麼？
options: 讓其查閱任何指明業務紀錄並於指明時間及地點交出，以及回答為該款目的而提出的任何問題
只可要求口頭回答問題，無權要求提供紀錄
只可要求交出紀錄，無權提問
於24小時內到香港海關報到
tc.explain: 第9(5)條訂明，在第9A條的規限下，行使查詢權力的獲授權人可要求該人讓其查閱任何指明業務紀錄並於指明的時間及地點交出該紀錄，以及回答為該款目的而提出的任何問題。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(10)條

en.q: A person cannot answer an authorized person's question under section 9 because the information is not within their knowledge. What may be required?
options: That the person verify that fact and reason by statutory declaration within the time specified
That the person nominate a colleague who can answer
That the person cease trading until the information is located
Nothing further may be required in those circumstances
en.explain: Section 9(10) allows the authorized person to require in writing that the person verify, within the time specified, the fact that the information is not within their knowledge and the reason, by statutory declaration. Section 9(11) permits the declaration to be taken by the authorized person.

tc.q: 某人因有關資料並非其所知而無法回答獲授權人根據第9條提出的問題。可要求該人作出甚麼？
options: 於指明時間內以法定聲明核實該事實及理由
提名一名能回答的同事
在找到該資料前停止營業
在該等情況下不可再作任何要求
tc.explain: 第9(10)條准許獲授權人以書面要求該人於指明時間內，以法定聲明核實該資料並非其所知一事及其理由。第9(11)條准許該法定聲明由獲授權人監誓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第66(1)(b)條

en.q: Besides its determination and reasons, what else must the Tribunal deliver after completing a review?
options: Any order made under section 65 in relation to the review, together with the reasons for that order
A transcript of the entire hearing
A copy of every document received in evidence
A recommendation as to whether the specified authority should amend its guidelines
en.explain: Section 66(1)(b) requires the Tribunal to deliver, along with its determination and reasons, any order made under section 65 — the costs provision — in relation to the review and the reasons for that order.

tc.q: 除裁定及理由外，審裁處完成覆核後還須交付甚麼？
options: 就該覆核根據第65條作出的任何命令，連同該命令的理由
整個聆訊的謄本
收納為證據的每份文件的副本
就指明當局應否修訂其指引提出的建議
tc.explain: 第66(1)(b)條規定審裁處除交付其裁定及理由外，還須交付就該覆核根據第65條（訟費條文）作出的任何命令，連同該命令的理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第65(2)條

en.q: How are costs awarded by the Review Tribunal recovered?
options: As a civil debt, payable by the party the Tribunal considers appropriate or by the other party to the review
By execution against the licensee's business premises
By deduction from any pecuniary penalty already paid
They are not recoverable; payment is voluntary
en.explain: Section 65(2) provides that costs awarded under section 65(1) must be paid by, and are recoverable as a civil debt from, any party to the review that the Tribunal considers appropriate (where awarded to an attending person) or the other party to the review (where awarded to a party).

tc.q: 審裁處判給的訟費如何追討？
options: 作為民事債項，由審裁處認為適當的一方或覆核的另一方支付
以執行程序針對該持牌人的業務處所追討
從已繳付的任何罰款中扣除
不可追討；付款屬自願性質
tc.explain: 第65(2)條訂明，根據第65(1)條判給的訟費須由審裁處認為適當的覆核任何一方（如判給出席者）或覆核的另一方（如判給某一方）支付，並可作為民事債項追討。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(1)條

en.q: Who may lay the information on oath on which a magistrate issues a warrant under section 17?
options: An investigator, a person authorized under section 9(12), or an employee or staff member of a relevant authority
Only a police officer of the rank of inspector or above
Only the Commissioner of Customs and Excise personally
Only the Secretary for Justice
en.explain: Section 17(1) provides that the magistrate may issue the warrant if satisfied by information on oath laid by an investigator, a person authorized under section 9(12), or an employee or staff member of a relevant authority, that there are reasonable grounds to suspect the presence of records that may be required to be produced under Part 3.

tc.q: 裁判官根據第17條發出手令所憑藉的、經宣誓而作的告發，可由何人作出？
options: 調查員、根據第9(12)條獲授權的人，或有關當局的僱員或職員
只限督察級或以上的警務人員
只限海關關長本人
只限律政司司長
tc.explain: 第17(1)條訂明，裁判官如因調查員、根據第9(12)條獲授權的人，或有關當局的僱員或職員經宣誓而作的告發，信納有合理理由懷疑存有根據第3部可能須交出的紀錄，即可發出手令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(2)條

en.q: Of whom found on premises entered under a section 17 warrant may an authorized person require production of records?
options: A person the authorized person reasonably believes is employed in connection with a business carried on, or formerly carried on, on the premises
Any person present, whatever their connection with the premises
Only a director or partner of the business
Only a person who is himself under investigation
en.explain: Section 17(2) allows the authorized person, where there is reasonable cause to believe a person found on the premises is employed in connection with a business that is or has been carried on there, to require that person to produce for examination any record in their possession that may be required to be produced under Part 3.

tc.q: 獲授權人可要求在根據第17條手令進入的處所內發現的何人交出紀錄？
options: 獲授權人有合理理由相信是受僱與該處所現正或曾經經營的業務有關連的人
在場的任何人，不論其與該處所有何關連
只限該業務的董事或合夥人
只限本身正受調查的人
tc.explain: 第17(2)條准許獲授權人在有合理理由相信於處所內發現的人是受僱與該處所現正或曾經經營的業務有關連的情況下，要求該人交出其管有而根據第3部可能須交出的任何紀錄以供查驗。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(8)條

en.q: Which provision of the Criminal Procedure Ordinance applies to property coming into a relevant authority's possession under section 17?
options: Section 102, as it applies to property that has come into the possession of the police
Section 26, on time limits for prosecution
Section 65, on the admissibility of documents
Section 9, on the issue of warrants
en.explain: Section 17(8) provides that section 102 of the Criminal Procedure Ordinance (Cap. 221) applies to property that has by virtue of section 17 come into the possession of a relevant authority, as it applies to property that has come into the possession of the police.

tc.q: 憑藉第17條而歸有關當局管有的財產，適用《刑事訴訟程序條例》哪一條？
options: 第102條，一如其適用於歸警方管有的財產
第26條，關於檢控時限
第65條，關於文件的可接納性
第9條，關於發出手令
tc.explain: 第17(8)條訂明，《刑事訴訟程序條例》（第221章）第102條適用於憑藉第17條而歸有關當局管有的財產，一如其適用於歸警方管有的財產。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(1B)條

en.q: How does the section 9 inquiry power differ where the inspection subject is a licensed VAS provider rather than a licensed MSO?
options: Inquiries may also be made of an associated entity and of related corporations of the provider or of its associated entity
No inquiries may be made at all; only records may be inspected
A magistrate's warrant is required in every case
Only the Securities and Futures Commission may exercise the power
en.explain: Section 9(1B) extends the inquiry power, in the case of a licensed VAS provider or its associated entity, to inquiries of the provider, an associated entity, a related corporation of the provider, or a related corporation of an associated entity, as well as of information holders. Section 9(1A), which covers MSOs, is confined to the inspection subject and information holders.

tc.q: 如視察對象是持牌虛擬資產服務提供者而非持牌金錢服務經營者，第9條的查詢權力有何不同？
options: 亦可向該提供者的有聯繫實體，以及該提供者或其有聯繫實體的有關連法團作出查詢
完全不可作出查詢；只可視察紀錄
在任何情況下均須有裁判官手令
只有證券及期貨事務監察委員會方可行使該權力
tc.explain: 第9(1B)條就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者或其有聯繫實體，將查詢權力擴展至向該提供者、有聯繫實體、該提供者的有關連法團，或有聯繫實體的有關連法團，以及資料持有人作出查詢。涵蓋金錢服務經營者的第9(1A)條則限於視察對象及資料持有人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(2)(a)條

en.q: Which records may an investigator require a covered person to produce under section 12(2)(a)?
options: Records specified in the requirement that are or may be relevant to the investigation and are in the person's possession
Any record of any kind held by the person, whether relevant or not
Only records that the person created personally
Only records held in Hong Kong
en.explain: Section 12(2)(a) allows an investigator to require production, within the time and at the place specified, of any record or document specified in the requirement that is or may be relevant to the investigation and is in the person's possession.

tc.q: 調查員根據第12(2)(a)條可要求受涵蓋的人交出哪些紀錄？
options: 規定中所指明、與調查有關或可能有關，並且是該人管有的紀錄
該人持有的任何種類紀錄，不論是否相關
只限該人親自製備的紀錄
只限存放於香港的紀錄
tc.explain: 第12(2)(a)條准許調查員要求於指明時間及地點交出規定中所指明、與調查有關或可能有關，並且是該人管有的任何紀錄或文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第13(3)條

en.q: Which responses to an investigator's requirement are caught by the false-or-misleading offence in section 13(3)?
options: A record or document, or any answer, response, explanation or further particulars, that is false or misleading in a material particular
Only formal written statements signed by the person
Only records produced under section 12(2)(a)
Only answers given orally at an interview
en.explain: Section 13(3) covers the production of any record or document, or the giving of any answer, response, explanation or further particulars, that is false or misleading in a material particular, where the person knows that or is reckless as to whether it is so.

tc.q: 第13(3)條的虛假或誤導罪行，涵蓋對調查員規定的哪些回應？
options: 在要項上虛假或具誤導性的紀錄或文件，或任何答覆、回應、解釋或進一步詳情
只限該人簽署的正式書面陳述
只限根據第12(2)(a)條交出的紀錄
只限在會面中口頭作出的答覆
tc.explain: 第13(3)條涵蓋交出在要項上虛假或具誤導性的任何紀錄或文件，或作出該等答覆、回應、解釋或進一步詳情，而該人知道或罔顧其是否如此。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》時限比較

en.q: Which period applies to an application to the Review Tribunal for a review of a specified decision?
options: 21 days after the notice informing the person of the decision has been sent
30 days after the decision takes effect
45 days before the decision takes effect
One month beginning on the date of the decision
en.explain: Section 59(1) sets the review application period at 21 days after the notice has been sent. The 30-day period in sections 21(3) and 43(3) is for paying a pecuniary penalty; 45 days in section 31(2)(a) is for a renewal application; one month in section 40(1) is for notifying changes in particulars.

tc.q: 就指明決定向審裁處申請覆核，適用哪一期限？
options: 自告知該人該決定的通知發出後21日
自該決定生效後30日
於該決定生效前45日
自該決定日期起計一個月
tc.explain: 第59(1)條訂明覆核申請期為通知發出後21日。第21(3)及43(3)條的30日是繳付罰款期；第31(2)(a)條的45日是續期申請期；第40(1)條的一個月則是通知詳情變更的期限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》時限比較

en.q: A licensee is ordered to pay a pecuniary penalty under section 43. What is the default period for payment?
options: 30 days after the order has taken effect as a specified decision under section 75
21 days after the order is made
7 days after the notice is received
One month after the order is registered in the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 43(3) sets the default at 30 days, or any longer period the Commissioner may specify by notice under section 44(2), running from when the order takes effect as a specified decision under section 75. Section 21(3) applies the same default to relevant authorities' orders.

tc.q: 持牌人被命令根據第43條繳付罰款。預設繳付期為多久？
options: 自該命令根據第75條作為指明決定生效後30日
自該命令作出後21日
自接獲通知後7日
自該命令在原訟法庭登記後一個月
tc.explain: 第43(3)條訂明預設為30日，或海關關長根據第44(2)條以通知指明的任何較長期間；有關期間自該命令根據第75條作為指明決定生效時起計。第21(3)條就有關當局的命令訂有相同預設。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第29(1)條；第24條

en.q: A person's MSO licence was suspended last month, and they continue to operate the money service. What offence, if any, is committed?
options: An offence under section 29(1), because during suspension the person operates a money service without a valid licence
No offence, because a suspended licence is still a licence
An offence under section 39A only, for failing to display a valid licence
No offence, provided the suspension is under appeal to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 29(1) makes it an offence to operate a money service without a licence. A suspension under section 34(2)(b) deprives the operator of the authority the licence confers for the period specified, so continuing to operate falls within section 29(1); note also that under section 69(1) a review application is not itself a stay.

tc.q: 某人的金錢服務經營者牌照上月被暫時吊銷，而其仍繼續經營該金錢服務。該人觸犯甚麼罪行（如有）？
options: 第29(1)條所訂罪行，因在暫時吊銷期間，該人是在無有效牌照的情況下經營金錢服務
並無罪行，因被暫時吊銷的牌照仍屬牌照
只觸犯第39A條，即沒有展示有效牌照
並無罪行，只要該項暫時吊銷正向審裁處提出覆核
tc.explain: 第29(1)條將無牌經營金錢服務訂為罪行。根據第34(2)(b)條的暫時吊銷，在指明期間內剝奪了牌照所賦予的權限，故繼續經營即落入第29(1)條；另留意根據第69(1)條，覆核申請本身並不構成暫緩執行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第36(1)條；第24條

en.q: A shareholder increases their holding in a licensed corporation from 20% to 30% of the issued share capital. What does the AMLO require?
options: The licensee must apply for the Commissioner's approval before the person becomes an ultimate owner, since the holding now exceeds 25%
Nothing, because the person is not a director
Notification to the Commissioner within one month of the increase
Nothing, because approval is needed only above 50%
en.explain: Under section 24 an individual owning or controlling more than 25% of the issued share capital of a corporation is an ultimate owner. Section 36(1) prohibits a person from becoming an ultimate owner of a licensee unless the Commissioner has, on the licensee's application, given approval in writing beforehand.

tc.q: 某股東將其於持牌法團的持股量由已發行股本的20%增至30%。《打擊洗錢條例》有何規定？
options: 由於持股量現已超過25%，持牌人須在該人成為最終擁有人前申請海關關長批准
無須任何行動，因該人並非董事
須於增持後一個月內通知關長
無須任何行動，因超過50%方須批准
tc.explain: 根據第24條，擁有或控制法團超過25%已發行股本的個人即屬最終擁有人。第36(1)條禁止任何人成為持牌人的最終擁有人，除非海關關長已應持牌人的申請事先以書面給予批准。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38(1)條；第43(1)(c)條

en.q: A licensee licensed for one shop begins serving customers at a second shop without applying to add it. What are the two distinct consequences?
options: An offence under section 38(8), and a ground for disciplinary action against the licensee under section 43(1)(c)
An offence under section 29 only
Automatic revocation of the licence under section 42
A pecuniary penalty under section 21 of up to $10 million
en.explain: Section 38(1) prohibits operating at unadded premises; section 38(8) makes contravention an offence punishable by a fine at level 5 and 6 months' imprisonment. Section 43(1)(c) separately lists a contravention of section 38(1) as a ground for the Commissioner's disciplinary powers.

tc.q: 某持牌人獲發牌經營一間店舖，卻在第二間店舖開始為客戶提供服務而未有申請新增該處所。有哪兩項不同後果？
options: 構成第38(8)條所訂罪行，並構成第43(1)(c)條下針對持牌人採取紀律行動的理由
只構成第29條所訂罪行
牌照根據第42條自動被撤銷
須根據第21條繳付最高1,000萬元的罰款
tc.explain: 第38(1)條禁止在未加入牌照的處所經營；第38(8)條將違反訂為罪行，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。第43(1)(c)條則另行將違反第38(1)條列為海關關長行使紀律權力的理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(10)條；第69(1)條

en.q: A licensee's renewal is refused and it applies to the Review Tribunal. May it continue operating pending the review?
options: Not by reason of the application alone — section 69(1) provides that an application is not itself a stay, though a stay may be sought under section 69(2)
Yes — section 31(10) keeps the licence in force until the review is determined
Yes — a refusal never takes effect until every avenue of appeal is exhausted
No, and the Tribunal has no power to permit continued operation
en.explain: Section 31(10) keeps the licence in force only until the Commissioner's refusal decision takes effect. Under section 75(1)(c) the decision's effective date depends on the review, but section 69(1) makes clear that making the application is not itself a stay; a stay must be applied for under section 69(2).

tc.q: 某持牌人的續期申請被拒，並向審裁處提出覆核。在覆核期間可否繼續經營？
options: 不能僅憑該項申請——第69(1)條訂明申請本身並不構成暫緩執行，但可根據第69(2)條申請暫緩
可以——第31(10)條使牌照維持有效直至覆核有裁定
可以——拒絕決定在所有上訴途徑用盡前均不生效
不可以，而審裁處亦無權准許繼續經營
tc.explain: 第31(10)條只使牌照維持有效至海關關長的拒絕決定生效為止。根據第75(1)(c)條，該決定的生效時間取決於覆核；但第69(1)條明確訂明提出申請本身並不構成暫緩執行，須根據第69(2)條另行申請暫緩。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(9)條；第10(11)條

en.q: The section 5(9) defence is available to which persons charged under section 5(7)?
options: A person who is an employee of a financial institution or is employed to work for one
Any person concerned in the management of the institution, including directors
The financial institution itself
Any person, provided they did not personally benefit
en.explain: Section 5(9) makes the defence available in proceedings under section 5(7) against a person who is an employee of a financial institution or is employed to work for a financial institution. It does not extend on its terms to a person merely concerned in the management of the institution.

tc.q: 第5(9)條的免責辯護可供根據第5(7)條被控的哪些人援引？
options: 屬金融機構僱員或受僱為金融機構工作的人
參與該機構管理的任何人，包括董事
該金融機構本身
任何人，只要其本人並無得益
tc.explain: 第5(9)條訂明，該免責辯護可在針對屬金融機構僱員或受僱為金融機構工作的人而根據第5(7)條提起的法律程序中援引。按其字面，並不延伸至僅參與該機構管理的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第20(1)條

en.q: Which forms of interference with a record are caught by the section 20 offence?
options: Destroying, falsifying, concealing or otherwise disposing of it, and causing or permitting any of those things
Only physical destruction of the record
Only alteration of the record's contents
Only removal of the record from Hong Kong
en.explain: Section 20(1) covers destroying, falsifying, concealing or otherwise disposing of a record required to be produced under Part 3, and also causing or permitting its destruction, falsification, concealment or disposal, in each case with intent to conceal facts from the authorized person or investigator.

tc.q: 第20條的罪行涵蓋哪些干預紀錄的形式？
options: 銷毀、偽造、隱藏或以其他方式處置該紀錄，以及導致或准許上述任何行為
只限實際銷毀該紀錄
只限更改該紀錄的內容
只限將該紀錄移離香港
tc.explain: 第20(1)條涵蓋銷毀、偽造、隱藏或以其他方式處置根據第3部須交出的紀錄，亦涵蓋導致或准許該等銷毀、偽造、隱藏或處置；在各情況下均須具有向獲授權人或調查員隱瞞事實的意圖。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第18(1)條

en.q: Information required under Part 3 is recorded otherwise than in a legible form but can be reproduced legibly. What may be required?
options: Production of a reproduction of the recording, or the relevant part, in a legible form
Production of the original storage medium itself
A sworn statement that the information cannot be produced
Nothing, unless the information is already in writing
en.explain: Section 18(1) provides that any person empowered to require production of a record under Part 3 is also empowered to require production of a reproduction of the recording of the information, or the relevant part, in a legible form. Section 18(2) makes parallel provision for information held in an information system.

tc.q: 根據第3部須提供的資料以非可閱形式記錄，但可以可閱形式複製。可要求提供甚麼？
options: 以可閱形式交出該項記錄或其有關部分的複製本
交出原有的儲存媒體本身
作出宣誓陳述，聲明該資料無法提供
無可要求，除非該資料已屬書面形式
tc.explain: 第18(1)條訂明，任何根據第3部有權要求交出紀錄的人，亦有權要求以可閱形式交出該資料的記錄或其有關部分的複製本。第18(2)條就存放於資訊系統的資料訂有相應條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第19(2)條

en.q: When permitting inspection of a record it has taken possession of, what may an authorized person or investigator impose?
options: Any reasonable condition as to security or otherwise that the person thinks fit
A fee calculated by reference to Schedule 3
A requirement that the inspection take place at the Review Tribunal
A prohibition on the making of any copies
en.explain: Section 19(2) provides that a person who gives a permission under section 19(1) may impose any reasonable condition as to security or otherwise that the person thinks fit. Section 19(1) itself requires copies to be permitted, so a blanket ban on copying would be inconsistent with it.

tc.q: 獲授權人或調查員准許查閱其所管有的紀錄時，可施加甚麼？
options: 該人認為合適的任何合理的保安或其他條件
按附表3計算的費用
規定查閱須在審裁處進行
禁止製作任何副本
tc.explain: 第19(2)條訂明，根據第19(1)條給予准許的人，可施加其認為合適的任何合理的保安或其他條件。第19(1)條本身規定須准許製作副本，故全面禁止複製與之不符。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(1)(a)(i)條

en.q: Where the licensee is an individual, on what basis relating to the licensee personally may the Commissioner revoke or suspend the licence?
options: That the individual is no longer a fit and proper person to operate a money service
That the individual has changed their residential address
That the individual has ceased to be a Hong Kong resident
That the individual has been named in a suspicious transaction report
en.explain: Section 34(1)(a)(i)(A) makes the powers available where the Commissioner is of the opinion that an individual licensee is no longer a fit and proper person to operate a money service; sub-paragraph (B) covers the individual's ultimate owner ceasing to be fit and proper.

tc.q: 如持牌人是個人，海關關長可基於與該持牌人本人有關的甚麼理由撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照？
options: 該個人不再是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選
該個人已更改住址
該個人已不再是香港居民
該個人的姓名曾出現於某可疑交易報告
tc.explain: 第34(1)(a)(i)(A)條訂明，凡海關關長認為個人持牌人不再是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選，即可行使該等權力；(B)節則涵蓋該個人的最終擁有人不再是適當人選的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(2)(b)條

en.q: What form does a remedial order under section 43(2)(b) take?
options: An order that the licensee take, by a date specified by the Commissioner, any action specified by the Commissioner for the purpose of remedying the contravention
An order that the licensee suspend all operations until further notice
An order that the licensee compensate any customer affected
An order that the licensee appoint an independent monitor chosen by the Commissioner
en.explain: Section 43(2)(b) empowers the Commissioner to order the licensee to take, by a specified date, any action specified for the purpose of remedying the contravention. Failure to comply exposes the licensee to a daily penalty of up to $10,000 under section 43(4).

tc.q: 第43(2)(b)條下的糾正命令採取甚麼形式？
options: 命令持牌人於海關關長指明的日期前，採取關長為糾正該項違反而指明的任何行動
命令持牌人暫停一切運作直至另行通知
命令持牌人賠償任何受影響的客戶
命令持牌人委任由關長選定的獨立監察人
tc.explain: 第43(2)(b)條授權海關關長命令持牌人於指明日期前，採取為糾正該項違反而指明的任何行動。不遵從者，持牌人須承受第43(4)條下最高每日10,000元的罰款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(5)條

en.q: What may an authorized officer do if a person forcibly resists or attempts to evade arrest under section 48?
options: Use any force that is reasonably necessary to effect the arrest or detention
Use any force whatsoever, without limitation
Call the police and take no further action personally
Detain the person for up to 72 hours as a penalty
en.explain: Section 48(5) provides that if a person forcibly resists or attempts to evade arrest or detention under that section, the authorized officer may use any force that is reasonably necessary to effect the arrest or detention. The 48-hour limit in section 48(4) remains.

tc.q: 如某人強行抗拒或企圖逃避根據第48條的拘捕，獲授權人員可怎樣做？
options: 使用合理需要的武力以進行該項拘捕或扣留
使用任何武力，並無限制
報警並不再親自採取行動
將該人扣留最多72小時以作懲罰
tc.explain: 第48(5)條訂明，如某人強行抗拒或企圖逃避該條下的拘捕或扣留，獲授權人員可使用合理需要的武力以進行該項拘捕或扣留。第48(4)條的48小時限制仍然適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(2)(e)及(f)條

en.q: Records found on premises entered under a section 47 warrant are held in an information system. Whom may the authorized officer require to produce a legible reproduction?
options: A person who appears to be in charge of the premises, or who appears able to produce a reproduction of the recording
Only a director of the business concerned
Only an information technology contractor engaged by the business
No one — the officer must seize the system itself
en.explain: Section 47(2)(f) allows the officer to require a person who appears to be in charge of the premises, or who appears to be or to be likely to be able to produce a reproduction, to produce it in a form enabling the information to be reproduced in a legible form. Section 47(2)(e) makes parallel provision for information not in legible form.

tc.q: 在根據第47條手令進入的處所內發現的紀錄存放於資訊系統。獲授權人員可要求何人交出可閱形式的複製本？
options: 看來是掌管該處所的人，或看來能製作該項記錄複製本的人
只限有關業務的董事
只限該業務聘用的資訊科技承辦商
不可要求任何人——人員須檢取該系統本身
tc.explain: 第47(2)(f)條准許人員要求看來是掌管該處所的人，或看來能或相當可能能製作複製本的人，以能使該資料以可閱形式複製的形式交出該複製本。第47(2)(e)條就非可閱形式的資料訂有相應條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(1)條

en.q: What is the basic effect of section 5(1) of the AMLO?
options: Schedule 2 has effect with respect to financial institutions, subject to the qualifications in subsections (2), (3) and (4)
Schedule 2 has effect with respect to every person carrying on business in Hong Kong
Schedule 1 has effect with respect to financial institutions
Schedule 3 has effect with respect to financial institutions
en.explain: Section 5(1) provides that, subject to subsections (2), (3) and (4), Schedule 2 has effect with respect to financial institutions. Section 5A then makes separate provision for the application of Schedule 2 to DNFBPs.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(1)條的基本效力為何？
options: 在第(2)、(3)及(4)款的限制下，附表2就金融機構具有效力
附表2就在香港經營業務的每一個人具有效力
附表1就金融機構具有效力
附表3就金融機構具有效力
tc.explain: 第5(1)條訂明，在第(2)、(3)及(4)款的規限下，附表2就金融機構具有效力。第5A條則就附表2適用於指定非金融企業及行業另作規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第1(1)條

en.q: What is the full short title of Cap. 615, as amended in 2018?
options: The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance
The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Financial Institutions) Ordinance
The Money Service Operators Licensing Ordinance
The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Ordinance
en.explain: Section 1(1) provides that the Ordinance may be cited as the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, the words “(Financial Institutions)” having been removed by amendment in 2018 when the regime was extended to DNFBPs.

tc.q: 第615章經2018年修訂後的完整簡稱為何？
options: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》
《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集（金融機構）條例》
《金錢服務經營者發牌條例》
《打擊洗錢及打擊恐怖主義融資條例》
tc.explain: 第1(1)條訂明本條例可引稱為《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》；「（金融機構）」等字已於2018年制度擴展至指定非金融企業及行業時經修訂刪去。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(12)及(13)條

en.q: How is an authorized person for the purposes of section 9 appointed, and what must follow?
options: A relevant authority authorizes in writing any person, or any person belonging to a class of persons, and must provide the authorized person with a copy of the authorization
A magistrate issues a warrant of appointment valid for one year
The Secretary appoints them by notice in the Gazette
They are appointed by the Chief Executive on the Commissioner's recommendation
en.explain: Section 9(12) allows a relevant authority to authorize in writing any person, or any person belonging to a class of persons, as an authorized person for the purposes of section 9. Section 9(13) requires the authority to provide a copy of the authorization, and section 9(14) requires its production when powers are exercised.

tc.q: 就第9條而言，獲授權人如何獲委任？其後須怎樣做？
options: 由有關當局以書面授權任何人或屬某類別的任何人，並須向該獲授權人提供授權書副本
由裁判官發出有效期一年的委任手令
由局長以憲報公告委任
由行政長官按海關關長推薦而委任
tc.explain: 第9(12)條准許有關當局以書面授權任何人或屬某類別的任何人，就第9條而言為獲授權人。第9(13)條規定當局須提供授權書副本，第9(14)條則規定行使權力時須出示該副本。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75(1)(c)條

en.q: A person applies for a review within 21 days and the Tribunal confirms the decision. When does the specified decision take effect?
options: At the time the decision is so confirmed
At the expiry of the original 21-day period
On the date the application for review was lodged
Only after any appeal to the Court of Appeal is determined
en.explain: Section 75(1)(c)(i) provides that where a review is applied for within the 21-day period and the decision is confirmed by the Tribunal, the decision takes effect at the time it is so confirmed. Sub-paragraphs (ii) and (iii) deal with variation or substitution and with withdrawal of the application.

tc.q: 某人於21日內申請覆核，而審裁處確認該決定。該指明決定何時生效？
options: 於該決定獲如此確認時
於原本的21日期間屆滿時
於覆核申請提交之日
須待任何向上訴法庭的上訴有裁定後
tc.explain: 第75(1)(c)(i)條訂明，凡在21日期間內申請覆核而該決定獲審裁處確認，該決定於獲如此確認時生效。(ii)及(iii)節則分別處理更改或取代，以及撤回申請的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75(1)(c)(iii)條

en.q: A person applies for a review and then withdraws the application. When does the specified decision take effect?
options: At the time the application is withdrawn
At the expiry of the original 21-day period
Retrospectively, from the date the decision was made
Only if the specified authority issues a fresh notice
en.explain: Section 75(1)(c)(iii) provides that where the person applies for a review within the 21-day period and the application is withdrawn, the decision takes effect at the time the application is withdrawn.

tc.q: 某人申請覆核後撤回申請。該指明決定何時生效？
options: 於該申請被撤回時
於原本的21日期間屆滿時
追溯至該決定作出之日
須待指明當局重新發出通知
tc.explain: 第75(1)(c)(iii)條訂明，凡該人在21日期間內申請覆核而該申請被撤回，該決定於該申請被撤回時生效。

en.q: What must accompany an application for the Commissioner's approval of a proposed director, ultimate owner or partner?
options: The fee specified in Schedule 3, with the application made in the form and manner specified by the Commissioner
A sworn declaration by the proposed appointee as to their financial position
A police certificate of no criminal conviction for the proposed appointee
A resolution of the licensee's shareholders approving the appointment
en.explain: Sections 35(2), 36(2) and 37(2) each require the application to be made in the form and manner specified by the Commissioner and to be accompanied by the fee specified in Schedule 3.

tc.q: 就擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人向海關關長申請批准時，須連同甚麼一併提交？
options: 附表3訂明的費用，並須按關長指明的格式及方式提出申請
擬任者就其財政狀況作出的宣誓聲明
擬任者的警方無犯罪紀錄證明書
持牌人股東批准該項委任的決議
tc.explain: 第35(2)、36(2)及37(2)條均規定申請須按海關關長指明的格式及方式提出，並須連同附表3訂明的費用一併提交。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第35(5)及(6)條

en.q: If the Commissioner refuses approval of a proposed director, whom must the Commissioner inform, and what must the notice contain?
options: The licensee, by notice in writing containing the reasons and a statement that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal
The proposed director personally, by notice stating only the outcome
Both the licensee and the Companies Registry, by notice in the Gazette
No one — a refusal takes effect without notice
en.explain: Section 35(5) requires the Commissioner to inform the licensee by notice in writing, and section 35(6) requires that notice to include a statement of the reasons for the decision and a statement that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review. Sections 36 and 37 mirror this.

tc.q: 如海關關長拒絕批准擬任董事，須通知何人？通知須載有甚麼？
options: 以書面通知持牌人，並須載有理由及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核的陳述
以只述明結果的通知，親自通知該名擬任董事
以憲報公告通知持牌人及公司註冊處
無須通知任何人——拒絕無須通知即生效
tc.explain: 第35(5)條規定海關關長須以書面通知告知持牌人；第35(6)條規定該通知須載有決定理由的陳述，以及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核的陳述。第36及37條訂有相同規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(i)條

en.q: On what basis may the Tribunal stay proceedings in a review?
options: On any grounds and on any terms and conditions it considers appropriate, having regard to the interests of justice
Only where a party is awaiting the outcome of criminal proceedings
Only with the consent of both parties to the review
The Tribunal has no power to stay its own proceedings
en.explain: Section 61(1)(i) allows the Tribunal to stay any of the proceedings in the review on any grounds and on any terms and conditions that it considers appropriate having regard to the interests of justice. This is distinct from a stay of execution of a decision under section 69 or of a determination under section 70.

tc.q: 審裁處可基於甚麼理由擱置覆核中的法律程序？
options: 顧及司法公正的利益，基於其認為適當的任何理由及任何條款及條件
只限一方正等候刑事法律程序結果的情況
只限覆核雙方同意的情況
審裁處無權擱置其本身的法律程序
tc.explain: 第61(1)(i)條准許審裁處顧及司法公正的利益，基於其認為適當的任何理由及任何條款及條件，擱置覆核中的任何法律程序。這有別於第69條下暫緩執行決定，或第70條下暫緩執行裁定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(5)及(6)條

en.q: What distinguishes the offences in sections 10(5) and 10(6) from those in sections 10(1) and 10(3)?
options: Sections 10(5) and (6) require an intent to defraud and attract the higher 7-year maximum, whereas sections 10(1) and (3) do not require that intent
Sections 10(5) and (6) apply only to corporations
Sections 10(5) and (6) are triable only summarily
Sections 10(1) and (3) require an intent to defraud, and sections 10(5) and (6) do not
en.explain: Section 10(1) covers failure to comply without reasonable excuse, and section 10(3) covers knowingly or recklessly producing false material. Sections 10(5) and (6) cover the same conduct committed with intent to defraud, and by section 10(9) carry a maximum of $1,000,000 and 7 years on indictment.

tc.q: 第10(5)及10(6)條的罪行與第10(1)及10(3)條的罪行有何分別？
options: 第10(5)及(6)條須具有欺騙意圖，最高刑期為7年；第10(1)及(3)條則不須具備該意圖
第10(5)及(6)條只適用於法團
第10(5)及(6)條只可循簡易程序審訊
第10(1)及(3)條須具有欺騙意圖，第10(5)及(6)條則不須
tc.explain: 第10(1)條涵蓋無合理辯解而不遵從規定，第10(3)條涵蓋在知情或罔顧下提供虛假材料。第10(5)及(6)條涵蓋具有欺騙意圖而作出的同樣行為，並根據第10(9)條循公訴程序定罪最高可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(7)及(8)條

en.q: Sections 10(7) and 10(8) create offences for a related person. What conduct do they target?
options: Causing or allowing, with intent to defraud, an obligated person to fail to comply with a section 9 requirement or to produce false material
Failing personally to answer a question put by an authorized person
Advising an obligated person to seek legal advice before responding
Attending an inspection without the authorized person's permission
en.explain: Sections 10(7) and (8) apply where a related person — an employee of, employed to work for, or concerned in the management of the obligated person under section 10(11) — with intent to defraud causes or allows the obligated person to fail to comply with a requirement, or to produce a false or misleading record or answer.

tc.q: 第10(7)及10(8)條就有關連的人訂立罪行。所針對的是甚麼行為？
options: 意圖欺騙而導致或容許有責任的人不遵從第9條規定，或提供虛假材料
本人沒有回答獲授權人所提出的問題
建議有責任的人在回應前尋求法律意見
未經獲授權人准許而出席視察
tc.explain: 第10(7)及(8)條適用於有關連的人（即第10(11)條所指屬有責任的人的僱員、受僱為其工作或參與其管理的人）意圖欺騙而導致或容許該有責任的人不遵從規定，或交出虛假或具誤導性的紀錄或答覆的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第13(7)及(8)條

en.q: Do the “related person” offences also apply to requirements imposed by an investigator under section 12?
options: Yes — sections 13(7) and (8) mirror sections 10(7) and (8) in relation to section 12 requirements
No — related-person liability applies only to section 9 requirements
Yes, but only where the related person is a director
No — section 12 requirements bind only the covered person named in them
en.explain: Sections 13(7) and (8) create the equivalent related-person offences in relation to requirements imposed under section 12, and section 13(9) applies the same $1,000,000 and 7-year maximum on indictment as section 10(9) does for section 9.

tc.q: 「有關連的人」罪行是否亦適用於調查員根據第12條施加的規定？
options: 適用——第13(7)及(8)條就第12條的規定，與第10(7)及(8)條相對應
不適用——有關連的人的法律責任只適用於第9條的規定
適用，但只限該有關連的人是董事的情況
不適用——第12條的規定只約束其中列名的受涵蓋的人
tc.explain: 第13(7)及(8)條就第12條下施加的規定訂立相對應的有關連的人罪行；第13(9)條並適用與第10(9)條就第9條所訂相同的循公訴程序最高罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)(a)(ii)條

en.q: Where the applicant for a licence is a partnership, whose fitness and propriety must the Commissioner be satisfied of?
options: Each partner in the partnership, and the ultimate owner if there is one
The managing partner alone, and the ultimate owner
Any two partners nominated by the partnership
The partnership as an entity, rather than individual partners
en.explain: Section 30(3)(a)(ii) requires the Commissioner to be satisfied that each partner in the partnership is a fit and proper person to operate a money service, and that any ultimate owner in relation to the partnership is a fit and proper person to be associated with the business.

tc.q: 如牌照申請人是合夥，海關關長須信納何人的適當人選資格？
options: 該合夥的每名合夥人，以及最終擁有人（如有）
只限管理合夥人，以及最終擁有人
由該合夥提名的任何兩名合夥人
該合夥作為實體，而非個別合夥人
tc.explain: 第30(3)(a)(ii)條規定海關關長須信納該合夥的每名合夥人是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選，而該合夥的任何最終擁有人是適合與該業務有聯繫的適當人選。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(1)(b)(i)條

en.q: An occupant of domestic premises who had consented to entry by an authorized person later revokes that consent. What may follow?
options: The Commissioner may revoke or suspend the licence under section 34(2)
The consent is treated as irrevocable for the life of the licence
The occupant commits an offence under section 47(4)
The Commissioner must apply to a magistrate for a warrant instead
en.explain: Section 34(1)(b)(i) makes the section 34(2) revocation and suspension powers available where any occupant of domestic premises revokes written consent previously given for an authorized person as defined by section 8 to enter for the purpose of exercising the powers under section 9.

tc.q: 曾同意獲授權人進入的住宅處所佔用人其後撤回該同意。可能有甚麼後果？
options: 海關關長可根據第34(2)條撤銷或暫時吊銷該牌照
該同意視為在牌照有效期內不可撤回
該佔用人觸犯第47(4)條所訂罪行
關長須改為向裁判官申請手令
tc.explain: 第34(1)(b)(i)條訂明，凡住宅處所的任何佔用人撤回其先前給予、讓第8條所界定的獲授權人為行使第9條權力而進入處所的書面同意，海關關長即可行使第34(2)條的撤銷及暫時吊銷權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第39A(1)條

en.q: Which licensees are subject to the duty to display the original of the licence, and where must it be displayed?
options: Licensees licensed to operate at premises specified in the licence, in a conspicuous place at those specified premises
All licensees, at their correspondence address
All licensees, at the office of the Commissioner
Only licensees operating at more than one premises, at their principal premises
en.explain: Section 39A(1) applies to a licensee licensed to operate a money service at premises specified in the licence, and requires the original of the licence to be displayed in a conspicuous place at the specified premises. A licensee with no specified premises is not caught by the duty.

tc.q: 哪些持牌人須履行展示牌照正本的責任？須展示於何處？
options: 獲發牌在牌照指明處所經營的持牌人，須展示於該等指明處所的顯眼位置
所有持牌人，須展示於其通訊地址
所有持牌人，須展示於海關關長的辦事處
只限在多於一個處所經營的持牌人，須展示於其主要處所
tc.explain: 第39A(1)條適用於獲發牌在牌照指明處所經營金錢服務的持牌人，並規定須在該等指明處所的顯眼位置展示牌照正本。並無指明處所的持牌人不受該項責任約束。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(2)(b)條

en.q: When a licence is returned on cessation of business, what must the Commissioner do to the register?
options: Remove the relevant particulars from the register
Mark the entry as dormant but retain it indefinitely
Transfer the entry to a separate register of former licensees
Leave the register unchanged until the licence would have expired
en.explain: Section 41(2) requires the Commissioner, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving the returned licence, to cancel or amend the licence and to remove the relevant particulars from the register. Sections 38(7) and 39(7) deal with additions and amendments to the register when premises are added.

tc.q: 因停止營業而交回牌照時，海關關長須對登記冊作出甚麼處理？
options: 從登記冊剔除有關詳情
將該記項標示為不活躍但無限期保留
將該記項轉移至前持牌人的另一登記冊
在牌照本應屆滿前保持登記冊不變
tc.explain: 第41(2)條規定海關關長須在接獲交回的牌照後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快註銷或修訂該牌照，並從登記冊剔除有關詳情。第38(7)及39(7)條則處理新增處所時登記冊的加入及修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第14(3)條

en.q: In what form must an originating summons under section 14(1) be issued?
options: Form No. 10 in Appendix A to the Rules of the High Court
Form No. 1 in Appendix B to the Rules of the District Court
A form specified by the Commissioner under section 30(1)
A form prescribed by the Chief Justice under section 76
en.explain: Section 14(3) provides that an originating summons under section 14(1) is to be in Form No. 10 in Appendix A to the Rules of the High Court (Cap. 4 sub. leg. A).

tc.q: 根據第14(1)條發出的原訟傳票須採用甚麼格式？
options: 《高等法院規則》附錄A的第10號表格
《區域法院規則》附錄B的第1號表格
海關關長根據第30(1)條指明的格式
終審法院首席法官根據第76條訂明的格式
tc.explain: 第14(3)條訂明，根據第14(1)條發出的原訟傳票須採用《高等法院規則》（第4章，附屬法例A）附錄A的第10號表格。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第15(1)條

en.q: Before requiring an answer or explanation under section 12(2) or (3), what must an investigator ensure?
options: That the person has first been informed or reminded of the limitations imposed by section 15(2) on the admissibility of the requirement, question and answer
That the person has been given the opportunity to consult a solicitor
That a magistrate has authorised the questioning
That the person has been cautioned in the same terms as a police caution
en.explain: Section 15(1) requires the investigator to ensure that the person has first been informed or reminded of the limitations imposed by section 15(2) on the admissibility in evidence of the requirement and of the question and answer, or the explanation or further particulars.

tc.q: 調查員根據第12(2)或(3)條要求作出答覆或解釋前，須確保甚麼？
options: 該人已事先獲告知或獲提醒第15(2)條就該規定、問題及答覆的可接納性所施加的限制
該人已獲給予諮詢律師的機會
裁判官已授權該項訊問
已按警誡辭的相同措辭向該人作出警誡
tc.explain: 第15(1)條規定調查員須確保該人已事先獲告知或獲提醒第15(2)條就該規定、問題及答覆，或該解釋或進一步詳情的證據可接納性所施加的限制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(7)條

en.q: When may an authorized person require an information holder, rather than the inspection subject, to produce a specified business record?
options: Only where the authorized person has reasonable cause to believe the record or information cannot be obtained from the inspection subject
At any time, provided the information holder is given 7 days' notice
Only where the inspection subject has refused to co-operate in writing
Only with the prior approval of a magistrate
en.explain: Section 9(7) provides that the power under section 9(3)(b) may be exercised only if the authorized person has reasonable cause to believe that the specified business record or the information sought cannot be obtained by exercising the power under section 9(3)(a) against the inspection subject.

tc.q: 獲授權人在甚麼情況下可要求資料持有人（而非視察對象）交出指明業務紀錄？
options: 只限獲授權人有合理因由相信該紀錄或所尋求的資料無法從視察對象取得
任何時間均可，只要向該資料持有人發出7日通知
只限視察對象已書面拒絕合作的情況
只限事先取得裁判官批准的情況
tc.explain: 第9(7)條訂明，只有在獲授權人有合理因由相信該指明業務紀錄或所尋求的資料，無法藉對視察對象行使第9(3)(a)條的權力而取得時，方可行使第9(3)(b)條的權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第32(2)及(3)條

en.q: When the Commissioner amends a licence condition under section 32, what must the notice to the licensee include?
options: A statement of the reasons for the decision and a statement that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review
The date on which the previous condition was first imposed
A copy of the guidelines published under section 45
An estimate of the cost of compliance with the amended condition
en.explain: Section 32(2) requires the Commissioner to inform the licensee by notice in writing, and section 32(3) requires that notice to include a statement of the reasons for the decision and a statement that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review of the decision.

tc.q: 海關關長根據第32條修訂牌照條件時，致持牌人的通知須載有甚麼？
options: 決定理由的陳述，以及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核該決定的陳述
先前條件首次施加的日期
根據第45條公布的指引副本
遵從經修訂條件的估計費用
tc.explain: 第32(2)條規定海關關長須以書面通知告知持牌人；第32(3)條規定該通知須載有決定理由的陳述，以及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核該決定的陳述。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第29(1)條；第53條

en.q: The Commissioner discovers in March 2026 that a person operated an unlicensed money service in 2023 and was dealt with summarily. Within what period may proceedings be instituted?
options: Within 12 months after the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner
Within 12 months after the offence was committed
Within 6 months after the offence is discovered
No proceedings may be brought, as more than two years have elapsed
en.explain: Section 53 provides that, despite section 26 of the Magistrates Ordinance, proceedings for an offence under Part 5 other than an indictable offence may be instituted within 12 months after the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner — so the clock runs from discovery, not commission.

tc.q: 海關關長於2026年3月發現某人曾於2023年無牌經營金錢服務，並以簡易程序處理。可於甚麼期限內提起法律程序？
options: 自該罪行由關長發現或引起關長注意後12個月內
自該罪行發生後12個月內
自該罪行被發現後6個月內
不可提起法律程序，因已逾兩年
tc.explain: 第53條訂明，即使《裁判官條例》第26條另有規定，就第5部下並非可公訴罪行的罪行提起的法律程序，可在該罪行由海關關長發現或引起關長注意後12個月內提起——故計時起點為發現之時，而非犯罪之時。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2及3部

en.q: Which parts of Schedule 2 to the AMLO contain the customer due diligence and record-keeping requirements respectively?
options: Part 2 contains the CDD requirements; Part 3 contains the record-keeping requirements
Part 1 contains CDD; Part 2 contains record-keeping
Part 3 contains CDD; Part 4 contains record-keeping
Both are in Schedule 1
en.explain: Schedule 2 is the core operational schedule: Part 1 is interpretation, Part 2 sets out the CDD requirements and Part 3 the record-keeping requirements. Section 23 of Schedule 2 requires safeguards to prevent contraventions of Parts 2 and 3.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2哪些部分分別載有客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄的規定？
options: 第2部載有盡職審查規定；第3部載有備存紀錄規定
第1部載有盡職審查；第2部載有備存紀錄
第3部載有盡職審查；第4部載有備存紀錄
兩者均載於附表1
tc.explain: 附表2是核心運作附表：第1部為釋義，第2部載列客戶盡職審查規定，第3部載列備存紀錄規定。附表2第23條規定須設保障措施，防止違反第2及3部的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條

en.q: Where in the AMLO are the statutory definitions of “money laundering” and “terrorist financing” found?
options: Section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1
Section 1 of Schedule 2
Part 5 of the main body
Schedule 3
en.explain: The definitions of ML and TF (and of money service, money changing service and remittance service) are in Schedule 1, Part 1. Schedule 2 carries the CDD/record-keeping regime and its own interpretation section; Schedule 3 lists fees.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》中「洗錢」及「恐怖分子資金籌集」的法定定義載於何處？
options: 附表1第1部第1條
附表2第1條
主體條文第5部
附表3
tc.explain: 「洗錢」及「恐怖分子資金籌集」的定義（以及金錢服務、貨幣兌換服務及匯款服務的定義）載於附表1第1部。附表2載有盡職審查／備存紀錄制度及其本身的釋義條文；附表3則列明費用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3（經修訂，2026年5月15日生效）

en.q: Schedule 3 to the AMLO sets out what?
options: The fees payable for MSO licence applications and related matters — e.g. $3,810 for a licence grant application (from 15 May 2026)
The list of countries subject to sanctions
The seven modules of the Competence Assessment
The maximum penalties for money laundering offences
en.explain: Schedule 3 prescribes the fees for licensing matters: e.g. grant of licence $3,810 (plus $2,440 per additional business premises and $945 per person subject to the fit-and-proper test), renewal $910, and $945 per person for director/ultimate owner/partner approvals — figures as amended with effect from 15 May 2026.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3載列甚麼？
options: 金錢服務經營者牌照申請及相關事項的費用——例如牌照批給申請費3,810元（2026年5月15日起）
受制裁國家名單
能力評核的七個單元
洗錢罪行的最高刑罰
tc.explain: 附表3訂明發牌事項的費用：例如牌照批給申請3,810元（每個額外營業處所另加2,440元；每名須接受適當人選審查的人另加945元）、續期910元，以及董事／最終擁有人／合夥人批准申請每人945元——以上為2026年5月15日起生效的修訂數額。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條

en.q: Under the AMLO, “money service” means what?
options: A money changing service or a remittance service
Any service involving the handling of cash
Banking and deposit-taking services
Securities dealing and asset management services
en.explain: Schedule 1 defines money service as (a) a money changing service, or (b) a remittance service. Banking, securities and insurance activities are regulated separately under their own regimes.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，「金錢服務」指甚麼？
options: 貨幣兌換服務或匯款服務
任何涉及處理現金的服務
銀行及接受存款服務
證券交易及資產管理服務
tc.explain: 附表1將金錢服務界定為(a)貨幣兌換服務；或(b)匯款服務。銀行、證券及保險業務由各自的制度另行規管。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of remittance service)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（匯款服務的定義）

en.q: Which statement about the statutory definition of a “remittance service” is CORRECT?
options: It covers, as a business in Hong Kong, sending (or arranging the sending of) money OUT of Hong Kong AND receiving (or arranging the receipt of) money FROM a place outside Hong Kong
It only covers sending money out of Hong Kong
It only covers transfers within Hong Kong
It covers any electronic payment between Hong Kong bank accounts
