en.explain: The Schedule 1 definition covers a service operated in Hong Kong as a business of sending or arranging the sending of money to a place outside Hong Kong, receiving or arranging the receipt of money from outside Hong Kong (and related arrangements). Both directions are covered.

tc.q: 關於「匯款服務」的法定定義，下列哪項正確？
options: 涵蓋在香港作為業務經營的：將款項（或安排將款項）移離香港，以及自香港以外地方收取（或安排收取）款項
只涵蓋將款項匯出香港
只涵蓋香港境內的轉帳
涵蓋香港銀行戶口之間的任何電子支付
tc.explain: 附表1的定義涵蓋在香港作為業務經營的下述服務：將款項傳送或安排傳送至香港以外地方；自香港以外地方收取或安排收取款項（及相關安排）。匯出與匯入兩個方向均涵蓋在內。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of money changing service)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（貨幣兌換服務的定義）

en.q: A hotel operates a currency exchange counter inside the hotel primarily for the convenience of its guests. Is this a “money changing service” under the AMLO?
options: No — the definition expressly excludes an exchange service operated by a hotel manager within the hotel primarily for guests' convenience
Yes — all currency exchange in Hong Kong falls within the definition
Yes, but only if the hotel has more than 100 rooms
No, because hotels are supervised by the HKMA
en.explain: The Schedule 1 definition of money changing service covers currency exchange operated in Hong Kong as a business, but expressly excludes a service operated by a person who manages a hotel where the service is operated within the hotel premises primarily for the convenience of guests and consists solely of buying non-Hong Kong currencies in exchange for Hong Kong currency.

tc.q: 一間酒店在店內設貨幣兌換櫃位，主要為方便住客。這是否《打擊洗錢條例》所指的「貨幣兌換服務」？
options: 不是——定義明文豁除酒店管理人在酒店處所內主要為方便住客而經營的兌換服務
是——香港所有貨幣兌換均屬定義範圍
是，但只限房間數目超過100間的酒店
不是，因為酒店由金融管理專員監管
tc.explain: 附表1「貨幣兌換服務」的定義涵蓋在香港作為業務經營的貨幣兌換服務，但明文豁除由管理酒店的人經營、在酒店處所內主要為方便住客而設，且只包含以港幣購買非香港貨幣交易的兌換服務。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1 (definition of business relationship)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1條（業務關係的定義）

en.q: Under Schedule 2, what distinguishes a “business relationship” from an occasional dealing?
options: A business relationship is a business, professional or commercial relationship with an element of duration (or expected duration at first contact)
A business relationship requires a minimum of ten transactions
A business relationship exists only where a written contract is signed
A business relationship requires transactions above $120,000
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.1: a business relationship is a business, professional or commercial relationship that has an element of duration, or that the institution expects to have an element of duration when the person first contacts it as a potential customer. An occasional transaction is one with a customer who has no business relationship with the MSO.

tc.q: 根據附表2，「業務關係」與偶然交易的分別在於甚麼？
options: 業務關係是具持續性質（或在首次接觸時預期具持續性質）的業務、專業或商業關係
業務關係須有最少十宗交易
只有簽署書面合約才構成業務關係
業務關係須涉及120,000元以上的交易
tc.explain: 附表2第1條：業務關係指具持續元素的業務、專業或商業關係，或在該人首次以潛在客戶身分接觸金融機構時，該機構預期具持續元素的關係。非經常交易則指與該機構並無業務關係的客戶進行的交易。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1 (definition of occasional transaction); AML/CFT Guideline ¶4.2.3
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1條（非經常交易的定義）；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.2.3段

en.q: Under Schedule 2 to the AMLO, an “occasional transaction” is:
options: A transaction between an MSO and a customer who does NOT have a business relationship with the MSO
Any transaction below $8,000
Any transaction conducted less than once a month
A transaction conducted outside normal business hours
en.explain: An occasional transaction is defined as a transaction between the MSO and a customer who does not have a business relationship with the MSO (e.g. a walk-in exchange or remittance customer). CDD thresholds of $120,000 / $8,000 (wire and VA transfers) attach to occasional transactions.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》附表2，「非經常交易」是指：
options: 金錢服務經營者與跟它並無業務關係的客戶之間進行的交易
任何低於8,000元的交易
每月少於一次的交易
在正常營業時間以外進行的交易
tc.explain: 非經常交易的定義是金錢服務經營者與跟它並無業務關係的客戶之間的交易（例如街客的兌換或匯款交易）。120,000元／8,000元（電傳轉帳及虛擬資產轉移）的盡職審查門檻正是就非經常交易而設。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.2.4至4.2.5段

en.q: A walk-in customer sends three wire transfers of $3,000 each to the same recipient within an hour. What does Schedule 2 require?
options: CDD must be carried out — the $8,000 threshold applies to several operations that appear to the MSO to be linked, and $9,000 in linked transfers exceeds it
Nothing — each transaction is below $8,000
Only a record of the last transaction
CDD is only needed if the customer looks suspicious
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.3(1): the occasional-transaction thresholds apply whether the transaction is carried out in a single operation or in several operations that appear to the MSO to be linked. Three linked $3,000 wire transfers total $9,000 — above the $8,000 wire-transfer threshold — so CDD must be carried out (¶4.2.4–4.2.5).

tc.q: 一名街客在一小時內向同一收款人先後發出三筆各3,000元的電傳轉帳。附表2有何規定？
options: 必須執行盡職審查——8,000元門檻適用於在經營者看來互有關連的多項交易，而互有關連的轉帳合共9,000元已超過門檻
毋須任何行動——每筆交易均低於8,000元
只須記錄最後一筆交易
只有客戶形跡可疑時才須盡職審查
tc.explain: 附表2第3(1)條：非經常交易門檻適用於以單一交易進行或以在經營者看來互有關連的多項交易進行的情況。三筆互有關連的3,000元電傳轉帳合共9,000元，已超過電傳轉帳8,000元的門檻，故必須執行盡職審查（第4.2.4至4.2.5段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(a)至(b)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.4.1及4.4.3段

en.q: Under Schedule 2, how do the verification standards differ between a customer and a beneficial owner?
options: The customer's identity must be verified; for a beneficial owner, the MSO must take REASONABLE MEASURES to verify identity so that it is satisfied it knows who the beneficial owner is
Both must be verified to exactly the same standard in all cases
Beneficial owners never need any verification
Only beneficial owners need verification; customers do not
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.2(1): the customer must be identified and verified using reliable and independent documents, data or information; for a beneficial owner, the MSO must identify them and take reasonable measures to verify their identity — a risk-sensitive standard (¶4.4.3), including understanding the ownership and control structure of legal persons and trusts.

tc.q: 根據附表2，對客戶與對實益擁有人的身分核實標準有何分別？
options: 客戶的身分必須核實；對實益擁有人則須採取「合理措施」核實其身分，使經營者信納它知道實益擁有人是誰
兩者在任何情況下均須以完全相同的標準核實
實益擁有人從來無須任何核實
只須核實實益擁有人，客戶無須核實
tc.explain: 附表2第2(1)條：客戶必須以可靠而獨立的文件、數據或資料識別及核實身分；對實益擁有人，則須識別並採取合理措施核實其身分——此為按風險而定的標準（第4.4.3段），包括了解法人或信託的擁有權及控制權架構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(3)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.8.10段

en.q: For which customer may an MSO choose NOT to identify and verify the beneficial owners under section 4 of Schedule 2?
options: A corporation listed on a stock exchange
Any private company incorporated in Hong Kong
Any customer introduced by an existing customer
A company whose director is personally known to the MSO's owner
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.4(3) permits skipping beneficial-owner identification/verification for specific customers: an FI as defined in the AMLO (or equivalent overseas institution), a corporation listed on any stock exchange, certain investment vehicles, the Government or a public body in Hong Kong, and equivalent-jurisdiction governments/public bodies (¶4.8.10). Ordinary private companies enjoy no such exemption.

tc.q: 根據附表2第4條，金錢服務經營者可就哪類客戶選擇不識別及核實其實益擁有人？
options: 在證券交易所上市的法團
任何在香港註冊成立的私人公司
任何由現有客戶介紹的客戶
其董事與經營者東主相熟的公司
tc.explain: 附表2第4(3)條准許就特定客戶不識別／核實實益擁有人：《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構（或對等司法管轄區的類似機構）、在任何證券交易所上市的法團、若干投資工具、香港政府或公共機構，以及對等司法管轄區的政府／公共機構（第4.8.10段）。一般私人公司並無此豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)條

en.q: Section 5 of Schedule 2 requires an MSO to continuously monitor its business relationships. Which duties does it impose?
options: Reviewing CDD documents and information to keep them up-to-date; scrutinising transactions for consistency with the customer's profile; and examining (with written findings) complex, unusually large or unusual-pattern transactions with no apparent economic or lawful purpose
Auditing the customer's financial statements every year
Visiting each customer's business premises quarterly
Requiring customers to re-submit identity documents every month
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.5(1) requires ongoing monitoring: keeping CDD documents, data and information up-to-date and relevant; scrutinising transactions for consistency with the MSO's knowledge of the customer; and identifying and examining complex, unusually large or unusual-pattern transactions with no apparent economic or lawful purpose, setting out findings in writing.

tc.q: 附表2第5條規定金錢服務經營者須對業務關係作持續監察。它施加了哪些責任？
options: 不時覆核盡職審查文件及資料以確保反映現況；審察交易是否與對客戶的認識相符；並審查（連同書面載述審查結果）複雜、異常龐大或模式異常且無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易
每年審計客戶的財務報表
每季探訪每名客戶的營業處所
要求客戶每月重新提交身分證明文件
tc.explain: 附表2第5(1)條規定持續監察：確保盡職審查文件、數據及資料反映現況及切合需要；審察交易是否與經營者對客戶的認識相符；以及識別並審查複雜、金額異常龐大或模式異常且無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易，並以書面載述審查結果。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第6條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.12.1段

en.q: When must CDD be carried out for a PRE-EXISTING customer (relationship established before the AMLO commenced on 1 April 2012)?
options: When an unusual or suspicious transaction occurs, a material change occurs in the way the account is operated, ML/TF is suspected, or the veracity of previously obtained identification information is doubted
Never — pre-existing customers are permanently exempt from CDD
Only when the customer voluntarily offers new documents
Every month, regardless of circumstances
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.6 (¶4.12.1): CDD must be performed for pre-existing customers when (a) an unusual/suspicious transaction inconsistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer takes place; (b) a material change occurs in the way the account is operated; (c) ML/TF is suspected; or (d) the MSO doubts the veracity or adequacy of previously obtained identification information. Ongoing monitoring also applies to them.

tc.q: 就「既有客戶」（在《打擊洗錢條例》2012年4月1日生效前已建立關係的客戶），何時必須執行盡職審查？
options: 出現異常或可疑交易、帳戶運作方式出現重大改變、懷疑涉及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集，或對先前取得的身分資料的真實性有疑問時
永遠無須——既有客戶永久豁免盡職審查
只有客戶自願提供新文件時
不論情況如何，每月一次
tc.explain: 附表2第6條（第4.12.1段）：就既有客戶，在下列情況必須執行盡職審查：(a)發生金額或性質異常或可疑、與經營者對客戶認識不符的交易；(b)帳戶運作方式出現重大改變；(c)懷疑涉及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集；或(d)對先前為識別或核實身分而取得的資料的真實性或充分性有疑問。持續監察規定亦適用於既有客戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)至(2)條

en.q: Section 9(1) of Schedule 2 deals with customers not physically present for identification. Which statement is CORRECT?
options: At least one prescribed additional measure must be carried out to mitigate the risk — unless identity was verified through a digital identification system recognised by the CCE as a reliable and independent source
Non-face-to-face customers are prohibited entirely
The MSO may simply skip verification for online customers
The additional measures are only recommended, never required
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.9(1) requires at least one additional measure for customers not physically present (further verification from unused sources; supplementary verification measures; or first payment through an account in the customer's name with an authorized institution or equivalent). s.9(2): verification via a CCE-recognised digital identification system dispenses with the additional measures.

tc.q: 附表2第9(1)條處理並非親身在場接受身分識別的客戶。下列哪項正確？
options: 必須執行最少一項訂明的額外措施以減低風險——除非已透過關長認可為可靠及獨立來源的數碼識別系統核實身分
完全禁止非親身在場的客戶
網上客戶可直接略過身分核實
額外措施只屬建議，從非強制
tc.explain: 附表2第9(1)條規定，就並非親身在場的客戶，必須執行最少一項額外措施（以未用過的來源進一步核實身分；採取補充核實措施；或首筆付款須經以客戶名義於認可機構或同類機構開立的帳戶進行）。第9(2)條：如經關長認可的數碼識別系統核實身分，則無須執行額外措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10及15條

en.q: Which sections of Schedule 2 provide the statutory basis for enhanced due diligence on non-Hong Kong PEPs and on high-risk situations respectively?
options: Section 10 (non-Hong Kong PEPs) and section 15 (high-risk situations, including those specified by the CCE)
Section 5 and section 6
Section 20 and section 21
Section 12 and section 13
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.10 imposes the mandatory EDD measures for customers/beneficial owners who are non-Hong Kong PEPs (senior management approval, source of wealth/funds, enhanced monitoring); s.15 requires special/enhanced measures in situations that by their nature present a high ML/TF risk or as specified by the CCE. s.5 is ongoing monitoring; s.12/13 are wire transfers and remittance; s.20/21 are records.

tc.q: 附表2哪些條文分別為對非香港政治人物及對高風險情況採取更嚴格盡職審查提供法定依據？
options: 第10條（非香港政治人物）及第15條（高風險情況，包括關長指明的情況）
第5條及第6條
第20條及第21條
第12條及第13條
tc.explain: 附表2第10條就屬非香港政治人物的客戶／實益擁有人施加強制性的更嚴格盡職審查措施（高級管理層批准、財富及資金來源、更嚴格監察）；第15條規定在按性質屬高風險或關長指明的情況採取特別／更嚴格措施。第5條為持續監察；第12／13條為電傳轉帳及匯款；第20／21條為紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(2)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第10.4段

en.q: To which of the following does the wire-transfer information regime in section 12 of Schedule 2 NOT apply?
options: A wire transfer between an MSO and a financial institution where each acts on its own behalf, and card-based transactions (credit/debit/prepaid) not used for person-to-person transfers
Any wire transfer below $50,000
Wire transfers to family members
Wire transfers denominated in foreign currencies
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.12(2) (¶10.4): the s.12 requirements do not apply to (a) transfers between an MSO and an FI each acting on its own behalf; (b) transfers between an MSO and a foreign institution each acting on its own behalf; or (c) card-based transactions where the card is not used for person-to-person transfers and the card number accompanies the transfer. There is no exemption based on amount, currency or family relationship.

tc.q: 附表2第12條的電傳轉帳資料規定不適用於下列哪項？
options: 金錢服務經營者與金融機構之間、各自代表本身行事的電傳轉帳；以及並非用作人對人轉帳的信用咭／扣帳咭／預付咭交易
任何低於50,000元的電傳轉帳
匯給家庭成員的電傳轉帳
以外幣結算的電傳轉帳
tc.explain: 附表2第12(2)條（第10.4段）：第12條規定不適用於：(a)金錢服務經營者與金融機構之間、各自只代表本身行事的電傳轉帳；(b)與外地機構之間、各自只代表本身行事的電傳轉帳；及(c)以咭進行、並非用作人對人轉帳且咭號碼附隨轉帳的交易。並無按金額、貨幣或親屬關係而設的豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第11.3及11.6段

en.q: Before carrying out a remittance transaction (other than a wire transfer) of $8,000 or above, section 13 of Schedule 2 requires the MSO to:
options: Identify the originator, verify the originator's identity by reference to their identification document, and record prescribed particulars including the originator's name, ID document number, address, currency and amount, and the recipient's details
Obtain the recipient's consent in writing
Report the transaction to the JFIU in advance
Hold the funds for 24 hours before remitting
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.13: before a remittance transaction of $8,000 or above (other than a wire transfer), the MSO must identify and verify the originator by reference to their identification document and record the prescribed particulars — originator's name, ID document number (and place of issue for travel documents), address, currency and amount, date/time of instruction, recipient's name and address and delivery method (¶11.6).

tc.q: 在進行8,000元或以上的匯款交易（電傳轉帳除外）前，附表2第13條規定金錢服務經營者須：
options: 識別匯款人、按其身分證明文件核實其身分，並記錄訂明資料，包括匯款人姓名、身分證明文件號碼、地址、貨幣及金額，以及收款人的資料
取得收款人的書面同意
預先向聯合財富情報組申報該交易
先扣起款項24小時才匯出
tc.explain: 附表2第13條：進行8,000元或以上的匯款交易（電傳轉帳除外）前，須識別匯款人並按其身分證明文件核實其身分，並記錄訂明資料——匯款人姓名、身分證明文件號碼（旅行證件則連同簽發地點）、地址、所涉貨幣及金額、收到指示的日期及時間、收款人姓名及地址與交付方式（第11.6段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13A條

en.q: Section 13A of Schedule 2 imposes special requirements on which type of transaction?
options: Virtual asset transfers — transfers of virtual assets carried out by an ordering institution on behalf of an originator to make them available to a recipient at a beneficiary institution
Cheque deposits
Physical gold shipments
Foreign currency cash exchanges
en.explain: s.13A (added by the 2022 amendments) defines a virtual asset transfer — mirroring the wire-transfer structure of ordering, intermediary and beneficiary institutions — and imposes originator/recipient information requirements before carrying out VA transfers; the $8,000 CDD threshold applies to occasional VA transfers (s.3(1)).

tc.q: 附表2第13A條就哪類交易施加特別規定？
options: 虛擬資產轉移——由轉移機構代表匯款人轉移虛擬資產，使收款人可在收款機構取得該資產
支票存款
實金付運
外幣現鈔兌換
tc.explain: 第13A條（2022年修訂加入）界定虛擬資產轉移——結構與電傳轉帳的匯款、中介及收款機構相對應——並就進行虛擬資產轉移前的匯款人／收款人資料施加規定；非經常虛擬資產轉移適用8,000元的盡職審查門檻（第3(1)條）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20及21條（第3部）

en.q: Under Part 3 of Schedule 2, in what form may required records be kept?
options: As original documents, or copies kept on microfilm or in a computer database; data and information records on microfilm or in a computer database
Original paper documents only — electronic copies are not permitted
Any form, provided records are destroyed within one year
Verbal records maintained by the compliance officer
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.21: where a record consists of a document, either the original or a copy on microfilm or in a computer database must be kept; records of data or information are kept on microfilm or in a computer database. s.20 sets the retention periods (at least 5 years) and allows the CCE to require longer retention by written notice.

tc.q: 根據附表2第3部，規定備存的紀錄可以何種形式保存？
options: 文件正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫形式保存的副本；數據或資料紀錄則以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫保存
只可保存文件正本——不准電子副本
任何形式均可，惟紀錄須於一年內銷毀
由合規主任以口頭方式記存
tc.explain: 附表2第21條：如紀錄屬文件，須保存正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫保存副本；如紀錄屬數據或資料，須以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫保存。第20條訂明保存期（最少5年），關長並可以書面通知要求更長的保存期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22及23條

en.q: Which of the following correctly pairs sections 22 and 23 of Schedule 2 with their subject matter?
options: s.22 — ensuring overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings have procedures for similar CDD/record-keeping compliance; s.23 — the duty to maintain safeguards and mitigate ML/TF risks
s.22 — licence fees; s.23 — staff training requirements
s.22 — wire transfers; s.23 — remittance transactions
s.22 — the register of licensees; s.23 — the Review Tribunal
en.explain: s.22 requires a Hong Kong-incorporated institution to ensure its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings (carrying on similar business) have procedures for compliance with CDD and record-keeping requirements similar to Parts 2 and 3, to the extent local law permits — with the CCE informed where local law prevents it. s.23 requires all reasonable measures to ensure proper safeguards exist and to mitigate ML/TF risks.

tc.q: 下列哪項正確配對附表2第22條及第23條的主題？
options: 第22條——確保外地分行及附屬企業設有程序，遵守類似的盡職審查／備存紀錄規定；第23條——維持保障措施及減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的責任
第22條——牌照費用；第23條——職員培訓規定
第22條——電傳轉帳；第23條——匯款交易
第22條——持牌人登記冊；第23條——覆核審裁處
tc.explain: 第22條規定在香港成立為法團的機構，須確保其經營類似業務的外地分行及附屬企業設有程序，在當地法律准許的範圍內遵守與附表2第2及3部相類似的盡職審查及備存紀錄規定——如當地法律不准許，須通知關長。第23條規定須採取一切合理措施，確保設有合適的保障措施及減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「貨幣」的定義）

en.q: For the purposes of the AMLO, what does “currency” include?
options: A cheque and a traveller's cheque
Only banknotes and coins in circulation
Only Hong Kong legal tender
Stored value facilities and virtual assets
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that currency includes a cheque and a traveller's cheque. The separate definition of money is money in whatever form or currency.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，「貨幣」包括甚麼？
options: 支票及旅行支票
只限流通的鈔票及硬幣
只限香港法定貨幣
儲值支付工具及虛擬資產
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「貨幣」包括支票及旅行支票。另有「金錢」的定義，指任何形式或任何貨幣的金錢。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「金錢」的定義）

en.q: How is “money” defined in Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: Money in whatever form or currency
Hong Kong dollars and other freely convertible currencies only
Physical cash, excluding funds held in accounts
Any medium of exchange recognised by the Monetary Authority
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 defines money as money in whatever form or currency. The breadth of this definition matters because the definition of remittance service turns on the sending or receiving of money.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1如何界定「金錢」？
options: 任何形式或任何貨幣的金錢
只限港元及其他可自由兌換的貨幣
實物現金，不包括帳戶內的資金
金融管理專員認可的任何交易媒介
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條界定「金錢」為任何形式或任何貨幣的金錢。此定義的廣泛程度十分重要，因「匯款服務」的定義取決於金錢的寄出或收取。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “money changing service”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「貨幣兌換服務」的定義）

en.q: Both conditions must be met for the hotel exception to the definition of “money changing service”. What is the second condition, besides the service being operated within the hotel premises primarily for guests' convenience?
options: The service consists solely of transactions for the purchase by the hotel manager of non-Hong Kong currencies in exchange for Hong Kong currency
The service is limited to transactions of no more than $8,000 per guest per day
The hotel notifies the Commissioner in writing each year
The service is operated only outside normal banking hours
en.explain: The hotel exception requires both that the service is operated within the hotel premises primarily for the convenience of guests, and that it consists solely of transactions for the purchase by the hotel manager of non-Hong Kong currencies in exchange for Hong Kong currency — one-way exchange only.

tc.q: 「貨幣兌換服務」定義下的酒店例外須同時符合兩項條件。除該服務在酒店處所內主要為住客提供方便而經營外，第二項條件是甚麼？
options: 該服務純粹包括該酒店管理人以港幣購買非港幣的交易
該服務限於每名住客每日不超過8,000元的交易
該酒店每年以書面通知海關關長
該服務只在正常銀行營業時間以外經營
tc.explain: 酒店例外須同時符合兩項條件：該服務在酒店處所內主要為酒店住客提供方便而經營；及該服務純粹包括該人以港幣購買非港幣的交易——即只限單向兌換。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “remittance service”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「匯款服務」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is expressly one of the limbs of the definition of “remittance service”?
options: Arranging for the receipt of money in a place outside Hong Kong
Exchanging one non-Hong Kong currency for another within Hong Kong
Holding customer funds on deposit in Hong Kong
Issuing stored value facilities to customers in Hong Kong
en.explain: The definition covers a service, operated in Hong Kong as a business, of sending or arranging for the sending of money to a place outside Hong Kong; receiving or arranging for the receipt of money from a place outside Hong Kong; or arranging for the receipt of money in a place outside Hong Kong. Currency exchange falls under money changing service instead.

tc.q: 下列何者明文屬「匯款服務」定義的其中一項？
options: 安排在香港以外地方收取金錢
在香港境內將一種非港幣貨幣兌換為另一種
在香港為客戶持有存款
在香港向客戶發行儲值支付工具
tc.explain: 該定義涵蓋在香港以業務方式經營的下列一項或多於一項服務：將金錢寄往香港以外地方或安排寄往；從香港以外地方收取金錢或安排收取；或安排在香港以外地方收取金錢。貨幣兌換則屬「貨幣兌換服務」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第3條

en.q: A company provides financial institutions with a messaging system for transmitting funds, but handles no money itself. Is it regarded as operating a remittance service?
options: No — section 3 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 expressly excludes a person who only provides such message or support systems
Yes — any participation in the transmission of funds constitutes a remittance service
Yes, but only if the system is used for cross-border transfers
No, provided the company registers the system with the Commissioner
en.explain: Section 3 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 provides that a person who only provides to financial institutions a message system or other support systems for transmitting funds is not, for the purposes of the Ordinance, to be regarded as a person operating a remittance service.

tc.q: 某公司向金融機構提供傳送資金的訊息系統，但本身並不處理金錢。它是否被視為經營匯款服務？
options: 否——附表1第1部第3條明文將只提供該等訊息或支援系統的人排除在外
是——任何參與資金傳送的行為均構成匯款服務
是，但只限該系統用於跨境轉帳的情況
否，只要該公司向海關關長登記該系統
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第3條訂明，只向金融機構提供傳送資金的訊息系統或其他支援系統的人，就本條例而言，不視為經營匯款服務的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「財產」的定義）

en.q: What does “property” include under Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: Money, goods, choses in action and land, whether in Hong Kong or elsewhere, together with obligations, easements and every description of estate, interest and profit arising out of them
Only tangible assets physically located in Hong Kong
Only assets capable of being registered in a public register
Only money and goods, excluding rights of action
en.explain: The definition covers money, goods, choses in action and land, whether in Hong Kong or elsewhere, and obligations, easements and every description of estate, interest and profit, present or future, vested or contingent, arising out of or incident to property as so defined.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1下的「財產」包括甚麼？
options: 金錢、貨品、據法權產及土地（不論在香港或其他地方），連同因此產生或附帶的義務、地役權及各種產業權、權益及收益
只限實際位於香港的有形資產
只限可在公共登記冊登記的資產
只限金錢及貨品，不包括訴訟權
tc.explain: 該定義涵蓋金錢、貨品、據法權產及土地（不論在香港或其他地方），以及因上述定義的財產產生或附帶的義務、地役權及各種現有或將來的、既得或視乎情況而定的產業權、權益及收益。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第2條

en.q: Where do the terms “terrorist”, “terrorist act” and “terrorist associate” used in the definition of terrorist financing take their meaning from?
options: Section 2(1) of the United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (Cap. 575)
Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO
Section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Securities and Futures Ordinance
The FATF Recommendations
en.explain: Section 2 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 provides that, in the definition of terrorist financing, terrorist, terrorist act and terrorist associate have the meaning given by section 2(1) of the UNATMO (Cap. 575).

tc.q: 「恐怖分子資金籌集」定義中所用的「恐怖分子」、「恐怖主義行為」及「恐怖分子聯繫者」，其涵義源自何處？
options: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》（第575章）第2(1)條
《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部
《證券及期貨條例》附表1第1部第1條
財務行動特別組織的建議
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第2條訂明，在「恐怖分子資金籌集」的定義中，「恐怖分子」、「恐怖主義行為」及「恐怖分子聯繫者」具有《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》（第575章）第2(1)條所給予的涵義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「關長」的定義）

en.q: Whom does “Commissioner” include under Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: The Commissioner of Customs and Excise, any Deputy or Assistant Commissioner, and a person to whom functions have been delegated under section 26
Only the Commissioner of Customs and Excise personally
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise and the Commissioner of Police
Any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines Commissioner as the Commissioner of Customs and Excise, any Deputy Commissioner, any Assistant Commissioner, or a person to whom the Commissioner has delegated any function under section 26.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部下的「關長」包括何人？
options: 海關關長、任何海關副關長或助理關長，以及根據第26條獲轉授職能的人
只限海關關長本人
海關關長及警務處處長
任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「關長」為海關關長、任何海關副關長、任何海關助理關長，或海關關長根據第26條向其轉授任何職能的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「營業日」的定義）

en.q: Which days are excluded from the definition of “business day” in Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: A public holiday, and a gale warning day or black rainstorm warning day as defined by section 71(2) of the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance
Saturdays and Sundays only
Any day on which the Customs and Excise Department is closed to the public
Any day on which the Hong Kong Stock Exchange does not trade
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines business day as any day other than a public holiday or a gale warning day or black rainstorm warning day as defined by section 71(2) of the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance (Cap. 1).

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1「營業日」的定義不包括哪些日子？
options: 公眾假期，以及《釋義及通則條例》第71(2)條所界定的烈風警告日或黑色暴雨警告日
只限星期六及星期日
香港海關不對外開放的任何日子
香港交易所不進行交易的任何日子
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「營業日」為公眾假期，或《釋義及通則條例》（第1章）第71(2)條所界定的烈風警告日或黑色暴雨警告日以外的任何日子。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「指定非金融企業及行業」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is a DNFBP under Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: An estate agent
A licensed money service operator
An authorized institution
An SVF licensee
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines DNFBP as an accounting professional, an estate agent, a legal professional, a TCSP licensee or a Category B PMS registrant. Money service operators, authorized institutions and SVF licensees are financial institutions, not DNFBPs.

tc.q: 下列何者屬《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部下的指定非金融企業及行業？
options: 地產代理
持牌金錢服務經營者
認可機構
儲值支付工具持牌人
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「指定非金融企業及行業」為會計專業人士、地產代理、法律專業人士、信託或公司服務提供者持牌人，或B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人。金錢服務經營者、認可機構及儲值支付工具持牌人均屬金融機構，而非指定非金融企業及行業。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「金融機構」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is included in the definition of “financial institution” in Schedule 1?
options: The Postmaster General
The Estate Agents Authority
A licensed estate agent
A certified public accountant
en.explain: The Schedule 1 Part 2 definition of financial institution lists authorized institutions, licensed corporations, authorized insurers, licensed individual insurance agents, licensed insurance agencies, licensed insurance broker companies, licensed money service operators, the Postmaster General, SVF licensees, licensed VAS providers and stablecoin licensees.

tc.q: 下列何者包括在附表1「金融機構」的定義內？
options: 郵政署署長
地產代理監管局
持牌地產代理
執業會計師
tc.explain: 附表1第2部「金融機構」的定義列出認可機構、持牌法團、認可保險人、持牌個人保險代理、持牌保險代理機構、持牌保險經紀公司、持牌金錢服務經營者、郵政署署長、儲值支付工具持牌人、持牌虛擬資產服務提供者及穩定幣持牌人。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 2 (definition of “licensed money service operator”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「持牌金錢服務經營者」的定義）

en.q: How is “licensed money service operator” defined in Schedule 1?
options: The holder of a licence as defined by section 24
Any person operating a money service in Hong Kong
A person registered with the Commissioner under section 27
Any person who has applied for a licence under section 30
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines licensed money service operator as the holder of a licence as defined by section 24 — that is, a licence granted under section 30, renewed under section 31, or deemed granted under section 82.

tc.q: 附表1如何界定「持牌金錢服務經營者」？
options: 第24條所界定的牌照的持有人
在香港經營金錢服務的任何人
根據第27條在海關關長處登記的人
根據第30條已提出牌照申請的任何人
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「持牌金錢服務經營者」為第24條所界定的牌照的持有人——即根據第30條批出、根據第31條續期，或根據第82條被當作已批出的牌照。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「客戶」的定義）

en.q: What does the definition of “customer” in Part 2 of Schedule 1 expressly include?
options: A client
Any beneficial owner of the person dealing with the institution
Any person purporting to act on behalf of another
Only a person with whom a business relationship has been established
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 provides that customer includes a client, and, in relation to a Category B PMS registrant, includes a person who is a party to a transaction carried out by the registrant in the course of a precious metals and stones business. Beneficial owners and persons purporting to act are dealt with separately in Schedule 2.

tc.q: 附表1第2部「客戶」的定義明文包括甚麼？
options: 委託人
與該機構交易的人的任何實益擁有人
聲稱代另一人行事的任何人
只限已建立業務關係的人
tc.explain: 附表1第2部訂明「客戶」包括委託人；就B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人而言，並包括該註冊人在經營貴金屬及寶石業務過程中所進行交易的一方。實益擁有人及聲稱代其行事的人則在附表2另行處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「法律專業人士」的定義）

en.q: Who is a “legal professional” for the purposes of the AMLO?
options: A solicitor or a foreign lawyer, each as defined by section 2(1) of the Legal Practitioners Ordinance
A solicitor or barrister admitted in Hong Kong
Any person providing legal advice by way of business
A solicitor only; foreign lawyers are excluded
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines legal professional as a solicitor as defined by section 2(1) of the Legal Practitioners Ordinance (Cap. 159), or a foreign lawyer as defined by that section.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，何人屬「法律專業人士」？
options: 《法律執業者條例》第2(1)條所界定的律師或外地律師
在香港獲認許的律師或大律師
以業務方式提供法律意見的任何人
只限律師；外地律師不包括在內
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「法律專業人士」為《法律執業者條例》（第159章）第2(1)條所界定的律師，或該條所界定的外地律師。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “trust or company service”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「信託或公司服務」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following falls within the definition of “trust or company service”?
options: Providing a registered office, business address, correspondence or administrative address for a corporation, partnership or other legal person or arrangement
Auditing the annual accounts of a corporation
Acting as legal adviser to a corporation in litigation
Providing insurance broking services to a corporation
en.explain: The definition covers forming corporations or other legal persons; acting or arranging for another to act as a director or secretary of a corporation, as a partner of a partnership or in a similar position; providing a registered office, business address, correspondence or administrative address; and acting or arranging for another to act as trustee of an express trust or as a nominee shareholder.

tc.q: 下列何者屬「信託或公司服務」定義的範圍？
options: 為法團、合夥或任何其他法人或法律安排提供註冊辦事處、業務地址、通訊或行政地址
審計法團的周年帳目
在訴訟中擔任法團的法律顧問
向法團提供保險經紀服務
tc.explain: 該定義涵蓋組成法團或其他法人；擔任或安排他人擔任法團的董事或秘書、合夥的合夥人或其他法人的類似職位；提供註冊辦事處、業務地址、通訊或行政地址；以及擔任或安排他人擔任明訂信託的受託人或代名股東。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(a)條

en.q: On the basis of documents, data or information from which sources must a financial institution verify a customer's identity under section 2(1)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: A governmental body, the relevant authority or any other relevant authority, a similar overseas authority, a recognized digital identification system, or any other reliable and independent source recognized by the relevant authority
Any source the institution considers convenient
Only documents issued by the Hong Kong Immigration Department
Only documents certified by a solicitor or notary public
en.explain: Section 2(1)(a) lists the permitted sources as a governmental body; the relevant authority or any other relevant authority; an authority outside Hong Kong performing similar functions; a recognized digital identification system; or any other reliable and independent source recognized by the relevant authority.

tc.q: 根據附表2第2(1)(a)條，金融機構須依據來自哪些來源的文件、數據或資料核實客戶身分？
options: 政府機構、有關當局或任何其他有關當局、職能類似的境外當局、獲認可數碼身分識別系統，或有關當局認可的任何其他可靠而獨立的來源
該機構認為方便的任何來源
只限香港入境事務處簽發的文件
只限經律師或公證人核證的文件
tc.explain: 第2(1)(a)條列出可接受的來源為：政府機構；有關當局或任何其他有關當局；在香港以外地方執行類似職能的當局；獲認可數碼身分識別系統；或有關當局認可的任何其他可靠而獨立的來源。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(b)條

en.q: Where the customer is a legal person or trust, what must the beneficial ownership measure in section 2(1)(b) of Schedule 2 enable the institution to do?
options: Understand the ownership and control structure of the legal person or trust
Obtain a certified copy of the constitutional documents in every case
Verify each beneficial owner to the same standard as the customer
Identify every shareholder, regardless of the size of their holding
en.explain: Section 2(1)(b) requires identifying the beneficial owner and taking reasonable measures to verify their identity so that the institution is satisfied it knows who the beneficial owner is, including, where the customer is a legal person or trust, measures to enable it to understand the ownership and control structure.

tc.q: 如客戶是法人或信託，附表2第2(1)(b)條的實益擁有人措施須使該機構能夠作出甚麼？
options: 了解該法人或信託的擁有權及控制權結構
在任何情況下均取得憲章文件的經核證副本
以與客戶相同的標準核實每名實益擁有人
識別每名股東，不論其持股量多少
tc.explain: 第2(1)(b)條規定須識別實益擁有人並採取合理措施核實其身分，以令該機構信納其知悉實益擁有人為何人；如客戶是法人或信託，並須包括使該機構能了解該法人或信託的擁有權及控制權結構的措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(c)條

en.q: When must an institution obtain information on the purpose and intended nature of a business relationship?
options: When a business relationship is to be established, unless the purpose and intended nature are obvious
In every case without exception, including occasional transactions
Only where the customer is assessed as high risk
Only where the customer is a legal person
en.explain: Section 2(1)(c) requires the institution, if a business relationship is to be established, to obtain information on the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship, unless the purpose and intended nature are obvious.

tc.q: 機構須於何時取得有關業務關係的目的及擬有性質的資料？
options: 擬建立業務關係時，除非該目的及擬有性質屬顯而易見
在任何情況下均須，包括單次交易
只限客戶被評為高風險的情況
只限客戶是法人的情況
tc.explain: 第2(1)(c)條規定，如擬建立業務關係，機構須取得有關該業務關係的目的及擬有性質的資料，除非該目的及擬有性質屬顯而易見。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(d)條

en.q: Where a person purports to act on behalf of the customer, what must the institution do in addition to identifying and verifying that person's identity?
options: Verify the person's authority to act on behalf of the customer
Obtain a power of attorney witnessed by a solicitor
Refuse the transaction unless the customer attends in person
Treat the person as the beneficial owner of the customer
en.explain: Section 2(1)(d) requires identifying the person purporting to act and taking reasonable measures to verify their identity on the basis of the listed sources, and, by sub-paragraph (ii), verifying the person's authority to act on behalf of the customer.

tc.q: 如有人聲稱代客戶行事，除識別及核實該人身分外，機構還須作出甚麼？
options: 核實該人代該客戶行事的權限
取得由律師見證的授權書
除非客戶親身到場，否則拒絕該交易
視該人為該客戶的實益擁有人
tc.explain: 第2(1)(d)條規定須識別聲稱代其行事的人，並依據所列來源採取合理措施核實其身分；並根據(ii)節核實該人代該客戶行事的權限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(b)條

en.q: At what threshold does an occasional transaction (other than a wire transfer) trigger the CDD requirement under section 3(1)(b) of Schedule 2?
options: An amount equal to or above $120,000, or an equivalent amount in any other currency
An amount equal to or above $8,000
An amount above $20,000
Any amount, with no threshold
en.explain: Section 3(1)(b) requires CDD before carrying out an occasional transaction involving an amount equal to or above $120,000 or the equivalent in any other currency, whether in a single operation or in several operations that appear to be linked. Section 3(1A) sets the lower $8,000 threshold for wire transfers.

tc.q: 根據附表2第3(1)(b)條，單次交易（電匯除外）在甚麼門檻會觸發客戶盡職審查規定？
options: 款額相等於或高於120,000元，或任何其他貨幣的等值款額
款額相等於或高於8,000元
款額高於20,000元
任何款額，並無門檻
tc.explain: 第3(1)(b)條規定在進行涉及款額相等於或高於120,000元（或任何其他貨幣等值款額）的單次交易前，須進行客戶盡職審查，不論該交易以單一項或看來有關連的多項操作進行。第3(1A)條就電匯訂明較低的8,000元門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1A)條

en.q: What threshold applies to an occasional wire transfer under section 3(1A) of Schedule 2?
options: An amount equal to or above $8,000, or an equivalent amount in any other currency
An amount equal to or above $120,000
An amount above $20,000
An amount equal to or above $50,000
en.explain: Section 3(1A) requires a financial institution to carry out CDD before carrying out an occasional transaction that is a wire transfer involving an amount equal to or above $8,000, or a virtual asset transfer involving virtual assets amounting to no less than $8,000, whether in a single operation or in linked operations.

tc.q: 根據附表2第3(1A)條，單次電匯適用甚麼門檻？
options: 款額相等於或高於8,000元，或任何其他貨幣的等值款額
款額相等於或高於120,000元
款額高於20,000元
款額相等於或高於50,000元
tc.explain: 第3(1A)條規定金融機構在為客戶進行屬電匯而涉及款額相等於或高於8,000元的單次交易，或涉及不少於8,000元虛擬資產的虛擬資產轉移前，須進行客戶盡職審查，不論該交易以單一項或有關連的多項操作進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(e)條

en.q: Which circumstance, unrelated to any transaction threshold, triggers the CDD requirement under section 3(1)(e) of Schedule 2?
options: When the institution doubts the veracity or adequacy of any information previously obtained for identifying or verifying the customer
When the customer changes their correspondence address
When the customer has been a customer for more than five years
When the customer requests a transaction in a foreign currency
en.explain: Section 3(1)(e) requires CDD when the institution doubts the veracity or adequacy of any information previously obtained for the purpose of identifying the customer or verifying the customer's identity. Section 3(1)(d) separately covers suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing.

tc.q: 附表2第3(1)(e)條下，哪一項與交易門檻無關的情況會觸發客戶盡職審查規定？
options: 機構懷疑先前為識別客戶或核實客戶身分而取得的任何資料的真確性或充分性
客戶更改其通訊地址
客戶成為客戶已超過五年
客戶要求以外幣進行交易
tc.explain: 第3(1)(e)條規定，當機構懷疑先前為識別客戶或核實客戶身分而取得的任何資料的真確性或充分性時，須進行客戶盡職審查。第3(1)(d)條則另行涵蓋懷疑涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(2)條

en.q: On what two conditions may an institution verify a customer's identity after, rather than before, establishing a business relationship?
options: That this is necessary not to interrupt the normal conduct of business, and that any resulting ML/TF risk is effectively managed
That the customer is a corporation, and that the amount involved is below $120,000
That the customer consents in writing, and that a director approves
That the relevant authority has granted a written exemption
en.explain: Section 3(2) permits post-establishment verification only where it is necessary not to interrupt the normal conduct of business with regard to the customer, and any risk of money laundering or terrorist financing caused by deferring verification is effectively managed.

tc.q: 機構可在符合哪兩項條件下，於建立業務關係後（而非之前）核實客戶身分？
options: 為免打斷與該客戶的正常業務往來而有此需要；及因此產生的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險獲有效管理
客戶是法團，且所涉款額低於120,000元
客戶書面同意，且經一名董事批准
有關當局已給予書面豁免
tc.explain: 第3(2)條只在下列情況下准許事後核實：為免打斷與該客戶的正常業務往來而有此需要；及因延後核實而可能引致的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險獲有效管理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(3)條

en.q: Where verification is deferred under section 3(2), by when must it be completed?
options: As soon as reasonably practicable after establishing the business relationship
Within 30 days of establishing the business relationship
Before the customer's first transaction exceeding $8,000
Within one month, or such longer period as the relevant authority allows
en.explain: Section 3(3) requires an institution that carries out verification after establishing a business relationship under section 3(2) to complete the verification as soon as reasonably practicable after establishing the relationship. No fixed number of days is prescribed.

tc.q: 如根據第3(2)條延後核實，須於何時完成？
options: 在建立業務關係後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快完成
在建立業務關係後30日內
在客戶首次超過8,000元的交易前
在一個月內，或有關當局容許的較長期間內
tc.explain: 第3(3)條規定，根據第3(2)條在建立業務關係後方進行核實的機構，須在建立業務關係後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快完成核實。條文並無訂明固定日數。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(4)條

en.q: An MSO cannot complete the required CDD measures for a walk-in customer. What must it do?
options: It must not carry out the occasional transaction; and if a business relationship already exists, it must terminate that relationship as soon as reasonably practicable
It may proceed provided it files a suspicious transaction report
It may proceed if the amount is below $120,000
It must refer the customer to another licensed MSO
en.explain: Section 3(4) provides that an institution unable to comply with section 3(1), (1A), (1B) or (3) must not establish a business relationship or carry out any occasional transaction with the customer, or, where a business relationship already exists, must terminate it as soon as reasonably practicable.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者無法就一名即場客戶完成所需的客戶盡職審查措施。它須怎樣做？
options: 不得進行該單次交易；如已存在業務關係，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止該關係
只要提交可疑交易報告即可進行
只要款額低於120,000元即可進行
須將該客戶轉介另一持牌金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 第3(4)條訂明，機構如無法遵從第3(1)、(1A)、(1B)或(3)款，不得與該客戶建立業務關係或進行任何單次交易；如已與該客戶建立業務關係，則須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止該關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(1)條

en.q: Which CDD measures may be omitted when simplified due diligence is applied under section 4(1) of Schedule 2?
options: Only the beneficial ownership measure in section 2(1)(b); the measures in section 2(1)(a), (ab), (c) and (d) must still be carried out
All CDD measures may be omitted
Only the measure in section 2(1)(c) concerning purpose and intended nature
All measures except identifying the customer by name
en.explain: Section 4(1) allows an institution, instead of carrying out all the CDD measures, to carry out only the measures set out in section 2(1)(a), (ab), (c) and (d). The measure omitted is therefore the section 2(1)(b) beneficial ownership measure.

tc.q: 根據附表2第4(1)條採用簡化盡職審查時，可省略哪些客戶盡職審查措施？
options: 只可省略第2(1)(b)條的實益擁有人措施；第2(1)(a)、(ab)、(c)及(d)條的措施仍須進行
可省略所有客戶盡職審查措施
只可省略第2(1)(c)條有關目的及擬有性質的措施
除按姓名識別客戶外，可省略所有措施
tc.explain: 第4(1)條准許機構不進行所有客戶盡職審查措施，而只進行第2(1)(a)、(ab)、(c)及(d)條所列的措施。因此獲省略的是第2(1)(b)條的實益擁有人措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(3)(c)條

en.q: Which of the following customers falls within section 4(3) of Schedule 2, permitting simplified due diligence?
options: A corporation listed on any stock exchange
Any corporation with paid-up capital exceeding $10 million
Any customer introduced by an existing customer
Any customer resident in an equivalent jurisdiction
en.explain: Section 4(3) lists a financial institution; an institution in an equivalent jurisdiction carrying on a similar business with similar compliance measures and supervision; a corporation listed on any stock exchange; certain investment vehicles; the Government or a public body in Hong Kong; and the government or an equivalent public body of an equivalent jurisdiction.

tc.q: 下列哪類客戶屬附表2第4(3)條範圍，因而可採用簡化盡職審查？
options: 在任何證券交易所上市的法團
實繳股本超過1,000萬元的任何法團
由現有客戶引介的任何客戶
居於同等司法管轄區的任何客戶
tc.explain: 第4(3)條列出金融機構；在同等司法管轄區成立、經營類似業務並設有類似合規措施及受監督的機構；在任何證券交易所上市的法團；若干投資工具；政府或香港任何公共機構；以及同等司法管轄區的政府或執行類似公共機構職能的團體。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(5)(c)條

en.q: A life insurance policy qualifies for simplified due diligence under section 4(5)(c) of Schedule 2 at what premium levels?
options: An annual premium of no more than $8,000, or a single premium of no more than $20,000
An annual premium of no more than $20,000, or a single premium of no more than $8,000
An annual premium of no more than $120,000 in either case
Any premium level, provided the policy has no surrender value
en.explain: Section 4(5)(c) covers a life insurance policy in respect of which an annual premium of no more than $8,000, or a single premium of no more than $20,000, or the equivalent in any other currency, is payable.

tc.q: 人壽保險保單在甚麼保費水平下符合附表2第4(5)(c)條的簡化盡職審查資格？
options: 每年保費不超過8,000元，或整筆保費不超過20,000元
每年保費不超過20,000元，或整筆保費不超過8,000元
兩種情況下每年保費均不超過120,000元
任何保費水平，只要該保單並無退保價值
tc.explain: 第4(5)(c)條涵蓋須繳付每年保費不超過8,000元，或整筆保費不超過20,000元（或任何其他貨幣等值款額）的人壽保險保單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(6)條

en.q: Where a financial institution's customer is a solicitor or firm of solicitors, in relation to which account is the beneficial ownership measure not required?
options: An account kept in the customer's name, in which clients' moneys or securities are mingled, and which the customer manages as those clients' agent
Any account held by the solicitor, whether client money or office money
Only an account holding funds of a single identified client
Only an account used exclusively for conveyancing transactions
en.explain: Section 4(6) removes the section 2(1)(b) requirement in relation to an account that is kept in the customer's name, in which moneys or securities of the customer's clients are mingled, and that is managed by the customer as those clients' agent — the classic pooled client account.

tc.q: 如金融機構的客戶是律師或律師行，就哪類帳戶無須進行實益擁有人措施？
options: 以該客戶名義開立、混合存放該客戶的委託人的款項或證券，並由該客戶以該等委託人的代理人身分管理的帳戶
該律師持有的任何帳戶，不論屬委託人款項或事務所款項
只限持有單一已識別委託人款項的帳戶
只限專用於物業轉易交易的帳戶
tc.explain: 第4(6)條就以該客戶名義開立、混合存放該客戶的委託人的款項或證券，並由該客戶以該等委託人的代理人身分管理的帳戶（即典型的匯集委託人帳戶），免除第2(1)(b)條的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)(c)條

en.q: Which transactions must an institution identify and examine under section 5(1)(c) of Schedule 2, and what must it do with its findings?
options: Transactions that are complex, unusually large in amount or of an unusual pattern and have no apparent economic or lawful purpose; the findings must be set out in writing
All transactions exceeding $120,000; the findings must be reported to the relevant authority
Transactions involving a foreign currency; the findings must be retained for six years
Transactions with new customers only; the findings must be reviewed by a director
en.explain: Section 5(1)(c) requires the institution to identify transactions that are complex, unusually large in amount or of an unusual pattern and that have no apparent economic or lawful purpose, to examine the background and purposes of those transactions, and to set out the findings in writing.

tc.q: 根據附表2第5(1)(c)條，機構須識別及審查哪些交易？並須如何處理其結論？
options: 複雜、金額異常龐大或模式異常，且並無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易；結論須以書面列明
所有超過120,000元的交易；結論須向有關當局呈報
涉及外幣的交易；結論須保存六年
只限與新客戶的交易；結論須由一名董事覆核
tc.explain: 第5(1)(c)條規定機構須識別複雜、金額異常龐大或模式異常，且並無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易，審查該等交易的背景及目的，並以書面列明結論。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)(b)條

en.q: Against what must an institution scrutinise transactions carried out for a customer under section 5(1)(b) of Schedule 2?
options: Its knowledge of the customer, the customer's business and risk profile, and the source of the customer's funds
The average transaction value across the institution's customer base
The prevailing market exchange rate on the transaction date
Published statistics on remittance flows to the destination country
en.explain: Section 5(1)(b) requires appropriate scrutiny of transactions carried out for the customer to ensure they are consistent with the institution's knowledge of the customer and the customer's business and risk profile, and with its knowledge of the source of the customer's funds.

tc.q: 根據附表2第5(1)(b)條，機構須參照甚麼審視為客戶進行的交易？
options: 其對該客戶、該客戶的業務及風險狀況的認識，以及對該客戶資金來源的認識
該機構整體客戶群的平均交易價值
交易當日的現行市場匯率
已公布的匯往目的地國家的匯款流量統計
tc.explain: 第5(1)(b)條規定須對為該客戶進行的交易作適當審視，以確保該等交易與該機構對該客戶及該客戶的業務及風險狀況的認識，以及與其對該客戶資金來源的認識相符。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(3)條

en.q: In which three situations must an institution take additional measures when monitoring a business relationship under section 5(3) of Schedule 2?
options: Where the customer was not physically present for identification, where the customer or a beneficial owner is known to be a politically exposed person, and where a section 15 high-risk situation is involved
Where the customer is a corporation, a partnership, or a trust
Where the transaction exceeds $8,000, $20,000 or $120,000 respectively
Where the customer is new, dormant, or has previously been the subject of an STR
en.explain: Section 5(3) requires additional measures to compensate for ML/TF risk where the customer has not been physically present for identification, where the customer or a beneficial owner is known to be a politically exposed person, or where the customer or beneficial owner is involved in a situation referred to in section 15 of Schedule 2.

tc.q: 根據附表2第5(3)條，機構在監察業務關係時，須在哪三種情況下採取額外措施？
options: 客戶並未親身出席以供識別；客戶或實益擁有人已知屬政治人物；以及涉及第15條所指的高風險情況
客戶是法團、合夥或信託
客戶屬新客戶、不活躍客戶，或曾為可疑交易報告的對象
tc.explain: 第5(3)條規定，如客戶並未親身出席以供識別、客戶或其實益擁有人已知屬政治人物，或客戶或實益擁有人涉及附表2第15條所指的情況，機構須採取額外措施，以抵銷可能因此而引致的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(4)條

en.q: In what circumstance does the “not physically present” trigger for additional monitoring measures NOT apply?
options: Where the institution carried out the identification and verification measure on the basis of data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system
Where the customer later attends in person at any time
Where the customer is a Hong Kong permanent resident
Where the relationship has been in place for more than two years
en.explain: Section 5(4), added in 2022, disapplies section 5(3)(a) where the institution has carried out the measure referred to in section 2(1)(a) or (ab) on the basis of data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system.

tc.q: 在甚麼情況下，「並未親身出席」這項須採取額外監察措施的觸發條件並不適用？
options: 機構是依據獲認可數碼身分識別系統所提供的數據或資料，進行識別及核實措施
客戶其後在任何時間親身到場
客戶是香港永久性居民
該關係已維持超過兩年
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第5(4)條訂明，如機構是依據獲認可數碼身分識別系統所提供的數據或資料，進行第2(1)(a)或(ab)條所述的措施，則第5(3)(a)款並不適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(5)條

en.q: When does the politically-exposed-person trigger for additional monitoring measures cease to apply?
options: Where the institution is satisfied that the person is a former politically exposed person and does not present a high ML/TF risk based on an appropriate risk assessment
Automatically two years after the person leaves public office
Where the person provides a written declaration that they no longer hold office
Where the person's country is not on any sanctions list
en.explain: Section 5(5), added in 2022, disapplies section 5(3)(b) where the institution is satisfied both that the customer or beneficial owner is a former politically exposed person, and that the former PEP does not present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing based on an appropriate risk assessment.

tc.q: 政治人物這項須採取額外監察措施的觸發條件，在甚麼情況下不再適用？
options: 機構信納該人屬前政治人物，且根據適當的風險評估並不構成高洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該人離任公職兩年後自動不適用
該人提供書面聲明表示已不再擔任職位
該人所屬國家並未列於任何制裁名單
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第5(5)條訂明，如機構信納該客戶或實益擁有人屬前政治人物，並且該前政治人物根據適當的風險評估並不構成高洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險，則第5(3)(b)款並不適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(2)條

en.q: When reviewing documents for a pre-existing customer before first carrying out CDD, what is the institution required to review?
options: Only the documents, data and information relating to the customer that it holds at the time it conducts the review
All documents that could reasonably be obtained from public registers
A full set of fresh identification documents obtained from the customer
Nothing — no review is required until CDD is first carried out
en.explain: Section 5(2) provides that where the institution carries out the section 5(1)(a) duty in relation to a pre-existing customer before first carrying out CDD measures in accordance with Part 2, it is only required to review the documents, data and information relating to the customer that it holds at the time of the review.

tc.q: 就過渡期客戶而言，在首次進行客戶盡職審查前檢視文件時，機構須檢視甚麼？
options: 只須檢視其在進行檢視時所持有的、關於該客戶的文件、數據及資料
從公共登記冊合理地可取得的所有文件
向該客戶重新取得的整套身分識別文件
無須檢視——在首次進行客戶盡職審查前無須檢視
tc.explain: 第5(2)條訂明，如機構在按第2部規定首次就過渡期客戶進行客戶盡職審查措施前，履行第5(1)(a)款的責任，則只須檢視其在進行該項檢視時所持有的、關於該客戶的文件、數據及資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第6(1)(a)條

en.q: Which kind of transaction with a pre-existing customer triggers the CDD requirement under section 6(1)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: A transaction that is unusual or suspicious by virtue of its amount or nature, or that is inconsistent with the institution's knowledge of the customer, their business or risk profile, or the source of their funds
Any transaction exceeding $8,000
The customer's first transaction in any calendar year
Any transaction conducted other than face to face
en.explain: Section 6(1)(a) applies where a transaction takes place that is, by virtue of its amount or nature, unusual or suspicious, or that is not consistent with the institution's knowledge of the customer, the customer's business or risk profile, or the source of the customer's funds. Section 6(1)(b) separately covers a material change in how the account is operated.

tc.q: 與過渡期客戶進行哪類交易會觸發附表2第6(1)(a)條的客戶盡職審查規定？
options: 因其款額或性質而屬不尋常或可疑的交易，或與機構對該客戶、其業務或風險狀況或其資金來源的認識不符的交易
任何超過8,000元的交易
該客戶在任何曆年的首宗交易
任何並非面對面進行的交易
tc.explain: 第6(1)(a)條適用於下列交易：因其款額或性質而屬不尋常或可疑；或與機構對該客戶、該客戶的業務或風險狀況，或該客戶資金來源的認識不符。第6(1)(b)條則另行涵蓋該客戶帳戶運作方式的重大改變。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第6(2)條

en.q: An institution cannot carry out the required CDD measures on a pre-existing customer when a section 6(1) trigger arises. What must it do?
options: Terminate the business relationship with the customer as soon as reasonably practicable
Continue the relationship but restrict transactions to below $8,000
Report the matter to the relevant authority and await instructions
Freeze the customer's funds pending completion of CDD
en.explain: Section 6(2) provides that if the institution is unable to comply with section 6(1), it must terminate the business relationship with the customer as soon as reasonably practicable — the same consequence as under section 3(4)(b).

tc.q: 當第6(1)條的觸發情況出現時，機構無法就過渡期客戶進行所需的客戶盡職審查措施。它須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止與該客戶的業務關係
繼續該關係，但將交易限於8,000元以下
向有關當局報告並等候指示
凍結該客戶的資金，直至完成客戶盡職審查
tc.explain: 第6(2)條訂明，機構如無法遵從第6(1)款，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止與該客戶的業務關係——與第3(4)(b)條的後果相同。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(2)條

en.q: A customer that does not itself qualify for simplified due diligence has, in its beneficial ownership chain, an entity that does. What follows under section 4(2) of Schedule 2?
options: The institution need not identify or verify the beneficial owners of that entity, or of any person in the chain beyond it
The whole customer relationship qualifies for simplified due diligence
The institution must apply enhanced due diligence to the entire chain
The institution must obtain the relevant authority's written confirmation before relying on the exemption
en.explain: Section 4(2) provides that where such an entity appears in the beneficial ownership chain, the institution is not required, when carrying out the section 2(1)(b) measure in respect of beneficial owners in that chain, to identify or verify the identities of that entity's beneficial owners or of any person in the chain beyond that entity.

tc.q: 某客戶本身不符合簡化盡職審查資格，但其實益擁有權鏈中有一實體符合資格。根據附表2第4(2)條有何後果？
options: 機構無須識別或核實該實體的實益擁有人，或該鏈中在該實體以外的任何人的身分
整段客戶關係均符合簡化盡職審查資格
機構須對整條鏈採取加強盡職審查
機構須先取得有關當局的書面確認方可倚賴該項豁免
tc.explain: 第4(2)條訂明，如該實益擁有權鏈中出現該等實體，機構在就該鏈中的實益擁有人進行第2(1)(b)條措施時，無須識別或核實該實體的實益擁有人，或該鏈中在該實體以外的任何人的身分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(5)(a)條

en.q: Which feature must a retirement scheme have to fall within the simplified due diligence product category in section 4(5)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: Contributions are made by way of deduction from income from employment, and the scheme rules do not permit assignment of a member's interest
The scheme is registered with the Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority
The scheme has more than 100 members
The scheme invests only in Hong Kong listed securities
en.explain: Section 4(5)(a) covers a provident, pension, retirement or superannuation scheme providing retirement benefits to employees, where contributions are made by way of deduction from income from employment and the scheme rules do not permit the assignment of a member's interest under the scheme.

tc.q: 退休計劃須具備甚麼特徵，方屬附表2第4(5)(a)條的簡化盡職審查產品類別？
options: 供款以從受僱收入中扣除的方式作出，而計劃規則不准許轉讓成員在該計劃下的權益
該計劃已向強制性公積金計劃管理局登記
該計劃有超過100名成員
該計劃只投資於香港上市證券
tc.explain: 第4(5)(a)條涵蓋向僱員提供退休福利的公積金、退休金、退休或離職金計劃（不論如何描述），而其供款以從受僱收入中扣除的方式作出，且計劃規則不准許轉讓成員在該計劃下的權益。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)(a)條

en.q: What is the purpose of the periodic review of customer documents required by section 5(1)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: To ensure that the documents, data and information obtained for complying with Part 2 remain up-to-date and relevant
To calculate the institution's exposure to each customer
To confirm that the customer has not been the subject of a suspicious transaction report
To satisfy the record-keeping period prescribed by section 20
en.explain: Section 5(1)(a) requires the institution to review from time to time the documents, data and information relating to the customer obtained for the purpose of complying with the requirements imposed under Part 2, to ensure that they are up-to-date and relevant.

tc.q: 附表2第5(1)(a)條所規定的定期檢視客戶文件，目的為何？
options: 確保為遵從第2部規定而取得的文件、數據及資料保持最新及切合所需
計算該機構對每名客戶的風險承擔
確認該客戶並非可疑交易報告的對象
符合第20條訂明的紀錄保存期
tc.explain: 第5(1)(a)條規定機構須不時檢視為遵從第2部下規定而取得的、關於該客戶的文件、數據及資料，以確保其保持最新及切合所需。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第8條

en.q: What is the relationship between the special requirements in Division 2 of Part 2 of Schedule 2 and the general requirements in sections 3 and 5?
options: The Division 2 requirements are additional to those in sections 3 and 5, which must still be complied with
The Division 2 requirements replace those in sections 3 and 5 where they apply
Division 2 applies only where sections 3 and 5 cannot be complied with
Division 2 applies only to DNFBPs, not to financial institutions
en.explain: Section 8 provides that, in addition to complying with the requirements under sections 3 and 5 of Schedule 2, a financial institution or DNFBP must also comply with the requirements under Division 2. The special requirements layer on top of the general ones.

tc.q: 附表2第2部第2分部的特別規定，與第3及5條的一般規定有何關係？
options: 第2分部的規定是在第3及5條的規定以外另加的，後者仍須遵從
在適用時，第2分部的規定取代第3及5條的規定
只有在無法遵從第3及5條時，第2分部方適用
第2分部只適用於指定非金融企業及行業，不適用於金融機構
tc.explain: 第8條訂明，金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業除須遵從附表2第3及5條的規定外，亦須遵從第2分部下的規定。特別規定是疊加於一般規定之上。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)條

en.q: Where a customer has not been physically present for identification, how many of the section 9(1) measures must be carried out?
options: At least one of the three listed measures
All three of the listed measures
At least two of the three listed measures
None, provided the customer is assessed as low risk
en.explain: Section 9(1) requires the institution to carry out at least one of the listed measures: further verification using documents not previously used; supplementary measures to verify information already obtained; or ensuring the first payment is made through an account in the customer's name with a qualifying institution.

tc.q: 如客戶並未親身出席以供識別，須進行第9(1)條下多少項措施？
options: 所列三項措施中至少一項
所列三項措施全部
所列三項措施中至少兩項
無須進行，只要該客戶被評為低風險
tc.explain: 第9(1)條規定機構須進行所列措施中至少一項：以先前未曾使用的文件進一步核實身分；就已取得的資料採取補充措施核實；或確保首筆付款是透過以該客戶名義在合資格機構開立的帳戶作出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)(a)條

en.q: What is distinctive about the documents used for the further verification measure in section 9(1)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: They must be documents, data or information of the kind referred to in section 2(1)(a) or (ab) that were not previously used for verifying that customer's identity
They must be originals rather than copies
They must be certified by a solicitor or notary public
They must be issued within the preceding three months
en.explain: Section 9(1)(a) requires further verification of the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information referred to in section 2(1)(a) or (ab), but not previously used for the purposes of verification of that customer's identity under that section. The point is independent corroboration from a fresh source.

tc.q: 附表2第9(1)(a)條的進一步核實措施所用的文件，有何特別之處？
options: 須屬第2(1)(a)或(ab)條所述類別，並且是先前未曾用於核實該客戶身分的文件、數據或資料
須為正本而非副本
須經律師或公證人核證
須為過去三個月內簽發
tc.explain: 第9(1)(a)條規定須依據第2(1)(a)或(ab)條所述、但先前未曾根據該條用於核實該客戶身分的文件、數據或資料，進一步核實該客戶的身分。重點在於取得來自新來源的獨立佐證。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)(c)條

en.q: What does the payment-routing measure in section 9(1)(c) of Schedule 2 require?
options: Ensuring the payment, or the first of several payments, in relation to the customer's account is carried out through an account opened in the customer's name with an authorized institution or a qualifying overseas institution
Ensuring all payments are made in cash at the institution's premises
Ensuring the customer's first payment does not exceed $8,000
Ensuring payment is made through an account in the name of a person known to the institution
en.explain: Section 9(1)(c) requires the institution to ensure that the payment, or where there is more than one the first payment, in relation to the customer's account is carried out through an account opened in the customer's name with an authorized institution, or with an institution in an equivalent jurisdiction meeting the four stated criteria.

tc.q: 附表2第9(1)(c)條的付款途徑措施有何規定？
options: 確保就該客戶帳戶的付款（如有多於一筆，則為首筆付款）是透過以該客戶名義在認可機構或合資格境外機構開立的帳戶進行
確保所有付款均在該機構處所以現金作出
確保該客戶的首筆付款不超過8,000元
確保付款透過以該機構所認識的人的名義開立的帳戶進行
tc.explain: 第9(1)(c)條規定機構須確保就該客戶帳戶的付款（如有多於一筆付款，則為首筆付款），是透過以該客戶名義在認可機構，或在符合四項訂明準則的同等司法管轄區機構開立的帳戶進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(2)條

en.q: When do the section 9(1) special requirements for non-face-to-face customers NOT apply?
options: Where the institution carried out the section 2(1)(a) or (ab) measure on the basis of data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system
Where the customer subsequently attends the institution's premises
Where the customer is an existing customer of an affiliated institution
Where the transaction amount is below $8,000
en.explain: Section 9(2), added in 2022, provides that section 9(1) does not apply where the institution has carried out the identification and verification measure in section 2(1)(a) or (ab) on the basis of data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system. Section 5(4) makes the parallel exception for ongoing monitoring.

tc.q: 第9(1)條就非面對面客戶的特別規定，在甚麼情況下不適用？
options: 機構是依據獲認可數碼身分識別系統所提供的數據或資料，進行第2(1)(a)或(ab)條的措施
該客戶其後親身到該機構的處所
該客戶是相聯機構的現有客戶
交易款額低於8,000元
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第9(2)條訂明，如機構是依據獲認可數碼身分識別系統所提供的數據或資料，進行第2(1)(a)或(ab)條的識別及核實措施，則第9(1)條並不適用。第5(4)條就持續監察訂有相對應的例外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10(1)條

en.q: Before establishing a business relationship with a customer known to be a politically exposed person, what two steps must an institution take?
options: Obtain approval from senior management, and take reasonable measures to establish the source of wealth and the source of the funds involved in the proposed relationship
Obtain approval from the relevant authority, and file a suspicious transaction report
Obtain a written declaration of assets, and impose a transaction ceiling
Verify identity twice, using two separate governmental documents
en.explain: Section 10(1) requires the institution, before establishing the relationship, to obtain approval from senior management and to take reasonable measures to establish the customer's or beneficial owner's source of wealth and the source of the funds that will be involved in the proposed business relationship.

tc.q: 與已知屬政治人物的客戶建立業務關係前，機構須採取哪兩項步驟？
options: 取得高級管理層的批准，並採取合理措施確定財富來源及擬建立的關係將涉及的資金來源
取得有關當局的批准，並提交可疑交易報告
取得書面資產聲明，並設定交易上限
以兩份不同的政府文件核實身分兩次
tc.explain: 第10(1)條規定機構在建立該關係前，須取得高級管理層的批准，並採取合理措施確定該客戶或實益擁有人的財富來源，以及擬建立的業務關係將涉及的資金來源。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10(2)條

en.q: An existing customer becomes a politically exposed person. What does section 10(2) of Schedule 2 require?
options: The institution must not continue the business relationship unless it has obtained senior management approval and taken reasonable measures to establish the source of wealth and source of funds involved
The institution must terminate the relationship immediately
The institution must report the change to the relevant authority within 7 days
No action is required until the next periodic review
en.explain: Section 10(2) provides that where the institution comes to know that an existing customer or a beneficial owner is or has become a politically exposed person, it must not continue the business relationship unless it has obtained senior management approval and taken reasonable measures to establish the source of wealth and the source of the funds involved in the relationship.

tc.q: 現有客戶成為政治人物。附表2第10(2)條有何規定？
options: 除非機構已取得高級管理層批准，並已採取合理措施確定財富來源及該關係所涉的資金來源，否則不得繼續該業務關係
機構須即時終止該關係
機構須於7日內將該轉變報告有關當局
在下次定期檢視前無須採取行動
tc.explain: 第10(2)條訂明，如機構得悉現有客戶或其實益擁有人屬政治人物或已成為政治人物，除非該機構已取得高級管理層批准，並已採取合理措施確定該客戶或實益擁有人的財富來源，以及該業務關係所涉的資金來源，否則不得繼續該業務關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10(1)及(2)條（觸發條件）

en.q: From what sources of knowledge does the politically exposed person requirement in section 10 of Schedule 2 arise?
options: Publicly known information, or information in the institution's own possession
Only a designation published in the Gazette
Only information supplied by the relevant authority
Only a declaration made by the customer on account opening
en.explain: Sections 10(1) and (2) are engaged where the institution knows, from publicly known information or information in its own possession, that a customer or beneficial owner is or has become a politically exposed person. The same formulation appears in section 5(3)(b).

tc.q: 附表2第10條的政治人物規定，源自哪些知悉途徑？
options: 公眾已知的資料，或該機構本身所管有的資料
只限憲報公布的指定
只限有關當局提供的資料
只限客戶在開立帳戶時所作的聲明
tc.explain: 第10(1)及(2)條在機構從公眾已知的資料或其本身管有的資料而知道客戶或實益擁有人屬政治人物或已成為政治人物時適用。第5(3)(b)條採用相同的表述。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10(3)條

en.q: On what two conditions do the politically exposed person requirements in section 10 cease to apply?
options: The institution is satisfied that the person is a former politically exposed person, and that they do not present a high ML/TF risk based on an appropriate risk assessment
The person has been out of office for at least five years, and holds no public appointment
The person's country has been removed from any FATF monitoring list
The person's account has been dormant for twelve months
en.explain: Section 10(3), added in 2022, disapplies subsections (1) and (2) where the institution is satisfied both that the customer or beneficial owner is a former politically exposed person, and that the former PEP does not present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing based on an appropriate risk assessment.

tc.q: 第10條的政治人物規定在符合哪兩項條件下不再適用？
options: 機構信納該人屬前政治人物，並且根據適當的風險評估，該人並不構成高洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該人已離任至少五年，並無擔任任何公職
該人所屬國家已從任何財務行動特別組織監察名單中剔除
該人的帳戶已不活躍十二個月
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第10(3)條訂明，如機構信納該客戶或實益擁有人屬前政治人物，並且該前政治人物根據適當的風險評估並不構成高洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險，則第(1)及(2)款並不適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第11(1)條

en.q: Where the beneficiary of an insurance policy is designated by description rather than by name, what must the financial institution do?
options: Obtain sufficient information about the beneficiary to satisfy itself that it will be able to establish their identity at the earlier of the exercise of rights or the first payout
Refuse to accept the designation until a name is provided
Treat the policy holder as the beneficiary for CDD purposes
Verify the identity of every person who could possibly fall within the description
en.explain: Section 11(1)(b) requires the institution, where the beneficiary is designated by description or other means, to obtain sufficient information about the beneficiary to satisfy itself that it will be able to establish the beneficiary's identity at the time rights are exercised or at the time of the first payout, whichever is the earlier.

tc.q: 如保險保單的受益人是以描述而非姓名指定，金融機構須怎樣做？
options: 取得關於該受益人的充分資料，以令其信納能在行使權利或首次派款兩者中較早者的時間確定該受益人的身分
在提供姓名前拒絕接受該項指定
就客戶盡職審查而言，視保單持有人為受益人
核實所有可能符合該描述的每一個人的身分
tc.explain: 第11(1)(b)條規定，如受益人是以描述或其他方式指定，機構須取得關於該受益人的充分資料，以令其信納能在該受益人行使保單所賦予的權利時，或按保單條款首次派款時（以較早者為準）確定該受益人的身分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第11(2)條

en.q: At what point must a financial institution verify the identity of an insurance policy beneficiary under section 11(2) of Schedule 2?
options: At the time the beneficiary exercises a right under the policy, or at the time of the first payout, whichever is the earlier
At the time the policy is issued, in every case
Within 30 days after the beneficiary is designated
Only if the payout exceeds $120,000
en.explain: Section 11(2) requires the specified measures to be carried out at the time the beneficiary exercises a right vested in them under the policy, or at the time of payout (or the first payout where there is more than one), whichever is the earlier.

tc.q: 根據附表2第11(2)條，金融機構須於何時核實保險保單受益人的身分？
options: 該受益人行使保單所賦予的權利時，或首次派款時，以較早者為準
在任何情況下均於保單簽發時
於指定受益人後30日內
只在派款超過120,000元時
tc.explain: 第11(2)條規定須於該受益人行使保單所賦予其的權利時，或於派款時（如有多於一次派款，則為首次派款時），以較早者為準，進行所指明的措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第11(3)(b)條

en.q: Where an insurance policy beneficiary is a legal person or trust, when must the institution verify the beneficial owners' identities?
options: Where there is a high risk of ML/TF having regard to the particular circumstances of the beneficial owners; identification alone is required otherwise
In every case, to the same standard as the customer
Never — identification of the legal person alone suffices
Only where the payout exceeds $8,000
en.explain: Section 11(3)(b) requires identifying the beneficial owners of a beneficiary that is a legal person or trust and, if there is a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing having regard to the particular circumstances of the beneficial owners, taking reasonable measures to verify their identities so that the institution knows who they are.

tc.q: 如保險保單受益人是法人或信託，機構須於何時核實實益擁有人的身分？
options: 當顧及該等實益擁有人的特定情況而存在高洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險時；否則只須識別
在任何情況下均須，並以與客戶相同的標準
永不需要——只識別該法人已足夠
只在派款超過8,000元時
tc.explain: 第11(3)(b)條規定須識別屬法人或信託的受益人的實益擁有人；如顧及該等實益擁有人的特定情況而存在高洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險，則須採取合理措施核實其身分，以令該機構知悉他們是何人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(2)(a)及(b)條

en.q: Which wire transfers are excluded from section 12 of Schedule 2 on the basis of who the parties are?
options: A transfer between two financial institutions, or between a financial institution and a foreign institution, where each acts on its own behalf
Any transfer between two institutions located in Hong Kong
Any transfer where the originator and recipient are the same person
Any transfer below $8,000
en.explain: Section 12(2)(a) and (b) exclude a wire transfer between two financial institutions if each acts on its own behalf, and a wire transfer between a financial institution and a foreign institution if each acts on its own behalf. Acting on one's own behalf, rather than for a customer, is the key.

tc.q: 按照交易各方的身分，哪些電匯不受附表2第12條規管？
options: 兩間金融機構之間，或金融機構與外地機構之間的轉帳，而各方均為其本身行事
任何兩間位於香港的機構之間的轉帳
匯款人與收款人是同一人的任何轉帳
任何低於8,000元的轉帳
tc.explain: 第12(2)(a)及(b)條將兩間金融機構之間（各方均為其本身行事）的電匯，以及金融機構與外地機構之間（各方均為其本身行事）的電匯排除在外。關鍵在於各方是為其本身而非為客戶行事。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(2)(c)條

en.q: Three conditions must all be met for the card-transaction exclusion in section 12(2)(c) of Schedule 2. Which is one of them?
options: The card is not used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer
The transaction is carried out within Hong Kong only
The cardholder has been subject to full CDD within the preceding twelve months
The transaction amount is below $8,000
en.explain: Section 12(2)(c) requires that the transfer arises from a credit, debit or prepaid card transaction such as an ATM withdrawal, cash advance or payment for goods or services; that the card is not used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer; and that the card number or equivalent unique identifier accompanies the transfer.

tc.q: 附表2第12(2)(c)條的信用卡交易例外須同時符合三項條件。下列何者為其中一項？
options: 該卡並非用作支付系統以進行人對人轉帳
該交易只在香港境內進行
該持卡人於過去十二個月內已接受全面客戶盡職審查
交易款額低於8,000元
tc.explain: 第12(2)(c)條規定：該轉帳源自信用卡、扣賬卡或預付卡交易（例如自動櫃員機提款、信用卡透支現金或以卡支付貨品或服務）；該卡並非用作支付系統以進行人對人轉帳；及該卡的號碼（或等同的獨有識別碼）載於隨附該轉帳的訊息或付款表格內。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(3)條

en.q: Which items must an ordering institution record before carrying out a wire transfer under section 12(3) of Schedule 2?
options: The originator's name and account number (or unique reference), the originator's address or identification details, and the recipient's name and account number (or unique reference)
Only the originator's name and the amount transferred
Only the recipient's name and address
The originator's name and the purpose of the transfer
en.explain: Section 12(3) requires the ordering institution to record the originator's name; the number of the originator's account from which the money is paid or a unique reference number; the originator's address, customer identification number or identification document number or, for an individual, date and place of birth; the recipient's name; and the recipient's account number or a unique reference number.

tc.q: 根據附表2第12(3)條，匯出機構在進行電匯前須記錄哪些項目？
options: 匯款人姓名及帳戶號碼（或獨有參考編號）、匯款人地址或身分識別詳情，以及收款人姓名及帳戶號碼（或獨有參考編號）
只需匯款人姓名及匯款金額
只需收款人姓名及地址
匯款人姓名及該項轉帳的目的
tc.explain: 第12(3)條規定匯出機構須記錄匯款人姓名；支付該電匯款項的匯款人帳戶號碼，或（如無該帳戶）該機構為該電匯編配的獨有參考編號；匯款人地址、客戶識別編號或身分證明文件號碼，或（如匯款人是個人）其出生日期及地點；收款人姓名；以及收款人帳戶號碼或獨有參考編號。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(3A)條

en.q: Which recording requirement does NOT apply to a wire transfer below $8,000?
options: Section 12(3)(c) — the originator's address, customer identification number or identification document number, or date and place of birth
Section 12(3)(a) — the originator's name
Section 12(3)(d) — the recipient's name
Section 12(3)(e) — the recipient's account number
en.explain: Section 12(3A) provides that section 12(3)(c) does not apply to a wire transfer involving an amount below $8,000 or the equivalent in another currency. The name and account details of both originator and recipient must still be recorded.

tc.q: 就低於8,000元的電匯，哪一項記錄規定並不適用？
options: 第12(3)(c)條——匯款人地址、客戶識別編號或身分證明文件號碼，或出生日期及地點
第12(3)(a)條——匯款人姓名
第12(3)(d)條——收款人姓名
第12(3)(e)條——收款人帳戶號碼
tc.explain: 第12(3A)條訂明，第12(3)(c)款不適用於涉及款額低於8,000元（或另一貨幣等值款額）的電匯。匯款人及收款人的姓名及帳戶詳情仍須記錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(5)(b)條

en.q: For a wire transfer below $8,000, which recorded information must accompany the transfer in the message or payment form?
options: The information recorded under section 12(3)(a), (b), (d) and (e) — the names and account numbers of originator and recipient
All the information recorded under section 12(3)
Only the originator's name
No accompanying information is required below the threshold
en.explain: Section 12(5)(b) requires, for a transfer below $8,000, the information recorded under section 12(3)(a), (b), (d) and (e) to accompany the transfer. Section 12(5)(a) requires the full set including paragraph (c) for transfers of $8,000 or above.

tc.q: 就低於8,000元的電匯，訊息或付款表格內須隨附哪些已記錄的資料？
options: 根據第12(3)(a)、(b)、(d)及(e)款記錄的資料——即匯款人及收款人的姓名及帳戶號碼
根據第12(3)條記錄的所有資料
只需匯款人姓名
低於該門檻無須隨附任何資料
tc.explain: 第12(5)(b)條規定，就低於8,000元的轉帳，須隨附根據第12(3)(a)、(b)、(d)及(e)款記錄的資料。第12(5)(a)條則就8,000元或以上的轉帳，規定須隨附包括(c)款在內的全套資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(6)條

en.q: A financial institution includes only the originator's account number with a domestic wire transfer. What must it then be able to do?
options: Provide the originator's name and address details to the receiving institution or the relevant authority within 3 business days of a request
Provide the full information to every institution in the payment chain automatically
Obtain the relevant authority's prior approval for the abbreviated format
Repeat the transfer in full format within 24 hours
en.explain: Section 12(6) permits a domestic wire transfer to carry only the section 12(3)(b) account information, but requires the institution, on request by the institution to which it passes the transfer instruction or by the relevant authority, to provide the section 12(3)(a) and (c) information within 3 business days after receiving the request.

tc.q: 某金融機構就本地電匯只附上匯款人的帳戶號碼。它其後須能夠作出甚麼？
options: 在接獲要求後3個營業日內，向接收機構或有關當局提供匯款人的姓名及地址等資料
自動向付款鏈上的每一間機構提供全套資料
就該簡化格式事先取得有關當局批准
於24小時內以完整格式重新進行該轉帳
tc.explain: 第12(6)條准許本地電匯只附上第12(3)(b)款的帳戶資料，但規定該機構須應其傳遞轉帳指示的機構或有關當局的要求，在接獲要求後3個營業日內提供第12(3)(a)及(c)款的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(7)條

en.q: Several individual wire transfers from a single originator are bundled in a batch file for recipients outside Hong Kong. On what conditions is the ordering institution relieved of the full accompanying-information requirement for each transfer?
options: The section 12(3)(b) account information accompanies each transfer, and the batch file itself contains the information recorded under section 12(3)
The batch contains no more than 100 individual transfers
Each individual transfer is below $8,000
The recipients are all located in an equivalent jurisdiction
en.explain: Section 12(7) relieves the institution from complying with section 12(5) for each individual transfer in a cross-border batch file if the information recorded under section 12(3)(b) is included in the message or payment form accompanying each transfer, and the batch file contains the information recorded under section 12(3).

tc.q: 來自單一匯款人的多筆個別電匯，被匯集於一個批次檔案內以轉送香港以外的收款人。匯出機構在甚麼條件下可獲免除就每筆轉帳附上全套資料的規定？
options: 每筆轉帳均附有第12(3)(b)款的帳戶資料，而該批次檔案本身載有根據第12(3)條記錄的資料
該批次包含不多於100筆個別轉帳
每筆個別轉帳均低於8,000元
收款人全部位於同等司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第12(7)條訂明，如隨附每筆轉帳的訊息或付款表格載有根據第12(3)(b)款記錄的資料，而該批次檔案載有根據第12(3)條記錄的資料，則機構無須就跨境批次檔案內的每筆轉帳遵從第12(5)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(8)條

en.q: What is the obligation of a financial institution acting as an intermediary institution in a wire transfer?
options: It must transmit all of the information it receives with the transfer to the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction
It must verify the originator's identity before passing on the transfer
It must record the information afresh in its own format
It must retain the information and pass on only the account numbers
en.explain: Section 12(8) requires a financial institution acting as an intermediary institution in a wire transfer to transmit all of the information that it receives with the transfer to the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction. Stripping information from the chain is prohibited.

tc.q: 在電匯中擔任中介機構的金融機構有何責任？
options: 須將其隨該轉帳收到的所有資料，傳送予其傳遞轉帳指示的機構
須在傳遞轉帳前核實匯款人身分
須以其本身格式重新記錄該等資料
須保留該等資料，並只傳遞帳戶號碼
tc.explain: 第12(8)條規定，在電匯中擔任中介機構的金融機構，須將其隨該轉帳收到的所有資料，傳送予其傳遞轉帳指示的機構。禁止在傳遞鏈中刪減資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(10)(a)條

en.q: A beneficiary institution receives a cross-border wire transfer missing required information and cannot obtain it from the sending institution. What are its options?
options: Consider restricting or terminating its business relationship with that institution, or take reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved
Return the funds to the originator immediately
Complete the transfer and record the deficiency for the annual audit
Report the sending institution to the relevant authority within 3 business days
en.explain: Section 12(10)(a)(ii) requires the institution, where missing information cannot be obtained, either to consider restricting or terminating its business relationship with the institution from which it received the transfer instruction, or to take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved.

tc.q: 收款機構收到一筆缺少所需資料的跨境電匯，並且無法從匯出機構取得該等資料。它有哪些選擇？
options: 考慮限制或終止與該機構的業務關係，或採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
立即將款項退回匯款人
完成該轉帳並記錄該項不足之處以供年度審計
於3個營業日內向有關當局舉報該匯出機構
tc.explain: 第12(10)(a)(ii)條規定，如無法取得欠缺的資料，機構須考慮限制或終止與其接獲轉帳指示的機構的業務關係，或採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(10)(b)條

en.q: A beneficiary institution notices that the information accompanying a cross-border wire transfer is incomplete or meaningless. What must it do?
options: As soon as reasonably practicable, take reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved
Complete the transfer without further action, since some information was provided
Reject the transfer automatically in every case
Refer the matter to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 12(10)(b) requires the institution, where it is aware that accompanying information purporting to be the required information is incomplete or meaningless, to take reasonable measures as soon as reasonably practicable to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved.

tc.q: 收款機構察覺隨附跨境電匯的資料不完整或無意義。它須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
既已提供部分資料，即可完成轉帳而無須再採取行動
在任何情況下均自動拒絕該項轉帳
將事宜轉交審裁處
tc.explain: 第12(10)(b)條規定，如機構察覺看來是所需資料的隨附資料並不完整或無意義，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。
