source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.12(11) (definition of “domestic wire transfer”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(11)條（「本地電匯」的定義）

en.q: What makes a wire transfer a “domestic wire transfer” under section 12(11) of Schedule 2?
options: The ordering institution, the beneficiary institution and every intermediary institution involved are financial institutions located in Hong Kong
The originator and recipient are both Hong Kong residents
The transfer is denominated in Hong Kong dollars
The transfer amount is below $8,000
en.explain: Section 12(11) defines domestic wire transfer as a wire transfer in which the ordering institution and the beneficiary institution and, if one or more intermediary institutions are involved, the intermediary institution or all the intermediary institutions are financial institutions located in Hong Kong.

tc.q: 根據附表2第12(11)條，甚麼令一筆電匯成為「本地電匯」？
options: 匯出機構、收款機構及所涉的每一間中介機構，均為位於香港的金融機構
匯款人及收款人均為香港居民
該轉帳以港元計值
該轉帳款額低於8,000元
tc.explain: 第12(11)條界定「本地電匯」為：匯出機構及收款機構，以及（如涉及一間或多於一間中介機構）該中介機構或所有中介機構，均為位於香港的金融機構的電匯。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(11)條（「匯款人」的定義）

en.q: Who is the “originator” of a wire transfer under section 12(11) of Schedule 2?
options: The person from whose account with the ordering institution the money is paid or, in the absence of such an account, the person who instructs the ordering institution to carry out the transfer
The person who ultimately benefits from the transfer
The financial institution that initiates the transfer
The person named as sender in the message accompanying the transfer, whoever that may be
en.explain: Section 12(11) defines originator, in relation to a wire transfer, as the person from whose account with the ordering institution the money for the wire transfer is paid, or, in the absence of such an account, the person who instructs the ordering institution to carry out the wire transfer.

tc.q: 根據附表2第12(11)條，電匯的「匯款人」是誰？
options: 支付該電匯款項的、在匯出機構開立帳戶的人；如無該帳戶，則為指示匯出機構進行該電匯的人
最終從該轉帳得益的人
發起該轉帳的金融機構
隨附該轉帳的訊息內列為寄款人的人，不論其為何人
tc.explain: 第12(11)條就電匯界定「匯款人」為：支付該電匯款項的、在匯出機構開立帳戶的人；或如無該帳戶，則為指示匯出機構進行該電匯的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(11)條（「外地機構」的定義）

en.q: How is a “foreign institution” defined for the purposes of section 12 of Schedule 2?
options: An institution located in a place outside Hong Kong that carries on a business similar to that carried on by a financial institution
Any institution incorporated outside Hong Kong
Any institution supervised by an authority outside Hong Kong
Any institution that is not an authorized institution
en.explain: Section 12(11) defines foreign institution as an institution that is located in a place outside Hong Kong and that carries on a business similar to that carried on by a financial institution. The definition matters for the section 12(2)(b) exclusion.

tc.q: 就附表2第12條而言，「外地機構」如何界定？
options: 位於香港以外地方，並經營與金融機構所經營者類似業務的機構
在香港以外註冊成立的任何機構
受香港以外當局監管的任何機構
並非認可機構的任何機構
tc.explain: 第12(11)條界定「外地機構」為位於香港以外地方，並經營與金融機構所經營者類似業務的機構。此定義對第12(2)(b)條的例外規定十分重要。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(1)條

en.q: To which transactions does section 13 of Schedule 2 apply?
options: A remittance transaction, other than a wire transfer, involving an amount equal to or above $8,000, carried out by a licensed money service operator
Any remittance transaction of any amount carried out by any financial institution
Only remittance transactions above $120,000
All wire transfers carried out by a licensed money service operator
en.explain: Section 13(1) applies to a remittance transaction, other than a wire transfer, involving an amount equal to or above $8,000 or the equivalent in any other currency, that is carried out by a licensed money service operator. Wire transfers are governed by section 12.

tc.q: 附表2第13條適用於哪些交易？
options: 由持牌金錢服務經營者進行、涉及款額相等於或高於8,000元、並非電匯的匯款交易
任何金融機構進行的任何款額的任何匯款交易
只限超過120,000元的匯款交易
持牌金錢服務經營者進行的所有電匯
tc.explain: 第13(1)條適用於由持牌金錢服務經營者進行、涉及款額相等於或高於8,000元（或任何其他貨幣等值款額）、並非電匯的匯款交易。電匯則由第12條規管。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(2)(b)條

en.q: By reference to what must a licensed MSO verify the identity of the originator of a section 13 remittance transaction?
options: The originator's identification document
A written declaration signed by the originator
A reference from another licensed money service operator
A record of the originator's previous transactions with the MSO
en.explain: Section 13(2) requires the licensed MSO, before carrying out the remittance transaction, to identify the originator and to verify the originator's identity by reference to the originator's identification document, and then to record the specified particulars.

tc.q: 持牌金錢服務經營者須參照甚麼核實第13條匯款交易的匯款人身分？
options: 該匯款人的身分證明文件
該匯款人簽署的書面聲明
另一持牌金錢服務經營者的推薦
該匯款人過往與該經營者的交易紀錄
tc.explain: 第13(2)條規定持牌金錢服務經營者在進行該匯款交易前，須識別匯款人，並參照該匯款人的身分證明文件核實其身分，繼而記錄所指明的詳情。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(2)(c)(ii)條

en.q: Where the originator's identification document is a travel document, what additional particular must a licensed MSO record?
options: The place of issue of the travel document
The expiry date of the travel document
The originator's nationality as stated in the document
The visa status of the originator
en.explain: Section 13(2)(c)(ii) requires the MSO to record the originator's identification document number and, if the identification document is a travel document, the place of issue of the travel document.

tc.q: 如匯款人的身分證明文件是旅行證件，持牌金錢服務經營者須另行記錄甚麼詳情？
options: 該旅行證件的簽發地點
該旅行證件的屆滿日期
該文件所載的匯款人國籍
該匯款人的簽證狀況
tc.explain: 第13(2)(c)(ii)條規定該經營者須記錄匯款人的身分證明文件號碼；如該身分證明文件是旅行證件，並須記錄該旅行證件的簽發地點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(2)(c)(v)條

en.q: Which of the following must a licensed MSO record under section 13(2)(c)(v) of Schedule 2?
options: The date and time of receipt of the instructions, the recipient's name and address, and the method of delivery
The exchange rate applied and the commission charged
The originator's occupation and employer
The purpose of the remittance as stated by the originator
en.explain: Section 13(2)(c) requires recording the originator's name; identification document number and, for a travel document, place of issue; address; the currency and amount involved; and the date and time of receipt of the instructions, the recipient's name and address and the method of delivery.

tc.q: 根據附表2第13(2)(c)(v)條，持牌金錢服務經營者須記錄下列哪項？
options: 接獲指示的日期及時間、收款人的姓名及地址，以及交付方法
所採用的匯率及所收取的佣金
匯款人的職業及僱主
匯款人所述的匯款目的
tc.explain: 第13(2)(c)條規定須記錄匯款人姓名；身分證明文件號碼，及（如屬旅行證件）簽發地點；地址；所涉貨幣及款額；以及接獲指示的日期及時間、收款人的姓名及地址和交付方法。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(3)條（「匯款交易」的定義）

en.q: How is “remittance transaction” defined for the purposes of section 13 of Schedule 2?
options: A transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong
Any transfer of money between two parties in Hong Kong
Any exchange of one currency for another as a business
Any transfer of value, including virtual assets, across a border
en.explain: Section 13(3) defines remittance transaction as a transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong. Note that this is narrower than the Schedule 1 definition of remittance service, which also covers receiving money from outside Hong Kong.

tc.q: 就附表2第13條而言，「匯款交易」如何界定？
options: 將金錢寄往香港以外地方或安排寄往香港以外地方的交易
在香港境內兩方之間的任何金錢轉移
以業務方式將一種貨幣兌換為另一種
跨境的任何價值轉移，包括虛擬資產
tc.explain: 第13(3)條界定「匯款交易」為將金錢寄往香港以外地方或安排寄往香港以外地方的交易。留意此定義較附表1「匯款服務」的定義為窄，後者亦涵蓋從香港以外地方收取金錢。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(3)條（「匯款人」的定義）

en.q: Who is the “originator” of a remittance transaction carried out by a licensed MSO?
options: The person from whose account with the MSO the money is paid or, in the absence of such an account, the person who instructs the MSO to carry out the transaction
The person who physically hands over the cash at the counter, whoever that is
The person named as recipient in the instruction
The MSO's staff member who processes the transaction
en.explain: Section 13(3) defines originator, in relation to a remittance transaction carried out by a licensed MSO, as the person from whose account with the MSO the money for the remittance is paid, or, in the absence of such an account, the person who instructs the MSO to carry out the remittance transaction.

tc.q: 持牌金錢服務經營者進行的匯款交易的「匯款人」是誰？
options: 支付該匯款款項的、在該經營者開立帳戶的人；如無該帳戶，則為指示該經營者進行該交易的人
在櫃檯實際交付現金的人，不論其為何人
指示中列為收款人的人
處理該交易的該經營者職員
tc.explain: 第13(3)條就持牌金錢服務經營者進行的匯款交易界定「匯款人」為：支付該匯款款項的、在該經營者開立帳戶的人；或如無該帳戶，則為指示該經營者進行該匯款交易的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13A(1)條

en.q: What are the two essential elements of a “virtual asset transfer” under section 13A(1) of Schedule 2?
options: It is carried out by an ordering institution on behalf of an originator by transferring virtual assets, with a view to making them available to a recipient at a beneficiary institution
It involves virtual assets and is carried out between two individuals directly
It involves the conversion of virtual assets into fiat currency
It involves virtual assets and exceeds $120,000 in value
en.explain: Section 13A(1) defines a virtual asset transfer as a transaction carried out by an institution (the ordering institution) on behalf of an originator by transferring any virtual assets, with a view to making the virtual assets available to that person or another person (the recipient) at an institution (the beneficiary institution), whether or not intermediary institutions participate.

tc.q: 根據附表2第13A(1)條，「虛擬資產轉移」的兩項要素是甚麼？
options: 由匯出機構代匯款人以轉移虛擬資產的方式進行，並旨在使該等虛擬資產可在收款機構供收款人取用
涉及虛擬資產，並在兩名個人之間直接進行
涉及將虛擬資產兌換為法定貨幣
涉及虛擬資產，且價值超過120,000元
tc.explain: 第13A(1)條界定「虛擬資產轉移」為由某機構（匯出機構）代匯款人以轉移任何虛擬資產的方式進行的交易，並旨在使該等虛擬資產可在某機構（收款機構）供該人或另一人（收款人）取用，不論是否有中介機構參與完成該項轉移。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第11(1)(a)條

en.q: Where the beneficiary of an insurance policy is identified by name, what must the financial institution do at that point?
options: Record the name of the beneficiary
Verify the beneficiary's identity immediately
Obtain senior management approval for the designation
Notify the relevant authority of the designation
en.explain: Section 11(1)(a) requires the institution, whenever a beneficiary or new beneficiary is identified or designated by the policy holder, to record the name of the beneficiary where the beneficiary is identified by name. Verification comes later, under section 11(2).

tc.q: 如保險保單的受益人是以姓名識別，金融機構當時須怎樣做？
options: 記錄該受益人的姓名
即時核實該受益人的身分
就該項指定取得高級管理層批准
將該項指定通知有關當局
tc.explain: 第11(1)(a)條規定，每當保單持有人識別或指定受益人或新受益人時，如該受益人是以姓名識別，機構須記錄該受益人的姓名。核實則按第11(2)條在較後階段進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)(b)條

en.q: What is the supplementary measure available under section 9(1)(b) of Schedule 2 for a non-face-to-face customer?
options: Taking supplementary measures to verify information relating to the customer that has already been obtained by the institution
Requiring the customer to attend in person within 30 days
Obtaining a guarantee from another financial institution
Limiting the customer's transactions to below $8,000
en.explain: Section 9(1)(b) allows the institution to take supplementary measures to verify information relating to the customer that has been obtained by the institution. It is an alternative to the further-verification measure in paragraph (a) and the payment-routing measure in paragraph (c).

tc.q: 附表2第9(1)(b)條就非面對面客戶提供甚麼補充措施？
options: 採取補充措施，核實該機構已取得的、關於該客戶的資料
要求該客戶於30日內親身到場
取得另一金融機構的擔保
將該客戶的交易限於8,000元以下
tc.explain: 第9(1)(b)條准許機構採取補充措施，核實該機構已取得的、關於該客戶的資料。這是(a)款進一步核實措施及(c)款付款途徑措施以外的另一選擇。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(9)(a)條

en.q: A beneficiary institution in a domestic wire transfer finds the section 12(3)(b) account information missing. What must it do first?
options: As soon as reasonably practicable, obtain the information from the institution from which it received the transfer instruction
Return the funds to the ordering institution
Report the omission to the relevant authority within 3 business days
Complete the transfer and note the omission in its records
en.explain: Section 12(9)(a)(i) requires the beneficiary institution, as soon as reasonably practicable, to obtain the missing information from the institution from which it receives the transfer instruction; only if it cannot be obtained do the options in sub-paragraph (ii) — restricting or terminating the relationship, or mitigating the risk — arise.

tc.q: 本地電匯的收款機構發現欠缺第12(3)(b)款的帳戶資料。它須首先怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快，向其接獲轉帳指示的機構取得該資料
將款項退回匯出機構
於3個營業日內向有關當局報告該項遺漏
完成該轉帳並在其紀錄中註明該項遺漏
tc.explain: 第12(9)(a)(i)條規定收款機構須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快，向其接獲轉帳指示的機構取得欠缺的資料；只有在無法取得時，方會出現(ii)節的選擇——限制或終止關係，或減低風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(5)(a)條

en.q: For a wire transfer of $8,000 or above, which information must accompany the transfer?
options: All the information recorded under section 12(3)(a), (b), (c), (d) and (e)
Only the originator's and recipient's names
Only the account numbers of originator and recipient
The information recorded under section 12(3) except the recipient's details
en.explain: Section 12(5)(a) requires, for a wire transfer involving an amount equal to or above $8,000 or the equivalent in another currency, that the information recorded under section 12(3)(a), (b), (c), (d) and (e) accompanies the transfer in the message or payment form.

tc.q: 就8,000元或以上的電匯，須隨附哪些資料？
options: 根據第12(3)(a)、(b)、(c)、(d)及(e)款記錄的所有資料
只需匯款人及收款人的姓名
只需匯款人及收款人的帳戶號碼
根據第12(3)條記錄的資料，但收款人詳情除外
tc.explain: 第12(5)(a)條規定，就涉及款額相等於或高於8,000元（或另一貨幣等值款額）的電匯，須在訊息或付款表格內隨附根據第12(3)(a)、(b)、(c)、(d)及(e)款記錄的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(2)(c)(i)條

en.q: Which of the following is given in section 12(2)(c)(i) as an example of a card transaction potentially outside section 12?
options: Withdrawing money from a bank account through an automated teller machine with a debit card
Transferring funds from one cardholder to another using a card-based application
Loading value onto a prepaid card from a bank account
Settling a monthly credit card statement by bank transfer
en.explain: Section 12(2)(c)(i) gives as examples withdrawing money from a bank account through an ATM with a debit card, obtaining a cash advance on a credit card, and paying for goods or services with a credit, debit or prepaid card. A person-to-person transfer is expressly excluded from the exception by sub-paragraph (ii).

tc.q: 第12(2)(c)(i)條舉出下列哪項作為可能不受第12條規管的卡交易例子？
options: 以扣賬卡透過自動櫃員機從銀行帳戶提款
以卡類應用程式將資金由一名持卡人轉至另一名持卡人
從銀行帳戶為預付卡增值
以銀行轉帳清繳每月信用卡結單
tc.explain: 第12(2)(c)(i)條所舉例子包括以扣賬卡透過自動櫃員機從銀行帳戶提款、以信用卡透支現金，以及以信用卡、扣賬卡或預付卡支付貨品或服務。(ii)節明文將人對人轉帳排除於該例外之外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(2)條

en.q: At what point must a licensed MSO carry out the section 13 identification, verification and recording steps?
options: Before carrying out the remittance transaction
Within 24 hours after carrying out the transaction
At the end of the business day on which the transaction is carried out
Only if the transaction is later queried by the relevant authority
en.explain: Section 13(2) requires the licensed money service operator, before carrying out a remittance transaction to which section 13 applies, to identify the originator, verify the originator's identity by reference to their identification document, and record the specified particulars.

tc.q: 持牌金錢服務經營者須於何時進行第13條的識別、核實及記錄步驟？
options: 在進行該匯款交易之前
在進行該交易後24小時內
在進行該交易當日的營業時間結束前
只在該交易其後被有關當局查詢時
tc.explain: 第13(2)條規定持牌金錢服務經營者在進行第13條適用的匯款交易之前，須識別匯款人、參照其身分證明文件核實其身分，並記錄所指明的詳情。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第11(3)(a)條

en.q: On the basis of documents from which sources must a financial institution verify an insurance beneficiary's identity under section 11(3)(a)?
options: A governmental body, the relevant authority or any other relevant authority, a similar overseas authority, or any other reliable and independent source recognized by the relevant authority
Only documents provided by the policy holder
Only documents certified by the insurer's own compliance officer
Only documents issued within the preceding six months
en.explain: Section 11(3)(a) requires verification of the beneficiary's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a governmental body; the relevant authority or any other relevant authority; an authority outside Hong Kong performing similar functions; or any other reliable and independent source recognized by the relevant authority.

tc.q: 根據第11(3)(a)條，金融機構須依據來自哪些來源的文件核實保險受益人的身分？
options: 政府機構、有關當局或任何其他有關當局、職能類似的境外當局，或有關當局認可的任何其他可靠而獨立的來源
只限保單持有人提供的文件
只限經該保險人本身合規主任核證的文件
只限過去六個月內簽發的文件
tc.explain: 第11(3)(a)條規定須依據下列來源提供的文件、數據或資料核實受益人身分：政府機構；有關當局或任何其他有關當局；在香港以外地方執行類似職能的當局；或有關當局認可的任何其他可靠而獨立的來源。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)(c)(ii)條

en.q: Where the payment-routing measure uses an overseas institution rather than an authorized institution, which conditions must that institution meet?
options: It is incorporated or established in an equivalent jurisdiction, carries on a business similar to an authorized institution, has measures to ensure compliance with requirements similar to Schedule 2, and is supervised for compliance by an authority performing functions similar to the Monetary Authority
It is a member of an international banking group with a Hong Kong presence
It holds a licence issued by the Commissioner of Customs and Excise
It is listed on a recognised stock exchange in its own jurisdiction
en.explain: Section 9(1)(c)(ii) sets four cumulative conditions: incorporation or establishment in an equivalent jurisdiction; carrying on a business similar to that of an authorized institution; having measures in place to ensure compliance with requirements similar to those in Schedule 2; and being supervised for compliance by authorities in that jurisdiction performing functions similar to those of the Monetary Authority.

tc.q: 如付款途徑措施採用境外機構而非認可機構，該機構須符合哪些條件？
options: 在同等司法管轄區成立或設立、經營與認可機構類似的業務、設有措施確保遵從與附表2類似的規定，並由執行與金融管理專員類似職能的當局監督其遵從情況
屬在香港設有據點的國際銀行集團成員
持有海關關長發出的牌照
在其本身司法管轄區的認可證券交易所上市
tc.explain: 第9(1)(c)(ii)條訂明四項須同時符合的條件：在同等司法管轄區成立或設立；經營與認可機構所經營者類似的業務；設有措施確保遵從與附表2所施加者類似的規定；及由該司法管轄區內執行與金融管理專員類似職能的當局，監督其對該等規定的遵從情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15條

en.q: What two kinds of situation engage the special requirements in section 15 of Schedule 2?
options: A situation specified by the relevant authority in a written notice, and any other situation that by its nature may present a high risk of ML/TF
Only a situation specified by the relevant authority in a written notice
Only a situation involving a customer resident outside Hong Kong
Only a situation in which a suspicious transaction report has been filed
en.explain: Section 15 applies in a situation specified by the relevant authority (or, for certain DNFBPs, the relevant regulatory body) in a notice in writing, and in any other situation that by its nature may present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing. The second limb is self-executing and does not depend on any notice.

tc.q: 哪兩類情況會觸發附表2第15條的特別規定？
options: 有關當局以書面通知指明的情況，以及按其性質可能構成高洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險的任何其他情況
只限有關當局以書面通知指明的情況
只限涉及居於香港以外客戶的情況
只限已提交可疑交易報告的情況
tc.explain: 第15條適用於有關當局（或就若干指定非金融企業及行業而言，有關監管團體）以書面通知指明的情況，以及按其性質可能構成高洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險的任何其他情況。第二項屬自動適用，並不取決於任何通知。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15(a)條

en.q: In a high-risk situation where a business relationship is to be established, what must an institution do under section 15(a) of Schedule 2?
options: Obtain senior management approval, and either establish source of wealth and source of funds or take additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk
Decline to establish the relationship in every case
Obtain the relevant authority's written approval before proceeding
Establish source of wealth and source of funds, with no alternative available
en.explain: Section 15(a) requires the institution to obtain approval from senior management to establish the relationship, and either to take reasonable measures to establish the customer's or beneficial owner's source of wealth and the source of the funds that will be involved, or to take additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved.

tc.q: 在擬建立業務關係的高風險情況下，機構須根據附表2第15(a)條作出甚麼？
options: 取得高級管理層批准，並須確定財富來源及資金來源，或採取額外措施減低洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
在任何情況下均拒絕建立該關係
在進行前取得有關當局的書面批准
必須確定財富來源及資金來源，並無其他選擇
tc.explain: 第15(a)條規定機構須取得高級管理層批准以建立該關係，並須採取合理措施確定該客戶或實益擁有人的財富來源及將涉及的資金來源，或採取額外措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15(b)(ii)條

en.q: Where a high-risk situation arises after a business relationship has been established and there is a beneficial owner, what does section 15(b)(ii) of Schedule 2 require?
options: Taking reasonable measures to verify the beneficial owner's identity so that the institution is satisfied it knows who the beneficial owner is
Terminating the relationship with the beneficial owner
Obtaining the beneficial owner's written consent to continue
Reporting the beneficial owner to the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
en.explain: Section 15(b) requires, where a relationship has been established, senior management approval to continue; where there is a beneficial owner, reasonable measures to verify that beneficial owner's identity; and either establishing source of wealth and source of funds or taking additional risk-mitigating measures.

tc.q: 如業務關係建立後才出現高風險情況，而存在實益擁有人，附表2第15(b)(ii)條有何規定？
options: 採取合理措施核實該實益擁有人的身分，以令機構信納其知悉該實益擁有人是何人
終止與該實益擁有人的關係
取得該實益擁有人的書面同意方可繼續
向聯合財富情報組舉報該實益擁有人
tc.explain: 第15(b)條規定，如關係已建立，須取得高級管理層批准以繼續該關係；如存在實益擁有人，須採取合理措施核實該實益擁有人的身分；並須確定財富來源及資金來源，或採取額外的減低風險措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15(c)條

en.q: What does section 15(c) of Schedule 2 require where a high-risk occasional transaction is to be carried out?
options: Taking additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved
Obtaining senior management approval and establishing source of wealth
Refusing to carry out the transaction
Reporting the transaction to the relevant authority before executing it
en.explain: Section 15(c) requires, where an occasional transaction is to be carried out in a high-risk situation, that the institution take additional measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved. The senior management approval and source of wealth steps apply to business relationships under paragraphs (a) and (b).

tc.q: 如擬進行高風險的單次交易，附表2第15(c)條有何規定？
options: 採取額外措施，減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
取得高級管理層批准並確定財富來源
拒絕進行該交易
在執行前將該交易報告有關當局
tc.explain: 第15(c)條規定，如在高風險情況下擬進行單次交易，機構須採取額外措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。高級管理層批准及財富來源等步驟則按(a)及(b)款適用於業務關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第16條

en.q: What does section 16 of Schedule 2 prohibit?
options: Opening or maintaining any anonymous account, or any account in a fictitious name, for any customer
Opening any account for a customer resident outside Hong Kong
Maintaining any account that has been dormant for more than five years
Opening any account without face-to-face contact with the customer
en.explain: Section 16 provides that a financial institution or DNFBP must not open, or maintain, any anonymous account or account in a fictitious name for any customer. The prohibition covers both opening and continuing to maintain such accounts.

tc.q: 附表2第16條禁止甚麼？
options: 為任何客戶開立或維持任何匿名帳戶或以虛構名稱開立的帳戶
為居於香港以外的客戶開立任何帳戶
維持任何已不活躍超過五年的帳戶
在沒有與客戶面對面接觸的情況下開立任何帳戶
tc.explain: 第16條訂明金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業不得為任何客戶開立或維持任何匿名帳戶或以虛構名稱開立的帳戶。該禁止規定同時涵蓋開立及繼續維持該等帳戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第17(2)條

en.q: When does a corporation have a “physical presence” in a place for the purposes of the shell bank prohibition?
options: When it carries on banking business at premises in that place and at least one full-time employee performs banking-related duties at those premises
When it maintains a registered office address in that place
When it holds a banking licence issued in that place
When it has customers resident in that place
en.explain: Section 17(2) provides that a corporation has a physical presence in a place if it carries on banking business at any premises there and at least one full-time employee of the corporation performs banking-related duties at those premises. A mailing address alone is not enough.

tc.q: 就空殼銀行禁止規定而言，法團在何時方在某地方有「實體存在」？
options: 當其在該地方的處所經營銀行業務，並有至少一名全職僱員在該等處所執行與銀行業務有關的職務
當其在該地方設有註冊辦事處地址
當其持有該地方簽發的銀行牌照
當其有客戶居於該地方
tc.explain: 第17(2)條訂明，如法團在某地方的任何處所經營銀行業務，並有該法團至少一名全職僱員在該等處所執行與銀行業務有關的職務，該法團即在該地方有實體存在。僅有郵寄地址並不足夠。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第17(3)條

en.q: When is one corporation an “affiliate” of another for the purposes of section 17 of Schedule 2?
options: Where it is a subsidiary of the other, or where at least one individual who is a controller of the corporation is at the same time a controller of the other
Only where the two corporations share a registered office
Only where one holds more than 25% of the other's shares
Where the two corporations have entered into a written cooperation agreement
en.explain: Section 17(3) provides that a corporation is an affiliate of another if it is a subsidiary of the other corporation, or if at least one individual who is a controller of the corporation is at the same time a controller of the other corporation.

tc.q: 就附表2第17條而言，法團在何時屬另一法團的「聯屬公司」？
options: 當其為另一法團的附屬公司，或當該法團的至少一名個人控權人同時是另一法團的控權人
只限兩間法團共用註冊辦事處
只限其中一間持有另一間超過25%的股份
當兩間法團訂立書面合作協議
tc.explain: 第17(3)條訂明，如某法團是另一法團的附屬公司，或該法團的至少一名個人控權人同時是另一法團的控權人，則該法團屬另一法團的聯屬公司。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第17(4)條（「控權人」的定義）

en.q: Under section 17(4) of Schedule 2, what voting threshold makes a person a “controller” of a corporation?
options: Entitlement, alone or with associates, to exercise or control the exercise of more than 50% of the voting rights at any general meeting
Entitlement to exercise more than 25% of the voting rights
Entitlement to exercise any voting rights at all
Holding more than 50% of the issued share capital, regardless of voting rights
en.explain: The section 17(4) definition of controller covers a person in accordance with whose directions the directors are accustomed to act (excluding professional advisers), and a person who, alone or with associates, is entitled to exercise or control the exercise of more than 50% of the voting rights at any general meeting of the corporation or of another corporation of which it is a subsidiary.

tc.q: 根據附表2第17(4)條，何種投票權門檻令某人成為法團的「控權人」？
options: 單獨或連同其相聯者，有權行使或控制行使該法團任何股東大會超過50%的投票權
有權行使超過25%的投票權
有權行使任何投票權
持有超過50%的已發行股本，不論投票權為何
tc.explain: 第17(4)條「控權人」的定義涵蓋該法團董事慣於按其指示行事的人（不包括以專業身分提供意見者），以及單獨或連同一名或多於一名相聯者，有權行使或控制行使該法團（或其為附屬公司的另一法團）任何股東大會超過50%投票權的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(1)條

en.q: What two conditions must be satisfied before an institution may carry out CDD measures by means of an intermediary?
options: The intermediary consents in writing to act as such, and the institution is satisfied the intermediary will on request provide copies of documents and records without delay
The intermediary is licensed in Hong Kong, and holds professional indemnity insurance
The relevant authority approves the arrangement in writing, and the customer consents
The intermediary is a member of the same group of companies, and shares a common compliance function
en.explain: Section 18(1) permits reliance on a specified intermediary if the intermediary consents in writing to be the institution's intermediary, and the institution is satisfied that the intermediary will on request provide a copy of any document, or a record of any data or information, obtained in the course of carrying out the CDD measure without delay.

tc.q: 機構藉中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施前，須符合哪兩項條件？
options: 該中介人以書面同意擔任該角色；及該機構信納該中介人會應要求毫不延遲地提供文件副本及紀錄
該中介人在香港持牌，並持有專業彌償保險
有關當局書面批准該安排，並取得客戶同意
該中介人屬同一公司集團成員，並共用合規職能
tc.explain: 第18(1)條准許倚賴指明中介人，條件為：該中介人以書面同意擔任該機構的中介人；及該機構信納該中介人會應要求毫不延遲地提供其在進行該客戶盡職審查措施過程中所取得的任何文件副本，或任何數據或資料的紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(2)條

en.q: Who remains liable if a CDD measure carried out through an intermediary is not properly performed?
options: The financial institution or DNFBP remains liable under the Ordinance for the failure
The intermediary alone is liable
Liability is shared equally between the institution and the intermediary
Neither, provided the written consent required by section 18(1)(a) was obtained
en.explain: Section 18(2) provides that an institution that carries out a CDD measure by means of an intermediary remains liable under the Ordinance for a failure to carry out that measure. Section 18(6) applies the same rule to CDD carried out by an agent.

tc.q: 如藉中介人進行的客戶盡職審查措施未有妥善執行，何人須負法律責任？
options: 該金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業就該項失責，仍須根據本條例負上法律責任
只有該中介人須負責
由該機構與該中介人平均分擔責任
兩者皆不需，只要已取得第18(1)(a)條所規定的書面同意
tc.explain: 第18(2)條訂明，藉中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施的機構，就沒有進行該措施一事，仍須根據本條例負上法律責任。第18(6)條就藉代理人進行的客戶盡職審查訂有相同規則。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(3)(a)條

en.q: Which additional condition must an accounting professional, estate agent, legal professional or TCSP licensee satisfy to act as a specified intermediary?
options: They must be able to satisfy the institution that they have adequate procedures in place to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing
They must be resident in Hong Kong for at least three years
They must have acted for the customer for at least twelve months
They must hold a licence issued by the Commissioner of Customs and Excise
en.explain: Section 18(3)(a) lists an accounting professional, estate agent, legal professional and TCSP licensee as specified intermediaries, but only where the person is able to satisfy the financial institution or DNFBP that they have adequate procedures in place to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing.

tc.q: 會計專業人士、地產代理、法律專業人士或信託或公司服務提供者持牌人，須另行符合甚麼條件方可擔任指明中介人？
options: 須能令該機構信納其設有充分程序以防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集
須在香港居住至少三年
須為該客戶行事至少十二個月
須持有海關關長發出的牌照
tc.explain: 第18(3)(a)條將會計專業人士、地產代理、法律專業人士及信託或公司服務提供者持牌人列為指明中介人，但須以該人能令該金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業信納其設有充分程序以防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集為條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(3)(c)條

en.q: Which three conditions must a professional practising in an equivalent jurisdiction meet to be a specified intermediary under section 18(3)(c)?
options: Being required to be registered, licensed or regulated under that jurisdiction's law; having measures to ensure compliance with requirements similar to Schedule 2; and being supervised for compliance by a similar authority
Being a member of an international professional body; carrying professional indemnity insurance; and having a Hong Kong office
Being nominated by the customer; consenting in writing; and providing an annual compliance certificate
Being incorporated in the equivalent jurisdiction; having at least five employees; and being audited annually
en.explain: Section 18(3)(c) requires that the overseas professional or institution is required under the law of that jurisdiction to be registered or licensed or is regulated under that law; has measures in place to ensure compliance with requirements similar to those imposed under Schedule 2; and is supervised for compliance by an authority in that jurisdiction performing functions similar to those of a relevant authority or regulatory body.

tc.q: 在同等司法管轄區執業的專業人士，須符合第18(3)(c)條的哪三項條件方可成為指明中介人？
options: 根據該司法管轄區的法律須註冊或領牌或受規管；設有措施確保遵從與附表2類似的規定；並由職能類似的當局監督其遵從情況
屬國際專業團體成員；持有專業彌償保險；並在香港設有辦事處
由客戶提名；書面同意；並提供年度合規證明書
在該同等司法管轄區註冊成立；有至少五名僱員；並每年接受審計
tc.explain: 第18(3)(c)條規定該境外專業人士或機構須：根據該司法管轄區的法律須註冊或領牌，或根據該法律受規管；設有措施確保遵從與附表2所施加者類似的規定；並由該司法管轄區內執行與有關當局或監管團體類似職能的當局，監督其對該等規定的遵從情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(4)(a)條

en.q: Immediately after an intermediary carries out a CDD measure, what must the relying institution obtain?
options: The data or information obtained by the intermediary, though not necessarily copies of the underlying documents at the same time
Copies of every underlying document, without exception
A written certificate that the measure was properly carried out
Nothing, until the relevant authority requests it
en.explain: Section 18(4)(a) requires the institution, immediately after the intermediary has carried out the measure, to obtain the data or information obtained in the course of carrying it out, but expressly does not require it to obtain at the same time a copy of any document or record. Copies must be obtainable on request under section 18(4)(b).

tc.q: 中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施後，倚賴的機構須即時取得甚麼？
options: 該中介人所取得的數據或資料，但無須同時取得相關文件的副本
每份相關文件的副本，並無例外
一份證明該措施已妥善進行的書面證明書
無須取得任何東西，直至有關當局作出要求
tc.explain: 第18(4)(a)條規定機構須在該中介人進行該措施後即時取得其在進行過程中所取得的數據或資料，但明文訂明無須同時取得任何文件副本或紀錄。根據第18(4)(b)條，副本須可應要求取得。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(4)(b)條

en.q: Over what period must the relying institution be able to obtain copies of documents from its intermediary?
options: The period referred to in section 20(2) or (3) of Schedule 2 — the applicable record-keeping period
Six months from the date the measure was carried out
Until the business relationship with the customer ends
Twelve months from the date of the intermediary's written consent
en.explain: Section 18(4)(b) requires the institution to ensure that the intermediary will, if requested within the period referred to in section 20(2) or (3) of Schedule 2, provide a copy of any document or record obtained in carrying out the measure, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving the request.

tc.q: 倚賴的機構須在多長期間內能夠從其中介人取得文件副本？
options: 附表2第20(2)或(3)條所述的期間——即適用的紀錄保存期
自進行該措施之日起計六個月
直至與該客戶的業務關係終止為止
自該中介人書面同意之日起計十二個月
tc.explain: 第18(4)(b)條規定機構須確保該中介人在其於附表2第20(2)或(3)條所述期間內提出要求時，會在接獲要求後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快，提供其在進行該措施過程中所取得的任何文件副本或紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(1)條

en.q: What procedures does section 19(1) of Schedule 2 require an institution to establish and maintain?
options: Effective procedures for determining whether a customer or a beneficial owner of a customer is a politically exposed person
Procedures for reporting suspicious transactions to the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
Procedures for the annual review of the institution's licence conditions
Procedures for the appointment and removal of directors
en.explain: Section 19(1) requires a financial institution or DNFBP to establish and maintain effective procedures for determining whether a customer or a beneficial owner of a customer is a politically exposed person — the operational counterpart to the section 10 special requirements.

tc.q: 附表2第19(1)條規定機構須建立及維持甚麼程序？
options: 有效程序，以斷定客戶或客戶的實益擁有人是否政治人物
向聯合財富情報組匯報可疑交易的程序
每年檢視機構牌照條件的程序
委任及罷免董事的程序
tc.explain: 第19(1)條規定金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業須建立及維持有效程序，以斷定客戶或客戶的實益擁有人是否政治人物——即第10條特別規定在運作層面的對應安排。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(2)條

en.q: What procedures must a financial institution that carries out wire transfers establish under section 19(2) of Schedule 2?
options: Effective procedures for identifying and handling wire transfers in relation to which section 12(5) has not been complied with
Procedures for converting foreign currency at the prevailing market rate
Procedures for notifying the relevant authority of every cross-border transfer
Procedures for retaining wire transfer records for ten years
en.explain: Section 19(2) requires a financial institution that carries out wire transfers to establish and maintain effective procedures for identifying and handling wire transfers in relation to which section 12(5) of Schedule 2 — the accompanying-information requirement — has not been complied with.

tc.q: 根據附表2第19(2)條，進行電匯的金融機構須建立甚麼程序？
options: 有效程序，以識別及處理未有遵從第12(5)條的電匯
按現行市場匯率兌換外幣的程序
就每筆跨境轉帳通知有關當局的程序
將電匯紀錄保存十年的程序
tc.explain: 第19(2)條規定進行電匯的金融機構須建立及維持有效程序，以識別及處理未有遵從附表2第12(5)條（即隨附資料規定）的電匯。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(3)條

en.q: In respect of what must an institution establish effective procedures under section 19(3) of Schedule 2, and for which duties?
options: In respect of each kind of customer, business relationship, product and transaction, for the purpose of carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15
In respect of high-risk customers only, for the purpose of section 15 alone
In respect of each business premises, for the purpose of section 20 record-keeping
In respect of each staff member, for the purpose of training under section 19
en.explain: Section 19(3) requires the institution, in respect of each kind of customer, business relationship, product and transaction, to establish and maintain effective procedures not inconsistent with the Ordinance for the purpose of carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15 of Schedule 2.

tc.q: 根據附表2第19(3)條，機構須就甚麼、為履行哪些責任而建立有效程序？
options: 就每種客戶、業務關係、產品及交易，以履行第3、4、5、9、10及15條下的責任
只就高風險客戶，並只為第15條的目的
就每個業務處所，以履行第20條的紀錄保存責任
就每名員工，以履行第19條的培訓責任
tc.explain: 第19(3)條規定機構須就每種客戶、業務關係、產品及交易，建立及維持與本條例並無抵觸的有效程序，以履行附表2第3、4、5、9、10及15條下的責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(1)(b)(ii)條

en.q: Besides identification documents, what customer records must be kept under section 20(1)(b) of Schedule 2?
options: The original or a copy of the files relating to the customer's account and business correspondence with the customer and any beneficial owner
Only the customer's signed application form
Only records of transactions exceeding $8,000
Only records that the relevant authority has specifically requested
en.explain: Section 20(1)(b) requires keeping, in relation to each customer, the original or a copy of the documents and a record of the data and information obtained in identifying and verifying the customer or any beneficial owner, and the original or a copy of the files relating to the customer's account and business correspondence with the customer and any beneficial owner.

tc.q: 除身分識別文件外，附表2第20(1)(b)條規定須保存哪些客戶紀錄？
options: 與該客戶帳戶有關的檔案，以及與該客戶及任何實益擁有人的業務往來函件的正本或副本
只需該客戶已簽署的申請表格
只需超過8,000元的交易紀錄
只需有關當局特別要求的紀錄
tc.explain: 第20(1)(b)條規定就每名客戶須保存：在識別及核實該客戶或其任何實益擁有人身分過程中所取得的文件正本或副本，以及數據及資料的紀錄；以及與該客戶帳戶有關的檔案，和與該客戶及任何實益擁有人的業務往來函件的正本或副本。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(2)條

en.q: For how long must transaction records be kept under section 20(2) of Schedule 2, and from when?
options: At least 5 years beginning on the date the transaction is completed, regardless of whether the business relationship ends during that period
At least 6 years beginning on the date the transaction is initiated
At least 5 years beginning on the date the business relationship ends
At least 7 years beginning on the date the record is created
en.explain: Section 20(2) requires records kept under section 20(1)(a) — transaction records — to be kept for a period of at least 5 years beginning on the date on which the transaction is completed, regardless of whether the business relationship ends during that period.

tc.q: 根據附表2第20(2)條，交易紀錄須保存多久？自何時起計？
options: 自該交易完成之日起計至少5年，不論該業務關係是否在該期間內終止
自該交易展開之日起計至少6年
自該業務關係終止之日起計至少5年
自該紀錄製備之日起計至少7年
tc.explain: 第20(2)條規定根據第20(1)(a)款保存的紀錄（即交易紀錄），須自該交易完成之日起計保存至少5年，而不論該業務關係是否在該期間內終止。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(3)條

en.q: For how long must customer identity and account records be kept under section 20(3) of Schedule 2?
options: Throughout the continuance of the business relationship, and for at least 5 years beginning on the date the relationship ends
For 5 years from the date the customer was first identified
For as long as the institution holds a licence
For 5 years from the date of the customer's last transaction
en.explain: Section 20(3) requires records kept under section 20(1)(b) to be kept throughout the continuance of the business relationship with the customer and for a period of at least 5 years beginning on the date on which the business relationship ends.

tc.q: 根據附表2第20(3)條，客戶身分及帳戶紀錄須保存多久？
options: 在業務關係持續期間，並自該關係終止之日起計至少5年
自首次識別該客戶之日起計5年
只要該機構持有牌照即須保存
自該客戶最後一次交易之日起計5年
tc.explain: 第20(3)條規定根據第20(1)(b)款保存的紀錄，須在與該客戶的業務關係持續期間保存，並自該業務關係終止之日起計保存至少5年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(3A)條

en.q: For how long must the section 20(1)(b) records be kept where the dealing was an occasional transaction rather than a business relationship?
options: At least 5 years beginning on the date the occasional transaction is completed
At least 5 years beginning on the date of the next occasional transaction
Only until the transaction has been reconciled
There is no requirement to keep such records for occasional transactions
en.explain: Section 20(3A), added in 2022, provides that records required under section 20(1)(b) for an occasional transaction carried out in any of the circumstances in section 3(1)(b), (1A) and (1B) must be kept for a period of at least 5 years beginning on the date the occasional transaction is completed.

tc.q: 如該項交易屬單次交易而非業務關係，第20(1)(b)款的紀錄須保存多久？
options: 自該單次交易完成之日起計至少5年
自下一宗單次交易之日起計至少5年
只須保存至該交易對帳完成為止
就單次交易而言並無保存該等紀錄的規定
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第20(3A)條訂明，就在第3(1)(b)、(1A)及(1B)條任何情況下進行的單次交易，根據第20(1)(b)款須保存的紀錄，須自該單次交易完成之日起計保存至少5年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(4)及(5)條

en.q: On what grounds may a relevant authority require records to be kept for longer than the statutory minimum?
options: Where it is satisfied the records are relevant to an ongoing criminal or other investigation it is carrying out, or where they are relevant to any other purposes specified in the notice
Only where criminal proceedings have already been commenced
Only where the customer is a politically exposed person
Only with the prior approval of the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 20(4) permits a relevant authority or regulatory body, by written notice, to require longer retention where it is satisfied that the records are relevant to an ongoing criminal or other investigation carried out by it, or where the records are relevant to any other purposes specified in the notice. Section 20(5) makes compliance with the notice mandatory.

tc.q: 有關當局可基於甚麼理由要求將紀錄保存超過法定最短年期？
options: 其信納該等紀錄與其正進行的刑事或其他調查有關，或該等紀錄與通知所指明的任何其他目的有關
只限刑事法律程序已展開的情況
只限該客戶屬政治人物的情況
只限事先取得審裁處批准的情況
tc.explain: 第20(4)條准許有關當局或監管團體以書面通知要求較長的保存期，條件為其信納該等紀錄與其正進行的刑事或其他調查有關，或該等紀錄與通知所指明的任何其他目的有關。第20(5)條規定必須遵從該通知。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第21(a)條

en.q: Where a record required under section 20 consists of a document, in what manner may it be kept?
options: Either the original must be kept, or a copy must be kept on microfilm or in the database of a computer
Only the original may be kept
Only a certified true copy may be kept
Only a paper copy stored at the institution's registered office
en.explain: Section 21(a) provides that if the record consists of a document, either the original of the document must be kept, or a copy of the document must be kept either on microfilm or in the database of a computer. Section 21(b) applies the microfilm or computer database options to records of data or information.

tc.q: 如第20條規定的紀錄由文件構成，可以何種方式保存？
options: 須保存該文件的正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫方式保存該文件的副本
只可保存正本
只可保存經核證的真實副本
只可將紙本副本存放於該機構的註冊辦事處
tc.explain: 第21(a)條訂明，如該紀錄由文件構成，須保存該文件的正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫方式保存該文件的副本。第21(b)條就由數據或資料構成的紀錄，同樣提供縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫的選擇。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(1)條

en.q: Which overseas operations must a Hong Kong-incorporated financial institution ensure have compliance procedures in place under section 22(1) of Schedule 2?
options: Its branches, and its subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as a financial institution in a place outside Hong Kong
Only its wholly owned subsidiaries anywhere in the world
Only its branches, not its subsidiaries
Every company in which it holds any shareholding
en.explain: Section 22(1) requires a financial institution incorporated in Hong Kong or that is a re-domiciled entity to ensure that its branches, and its subsidiary undertakings carrying on the same business as a financial institution outside Hong Kong, have procedures in place to ensure compliance, to the extent permitted by local law, with requirements similar to those in Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2.

tc.q: 根據附表2第22(1)條，在香港註冊成立的金融機構須確保哪些境外業務設有合規程序？
options: 其分支機構，以及在香港以外地方經營與金融機構相同業務的附屬企業
只限其在全球各地的全資附屬公司
只限其分支機構，不包括附屬公司
其持有任何股權的每一間公司
tc.explain: 第22(1)條規定在香港註冊成立或屬遷冊實體的金融機構，須確保其分支機構，以及在香港以外地方經營與金融機構相同業務的附屬企業，設有程序以確保在該地方法律准許的範圍內，遵從與附表2第2及3部所施加者類似的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(2)條

en.q: Local law at an overseas branch does not permit the application of a Schedule 2-equivalent procedure. What must the financial institution do?
options: Inform the relevant authority accordingly, and take additional measures to effectively mitigate the resulting ML/TF risk
Close the branch immediately
Apply the Hong Kong requirement regardless of local law
Take no action, since local law prevails
en.explain: Section 22(2) requires the institution, where local law does not permit the application of any procedures relating to the requirements, to inform the relevant authority accordingly and to take additional measures to effectively mitigate the risk of money laundering and terrorist financing faced by the branch or subsidiary undertaking as a result.

tc.q: 某境外分支機構所在地的法律不准許實施與附表2相若的程序。該金融機構須怎樣做？
options: 據此通知有關當局，並採取額外措施有效減低因此而面對的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
立即結束該分支機構
不論當地法律如何，一律適用香港的規定
無須採取行動，因當地法律優先
tc.explain: 第22(2)條規定，如該地方的法律不准許實施關乎有關規定的任何程序，該機構須據此通知有關當局，並採取額外措施，有效減低該分支機構或附屬企業因無法遵從該規定而面對的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(3)條（「分支機構」的定義）

en.q: How is “branch” defined for the purposes of section 22 of Schedule 2?
options: A branch outside Hong Kong at which the institution carries on a business similar to its own, whether or not limited by local law and whether or not called an agency there
Only an office formally registered as a branch in the local companies registry
Only an office employing more than five staff
Any office at which the institution's name appears
en.explain: Section 22(3) defines branch as a branch of the financial institution or DNFBP outside Hong Kong at which it carries on a business similar to that carried on by the institution, whether or not the business of the branch is limited by the laws or regulations of the place where it is situated, and whether or not the branch is referred to as an agency in that place.

tc.q: 就附表2第22條而言，「分支機構」如何界定？
options: 位於香港以外、該機構在該處經營與其類似業務的分支機構，不論其業務是否受當地法律限制，亦不論在當地是否稱為代理處
只限在當地公司註冊處正式登記為分支機構的辦事處
只限僱用超過五名員工的辦事處
任何展示該機構名稱的辦事處
tc.explain: 第22(3)條界定「分支機構」為該金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業在香港以外的分支機構，而其在該處經營與該機構所經營者類似的業務；不論該分支機構的業務是否受其所在地方的法律或規例所限制，亦不論該分支機構在該地方是否稱為代理處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第23條

en.q: Section 23 of Schedule 2 requires all reasonable measures for two purposes. What are they?
options: Ensuring proper safeguards exist to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2, and mitigating money laundering and terrorist financing risks
Preventing customer complaints, and ensuring profitability of the money service business
Ensuring staff are trained annually, and that records are audited by an external accountant
Preventing unauthorised access to customer data, and complying with the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance
en.explain: Section 23 requires a financial institution or DNFBP to take all reasonable measures (a) to ensure that proper safeguards exist to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2, and (b) to mitigate money laundering and terrorist financing risks.

tc.q: 附表2第23條規定須為兩個目的採取一切合理措施。該兩個目的是甚麼？
options: 確保設有適當防護措施以防止違反附表2第2或3部下的任何規定；及減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
防止客戶投訴；及確保金錢服務業務的盈利能力
確保員工每年接受培訓；及確保紀錄由外部會計師審計
防止未經授權查閱客戶數據；及遵從《個人資料（私隱）條例》
tc.explain: 第23條規定金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業須採取一切合理措施：(a)確保設有適當防護措施，以防止違反附表2第2或3部下的任何規定；及(b)減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 3, item 4 (as amended, effective 15 May 2026)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第4項（2026年5月15日生效的修訂）

en.q: What is the fee for an application for the grant of an MSO licence under Schedule 3, as it stands from 15 May 2026?
en.explain: Item 4 of Schedule 3 sets the fee for an application for the grant of a licence at $3,810, plus $2,440 for each additional business premises and $945 for each person subject to the fit and proper person test. The previous figure of $3,310 was revised with effect from 15 May 2026.

tc.q: 自2026年5月15日起，附表3就申請批出金錢服務經營者牌照訂明的費用為何？
tc.explain: 附表3第4項訂明批出牌照的申請費為3,810元，另每個額外業務處所2,440元，以及每名須接受適當人選測試的人945元。原有的3,310元已於2026年5月15日起修訂。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 3, item 5 (as amended, effective 15 May 2026)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第5項（2026年5月15日生效的修訂）

en.q: How does the Schedule 3 renewal application fee compare with the fee for a first grant, as both stand from 15 May 2026?
options: Renewal is $910 against $3,810 for a grant — roughly a quarter of the cost
Renewal and grant are both $3,810
Renewal is $3,810 against $910 for a grant
Renewal is $945 against $2,440 for a grant
en.explain: Item 5 of Schedule 3 sets the renewal application fee at $910, plus $410 for each additional business premises and $945 for each person subject to the fit and proper person test. The renewal fee is markedly lower than the $3,810 grant fee.

tc.q: 自2026年5月15日起，附表3的續期申請費用與首次批出牌照的費用相比如何？
options: 續期為910元，批出為3,810元——約為其四分之一
續期與批出均為3,810元
續期為3,810元，批出為910元
續期為945元，批出為2,440元
tc.explain: 附表3第5項訂明續期申請費為910元，另每個額外業務處所410元，以及每名須接受適當人選測試的人945元。續期費用明顯低於批出牌照的3,810元。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 3, items 6, 7 & 8 (as amended, effective 15 May 2026)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第6、7及8項（2026年5月15日生效的修訂）

en.q: What fee is payable for an application for approval to become a licensee's director, ultimate owner or partner?
options: $945 for each person in relation to whom the application is made
$945 for the application as a whole, whatever the number of persons
$2,440 for each person
$410 for each person
en.explain: Items 6, 7 and 8 of Schedule 3 each set the fee at $945 for each person in relation to whom the application is made. The fee is per person, not per application.

tc.q: 就申請批准成為持牌人的董事、最終擁有人或合夥人，須繳付甚麼費用？
options: 就每名有關申請所關乎的人繳付945元
不論人數多少，整份申請繳付945元
每人410元
tc.explain: 附表3第6、7及8項均訂明就每名有關申請所關乎的人繳付945元。該費用按人數計算，而非按申請份數計算。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 3, items 9 & 10 (as amended, effective 15 May 2026)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第9及10項（2026年5月15日生效的修訂）

en.q: What fee applies to an application to add new business premises, or to operate a money service at particular premises?
options: $2,440 for each business premises
$945 for each business premises
$3,810 for the application, whatever the number of premises
$410 for each business premises
en.explain: Items 9 and 10 of Schedule 3 each set the fee at $2,440 for each new business premises or each business premises concerned. The same figure appears as the additional-premises component of the grant fee under item 4.

tc.q: 就申請新增業務處所，或申請在特定處所經營金錢服務，適用甚麼費用？
options: 每個業務處所2,440元
每個業務處所945元
不論處所數目多少，整份申請3,810元
每個業務處所410元
tc.explain: 附表3第9及10項均訂明就每個新業務處所或每個有關業務處所繳付2,440元。同一數額亦出現於第4項批出牌照費用中的額外處所部分。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 3, items 1, 2 & 3 (as amended, effective 15 May 2026)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第1、2及3項（2026年5月15日生效的修訂）

en.q: What is the fee for providing an uncertified copy of an entry in, or extract from, the register of licensees?
options: $1.5 per page or portion of a page
$160 per copy
$1 per page or portion of a page
No fee is payable for an uncertified copy
en.explain: Item 2 of Schedule 3 sets the fee for an uncertified copy at $1.5 per page or portion of a page, revised from $1 with effect from 15 May 2026. Certifying a copy of an entry or extract, and providing a section 28(1)(b) certificate, are each $160 per copy under items 1 and 3.

tc.q: 提供持牌人登記冊記項或摘錄的未經核證副本，費用為何？
options: 每頁或每部分頁1.5元
每份160元
每頁或每部分頁1元
未經核證副本無須繳費
tc.explain: 附表3第2項訂明未經核證副本的費用為每頁或每部分頁1.5元，自2026年5月15日起由1元修訂。核證記項或摘錄的副本，以及提供第28(1)(b)條的證明書，則按第1及3項各為每份160元。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3（旁註）

en.q: Which sections of the AMLO does the marginal reference to Schedule 3 identify as the provisions under which fees become payable?
options: Sections 5, 7 and 21 only
Sections 9, 12 and 17
Sections 54 to 76
en.explain: The marginal reference to Schedule 3 lists sections 28, 30, 31, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39 and 50 — the certified copy provision, the grant and renewal provisions, the three approval provisions, the two premises provisions, and the power to amend the Schedule.

tc.q: 附表3的旁註指出費用是根據《打擊洗錢條例》哪些條文而須繳付？
options: 只限第5、7及21條
第54至76條
tc.explain: 附表3的旁註列出第28、30、31、35、36、37、38、39及50條——即經核證副本條文、批出及續期條文、三項批准條文、兩項處所條文，以及修訂該附表的權力條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1（旁註）

en.q: Which sections of the AMLO does the marginal reference to Schedule 1 identify?
options: Sections 2 and 5A
Sections 1 and 3
Sections 5 and 7
Sections 24 and 25
en.explain: The marginal reference to Schedule 1 reads “[ss. 2 & 5A]”. Section 2(1) provides that Schedule 1 contains interpretation provisions applying to the Ordinance, and section 5A concerns the application of Schedule 2 to DNFBPs.

tc.q: 附表1的旁註指出《打擊洗錢條例》的哪些條文？
options: 第2及5A條
第1及3條
第5及7條
第24及25條
tc.explain: 附表1的旁註為「[第2及5A條]」。第2(1)條訂明附表1載有適用於本條例的釋義條文，而第5A條則關乎附表2適用於指定非金融企業及行業的事宜。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(1)(a)條

en.q: What must be kept in relation to each transaction an institution carries out, under section 20(1)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: The original or a copy of the documents, and a record of the data and information, obtained in connection with the transaction in accordance with Part 2 of Schedule 2
Only the transaction receipt issued to the customer
Only a summary entry in the institution's ledger
Only records of transactions that gave rise to a suspicion
en.explain: Section 20(1)(a) requires the institution, in relation to each transaction it carries out, to keep the original or a copy of the documents and a record of the data and information obtained in connection with the transaction in accordance with Part 2 of Schedule 2.

tc.q: 根據附表2第20(1)(a)條，機構就其進行的每宗交易須保存甚麼？
options: 按附表2第2部就該交易所取得的文件正本或副本，以及數據及資料的紀錄
只需發給客戶的交易收據
只需該機構分類帳內的摘要記項
只需引起懷疑的交易的紀錄
tc.explain: 第20(1)(a)條規定機構須就其進行的每宗交易，保存按附表2第2部就該交易所取得的文件正本或副本，以及數據及資料的紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(6)條

en.q: Does section 18 prevent an institution from carrying out CDD measures through an agent rather than a specified intermediary?
options: No — section 18(6) preserves that possibility, but the institution remains liable for a failure to carry out the measure
Yes — CDD may be carried out only through a specified intermediary
Yes, unless the relevant authority approves the agency arrangement
No, and the agent assumes liability for any failure
en.explain: Section 18(6) provides that nothing in section 18 prevents an institution from carrying out a CDD measure by an agent, but such an institution remains liable under the Ordinance for a failure to carry out that measure — the same allocation of responsibility as under section 18(2).

tc.q: 第18條是否阻止機構藉代理人（而非指明中介人）進行客戶盡職審查措施？
options: 否——第18(6)條保留該可能性，但該機構就沒有進行該措施仍須負法律責任
是——只可藉指明中介人進行客戶盡職審查
是，除非有關當局批准該代理安排
否，而該代理人須就任何失責承擔責任
tc.explain: 第18(6)條訂明第18條並不阻止機構藉代理人進行客戶盡職審查措施，但該機構就沒有進行該措施一事，仍須根據本條例負上法律責任——與第18(2)條的責任分配相同。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(3A)條

en.q: What conditions must a related foreign financial institution meet to act as a specified intermediary under section 18(3)(d)?
options: It is required under group policy to have measures ensuring compliance with Schedule 2-similar requirements and to implement AML/CFT programmes, and is supervised for compliance at group level
It is wholly owned by the Hong Kong financial institution
It is located in a jurisdiction that is a FATF member
It has been established for at least five years
en.explain: Section 18(3A) requires that the related foreign financial institution is required under group policy to have measures in place to ensure compliance with requirements similar to those in Schedule 2 and to implement programmes against money laundering and terrorist financing, and is supervised for compliance at a group level by a relevant authority or an equivalent-jurisdiction authority.

tc.q: 有關連的外地金融機構須符合甚麼條件，方可根據第18(3)(d)條擔任指明中介人？
options: 根據集團政策，須設有措施確保遵從與附表2類似的規定並推行打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集計劃，且在集團層面受監督其遵從情況
由該香港金融機構全資擁有
位於財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區
已成立至少五年
tc.explain: 第18(3A)條規定該有關連的外地金融機構須根據集團政策，設有措施確保遵從與附表2所施加者類似的規定，並推行打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的計劃；並須在集團層面由有關當局或同等司法管轄區的當局監督其遵從情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(4)(c)條

en.q: Where a financial institution relies on a related foreign financial institution as its specified intermediary, what additional step is required?
options: Taking reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved
Obtaining the relevant authority's written approval for each customer
Duplicating the CDD measure in Hong Kong within 30 days
Obtaining the customer's consent to the cross-border arrangement
en.explain: Section 18(4)(c) requires a financial institution, where the intermediary is a specified intermediary under section 18(3)(d) — a related foreign financial institution — to take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved, in addition to the general obligations in paragraphs (a) and (b).

tc.q: 如金融機構倚賴有關連的外地金融機構作為其指明中介人，須另行採取甚麼步驟？
options: 採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
就每名客戶取得有關當局的書面批准
於30日內在香港重複進行該客戶盡職審查措施
取得該客戶對該跨境安排的同意
tc.explain: 第18(4)(c)條規定，如該中介人屬第18(3)(d)條的指明中介人（即有關連的外地金融機構），金融機構除須履行(a)及(b)款的一般責任外，還須採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第17(1)條

en.q: Which four characteristics together identify a corporation as a shell bank for the purposes of section 17(1) of Schedule 2?
options: Incorporated outside Hong Kong, authorized to carry on banking business there, without a physical presence there, and not an affiliate of a corporation with a physical presence in a jurisdiction where it is authorized to bank
Incorporated outside Hong Kong, unlicensed, with no customers, and no assets
Incorporated in Hong Kong, with no employees, no premises, and no accounts
Any bank located in a jurisdiction subject to United Nations sanctions
en.explain: Section 17(1) prohibits an authorized institution from establishing or continuing a correspondent banking relationship with a corporation that is incorporated outside Hong Kong, is authorized to carry on banking business in that place, does not have a physical presence there, and is not an affiliate of a corporation incorporated in and authorized to bank in a jurisdiction where that corporation has a physical presence.

tc.q: 哪四項特徵合起來令某法團就附表2第17(1)條而言屬空殼銀行？
options: 在香港以外註冊成立、在當地獲授權經營銀行業務、在當地並無實體存在，且並非某法團的聯屬公司（該法團在其獲授權經營銀行業務的司法管轄區設有實體存在）
在香港以外註冊成立、無牌照、無客戶、無資產
在香港註冊成立、無僱員、無處所、無帳戶
位於受聯合國制裁司法管轄區的任何銀行
tc.explain: 第17(1)條禁止認可機構與符合下列各項的法團建立或延續代理銀行關係：在香港以外地方註冊成立；在該地方獲授權經營銀行業務；在該地方並無實體存在；且並非某法團的聯屬公司，而該法團在某司法管轄區註冊成立、獲授權在該處經營銀行業務並在該處設有實體存在。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(2A)條

en.q: What procedures must a financial institution that carries out virtual asset transfers establish under section 19(2A) of Schedule 2?
options: Effective procedures for identifying and handling virtual asset transfers in relation to which section 13A(4) has not been complied with
Procedures for valuing virtual assets at the time of transfer
Procedures for converting virtual assets into Hong Kong dollars
Procedures for registering each virtual asset transfer with the relevant authority
en.explain: Section 19(2A), added in 2022, requires a financial institution carrying out virtual asset transfers to establish and maintain effective procedures for identifying and handling virtual asset transfers in relation to which section 13A(4) of Schedule 2 has not been complied with — the virtual asset counterpart to section 19(2).

tc.q: 根據附表2第19(2A)條，進行虛擬資產轉移的金融機構須建立甚麼程序？
options: 有效程序，以識別及處理未有遵從第13A(4)條的虛擬資產轉移
於轉移時為虛擬資產估值的程序
將虛擬資產兌換為港元的程序
就每筆虛擬資產轉移向有關當局登記的程序
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第19(2A)條規定進行虛擬資產轉移的金融機構，須建立及維持有效程序，以識別及處理未有遵從附表2第13A(4)條的虛擬資產轉移——即第19(2)條在虛擬資產方面的對應條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4（旁註）

en.q: What is the subject matter of Schedule 4 to the AMLO?
options: Provisions relating to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal
Fees payable under the licensing regime
Customer due diligence and record-keeping requirements
Interpretation provisions applying to the Ordinance
en.explain: Schedule 4 is headed “Provisions Relating to Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal” and its marginal reference cites sections 55, 56, 58, 61 and 64. Fees are in Schedule 3, CDD in Schedule 2 and interpretation in Schedule 1.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4的主題為何？
options: 關於打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集審裁處的條文
發牌制度下應繳的費用
客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存規定
適用於本條例的釋義條文
tc.explain: 附表4的標題為「關於打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集審裁處的條文」，其旁註援引第55、56、58、61及64條。費用載於附表3，客戶盡職審查載於附表2，釋義則載於附表1。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第2(1)條

en.q: Who appoints the panel of persons from whom ordinary members of the Review Tribunal are drawn, and what disqualifies a person from that panel?
options: The Secretary appoints the panel, and public officers may not be appointed to it
The Chief Justice appoints the panel, and solicitors may not be appointed
The Commissioner appoints the panel, and former licensees may not be appointed
The Chief Executive appoints the panel, and non-residents may not be appointed
en.explain: Section 2(1) of Schedule 4 requires the Secretary to appoint a panel of persons whom the Secretary considers suitable for appointment as ordinary members of the Tribunal and who are not public officers.

tc.q: 審裁處普通成員從何處挑選的小組由何人委任？何種身分令某人不合資格加入該小組？
options: 由局長委任該小組，而公職人員不得獲委任加入
由終審法院首席法官委任該小組，而律師不得獲委任
由海關關長委任該小組，而前持牌人不得獲委任
由行政長官委任該小組，而非居民不得獲委任
tc.explain: 附表4第2(1)條規定局長須委任一個小組，其成員為局長認為適合獲委任為審裁處普通成員，並且並非公職人員的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第2(5)條

en.q: On which grounds may the Secretary remove a panel member from office?
options: Incapacity, bankruptcy, neglect of duty, conflict of interest or misconduct
Only misconduct proved in disciplinary proceedings
Only bankruptcy or conviction of an indictable offence
Any ground the Secretary considers appropriate, without limitation
en.explain: Section 2(5) of Schedule 4 permits the Secretary, by notice in writing, to remove a panel member from office on the grounds of incapacity, bankruptcy, neglect of duty, conflict of interest or misconduct. The same grounds appear in section 3(5) for the chairperson.

tc.q: 局長可基於哪些理由將小組成員免任？
options: 無能力履行職責、破產、疏於職守、利益衝突或行為失當
只限在紀律程序中獲證明的行為失當
只限破產或被裁定犯可公訴罪行
局長認為適當的任何理由，並無限制
tc.explain: 附表4第2(5)條准許局長以書面通知，基於無能力履行職責、破產、疏於職守、利益衝突或行為失當的理由，將小組成員免任。第3(5)條就主席訂有相同理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第3(1)條

en.q: What is the maximum term of appointment of the chairperson of the Review Tribunal?
options: 3 years, with reappointment permitted after expiry
5 years, with no reappointment
2 years, renewable once only
There is no maximum term
en.explain: Section 3(1) of Schedule 4 provides that the term of appointment of a person as chairperson must not exceed 3 years, and section 3(2) permits a person whose term has expired to be reappointed.

tc.q: 審裁處主席的最長任期為多久？
options: 3年，任期屆滿後可獲再度委任
5年，不可再度委任
2年，只可續任一次
並無最長任期
tc.explain: 附表4第3(1)條訂明委任某人為主席的任期不得超過3年；第3(2)條則准許任期屆滿的人獲再度委任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第3(5)條

en.q: Besides the general grounds of incapacity, bankruptcy, neglect of duty, conflict of interest or misconduct, on what further ground may the chairperson be removed?
options: That the chairperson is no longer qualified for appointment as chairperson under section 56(2)
That the chairperson has determined more than a specified number of reviews
That a party to a review has objected to the chairperson
That the chairperson has reached the age of 65
en.explain: Section 3(5)(a) of Schedule 4 permits removal where the chairperson is no longer qualified for appointment as chairperson under section 56(2) — that is, no longer eligible for appointment as a High Court judge, or has become a public officer otherwise than by chairing a statutory board or tribunal.

tc.q: 除無能力履行職責、破產、疏於職守、利益衝突或行為失當等一般理由外，主席還可基於甚麼理由被免任？
options: 該主席已不再符合第56(2)條下獲委任為主席的資格
該主席已裁定超過指定數目的覆核
覆核的一方已就該主席提出反對
該主席已年滿65歲
tc.explain: 附表4第3(5)(a)條准許在該主席不再符合第56(2)條下獲委任為主席的資格時將其免任——即不再符合資格獲委任為高等法院法官，或已成為公職人員（並非僅因擔任法定委員會或審裁處主席）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第4(1)條

en.q: How are the two ordinary members of the Tribunal appointed for the purpose of determining a particular review?
options: By the Secretary, on the recommendation of the chairperson, from among the panel members
By the chairperson alone, from among the panel members
By the parties to the review, one each
By the Chief Justice, from among retired judges
en.explain: Section 4(1) of Schedule 4 requires the Secretary, on the recommendation of the chairperson, to appoint 2 panel members as ordinary members of the Tribunal in relation to the review. Appointment is review-specific under section 4(2).

tc.q: 為裁定某項覆核，審裁處的兩名普通成員如何獲委任？
options: 由局長按主席的推薦，從小組成員中委任
由主席獨自從小組成員中委任
由覆核雙方各委任一名
由終審法院首席法官從退休法官中委任
tc.explain: 附表4第4(1)條規定局長須按主席的推薦，就該項覆核委任2名小組成員為審裁處的普通成員。根據第4(2)條，該項委任是就個別指明覆核而作出的。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第4(5)條

en.q: What is the consequence if an ordinary member ceases to be a panel member during a review?
options: He or she ceases to be an ordinary member
He or she may continue as an ordinary member until the review is determined
The review must be discontinued automatically
The Secretary must appoint a replacement without the chairperson's recommendation
en.explain: Section 4(5) of Schedule 4 provides that if an ordinary member ceases to be a panel member, he or she ceases to be an ordinary member. Section 5(2) then governs whether proceedings may continue despite the change in membership.

tc.q: 如普通成員在覆核期間不再是小組成員，有何後果？
options: 該人隨即不再是普通成員
該人可繼續擔任普通成員直至該覆核獲裁定
該項覆核須自動終止
局長須在無主席推薦下委任替補人選
tc.explain: 附表4第4(5)條訂明，如普通成員不再是小組成員，該人即不再是普通成員。第5(2)條繼而規管在成員組成有變的情況下，法律程序可否繼續進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第5(1)條

en.q: The chairperson's term of appointment expires after a review has begun but before it is determined. What may happen?
options: The person may continue to act as chairperson for the purpose of that review until it has been determined
The review must start afresh before a newly appointed chairperson
The two ordinary members must determine the review between them
The review must be transferred to the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 5(1) of Schedule 4 provides that if the chairperson's term expires after proceedings for a review have begun but before the review is determined, the person may continue to act as chairperson for the purpose of the review until it has been determined.

tc.q: 主席的任期在覆核開始後但在裁定前屆滿。可能會怎樣？
options: 該人可就該項覆核繼續署理主席職務，直至該覆核獲裁定為止
該項覆核須在新委任的主席席前重新開始
須由兩名普通成員自行裁定該項覆核
該項覆核須移交原訟法庭
tc.explain: 附表4第5(1)條訂明，如主席的任期在覆核的法律程序開始後但在該覆核獲裁定前屆滿，該人可就該項覆核繼續署理主席職務，直至該覆核獲裁定為止。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第5(2)及(3)條

en.q: The membership of the Tribunal changes during proceedings for a review. On what basis may the proceedings continue?
options: Only if the parties to the review consent; otherwise the proceedings must be discontinued, though they may begin anew
Only with the leave of the Court of First Instance
Automatically, since the Tribunal is a continuing body
Only if the change concerns an ordinary member rather than the chairperson
en.explain: Section 5(2) of Schedule 4 permits proceedings to continue despite a change in membership if the parties to the review so consent. Section 5(3) provides that if the parties do not consent, the proceedings must be discontinued, but they may begin anew.

tc.q: 審裁處的成員組成在覆核的法律程序期間有變。該法律程序可基於甚麼繼續進行？
options: 只有在覆核各方同意下方可；否則該法律程序須終止，但可重新開始
只限取得原訟法庭許可
自動繼續，因審裁處屬延續性機構
只限有關變動涉及普通成員而非主席
tc.explain: 附表4第5(2)條准許在覆核各方同意下，即使成員組成有變，法律程序仍可繼續進行。第5(3)條訂明如各方不同意，該法律程序須終止，但可重新開始。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(3)及(4)條

en.q: Who must be present at a sitting of the Review Tribunal, and who presides?
options: The chairperson and 2 ordinary members must be present, and the chairperson presides at every sitting
Any two members constitute a quorum, and they elect a presiding member
The chairperson alone must be present in every case
The chairperson and at least one ordinary member, with either presiding
en.explain: Section 6(3) of Schedule 4 requires the chairperson and 2 ordinary members to be present at any sitting, and section 6(4) provides that the chairperson is to preside at every sitting. Section 9 provides the exceptions where the chairperson sits alone.

tc.q: 審裁處聆訊須有何人出席？由何人主持？
options: 主席及2名普通成員均須出席，並由主席主持每次聆訊
任何兩名成員即構成法定人數，並由他們互選主持人
在任何情況下均只須主席出席
主席及至少一名普通成員，並由其中一人主持
tc.explain: 附表4第6(3)條規定主席及2名普通成員須出席任何聆訊；第6(4)條訂明由主席主持每次聆訊。第9條則訂明主席獨自審理的例外情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(5)條

en.q: How is a question of law before the Review Tribunal determined?
options: By the chairperson alone, in contrast to other questions which are determined by a majority of votes cast
By a majority of the votes cast by the chairperson and ordinary members
By unanimous agreement of all three members
By referral to the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 6(5) of Schedule 4 provides that every question before the Tribunal is to be determined by a majority of the votes cast by the chairperson and the ordinary members, except that a question of law is to be determined by the chairperson alone.

tc.q: 審裁處席前的法律問題如何裁定？
options: 由主席獨自裁定；其他問題則以所投票數的過半數裁定
以主席及普通成員所投票數的過半數裁定
須經三名成員一致同意
轉交原訟法庭裁定
tc.explain: 附表4第6(5)條訂明審裁處席前的每個問題須以主席及普通成員所投票數的過半數裁定；但法律問題則由主席獨自裁定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(6)及(7)條

en.q: What is the default position on whether Tribunal sittings are held in public, and when may that change?
options: Sittings must be held in public, unless the Tribunal determines that in the interests of justice a sitting or part of it should not be
Sittings must be held in private, unless a party applies for a public hearing
Sittings are always in private, without exception
The chairperson decides at the outset without applying any test
en.explain: Section 6(6) of Schedule 4 requires every sitting to be held in public, subject to subsections (7) and (8). Section 6(7) permits a private sitting where the Tribunal, on its own initiative or on a party's application, determines that in the interests of justice the sitting or part of it should not be held in public.

tc.q: 審裁處聆訊是否公開進行的預設立場為何？在甚麼情況下可有改變？
options: 聆訊須公開進行，除非審裁處裁定基於司法公正的利益，該聆訊或其部分不應公開進行
聆訊須以非公開方式進行，除非有一方申請公開聆訊
聆訊一律以非公開方式進行，並無例外
由主席在開始時決定，無須應用任何準則
tc.explain: 附表4第6(6)條規定每次聆訊須公開進行，但須受第(7)及(8)款規限。第6(7)條准許在審裁處自行或應一方申請而裁定基於司法公正的利益該聆訊或其部分不應公開進行時，以非公開方式進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(8)條

en.q: An application is made for a sitting to be held in private. How must the hearing of that application itself be conducted?
options: It must be held in private
It must be held in public, since the substantive sitting is presumed public
It must be determined on the papers without any hearing
It must be referred to the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 6(8) of Schedule 4 provides that if an application is made under subsection (7) for a private sitting, any hearing of the application must be held in private — otherwise the very matter to be protected would be aired publicly.

tc.q: 如有人申請以非公開方式進行聆訊，該項申請本身的聆訊須如何進行？
options: 須以非公開方式進行
須公開進行，因實體聆訊推定為公開
須僅按書面文件裁定，無須進行聆訊
須轉交原訟法庭
tc.explain: 附表4第6(8)條訂明，如根據第(7)款提出以非公開方式進行聆訊的申請，該項申請的任何聆訊須以非公開方式進行——否則擬受保護的事宜本身即會被公開。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(9)條

en.q: Through whom is a partnership entitled to be heard at a sitting of the Review Tribunal?
options: Through a partner, or through a solicitor or counsel, or with the Tribunal's leave through any other person
Only through a solicitor or counsel
Only through the managing partner in person
Only through a representative approved by the specified authority
en.explain: Section 6(9) of Schedule 4 entitles the parties to be heard in person or, in the case of a corporation through an officer or employee, of a partnership through a partner, and of a specified authority through a representative; and through a solicitor or counsel or, with the leave of the Tribunal, through any other person.

tc.q: 合夥有權透過何人在審裁處聆訊中陳詞？
options: 透過合夥人，或透過律師或大律師，或經審裁處許可透過任何其他人
只可透過律師或大律師
只可由管理合夥人親自陳詞
只可透過指明當局批准的代表
tc.explain: 附表4第6(9)條賦予各方親自陳詞的權利；如屬法團則透過高級人員或僱員，如屬合夥則透過合夥人，如屬指明當局則透過代表；並可透過律師或大律師，或經審裁處許可透過任何其他人陳詞。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(11)條（「代表」的定義）

en.q: In relation to the Commissioner, who is a “representative” for the purposes of appearing before the Review Tribunal?
options: A public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department
Any counsel instructed by the Department of Justice
Any person authorized under section 9(12)
A public officer employed in the Companies Registry
en.explain: Section 6(11) of Schedule 4 defines representative, in relation to the Commissioner, as a public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department. In relation to the Registrar it means a public officer employed in the Companies Registry.

tc.q: 就在審裁處席前出庭而言，海關關長的「代表」是何人？
options: 受僱於香港海關的公職人員
律政司所延聘的任何大律師
根據第9(12)條獲授權的任何人
受僱於公司註冊處的公職人員
tc.explain: 附表4第6(11)條就海關關長界定「代表」為受僱於香港海關的公職人員。就註冊處處長而言，則指受僱於公司註冊處的公職人員。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(10)條

en.q: Who must prepare a record of the proceedings of every sitting of the Review Tribunal?
options: The chairperson, containing any particulars relating to the proceedings that the chairperson considers appropriate
The Secretary, in a form prescribed by regulation
A court reporter appointed by the Chief Justice
Each party, exchanging records at the close of the sitting
en.explain: Section 6(10) of Schedule 4 requires the chairperson to prepare a record of the proceedings of every sitting of the Tribunal containing any particulars relating to the proceedings that the chairperson considers appropriate.

tc.q: 何人須為審裁處每次聆訊的法律程序備存紀錄？
options: 主席，並須載有主席認為適當的關於該法律程序的任何詳情
局長，並須採用規例訂明的格式
由終審法院首席法官委任的法庭紀錄員
各方各自備存，並於聆訊結束時互相交換
tc.explain: 附表4第6(10)條規定主席須為審裁處每次聆訊的法律程序備存紀錄，載有主席認為適當的關於該法律程序的任何詳情。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第7(1)條

en.q: For what purposes may the chairperson direct that a preliminary conference be held?
options: Enabling the parties to prepare for the conduct of the review, assisting the Tribunal to determine issues, and generally securing the just, expeditious and economical conduct of the review
Attempting to settle the review without a determination
Assessing whether the applicant can afford the costs of the review
Determining whether the application for review was made in time
en.explain: Section 7(1) of Schedule 4 lists the three purposes of a preliminary conference: enabling the parties to prepare for the conduct of the review; assisting the Tribunal to determine issues for the purposes of the review; and generally securing the just, expeditious and economical conduct of the review.

tc.q: 主席可為哪些目的指示舉行預備會議？
options: 使各方能為進行覆核作準備、協助審裁處就覆核決定爭論點，以及大體上確保覆核得以公正、迅速及經濟地進行
嘗試在無須裁定下和解該項覆核
評估申請人是否負擔得起覆核的費用
裁定覆核申請是否及時提出
tc.explain: 附表4第7(1)條列出預備會議的三項目的：使各方能為進行覆核作準備；協助審裁處就覆核的目的決定爭論點；以及大體上確保覆核得以公正、迅速及經濟地進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第7(2)條

en.q: What condition must be met before the chairperson may direct that a preliminary conference be held?
options: The parties to the review must agree to the giving of the direction
The Secretary must approve the holding of the conference
At least 14 days must have elapsed since the application for review
The specified authority must have filed its response
en.explain: Section 7(2) of Schedule 4 provides that the chairperson may only give a direction under subsection (1) if the parties to the review agree to the giving of the direction. Section 7(3) permits the chairperson to consider material already submitted before giving the direction.

tc.q: 主席可指示舉行預備會議前，須符合甚麼條件？
options: 覆核各方須同意作出該項指示
局長須批准舉行該會議
自覆核申請提出後須已過至少14日
指明當局須已提交回應
tc.explain: 附表4第7(2)條訂明，主席只有在覆核各方同意作出該項指示的情況下，方可根據第(1)款作出指示。第7(3)條准許主席在作出指示前考慮已提交的材料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第8(1)條

en.q: On what conditions may the Tribunal or the chairperson make a consent order under section 8 of Schedule 4?
options: The parties request and agree to the making of the order, and consent to all of its terms
The parties have exchanged written submissions and the chairperson approves
The specified authority alone requests the order
The Secretary certifies that the order is in the public interest
en.explain: Section 8(1) of Schedule 4 permits a consent order where the parties to the review request, and agree to, the making of the order and consent to all of the terms of the order — and the order may then be made whether or not other requirements applicable to making it have been complied with.

tc.q: 審裁處或主席可在甚麼條件下根據附表4第8條作出同意令？
options: 各方要求並同意作出該命令，並同意該命令的所有條款
各方已交換書面陳詞，並經主席批准
只由指明當局要求作出該命令
局長證明該命令符合公眾利益
tc.explain: 附表4第8(1)條准許在覆核各方要求並同意作出該命令，並同意該命令的所有條款的情況下作出同意令；屆時不論作出該命令通常適用的其他規定是否已獲遵從，該命令均可作出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第8(2)及(3)條

en.q: What status does a consent order under section 8 of Schedule 4 have, and what does “order” include for this purpose?
options: It is regarded for all purposes as an order made under the relevant provision and in compliance with the requirements otherwise applicable; “order” includes any finding, determination and any other decision
It is binding only on the parties who consented and has no wider effect; “order” means a monetary order only
It is provisional until confirmed at a full sitting; “order” means a final determination only
It is advisory only; “order” includes recommendations
en.explain: Section 8(2) of Schedule 4 provides that a consent order is regarded for all purposes as an order made under the provision in question and as being in compliance with the requirements otherwise applicable to its making. Section 8(3) defines order to include any finding, determination and any other decision.

tc.q: 附表4第8條下的同意令具有甚麼地位？就此而言「命令」包括甚麼？
options: 就一切目的而言，視為根據有關條文作出並符合通常適用規定的命令；「命令」包括任何裁斷、裁定及任何其他決定
只對同意的各方具約束力而無更廣泛效力；「命令」只指金錢命令
在全體聆訊確認前屬臨時性質；「命令」只指最終裁定
只屬諮詢性質；「命令」包括建議
tc.explain: 附表4第8(2)條訂明同意令就一切目的而言，視為根據有關條文作出的命令，並視為符合通常適用於作出該命令的規定。第8(3)條界定「命令」包括任何裁斷、裁定及任何其他決定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9(1)條

en.q: In what circumstance may the chairperson determine a review as the sole member of the Tribunal?
options: Where, before any sitting is held, the parties inform the Tribunal in writing that they have agreed the review may be determined by the chairperson alone
Where the amount in dispute is below a prescribed threshold
Where no ordinary members are available
Where the specified authority does not oppose the application
en.explain: Section 9(1) of Schedule 4 permits the chairperson to determine a review as sole member where, at any time after the application has been made but before any sitting is held to determine it, the parties by notice in writing inform the Tribunal that they have agreed to that course.

tc.q: 主席可在甚麼情況下以審裁處唯一成員的身分裁定覆核？
options: 在舉行任何聆訊前，各方以書面通知審裁處他們已同意該項覆核可由主席獨自裁定
爭議款額低於訂明門檻
並無普通成員可供委任
指明當局並不反對該項申請
tc.explain: 附表4第9(1)條准許主席以唯一成員身分裁定覆核，條件是在申請提出後、但在舉行任何裁定該覆核的聆訊之前，各方以書面通知審裁處他們已同意採取該做法。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9(2)條

en.q: Which two kinds of application may the chairperson determine alone, without the parties' agreement?
options: An application under section 59(2) to extend time for applying for review, and an application under section 69(2) for a stay of execution of a specified decision
An application for costs, and an application to adduce further evidence
An application to hold a sitting in private, and an application for a preliminary conference
An application to appeal to the Court of Appeal, and an application for leave
en.explain: Section 9(2) of Schedule 4 permits the chairperson to determine as sole member an application under section 59(2) for an extension of time within which an application for review may be made, and an application under section 69(2) for a stay of execution of a specified decision.

tc.q: 主席可在無須各方同意下獨自裁定哪兩類申請？
options: 根據第59(2)條延展提出覆核申請時限的申請，以及根據第69(2)條暫緩執行指明決定的申請
訟費申請，以及提交進一步證據的申請
以非公開方式進行聆訊的申請，以及舉行預備會議的申請
向上訴法庭上訴的申請，以及上訴許可的申請
tc.explain: 附表4第9(2)條准許主席以唯一成員身分裁定根據第59(2)條延展提出覆核申請時限的申請，以及根據第69(2)條暫緩執行指明決定的申請。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9(3)條

en.q: What is the status of the Tribunal when the chairperson determines a matter as its sole member?
options: It is regarded for all purposes as the Tribunal constituted also by 2 ordinary members
Its determination is provisional until ratified by 2 ordinary members
Its determination binds only the applicant, not the specified authority
Its determination may be appealed without the leave of the Court of Appeal
en.explain: Section 9(3) of Schedule 4 provides that where the chairperson determines a review as sole member under subsection (1) or (2), the Tribunal so constituted is to be regarded for all purposes as the Tribunal constituted also by 2 ordinary members.

tc.q: 當主席以審裁處唯一成員身分裁定事宜時，審裁處具有甚麼地位？
options: 就一切目的而言，視為亦由2名普通成員組成的審裁處
其裁定屬臨時性質，直至獲2名普通成員追認
其裁定只對申請人具約束力，對指明當局則否
其裁定可無須上訴法庭許可即提出上訴
tc.explain: 附表4第9(3)條訂明，如主席根據第(1)或(2)款以唯一成員身分裁定覆核，則如此組成的審裁處就一切目的而言，視為亦由2名普通成員組成的審裁處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9(5)條

en.q: The chairperson is unable, or considers it undesirable, to determine a stay application under section 69(2). Who then determines it?
options: A judge or deputy judge of the Court of First Instance appointed by the Chief Justice for the purpose, acting as if duly appointed chairperson
The two ordinary members, sitting together
The Secretary, on the recommendation of the panel
The application lapses and must be renewed at the next sitting
