en.explain: Section 9(5) of Schedule 4 provides that where the chairperson is precluded by illness, absence from Hong Kong or any other cause, or considers it improper or undesirable to act, a judge or deputy judge of the Court of First Instance must, on appointment by the Chief Justice, determine the application as if he or she were the duly appointed chairperson.

tc.q: 如主席無法裁定第69(2)條的暫緩申請，或認為不宜由其裁定，該申請由何人裁定？
options: 由終審法院首席法官為此委任的原訟法庭法官或暫委法官，並猶如其為妥為委任的主席般行事
由兩名普通成員共同裁定
由局長按小組的推薦裁定
該申請失效，須於下次聆訊重新提出
tc.explain: 附表4第9(5)條訂明，如主席因疾病、不在香港或任何其他因由而不能行事，或認為由其行事屬不當或不合宜，則須由終審法院首席法官為此委任的原訟法庭法官或暫委法官裁定該申請，猶如該法官是根據本條例妥為委任的主席一樣。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9(4)條

en.q: After determining a stay application alone, what must the chairperson report to the Tribunal?
options: The making of the determination and the reasons for it, and any other matters relating to the determination that the chairperson considers appropriate
Only the outcome, without reasons
Nothing, since the determination is final
A recommendation as to how the substantive review should be decided
en.explain: Section 9(4) of Schedule 4 requires the chairperson, after making a determination under subsection (2)(b) as sole member, to report to the Tribunal the making of the determination and the reasons for it, and any other matters relating to the determination that the chairperson considers appropriate.

tc.q: 主席獨自裁定暫緩申請後，須向審裁處報告甚麼？
options: 該項裁定的作出及其理由，以及主席認為適當的關於該裁定的任何其他事宜
只需報告結果，無須理由
無須報告，因該裁定屬最終
就實體覆核應如何裁決提出建議
tc.explain: 附表4第9(4)條規定主席以唯一成員身分根據第(2)(b)款作出裁定後，須向審裁處報告該項裁定的作出及其理由，以及主席認為適當的關於該裁定的任何其他事宜。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第10條

en.q: What privileges and immunities do the Tribunal, its members, the parties and witnesses have in respect of a review?
options: The same as they would have if the review were civil proceedings before the Court of First Instance
The same as apply in criminal proceedings before the District Court
Absolute immunity from all civil and criminal liability
None, unless conferred by an order of the Tribunal
en.explain: Section 10 of Schedule 4 provides that, except as otherwise provided in the Ordinance, the Tribunal, its chairperson and ordinary members, the parties to a review, and any witness, solicitor, counsel or other person involved in a review have the same privileges and immunities in respect of the review as they would have if it were civil proceedings before the Court of First Instance.

tc.q: 就覆核而言，審裁處、其成員、各方及證人享有甚麼特權及豁免權？
options: 與該覆核假若是原訟法庭席前的民事法律程序時所享有的相同
與區域法院刑事法律程序中適用者相同
對所有民事及刑事法律責任享有絕對豁免
並無任何特權及豁免權，除非審裁處另行頒令授予
tc.explain: 附表4第10條訂明，除本條例另有規定外，審裁處、其主席及普通成員、覆核各方，以及涉及覆核的任何證人、律師、大律師或其他人，就該覆核享有的特權及豁免權，與該覆核假若是原訟法庭席前的民事法律程序時所享有者相同。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(2)條

en.q: What directions may the chairperson give to the parties after an application for review has been received?
options: Directions concerning procedural matters to be complied with, and the time within which they are to be complied with
Directions as to the outcome the Tribunal is minded to reach
Directions requiring the parties to settle the review
Directions transferring the review to the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 6(2) of Schedule 4 permits the chairperson, at any time after an application for review has been received, to give directions to the parties concerning procedural matters to be complied with by any of the parties, and the time within which those procedural matters are to be complied with.

tc.q: 接獲覆核申請後，主席可向各方發出甚麼指示？
options: 關於各方須遵從的程序事宜，以及須於何時內遵從該等程序事宜的指示
關於審裁處傾向達致何種結果的指示
要求各方就該覆核和解的指示
將該覆核移交原訟法庭的指示
tc.explain: 附表4第6(2)條准許主席在接獲覆核申請後隨時，就任何一方須遵從的程序事宜，以及須於何時內遵從該等程序事宜，向覆核各方發出指示。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第7(5)條

en.q: What may the chairperson do at a preliminary conference held under section 7 of Schedule 4?
options: Give any direction considered necessary or desirable for securing the just, expeditious and economical conduct of the review, and try to get the parties to make all agreements they ought reasonably to have made
Determine the review summarily if the parties do not attend
Impose costs sanctions on a party that refuses to settle
Take evidence on oath from any witness present
en.explain: Section 7(5) of Schedule 4 permits the chairperson at such a conference to give any direction considered necessary or desirable for securing the just, expeditious and economical conduct of the review, and to try to get the parties to make all agreements as they ought reasonably to have made in relation to the review.

tc.q: 主席在根據附表4第7條舉行的預備會議上可作出甚麼？
options: 發出其認為為確保覆核得以公正、迅速及經濟地進行而屬必需或合宜的任何指示，並嘗試促使各方達成其理應合理地達成的一切協議
如各方不出席，即以簡易程序裁定該覆核
對拒絕和解的一方施加訟費制裁
向在場的任何證人錄取經宣誓的證據
tc.explain: 附表4第7(5)條准許主席在該等會議上發出其認為為確保覆核得以公正、迅速及經濟地進行而屬必需或合宜的任何指示，並嘗試促使覆核各方達成其理應合理地就該覆核達成的一切協議。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第7(6)條

en.q: What must the chairperson do after a preliminary conference has been held?
options: Report to the Tribunal on any matters relating to the conference that the chairperson considers appropriate
Publish a note of the conference in the Gazette
Provide each party with a verbatim transcript
Refer any unresolved issues to the Secretary
en.explain: Section 7(6) of Schedule 4 requires the chairperson, after a conference has been held in accordance with a direction under section 7(1), to report to the Tribunal on any matters relating to the conference that the chairperson considers appropriate.

tc.q: 預備會議舉行後，主席須怎樣做？
options: 就其認為適當的關於該會議的任何事宜，向審裁處報告
在憲報刊登該會議的紀要
向各方提供逐字謄本
將任何未解決的爭論點轉交局長
tc.explain: 附表4第7(6)條規定主席在按第7(1)款的指示舉行會議後，須就其認為適當的關於該會議的任何事宜，向審裁處報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第1(1)條（定義）

en.q: How is an “ordinary member” of the Review Tribunal defined in Schedule 4?
options: A member of the Tribunal other than the chairperson
Any member of the panel appointed under section 2(1)
A member who is not legally qualified
A member appointed for a term not exceeding 3 years
en.explain: Section 1(1) of Schedule 4 defines ordinary member as a member of the Tribunal other than the chairperson, and panel member as a member of the panel of persons appointed under section 2(1) of Schedule 4. Not every panel member is an ordinary member of a given Tribunal.

tc.q: 附表4如何界定審裁處的「普通成員」？
options: 審裁處中主席以外的成員
根據第2(1)條委任的小組的任何成員
並無法律專業資格的成員
任期不超過3年的成員
tc.explain: 附表4第1(1)條界定「普通成員」為審裁處中主席以外的成員，並界定「小組成員」為根據附表4第2(1)條委任的小組的成員。並非每名小組成員都是某一審裁處的普通成員。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第2(2)及(3)條

en.q: For what term may a panel member be appointed, and may they be reappointed?
options: For any term the Secretary considers appropriate, and a person whose term has expired may be reappointed
For a fixed term of 3 years, with no reappointment
For a term determined by the chairperson, renewable once
For life, subject only to removal on the statutory grounds
en.explain: Section 2(2) of Schedule 4 permits appointment for any term the Secretary considers appropriate, subject to the resignation and removal provisions, and section 2(3) provides that a person whose term of appointment or reappointment has expired may be reappointed.

tc.q: 小組成員可獲委任的任期為何？可否再度獲委任？
options: 局長認為適當的任何任期；任期屆滿的人可再度獲委任
固定3年任期，不可再度獲委任
由主席決定的任期，可續任一次
終身任職，只可基於法定理由免任
tc.explain: 附表4第2(2)條准許以局長認為適當的任何任期委任（並須受辭職及免任條文規限）；第2(3)條訂明委任或再度委任的任期屆滿的人可再度獲委任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第3(4)條

en.q: When does a chairperson's notice of resignation take effect?
options: On the date the Secretary receives the notice, or on a later date if one is specified in the notice
Immediately on the notice being signed
Three months after the notice is given, in every case
Only when the Secretary accepts the resignation in writing
en.explain: Section 3(4) of Schedule 4 provides that a notice of resignation takes effect on the date the Secretary receives the notice, or, if a later date is specified in the notice, on that later date. Section 4(4) applies the same rule to ordinary members.

tc.q: 主席的辭職通知何時生效？
options: 於局長接獲該通知之日，或如該通知指明較後日期則於該較後日期
於該通知簽署時即時生效
在任何情況下均為發出通知後三個月
須待局長書面接納辭職後方生效
tc.explain: 附表4第3(4)條訂明辭職通知於局長接獲該通知之日生效；如該通知指明較後日期，則於該較後日期生效。第4(4)條就普通成員訂有相同規則。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(1)條

en.q: Who convenes sittings of the Review Tribunal, and how often?
options: The chairperson, as often as necessary to enable the Tribunal to determine a review
The Secretary, at intervals of not more than three months
The parties, by agreement between them
The Chief Justice, on the application of a party
en.explain: Section 6(1) of Schedule 4 requires the chairperson to convene sittings of the Tribunal as often as necessary to enable the Tribunal to determine a review. There is no prescribed calendar.

tc.q: 審裁處的聆訊由何人召開？頻次為何？
options: 由主席召開，並須按使審裁處能裁定覆核所需的頻次召開
由局長召開，相隔不超過三個月
由各方協議召開
由終審法院首席法官應一方申請召開
tc.explain: 附表4第6(1)條規定主席須按使審裁處能裁定覆核所需的頻次，召開審裁處的聆訊。條文並無訂明固定時間表。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第2(6)條

en.q: Where additional tribunals are established under section 55(3), how many panels must be appointed?
options: Only one — section 2(6) confirms that section 55(3) does not require appointment of persons to more than one panel
One panel for each additional tribunal established
Two panels, one for financial institutions and one for DNFBPs
A new panel for each review
en.explain: Section 2(6) of Schedule 4 states, to avoid doubt, that section 55(3) — which allows the Secretary to establish additional tribunals — does not require the appointment of persons to more than one panel under section 2(1).

tc.q: 如根據第55(3)條設立額外審裁處，須委任多少個小組？
options: 只需一個——第2(6)條確認第55(3)條並不要求就多於一個小組委任人選
每設立一個額外審裁處即須委任一個小組
兩個小組，分別就金融機構及指定非金融企業及行業
每項覆核設立一個新小組
tc.explain: 附表4第2(6)條為免生疑問訂明，第55(3)條（准許局長設立額外審裁處）並不要求根據第2(1)條就多於一個小組委任人選。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(d)條

en.q: A long-standing customer's transaction pattern gives rise to a suspicion of money laundering, though no threshold is crossed. What does section 3(1)(d) of Schedule 2 require?
options: Customer due diligence measures must be carried out, the suspicion itself being a trigger independent of any amount
No action, since the customer has already been subject to CDD
Termination of the relationship without further enquiry
Reporting to the relevant authority instead of carrying out CDD
en.explain: Section 3(1)(d) requires CDD measures to be carried out when the institution suspects that the customer or the customer's account is involved in money laundering or terrorist financing. The trigger is the suspicion, not the size of any transaction.

tc.q: 某長期客戶的交易模式引起洗錢懷疑，但並未超越任何門檻。附表2第3(1)(d)條有何規定？
options: 須進行客戶盡職審查措施；該項懷疑本身即為觸發條件，與款額無關
無須採取行動，因該客戶已接受過客戶盡職審查
無須進一步查究即終止該關係
以向有關當局匯報代替進行客戶盡職審查
tc.explain: 第3(1)(d)條規定，當機構懷疑客戶或客戶的帳戶涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集時，須進行客戶盡職審查措施。觸發條件是該項懷疑，而非任何交易的金額。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(b)條

en.q: What phrase in section 3(1)(b) of Schedule 2 prevents a customer from avoiding CDD by splitting a large occasional transaction?
options: “Whether the transaction is carried out in a single operation or in several operations that appear to the institution to be linked”
“Before establishing a business relationship with the customer”
“Subject to section 4 of this Schedule”
“Or an equivalent amount in any other currency”
en.explain: Section 3(1)(b) applies the $120,000 threshold whether the transaction is carried out in a single operation or in several operations that appear to the financial institution or DNFBP to be linked. The same formulation appears in sections 3(1A) and (1B).

tc.q: 附表2第3(1)(b)條中哪一句用語防止客戶藉拆細大額單次交易而規避客戶盡職審查？
options: 「不論該交易是以單一項操作進行，或是以看來屬有關連的多項操作進行」
「在與該客戶建立業務關係之前」
「在本附表第4條的規限下」
「或任何其他貨幣的等值款額」
tc.explain: 第3(1)(b)條訂明120,000元的門檻適用，不論該交易是以單一項操作進行，或是以在該金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業看來屬有關連的多項操作進行。第3(1A)及(1B)條採用相同表述。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(a)(iiia)條

en.q: Which source of identity verification was added to section 2(1)(a) of Schedule 2 by the 2022 amendments?
options: A recognized digital identification system
An authority in a place outside Hong Kong performing similar functions
A governmental body
Any other reliable and independent source recognized by the relevant authority
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (iiia), added by 15 of 2022, permits verification on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system. Its addition also underpins the exceptions in sections 5(4) and 9(2).

tc.q: 2022年的修訂在附表2第2(1)(a)條加入了哪一項身分核實來源？
options: 獲認可數碼身分識別系統
在香港以外地方執行類似職能的當局
政府機構
有關當局認可的任何其他可靠而獨立的來源
tc.explain: 由2022年第15號條例加入的(iiia)節，准許依據獲認可數碼身分識別系統所提供的文件、數據或資料進行核實。此項加入亦是第5(4)及9(2)條例外規定的基礎。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(3)(b)條

en.q: Which four conditions must an overseas institution satisfy to fall within section 4(3)(b) of Schedule 2 for simplified due diligence?
options: Incorporation or establishment in an equivalent jurisdiction; carrying on a business similar to a financial institution; having measures ensuring compliance with Schedule 2-similar requirements; and being supervised for compliance by a similar authority there
Being listed on a stock exchange; having audited accounts; being profitable; and having a Hong Kong branch
Being a member of the FATF; holding a banking licence; having no adverse findings; and consenting in writing
Being wholly owned by a Hong Kong financial institution; being profitable; being audited; and being solvent
en.explain: Section 4(3)(b) requires the institution to be incorporated or established in an equivalent jurisdiction, to carry on a business similar to that carried on by a financial institution, to have measures in place to ensure compliance with requirements similar to those imposed under Schedule 2, and to be supervised for compliance by an authority in that jurisdiction performing functions similar to those of any of the relevant authorities.

tc.q: 境外機構須符合哪四項條件，方屬附表2第4(3)(b)條的簡化盡職審查範圍？
options: 在同等司法管轄區成立或設立；經營與金融機構類似的業務；設有措施確保遵從與附表2類似的規定；並由該處職能類似的當局監督其遵從情況
在證券交易所上市；有經審計帳目；有盈利；並在香港設有分行
屬財務行動特別組織成員；持有銀行牌照；並無不利發現；並書面同意
由香港金融機構全資擁有；有盈利；經審計；並具償債能力
tc.explain: 第4(3)(b)條規定該機構須在同等司法管轄區成立或設立、經營與金融機構所經營者類似的業務、設有措施確保遵從與附表2所施加者類似的規定，並由該司法管轄區內執行與任何有關當局類似職能的當局監督其對該等規定的遵從情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(5)(b)條

en.q: Which two features must an insurance policy taken out for a retirement scheme have to qualify for simplified due diligence under section 4(5)(b)?
options: It does not contain a surrender clause and cannot be used as collateral
It has a term of at least ten years and a fixed premium
It is issued by an authorized insurer and denominated in Hong Kong dollars
It covers at least twenty scheme members and is reviewed annually
en.explain: Section 4(5)(b) covers an insurance policy for the purposes of a provident, pension, retirement or superannuation scheme, however described, that does not contain a surrender clause and cannot be used as a collateral — both features that limit its usefulness for laundering.

tc.q: 為退休計劃而購買的保險保單，須具備哪兩項特徵方符合第4(5)(b)條的簡化盡職審查資格？
options: 並無退保條款，且不能用作抵押品
年期至少十年，並有固定保費
由認可保險人簽發，並以港元計值
涵蓋至少二十名計劃成員，並每年檢討
tc.explain: 第4(5)(b)條涵蓋為公積金、退休金、退休或離職金計劃（不論如何描述）而購買的保險保單，而該保單並無退保條款，且不能用作抵押品——這兩項特徵均限制其被用作清洗黑錢的作用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第7(1)條

en.q: To which customers does section 7 of Schedule 2 apply?
options: A respondent bank located outside Hong Kong with which an authorized institution established a correspondent banking relationship before the commencement of the Ordinance
Any customer of an authorized institution that is located outside Hong Kong
Any pre-existing customer of a licensed money service operator
Any customer that is itself a financial institution
en.explain: Section 7(1) applies to a customer of an authorized institution that is an institution located outside Hong Kong carrying on a business similar to that of an authorized institution, and with which the authorized institution established a correspondent banking relationship before the commencement of the Ordinance.

tc.q: 附表2第7條適用於哪些客戶？
options: 位於香港以外、認可機構在本條例生效前已與其建立代理銀行關係的代理銀行
認可機構位於香港以外的任何客戶
持牌金錢服務經營者的任何過渡期客戶
本身屬金融機構的任何客戶
tc.explain: 第7(1)條適用於認可機構的客戶，而該客戶是位於香港以外、經營與認可機構所經營者類似業務的機構，並且該認可機構在本條例生效日期前已與其建立代理銀行關係。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, corporation)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——法團）

en.q: In relation to a corporation, which shareholding threshold makes an individual a “beneficial owner” under Schedule 2?
options: Owning or controlling, directly or indirectly and including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital
Owning more than 10% of the issued share capital
Owning more than 50% of the issued share capital
Owning any share in the corporation
en.explain: The Schedule 2 definition of beneficial owner covers, for a corporation, an individual who owns or controls directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital; is entitled to exercise or control more than 25% of the voting rights at general meetings; or exercises ultimate control over the management.

tc.q: 就法團而言，何種持股門檻令個人成為附表2下的「實益擁有人」？
options: 直接或間接（包括透過信託或持有不記名股份）擁有或控制超過25%的已發行股本
擁有超過10%的已發行股本
擁有超過50%的已發行股本
擁有該法團的任何股份
tc.explain: 附表2「實益擁有人」的定義就法團而言，涵蓋直接或間接（包括透過信託或持有不記名股份）擁有或控制超過25%已發行股本的個人；有權行使或控制行使股東大會上超過25%投票權的個人；或對管理行使最終控制權的個人。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, corporation)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——法團）

en.q: A corporation holds no more than 25% of anything but exercises ultimate control over another corporation's management. Is that enough to make an individual behind it a beneficial owner?
options: Yes — exercising ultimate control over the management of the corporation is an independent limb of the definition
No — only the 25% shareholding and voting limbs apply
Only if the control is exercised under a written agreement
Only if the individual is also a director
en.explain: The definition includes, as a separate limb, an individual who exercises ultimate control over the management of the corporation. Control need not be evidenced by a shareholding or voting entitlement.

tc.q: 某法團持有的權益均不超過25%，但對另一法團的管理行使最終控制權。這是否足以令其背後的個人成為實益擁有人？
options: 是——對該法團的管理行使最終控制權是該定義的一項獨立條件
否——只有25%持股及投票權兩項條件適用
只限該控制權是根據書面協議行使
只限該個人同時是董事
tc.explain: 該定義將對該法團的管理行使最終控制權的個人列為獨立一項。控制權無須以持股量或投票權作為憑證。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, corporation acting for another)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——代另一人行事的法團）

en.q: A corporate customer is acting on behalf of another person. Who is the beneficial owner under Schedule 2?
options: That other person
The corporation's largest shareholder in any event
The corporation itself
The corporation's board of directors collectively
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (a)(ii) of the definition provides that if the corporation is acting on behalf of another person, beneficial owner means that other person. The same structure appears for partnerships in (b)(ii) and for other persons in (d)(ii).

tc.q: 某公司客戶是代另一人行事。就附表2而言，誰是實益擁有人？
options: 該另一人
無論如何均為該法團的最大股東
該法團本身
該法團的董事會全體
tc.explain: 該定義的(a)(ii)節訂明，如該法團是代另一人行事，則「實益擁有人」指該另一人。合夥的(b)(ii)節及其他人的(d)(ii)節採用相同結構。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, trust)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——信託）

en.q: Which of the following is a beneficial owner in relation to a trust under Schedule 2?
options: The settlor of the trust
Any person who has ever received a distribution from the trust
The trust's legal adviser
Any creditor of the trust
en.explain: For a trust, the definition covers a beneficiary or class of beneficiaries entitled to a vested interest in the trust property, the settlor, the trustee, a protector or enforcer of the trust, and an individual who has ultimate control over the trust.

tc.q: 就信託而言，下列何者屬附表2下的實益擁有人？
options: 該信託的財產授予人
曾從該信託獲得分派的任何人
該信託的法律顧問
該信託的任何債權人
tc.explain: 就信託而言，該定義涵蓋有權享有信託財產既得權益的受益人或某類受益人、財產授予人、受託人、信託的保護人或執行人，以及對該信託有最終控制權的個人。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, trust)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——信託）

en.q: Which party was added to the trust limb of the “beneficial owner” definition by the 2022 amendments?
options: The trustee of the trust
The settlor of the trust
A protector or enforcer of the trust
An individual who has ultimate control over the trust
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (c)(iia), added by 15 of 2022, adds the trustee of the trust to the list, alongside the beneficiary with a vested interest, the settlor, a protector or enforcer, and an individual with ultimate control.

tc.q: 2022年的修訂在「實益擁有人」定義的信託一項中加入了哪一方？
options: 該信託的受託人
該信託的財產授予人
該信託的保護人或執行人
對該信託有最終控制權的個人
tc.explain: 由2022年第15號條例加入的(c)(iia)節，將該信託的受託人加入名單，與有既得權益的受益人、財產授予人、保護人或執行人及有最終控制權的個人並列。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, trust beneficiaries)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——信託受益人）

en.q: Which trust beneficiaries fall within the “beneficial owner” definition in Schedule 2?
options: A beneficiary or class of beneficiaries entitled to a vested interest in the trust property, whether in possession, remainder or reversion, and whether defeasible or not
Only beneficiaries currently receiving income from the trust
Only beneficiaries named individually in the trust deed
Only beneficiaries whose interest cannot be defeated
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (c)(i) covers a beneficiary or a class of beneficiaries of the trust entitled to a vested interest in the trust property, whether the interest is in possession or in remainder or reversion and whether it is defeasible or not.

tc.q: 哪些信託受益人屬附表2「實益擁有人」定義的範圍？
options: 有權享有信託財產既得權益的受益人或某類受益人，不論該權益屬管有、剩餘權益或復歸權益，亦不論其是否可被剝奪
只限現時從該信託收取收入的受益人
只限在信託契據中逐一列名的受益人
只限其權益不可被剝奪的受益人
tc.explain: (c)(i)節涵蓋有權享有信託財產既得權益的信託受益人或某類受益人，不論該權益屬管有、剩餘權益或復歸權益，亦不論該權益是否可被剝奪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「業務關係」的定義）

en.q: What makes a relationship a “business relationship” under Schedule 2?
options: It is a business, professional or commercial relationship that has an element of duration, or that the institution expects at first contact to have an element of duration
It involves more than one transaction, whatever the interval between them
It is recorded in a written contract signed by both parties
It involves transactions exceeding $120,000 in aggregate
en.explain: The definition covers a business, professional or commercial relationship that has an element of duration, or that the institution, at the time the person first contacts it in the capacity of a potential customer, expects to have an element of duration. Expectation at the outset is enough.

tc.q: 何種關係構成附表2下的「業務關係」？
options: 具有持續性元素的業務、專業或商業關係，或機構在初次接觸時預期會具有持續性元素的該等關係
涉及多於一宗交易，不論相隔多久
以雙方簽署的書面合約記錄
交易合計超過120,000元
tc.explain: 該定義涵蓋具有持續性元素的業務、專業或商業關係，或該人以潛在客戶身分初次接觸該機構時，該機構預期會具有持續性元素的該等關係。單憑開始時的預期已足夠。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「單次交易」的定義）

en.q: What single feature distinguishes an “occasional transaction” under Schedule 2?
options: It is a transaction with a customer who does not have a business relationship with the institution
It is a transaction carried out only once by that customer
It is a transaction below the $120,000 threshold
It is a transaction carried out in cash
en.explain: The definition of occasional transaction is a transaction between a financial institution or DNFBP and a customer who does not have a business relationship with the institution. The absence of a business relationship, not the frequency or size, is what matters.

tc.q: 附表2下的「單次交易」以哪一項特徵區別？
options: 該交易的客戶與該機構並無業務關係
該客戶只進行過一次的交易
低於120,000元門檻的交易
以現金進行的交易
tc.explain: 「單次交易」的定義是金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業與並無與其建立業務關係的客戶之間的交易。關鍵在於並無業務關係，而非交易頻次或金額。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「同等司法管轄區」的定義）

en.q: What are the two limbs of the definition of “equivalent jurisdiction” in Schedule 2?
options: A jurisdiction that is a member of the Financial Action Task Force other than Hong Kong, or a jurisdiction that imposes requirements similar to those imposed under Schedule 2
A jurisdiction with a mutual legal assistance treaty with Hong Kong, or a member of the United Nations
A jurisdiction not listed by the FATF as high risk, or one with a reciprocal licensing arrangement
A member of the FATF, including Hong Kong, or a Commonwealth jurisdiction
en.explain: The definition covers a jurisdiction that is a member of the FATF, other than Hong Kong, or a jurisdiction that imposes requirements similar to those imposed under Schedule 2. Hong Kong is expressly excluded from the first limb because the concept is used to describe foreign jurisdictions.

tc.q: 附表2「同等司法管轄區」定義的兩項條件是甚麼？
options: 屬財務行動特別組織成員（香港除外）的司法管轄區，或施加與附表2所施加者類似規定的司法管轄區
與香港訂有司法互助協定的司法管轄區，或聯合國成員
並未被財務行動特別組織列為高風險的司法管轄區，或訂有互惠發牌安排者
財務行動特別組織成員（包括香港），或英聯邦司法管轄區
tc.explain: 該定義涵蓋屬財務行動特別組織成員（香港除外）的司法管轄區，或施加與附表2所施加者類似規定的司法管轄區。第一項明文剔除香港，因該概念用於描述外地司法管轄區。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “Financial Action Task Force”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「財務行動特別組織」的定義）

en.q: How does Schedule 2 define the Financial Action Task Force?
options: The Financial Action Task Force on Money Laundering established by the G-7 Summit held in Paris in 1989
An agency of the United Nations established in 1989
A committee of the Bank for International Settlements
An inter-governmental body established by the OECD in 1990
en.explain: The Schedule 2 definition, replaced in 2018, describes the FATF as the Financial Action Task Force on Money Laundering established by the G-7 Summit held in Paris in 1989 — consistent with the account in ¶1.13 of the AML/CFT Guideline.

tc.q: 附表2如何界定財務行動特別組織？
options: 由1989年在巴黎舉行的七國集團高峰會設立的打擊清洗黑錢財務行動特別組織
1989年設立的聯合國機構
國際結算銀行轄下的委員會
經濟合作暨發展組織於1990年設立的跨政府組織
tc.explain: 附表2的定義（2018年重訂）將財務行動特別組織描述為由1989年在巴黎舉行的七國集團高峰會設立的打擊清洗黑錢財務行動特別組織——與《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第1.13段的說法一致。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “politically exposed person”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「政治人物」的定義）

en.q: Where must the prominent public function be held for an individual to be a “politically exposed person” under Schedule 2?
options: In a place outside Hong Kong
In Hong Kong or anywhere else
Only in a jurisdiction subject to United Nations sanctions
Only in a jurisdiction that is not a FATF member
en.explain: Paragraph (a) of the definition covers an individual who is or has been entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong. The definition is directed at foreign public functions.

tc.q: 個人須在何處擔任顯赫公職，方屬附表2下的「政治人物」？
options: 在香港以外的地方
在香港或任何其他地方
只限受聯合國制裁的司法管轄區
只限並非財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 該定義的(a)段涵蓋現時或曾經在香港以外地方擔任顯赫公職的個人。該定義針對的是外地公職。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “politically exposed person”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「政治人物」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is expressly included in the categories of prominent public function in the “politically exposed person” definition?
options: A senior executive of a state-owned corporation
A middle-ranking government official
A junior judicial officer
Any civil servant of the jurisdiction concerned
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (a)(i) includes a head of state, head of government, senior politician, senior government, judicial or military official, senior executive of a state-owned corporation and an important political party official. Sub-paragraph (a)(ii) expressly excludes middle-ranking or more junior officials.

tc.q: 「政治人物」定義的顯赫公職類別中，明文包括下列何者？
options: 國有企業的高級行政人員
中級政府官員
初級司法人員
有關司法管轄區的任何公務員
tc.explain: (a)(i)節包括國家元首、政府首長、高級從政者、高級政府官員、司法或軍方官員、國有企業的高級行政人員及重要政黨官員。(a)(ii)節則明文剔除中級或更低級的官員。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “politically exposed person”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「政治人物」的定義）

en.q: Which family members of a politically exposed person are themselves within the definition?
options: A spouse, a partner, a child or a parent, and a spouse or partner of a child
Only a spouse and children
Every relative within three degrees of consanguinity
Only those who share a household with the individual
en.explain: Paragraph (b) of the definition covers a spouse, a partner, a child or a parent of an individual falling within paragraph (a), or a spouse or a partner of a child of such an individual. Paragraph (c) separately covers close associates.

tc.q: 政治人物的哪些家庭成員本身亦在該定義範圍內？
options: 配偶、伴侶、子女或父母，以及子女的配偶或伴侶
只限配偶及子女
三親等內的每一名親屬
只限與該個人同住的人
tc.explain: 該定義的(b)段涵蓋屬(a)段所述個人的配偶、伴侶、子女或父母，或該等個人的子女的配偶或伴侶。(c)段則另行涵蓋密切聯繫人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(2)條

en.q: When is a person a “partner” of an individual for the purposes of the politically exposed person definition?
options: Where the person is considered by the law of the place where they and the individual live together as equivalent to a spouse
Where the person is a business partner of the individual
Where the person shares a bank account with the individual
Where the person has cohabited with the individual for at least two years
en.explain: Section 1(2) of Schedule 2 provides that, for paragraph (b) of the politically exposed person definition, a person is a partner of an individual if the person is considered by the law of the place where the person and the individual live together as equivalent to a spouse of the individual.

tc.q: 就政治人物的定義而言，某人在何時屬某個人的「伴侶」？
options: 按該人與該個人共同居住地方的法律，該人被視為等同該個人的配偶
該人是該個人的業務合夥人
該人與該個人共用銀行帳戶
該人與該個人同居至少兩年
tc.explain: 附表2第1(2)條訂明，就「政治人物」定義的(b)段而言，如按該人與該個人共同居住的地方的法律，該人被視為等同該個人的配偶，則該人屬該個人的伴侶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(3)條

en.q: Who is a “close associate” of a politically exposed person under Schedule 2?
options: An individual with close business relations with the PEP, including a co-beneficial owner of a legal person or trust, or the beneficial owner of a legal person or trust set up for the PEP's benefit
Any person who has met the PEP socially
Any employee of an organisation the PEP heads
Any person resident in the same country as the PEP
en.explain: Section 1(3) of Schedule 2 defines close associate as an individual who has close business relations with the first-mentioned individual, including an individual who is a beneficial owner of a legal person or trust of which the first-mentioned individual is also a beneficial owner, or an individual who is the beneficial owner of a legal person or trust set up for the benefit of the first-mentioned individual.

tc.q: 就附表2而言，何人屬政治人物的「密切聯繫人」？
options: 與該政治人物有密切業務關係的個人，包括與其同為某法人或信託實益擁有人的個人，或為其利益而設立的法人或信託的實益擁有人
任何曾與該政治人物在社交場合會面的人
該政治人物所領導組織的任何僱員
與該政治人物居於同一國家的任何人
tc.explain: 附表2第1(3)條界定「密切聯繫人」為與首述個人有密切業務關係的個人，包括與首述個人同為某法人或信託實益擁有人的個人，或屬為首述個人的利益而設立的法人或信託的實益擁有人的個人。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “former politically exposed person”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「前政治人物」的定義）

en.q: What distinguishes a “former politically exposed person” from a politically exposed person?
options: The individual has been, but is not currently, entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong
The individual has never held a prominent public function
The individual's family members are no longer covered
The individual has been out of office for at least three years
en.explain: The definition, added in 2022, covers an individual who, being a politically exposed person, has been but is not currently entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong, together with the same family members and close associates as the PEP definition. No fixed period out of office is prescribed.

tc.q: 「前政治人物」與「政治人物」有何分別？
options: 該個人曾在香港以外地方擔任顯赫公職，但現時並無擔任
該個人從未擔任顯赫公職
該個人的家庭成員不再受涵蓋
該個人已離任至少三年
tc.explain: 2022年加入的該定義涵蓋屬政治人物、曾在香港以外地方擔任但現時並無擔任顯赫公職的個人，連同與政治人物定義相同的家庭成員及密切聯繫人。條文並無訂明固定的離任年期。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “identification document”, individual)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「身分證明文件」的定義——個人）

en.q: What counts as an “identification document” in relation to an individual under Schedule 2?
options: An identity card, certificate of identity, document of identity or travel document, as defined by section 2(1) of the Immigration Ordinance
Any document bearing the individual's photograph and signature
A driving licence or any government-issued card
A bank statement showing the individual's name and address
en.explain: Paragraph (a) of the definition covers, in relation to an individual, his or her identity card, certificate of identity, document of identity or travel document, as defined by section 2(1) of the Immigration Ordinance (Cap. 115).

tc.q: 就附表2而言，甚麼屬個人的「身分證明文件」？
options: 《入境條例》第2(1)條所界定的身分證、身分證明書、身分證明文件或旅行證件
任何載有該個人相片及簽署的文件
駕駛執照或任何政府簽發的證件
載有該個人姓名及地址的銀行結單
tc.explain: 該定義的(a)段就個人涵蓋《入境條例》（第115章）第2(1)條所界定的其身分證、身分證明書、身分證明文件或旅行證件。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “identification document”, partnership)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「身分證明文件」的定義——合夥）

en.q: What is the “identification document” of a partnership that carries on business in Hong Kong?
options: Its business registration certificate issued under section 6 of the Business Registration Ordinance
Its partnership agreement
A certificate of incorporation issued by the Companies Registry
The identity cards of all its partners
en.explain: Paragraph (e) of the definition covers, in relation to a partnership that carries on business in Hong Kong, its business registration certificate issued under section 6 of the Business Registration Ordinance (Cap. 310). Paragraph (f) covers a partnership that does not carry on business in Hong Kong.

tc.q: 在香港經營業務的合夥，其「身分證明文件」是甚麼？
options: 根據《商業登記條例》第6條發出的商業登記證
其合夥協議
公司註冊處發出的公司註冊證明書
其所有合夥人的身分證
tc.explain: 該定義的(e)段就在香港經營業務的合夥，涵蓋根據《商業登記條例》（第310章）第6條就該合夥發出的商業登記證。(f)段則涵蓋並非在香港經營業務的合夥。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “identification document”, partnership)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「身分證明文件」的定義——合夥）

en.q: What is the “identification document” of a partnership that does NOT carry on business in Hong Kong?
options: Its partnership agreement, or any document evidencing its formation or registration issued by a governmental body
Its Hong Kong business registration certificate
A certificate issued by the Registrar of Companies in Hong Kong
A sworn declaration by the partners as to the partnership's existence
en.explain: Paragraph (f) of the definition covers, in relation to a partnership that does not carry on business in Hong Kong, its partnership agreement or any document evidencing its formation or registration issued by a governmental body.

tc.q: 並非在香港經營業務的合夥，其「身分證明文件」是甚麼？
options: 其合夥協議，或由政府機構發出、證明其組成或註冊的任何文件
其香港商業登記證
香港公司註冊處處長發出的證明書
合夥人就該合夥存在所作的宣誓聲明
tc.explain: 該定義的(f)段就並非在香港經營業務的合夥，涵蓋其合夥協議，或由政府機構發出、證明其組成或註冊的任何文件。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “identification document”, company)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「身分證明文件」的定義——公司）

en.q: What is the “identification document” of a company as defined by section 2(1) of the Companies Ordinance?
options: The certificate of incorporation issued under the Ordinance under which the company was formed and registered, or its certificate of re-domiciliation
Its annual return filed with the Companies Registry
Its memorandum and articles of association
Its business registration certificate
en.explain: Paragraph (b) of the definition covers the certificate of incorporation issued in respect of the company under the Ordinance under which it was formed and registered, or the certificate of re-domiciliation issued under section 820C(5)(c) of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622).

tc.q: 《公司條例》第2(1)條所界定的公司，其「身分證明文件」是甚麼？
options: 根據該公司據以組成及註冊的條例就該公司發出的公司註冊證明書，或其遷冊證明書
其向公司註冊處提交的周年申報表
其組織章程大綱及細則
其商業登記證
tc.explain: 該定義的(b)段涵蓋根據該公司據以組成及註冊的條例就該公司發出的公司註冊證明書，或根據《公司條例》（第622章）第820C(5)(c)條發出的遷冊證明書。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「過渡期客戶」的定義）

en.q: For a financial institution other than a licensed VAS provider, before what date must a business relationship have been established for the customer to be a “pre-existing customer”?
options: 1 April 2012
1 March 2018
1 June 2023
1 April 2023
en.explain: Paragraph (a) of the definition sets the date at 1 April 2012 for financial institutions other than licensed VAS providers. The other dates are 1 June 2023 for licensed VAS providers, 1 March 2018 for DNFBPs other than Category B PMS registrants, and 1 April 2023 for Category B PMS registrants.

tc.q: 就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者以外的金融機構而言，業務關係須在哪一日期前建立，該客戶方屬「過渡期客戶」？
tc.explain: 該定義的(a)段就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者以外的金融機構，訂明日期為2012年4月1日。其他日期為持牌虛擬資產服務提供者的2023年6月1日、B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人以外指定非金融企業及行業的2018年3月1日，以及B類註冊人的2023年4月1日。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「過渡期客戶」的定義）

en.q: For a DNFBP other than a Category B PMS registrant, what is the cut-off date for a customer to be a “pre-existing customer”?
options: 1 March 2018
1 April 2012
1 June 2023
1 January 2018
en.explain: Paragraph (c) of the definition sets the date at 1 March 2018 for a DNFBP other than a Category B PMS registrant, reflecting the commencement of the extension of the regime to designated non-financial businesses and professions.

tc.q: 就B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人以外的指定非金融企業及行業而言，客戶屬「過渡期客戶」的截止日期為何？
tc.explain: 該定義的(c)段就B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人以外的指定非金融企業及行業，訂明日期為2018年3月1日，反映該制度擴展至指定非金融企業及行業的生效日期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(4)條

en.q: What are the essential elements of a “wire transfer” under section 1(4) of Schedule 2?
options: A transaction carried out by an ordering institution on behalf of a person by electronic means, with a view to making money available to that or another person at a beneficiary institution
Any transfer of money between two bank accounts
Any transfer of money across a border
Any transfer of money exceeding $8,000
en.explain: Section 1(4) defines a wire transfer as a transaction carried out by an institution (the ordering institution) on behalf of a person by electronic means with a view to making an amount of money available to that person or another person (the recipient) at an institution (the beneficiary institution), whether or not intermediary institutions participate.

tc.q: 根據附表2第1(4)條，「電匯」的要素是甚麼？
options: 由匯出機構代某人以電子方式進行的交易，並旨在使一筆款項可在收款機構供該人或另一人取用
任何兩個銀行帳戶之間的金錢轉移
任何跨境金錢轉移
任何超過8,000元的金錢轉移
tc.explain: 第1(4)條界定「電匯」為由某機構（匯出機構）代某人以電子方式進行的交易，並旨在使一筆款項可在某機構（收款機構）供該人或另一人（收款人）取用，不論是否有中介機構參與。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「代理銀行業務」的定義）

en.q: How is “correspondent banking” defined in Schedule 2?
options: The provision of banking services by an authorized institution to another institution to enable the latter to provide services and products to its own customers
Any banking relationship between two institutions in different jurisdictions
The provision of clearing services between banks in Hong Kong
Any arrangement under which one bank holds an account with another
en.explain: The Schedule 2 definition is the provision of banking services by an authorized institution to another institution to enable that other institution to provide services and products to its own customers. The nested-customer element is what distinguishes it.

tc.q: 附表2如何界定「代理銀行業務」？
options: 認可機構向另一機構提供銀行服務，使後者能向其本身客戶提供服務及產品
不同司法管轄區兩間機構之間的任何銀行關係
香港各銀行之間提供的結算服務
一間銀行在另一間銀行開立帳戶的任何安排
tc.explain: 附表2的定義為認可機構向另一機構提供銀行服務，使該另一機構能向其本身的客戶提供服務及產品。當中的「客戶之客戶」元素正是其區別所在。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「法人」的定義）

en.q: What does “legal person” include under Schedule 2?
options: Any public body and any body of persons, whether corporate or unincorporate
Only companies incorporated under the Companies Ordinance
Only bodies with separate legal personality
Only bodies registered with a Hong Kong regulator
en.explain: The Schedule 2 definition provides that legal person includes any public body and any body of persons, corporate or unincorporate. The breadth matters because the beneficial ownership and close associate provisions both turn on the concept.

tc.q: 就附表2而言，「法人」包括甚麼？
options: 任何公共機構及任何人的團體，不論是否屬法團
只限根據《公司條例》註冊成立的公司
只限具有獨立法律人格的團體
只限已向香港監管機構登記的團體
tc.explain: 附表2的定義訂明「法人」包括任何公共機構及任何人的團體，不論屬法團或非法團。此定義的廣泛程度十分重要，因實益擁有人及密切聯繫人的條文均以此概念為基礎。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「公共機構」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is included in the definition of “public body” in Schedule 2?
options: Any board, commission, committee or other body appointed by the Chief Executive or the Government, whether paid or unpaid
Only Government bureaux and departments
Only bodies established by an Ordinance
Only bodies whose members are civil servants
en.explain: The definition includes any executive, legislative, municipal or urban council; any Government department or undertaking; any local or public authority or undertaking; any board, commission, committee or other body appointed by the Chief Executive or the Government, whether paid or unpaid; and any body with power to act in a public capacity under or for the purposes of any enactment.

tc.q: 附表2「公共機構」的定義包括下列何者？
options: 由行政長官或政府委任的任何委員會、公署、小組或其他團體，不論其成員是否受薪
只限政府決策局及部門
只限根據條例設立的團體
只限成員為公務員的團體
tc.explain: 該定義包括任何行政、立法、市政或區域議會；任何政府部門或企業；任何地方或公共當局或企業；由行政長官或政府委任的任何委員會、公署、小組或其他團體，不論受薪與否；以及根據任何成文法則或為其目的而有權以公職身分行事的任何團體。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “recognized digital identification system”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「獲認可數碼身分識別系統」的定義）

en.q: What makes a digital identification system a “recognized digital identification system” for a financial institution?
options: It is a digital identification system that is a reliable and independent source recognized by the relevant authority
It is operated by a Hong Kong government department
It has been certified under the Electronic Transactions Ordinance
It is used by at least three other financial institutions
en.explain: The definition, added in 2022, provides that, in relation to a financial institution or a DNFBP who is a TCSP licensee or Category B PMS registrant, it means a digital identification system that is a reliable and independent source recognized by the relevant authority; for other DNFBPs, recognition is by the relevant regulatory body.

tc.q: 就金融機構而言，何種數碼身分識別系統屬「獲認可數碼身分識別系統」？
options: 屬有關當局認可的可靠而獨立來源的數碼身分識別系統
由香港政府部門營運的系統
已根據《電子交易條例》獲認證的系統
至少有三間其他金融機構使用的系統
tc.explain: 2022年加入的該定義訂明，就金融機構或屬信託或公司服務提供者持牌人或B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人的指定非金融企業及行業而言，指屬有關當局認可的可靠而獨立來源的數碼身分識別系統；就其他指定非金融企業及行業而言，則由有關監管團體認可。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, partnership)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——合夥）

en.q: Which of the following makes an individual a beneficial owner in relation to a partnership under Schedule 2?
options: Being entitled to or controlling, directly or indirectly, more than a 25% share of the capital or profits of the partnership
Being named as a partner in the partnership agreement
Being entitled to any share of the partnership's profits
Being the partnership's designated compliance officer
en.explain: For a partnership, the definition covers an individual entitled to or controlling directly or indirectly more than a 25% share of the capital or profits; entitled to exercise or control the exercise of more than 25% of the voting rights in the partnership; or exercising ultimate control over the management of the partnership.

tc.q: 就合夥而言，下列何者令個人成為附表2下的實益擁有人？
options: 直接或間接有權享有或控制該合夥超過25%的資本或利潤份額
在合夥協議中被列名為合夥人
有權享有該合夥利潤的任何份額
擔任該合夥指定的合規主任
tc.explain: 就合夥而言，該定義涵蓋直接或間接有權享有或控制超過25%資本或利潤份額的個人；有權行使或控制行使該合夥超過25%投票權的個人；或對該合夥的管理行使最終控制權的個人。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, other persons)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——其他人）

en.q: For a customer that is neither a corporation, a partnership nor a trust, who is the beneficial owner?
options: An individual who ultimately owns or controls the person, or, if the person is acting on behalf of another, that other person
There is no beneficial owner in such a case
The customer itself in every case
The person who signs the account opening documents
en.explain: Paragraph (d) of the definition is the residual limb: in relation to a person not falling within paragraphs (a), (b) or (c), beneficial owner means an individual who ultimately owns or controls the person, or, if the person is acting on behalf of another person, that other person.

tc.q: 如客戶既非法團、合夥亦非信託，誰是實益擁有人？
options: 最終擁有或控制該人的個人；或如該人是代另一人行事，則為該另一人
在此情況下並無實益擁有人
在任何情況下均為該客戶本身
簽署開立帳戶文件的人
tc.explain: 該定義的(d)段是餘下情況的條文：就不屬(a)、(b)或(c)段的人而言，「實益擁有人」指最終擁有或控制該人的個人；或如該人是代另一人行事，則指該另一人。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “customer due diligence measures”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「客戶盡職審查措施」的定義）

en.q: Where does Schedule 2 locate the content of “customer due diligence measures”?
options: In section 2(1) of Schedule 2
In section 3(1) of Schedule 2
In Part 1 of Schedule 1
In guidelines published under section 7 of the AMLO
en.explain: The Schedule 2 definition provides that customer due diligence measures means the measures set out in section 2(1) of that Schedule — identification and verification of the customer, beneficial owner measures, purpose and intended nature of the relationship, and measures relating to persons purporting to act.

tc.q: 附表2將「客戶盡職審查措施」的內容置於何處？
options: 附表2第2(1)條
附表2第3(1)條
附表1第1部
根據《打擊洗錢條例》第7條公布的指引
tc.explain: 附表2的定義訂明「客戶盡職審查措施」指該附表第2(1)條所列的措施——識別及核實客戶身分、實益擁有人措施、業務關係的目的及擬有性質，以及關於聲稱代客戶行事的人的措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「過渡期客戶」的定義）

en.q: Which commencement date does the “pre-existing customer” definition tie to licensed VAS providers, reflecting when their licensing regime began?
options: 1 June 2023
1 April 2012
1 March 2018
1 April 2023
en.explain: Paragraph (b) of the definition, as replaced in 2022, sets the date at 1 June 2023 for a licensed VAS provider — the commencement of the virtual asset service provider licensing regime.

tc.q: 「過渡期客戶」的定義就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者採用哪一個生效日期？該日期反映其發牌制度何時開始？
tc.explain: 經2022年重訂的該定義(b)段就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者訂明日期為2023年6月1日，即虛擬資產服務提供者發牌制度的生效日期。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “identification document”, overseas corporation)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「身分證明文件」的定義——境外法團）

en.q: What is the “identification document” of a corporation incorporated outside Hong Kong that is not a registered non-Hong Kong company?
options: Its certificate of incorporation or registration, or any other document evidencing its incorporation, issued by an authority in that place performing functions similar to those of the Registrar of Companies
Its Hong Kong business registration certificate
A certified translation of its constitutional documents
A letter of good standing from its bankers
en.explain: Paragraph (d) of the definition covers a corporation incorporated outside Hong Kong that is neither a re-domiciled company nor a registered non-Hong Kong company, and points to its certificate of incorporation or registration, or any other document evidencing its incorporation, issued by an authority in that place performing functions similar to those of the Registrar of Companies.

tc.q: 在香港以外註冊成立、並非註冊非香港公司的法團，其「身分證明文件」是甚麼？
options: 由該地方執行與公司註冊處處長類似職能的當局發出的公司註冊或登記證明書，或證明其註冊成立的任何其他文件
其香港商業登記證
其憲章文件的經核證譯本
其往來銀行發出的信譽良好證明書
tc.explain: 該定義的(d)段涵蓋在香港以外註冊成立、既非遷冊公司亦非註冊非香港公司的法團，並指向由該地方執行與公司註冊處處長類似職能的當局發出的公司註冊或登記證明書，或證明其註冊成立的任何其他文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（定義的應用）

en.q: A walk-in customer with no ongoing relationship asks an MSO to remit $150,000 in one go. Which Schedule 2 concepts are engaged?
options: An occasional transaction, requiring CDD under section 3(1)(b) because it is at or above $120,000
A business relationship, requiring CDD under section 3(1)(a)
A wire transfer, requiring CDD under section 3(1A) at the $8,000 threshold
Neither, since the customer is not a pre-existing customer
en.explain: With no business relationship, the dealing is an occasional transaction as defined in section 1(1). Section 3(1)(b) requires CDD before carrying out an occasional transaction involving $120,000 or more, so the $150,000 remittance is squarely within it.

tc.q: 某即場客戶與該金錢服務經營者並無持續關係，要求一次過匯出150,000元。這觸發附表2的哪些概念？
options: 屬單次交易，因款額達到或超過120,000元而須按第3(1)(b)條進行客戶盡職審查
屬業務關係，須按第3(1)(a)條進行客戶盡職審查
屬電匯，須按第3(1A)條在8,000元門檻進行客戶盡職審查
兩者皆非，因該客戶並非過渡期客戶
tc.explain: 由於並無業務關係，該項往來屬第1(1)條所界定的單次交易。第3(1)(b)條規定在進行涉及120,000元或以上的單次交易前須進行客戶盡職審查，故該筆150,000元匯款正落入其範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)及3(1A)條的應用

en.q: A walk-in customer asks an MSO to make an electronic transfer of $10,000 to a recipient at an overseas institution. Which threshold applies?
options: The $8,000 wire transfer threshold in section 3(1A), because the transaction is a wire transfer within section 1(4)
The $120,000 occasional transaction threshold in section 3(1)(b)
The $20,000 threshold applicable to single-premium insurance
No threshold, since the customer has no business relationship
en.explain: Section 1(4) defines a wire transfer as an electronic transaction by an ordering institution to make money available to a recipient at a beneficiary institution. Section 3(1A) then requires CDD before an occasional wire transfer of $8,000 or above, displacing the general $120,000 threshold.

tc.q: 某即場客戶要求金錢服務經營者以電子方式將10,000元轉予境外機構的收款人。適用哪一門檻？
options: 第3(1A)條的8,000元電匯門檻，因該交易屬第1(4)條所指的電匯
第3(1)(b)條的120,000元單次交易門檻
適用於整筆保費保險的20,000元門檻
並無門檻，因該客戶並無業務關係
tc.explain: 第1(4)條界定「電匯」為匯出機構以電子方式進行、使款項可在收款機構供收款人取用的交易。第3(1A)條繼而規定在進行8,000元或以上的單次電匯前須進行客戶盡職審查，取代一般的120,000元門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)及13條的應用

en.q: An MSO arranges a cash-based remittance of $9,000 to a place outside Hong Kong, not by electronic means. Which provision governs the information it must record?
options: Section 13, which applies to a remittance transaction other than a wire transfer of $8,000 or above carried out by a licensed MSO
Section 12, which applies to wire transfers
Section 11, which applies to insurance policies
Section 13A, which applies to virtual asset transfers
en.explain: Because the transfer is not carried out by electronic means, it is not a wire transfer within section 1(4), so section 12 does not apply. Section 13 applies to a remittance transaction other than a wire transfer involving $8,000 or more carried out by a licensed money service operator.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者安排一筆9,000元的現金匯款至香港以外地方，並非以電子方式進行。其須記錄的資料受哪一條文規管？
options: 第13條，適用於持牌金錢服務經營者進行、8,000元或以上而並非電匯的匯款交易
第12條，適用於電匯
第11條，適用於保險保單
第13A條，適用於虛擬資產轉移
tc.explain: 由於該項轉帳並非以電子方式進行，故不屬第1(4)條所指的電匯，第12條並不適用。第13條適用於持牌金錢服務經營者進行、涉及8,000元或以上而並非電匯的匯款交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)及10條的應用

en.q: An MSO's prospective customer is the adult child of a serving foreign cabinet minister. What is the customer's status under Schedule 2?
options: A politically exposed person, because a child of an individual holding a prominent foreign public function falls within paragraph (b) of the definition
Not a politically exposed person, because the child holds no public function personally
A politically exposed person only if the child lives with the minister
A close associate rather than a politically exposed person
en.explain: Paragraph (b) of the politically exposed person definition covers a spouse, partner, child or parent of an individual within paragraph (a), and a spouse or partner of such a child. The section 10 requirements — senior management approval and establishing source of wealth and funds — therefore apply.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者的擬開戶客戶，是一名現任外國內閣部長的成年子女。就附表2而言，該客戶的身分為何？
options: 屬政治人物，因擔任顯赫外地公職的個人的子女落入該定義的(b)段
並非政治人物，因該子女本人並無擔任公職
只有在該子女與該部長同住的情況下方屬政治人物
屬密切聯繫人而非政治人物
tc.explain: 「政治人物」定義的(b)段涵蓋屬(a)段所述個人的配偶、伴侶、子女或父母，以及該等子女的配偶或伴侶。因此第10條的規定——高級管理層批准及確定財富來源及資金來源——即告適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)及2(1)(b)條的應用

en.q: A corporate customer's shares are held 30% by an individual through a bearer share holding. Is that individual a beneficial owner?
options: Yes — the definition expressly covers ownership or control exercised indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding
No — bearer share holdings are excluded from the definition
Only if the individual also sits on the board
Only if the shares carry voting rights
en.explain: The corporation limb of the beneficial owner definition covers an individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital. A 30% bearer holding is squarely within it.

tc.q: 某公司客戶的股份中，有30%由一名個人透過持有不記名股份持有。該個人是否實益擁有人？
options: 是——該定義明文涵蓋間接行使的擁有權或控制權，包括透過信託或持有不記名股份
否——不記名股份持有量不在該定義範圍內
只限該個人同時任職董事會
只限該等股份附有投票權
tc.explain: 「實益擁有人」定義中關於法團的一項，涵蓋直接或間接（包括透過信託或持有不記名股份）擁有或控制超過25%已發行股本的個人。30%的不記名股份持有量正落入其範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)及4(3)條的應用

en.q: An MSO's customer is a bank incorporated in a FATF member jurisdiction and supervised there. Which Schedule 2 route is available?
options: Simplified due diligence under section 4, since the customer may fall within section 4(3)(b) as an institution in an equivalent jurisdiction
Enhanced due diligence under section 15, because the customer is foreign
No due diligence at all, since banks are exempt
Section 14 correspondent banking measures, since the customer is a bank
en.explain: A FATF member jurisdiction other than Hong Kong is an equivalent jurisdiction under the section 1(1) definition. Section 4(3)(b) then permits simplified due diligence for an institution incorporated there that carries on a similar business, has similar compliance measures and is supervised for compliance.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者的客戶是在財務行動特別組織成員司法管轄區註冊成立並在當地受監管的銀行。附表2下有哪一途徑可用？
options: 第4條的簡化盡職審查，因該客戶可能屬第4(3)(b)條所指同等司法管轄區的機構
第15條的加強盡職審查，因該客戶屬外地客戶
完全無須盡職審查，因銀行獲豁免
第14條的代理銀行業務措施，因該客戶是銀行
tc.explain: 香港以外的財務行動特別組織成員司法管轄區，屬第1(1)條定義下的同等司法管轄區。第4(3)(b)條繼而准許對在當地註冊成立、經營類似業務、設有類似合規措施並受監督的機構採用簡化盡職審查。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “business relationship”) applied
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「業務關係」的定義）的應用

en.q: A customer opens an account with an MSO intending to remit monthly to family overseas. At what point does a business relationship arise?
options: At first contact, because the institution then expects the relationship to have an element of duration
Only after the second remittance is completed
Only once twelve months have elapsed
Only when the aggregate of remittances exceeds $120,000
en.explain: Limb (b) of the definition covers a relationship that the institution, at the time the person first contacts it in the capacity of a potential customer, expects to have an element of duration. The expectation at first contact is sufficient; no waiting period or transaction count is required.

tc.q: 某客戶在金錢服務經營者開立帳戶，擬每月向海外家人匯款。業務關係於何時產生？
options: 於初次接觸時，因該機構當時已預期該關係具有持續性元素
須待第二筆匯款完成後
須待十二個月屆滿後
須待匯款總額超過120,000元
tc.explain: 該定義的(b)項涵蓋該人以潛在客戶身分初次接觸該機構時，該機構預期會具有持續性元素的關係。初次接觸時的預期已屬足夠，無須等待期或交易次數。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “politically exposed person”) applied
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「政治人物」的定義）的應用

en.q: A prospective customer is a middle-ranking official in a foreign government ministry. Does the politically exposed person definition apply?
options: No — sub-paragraph (a)(ii) expressly excludes a middle-ranking or more junior official of the listed categories
Yes — any government official abroad is a politically exposed person
Yes, but only if the ministry controls a state-owned corporation
Only if the official has held the post for more than five years
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (a)(i) lists the senior categories covered, and sub-paragraph (a)(ii) expressly provides that the definition does not include a middle-ranking or more junior official of any of those categories. The section 10 requirements therefore are not triggered by that status alone.

tc.q: 某擬開戶客戶是外國政府部門的中級官員。「政治人物」的定義是否適用？
options: 否——(a)(ii)節明文剔除所列類別中的中級或更低級官員
是——任何外地政府官員均屬政治人物
是，但只限該部門控制國有企業的情況
只限該官員擔任該職位超過五年
tc.explain: (a)(i)節列出所涵蓋的高級類別，而(a)(ii)節明文訂明該定義不包括該等類別中任何中級或更低級的官員。因此，僅憑該身分並不觸發第10條的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第14(1)(a)條

en.q: Before establishing a correspondent banking relationship, what information must an authorized institution collect about the proposed respondent bank?
options: Sufficient information to enable it to understand fully the nature of the proposed respondent bank's business
Only the respondent bank's audited financial statements
Only confirmation that the respondent bank holds a banking licence
Only a list of the respondent bank's directors
en.explain: Section 14(1)(a) of Schedule 2 requires the authorized institution to collect sufficient information about the proposed respondent bank to enable it to understand fully the nature of that bank's business, alongside determining its reputation and assessing its AML/CFT controls.

tc.q: 在建立代理銀行關係前，認可機構須就擬議代理銀行收集甚麼資料？
options: 足夠資料，使其能全面了解該擬議代理銀行業務的性質
只需該代理銀行的經審計財務報表
只需確認該代理銀行持有銀行牌照
只需該代理銀行的董事名單
tc.explain: 附表2第14(1)(a)條規定認可機構須收集關於該擬議代理銀行的足夠資料，使其能全面了解該銀行業務的性質；此外還須確定其聲譽及評估其打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集管控措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第14(1)(b)條

en.q: From what source must an authorized institution determine the reputation of a proposed respondent bank and the quality of its supervision?
options: Publicly available information
Information supplied by the respondent bank itself
A report commissioned from an independent consultant
Confidential intelligence provided by the Monetary Authority
en.explain: Section 14(1)(b) requires the authorized institution to determine, from publicly available information, the reputation of the proposed respondent bank and the quality of its supervision by authorities in that place performing functions similar to those of the Monetary Authority.

tc.q: 認可機構須從甚麼來源確定擬議代理銀行的聲譽及其所受監管的質素？
options: 公開可得的資料
該代理銀行本身提供的資料
委聘獨立顧問撰寫的報告
金融管理專員提供的機密情報
tc.explain: 第14(1)(b)條規定認可機構須從公開可得的資料，確定該擬議代理銀行的聲譽，以及該地方執行與金融管理專員類似職能的當局對其監管的質素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第14(2)條

en.q: Which of the following must an authorized institution do before establishing a correspondent banking relationship?
options: Obtain approval from its senior management and document its own responsibilities and those of the proposed respondent bank
Obtain the Monetary Authority's written approval
Obtain a guarantee from the respondent bank's regulator
Obtain the consent of the respondent bank's own customers
en.explain: Section 14(2) requires senior management approval; satisfaction, after complying with section 14(1), that the respondent bank's AML/CFT controls are adequate and effective; documentation of the responsibilities of both institutions; and satisfaction as to the respondent bank's handling of customers who can directly operate the accounts.

tc.q: 認可機構在建立代理銀行關係前，須作出下列哪項？
options: 取得其高級管理層批准，並以文件記錄其本身及該擬議代理銀行的責任
取得金融管理專員的書面批准
取得該代理銀行的監管機構的擔保
取得該代理銀行本身客戶的同意
tc.explain: 第14(2)條規定須取得高級管理層批准；在遵從第14(1)款後信納該代理銀行的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集管控措施充分有效；以文件記錄雙方機構的責任；並就該代理銀行如何處理可直接操作帳戶的客戶感到信納。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第14(2)(d)條

en.q: In relation to a respondent bank's customers who will be able to directly operate the accounts maintained for the respondent bank, of what must the authorized institution be satisfied?
options: That the respondent bank will verify those customers' identities and continuously monitor those relationships to similar standards, and will provide the resulting documents on request
That those customers will be individually approved by the authorized institution
That those customers are all resident in the respondent bank's jurisdiction
That the number of such customers will not exceed a specified limit
en.explain: Section 14(2)(d) requires satisfaction that the proposed respondent bank will verify the identities of those customers and continuously monitor its business relationships with them in accordance with requirements similar to those in Schedule 2, and will be able to provide the documents, data or information obtained to the authorized institution on request.

tc.q: 就將可直接操作為代理銀行維持的帳戶的該代理銀行客戶，認可機構須信納甚麼？
options: 該代理銀行會按類似標準核實該等客戶的身分並持續監察該等關係，並會應要求提供由此取得的文件
該等客戶會由該認可機構逐一批准
該等客戶全部居於該代理銀行所在司法管轄區
該等客戶的數目不會超過指定上限
tc.explain: 第14(2)(d)條規定須信納該擬議代理銀行會按與附表2所施加者類似的規定，核實該等客戶的身分並持續監察與他們的業務關係，並能應要求向該認可機構提供所取得的文件、數據或資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第7(2)條

en.q: What was an authorized institution required to do on the commencement of the Ordinance in relation to a pre-existing correspondent banking relationship?
options: Terminate the relationship, unless the three conditions in section 7(2)(a) to (c) had already been satisfied before that date
Continue the relationship in every case, since it predated the Ordinance
Apply to the Monetary Authority for permission to continue
Convert the relationship into an ordinary customer relationship
en.explain: Section 7(2) required termination on the commencement date unless, before that date, the institution had carried out the section 14(1) measures and was satisfied the respondent bank's controls were adequate and effective; had documented both parties' responsibilities; and was satisfied as to the respondent bank's handling of directly-operating customers.

tc.q: 就本條例生效前已存在的代理銀行關係，認可機構在本條例生效時須怎樣做？
options: 終止該關係，除非第7(2)(a)至(c)款的三項條件已在該日期前獲符合
在任何情況下均可繼續該關係，因其早於本條例
向金融管理專員申請准許繼續
將該關係轉為一般客戶關係
tc.explain: 第7(2)條規定須於生效日期終止該關係，除非該機構在該日期前已進行第14(1)款的措施並信納該代理銀行的管控措施充分有效；已以文件記錄雙方的責任；並就該代理銀行如何處理可直接操作帳戶的客戶感到信納。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「職能」的定義）

en.q: What does “function” include under Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: Power and duty
Power only, not duty
Duty only, not power
Only functions expressly conferred by the Ordinance
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that function includes power and duty. The breadth matters for provisions such as section 4 immunity and section 26 delegation, both of which are framed in terms of functions.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》附表1而言，「職能」包括甚麼？
options: 權力及職責
只包括權力，不包括職責
只包括職責，不包括權力
只包括本條例明文授予的職能
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「職能」包括權力及職責。此定義的廣泛程度對第4條的免責保障及第26條的職能轉授等條文十分重要，因兩者均以「職能」表述。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definitions of “document” and “record”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「文件」及「紀錄」的定義）

en.q: From which Ordinance do the definitions of “document” and “record” in Schedule 1 to the AMLO take their meaning?
options: The Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571), section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1
The Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622)
The Evidence Ordinance (Cap. 8)
The Electronic Transactions Ordinance (Cap. 553)
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that document and record each have the meaning given by section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571). Information system, by contrast, takes its meaning from the Electronic Transactions Ordinance.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1中「文件」及「紀錄」的定義，源自哪一條例？
options: 《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）附表1第1部第1條
《公司條例》（第622章）
《證據條例》（第8章）
《電子交易條例》（第553章）
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「文件」及「紀錄」各具有《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）附表1第1部第1條所給予的涵義。相對而言，「資訊系統」則源自《電子交易條例》。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「資訊系統」的定義）

en.q: From which Ordinance does “information system” take its meaning for the purposes of the AMLO?
options: The Electronic Transactions Ordinance (Cap. 553), section 2(1)
The Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571)
The Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486)
The Telecommunications Ordinance (Cap. 106)
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 provides that information system has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Electronic Transactions Ordinance (Cap. 553). The term is used in the production powers in sections 9, 18 and 47.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，「資訊系統」的涵義源自哪一條例？
options: 《電子交易條例》（第553章）第2(1)條
《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）
《個人資料（私隱）條例》（第486章）
《電訊條例》（第106章）
tc.explain: 附表1第2部訂明「資訊系統」具有《電子交易條例》（第553章）第2(1)條所給予的涵義。該詞用於第9、18及47條的交出資料權力條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「法團」的定義）

en.q: How is “corporation” defined in Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: A company as defined by section 2(1) of the Companies Ordinance, or other body corporate incorporated either in Hong Kong or elsewhere
Only a company incorporated in Hong Kong
Only a company listed on a recognised stock exchange
Any body of persons, whether corporate or unincorporate
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines corporation as a company as defined by section 2(1) of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) or other body corporate incorporated either in Hong Kong or elsewhere. A body of persons corporate or unincorporate is a legal person under Schedule 2, which is wider.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部如何界定「法團」？
options: 《公司條例》第2(1)條所界定的公司，或在香港或其他地方成立為法團的其他法人團體
只限在香港註冊成立的公司
只限在認可證券交易所上市的公司
任何人的團體，不論是否屬法團
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「法團」為《公司條例》（第622章）第2(1)條所界定的公司，或在香港或其他地方成立為法團的其他法人團體。附表2下的「法人」則涵蓋任何屬法團或非法團的人的團體，範圍更廣。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「董事」的定義）

en.q: How is “director” defined in Part 2 of Schedule 1 for a corporation that is not a Companies Ordinance company?
options: A person, by whatever name called, who occupies in the corporation a position similar to that of a director of a Companies Ordinance company
Only a person registered as a director in the jurisdiction of incorporation
Only an executive officer with day-to-day management responsibility
Only a person appointed by shareholders' resolution
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines director, for a Companies Ordinance company, by reference to that Ordinance, and for any other corporation as a person (by whatever name called) who occupies in the corporation a position similar to that of such a director. Section 24 uses a comparable substance-over-form formula for Part 5.

tc.q: 就並非《公司條例》公司的法團而言，附表1第2部如何界定「董事」？
options: 在該法團中擔任類似《公司條例》公司董事職位的人，不論其職銜為何
只限在註冊成立司法管轄區登記為董事的人
只限負責日常管理的行政人員
只限經股東決議委任的人
tc.explain: 附表1第2部就《公司條例》公司按該條例界定「董事」；就任何其他法團，則界定為在該法團中擔任類似該等董事職位的人，不論其職銜為何。第24條就第5部採用可比的重實質而非形式的表述。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「地產代理」的定義）

en.q: Who is an “estate agent” for the purposes of the AMLO?
options: A licensed estate agent or a licensed salesperson, each as defined by section 2(1) of the Estate Agents Ordinance
Only a licensed estate agent, not a salesperson
Any person who arranges property transactions by way of business
Only an estate agent who is a member of a professional body
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines estate agent as a licensed estate agent as defined by section 2(1) of the Estate Agents Ordinance (Cap. 511), or a licensed salesperson as defined by that section. Both are DNFBPs.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，何人屬「地產代理」？
options: 《地產代理條例》第2(1)條所界定的持牌地產代理或持牌營業員
只限持牌地產代理，不包括營業員
以業務方式安排物業交易的任何人
只限屬專業團體會員的地產代理
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「地產代理」為《地產代理條例》（第511章）第2(1)條所界定的持牌地產代理，或該條所界定的持牌營業員。兩者均屬指定非金融企業及行業。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 2 (definition of “Estate Agents Authority”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「地產代理監管局」的定義）

en.q: Under which provision is the Estate Agents Authority established, as referenced in Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: Section 4 of the Estate Agents Ordinance (Cap. 511)
Section 2(1) of the Estate Agents Ordinance
Section 6 of the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council Ordinance
Section 4AAA of the Insurance Ordinance
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines Estate Agents Authority as the body established by section 4 of the Estate Agents Ordinance (Cap. 511). Section 4AAA of the Insurance Ordinance establishes the Insurance Authority, and section 6 of Cap. 588 continues the AFRC.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1所提述的地產代理監管局，是根據哪一條文設立？
options: 《地產代理條例》（第511章）第4條
《地產代理條例》第2(1)條
《會計及財務匯報局條例》第6條
《保險業條例》第4AAA條
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「地產代理監管局」為根據《地產代理條例》（第511章）第4條設立的團體。《保險業條例》第4AAA條設立保險業監管局，而第588章第6條則延續會計及財務匯報局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「保險業監管局」的定義）

en.q: Under which provision of the Insurance Ordinance is the Insurance Authority established, as referenced in Schedule 1?
options: Section 4AAA
Section 2(1)
Section 5F
Section 4
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines Insurance Authority as the Insurance Authority established under section 4AAA of the Insurance Ordinance (Cap. 41). Section 5F of that Ordinance concerns audits, referred to in section 76D(1)(j).

tc.q: 附表1所提述的保險業監管局，是根據《保險業條例》哪一條文設立？
options: 第4AAA條
第5F條
第4條
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「保險業監管局」為根據《保險業條例》（第41章）第4AAA條設立的保險業監管局。該條例第5F條關乎審計，見第76D(1)(j)條的提述。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「香港會計師公會」的定義）

en.q: Under which provision is the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants incorporated, as referenced in Schedule 1?
options: Section 3 of the Professional Accountants Ordinance (Cap. 50)
Section 2(1) of the Professional Accountants Ordinance
Section 6 of the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council Ordinance
Section 4 of the Companies Ordinance
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines HKICPA as the body known as the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants incorporated by section 3 of the Professional Accountants Ordinance (Cap. 50). The AFRC is continued under section 6 of Cap. 588.

tc.q: 附表1所提述的香港會計師公會，是根據哪一條文成立為法團？
options: 《專業會計師條例》（第50章）第3條
《專業會計師條例》第2(1)條
《會計及財務匯報局條例》第6條
《公司條例》第4條
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「香港會計師公會」為根據《專業會計師條例》（第50章）第3條成立為法團、名為香港會計師公會的團體。會計及財務匯報局則根據第588章第6條延續。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「認可機構」的定義）

en.q: From which Ordinance does “authorized institution” take its meaning for the purposes of the AMLO?
options: The Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155), section 2(1)
The Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571)
The Insurance Ordinance (Cap. 41)
The Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584)
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 provides that authorized institution has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155). The concept matters because section 25 excludes authorized institutions from Part 5 altogether.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，「認可機構」的涵義源自哪一條例？
options: 《銀行業條例》（第155章）第2(1)條
《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）
《保險業條例》（第41章）
《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）
tc.explain: 附表1第2部訂明「認可機構」具有《銀行業條例》（第155章）第2(1)條所給予的涵義。此概念十分重要，因第25條將認可機構完全排除於第5部之外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「持牌法團」的定義）

en.q: From which Ordinance does “licensed corporation” take its meaning for the purposes of the AMLO?
options: The Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571), Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1
The Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622)
The Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155)
The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance itself
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 provides that licensed corporation has the meaning given by section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571) — the same source as the definitions of document and record.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，「持牌法團」的涵義源自哪一條例？
options: 《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）附表1第1部第1條
《公司條例》（第622章）
《銀行業條例》（第155章）
《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》本身
tc.explain: 附表1第2部訂明「持牌法團」具有《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）附表1第1部第1條所給予的涵義——與「文件」及「紀錄」的定義出處相同。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “stored value facility”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「儲值支付工具」的定義）

en.q: From which Ordinance does “stored value facility” take its meaning under Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: The Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584), section 2A
The Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155)
The Electronic Transactions Ordinance (Cap. 553)
The Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571)
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that stored value facility has the meaning given by section 2A of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584). Designated retail payment system takes its meaning from section 2 of the same Ordinance.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1下「儲值支付工具」的涵義源自哪一條例？
options: 《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）第2A條
《銀行業條例》（第155章）
《電子交易條例》（第553章）
《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「儲值支付工具」具有《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）第2A條所給予的涵義。「指定零售支付系統」則源自同一條例第2條。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “Review Tribunal”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「審裁處」的定義）

en.q: How is “Review Tribunal” defined in Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: The Tribunal as defined by section 54
A tribunal established by the Chief Justice under section 76
Any tribunal established under Part 6 or Schedule 4
The Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that Review Tribunal means the Tribunal as defined by section 54 — the interpretation provision for Part 6, which establishes the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1如何界定「審裁處」？
options: 第54條所界定的審裁處
終審法院首席法官根據第76條設立的審裁處
根據第6部或附表4設立的任何審裁處
證券及期貨事務上訴審裁處
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「審裁處」指第54條所界定的審裁處——即第6部的釋義條文，而第6部設立打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集審裁處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「會計專業人士」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is included in the definition of “accounting professional” in Schedule 1?
options: A certified public accountant, a corporate practice, and a CPA firm, each as defined in the relevant Ordinance
Only a certified public accountant in sole practice
Any person holding an accounting degree
Only a member of an overseas accounting body practising in Hong Kong
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines accounting professional as a certified public accountant as defined by section 2(1) of the Professional Accountants Ordinance or a certified public accountant (practising) as defined in the AFRC Ordinance; a corporate practice as defined in the AFRC Ordinance; or a CPA firm as defined in that Ordinance.

tc.q: 附表1「會計專業人士」的定義包括下列何者？
options: 有關條例所界定的執業會計師、法團執業及會計師事務所
只限獨資執業的執業會計師
任何持有會計學位的人
只限在香港執業的海外會計團體會員
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「會計專業人士」為《專業會計師條例》第2(1)條所界定的會計師或《會計及財務匯報局條例》所界定的執業會計師；該局條例所界定的法團執業；或該條例所界定的會計師事務所。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「會財局」的定義）

en.q: What does “AFRC” mean in Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: The Accounting and Financial Reporting Council continued under section 6 of the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council Ordinance (Cap. 588)
The Audit and Financial Reporting Commission established under the Companies Ordinance
A committee of the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants
An advisory body to the Financial Secretary on accounting standards
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1, as amended in 2022, defines AFRC as the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council continued under section 6 of the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council Ordinance (Cap. 588). It also appears in the section 76D(1)(g) disclosure list.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部中「會財局」指甚麼？
options: 根據《會計及財務匯報局條例》（第588章）第6條延續的會計及財務匯報局
根據《公司條例》設立的審計及財務匯報委員會
香港會計師公會轄下的委員會
就會計準則向財政司司長提供意見的諮詢機構
tc.explain: 經2022年修訂的附表1第2部界定「會財局」為根據《會計及財務匯報局條例》（第588章）第6條延續的會計及財務匯報局。該局亦見於第76D(1)(g)條的披露名單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「律師會」的定義）

en.q: What does “Law Society” mean in Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: The Law Society of Hong Kong
The Hong Kong Bar Association
Any professional body regulating legal practitioners in Hong Kong
The Legal Practitioners Registration Committee
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1, added in 2018, defines Law Society as The Law Society of Hong Kong. It is one of the bodies to which a relevant authority may disclose information under section 76D(1)(g).

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部中「律師會」指甚麼？
options: 香港律師會
香港大律師公會
在香港規管法律執業者的任何專業團體
法律執業者登記委員會
tc.explain: 2018年加入的附表1第2部界定「律師會」為香港律師會。該會是有關當局可根據第76D(1)(g)條向其披露資料的團體之一。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “designated retail payment system”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「指定零售支付系統」的定義）

en.q: From which provision does “designated retail payment system” take its meaning under Schedule 1?
options: Section 2 of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584)
Section 2A of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance
Section 2(1) of the Banking Ordinance
Section 2(1) of the Electronic Transactions Ordinance
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that designated retail payment system has the meaning given by section 2 of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584). Section 2A of that Ordinance defines stored value facility.

tc.q: 附表1下「指定零售支付系統」的涵義源自哪一條文？
options: 《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）第2條
《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》第2A條
《銀行業條例》第2(1)條
《電子交易條例》第2(1)條
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「指定零售支付系統」具有《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）第2條所給予的涵義。該條例第2A條則界定「儲值支付工具」。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.3(1)(a) and s.3(2) compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(a)條與第3(2)條的比較

en.q: What is the relationship between section 3(1)(a) and section 3(2) of Schedule 2?
options: Section 3(1)(a) requires CDD before establishing a business relationship; section 3(2) creates a narrow exception permitting verification afterwards on two conditions
Section 3(2) repeals section 3(1)(a) for all financial institutions
Section 3(2) applies only to DNFBPs, and section 3(1)(a) only to financial institutions
Section 3(2) permits CDD to be omitted entirely in urgent cases
en.explain: Section 3(1)(a) is expressly made subject to subsection (2). Section 3(2) permits verification of the customer and any beneficial owner after establishing the relationship, but only where that is necessary not to interrupt normal business conduct and any resulting risk is effectively managed.

tc.q: 附表2第3(1)(a)條與第3(2)條有何關係？
options: 第3(1)(a)條規定在建立業務關係前須進行客戶盡職審查；第3(2)條則設立狹窄例外，在兩項條件下准許事後核實
第3(2)條就所有金融機構廢除第3(1)(a)條
第3(2)條只適用於指定非金融企業及行業，第3(1)(a)條只適用於金融機構
第3(2)條准許在緊急情況下完全省略客戶盡職審查
tc.explain: 第3(1)(a)條明文受第(2)款規限。第3(2)條准許在建立關係後方核實客戶及任何實益擁有人的身分，但只限為免打斷正常業務往來而有此需要，且因此產生的風險獲有效管理。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.4 and s.15 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4條與第15條的比較

en.q: How do sections 4 and 15 of Schedule 2 relate to one another?
options: Section 4 permits simplified due diligence in specified lower-risk situations, while section 15 imposes additional requirements in high-risk situations
Both impose additional requirements, section 15 being the stricter
Section 4 applies to financial institutions and section 15 to DNFBPs
Section 15 replaces section 4 where both could apply
en.explain: Section 4 allows an institution, in defined lower-risk cases, to carry out only the section 2(1)(a), (ab), (c) and (d) measures. Section 15 works in the opposite direction, adding senior management approval, source of wealth and funds enquiries or additional mitigating measures in high-risk situations.

tc.q: 附表2第4條與第15條有何關係？
options: 第4條在指明的較低風險情況下准許簡化盡職審查；第15條則在高風險情況下施加額外規定
兩者均施加額外規定，而第15條較嚴格
第4條適用於金融機構，第15條適用於指定非金融企業及行業
在兩者均可適用時，第15條取代第4條
tc.explain: 第4條在界定的較低風險情況下，准許機構只進行第2(1)(a)、(ab)、(c)及(d)條的措施。第15條方向相反，在高風險情況下加入高級管理層批准、財富及資金來源查究或額外的減低風險措施。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.20 and s.21 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20條與第21條的比較

en.q: What is the division of subject matter between sections 20 and 21 of Schedule 2?
options: Section 20 governs what records must be kept and for how long; section 21 governs the form in which they must be kept
Section 20 applies to financial institutions and section 21 to DNFBPs
Section 20 covers transaction records and section 21 covers customer records
Section 21 sets a longer retention period than section 20
en.explain: Section 20 sets out the duty to keep records — what must be kept under subsection (1) and the retention periods under subsections (2), (3), (3A) and any extension under (4). Section 21 addresses the manner of keeping: originals, or copies on microfilm or in a computer database.

tc.q: 附表2第20條與第21條在主題上如何分工？
options: 第20條規管須保存哪些紀錄及保存多久；第21條規管須以何種形式保存
第20條適用於金融機構，第21條適用於指定非金融企業及行業
第20條涵蓋交易紀錄，第21條涵蓋客戶紀錄
第21條訂明較第20條更長的保存期
tc.explain: 第20條訂明保存紀錄的責任——第(1)款訂明須保存甚麼，第(2)、(3)、(3A)款訂明保存期，第(4)款則訂明延長。第21條則處理保存方式：正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫保存的副本。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4部的結構

en.q: Which two sections make up Part 4 of Schedule 2, and what do they address?
options: Section 22, extending duties to overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings, and section 23, requiring safeguards to prevent contravention and mitigate risks
Section 20, record-keeping, and section 21, the manner of keeping records
Section 18, intermediaries, and section 19, procedures
Section 16, anonymous accounts, and section 17, shell banks
en.explain: Part 4 of Schedule 2 is headed Miscellaneous and comprises section 22, which extends the Parts 2 and 3 duties to branches and subsidiary undertakings outside Hong Kong, and section 23, which requires all reasonable measures to ensure proper safeguards and to mitigate ML/TF risks.

tc.q: 附表2第4部由哪兩條組成？各自處理甚麼？
options: 第22條將責任延伸至境外分支機構及附屬企業；第23條規定須設有防護措施以防止違反並減低風險
第20條紀錄保存，及第21條保存紀錄的方式
第18條中介人，及第19條程序
第16條匿名帳戶，及第17條空殼銀行
tc.explain: 附表2第4部標題為「雜項」，由第22條（將第2及3部的責任延伸至香港以外的分支機構及附屬企業）及第23條（規定須採取一切合理措施確保設有適當防護措施並減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險）組成。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2部第3分部

en.q: What is the subject matter of Division 3 of Part 2 of Schedule 2?
options: Prohibitions — anonymous accounts and correspondent banking relationships with shell banks
Special requirements for higher-risk customers and transactions
General customer due diligence obligations
Record-keeping requirements
en.explain: Division 3 of Part 2 of Schedule 2 is headed Prohibitions and contains section 16 (anonymous accounts and accounts in fictitious names) and section 17 (correspondent banking relationships with shell banks). Division 2 contains the special requirements and Division 4 the miscellaneous provisions.

tc.q: 附表2第2部第3分部的主題為何？
options: 禁止事項——匿名帳戶，以及與空殼銀行的代理銀行關係
就較高風險客戶及交易的特別規定
一般客戶盡職審查責任
紀錄保存規定
tc.explain: 附表2第2部第3分部標題為「禁止事項」，載有第16條（匿名帳戶及以虛構名稱開立的帳戶）及第17條（與空殼銀行的代理銀行關係）。第2分部載有特別規定，第4分部則載有雜項條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2部第4分部

en.q: Which sections make up Division 4 of Part 2 of Schedule 2?
options: Section 18, on carrying out CDD measures by means of intermediaries, and section 19, on establishing procedures
Sections 16 and 17, on prohibitions
Sections 20 and 21, on record-keeping
Sections 22 and 23, on branches and safeguards
