en.explain: Division 4 of Part 2 of Schedule 2 is headed Miscellaneous and comprises section 18 (carrying out customer due diligence measures by means of intermediaries) and section 19 (financial institutions and DNFBPs to establish procedures).

tc.q: 附表2第2部第4分部由哪些條文組成？
options: 第18條（藉中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施）及第19條（訂立程序）
第16及17條（禁止事項）
第20及21條（紀錄保存）
第22及23條（分支機構及防護措施）
tc.explain: 附表2第2部第4分部標題為「雜項」，由第18條（藉中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施）及第19條（金融機構及指定非金融企業及行業須訂立程序）組成。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.5 and s.6 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5條與第6條的比較

en.q: How do the termination consequences in sections 5 and 6 of Schedule 2 differ?
options: Section 6(2) requires termination where the institution cannot comply with section 6(1) for a pre-existing customer; section 5 imposes monitoring duties but contains no termination provision of its own
Both sections require termination on the same terms
Section 5 requires termination and section 6 does not
Neither section provides for termination; only section 3(4) does
en.explain: Section 5 sets out the continuous monitoring duty and, in subsection (3), additional measures for higher-risk customers, but has no termination provision. Section 6(2) requires termination as soon as reasonably practicable where the institution cannot carry out CDD on a pre-existing customer when a section 6(1) trigger arises; section 3(4) contains the parallel rule for other cases.

tc.q: 附表2第5條與第6條的終止關係後果有何不同？
options: 第6(2)條規定，如機構就過渡期客戶無法遵從第6(1)款，須終止關係；第5條訂明監察責任，但本身並無終止條文
兩條均按相同條款規定須終止
第5條規定須終止，第6條則否
兩條均無終止規定；只有第3(4)條有
tc.explain: 第5條訂明持續監察責任，並在第(3)款訂明就較高風險客戶的額外措施，但並無終止條文。第6(2)條規定，如第6(1)款的觸發情況出現而機構無法就過渡期客戶進行客戶盡職審查，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止關係；第3(4)條就其他情況訂有相對應規則。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.12 and s.13 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12條與第13條的比較

en.q: Which institutions are subject to section 13 of Schedule 2, and how does that differ from section 12?
options: Section 13 applies specifically to licensed money service operators carrying out non-wire remittance transactions; section 12 applies to financial institutions generally in relation to wire transfers
Section 13 applies to authorized institutions and section 12 to money service operators
Both apply to all financial institutions without distinction
Section 13 applies only to virtual asset transfers
en.explain: Section 13(1) applies to a remittance transaction other than a wire transfer, of $8,000 or above, carried out by a licensed money service operator. Section 12 applies to financial institutions generally in relation to wire transfers, subject to the exclusions in section 12(2).

tc.q: 附表2第13條適用於哪些機構？與第12條有何分別？
options: 第13條特別適用於進行非電匯匯款交易的持牌金錢服務經營者；第12條則就電匯一般適用於金融機構
第13條適用於認可機構，第12條適用於金錢服務經營者
兩者均不加區別地適用於所有金融機構
第13條只適用於虛擬資產轉移
tc.explain: 第13(1)條適用於持牌金錢服務經營者進行、8,000元或以上而並非電匯的匯款交易。第12條則就電匯一般適用於金融機構，並受第12(2)款的例外規定所限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20條的應用

en.q: An MSO's customer relationship ends in June 2026, having begun in 2019. Until when must the customer identity records be kept?
options: Until at least June 2031 — at least 5 years beginning on the date the business relationship ends
Until at least 2024 — 5 years from when the relationship began
Only until the relationship ends, since the records then serve no purpose
Until at least June 2032 — 6 years from the end of the relationship
en.explain: Section 20(3) requires records under section 20(1)(b) to be kept throughout the continuance of the business relationship and for at least 5 years beginning on the date the relationship ends. A relationship ending in June 2026 therefore carries a retention obligation until at least June 2031.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者與客戶的關係於2019年開始，並於2026年6月終止。客戶身分紀錄須保存至何時？
options: 至少至2031年6月——自業務關係終止之日起計至少5年
至少至2024年——自關係開始起計5年
只須保存至關係終止為止，因其後已無用途
至少至2032年6月——自關係終止起計6年
tc.explain: 第20(3)條規定第20(1)(b)款的紀錄須在業務關係持續期間保存，並自關係終止之日起計至少5年。因此，於2026年6月終止的關係，其保存責任至少延續至2031年6月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(2)條的應用

en.q: A customer completes a transaction in March 2026 and closes the relationship in September 2026. Until when must the transaction record be kept?
options: Until at least March 2031 — the 5-year period runs from completion of the transaction, regardless of the relationship ending
Until at least September 2031, aligned with the end of the relationship
Only until September 2026, when the relationship ended
Until at least March 2032
en.explain: Section 20(2) requires transaction records to be kept for at least 5 years beginning on the date the transaction is completed, regardless of whether the business relationship ends during that period. The transaction date, not the relationship end date, governs.

tc.q: 某客戶於2026年3月完成一宗交易，並於2026年9月終止關係。該交易紀錄須保存至何時？
options: 至少至2031年3月——5年期自交易完成起計，不論關係是否終止
至少至2031年9月，與關係終止時間一致
只須保存至2026年9月關係終止時
至少至2032年3月
tc.explain: 第20(2)條規定交易紀錄須自該交易完成之日起計保存至少5年，不論該業務關係是否在該期間內終止。以交易日期而非關係終止日期為準。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.2(1)(a) and s.2(1)(b) compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(a)條與第2(1)(b)條的比較

en.q: How does the verification standard for a beneficial owner differ from that for the customer under section 2(1) of Schedule 2?
options: The customer's identity must be verified on the basis of documents from the listed sources; for a beneficial owner, only reasonable measures to verify are required, so that the institution is satisfied it knows who they are
Both require verification to the identical documentary standard
The beneficial owner's identity must be verified more rigorously than the customer's
No verification of a beneficial owner is required in any circumstances
en.explain: Section 2(1)(a) requires identifying the customer and verifying identity on the basis of documents, data or information from the listed sources. Section 2(1)(b) requires identifying the beneficial owner and taking reasonable measures to verify identity, so that the institution is satisfied it knows who the beneficial owner is — a risk-sensitive rather than documentary standard.

tc.q: 根據附表2第2(1)條，核實實益擁有人身分的標準與核實客戶身分的標準有何不同？
options: 客戶身分須依據所列來源的文件核實；就實益擁有人而言，只須採取合理措施核實，以令機構信納其知悉該實益擁有人是何人
兩者均須按完全相同的文件標準核實
實益擁有人的身分須較客戶更嚴格地核實
在任何情況下均無須核實實益擁有人身分
tc.explain: 第2(1)(a)條規定須識別客戶並依據所列來源的文件、數據或資料核實其身分。第2(1)(b)條則規定須識別實益擁有人並採取合理措施核實其身分，以令機構信納其知悉該實益擁有人是何人——屬按風險而定而非文件式的標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第16條的應用

en.q: An MSO discovers that an account it has maintained for two years is in a fictitious name. What does section 16 of Schedule 2 require?
options: The prohibition covers maintaining as well as opening such an account, so the MSO must not continue to maintain it
Nothing, since the prohibition applies only at the point of opening
The MSO may maintain the account provided it now identifies the true customer
The MSO must report the account but may continue to operate it
en.explain: Section 16 provides that an institution must not open, or maintain, any anonymous account or account in a fictitious name for any customer. Because maintaining is prohibited as well as opening, discovering the position mid-relationship does not cure the contravention.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者發現其維持了兩年的一個帳戶是以虛構名稱開立。附表2第16條有何規定？
options: 該禁止規定同時涵蓋開立及維持該等帳戶，故該經營者不得繼續維持該帳戶
無須採取行動，因該禁止規定只在開立時適用
只要現時識別出真正客戶，該經營者即可維持該帳戶
該經營者須匯報該帳戶，但可繼續操作
tc.explain: 第16條訂明機構不得為任何客戶開立或維持任何匿名帳戶或以虛構名稱開立的帳戶。由於「維持」與「開立」同受禁止，在關係中途發現此情況並不能補救該項違反。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.5(1)(a) and s.5(2) compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)(a)條與第5(2)條的比較

en.q: How is the section 5(1)(a) review duty modified for a pre-existing customer before CDD is first carried out?
options: The institution need only review the documents, data and information it holds at the time of the review, rather than obtaining fresh material
The duty does not apply at all until CDD has been carried out
The institution must obtain a full fresh set of identification documents
The review must be carried out annually rather than from time to time
en.explain: Section 5(2) limits the section 5(1)(a) duty, in relation to a pre-existing customer before CDD measures are first carried out under Part 2, to reviewing the documents, data and information relating to the customer that the institution holds at the time it conducts the review.

tc.q: 就過渡期客戶而言，在首次進行客戶盡職審查前，第5(1)(a)條的檢視責任如何調整？
options: 機構只須檢視其在進行檢視時所持有的文件、數據及資料，而無須另行取得新材料
在進行客戶盡職審查前該責任完全不適用
機構須重新取得整套身分識別文件
檢視須每年進行，而非不時進行
tc.explain: 第5(2)條將第5(1)(a)款的責任加以限制：就過渡期客戶而言，在按第2部首次進行客戶盡職審查措施前，只須檢視該機構在進行該項檢視時所持有的、關於該客戶的文件、數據及資料。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.9 and s.5(3)(a) compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9條與第5(3)(a)條的比較

en.q: A customer is not physically present for identification. Which two distinct obligations does Schedule 2 impose?
options: Section 9 requires at least one of three special verification measures at the outset; section 5(3)(a) requires additional measures in the ongoing monitoring of the relationship
Only section 9 applies; ongoing monitoring is unaffected
Only section 5(3)(a) applies; no special measures are needed at the outset
Both sections require the relationship to be refused
en.explain: Section 9(1) addresses the point of identification, requiring at least one of the three listed measures. Section 5(3)(a) addresses the ongoing relationship, requiring additional measures in monitoring to compensate for the risk. Both are disapplied where a recognized digital identification system was used.

tc.q: 某客戶並未親身出席以供識別。附表2施加哪兩項不同的責任？
options: 第9條規定在開始時須進行三項特別核實措施中至少一項；第5(3)(a)條則規定在持續監察該關係時須採取額外措施
只有第9條適用；持續監察不受影響
只有第5(3)(a)條適用；開始時無須特別措施
兩條均規定須拒絕建立該關係
tc.explain: 第9(1)條處理識別環節，規定須進行所列三項措施中至少一項。第5(3)(a)條則處理持續關係，規定在監察時須採取額外措施以抵銷風險。如已使用獲認可數碼身分識別系統，兩者均不適用。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.10 and s.15 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10條與第15條的比較

en.q: What do the politically exposed person requirements in section 10 and the high-risk requirements in section 15 have in common?
options: Both require senior management approval and, in the case of a business relationship, reasonable measures to establish source of wealth and source of funds
Both require the relationship to be terminated
Both apply only to occasional transactions
Both may be satisfied by taking additional mitigating measures instead
en.explain: Section 10(1) requires senior management approval and reasonable measures to establish source of wealth and source of funds before establishing a relationship with a PEP. Section 15(a) requires senior management approval and either the same source enquiries or additional mitigating measures — section 10 does not offer that alternative.

tc.q: 第10條的政治人物規定與第15條的高風險規定有何共通之處？
options: 兩者均規定須取得高級管理層批准；如涉及業務關係，並須採取合理措施確定財富來源及資金來源
兩者均規定須終止該關係
兩者均只適用於單次交易
兩者均可改以採取額外的減低風險措施而符合
tc.explain: 第10(1)條規定在與政治人物建立關係前，須取得高級管理層批准並採取合理措施確定財富來源及資金來源。第15(a)條規定須取得高級管理層批准，並須作出相同的來源查究或採取額外的減低風險措施——第10條並無該替代選項。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.18 and s.22 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18條與第22條的比較

en.q: An MSO relies on an overseas office for part of its compliance work. Which Schedule 2 provisions may be engaged?
options: Section 18, if the office acts as an intermediary carrying out CDD measures, and section 22, if the office is a branch or subsidiary undertaking of the MSO
Only section 18, since section 22 applies to authorized institutions alone
Only section 22, since section 18 applies to Hong Kong intermediaries alone
Neither, since overseas offices fall outside Schedule 2
en.explain: Section 18 governs the carrying out of CDD measures by means of a specified intermediary, which can include a related foreign financial institution under section 18(3)(d). Section 22 requires a Hong Kong-incorporated institution to ensure its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings have compliance procedures in place.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者倚賴海外辦事處處理部分合規工作。附表2的哪些條文可能適用？
options: 如該辦事處作為中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施，則第18條適用；如該辦事處是該經營者的分支機構或附屬企業，則第22條適用
只有第18條，因第22條只適用於認可機構
只有第22條，因第18條只適用於香港的中介人
兩者皆不適用，因海外辦事處不在附表2範圍內
tc.explain: 第18條規管藉指明中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施，而根據第18(3)(d)條，指明中介人可包括有關連的外地金融機構。第22條則規定在香港註冊成立的機構須確保其境外分支機構及附屬企業設有合規程序。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.23 and s.19 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第23條與第19條的比較

en.q: How do the obligations in sections 19 and 23 of Schedule 2 differ in character?
options: Section 19 requires specific procedures for identified matters such as PEP determination; section 23 imposes a general duty to take all reasonable measures to ensure safeguards and mitigate risks
Section 19 applies to financial institutions and section 23 to DNFBPs
Section 23 is narrower than section 19 and applies only to record-keeping
They are alternatives, and complying with one discharges the other
en.explain: Section 19 prescribes particular procedures — for determining PEP status, for handling non-compliant wire and virtual asset transfers, and for carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15. Section 23 is the general safeguards duty covering any requirement under Part 2 or 3 and the mitigation of ML/TF risks.

tc.q: 附表2第19條與第23條的責任在性質上有何不同？
options: 第19條就已識別的事項（例如斷定政治人物身分）規定具體程序；第23條則施加一般責任，須採取一切合理措施確保設有防護措施並減低風險
第19條適用於金融機構，第23條適用於指定非金融企業及行業
第23條較第19條為窄，只適用於紀錄保存
兩者屬替代關係，遵從其一即已履行另一項
tc.explain: 第19條訂明特定程序——斷定政治人物身分、處理不符規定的電匯及虛擬資產轉移，以及履行第3、4、5、9、10及15條下的責任。第23條則是涵蓋第2或3部任何規定及減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的一般防護責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2的結構

en.q: How is Schedule 2 to the AMLO structured?
options: Part 1 interpretation, Part 2 customer due diligence requirements, Part 3 record-keeping requirements, and Part 4 miscellaneous
Part 1 customer due diligence, Part 2 record-keeping, Part 3 fees, Part 4 the Review Tribunal
A single undivided set of sections numbered 1 to 23
Part 1 general requirements and Part 2 special requirements only
en.explain: Schedule 2 comprises Part 1 (Interpretation, section 1); Part 2 (Customer Due Diligence Requirements, sections 2 to 19, arranged in four Divisions); Part 3 (Record-keeping Requirements, sections 20 and 21); and Part 4 (Miscellaneous, sections 22 and 23).

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2的結構為何？
options: 第1部釋義、第2部客戶盡職審查規定、第3部紀錄保存規定、第4部雜項
第1部客戶盡職審查、第2部紀錄保存、第3部費用、第4部審裁處
由第1至23條組成的單一不分部條文
只有第1部一般規定及第2部特別規定
tc.explain: 附表2由第1部（釋義，第1條）、第2部（客戶盡職審查規定，第2至19條，分為四個分部）、第3部（紀錄保存規定，第20及21條）及第4部（雜項，第22及23條）組成。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第1.1段

en.q: Since when has the Customs and Excise Department been the authority regulating money service operators, and under which ordinance?
options: Since 1 April 2012, under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615)
Since 1997, under the Banking Ordinance
Since 2018, under the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance
Since 2022, under the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance
en.explain: Licensing Guide §1.1: the C&ED has been the authority for regulating MSOs with effect from 1 April 2012, with the relevant powers provided under the AMLO (Cap. 615).

tc.q: 香港海關自何時起成為規管金錢服務經營者的當局？依據哪條條例？
options: 自2012年4月1日起，依據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》（第615章）
自1997年起，依據《銀行業條例》
自2018年起，依據《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》
自2022年起，依據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》
tc.explain: 《牌照指引》第1.1段：海關自2012年4月1日起成為規管金錢服務經營者的當局，相關權力由《打擊洗錢條例》（第615章）賦予。

en.q: What is the normal validity period of an MSO licence, and when does a licence otherwise cease to be valid?
options: Normally 2 years; it also ceases on the death of an individual licensee, dissolution of a partnership, or commencement of winding up of a corporation
Normally 1 year, renewable monthly
Normally 5 years with no other cessation events
Indefinitely, until surrendered
en.explain: §2.10: a licence is normally valid for 2 years and must be renewed before expiry to continue operating. It otherwise ceases to be valid on the death of an individual licensee, the dissolution of a partnership, or the commencement of winding up of a corporate licensee.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者牌照一般的有效期是多久？牌照在其他哪些情況下失效？
options: 一般為2年；如屬個人持牌人身故、合夥解散，或法團開始清盤，牌照亦告失效
一般為1年，按月續期
一般為5年，並無其他失效情況
無限期，直至交回為止
tc.explain: 第2.10段：牌照一般有效期為2年，如欲繼續經營須在期滿前申請續期。另外，個人持牌人身故、合夥解散或法團持牌人開始清盤時，牌照即失效。

en.q: If the CCE refuses an application for the grant of an MSO licence, what happens to the application fee and fit-and-proper test fee already paid?
options: No refund is made, irrespective of whether the application is approved or refused
Both fees are refunded in full
Half of each fee is refunded
The fees are credited towards a future application
en.explain: §2.8: no refund of the application fee is made irrespective of whether the application is approved or refused. §4.14: the fit-and-proper person test fee is likewise non-refundable.

tc.q: 如關長拒絕批出金錢服務經營者牌照，已繳付的申請費及適當人選審查費會如何處理？
options: 不論申請獲批准與否，費用概不退還
兩項費用全數退還
各退還一半
費用可轉作日後申請之用
tc.explain: 第2.8段：不論申請其後獲批准或被拒絕，已收取的申請費概不退還。第4.14段：適當人選審查費同樣不獲退還。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.3段

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide, which of the following does NOT count as a licensable money changing service?
options: A retail shop accepting foreign currencies in sales transactions, incidental to its main business
A dedicated street-level currency exchange shop
An office operating currency exchange for walk-in customers as its business
A company whose business is buying and selling foreign banknotes to the public
en.explain: §2.3: a money changing service is currency exchange operated in Hong Kong as a business, but excludes a service incidental to the main business (e.g. a retail business accepting foreign currencies in transactions) and a hotel service run primarily for guests' convenience consisting solely of buying foreign currency for HK currency.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，下列哪項不屬須領牌的貨幣兌換服務？
options: 零售商店在交易中附帶接受外幣，屬其主要業務的附帶服務
專營的臨街貨幣找換店
以兌換貨幣為業務、接待街客的辦事處
以向公眾買賣外幣鈔票為業務的公司
tc.explain: 第2.3段：貨幣兌換服務指在香港作為業務經營的兌換貨幣服務，但不包括附帶於主要業務的服務（例如零售商在交易中接受外幣），亦不包括酒店主要為方便住客而設、只包含以港幣購買非香港貨幣交易的服務。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) §4.3; Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety (Apr 2018)
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.3段；《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）

en.q: In determining whether a person is fit and proper, the CCE must have regard to all of the following EXCEPT:
options: The person's academic qualifications in finance
Convictions for ML/TF-related offences (in Hong Kong or elsewhere)
Whether the person is an undischarged bankrupt or subject to bankruptcy proceedings
Whether a corporate applicant is in liquidation or subject to a winding-up order
en.explain: §4.3 (and the F&P Guideline): the CCE must consider convictions for specified AMLO/UNATMO/DTROP/OSCO offences and overseas equivalents (including ML/TF and fraud/dishonesty offences), persistent non-compliance with the AMLO, bankruptcy (individuals), liquidation/receivership (corporations), and any other relevant matter. Academic qualifications are not a listed criterion.

tc.q: 關長在決定某人是否屬適當人選時，必須考慮下列各項，但不包括：
options: 該人的金融學歷
（在香港或其他地方）因洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集相關罪行被定罪
該人是否未獲解除破產的破產人或破產程序的對象
法團申請人是否正在清盤或屬清盤令的對象
tc.explain: 第4.3段（及《適當人選準則指引》）：關長須考慮：因《打擊洗錢條例》／《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》／《販毒條例》／《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》指明罪行（及海外同類罪行，包括洗錢及涉欺詐、貪污、不誠實的罪行）被定罪；持續不遵守條例；個人破產情況；法團清盤／接管情況；以及其他有關事宜。學歷並非所列準則。

en.q: An applicant intends to operate a money service with no particular premises (e.g. purely via mobile devices). What must it provide?
options: A local management office (LMO), a correspondence address and a local place for storage of books and records — the LMO staffed by the proprietor/partner/director/ultimate owner and/or CO, not a service provider's address
Nothing beyond an email address
A P.O. Box in Hong Kong
An overseas head-office address
en.explain: §4.5/§4.7: an applicant operating without particular premises must provide an LMO (a physical office reachable in person and by phone by C&ED, staffed by the sole proprietor, partner, director, ultimate owner and/or CO), a correspondence address and an LPS. Residential addresses or the premises of service providers (company secretaries, accountants, solicitors) are not accepted; failure to maintain the LMO can lead to suspension/revocation.

tc.q: 申請人擬在沒有特定處所的情況下經營金錢服務（例如純以流動裝置進行交易）。它必須提供甚麼？
options: 本地管理辦事處、通訊地址及本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點——本地管理辦事處的人員須為東主／合夥人／董事／最終擁有人及／或合規主任，不接受服務供應商的地址
只須提供電郵地址
一個香港郵政信箱
海外總部地址
tc.explain: 第4.5及4.7段：無特定處所經營者必須提供本地管理辦事處（海關人員可親身到達及以電話聯絡的實體辦公室，人員須為獨資經營者、合夥人、董事、最終擁有人及／或合規主任）、通訊地址及本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點。住宅地址或服務供應商（公司秘書行、會計師行、律師行）的處所不獲接納；未能維持本地管理辦事處可導致牌照被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷。

en.q: Which statement about the local place for storage of books and records (LPS) is CORRECT?
options: ALL applicants must provide an LPS in Hong Kong — a physical place under the licensee's control keeping the full set of money service books and records, accessible to C&ED officers
Only applicants with more than one shop need an LPS
Records may simply be kept at the licensee's accounting firm
Cloud storage overseas replaces the need for an LPS
en.explain: §4.10–4.11: all applicants are required to have an LPS in Hong Kong — a physical place keeping the full set of books and records of money service transactions, under the licensee's control to facilitate C&ED access. Residential premises or service providers' addresses (company secretarial, accounting or solicitor firms) are not accepted. Failing to maintain the LPS can lead to suspension/revocation.

tc.q: 關於本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點，下列哪項正確？
options: 所有申請人均須在香港提供本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點——由持牌人控制、存放整套金錢服務交易簿冊及紀錄的實體地點，供海關人員查閱
只有經營多於一間店舖的申請人才需要
紀錄存放於持牌人的會計師行即可
以海外雲端儲存取代即可
tc.explain: 第4.10至4.11段：所有申請人均須提供位於香港的本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點——存放整套金錢服務交易簿冊及紀錄的實體地點，且須由持牌人控制，方便海關人員查閱。住宅處所或服務供應商（公司秘書行、會計師行、律師行）的地址不獲接納。未能維持該地點可導致牌照被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷。

en.q: Which of the following premises would be considered SUITABLE for registration as MSO business premises?
options: Premises in a mixed commercial and residential building, where the applicant has secured the written consent of every occupant for C&ED authorized persons to enter for inspection
Premises in a wholly residential building
Premises already used by another MSO for operating its money service
Premises whose signboard shows a business name different from the Business Registration Certificate
en.explain: §4.6: premises must be accessible to C&ED officers; in a mixed commercial/residential building the written consent of every occupant is needed. NOT suitable: premises in wholly residential buildings, premises used or declared by another MSO, premises accessible only through another party's area, and premises whose signboard name differs from the registered business name.

tc.q: 下列哪類處所會被視為適合登記為金錢服務經營者的營業處所？
options: 位於商住混合大廈的處所，而申請人已取得每名佔用人的書面同意，讓海關獲授權人員進入查察
位於純住宅大廈的處所
已被另一金錢服務經營者用作經營金錢服務的處所
招牌顯示的商號名稱與商業登記證不符的處所
tc.explain: 第4.6段：處所須讓海關人員可進入執行職務；位於商住混合大廈的處所，須取得每名佔用人的書面同意。不適合的處所包括：位於純住宅大廈、已被其他經營者使用或申報、須經他人範圍才能進入，以及招牌名稱與商業登記證登記名稱不符的處所。

en.q: Which statement about the appointment of the CO and MLRO as a licensing requirement is CORRECT?
options: Unless the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner personally takes the role, the CO and MLRO must be the applicant's employee within the meaning of the Employment Ordinance
The CO and MLRO may be freelance consultants paid per assignment
The roles may be left vacant for up to a year
The CO must be a lawyer and the MLRO an accountant
en.explain: §4.15(a): an applicant must appoint a competent CO and MLRO; except where the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner is also the CO/MLRO, they must be the applicant's employee under the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57). Failing to appoint or maintain a competent CO/MLRO is a ground for refusing, suspending or revoking a licence (§5.10(g), §7.1(i)).

tc.q: 關於委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任作為發牌規定，下列哪項正確？
options: 除非由獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人親自兼任，否則合規主任及洗錢報告主任必須是申請人按《僱傭條例》定義的僱員
可委任按項目收費的自由顧問擔任
有關職位可懸空長達一年
合規主任須為律師，洗錢報告主任須為會計師
tc.explain: 第4.15(a)段：申請人須委任稱職的合規主任及洗錢報告主任；除由獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人兼任外，兩者必須是申請人按《僱傭條例》（第57章）定義的僱員。未能委任或維持稱職的合規主任／洗錢報告主任，是拒絕批出、暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照的理由（第5.10(g)及7.1(i)段）。

en.q: Which statement about the Competence Assessment as a licensing requirement is CORRECT?
options: The sole proprietor, any one of the partners or directors must pass the Assessment; its result is one of the factors the CCE considers in determining fitness and properness
Every employee of the applicant must pass the Assessment
Passing the Assessment guarantees the grant of a licence
The Assessment is voluntary and has no bearing on the licence
en.explain: §4.15(b): the sole proprietor, any one of the partners and directors must pass the Competence Assessment, which ensures senior management understands ML/TF risks and can implement effective AML/CFT systems. §5.4: the result is one of the factors relevant to the fit-and-proper determination — passing does not by itself qualify the applicant for a licence.

tc.q: 關於能力評核作為發牌規定，下列哪項正確？
options: 獨資經營者、任何一名合夥人或董事必須在能力評核取得合格成績；評核結果是關長釐定適當人選時考慮的因素之一
申請人的每名僱員均須通過評核
通過評核保證獲批牌照
評核屬自願性質，與牌照無關
tc.explain: 第4.15(b)段：獨資經營者、任何一名合夥人及董事必須在海關舉行的能力評核取得合格成績，以確保高級管理層清楚了解洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險並有能力推行有效的打擊洗錢制度。第5.4段：評核結果是關長釐定申請人是否適當人選的考慮因素之一——合格本身不代表必獲批牌照。

en.q: Under the Licensing Guide, which of the following is an express example of a situation where the CCE may REFUSE to grant a licence?
options: None of the applicant's senior management (sole proprietor, partner or director) attends or passes the designated Competence Assessment
The applicant's projected profits are too low
The applicant has fewer than three staff
The applicant's office is smaller than 200 square feet
en.explain: §5.10 lists refusal examples: failing the fit-and-proper test, unsuitable premises, missing occupant consents, no LPS/LMO information, no compliant Business Plan/AML Policy, no competent CO/MLRO, incomplete applications, none of the senior management attending (i) or passing (j) the Assessment, and exempted persons. Profitability, headcount and office size are not listed grounds.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，下列哪項是關長可拒絕批出牌照的明文例子？
options: 申請人的高級管理層（獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）無人出席或無人通過指定的能力評核
申請人的預計利潤太低
申請人僱員少於三人
申請人的辦公室面積小於200平方呎
tc.explain: 第5.10段列出可拒絕批出牌照的例子：未能通過適當人選審查、處所不適合、未取得佔用人同意書、未提供儲存紀錄地點／本地管理辦事處資料、未按指引提交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策、未委任稱職的合規主任或洗錢報告主任、申請不完整、高級管理層無人出席（第(i)項）或無人通過（第(j)項）評核，以及屬獲豁免人士。利潤、人手及辦公室面積並非所列理由。

en.q: Which statement about the licence renewal process is CORRECT?
options: C&ED sends a reminder with the Assessment invitation 90 days before expiry; the licensee must nominate eligible person(s) within 7 days of receiving the invitation, and they attend the Assessment within 30 days — but applying for renewal 45 days before expiry remains the licensee's legal responsibility
The reminder letter relieves the licensee of the 45-day renewal deadline
Renewal happens automatically unless the CCE objects
The Assessment is waived on renewal
en.explain: §6.2: a reminder with the Assessment invitation is sent 90 days before expiry; nomination must be made within 7 days of receipt and attendance within 30 days; it remains the licensee's legal responsibility to apply 45 days before expiry. §6.4: an invalid renewal application means the licence lapses automatically on expiry — continuing to operate would be unlicensed operation, an offence.

tc.q: 關於牌照續期程序，下列哪項正確？
options: 海關會在期滿前90日發出提示信連同能力評核邀請信；持牌人須在接獲邀請信後7日內提名合資格人士，獲提名者須在30日內應考——但在期滿前45日申請續期仍是持牌人的法律責任
提示信免除持牌人45日限期的責任
除非關長反對，牌照會自動續期
續期時豁免能力評核
tc.explain: 第6.2段：海關會在牌照期滿前90日向持牌人發出提示信連同評核邀請信；持牌人須在接獲邀請信後7日內提名合資格人士，獲提名者須在接獲邀請信後30日內應考；在期滿前45日申請續期仍是持牌人的法律責任。第6.4段：無效的續期申請會令牌照在有效期屆滿時自動失效——繼續經營即屬無牌經營，屬刑事罪行。

en.q: Which of the following is an express example in the Licensing Guide of a ground on which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence?
options: The licensee has never actually provided a money service, so holding the licence fails to fulfil its purpose
The licensee changed its opening hours
The licensee declined to sponsor a community event
The licensee switched to a cheaper office in the same building
en.explain: §7.1 examples include: loss of fit-and-proper status; occupants revoking consent; failure to maintain the LPS or LMO; failure to submit periodic returns on time; holding the licence without providing a money service; non-compliance with AMLO requirements; and failure to appoint or maintain a competent CO or MLRO. The licensee gets an opportunity to be heard (§7.2) and may appeal to the Review Tribunal within 21 days (§7.3).

tc.q: 下列哪項是《牌照指引》明文所載、關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由例子？
options: 持牌人從未實際提供金錢服務，持有牌照未能符合發牌目的
持牌人更改營業時間
持牌人拒絕贊助社區活動
持牌人搬往同一大廈較便宜的辦公室
tc.explain: 第7.1段的例子包括：不再屬適當人選；佔用人撤回同意書；未能維持儲存紀錄地點或本地管理辦事處；未能按時遞交定期申報表；持有牌照而未能符合發牌目的（例如從未提供金錢服務）；不遵守條例規定；及未能委任或維持稱職的合規主任或洗錢報告主任。持牌人有陳詞機會（第7.2段），並可在21日內向覆核審裁處上訴（第7.3段）。

en.q: Which of the following correctly matches the C&ED forms with their purposes?
options: Form 4 — approval of a proposed director/ultimate owner/partner; Form 5 — adding business premises; Form 6 — notification of changes in particulars; Form 7 — notification of cessation of business
Form 4 — cessation; Form 5 — change of particulars; Form 6 — new premises; Form 7 — new directors
Form 4 — licence application; Form 5 — renewal; Form 6 — periodic return; Form 7 — appeal
Form 4 — periodic return; Form 5 — STR; Form 6 — appeal; Form 7 — renewal
en.explain: Per the Licensing Guide: Form 1 is the licence application, Form 2 renewal, Forms 3A/3B fit-and-proper declarations, Form 4 the application for prior approval of a proposed director/ultimate owner/partner (§8.1–8.3), Form 5 adding premises (§8.4), Form 6 notification of changes in particulars (§9.1), and Form 7 notification of cessation of business (§10.2).

tc.q: 下列哪項正確配對海關表格及其用途？
options: 表格4——擬任董事／最終擁有人／合夥人的事先批准申請；表格5——增加營業處所；表格6——資料變更通知；表格7——停業通知
表格4——停業；表格5——資料變更；表格6——新處所；表格7——新董事
表格4——牌照申請；表格5——續期；表格6——定期申報表；表格7——上訴
表格4——定期申報表；表格5——可疑交易報告；表格6——上訴；表格7——續期
tc.explain: 根據《牌照指引》：表格1為牌照申請；表格2為續期；表格3A／3B為適當人選聲明；表格4為擬任董事／最終擁有人／合夥人的事先批准申請（第8.1至8.3段）；表格5為增加營業處所（第8.4段）；表格6為資料變更通知（第9.1段）；表格7為停業通知（第10.2段）。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第8.5段；《打擊洗錢條例》第35(7)條

en.q: A person becomes a director of a licensed MSO corporation without the CCE's prior written approval. What is the criminal penalty on conviction?
options: A fine of HK$50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of HK$1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of HK$10,000,000
Community service only
en.explain: §8.5: contravening s.35(1) without reasonable excuse is an offence with a fine of HK$50,000 and 6 months' imprisonment on conviction; the same penalty applies for contraventions of ss.36(1), 37(1), 38(1) and 39(1). The CCE may additionally take disciplinary action under s.43(1)(c) — and suspend or revoke the licence.

tc.q: 某人未經關長事先書面批准便成為持牌金錢服務經營者（法團）的董事。一經定罪，刑罰為何？
options: 罰款50,000元及監禁6個月
罰款100萬元及監禁2年
罰款1,000萬元
只須社會服務令
tc.explain: 第8.5段：無合理辯解而違反第35(1)條即屬犯罪，一經定罪可處罰款50,000元及監禁6個月；違反第36(1)、37(1)、38(1)及39(1)條的刑罰相同。關長另可根據第43(1)(c)條採取紀律行動，並可暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照。

en.q: How often, and by when, must a licensee lodge periodic returns with the CCE?
options: Within 2 weeks beginning from each half year, in the form and manner specified by the CCE, unless otherwise specified by written notice
Once a year, within 3 months of the financial year end
Monthly, by the 5th of the following month
Only when requested by the CCE
en.explain: §11.2: a licensee must lodge a periodic return within 2 weeks beginning from each half year (unless the CCE specifies otherwise by notice in writing), in the specified form and manner. Failure to submit on time may result in suspension and/or revocation of the licence — it is also an express revocation example in §7.1(f).

tc.q: 持牌人須多久及在何時前向關長遞交定期申報表？
options: 除關長另以書面通知指明外，須在每半年開始起計2星期內，按關長指明的格式及方式遞交
每年一次，於財政年度結束後3個月內
每月一次，於翌月5日前
只在關長要求時
tc.explain: 第11.2段：持牌人須在每半年開始起計2星期內（除非關長以書面通知另行指明），按指明格式及方式遞交定期申報表。未能按時遞交可導致牌照被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷——這亦是第7.1(f)段明文所載的撤銷理由例子。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) §11.1(j); Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (12/2019), item 8
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第11.1(j)段；《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12-2019版）第8項

en.q: Which statement about bank accounts used for operating the money service business is CORRECT?
options: The account must be in the name of the licensee's company, or its sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner — third-party bank accounts are not allowed
Any account may be used, including accounts of friends or business associates
Bank accounts are prohibited for MSOs
Only overseas bank accounts may be used
en.explain: §11.1(j): where bank accounts are used for the money service business, they must be in the name of the licensee's company, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner. The Business Plan guidelines likewise require account details and state that no third-party bank account is allowed; an applicant operating without a bank account must explain how the business operates.

tc.q: 關於用於經營金錢服務業務的銀行戶口，下列哪項正確？
options: 戶口必須以持牌人公司、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的名義開立——不容許使用第三者銀行戶口
任何戶口均可使用，包括朋友或生意夥伴的戶口
金錢服務經營者禁止使用銀行戶口
只可使用海外銀行戶口
tc.explain: 第11.1(j)段：如以銀行戶口經營金錢服務業務，戶口必須以持牌人公司、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的名義開立。《遞交業務計劃的指引》同樣要求提供戶口資料，並訂明不容許第三者銀行戶口；如不使用銀行戶口經營，申請人須詳述業務如何運作。

source.en: Circular MSSB/MIS_02/2026 (13 Mar 2026); Circular MSSB/MIS_03/2026 (15 May 2026)

en.q: According to the 2026 circulars on fee revision, which statement is CORRECT?
options: Twelve licensing fees were revised with effect from 15 May 2026 — e.g. the licence grant application fee rose from $3,310 to $3,810 and the renewal fee from $790 to $910 — in line with the user-pays principle
All licensing fees were abolished from 15 May 2026
Fees were reduced by half to support the industry
Only the fit-and-proper test fee changed, from $945 to $860
en.explain: The 13 March 2026 circular announced the gazettal of the Amendment of Schedule 3 Notice 2026 revising 12 fees effective 15 May 2026: grant $3,310→$3,810; additional premises $2,220→$2,440; F&P test $860→$945; renewal $790→$910 (additional premises $355→$410); approvals $860→$945 per person. The 15 May 2026 circular confirmed the revised Licensing Guide took immediate effect.

tc.q: 根據2026年有關費用調整的通函，下列哪項正確？
options: 發牌制度下12項費用自2026年5月15日起調整——例如牌照批給申請費由3,310元調升至3,810元、續期費由790元調升至910元——以符合「用者自付」原則
所有牌照費用自2026年5月15日起取消
費用減半以支援業界
只有適當人選審查費有變，由945元調整至860元
tc.explain: 2026年3月13日的通函公布政府刊憲修訂附表3，12項費用於2026年5月15日起生效：批給申請3,310→3,810元；每個額外營業處所2,220→2,440元；適當人選審查860→945元；續期790→910元（額外處所355→410元）；董事／最終擁有人／合夥人批准申請每人860→945元。2026年5月15日的通函確認經修訂的《牌照指引》即時生效。

source.en: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 — Trade-based Money Laundering (20 Jan 2026)
source.tc: 通函MSSB/MIS_01/2026——打擊以貿易進行洗錢活動指引（2026年1月20日）

en.q: What does the January 2026 C&ED circular on trade-based money laundering (TBML) warn MSOs about?
options: TBML syndicates using falsified trade documents (fake contracts and invoices) and shell companies to disguise illicit funds as legitimate trade income, with MSOs' cross-boundary remittance services exploited as a conduit — MSOs should use the FATF's TBML risk indicators
A new tax on trade-related remittances
A prohibition on serving any import/export customers
The closure of the FATF's trade office
en.explain: The circular highlights TBML typologies involving falsified trade documents to create bogus transaction records and shell companies to obscure beneficial owners or the source of illicit funds. Cross-boundary remittance services could be exploited as conduits. MSOs are directed to FATF's TBML risk indicators and reminded to strengthen risk assessment, CDD/EDD (including SoF/SoW), transaction monitoring and STR filing.

tc.q: 海關2026年1月有關以貿易為基礎的洗錢活動的通函提醒金錢服務經營者甚麼？
options: 犯罪集團利用虛假貿易文件（假合約及假發票）及空殼公司，把非法資金偽裝成合法貿易收入，經營者的跨境匯款服務可能被利用作轉移渠道——經營者應參考特別組織的相關風險指標
對貿易相關匯款開徵新稅
禁止服務任何進出口客戶
特別組織的貿易辦事處結束
tc.explain: 該通函指出以貿易為基礎的洗錢手法：利用虛假貿易文件製造虛假交易紀錄，並以空殼公司隱藏實益擁有人或非法資金來源；跨境匯款服務可能被利用作轉移貿易犯罪得益的渠道。通函提供特別組織的風險指標連結，並提醒經營者加強風險評估、盡職審查／更嚴格審查（包括資金及財富來源）、交易監察及提交可疑交易報告。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018); Disciplinary Fining Guideline (May 2018)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）；《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）

en.q: According to the C&ED's disciplinary fining guidelines, which principles guide the imposition of pecuniary penalties?
options: Penalties should deter the licensee and other licensees, should reflect the seriousness of the contravention, and should not have the likely effect of putting the licensee in financial jeopardy; decisions to fine are usually publicised
Fines are always set at the statutory maximum
Fines are calculated purely as a fixed percentage of annual turnover
Fines are kept confidential and never publicised
en.explain: Both guidelines (published under s.45(1) for s.43(2)(c) penalties and s.23(1) for s.21(2)(c) penalties) state: a penalty acts as a specific and general deterrent; the more serious the contravention the larger the likely penalty (considering intent, duration, damage to Hong Kong's reputation, systemic weaknesses etc.); a penalty should not put the licensee in financial jeopardy (size and resources considered); and the CCE will usually publicise fining decisions.

tc.q: 根據海關的紀律罰款指引，施加罰款時遵循哪些原則？
options: 罰款應對有關持牌人及其他持牌人起阻嚇作用、應反映違反事項的嚴重程度，且不應令持牌人陷入財政困境；罰款決定通常會公開
罰款一律按法定上限徵收
罰款純粹按年度營業額的固定百分比計算
罰款保密，永不公開
tc.explain: 兩份指引（分別根據第45(1)條就第43(2)(c)條罰款、及第23(1)條就第21(2)(c)條罰款發出）訂明：罰款須對有關持牌人及其他持牌人起阻嚇作用；違反越嚴重，罰款可能越高（考慮是否蓄意、持續時間、對香港聲譽的損害、制度性缺失等）；罰款不應令持牌人陷入財政困境（會考慮其規模及財政資源）；關長通常會公開施加罰款的決定。

source.en: Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety (Apr 2018), cover
source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）封面

en.q: Under which provision of the AMLO is the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety issued?
options: Section 30, in Part 5 — for the grant of a licence
Section 45(1), in Part 5 — on pecuniary penalties
Section 23(1), in Part 4 — on fining
Section 7 — guidelines for the operation of Schedule 2
en.explain: The F&P Guideline is stated on its cover to be issued for the grant of a licence under section 30, in Part 5, of the AMLO. The Disciplinary Action Guideline on Imposition of Pecuniary Penalty is published under section 45(1), and the Disciplinary Fining Guideline under section 23(1).

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》是根據《打擊洗錢條例》哪一條文發出？
options: 第5部第30條——就批出牌照而言
第5部第45(1)條——關於罰款
第4部第23(1)條——關於施加罰款
第7條——關於附表2運作的指引
tc.explain: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》封面訂明其就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部第30條批出牌照而發出。《施加罰款紀律行動指引》根據第45(1)條發出，《紀律處分罰款指引》則根據第23(1)條發出。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第4段

en.q: To whom does the F&P Guideline apply?
options: Every applicant for a licence under section 30, and also to the person who will hold the licence
Only to corporate applicants
Only to individuals nominated to sit the Competence Assessment
Only to applicants who have previously been refused a licence
en.explain: Paragraph 4 states that the Guideline applies to every applicant for a licence under section 30 of the AMLO, and is applicable both to the applicant for a licence and to the person who will hold the licence.

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》適用於何人？
options: 每名根據第30條申請牌照的人，以及將持有該牌照的人
只限公司申請人
只限獲提名參加能力評核的個人
只限此前曾被拒發牌照的申請人
tc.explain: 第4段訂明本指引適用於每名根據《打擊洗錢條例》第30條申請牌照的人，並同時適用於牌照申請人及將持有該牌照的人。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第5(a)段

en.q: Which of the following factors does the F&P Guideline list as relevant to assessing fitness and propriety?
options: Whether the person has failed to comply with any requirement imposed under the AMLO or any regulation made by the CCE
Whether the person holds a professional qualification in finance
Whether the person has operated a money service for at least three years
Whether the person is a Hong Kong permanent resident
en.explain: Paragraph 5 lists the factors, beginning with whether the person has failed to comply with any requirement imposed under the AMLO or any regulation made by the CCE, and continuing with bankruptcy, winding up or receivership, failure to comply with licence conditions, and certain criminal convictions.

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》列出下列哪項為評估適當人選資格的相關因素？
options: 該人有否沒有遵從《打擊洗錢條例》或海關關長訂立的任何規例所施加的任何規定
該人有否持有金融方面的專業資格
該人有否經營金錢服務至少三年
該人是否香港永久性居民
tc.explain: 第5段列出各項因素，首項為該人有否沒有遵從《打擊洗錢條例》或海關關長訂立的任何規例所施加的任何規定；其後包括破產、清盤或接管、沒有遵從牌照條件，以及某些刑事定罪。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第5(e)段

en.q: How does the F&P Guideline treat criminal convictions that are NOT listed in section 30(4)(a) and (b) of the AMLO?
options: They remain relevant if the offence has a significant and negative bearing on the person's honesty, integrity and reliability
They are disregarded entirely, since the statutory list is exhaustive
They are relevant only if the sentence exceeded twelve months' imprisonment
They are relevant only if the conviction occurred in Hong Kong
en.explain: Paragraph 5(e) makes relevant whether the person has been convicted of a criminal offence which is not listed in section 30(4)(a) and (b) of the AMLO but which has a significant and negative bearing on his or her honesty, integrity and reliability.

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》如何處理並未列於《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(a)及(b)條的刑事定罪？
options: 如該罪行對該人的誠實、正直及可靠性有重大負面影響，仍屬相關
完全不予理會，因法定清單已屬詳盡
只有在刑期超過十二個月監禁時方屬相關
只有在該定罪發生於香港時方屬相關
tc.explain: 第5(e)段訂明，該人有否被裁定犯並非列於《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(a)及(b)條、但對其誠實、正直及可靠性有重大負面影響的刑事罪行，屬相關因素。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第6及7段

en.q: What status does the F&P Guideline assign to itself?
options: It provides general guidance, is not exhaustive or comprehensive, and is advisory
It is exhaustive and binding on the CCE
It has the force of subsidiary legislation
It overrides the criteria set out in the AMLO
en.explain: Paragraph 6 states that the Guideline provides general guidance and is not intended to be exhaustive or comprehensive, each case being considered on its own merits. Paragraph 7 states, for avoidance of doubt, that the Guideline is advisory, and recommends legal advice where there are concerns.

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》為其本身賦予甚麼地位？
options: 提供一般指引，並非詳盡無遺，且屬諮詢性質
屬詳盡無遺並對海關關長具約束力
具附屬法例的效力
凌駕《打擊洗錢條例》所訂的準則
tc.explain: 第6段訂明本指引提供一般指引，並非旨在詳盡無遺，每宗個案均按其本身情況考慮。第7段為免生疑問訂明本指引屬諮詢性質，並建議如有疑慮應尋求法律意見。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第5段

en.q: Beyond applications for the grant of a licence, to what else does the Supplementary F&P Guideline apply?
options: Applications for renewal under section 31, and to licensees who must continue to satisfy the fit and proper criteria after the grant
Only to applications refused in the preceding twelve months
Only to corporate licensees, not individuals
Only to licensees under active investigation
en.explain: Paragraph 5 states that the Guideline applies to every applicant for a licence under section 30 and for renewal under section 31, as well as to licensees who must satisfy and continue to satisfy after the grant that they are fit and proper persons.

tc.q: 除批出牌照的申請外，《補充指引》還適用於甚麼？
options: 根據第31條的續期申請，以及在批出牌照後須持續符合適當人選準則的持牌人
只限過去十二個月內被拒的申請
只限公司持牌人，不包括個人
只限正受調查的持牌人
tc.explain: 第5段訂明本指引適用於每名根據第30條申請牌照及根據第31條申請續期的人，以及在獲批牌照後須符合並持續符合適當人選資格的持牌人。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第5段

en.q: What consequence does the Supplementary F&P Guideline identify if a licensee fails to meet the fit and proper criteria after the licence has been granted?
options: It may reflect adversely on the fit and proper person status and would be a ground for suspension or revocation under section 34
It results in an automatic pecuniary penalty under section 43
It has no consequence until the licence falls due for renewal
It requires the licensee to re-sit the Competence Assessment
en.explain: Paragraph 5 states that failure of any licensee to meet the fit and proper criteria may reflect adversely on the fit and proper person status and would be a ground for suspension or revocation of the licence by virtue of section 34, in Part 5, of the AMLO.

tc.q: 《補充指引》指出持牌人在獲批牌照後不符合適當人選準則，會有甚麼後果？
options: 可能對其適當人選資格有負面影響，並構成第34條下暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照的理由
自動觸發第43條的罰款
在牌照到期續期前並無後果
須重新參加能力評核
tc.explain: 第5段訂明，任何持牌人未能符合適當人選準則，可能對其適當人選資格有負面影響，並憑藉《打擊洗錢條例》第5部第34條構成暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照的理由。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(f)段

en.q: Which example does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of a person lacking genuine intention and readiness to carry on the proposed money service business?
options: The person provided nil money service for a prolonged period after the grant of the licence
The person operated from premises smaller than those described in the application
The person changed its business name after the licence was granted
The person appointed a compliance officer from outside Hong Kong
en.explain: Paragraph 6(f) makes relevant whether the person has genuine intention and readiness to carry on the money service business proposed in the licence application, giving as an example a person who provided nil money service for a prolonged period after the grant of the licence.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就某人欠缺經營所建議金錢服務業務的真正意向及準備，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 該人在獲批牌照後長期並無提供任何金錢服務
該人在較申請所述為小的處所經營
該人在獲批牌照後更改業務名稱
該人委任來自香港以外的合規主任
tc.explain: 第6(f)段訂明該人有否真正意向及準備經營其在牌照申請中所建議的金錢服務業務屬相關因素，並以該人在獲批牌照後長期並無提供任何金錢服務為例。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(g)段

en.q: What example does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of having established effective AML/CFT systems?
options: Having a competent compliance officer of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the licensee to oversee the establishment and maintenance of the AML/CFT systems
Having an external auditor certify the systems annually
Having a written AML/CFT policy of at least twenty pages
Having systems approved in advance by the CCE
en.explain: Paragraph 6(g) makes relevant whether the person has established effective AML/CFT systems to ensure compliance with all applicable requirements, giving as an example that the person must have a competent compliance officer of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the licensee to oversee the establishment and maintenance of those systems.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就已建立有效的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集系統，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 在該持牌人內有一名具備足夠資歷及權限的稱職合規主任，監督該等系統的建立及維持
每年由外部核數師核證該等系統
備有至少二十頁的書面打擊洗錢政策
該等系統事先獲海關關長批准
tc.explain: 第6(g)段訂明該人有否建立有效的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集系統以確保遵從所有適用規定屬相關因素，並以該人必須在其內有一名具備足夠資歷及權限的稱職合規主任，監督該等系統的建立及維持為例。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(h)段

en.q: Which example does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of a person not being equipped with the necessary skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism?
options: A person who did not take, or failed to pass, the relevant test conducted by the C&ED in the course of processing the licence application
A person with fewer than five years' experience in financial services
A person who has not attended an external AML/CFT training course
A person who holds no tertiary qualification
en.explain: Paragraph 6(h) makes relevant whether the person is equipped with the skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism necessary to perform the business's functions, and gives as an example a person who did not take or failed to pass the relevant test, if any, conducted by the C&ED in the course of processing the licence application — the Competence Assessment.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就某人並不具備所需的技能、知識、經驗及專業水平，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 該人在處理牌照申請過程中並無參加或未能通過香港海關進行的有關測試
該人在金融服務業的經驗少於五年
該人並無參加外間的打擊洗錢培訓課程
該人並無專上學歷
tc.explain: 第6(h)段訂明該人是否具備有效履行業務職能所需的技能、知識、經驗及專業水平屬相關因素，並以該人在處理牌照申請過程中並無參加或未能通過香港海關進行的有關測試（即能力評核）為例。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(k)段

en.q: For what three purposes must a person provide the necessary infrastructure and internal control systems, according to the Supplementary F&P Guideline?
options: To manage risk effectively, avoid conflict of interest and provide a proper audit trail
To maximise profitability, satisfy shareholders and reduce staffing costs
To satisfy the external auditor, the CCE and the Review Tribunal
To process transactions quickly, retain customers and expand market share
en.explain: Paragraph 6(k) makes relevant whether the person has failed to provide the necessary infrastructure and internal control systems to manage risk effectively, avoid conflict of interest and provide a proper audit trail.

tc.q: 根據《補充指引》，某人須為哪三個目的提供必需的基礎設施及內部監控系統？
options: 有效管理風險、避免利益衝突及提供適當的審計線索
盡量提高盈利、滿足股東及減低人手成本
滿足外部核數師、海關關長及審裁處
快速處理交易、留住客戶及擴大市場佔有率
tc.explain: 第6(k)段訂明該人有否未能提供必需的基礎設施及內部監控系統，以有效管理風險、避免利益衝突及提供適當的審計線索，屬相關因素。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(l)段

en.q: Which examples does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of criminal offences with a significant and negative bearing on honesty, integrity and reliability?
options: Offences relating to fraud, dishonesty and malpractice
Offences relating to traffic and public order
Offences under the Employment Ordinance
Offences relating to environmental protection
en.explain: Paragraph 6(l) makes relevant a conviction for a criminal offence not listed in section 30(4)(a) and (b) of the AMLO but with a significant and negative bearing on honesty, integrity and reliability, giving offences relating to fraud, dishonesty and malpractice as examples.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就對誠實、正直及可靠性有重大負面影響的刑事罪行，舉出哪些例子？
options: 與欺詐、不誠實及失當行為有關的罪行
與交通及公眾秩序有關的罪行
《僱傭條例》下的罪行
與環境保護有關的罪行
tc.explain: 第6(l)段訂明就並非列於《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(a)及(b)條、但對誠實、正直及可靠性有重大負面影響的刑事罪行的定罪屬相關因素，並以與欺詐、不誠實及失當行為有關的罪行為例。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(q)段

en.q: What examples does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of a lack of financial integrity?
options: Failing to satisfy a judgment debt under a court order, or making a compromise or arrangement with creditors
Reporting a loss in any financial year
Holding fewer liquid assets than a competitor of similar size
Failing to distribute a dividend to shareholders
en.explain: Paragraph 6(q) makes relevant whether the person has financial integrity to ensure adequate financial resources for the nature and scale of its operations, and whether its financial position or solvency would undermine customers' or the public's interests, giving as examples failure to satisfy a judgment debt under a court order, or making a compromise or arrangement with creditors.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就欠缺財政操守舉出哪些例子？
options: 未有清償法庭命令下的判定債項，或與債權人達成債務重整或安排
在任何財政年度錄得虧損
持有的流動資產少於規模相若的競爭者
未有向股東派發股息
tc.explain: 第6(q)段訂明該人是否具備財政操守，以確保就其營運的性質及規模有足夠財政資源，以及其財政狀況或償債能力會否損害客戶及公眾的利益，屬相關因素；並以未有清償法庭命令下的判定債項，或與債權人達成債務重整或安排為例。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(r)段

en.q: Why is the state of affairs of a person's other businesses relevant to fitness and propriety?
options: Because another business may expose the person to potential money laundering risk or adversely affect the person's financial integrity
Because the CCE licenses all businesses operated by an MSO
Because other businesses must also pass the Competence Assessment
Because profits from other businesses may not be used in the money service
en.explain: Paragraph 6(r) makes relevant the state of affairs of any other business which the person carries on, proposes to carry on or has any business relationship with, giving as examples another business that exposes the person to the potential risk of money laundering or affects adversely the person's financial integrity.

tc.q: 某人其他業務的狀況為何與適當人選資格有關？
options: 因另一業務可能令該人面對潛在洗錢風險，或對該人的財政操守有不利影響
因海關關長為金錢服務經營者經營的所有業務發牌
因其他業務亦須通過能力評核
因其他業務的利潤不得用於金錢服務
tc.explain: 第6(r)段訂明該人所經營、擬經營或與之有業務關係的任何其他業務的狀況屬相關因素，並以令該人面對潛在洗錢風險，或對該人的財政操守有不利影響的其他業務為例。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(i)段

en.q: Which conduct towards the CCE or the C&ED does the Supplementary F&P Guideline treat as relevant to fitness and propriety?
options: Being untruthful, providing false or misleading information, omitting material information, or being uncooperative in the performance of a function under the AMLO
Declining to answer questions on legal advice
Requesting an extension of time to file a return
Applying to the Review Tribunal for a review of a decision
en.explain: Paragraph 6(i) makes relevant whether the person has been untruthful or provided false or misleading information or omitted material information to the CCE, or been uncooperative with the C&ED in the performance of a function under the AMLO.

tc.q: 《補充指引》將對海關關長或香港海關的哪種行為視為與適當人選資格有關？
options: 不誠實、提供虛假或具誤導性資料、遺漏要項資料，或在執行《打擊洗錢條例》職能時不予合作
基於法律意見而拒絕回答問題
要求延期提交申報表
向審裁處申請覆核決定
tc.explain: 第6(i)段訂明該人有否對海關關長不誠實、提供虛假或具誤導性資料、遺漏要項資料，或在香港海關執行《打擊洗錢條例》職能時不予合作，屬相關因素。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(c)段

en.q: Which guidelines does the Supplementary F&P Guideline name as ones with which compliance is relevant to fitness and propriety?
options: The Licensing Guide and the Guideline on AML/CFT issued for money service operators
The FATF Recommendations and the Basel Core Principles
The Companies Ordinance and the Business Registration Ordinance
The Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance codes of practice
en.explain: Paragraph 6(c) makes relevant whether the person is in compliance with guidelines promulgated for money service operators in the regulatory regime, such as the Licensing Guide and the Guideline on Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism issued for MSOs.

tc.q: 《補充指引》指名哪些指引的遵從情況與適當人選資格有關？
options: 《牌照指引》及為金錢服務經營者發出的《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》
財務行動特別組織的建議及巴塞爾核心原則
《公司條例》及《商業登記條例》
《個人資料（私隱）條例》的實務守則
tc.explain: 第6(c)段訂明該人有否遵從在監管制度下為金錢服務經營者頒布的指引屬相關因素，例如《牌照指引》及為金錢服務經營者發出的《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(d)段

en.q: What examples does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of an inability to carry on the money service business competently, honestly and fairly?
options: Contravention of any law designed for consumer protection, or being the subject of a complaint made reasonably and in good faith about the conduct of the business
Failing to achieve a target level of turnover
Employing fewer staff than comparable licensees
Operating from a single business premises only
en.explain: Paragraph 6(d) makes relevant whether the person has the ability to carry out the money service business competently, honestly and fairly and in a manner not detrimental to customers or the public, giving as examples contravention of any consumer protection law, or being the subject of a complaint made reasonably and in good faith about the conduct of the business.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就無能力稱職、誠實及公平地經營金錢服務業務，舉出哪些例子？
options: 違反任何為保障消費者而制定的法律，或成為就其經營業務的行為而合理地及真誠地作出的投訴的對象
未能達到營業額目標
僱用的員工少於同類持牌人
只在單一業務處所經營
tc.explain: 第6(d)段訂明該人是否有能力稱職、誠實及公平地經營金錢服務業務，且其方式不會或不大可能損害客戶或公眾的利益，屬相關因素；並以違反任何為保障消費者而制定的法律，或成為就其經營業務的行為而合理地及真誠地作出的投訴的對象為例。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(n)及(o)段

en.q: Which regulatory histories outside Hong Kong does the Supplementary F&P Guideline treat as relevant?
options: Being censured, disciplined or publicly criticized by a regulatory authority or professional body, and being refused or restricted from the right to carry on a licensed trade, business or profession
Only convictions recorded in a criminal court
Only sanctions imposed by a FATF member jurisdiction
Only matters that have been reported in the press
en.explain: Paragraphs 6(n) and (o) make relevant whether the person has been censured, disciplined or publicly criticized by any regulatory authority or professional body in Hong Kong or elsewhere, and whether the person has been refused or restricted from the right to carry on any trade, business or profession requiring a licence, registration or other authorization.

tc.q: 《補充指引》將香港以外的哪些監管紀錄視為相關？
options: 曾被監管當局或專業團體譴責、紀律處分或公開批評，以及曾被拒絕或限制經營須領牌行業、業務或專業的權利
只限刑事法庭記錄的定罪
只限財務行動特別組織成員司法管轄區所施加的制裁
只限曾見報的事宜
tc.explain: 第6(n)及(o)段訂明該人有否在香港或其他地方被任何監管當局或專業團體譴責、紀律處分或公開批評，以及有否被拒絕或限制經營任何依法須領牌、註冊或取得其他授權的行業、業務或專業的權利，屬相關因素。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(m)及(p)段

en.q: Which two further matters does the Supplementary F&P Guideline treat as relevant, even in the absence of a conviction?
options: Being the subject of unresolved criminal charges in Hong Kong or elsewhere, and having been disqualified by a court of competent jurisdiction from being a director
Having been questioned by the police, and having resigned from a directorship
Having been named in a suspicious transaction report, and having changed auditors
Having been audited by the C&ED, and having filed a late return
en.explain: Paragraph 6(m) makes relevant whether the person is the subject of unresolved criminal charges in Hong Kong or elsewhere, and paragraph 6(p) whether the person has been disqualified by a court of competent jurisdiction from being a director. Neither requires a conviction.

tc.q: 即使並無定罪，《補充指引》仍將哪兩項事宜視為相關？
options: 在香港或其他地方成為未了結刑事控罪的對象，以及曾被具司法管轄權的法院取消擔任董事的資格
曾被警方問話，以及曾辭去董事職位
曾在可疑交易報告中被提及，以及曾更換核數師
曾接受香港海關審查，以及曾遲交申報表
tc.explain: 第6(m)段訂明該人是否在香港或其他地方成為未了結刑事控罪的對象屬相關因素；第6(p)段則訂明該人有否被具司法管轄權的法院取消擔任董事的資格屬相關因素。兩者均不要求有定罪。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第7段

en.q: Does failure to comply with an individual element of paragraph 6 of the Supplementary F&P Guideline necessarily mean the CCE will not be satisfied that a person is fit and proper?
options: No — paragraph 7 states that failure to comply with individual elements may not result in the CCE not being satisfied; each case is considered on its own merits
Yes — each element is a mandatory requirement
Yes, unless the person obtains a written waiver from the CCE
No — paragraph 6 is purely illustrative and carries no weight
en.explain: Paragraph 7 states that the criteria in paragraph 6 are likely to give rise to concerns about fitness and properness, but that failure to comply with individual elements may not result in the CCE not being satisfied; each case is considered on its own merits taking into account all relevant factors.

tc.q: 不符合《補充指引》第6段的個別項目，是否必然導致海關關長不信納某人是適當人選？
options: 否——第7段訂明不符合個別項目未必導致關長不予信納；每宗個案均按其本身情況考慮
是——每一項目均屬強制性規定
是，除非該人取得關長的書面豁免
否——第6段純屬舉例，並無分量
tc.explain: 第7段訂明第6段所列準則相當可能引起對某人適當人選資格的疑慮，但不符合個別項目未必導致海關關長不予信納；每宗個案均按其本身情況並顧及所有相關因素考慮。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Imposition of Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶1
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第1段

en.q: Under which section of the AMLO does the Disciplinary Action Guideline on Imposition of Pecuniary Penalty address the CCE's power?
options: Section 43, applying to licensees who contravene section 51 regulations, licence conditions, or sections 35(1) to 41(1)
Section 21, applying to financial institutions that contravene specified provisions of Schedule 2
Section 34, applying to revocation and suspension
Section 30, applying to the grant of a licence
en.explain: Paragraph 1 explains that under section 43 of the AMLO the CCE may impose a pecuniary penalty on a licensee that contravenes any regulation made under section 51, any condition of its licence, or sections 35(1), 36(1), 37(1), 38(1), 39(1), 39A(1), 40(1) or 41(1). The section 21 power is the subject of the separate Disciplinary Fining Guideline.

tc.q: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》處理海關關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》哪一條的權力？
options: 第43條，適用於違反第51條規例、牌照條件或第35(1)至41(1)條的持牌人
第21條，適用於違反附表2指明條文的金融機構
第34條，適用於撤銷及暫時吊銷
第30條，適用於批出牌照
tc.explain: 第1段解釋，根據《打擊洗錢條例》第43條，海關關長可對違反第51條規例、其牌照任何條件，或第35(1)、36(1)、37(1)、38(1)、39(1)、39A(1)、40(1)或41(1)條的持牌人施加罰款。第21條的權力則由另一份《紀律處分罰款指引》處理。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶4; Disciplinary Fining Guideline (May 2018) ¶3
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第4段；《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第3段

en.q: What is the CCE's stated policy on publicising decisions to impose a pecuniary penalty?
options: The CCE will usually publicise all such decisions
The CCE will publicise a decision only if the licensee consents
The CCE will never publicise such decisions
The CCE will publicise only decisions exceeding $1 million
en.explain: Both guidelines state, as a matter of policy, that the CCE will usually publicise all his decisions to impose a pecuniary penalty. Section 43(7) of the AMLO separately permits disclosure of the decision, the reasons and any material facts.

tc.q: 海關關長就公開施加罰款的決定，訂明的政策為何？
options: 關長通常會公開其所有該等決定
只有在持牌人同意下方會公開
永不會公開該等決定
只會公開超過100萬元的決定
tc.explain: 兩份指引均訂明，作為政策，海關關長通常會公開其所有施加罰款的決定。《打擊洗錢條例》第43(7)條另行准許披露該決定、其理由及任何要項事實。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶6
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第6段

en.q: What twofold purpose is a pecuniary penalty imposed by the CCE intended to serve?
options: To act as a deterrent to the licensee concerned, and as a general deterrent to other licensees
To compensate customers, and to fund the CCE's supervisory work
To recover the costs of the investigation, and to reflect public opinion
To punish the individual directors, and to signal to overseas regulators
en.explain: Paragraph 6 states that any pecuniary penalty imposed by the CCE is intended to act as a deterrent to the licensee concerned and to act as a general deterrent to other licensees. The Disciplinary Fining Guideline expresses the same principle at paragraph 5.

tc.q: 海關關長施加的罰款旨在達致哪兩重目的？
options: 對有關持牌人起阻嚇作用，並對其他持牌人起一般阻嚇作用
賠償客戶，並為關長的監管工作提供經費
收回調查費用，並反映公眾意見
懲罰個別董事，並向海外監管機構發出訊息
tc.explain: 第6段訂明海關關長施加的任何罰款，旨在對有關持牌人起阻嚇作用，並對其他持牌人起一般阻嚇作用。《紀律處分罰款指引》第5段表述相同原則。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶7
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第7段

en.q: What limit does the guideline place on the size of a pecuniary penalty, and what does the CCE take into account?
options: A penalty should not have the likely effect of putting the licensee in financial jeopardy; the CCE takes into account the size and financial resources of the licensee
A penalty must never exceed 10% of the licensee's annual turnover
A penalty must be no more than the profit gained from the contravention
A penalty must be set at the statutory maximum unless the licensee cooperates
en.explain: Paragraph 7 states that a pecuniary penalty should not have the likely effect of putting the licensee concerned in financial jeopardy, and that in considering this factor the CCE will take into account the size and financial resources of the licensee.

tc.q: 指引就罰款金額設下甚麼限制？海關關長會顧及甚麼？
options: 罰款不應相當可能令該持牌人陷入財政危機；關長會顧及該持牌人的規模及財政資源
罰款不得超過該持牌人年度營業額的10%
罰款不得超過因該項違反所獲的利潤
除非該持牌人合作，否則罰款須訂於法定上限
tc.explain: 第7段訂明罰款不應相當可能令有關持牌人陷入財政危機；關長在考慮此因素時，會顧及該持牌人的規模及財政資源。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第6段

en.q: Although section 21(2)(c)(ii) allows a fine of up to three times the profit gained or costs avoided, what does the Disciplinary Fining Guideline say about that measure?
options: The CCE will not automatically link the fine imposed in any particular case with the profit gained or costs avoided
The CCE will always calculate the fine as three times the profit gained
The CCE will apply the multiple only where the profit exceeds $10 million
The CCE will treat the multiple as a minimum rather than a maximum
en.explain: Paragraph 6 states that although section 21(2)(c)(ii) provides one alternative maximum level of fine as three times the profit gained or costs avoided, the CCE will not automatically link the fine imposed in any particular case with the profit gained or costs avoided.

tc.q: 雖然第21(2)(c)(ii)條容許罰款高達所獲利潤或所避免成本的三倍，《紀律處分罰款指引》就該計算基準有何說明？
options: 海關關長不會自動將個別個案所施加的罰款，與所獲利潤或所避免的成本掛鈎
關長一律按所獲利潤的三倍計算罰款
只有在利潤超過1,000萬元時方會採用該倍數
關長會將該倍數視為下限而非上限
tc.explain: 第6段訂明，雖然第21(2)(c)(ii)條訂明罰款的其中一個替代上限為所獲利潤或所避免成本的三倍，但海關關長不會自動將個別個案所施加的罰款與所獲利潤或所避免的成本掛鈎。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(a)(i)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(a)(i)段

en.q: How does the guideline treat a contravention resulting from negligence, or conduct amounting only to a technical breach?
options: It is generally regarded as less serious than an intentional or reckless contravention
It is treated identically to an intentional contravention
It is not a contravention at all and attracts no penalty
It attracts a fixed reduction of 50% in the penalty
en.explain: Paragraph 9(a)(i) lists whether the contravention is intentional or results from recklessness or negligence, and states that a contravention resulting from negligence or conduct which only results in a technical breach is generally regarded as less serious.

tc.q: 指引如何看待因疏忽而引致的違反，或僅構成技術性違規的行為？
options: 一般視為較故意或罔顧後果的違反為輕
與故意違反同等看待
根本不構成違反，並無罰則
罰款自動減少50%
tc.explain: 第9(a)(i)段列出該項違反是故意作出，抑或因罔顧後果或疏忽而引致，並訂明因疏忽而引致的違反或僅構成技術性違規的行為，一般視為較輕。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(a)(iii)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(a)(iii)段

en.q: Which reputational consideration does the pecuniary penalty guideline list among the seriousness factors?
options: Whether the contravention is potentially damaging or detrimental to the integrity of the operation of money services in Hong Kong or the reputation of Hong Kong as an international financial centre
Whether the contravention has been reported in the local press
Whether the licensee's own reputation has been damaged
Whether overseas customers have been deterred from using Hong Kong MSOs
en.explain: Paragraph 9(a)(iii) of the pecuniary penalty guideline asks whether the contravention is potentially damaging or detrimental to the integrity of the operation of money services in Hong Kong or the reputation of Hong Kong as an international financial centre.

tc.q: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》在嚴重程度因素中列出哪一項聲譽考慮？
options: 該項違反是否可能損害香港金錢服務營運的健全性，或香港作為國際金融中心的聲譽
該項違反有否被本地傳媒報道
該持牌人本身的聲譽有否受損
海外客戶有否因而卻步不使用香港的金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》第9(a)(iii)段詢問該項違反是否可能損害香港金錢服務營運的健全性，或香港作為國際金融中心的聲譽。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(a)(vi)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(a)(vi)段

en.q: Which systemic consideration does the guideline list among the factors bearing on the seriousness of a contravention?
options: Whether the contravention reveals serious or systemic weaknesses in the management system or internal controls in respect of customer due diligence and record-keeping procedures
Whether the licensee has changed its senior management since the contravention
Whether the licensee uses an off-the-shelf compliance software package
Whether the licensee operates from more than one business premises
en.explain: Paragraph 9(a)(vi) asks whether the contravention reveals serious or systemic weaknesses in the management system or internal controls in respect of the customer due diligence and record-keeping procedures relating to all or part of a licensee's business.

tc.q: 指引在影響違反嚴重程度的因素中，列出哪一項系統性考慮？
options: 該項違反是否顯示管理系統或內部監控在客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存程序方面存在嚴重或系統性弱點
該持牌人在違反後有否更換高級管理層
該持牌人有否使用現成的合規軟件
該持牌人有否在多於一個業務處所經營
tc.explain: 第9(a)(vi)段詢問該項違反是否顯示該持牌人全部或部分業務的管理系統或內部監控，在客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存程序方面存在嚴重或系統性弱點。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(a)(viii)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(a)(viii)段

en.q: How does the guideline treat a series of smaller issues that individually would not justify a pecuniary penalty?
options: They may justify a penalty when taken collectively
They are disregarded unless each independently justifies a penalty
They are dealt with by written warning only
They are aggregated only if they occurred within the same calendar year
en.explain: Paragraph 9(a)(viii) asks whether there are a number of smaller issues which individually may not justify a pecuniary penalty, but which do so when taken collectively.

tc.q: 指引如何看待一連串個別而言不足以構成施加罰款理由的較小事項？
options: 合起來考慮時可能構成施加罰款的理由
除非每項本身足以構成理由，否則不予理會
只以書面警告處理
只有在同一曆年內發生方會合併計算
tc.explain: 第9(a)(viii)段詢問是否有若干較小事項，個別而言未必足以構成施加罰款的理由，但合起來考慮時則足以構成該理由。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(b)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(b)段

en.q: Which aspects of a licensee's conduct AFTER a contravention does the guideline take into account?
options: Whether it attempted to conceal the contravention, any remedial steps and action against those involved, the degree of cooperation, and the likelihood of recurrence
Only whether it paid any earlier penalty on time
Only whether it dismissed the staff responsible
Only whether it notified its customers
en.explain: Paragraph 9(b) lists attempted concealment; remedial steps taken since the contravention was identified, action taken against those involved and steps to prevent recurrence; the degree of cooperation with the CCE, other relevant authorities and law enforcement agencies; and the likelihood of the same type of contravention recurring if no or a lighter penalty is imposed.

tc.q: 指引會顧及持牌人在違反「之後」行為的哪些方面？
options: 有否試圖隱瞞該項違反、已採取的糾正步驟及對涉事者的行動、合作程度，以及再犯的可能性
只顧及有否準時繳付先前的罰款
只顧及有否辭退負責的員工
只顧及有否通知其客戶
tc.explain: 第9(b)段列出：有否試圖隱瞞違反；自發現違反以來所採取的糾正步驟、對涉事者採取的行動及防止日後再犯的步驟；在調查期間與海關關長、其他有關當局及執法機構的合作程度；以及若不施加或施加較輕罰款，再犯同類違反的可能性。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(c)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(c)段

en.q: Which elements of a licensee's history does the guideline take into account?
options: Its relevant previous disciplinary record including previous similar contraventions, any previous undertaking not to engage in the conduct, and punishment or regulatory action by other relevant authorities on the same incident
Only convictions recorded in the preceding twelve months
Only its record with the CCE, disregarding other regulators
Only complaints made by customers
en.explain: Paragraph 9(c) lists the relevant previous disciplinary record of the licensee including previous similar contraventions; whether the licensee has previously undertaken not to engage in the particular conduct; and any punishment imposed or regulatory action taken or likely to be taken by other relevant authorities in respect of the same incident.

tc.q: 指引會顧及持牌人過往紀錄的哪些方面？
options: 其相關的過往紀律紀錄（包括過往同類違反）、此前有否承諾不作出該行為，以及其他有關當局就同一事件所施加的懲罰或監管行動
只顧及過去十二個月內記錄的定罪
只顧及其在海關關長處的紀錄，不理會其他監管機構
只顧及客戶作出的投訴
tc.explain: 第9(c)段列出：該持牌人的相關過往紀律紀錄，包括其過往同類違反；該持牌人此前有否承諾不從事導致該項違反的特定行為；以及其他有關當局就同一事件已施加或已採取（或相當可能採取）的懲罰或監管行動。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(d)(i)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(d)(i)段

en.q: What does the guideline say about conduct that was in line with guidance current at the time?
options: Generally the CCE will not take disciplinary action against a licensee for conduct that is in line with guidance which was current at the time of the conduct in question
Such conduct is a complete statutory defence
Such conduct is treated as a mitigating factor reducing the penalty by half
Guidance current at the time is irrelevant to the CCE's decision
en.explain: Paragraph 9(d)(i) asks whether the CCE has issued any guidelines in relation to the conduct in question, and states that generally the CCE will not take disciplinary action against a licensee for conduct that is in line with guidance which was current at the time of the conduct.

tc.q: 指引就符合當時有效指引的行為有何說明？
options: 就符合有關行為當時有效指引的行為，海關關長一般不會對持牌人採取紀律行動
該等行為構成完全的法定免責辯護
該等行為屬減輕因素，可將罰款減半
有關行為當時有效的指引與關長的決定無關
tc.explain: 第9(d)(i)段詢問海關關長有否就有關行為發出任何指引，並訂明就符合有關行為當時有效指引的行為，關長一般不會對持牌人採取紀律行動。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(d)(ii)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(d)(ii)段

en.q: What consistency principle does the guideline state in relation to previous similar cases?
options: In general similar cases should be treated in a consistent manner, having regard to what action the CCE and other relevant authorities have taken previously
Each case must be decided without reference to any earlier case
Previous cases are relevant only if they involved the same licensee
Consistency applies only to cases decided in the same calendar year
en.explain: Paragraph 9(d)(ii) asks what action the CCE and/or other relevant authorities have taken in previous similar cases, and states that in general similar cases should be treated in a consistent manner.

tc.q: 指引就過往同類個案訂明甚麼一致性原則？
options: 一般而言，同類個案應以一致方式處理，並須顧及海關關長及其他有關當局過往所採取的行動
每宗個案均須在不參照任何先前個案的情況下裁定
過往個案只在涉及同一持牌人時方屬相關
一致性只適用於同一曆年內裁定的個案
tc.explain: 第9(d)(ii)段詢問海關關長及／或其他有關當局在過往同類個案中採取過甚麼行動，並訂明一般而言同類個案應以一致方式處理。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(d)(iv)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(d)(iv)段

en.q: Which mitigating factor does the guideline expressly identify?
options: Whether the licensee has promptly, effectively and completely brought the contravention or possible contravention to the attention of the CCE
Whether the licensee has been licensed for more than ten years
Whether the licensee has never previously been inspected
Whether the licensee has offered to pay a voluntary contribution
en.explain: Paragraph 9(d)(iv) identifies as a mitigating factor whether the licensee has promptly, effectively and completely brought the contravention or possible contravention to the attention of the CCE — self-reporting is expressly rewarded.

tc.q: 指引明文指出哪一項減輕因素？
options: 該持牌人有否迅速、有效及完整地將該項違反或可能的違反提請海關關長注意
該持牌人是否持牌超過十年
該持牌人此前有否從未被視察
該持牌人有否提出自願捐款
tc.explain: 第9(d)(iv)段將該持牌人有否迅速、有效及完整地將該項違反或可能的違反提請海關關長注意，列為減輕因素——主動申報獲明文肯定。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第1段

en.q: Under which section of the AMLO is the Disciplinary Fining Guideline published, and which fining power does it address?
options: Section 23(1), addressing the section 21(2)(c) power over MSOs that contravene a specified provision as defined by section 5(11)
Section 45(1), addressing the section 43(2)(c) power over licensees
Section 7, addressing guidelines on the operation of Schedule 2
Section 51, addressing regulations made by the CCE
en.explain: Paragraph 1 states that the guideline is published under section 23(1) of the AMLO to indicate how the CCE will exercise the fining power under section 21(2)(c), which applies where an MSO contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11).

tc.q: 《紀律處分罰款指引》根據《打擊洗錢條例》哪一條發出？處理哪一項罰款權力？
options: 第23(1)條，處理第21(2)(c)條就違反第5(11)條所界定指明條文的金錢服務經營者的權力
第45(1)條，處理第43(2)(c)條就持牌人的權力
第7條，處理關於附表2運作的指引
第51條，處理海關關長訂立的規例
tc.explain: 第1段訂明本指引根據《打擊洗錢條例》第23(1)條發出，以說明海關關長將如何行使第21(2)(c)條的罰款權力；該權力適用於金錢服務經營者違反第5(11)條所界定的指明條文的情況。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第1段

en.q: May the CCE impose a pecuniary penalty under section 21 together with other disciplinary sanctions?
options: Yes — paragraph 1 states the penalty may be imposed either on its own or together with other disciplinary sanctions
No — a pecuniary penalty must always be imposed alone
Only where the Review Tribunal has approved the combination
Only where the MSO consents to the combined sanction
en.explain: Paragraph 1 of the Disciplinary Fining Guideline states that under section 21 the CCE may impose a pecuniary penalty either on its own or together with other disciplinary sanctions on an MSO that contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11).

tc.q: 海關關長可否在施加第21條罰款的同時，一併施加其他紀律制裁？
options: 可以——第1段訂明該罰款可單獨施加，亦可連同其他紀律制裁一併施加
不可以——罰款必須單獨施加
只限審裁處批准該項合併的情況
只限該金錢服務經營者同意合併制裁的情況
tc.explain: 《紀律處分罰款指引》第1段訂明，根據第21條，海關關長可對違反第5(11)條所界定指明條文的金錢服務經營者，單獨施加罰款，或連同其他紀律制裁一併施加。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第9(a)(iii)段

en.q: How does the reputational factor in the Disciplinary Fining Guideline differ in wording from that in the pecuniary penalty guideline?
options: The Fining Guideline refers only to the reputation of Hong Kong as an international financial centre, while the pecuniary penalty guideline also refers to the integrity of the operation of money services in Hong Kong
The Fining Guideline omits any reputational factor
The Fining Guideline refers only to the licensee's own reputation
The two are worded identically
en.explain: Paragraph 9(a)(iii) of the Disciplinary Fining Guideline asks whether the contravention is potentially damaging or detrimental to the reputation of Hong Kong as an international financial centre. The corresponding paragraph of the pecuniary penalty guideline adds the integrity of the operation of money services in Hong Kong.

tc.q: 《紀律處分罰款指引》的聲譽因素在措辭上與《施加罰款紀律行動指引》有何不同？
options: 《紀律處分罰款指引》只提及香港作為國際金融中心的聲譽，而《施加罰款紀律行動指引》亦提及香港金錢服務營運的健全性
《紀律處分罰款指引》並無聲譽因素
《紀律處分罰款指引》只提及該持牌人本身的聲譽
兩者措辭完全相同
tc.explain: 《紀律處分罰款指引》第9(a)(iii)段詢問該項違反是否可能損害香港作為國際金融中心的聲譽。《施加罰款紀律行動指引》的對應段落則另加香港金錢服務營運的健全性。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第9段

en.q: How does the Disciplinary Fining Guideline describe the list of seriousness factors it sets out?
options: Not exhaustive — some may not apply in a particular case, and there may be other relevant factors not listed
Exhaustive and binding, with each factor to be scored
Applicable only to first-time contraventions
Applicable only where the contravention was intentional
en.explain: Paragraph 9 states that in determining the seriousness of a contravention the CCE will consider all the circumstances and take into account the relevant factors set out, that the factors listed are not exhaustive, that some may not be applicable in a particular case, and that there may be other relevant factors not listed.

tc.q: 《紀律處分罰款指引》如何描述其所列的嚴重程度因素清單？
options: 並非詳盡無遺——某些因素在個別個案中可能不適用，亦可能有其他未列出的相關因素
詳盡無遺並具約束力，每項因素均須評分
只適用於首次違反
只適用於故意作出的違反
tc.explain: 第9段訂明，在斷定違反的嚴重程度時，海關關長會考慮所有情況並顧及所列的相關因素；所列因素並非詳盡無遺，某些在個別個案中可能不適用，亦可能有其他未列出的相關因素。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第2段；《補充指引》（2020年1月）第2段

en.q: Both fitness-and-propriety guidelines emphasise the same statutory point about section 30(4). What is it?
options: In addition to the matters the CCE must have regard to, the CCE may take into account any other matter he considers relevant
Section 30(4) is an exhaustive list of relevant matters
Section 30(4) applies only to corporate applicants
Section 30(4) may be waived by the CCE in a particular case
en.explain: Paragraph 2 of both guidelines states that section 30(4) details the matters the CCE must have regard to, and that in addition to those matters the CCE may take into account any other matter he considers relevant. The Supplementary Guideline exists precisely to give examples of those other matters.

tc.q: 兩份適當人選指引均強調關於第30(4)條的同一法定要點。該要點是甚麼？
options: 除海關關長必須顧及的事項外，關長可考慮其認為相關的任何其他事項
第30(4)條是相關事項的詳盡清單
第30(4)條只適用於公司申請人
關長可在個別個案中豁免第30(4)條
tc.explain: 兩份指引的第2段均訂明第30(4)條詳列海關關長必須顧及的事項，而除該等事項外，關長可考慮其認為相關的任何其他事項。《補充指引》的存在正是為就該等其他事項提供例子。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）前言

en.q: How must the Supplementary F&P Guideline be read?
options: In conjunction with the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety
As a free-standing replacement for the earlier F&P Guideline
Only alongside the Licensing Guide
Only alongside the AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs
en.explain: The preamble states that the Supplementary Guideline must be read in conjunction with the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety, and that it aims to provide examples to further an applicant's understanding of the CCE's power to have regard to any other relevant matter.

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》須如何閱讀？
options: 須與《有關適當人選準則的指引》一併閱讀
作為取代較早前《適當人選指引》的獨立文件
只須與《牌照指引》一併閱讀
只須與《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》一併閱讀
tc.explain: 前言訂明本《補充指引》須與《有關適當人選準則的指引》一併閱讀，其目的是提供例子，以增進申請人對海關關長可顧及任何其他相關事項的權力的理解。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), introduction
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）引言

en.q: What is the stated purpose of the Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan?
options: To set out key elements that should be included so the Money Service Supervision Bureau has a comprehensive understanding of the proposed money service business and its mode of operation
To prescribe a minimum level of capital for licence applicants
To set out the fees payable on a licence application
To specify the format of periodic returns
en.explain: The introduction states that the guidelines set out key elements that should be included in the business plan so as to allow the Money Service Supervision Bureau (MSSB) to have a comprehensive understanding of the applicant's proposed money service business and its mode of operation.

tc.q: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》訂明的目的為何？
options: 列出業務計劃應包括的主要元素，使金錢服務監理科能全面了解申請人擬經營的金錢服務業務及其運作模式
訂明牌照申請人的最低資本水平
訂明牌照申請應繳付的費用
指明定期申報表的格式
tc.explain: 引言訂明本指引列出業務計劃應包括的主要元素，使金錢服務監理科能全面了解申請人擬經營的金錢服務業務及其運作模式。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), introduction
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）引言

en.q: What must an applicant confirm in writing in the business plan?
options: That it is aware of and will comply with the requirement to notify the Commissioner in writing of any change in particulars within one month of the change
That it will not change its business model for at least two years
That it has never applied for a licence in another jurisdiction
That it will submit audited accounts every six months
en.explain: The introduction requires the applicant to confirm in writing in the business plan that it is well aware of and will comply with the statutory requirement that if there is any change in the particulars provided to the Commissioner for the grant or renewal of an MSO licence, the licensee must notify the Commissioner in writing within one month beginning on the date the change takes place.

tc.q: 申請人須在業務計劃中以書面確認甚麼？
options: 其充分知悉並會遵從下述規定：所提供的詳情如有變更，須自變更發生之日起計一個月內以書面通知海關關長
其在至少兩年內不會更改業務模式
其從未在其他司法管轄區申請牌照
其會每六個月提交經審計帳目
tc.explain: 引言規定申請人須在業務計劃中以書面確認，其充分知悉並會遵從以下法定規定：就批出或續期金錢服務經營者牌照而向海關關長提供的詳情如有任何變更，持牌人須自變更發生之日起計一個月內以書面通知關長。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), introduction
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）引言

en.q: What consequence does the Business Plan guideline attach to failing to provide the necessary information?
options: It may delay or hinder the processing of the application
The application is automatically refused
The applicant is liable to a pecuniary penalty
