The application is referred to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: The introduction states that it is important that the applicant provides all necessary information to the MSSB for examination and has the necessary resources to execute the business plan and comply with statutory and regulatory requirements, and that failure to provide this information may delay or hinder the processing of the application.

tc.q: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》就未有提供所需資料訂明甚麼後果？
options: 可能延誤或阻礙申請的處理
申請自動被拒絕
申請人須繳付罰款
申請會轉交審裁處
tc.explain: 引言訂明申請人向金錢服務監理科提供所有必需資料以供審查，並具備執行業務計劃及遵從法定及監管規定的必要資源，十分重要；未有提供該等資料可能延誤或阻礙申請的處理。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 8
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第8項

en.q: What rule does the Business Plan guideline state about bank accounts used for the money service business?
options: No third party bank account is allowed; the applicant must provide the account number and the owner of the account
Any account may be used provided the applicant discloses it
Only accounts with authorized institutions in Hong Kong may be used
At least two separate accounts must be maintained
en.explain: Item 8 requires information on any bank accounts used for the business, such as the account number and owner of the bank account, and states expressly that no third party bank account is allowed.

tc.q: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》就用於金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶訂明甚麼規則？
options: 不容許使用第三方銀行帳戶；申請人須提供帳戶號碼及帳戶擁有人
只要申請人披露，任何帳戶均可使用
只可使用在香港認可機構開立的帳戶
須維持至少兩個獨立帳戶
tc.explain: 第8項規定須提供用於業務的任何銀行帳戶的資料，例如帳戶號碼及帳戶擁有人，並明文訂明不容許使用第三方銀行帳戶。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 8 note
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第8項註

en.q: An applicant considers it does not need a bank account for the business. What does the Business Plan guideline require?
options: The applicant must provide details on how the company will provide money service without a bank account
The application cannot proceed without a bank account
The applicant must use a director's personal account instead
The applicant must obtain the Commissioner's written exemption
en.explain: The note to item 8 states that if the applicant considers there is no need to open a bank account for the business, the applicant is required to provide details on how the company will provide money service without a bank account.

tc.q: 某申請人認為其業務無須開立銀行帳戶。《遞交業務計劃的指引》有何規定？
options: 申請人須提供詳情，說明公司在沒有銀行帳戶的情況下如何提供金錢服務
沒有銀行帳戶則申請不能進行
申請人須改用董事的個人帳戶
申請人須取得海關關長的書面豁免
tc.explain: 第8項的註訂明，如申請人認為業務無須開立銀行帳戶，申請人須提供詳情，說明公司在沒有銀行帳戶的情況下如何提供金錢服務。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 6
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第6項

en.q: What must the description of business operation in Hong Kong detail, according to the Business Plan guideline?
options: The entire transaction process, such as placing the transaction order, handling and processing of the order, movement of funds, compliance function, and accounting and record-keeping function
Only the expected annual turnover
Only the number of counters and staff
Only the currencies to be handled
en.explain: Item 6 requires the applicant to elaborate in detail on what business operation will take place in Hong Kong and the reason for obtaining a licence locally, with the business operation detailing the entire transaction process including placing the transaction order, handling and processing of the order, movement of funds, compliance function, and accounting and record-keeping function.

tc.q: 根據《遞交業務計劃的指引》，香港業務運作的描述須詳述甚麼？
options: 整個交易流程，例如落交易指示、處理指示、資金流動、合規職能，以及會計及紀錄保存職能
只需預期年度營業額
只需櫃檯及員工數目
只需將處理的貨幣
tc.explain: 第6項規定申請人須詳細說明將在香港進行的業務運作及在本地取得牌照的原因，而業務運作須詳述整個交易流程，例如落交易指示、處理指示、資金流動、合規職能，以及會計及紀錄保存職能。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 7
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第7項

en.q: Where foreign agents or foreign MSOs are used to transfer or receive funds, what must the business plan provide?
options: Information on all agents and overseas MSOs together with the service agreement, and the measures taken to protect customer funds against loss if an agent or MSO fails to perform
Only the names of the agents
Only the jurisdictions in which the agents operate
Only confirmation that the agents are licensed locally
en.explain: Item 7 requires information on all agents and overseas MSOs together with the service agreement, and requires the applicant to elaborate the measures taken to protect customer funds against risk of loss in the event of non-fulfilment by another agent or MSO both inside and outside Hong Kong.

tc.q: 如使用外地代理或外地金錢服務經營者轉移或收取資金，業務計劃須提供甚麼？
options: 所有代理及海外金錢服務經營者的資料連同服務協議，以及在代理或經營者未能履行時保障客戶資金免受損失的措施
只需代理的名稱
只需代理營運所在的司法管轄區
只需確認該等代理在當地持牌
tc.explain: 第7項規定須提供所有代理及海外金錢服務經營者的資料連同服務協議，並規定申請人須詳述在香港境內外其他代理或經營者未能履行的情況下，保障客戶資金免受損失風險所採取的措施。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 9
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第9項

en.q: Over what period must the business plan project profitability, and what else must it cover?
options: The expected profit margin and turnover on each type of product and service for the next two years, and the running capital for daily operation
The next five years, together with a break-even analysis
The next twelve months only, with no capital information
The preceding two years' actual results
en.explain: Item 9 requires information on the expected profit margin and turnover on each type of product and service for the next two years, and the running capital for the daily operation of the business.

tc.q: 業務計劃須就多長期間預測盈利能力？還須涵蓋甚麼？
options: 未來兩年每類產品及服務的預期利潤率及營業額，以及業務日常營運的營運資金
未來五年，連同收支平衡分析
只需未來十二個月，無須資本資料
過去兩年的實際業績
tc.explain: 第9項規定須提供未來兩年每類產品及服務的預期利潤率及營業額，以及業務日常營運的營運資金的資料。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 10
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第10項

en.q: What must the business plan include about organizational structure?
options: Organizational charts of both the Hong Kong group of companies and the international group, with a brief description and the business carried out by each entity
Only a chart of the Hong Kong entity
Only a list of directors and their shareholdings
Only the number of employees at each location
en.explain: Item 10 requires elaboration of the group of companies in Hong Kong — including parent company, local branches and subsidiaries — and of the international group of companies to which the applicant belongs, with an organizational chart in each case and a brief description of each entity and the business it carries out.

tc.q: 業務計劃就組織架構須包括甚麼？
options: 香港公司集團及國際集團的組織圖，並附各實體的簡介及其所經營的業務
只需香港實體的組織圖
只需董事名單及其持股量
只需各地點的僱員人數
tc.explain: 第10項規定須詳述在香港的公司集團（包括母公司、本地分支機構及附屬公司）及申請人所屬的國際公司集團，兩者均須附上組織圖，並就集團內每個實體提供簡介及其所經營的業務。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 11
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第11項

en.q: Where the applicant's business premises are shared with other businesses, what must the business plan elaborate?
options: The nature of those other businesses, whether they are owned by the applicant, its director, partner or staff, and whether they have any business relationship with the applicant
Only the floor area occupied by each business
Only the rent apportionment between the businesses
Only whether the other businesses hold their own MSO licences
en.explain: Item 11 requires the applicant to elaborate the nature of the other businesses sharing its premises, whether those other businesses are also owned by the applicant, its director, partner or staff, and whether they have any business relationships with the applicant, describing the nature of any such relationships.

tc.q: 如申請人的業務處所與其他業務共用，業務計劃須詳述甚麼？
options: 該等其他業務的性質、該等業務是否亦由申請人、其董事、合夥人或員工擁有，以及該等業務與申請人有否任何業務關係
只需各業務所佔的樓面面積
只需各業務之間的租金分攤
只需該等其他業務有否持有本身的金錢服務經營者牌照
tc.explain: 第11項規定申請人須詳述與其共用處所的其他業務的性質、該等其他業務是否亦由申請人、其董事、合夥人或員工擁有，以及該等業務與申請人有否任何業務關係；如有，須說明該等關係的性質。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 12
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第12項

en.q: What details must the business plan give about the applicant's management team and employees?
options: Their total number, positions, roles and responsibilities such as compliance functions and reporting of suspicious transactions, whether full time or part time, and the reporting lines
Only their names and identity card numbers
Only their salaries and terms of employment
Only the number of staff who have passed the Competence Assessment
en.explain: Item 12 requires elaboration of the composition of the management team and of the employees, including total numbers, positions, roles and responsibilities (giving compliance functions and reporting of suspicious transactions as examples), whether full time or part time, and the reporting lines.

tc.q: 業務計劃就申請人的管理團隊及僱員須提供甚麼詳情？
options: 總人數、職位、角色及職責（例如合規職能及可疑交易匯報）、屬全職或兼職，以及匯報層級
只需姓名及身分證號碼
只需薪酬及僱傭條款
只需已通過能力評核的員工人數
tc.explain: 第12項規定須詳述管理團隊及僱員的組成，包括總人數、職位、角色及職責（並以合規職能及可疑交易匯報為例）、屬全職或兼職，以及匯報層級。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 13
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第13項

en.q: Which examples does the Business Plan guideline give of outsourced services used for AML/CFT purposes?
options: An external audit function, and any specified intermediary
Payroll processing and office cleaning
Legal advice and insurance broking
Website design and marketing
en.explain: Item 13 requires the name and nature of any outsourced services used by the applicant for AML/CFT purposes, giving as examples an external audit function and any specified intermediary — the latter being the Schedule 2 section 18 concept.

tc.q: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》就為打擊洗錢用途而外判的服務舉出哪些例子？
options: 外部審計職能，以及任何指明中介人
薪酬處理及辦公室清潔
法律意見及保險經紀服務
網站設計及市場推廣
tc.explain: 第13項規定須提供申請人為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集用途而使用的任何外判服務的名稱及性質，並以外部審計職能及任何指明中介人為例；後者即附表2第18條的概念。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 14
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第14項

en.q: What must the business plan state about computerized and screening systems?
options: The computerized and other automation systems used in the business, for example the name of the commercial service or database provider for automated AML solutions and sanction screening
Only the brand of computer hardware used
Only whether records are kept electronically or on paper
Only the cost of the systems
en.explain: Item 14 requires the applicant to elaborate the computerized systems and other automation systems used in the business, giving as an example the name of the commercial service or database provider for automated AML solutions and sanction screening.

tc.q: 業務計劃就電腦化系統及篩查系統須說明甚麼？
options: 業務中使用的電腦化系統及其他自動化系統，例如自動化打擊洗錢方案及制裁篩查的商業服務或資料庫供應商名稱
只需所用電腦硬件的品牌
只需紀錄是以電子還是紙本方式保存
只需該等系統的成本
tc.explain: 第14項規定申請人須詳述業務中使用的電腦化系統及其他自動化系統，並以自動化打擊洗錢方案及制裁篩查的商業服務或資料庫供應商名稱為例。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 16
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第16項

en.q: Which two situations must be addressed under “other types of business relationships” in the business plan?
options: Use of a third party's payment platform or network such as a digital wallet, and activities involving local or cross-boundary physical cash movement
Sponsorship arrangements and charitable donations
Employee share schemes and pension arrangements
Advertising contracts and media relationships
en.explain: Item 16 requires the applicant to explain the role of any third party payment platform or network, such as a digital wallet, in its business, and to provide the name of the company or person involved where the business involves local or cross-boundary physical cash movement.

tc.q: 業務計劃「其他類型業務關係」一項須處理哪兩種情況？
options: 使用第三方支付平台或網絡（例如電子錢包），以及涉及本地或跨境實物現金運送的活動
贊助安排及慈善捐款
僱員股份計劃及退休金安排
廣告合約及傳媒關係
tc.explain: 第16項規定申請人須解釋任何第三方支付平台或網絡（例如電子錢包）在其業務中的角色；如業務涉及本地／跨境實物現金運送活動，並須提供有關公司或人士的名稱。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 17
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第17項

en.q: What must the business plan disclose about other supervision?
options: Whether the applicant's local business or its international group is subject to other supervision, such as holding a licence granted by another regulator or competent authority, and if so the name of that authority
Whether the applicant has ever been inspected by the C&ED
Whether the applicant's auditors are registered in Hong Kong
Whether the applicant belongs to any industry association
en.explain: Item 17 requires disclosure of whether the applicant's local business, or the international group of companies to which it belongs, is also subject to other types of supervision — for example holding a licence granted by another regulator or competent authority — and if so the name of that regulator or authority.

tc.q: 業務計劃就其他監管須披露甚麼？
options: 申請人的本地業務或其國際集團是否亦受其他類型監管（例如持有其他監管機構或主管當局批出的牌照）；如是，須提供該當局的名稱
申請人有否曾被香港海關視察
申請人的核數師是否在香港註冊
申請人有否加入任何業界協會
tc.explain: 第17項規定須披露申請人的本地業務或其所屬國際公司集團，是否亦受其他類型的監管（例如持有其他監管機構／主管當局批出的牌照）；如是，須提供該監管機構／主管當局的名稱。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), introduction
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）引言

en.q: On what must an applicant's AML/CFT policy be based, according to the submission guidelines?
options: The applicant's own self AML/CFT risk assessment, and it must meet the applicant's particular business risk profile
A model policy issued by the Money Service Supervision Bureau
The policy of an established licensee in the same sector
The FATF Recommendations reproduced in full
en.explain: The introduction states that each applicant has its unique way of conducting money service business, that it is important for the applicant to complete a self AML/CFT risk assessment and put in place a policy to mitigate ML/TF risks, and that the policy must be based on the applicant's risk assessment and meet its particular business risk profile.

tc.q: 根據遞交指引，申請人的打擊洗錢政策須以甚麼為基礎？
options: 申請人本身的自我打擊洗錢風險評估，並須切合其特定業務風險狀況
金錢服務監理科發出的範本政策
同業中已成立持牌人的政策
全文轉載財務行動特別組織的建議
tc.explain: 引言訂明每名申請人經營金錢服務業務的方式各有不同；申請人完成自我打擊洗錢風險評估並訂立政策以減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險，十分重要；而該政策必須以申請人的風險評估為基礎，並切合其特定業務風險狀況。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 1
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第1項

en.q: Which statutory provisions does item 1 of the AML/CFT Policy guideline require the policy's introduction to reflect?
options: The section 23 Schedule 2 duty to ensure proper safeguards and mitigate ML/TF risks, and the section 19(3) duty to establish effective procedures for sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15 of Schedule 2
Sections 30 and 31 of the AMLO, on the grant and renewal of licences
Sections 43 and 45 of the AMLO, on disciplinary action
Sections 55 and 59 of the AMLO, on the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Item 1 requires the introduction to state that the applicant must take all reasonable measures to ensure proper safeguards exist to prevent a contravention of Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2 and to mitigate ML/TF risks, and that it is required by section 19(3) to establish and maintain effective procedures for carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15 of Schedule 2.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》第1項規定政策引言須反映哪些法定條文？
options: 附表2第23條確保設有適當防護措施及減低風險的責任，以及第19(3)條就附表2第3、4、5、9、10及15條訂立有效程序的責任
《打擊洗錢條例》第30及31條，關於批出及續期牌照
《打擊洗錢條例》第43及45條，關於紀律行動
《打擊洗錢條例》第55及59條，關於審裁處
tc.explain: 第1項規定引言須訂明申請人必須採取一切合理措施，確保設有適當防護措施以防止違反附表2第2或3部並減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險；並須根據第19(3)條建立及維持有效程序，以履行附表2第3、4、5、9、10及15條下的責任。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 1
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第1項

en.q: Which officers must the policy's introduction name, and what must it state about them?
options: A qualified Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer, with the line of reporting clearly stated
Only the Compliance Officer, with the reporting line optional
Only the Money Laundering Reporting Officer
The external auditor and the company secretary
en.explain: Item 1 requires the policy to state that a qualified Compliance Officer (named) and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (named) are employed to implement appropriate AML/CFT policies and procedures including suspicious transaction reporting, and that the line of reporting should be clearly stated.

tc.q: 政策引言須列出哪些人員？就他們須說明甚麼？
options: 合資格的合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任，並須清楚訂明匯報層級
只需合規主任，匯報層級屬選填
只需打擊洗錢報告主任
外部核數師及公司秘書
tc.explain: 第1項規定政策須訂明已聘用合資格的合規主任（列明姓名）及打擊洗錢報告主任（列明姓名），以實施適當的打擊洗錢政策及程序（包括可疑交易報告），並須清楚訂明匯報層級。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 2
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第2項

en.q: Which topics must the AML/CFT framework section of the policy cover?
options: What ML, TF and PF are; the MSO's legal obligations under different legislation; why an AML/CFT system matters; the three stages of ML; typical signs; STRs and the obligations they carry; and tipping off
Only the definitions of money laundering and terrorist financing
Only the procedures for filing suspicious transaction reports
Only the penalties for non-compliance with the AMLO
en.explain: Item 2 requires elaboration of the AML/CFT framework, covering what ML, TF and PF are; the legal obligations of the MSO under different legislation; why it is important to have an AML/CFT system; the three stages of ML; typical signs or indicators; what an STR is and the applicant's legal obligations; actions required if a suspicion arises; the procedure and timing of handling STRs; and what tipping off is.

tc.q: 政策中的打擊洗錢框架部分須涵蓋哪些課題？
options: 何謂洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集；金錢服務經營者在不同法例下的法律責任；為何須設立相關系統；洗錢的三個階段；典型跡象；可疑交易報告及其責任；以及洩密
只需洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的定義
只需提交可疑交易報告的程序
只需不遵從《打擊洗錢條例》的罰則
tc.explain: 第2項規定須詳述打擊洗錢框架，涵蓋何謂洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集；金錢服務經營者在不同法例下的法律責任；為何須為業務設立相關系統；洗錢的三個階段；典型跡象或指標；何謂可疑交易報告及申請人的法律責任；出現懷疑時須採取的行動；處理可疑交易報告的程序及時間；以及何謂洩密。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: What must the policy state about transaction thresholds for carrying out CDD?
options: The company policy on different transaction thresholds, including the treatment of a one-off transaction for a walk-in customer
Only the statutory $120,000 threshold
Only the thresholds applicable to corporate customers
That thresholds are a matter for the CCE rather than the applicant
en.explain: Item 3 requires the policy to state the company policy on different transaction thresholds for carrying out CDD, including the treatment of a one-off transaction for a walk-in customer — the occasional transaction scenario most common in the money service sector.

tc.q: 政策須就進行客戶盡職審查的交易門檻說明甚麼？
options: 公司就不同交易門檻的政策，包括如何處理即場客戶的一次性交易
只需法定的120,000元門檻
只需適用於公司客戶的門檻
門檻屬海關關長而非申請人的事宜
tc.explain: 第3項規定政策須訂明公司就進行客戶盡職審查的不同交易門檻的政策，包括如何處理即場客戶的一次性交易——這是金錢服務業最常見的單次交易情境。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: Which paragraphs of the AML/CFT Guideline must an MSO indicate compliance with when describing regular CDD in its policy?
options: Paragraphs 4.2.1 to 4.2.6, together with how linked transactions will be dealt with
Paragraphs 1.1 to 1.10
Paragraphs 6.1 to 6.19
Paragraphs 9.1 to 9.7
en.explain: Item 3 states that in describing regular CDD and its application within the company, the MSO should indicate how paragraphs 4.2.1 to 4.2.6 of the Guideline on AML/CFT issued for MSOs will be complied with, and how linked transactions will be dealt with.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者在政策中描述一般客戶盡職審查時，須說明遵從《打擊洗錢指引》哪些段落？
options: 第4.2.1至4.2.6段，連同如何處理有關連交易
tc.explain: 第3項訂明，在描述一般客戶盡職審查及其在公司內的應用時，金錢服務經營者應說明將如何遵從為金錢服務經營者發出的《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.2.1至4.2.6段，以及將如何處理有關連交易。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: Which example of a self-assessed high-risk situation does the AML/CFT Policy guideline give?
options: A walk-in customer remitting HK$200,000 in cash to the Mainland
Any customer aged over 65
Any transaction conducted after normal business hours
Any customer introduced by an existing customer
en.explain: Item 3, in listing the situations that should be covered under enhanced due diligence, includes any situation assessed to be high risk by the applicant, giving as an example a walk-in customer remitting HK$200,000 in cash to the Mainland.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》就申請人自行評估為高風險的情況舉出甚麼例子？
options: 即場客戶以現金匯款200,000港元至內地
任何65歲以上的客戶
任何在正常營業時間後進行的交易
任何由現有客戶引介的客戶
tc.explain: 第3項在列出加強盡職審查應涵蓋的情況時，包括申請人評估為高風險的任何情況，並以即場客戶以現金匯款200,000港元至內地為例。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: Which four EDD sub-topics does the AML/CFT Policy guideline list alongside self-assessed high-risk situations?
options: Politically exposed persons including domestic, foreign and international organization PEPs; non-face-to-face channels; and high risk countries such as those identified by the FATF
Cash transactions, cheque transactions, card transactions and virtual asset transactions
Individual customers, corporate customers, trusts and partnerships
New customers, dormant customers, high-turnover customers and overseas customers
en.explain: Item 3 lists under enhanced due diligence: what a politically exposed person is and the MSO's policy on domestic, foreign and international organization PEPs; non-face-to-face channels; high risk countries, for example countries identified by the FATF; and any situation assessed to be high risk by the applicant.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》在自行評估的高風險情況外，就加強盡職審查列出哪四項子課題？
options: 政治人物（包括本地、外地及國際組織政治人物）；非面對面渠道；以及高風險國家（例如財務行動特別組織所識別者）
現金交易、支票交易、信用卡交易及虛擬資產交易
個人客戶、公司客戶、信託及合夥
新客戶、不活躍客戶、高交易量客戶及海外客戶
tc.explain: 第3項在加強盡職審查下列出：何謂政治人物，以及金錢服務經營者就本地、外地及國際組織政治人物的政策；非面對面渠道；高風險國家（例如財務行動特別組織所識別的國家）；以及申請人評估為高風險的任何情況。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: Where funding is provided by a third party, what does the AML/CFT Policy guideline require the policy to address?
options: The procedures and steps for identifying and verifying the ultimate beneficial owner, including of a legal person, partnership, trust or other legal arrangement
A blanket refusal to accept third party funding
Notification of the CCE within one month of each such transaction
Obtaining a written indemnity from the third party
en.explain: Item 3 states that funding provided by a third party requires the applicant to identify and verify its ultimate beneficial owner, including legal persons, partnerships, trusts and other legal arrangements, and requires the policy to set out the procedures and steps taken to comply.

tc.q: 如資金由第三方提供，《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》要求政策處理甚麼？
options: 識別及核實最終實益擁有人（包括法人、合夥、信託及其他法律安排）的程序及步驟
全面拒絕接受第三方資金
於每宗該等交易後一個月內通知海關關長
取得該第三方的書面彌償保證
tc.explain: 第3項訂明由第三方提供資金，須由申請人識別及核實其最終實益擁有人，包括法人、合夥、信託及其他法律安排；並規定政策須載明為遵從該等規定所採取的程序及步驟。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: What retrieval standard does the AML/CFT Policy guideline suggest for record-keeping systems?
options: Whether the system can retrieve records within a reasonable timeframe, say one day
Whether the system can retrieve records within one hour
Whether the system retains records for at least ten years
Whether the system is hosted on servers located in Hong Kong
en.explain: Item 3 requires the policy to elaborate how CDD, transaction, screening and customer risk assessment records will be recorded and kept, and whether the system can retrieve those records within a reasonable timeframe, say one day.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》就紀錄保存系統建議甚麼檢索標準？
options: 該系統能否在合理時限內（例如一日）檢索該等紀錄
該系統能否在一小時內檢索紀錄
該系統是否保存紀錄至少十年
該系統是否寄存於位於香港的伺服器
tc.explain: 第3項規定政策須詳述客戶盡職審查、交易、篩查及客戶風險評估紀錄將如何記錄及保存，以及該系統能否在合理時限內（例如一日）檢索該等紀錄。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 5
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第5項

en.q: What must the policy state about distribution channels?
options: The channels used, for example counter service, internet or mobile, and the percentage of face-to-face and non-face-to-face transactions
Only the number of business premises operated
Only the opening hours of each channel
Only the cost of operating each channel
en.explain: Item 5 requires the applicant to elaborate the distribution channels — for example counter service, internet or mobile — and the percentage of face-to-face and non-face-to-face transactions, which bears directly on the section 9 Schedule 2 special requirements.

tc.q: 政策就分銷渠道須說明甚麼？
options: 所使用的渠道，例如櫃檯服務、互聯網或流動裝置，以及面對面與非面對面交易的百分比
只需經營的業務處所數目
只需各渠道的營業時間
只需經營各渠道的成本
tc.explain: 第5項規定申請人須詳述分銷渠道（例如櫃檯服務、互聯網或流動裝置），以及面對面與非面對面交易的百分比；此與附表2第9條的特別規定直接相關。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 8
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第8項

en.q: What must the policy specify about target jurisdictions for remittance?
options: The target jurisdictions for both inward remittance transactions and outward remittance transactions
Only the jurisdictions to which funds are sent
Only jurisdictions that are FATF members
Only jurisdictions in which the applicant has an agent
en.explain: Item 8 requires the applicant to elaborate the target jurisdictions for inward remittance transactions and for outward remittance transactions — both directions, since geographical risk attaches to each.

tc.q: 政策就匯款的目標司法管轄區須指明甚麼？
options: 匯入及匯出匯款交易兩者的目標司法管轄區
只需資金匯出的目的地
只需屬財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區
只需申請人設有代理的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第8項規定申請人須詳述「匯入匯款交易」及「匯出匯款交易」的目標司法管轄區——兩個方向均須說明，因地域風險在兩者均存在。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 10
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第10項

en.q: Which Schedule 2 provisions does item 10 of the AML/CFT Policy guideline expressly link to the payment systems and procedures it requires?
options: Section 13 for remittance transactions, and section 12 for wire transfers
Section 20 for record-keeping, and section 21 for the manner of keeping
Section 10 for politically exposed persons, and section 15 for high risk situations
Section 16 for anonymous accounts, and section 17 for shell banks
en.explain: Item 10 requires elaboration of the relevant payment systems and AML/CFT procedures in remittance transactions — expressly cited as section 13 in Schedule 2 — and wire transfers, cited as section 12 in Schedule 2.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》第10項明文將其所要求的支付系統及程序，連繫至附表2哪些條文？
options: 匯款交易的第13條，以及電匯的第12條
紀錄保存的第20條，以及保存方式的第21條
政治人物的第10條，以及高風險情況的第15條
匿名帳戶的第16條，以及空殼銀行的第17條
tc.explain: 第10項規定須詳述匯款交易（明文援引附表2第13條）及電匯（援引附表2第12條）中的相關支付系統及打擊洗錢程序。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 10
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第10項

en.q: Which risk-mitigation procedures does item 10 require the policy to describe for remittance and wire transfer transactions?
options: Procedures for identifying the source of funds and the identity and legality of counterparts or related parties, and for monitoring the compliance of overseas branches and agents
Procedures for setting exchange rates and commission levels
Procedures for reconciling daily cash balances
Procedures for handling customer complaints
en.explain: Item 10 requires the policy to cover the relevant payment system, fund flow and settlement system; procedures for taking other reasonable measures in mitigation of ML/TF risks such as identifying the source of funds and the identity and legality of counterparts or related parties; and procedures for monitoring the compliance of the company's overseas branches and agents with the AML/CFT policy.

tc.q: 第10項規定政策須就匯款及電匯交易描述哪些減低風險程序？
options: 識別資金來源，以及交易對手或關連方的身分及合法性的程序；並監察海外分支機構及代理的合規情況
釐定匯率及佣金水平的程序
每日現金結餘對帳的程序
處理客戶投訴的程序
tc.explain: 第10項規定政策須涵蓋相關支付系統、資金流動及結算系統；採取其他合理措施以減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的程序，例如識別資金來源，以及在處理交易時識別交易對手／關連方的身分及合法性；以及監察公司海外分支機構及代理遵從打擊洗錢政策的程序。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 11
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第11項

en.q: Against which three risks does the AML/CFT Policy guideline say sanctions screening should be directed?
options: Targeted financial sanctions related to terrorism and terrorist financing, targeted financial sanctions related to proliferation, and politically exposed persons
Credit risk, market risk and operational risk
Fraud, forgery and theft
Tax evasion, smuggling and bribery
en.explain: Item 11 requires elaboration of the procedures for conducting sanctions screening, giving as an example screening customers for mitigating the risks of (a) targeted financial sanctions related to terrorism and TF, (b) targeted financial sanctions related to proliferation, and (c) PEPs.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》指出制裁篩查應針對哪三項風險？
options: 與恐怖主義及恐怖分子資金籌集有關的定向金融制裁、與擴散有關的定向金融制裁，以及政治人物
信貸風險、市場風險及營運風險
欺詐、偽造及盜竊
逃稅、走私及賄賂
tc.explain: 第11項規定須詳述進行制裁篩查的程序，並以就下列風險篩查客戶為例：(a)與恐怖主義及恐怖分子資金籌集有關的定向金融制裁；(b)與擴散有關的定向金融制裁；及(c)政治人物。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 15
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第15項

en.q: What is the stated object of the AML/CFT audit function that the policy must describe?
options: To ensure the AML/CFT systems and programmes are commensurate with the up-to-date business risk profile and AML/CFT circumstances
To verify the accuracy of the annual financial statements
To confirm that all staff have passed the Competence Assessment
To calculate the pecuniary penalty risk faced by the licensee
en.explain: Item 15 requires the applicant to elaborate its AML/CFT audit function to ensure that its AML/CFT systems and programmes are commensurate with the up-to-date business risk profile and the AML/CFT circumstances, whether by internal or external audit.

tc.q: 政策須描述的打擊洗錢審計職能，其訂明目的為何？
options: 確保打擊洗錢系統及計劃與最新的業務風險狀況及打擊洗錢情況相稱
核實周年財務報表的準確性
確認所有員工已通過能力評核
計算持牌人面對的罰款風險
tc.explain: 第15項規定申請人須詳述其打擊洗錢審計職能，以確保其打擊洗錢系統／計劃與最新的業務風險狀況及打擊洗錢情況相稱，不論以內部或外部審計方式進行。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 16
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第16項

en.q: Which four matters must the scope of AML/CFT training cover under item 16 of the policy guideline?
options: Staff's personal statutory obligations and the consequence of failing to report an STR; the MSO's statutory obligations and consequences of breach; the MSO's AML/CFT policies and procedures; and new and emerging ML/TF techniques, methods and trends
Product knowledge, sales technique, customer service and complaint handling
Accounting standards, tax rules, employment law and data privacy
Cash handling, counterfeit detection, till reconciliation and shift scheduling
en.explain: Item 16 lists the scope of training as staff's personal statutory obligations and the consequence of failure to report an STR; the statutory obligations on the MSO and the consequences of breaching the relevant legislation; the MSO's AML/CFT policies and procedures; any new and emerging techniques, methods and trends in ML/TF; and other issues in paragraph 9.7 of the AML Guideline.

tc.q: 根據政策指引第16項，打擊洗錢培訓的範圍須涵蓋哪四項事宜？
options: 員工的個人法定責任及沒有匯報可疑交易報告的後果；金錢服務經營者的法定責任及違反相關法例的後果；該經營者的打擊洗錢政策及程序；以及洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的新興手法、方式及趨勢
產品知識、銷售技巧、客戶服務及投訴處理
會計準則、稅務規則、僱傭法及資料私隱
現金處理、偽鈔識別、櫃檯對帳及輪班編排
tc.explain: 第16項列出培訓範圍為：員工的個人法定責任及沒有匯報可疑交易報告的後果；金錢服務經營者的法定責任及違反相關法例的後果；該經營者的打擊洗錢政策及程序；員工履行其特定職責所需的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集新興手法、方式及趨勢；以及《打擊洗錢指引》第9.7段所列的其他事項。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 16
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第16項

en.q: How must an MSO monitor the effectiveness of its AML/CFT training, according to the policy guideline?
options: By testing staff's understanding of the training issues and their ability to recognize suspicious transactions
By counting the hours of training delivered
By surveying staff satisfaction with the training
By comparing training spend against industry benchmarks
en.explain: Item 16 states that the MSO will monitor the effectiveness of training by testing staff's understanding of the listed issues and their ability to recognize suspicious transactions, and will monitor and maintain records of who has been trained, when the staff received the training and the type of training provided.

tc.q: 根據政策指引，金錢服務經營者須如何監察其打擊洗錢培訓的成效？
options: 測試員工對培訓內容的理解，以及其識別可疑交易的能力
計算已提供的培訓時數
調查員工對培訓的滿意程度
將培訓開支與業界基準比較
tc.explain: 第16項訂明金錢服務經營者會透過測試員工對所列事項的理解及其識別可疑交易的能力，監察培訓成效；並會監察及備存紀錄，記錄何人接受培訓、員工何時接受培訓及所提供培訓的類型。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 16
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第16項

en.q: Which three particulars must an MSO record about training delivered?
options: Who has been trained, when the staff received the training, and the type of training provided
The cost, the venue and the trainer's qualifications
The duration, the pass rate and the retest date
The language of delivery, the materials used and the attendance rate
en.explain: Item 16 requires the MSO to monitor and maintain records of who has been trained, when the staff received the training, and the type of training provided — a documentary trail that supports the section 9 inspection power.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須就所提供的培訓記錄哪三項詳情？
options: 何人接受培訓、員工何時接受培訓，以及所提供培訓的類型
費用、地點及導師資歷
時數、合格率及重考日期
授課語言、所用教材及出席率
tc.explain: 第16項規定金錢服務經營者須監察及備存紀錄，記錄何人接受培訓、員工何時接受培訓，以及所提供培訓的類型——此文件線索有助配合第9條的視察權力。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 13
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第13項

en.q: What must the policy elaborate about the compliance function?
options: Management oversight, the roles of the compliance department, any relevant committee or panel, and the duties and responsibilities of the compliance officer and compliance staff
Only the name and contact details of the compliance officer
Only the compliance department's annual budget
Only the number of compliance staff employed
en.explain: Item 13 requires elaboration of the AML/CFT compliance function of the applicant, giving as examples management oversight, the roles of the compliance department, any relevant committee or panel, and the duties and responsibilities of the compliance officer and compliance staff.

tc.q: 政策就合規職能須詳述甚麼？
options: 管理層監督、合規部門的角色、任何相關委員會或小組，以及合規主任及合規人員的職責
只需合規主任的姓名及聯絡資料
只需合規部門的年度預算
只需所僱用合規人員的人數
tc.explain: 第13項規定須詳述申請人的打擊洗錢合規職能，並以管理層監督、合規部門的角色、任何相關委員會／小組，以及合規主任及合規人員的職責為例。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 14
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第14項

en.q: What must the policy elaborate about the reporting of suspicious transactions?
options: The company's procedures in the reporting process, the relevant reporting lines, and the roles of the money laundering reporting officer and relevant staff
Only the address of the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
Only the statutory penalties for failing to report
Only the number of reports filed in the preceding year
en.explain: Item 14 requires the applicant to elaborate the procedures of the company in the process of reporting suspicious transactions, the relevant reporting lines, and the roles of the money laundering reporting officer and relevant staff.

tc.q: 政策就可疑交易的匯報須詳述甚麼？
options: 公司在匯報過程中的程序、相關匯報層級，以及打擊洗錢報告主任及有關員工的角色
只需聯合財富情報組的地址
只需沒有匯報的法定罰則
只需上一年度所提交的報告數目
tc.explain: 第14項規定申請人須詳述公司在匯報可疑交易過程中的程序、相關匯報層級，以及打擊洗錢報告主任及有關員工的角色。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 19
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第19項

en.q: What commitment must the policy record regarding regulators and law enforcement?
options: That the applicant will cooperate with the C&ED on routine inspection or investigation, and with other law enforcement agencies wherever required under the laws of Hong Kong
That the applicant will notify the C&ED of every transaction above $8,000
That the applicant will grant law enforcement direct access to its systems
That the applicant will report annually to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Item 19 requires the policy to record that the applicant will cooperate with the Customs and Excise Department about routine inspection or investigation, and will also cooperate with other law enforcement agencies wherever required under the laws of Hong Kong.

tc.q: 政策須就監管機構及執法機關記錄甚麼承諾？
options: 申請人會就例行視察或調查與香港海關合作，並在香港法律規定的情況下與其他執法機關合作
申請人會就每宗超過8,000元的交易通知香港海關
申請人會讓執法機關直接查閱其系統
申請人會每年向審裁處匯報
tc.explain: 第19項規定政策須記錄申請人會就例行視察或調查與香港海關合作，並會在香港法律規定的情況下與其他執法機關合作。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 12
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第12項

en.q: What must the policy elaborate under “risk assessment procedures”?
options: The applicant's risk assessment methodology for AML/CFT purposes, for example the relevant risk factors and the procedures for assessing the risk of customers, products and services
Only the overall risk rating assigned to the business
Only the frequency with which risk assessments are reviewed
Only the identity of the person who signs off the risk assessment
en.explain: Item 12 requires elaboration of the risk assessment methodology of the applicant for AML/CFT purposes, giving as examples the relevant risk factors and the procedures to conduct risk assessment of customers, products and services.

tc.q: 政策在「風險評估程序」下須詳述甚麼？
options: 申請人為打擊洗錢用途所採用的風險評估方法，例如相關風險因素，以及評估客戶、產品及服務風險的程序
只需就業務評定的整體風險級別
只需檢視風險評估的頻次
只需簽署核准風險評估的人的身分
tc.explain: 第12項規定須詳述申請人為打擊洗錢用途所採用的風險評估方法，並以相關風險因素，以及進行客戶、產品及服務風險評估的程序為例。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: What question does the AML/CFT Policy guideline pose as the core of transaction monitoring?
options: What is a “normal” level of business activity and what is not, and is the transaction consistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer and profile
What is the average transaction value across the industry
What is the maximum transaction the MSO can process in a day
What is the profit margin on each transaction
en.explain: Item 3, under on-going monitoring, distinguishes customer monitoring from transaction monitoring and frames the latter around what is a normal level of business activity and what is not, and whether the transaction is consistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer and profile.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》將哪一問題列為交易監察的核心？
options: 何謂「正常」的業務活動水平、何謂不正常，以及該交易是否與金錢服務經營者對該客戶及其狀況的認識相符
業界的平均交易金額為何
該經營者一日內可處理的最高交易額為何
每宗交易的利潤率為何
tc.explain: 第3項在持續監察下區分客戶監察與交易監察，並將後者的核心界定為：何謂「正常」的業務活動水平、何謂不正常，以及該交易是否與金錢服務經營者對該客戶及其狀況的認識相符。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), introduction
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）引言

en.q: How does the AML/CFT Policy guideline describe the list of items it tabulates?
options: By no means exhaustive — the applicant must consider any other important issues peculiar to its business model
Exhaustive and mandatory in every respect
Applicable only to applicants offering remittance services
Applicable only to applicants with more than ten employees
en.explain: The introduction states that the items tabulated are by no means exhaustive and that the applicant must consider any other important issues that are peculiar to its business model, so as to facilitate the formulation of a practical and effective policy.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》如何描述其列表所載的項目？
options: 絕非詳盡無遺——申請人須考慮其業務模式特有的任何其他重要事項
在各方面均屬詳盡無遺並具強制性
只適用於提供匯款服務的申請人
只適用於僱員超過十人的申請人
tc.explain: 引言訂明列表所載項目絕非詳盡無遺，申請人須考慮其業務模式特有的任何其他重要事項，以有助制定切實可行而有效的政策。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第1.2段

en.q: What does the Licensing Guide set out, besides the licensing requirements and application procedures?
options: Information relating to the on-going obligations of an MSO licensee and possible actions taken by C&ED for improper acts
The syllabus and format of the Competence Assessment
The customer due diligence requirements in Schedule 2
The procedure for applying to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Paragraph 1.2 states that the guide is for individuals and corporations who operate or wish to operate money service in Hong Kong, sets out notes on the licensing requirements under the AMLO and explains the application procedures in detail, and also provides information relating to the on-going obligations for licensees and possible actions taken by C&ED for improper acts.

tc.q: 除發牌規定及申請程序外，《牌照指引》還載述甚麼？
options: 金錢服務經營者持牌人的持續責任，以及香港海關就不當行為可能採取的行動
能力評核的課程綱要及格式
附表2的客戶盡職審查規定
向審裁處提出申請的程序
tc.explain: 第1.2段訂明本指引供在香港經營或擬經營金錢服務的個人及法團使用，載述《打擊洗錢條例》下發牌規定的說明並詳細解釋申請程序，亦提供持牌人持續責任的資料，以及香港海關就不當行為可能採取的行動。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.3段

en.q: Besides the hotel exception, which activity does the Licensing Guide say is NOT a money changing service?
options: A currency exchange service that is incidental to the main business, for example a retail business accepting foreign currencies in transactions
Any currency exchange carried out for fewer than ten customers a day
Any currency exchange involving amounts below $8,000
Any currency exchange carried out by a company incorporated overseas
en.explain: Paragraph 2.3 states that a money changing service means a service for exchanging currencies operated in Hong Kong as a business, but does not include such a service that is incidental to the main business — for example a retail business accepting foreign currencies in transactions — or the hotel service meeting the two stated conditions.

tc.q: 除酒店例外情況外，《牌照指引》指出哪一項活動並非貨幣兌換服務？
options: 附帶於主要業務的貨幣兌換服務，例如零售業務在交易中接受外幣
每日為少於十名客戶進行的貨幣兌換
涉及款額低於8,000元的貨幣兌換
由海外註冊成立公司進行的貨幣兌換
tc.explain: 第2.3段訂明貨幣兌換服務指在香港以業務方式經營的貨幣兌換服務，但不包括附帶於主要業務的該等服務（例如零售業務在交易中接受外幣），亦不包括符合兩項訂明條件的酒店服務。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.6段

en.q: During an application for the grant of a licence, must an applicant make a separate application for each additional premises at which money service will be operated?
options: No — each additional premises must be included in the same licence application, with a fee paid for each additional business premises to be registered
Yes — a separate application form is required for each premises
Yes, but only where the additional premises is in a different district
No, and no additional fee is payable
en.explain: Paragraph 2.6 states that a separate application is not required: the applicant must include each additional premises in which money service is operated in the application for a licence and pay a fee for each additional business premises to be registered.

tc.q: 在申請批出牌照時，申請人是否須就每個將經營金錢服務的額外處所另行提出申請？
options: 否——每個額外處所須包括在同一份牌照申請內，並就每個擬登記的額外業務處所繳付費用
是——每個處所均須另行填寫申請表格
是，但只限該額外處所位於不同地區
否，而且無須繳付額外費用
tc.explain: 第2.6段訂明無須另行提出申請：申請人須將每個經營金錢服務的額外處所包括在牌照申請內，並就每個擬登記的額外業務處所繳付費用。

en.q: What is the position on refunds of the application fee and the fit and proper person test fee?
options: Neither is refunded, irrespective of whether the application is subsequently approved or refused
Both are refunded if the application is refused
The application fee is refunded but the fit and proper test fee is not
Both are refunded if the applicant withdraws before the interview
en.explain: Paragraph 2.8 states that no refund will be made for the application fee irrespective of whether the application is subsequently approved or refused, and paragraph 4.14 states that the fee paid for the fit and proper person test is non-refundable. Section 34(7) of the AMLO applies the same principle where a licence is revoked.

tc.q: 申請費用及適當人選測試費用的退款安排為何？
options: 兩者均不獲退還，不論申請其後獲批准或被拒絕
如申請被拒，兩者均獲退還
申請費用獲退還，但適當人選測試費用則否
如申請人在面談前撤回申請，兩者均獲退還
tc.explain: 第2.8段訂明不論申請其後獲批准或被拒絕，已收取的申請費用概不退還；第4.14段訂明就適當人選測試繳付的費用不獲退還。《打擊洗錢條例》第34(7)條就撤銷牌照訂有相同原則。

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide, what is the penalty on summary conviction for operating a money service without a licence?
options: A fine of $100,000 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
en.explain: Paragraph 2.11 states the section 29(2) penalties as, on conviction on indictment, a fine of HK$1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years; or on summary conviction, a fine of $100,000 and imprisonment for 6 months. The $100,000 figure corresponds to a fine at level 6 in the AMLO's own wording.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，無牌經營金錢服務循簡易程序定罪的刑罰為何？
options: 罰款100,000元及監禁6個月
罰款50,000元及監禁6個月
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
tc.explain: 第2.11段訂明第29(2)條的刑罰為：循公訴程序定罪，罰款1,000,000港元及監禁2年；或循簡易程序定罪，罰款100,000元及監禁6個月。該100,000元相當於《打擊洗錢條例》本身表述的第6級罰款。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第3.1段

en.q: What does the Licensing Guide say the CCE will do if an applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing requirements?
options: The CCE will not accept any application for the grant or renewal of a licence
The CCE will grant a licence on simplified terms
The CCE will refer the applicant to the relevant alternative regulator for a licence
The CCE will grant a licence subject to additional conditions
en.explain: Paragraph 3.1 lists the exempt categories — the Government, authorized institutions, and various licensed bodies operating a money service ancillary to their principal business — and states that the CCE will not accept any application for the grant or renewal of a licence if an applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing requirements.

tc.q: 如申請人已獲豁免遵守金錢服務經營者發牌規定，《牌照指引》訂明海關關長會怎樣做？
options: 關長不會接受任何批出或續期牌照的申請
關長會按簡化條款批出牌照
關長會將申請人轉介相關的另一監管機構申領牌照
關長會附加額外條件批出牌照
tc.explain: 第3.1段列出獲豁免類別——政府、認可機構，以及經營附屬於其主要業務的金錢服務的各類持牌團體——並訂明如申請人已獲豁免遵守金錢服務經營者發牌規定，關長不會接受任何批出或續期牌照的申請。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第3.7段

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide define an SVF licensee?
options: A person granted a licence under section 8F of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584)
A person granted a licence under section 2A of that Ordinance
Any issuer of a stored value facility, whether licensed or not
Any person licensed by the Monetary Authority for any purpose
en.explain: Paragraph 3.7 states that an SVF licensee means a person who is granted a licence under section 8F of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance, Chapter 584. Section 2 of that Ordinance defines system operator and settlement institution; section 2A defines stored value facility.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何界定儲值支付工具持牌人？
options: 根據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）第8F條獲批給牌照的人
根據該條例第2A條獲批給牌照的人
任何儲值支付工具發行人，不論是否持牌
任何為任何目的而獲金融管理專員發牌的人
tc.explain: 第3.7段訂明儲值支付工具持牌人指根據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）第8F條獲批給牌照的人。該條例第2條界定系統營運者及結算機構；第2A條則界定儲值支付工具。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.4段

en.q: Which of the following is given as an example of particular premises that must be registered?
options: Premises that are advertised, including by a signboard on display, for meeting customers there
Premises visited by the licensee as a customer of a bank
An accountant's office used solely for processing the licensee's accounting documents
A dining establishment at which the licensee occasionally meets contacts
en.explain: Paragraph 4.4 gives as examples of particular premises: premises occupied for operating a money service there; premises advertised, including by a signboard on display, for meeting customers there; and premises regularly controlled by the licensee as landlord or tenant. Premises where the licensee is only a visitor or customer are excluded.

tc.q: 下列何者屬須登記的特定處所例子？
options: 有作宣傳（包括展示招牌）以在該處會見客戶的處所
持牌人以銀行客戶身分到訪的處所
僅用作處理該持牌人會計文件的會計師辦事處
持牌人偶爾在該處會見聯絡人的餐飲場所
tc.explain: 第4.4段舉出特定處所的例子：為在該處經營金錢服務而佔用的處所；有作宣傳（包括展示招牌）以在該處會見客戶的處所；以及由持牌人以業主或租客身分經常控制的處所。持牌人僅以訪客或顧客身分到訪的處所則不包括在內。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.4段

en.q: Are premises treated as particular premises where the licensee attends only as a visitor or customer?
options: No — premises such as dining establishments, banks, or accountant or solicitor firms attended merely to process documents are not particular premises
Yes — any premises at which business is discussed must be registered
Yes, if the licensee attends more than once a month
Only if the licensee's signboard is displayed there
en.explain: Paragraph 4.4 states that premises are not treated as particular premises for operating a money service if the licensee is only a visitor or a customer at premises such as dining establishments or banks, or at accountant or solicitor firms merely for processing accounting or legal documents for the company.

tc.q: 如持牌人僅以訪客或顧客身分到訪某處所，該處所是否視為特定處所？
options: 否——僅為處理文件而到訪的餐飲場所、銀行，或會計師或律師行等處所，並非特定處所
是——任何曾商討業務的處所均須登記
是，如持牌人每月到訪多於一次
只限該處展示持牌人的招牌
tc.explain: 第4.4段訂明，如持牌人僅以訪客或顧客身分到訪餐飲場所或銀行等處所，或僅為公司處理會計或法律文件而到訪會計師或律師行，該等處所不視為經營金錢服務的特定處所。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.5段

en.q: Which of the following is given as an example of NOT operating a money service at particular premises?
options: Conducting transactions with the use of mobile electronic devices
Operating from a leased shopfront with a signboard
Operating from an office regularly controlled by the licensee as tenant
Operating from premises shared with a clearly partitioned other business
en.explain: Paragraph 4.5 gives three examples of not operating at particular premises: operating without any fixed premises, such as a door-to-door service; meeting customers at a customer's office; and conducting transactions with the use of mobile electronic devices.

tc.q: 下列何者屬「並非在特定處所經營金錢服務」的例子？
options: 使用流動電子裝置進行交易
在租用並設有招牌的地舖經營
在持牌人以租客身分經常控制的辦公室經營
在與其他業務共用但已清楚間隔的處所經營
tc.explain: 第4.5段舉出三個並非在特定處所經營的例子：並無任何固定處所而經營（例如上門服務）；在客戶辦公室會見客戶；以及使用流動電子裝置進行交易。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.5段

en.q: What three items must an applicant with no particular business premises provide in the application form?
options: A local management office, a correspondence address, and a local place for storage of books and records
A registered office, a bank reference, and a business plan
A residential address, a mobile telephone number, and an email address
A service provider's address, a tenancy agreement, and a floor plan
en.explain: Paragraph 4.5 states that if there are no particular premises for operating the money service, the applicant must provide a local management office, a correspondence address, and a local place for storage of books and records in the application form.

tc.q: 並無特定業務處所的申請人，須在申請表格中提供哪三項？
options: 本地管理辦事處、通訊地址，以及本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方
註冊辦事處、銀行證明及業務計劃
住址、流動電話號碼及電郵地址
服務供應商地址、租約及樓面平面圖
tc.explain: 第4.5段訂明，如並無經營金錢服務的特定處所，申請人須在申請表格中提供本地管理辦事處、通訊地址，以及本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: Which of the following is expressly listed as NOT suitable to be registered for operating a money service?
options: Particular premises situated in a wholly residential building
Particular premises situated in a mixed commercial and residential building where written consent has been secured
Particular premises accessible by C&ED officers
Particular premises on the ground floor of a commercial building
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 lists as not suitable: premises in a wholly residential building; premises being used by another MSO or declared by another applicant; premises not accessible without permission of the occupant of another business sharing them; and premises whose signboard business name differs from that on the Business Registration Certificate submitted.

tc.q: 下列何者明文列為不適合登記用作經營金錢服務？
options: 位於純住宅樓宇的特定處所
位於商住混合樓宇並已取得書面同意的特定處所
香港海關人員可進入的特定處所
位於商業大廈地下的特定處所
tc.explain: 第4.6段列為不適合的包括：位於純住宅樓宇的處所；正由其他金錢服務經營者使用或已由其他申請人申報的處所；未經共用處所的其他業務佔用人准許或協助便無法進入的處所；以及招牌上的業務名稱與所提交商業登記證上的業務名稱不同的處所。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: Why are premises not accessible without the permission of the occupant of another business considered unsuitable?
options: Because the area occupied or owned by another party becomes de facto the entrance to the particular premises
Because the other business may itself be unlicensed
Because the rent would then be shared between two businesses
Because the other occupant could see the licensee's customer records
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 lists as not suitable particular premises that are not accessible without the permission or assistance of the occupant or owner of another business sharing the same premises, in which the area occupied or owned by another party becomes de facto the entrance to the particular premises.

tc.q: 為何未經共用處所的其他業務佔用人准許便無法進入的處所被視為不適合？
options: 因另一方佔用或擁有的範圍實際上成為該特定處所的入口
因該其他業務本身可能無牌經營
因租金須由兩項業務分擔
因該其他佔用人可看到持牌人的客戶紀錄
tc.explain: 第4.6段將未經共用同一處所的其他業務的佔用人／擁有人准許或協助便無法進入的特定處所列為不適合；在該情況下，另一方佔用／擁有的範圍實際上成為該特定處所的入口。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: Why is a mismatch between the signboard name and the Business Registration Certificate a ground for treating premises as unsuitable?
options: Because the business name displayed on the signboard differs from the business name registered on the Business Registration Certificate submitted for the licence application or notification of changes
Because signboards must be in both English and Chinese
Because signboards must state the MSO licence number
Because the Business Registration Certificate must be displayed on the signboard
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 lists as not suitable premises where the business name displayed on the signboard is different from the business name registered in the Business Registration Certificate submitted for the grant or renewal of an MSO licence or for notification of changes in particulars in connection with the licence application.

tc.q: 為何招牌名稱與商業登記證不符會構成處所不適合的理由？
options: 因招牌上展示的業務名稱，與就牌照申請或詳情變更通知所提交的商業登記證上登記的業務名稱不同
因招牌須以中英文顯示
因招牌須列明金錢服務經營者牌照號碼
因商業登記證須在招牌上展示
tc.explain: 第4.6段將下列處所列為不適合：處所招牌上展示的業務名稱，與就批出或續期金錢服務經營者牌照，或就有關牌照申請的詳情變更通知所提交的商業登記證上登記的業務名稱不同。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.7段

en.q: Who must the personnel in a licensee's local management office be?
options: The sole proprietor, partner, director, ultimate owner and/or Compliance Officer of the licensee
Any employee of the licensee
Any person authorized in writing by the licensee
A representative of the licensee's company secretarial firm
en.explain: Paragraph 4.7 states that personnel in the LMO must be the sole proprietor, partner, director, ultimate owner and/or Compliance Officer of the licensee, so that there is a local office and personnel of the licensee as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED.

tc.q: 持牌人本地管理辦事處的人員必須是何人？
options: 該持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事、最終擁有人及／或合規主任
該持牌人的任何僱員
該持牌人以書面授權的任何人
該持牌人的公司秘書服務公司代表
tc.explain: 第4.7段訂明本地管理辦事處的人員必須是該持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事、最終擁有人及／或合規主任，以便有該持牌人的本地辦事處及人員作為與香港海關聯絡的接觸點。

en.q: Which addresses will the CCE NOT accept as an MSO's local management office or local place for storage of books and records?
options: The residential address or premises of the MSO, and the address or premises of its service provider such as a company secretarial, accounting or solicitor firm
Any address outside Hong Kong Island
Any address shared with another tenant
Any address in an industrial building
en.explain: Paragraphs 4.7 and 4.11 both state that the residential address or premises of an MSO, or the address or premises of its service provider — such as a company secretarial firm, accounting firm or solicitor firm — will not be accepted by the CCE as the LMO or the LPS of an MSO.

tc.q: 海關關長不會接受哪些地址作為金錢服務經營者的本地管理辦事處或本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方？
options: 該經營者的住址或住宅處所，以及其服務供應商（例如公司秘書服務公司、會計師行或律師行）的地址或處所
香港島以外的任何地址
與另一租客共用的任何地址
工業大廈內的任何地址
tc.explain: 第4.7及4.11段均訂明，金錢服務經營者的住址／住宅處所，或其服務供應商（例如公司秘書服務公司、會計師行或律師行）的地址／處所，不會獲海關關長接受為該經營者的本地管理辦事處或本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方。

en.q: What must the landlord of an LMO or LPS do, and how must it be evidenced?
options: Grant permission to use the premises for money service business, evidenced in the tenancy agreement or in a letter from the landlord to the applicant
Provide a personal guarantee for the licensee's obligations
Register as an interested party with the C&ED
Confirm in writing that no other MSO occupies the building
en.explain: Both paragraphs state that the landlord of the LMO or LPS must grant permission to the licensee to use the premises for money service business, which should be included in the tenancy agreement of the LMO or LPS or in a letter issued by the landlord to the applicant.

tc.q: 本地管理辦事處或存放紀錄地方的業主須作出甚麼？須如何證明？
options: 批准將該處所用於金錢服務業務，並載於租約內或由業主向申請人發出的信件中
就持牌人的責任提供個人擔保
向香港海關登記為有利害關係方
書面確認該大廈並無其他金錢服務經營者佔用
tc.explain: 兩段均訂明本地管理辦事處或存放紀錄地方的業主，必須批准持牌人將該處所用於金錢服務業務，並應載於該辦事處／地方的租約內，或由業主向申請人發出的信件中。

en.q: What are the consequences of failing to submit LMO or LPS information, and of failing to maintain them once licensed?
options: Failure to submit renders the application invalid so that it will not be processed and may result in refusal; failure to maintain results in suspension and/or revocation of the licence
Both attract a pecuniary penalty of up to $1 million
Both are dealt with by written warning only
Failure to submit delays the application; failure to maintain has no consequence
en.explain: Paragraphs 4.7 and 4.11 state that failure to submit the information of the LMO or LPS for a licence or renewal application is deemed an invalid application which will not be processed by C&ED and/or will result in refusal to grant a licence, and that failure to maintain the LMO or LPS will result in the suspension and/or revocation of the licence.

tc.q: 未有提交本地管理辦事處或存放紀錄地方的資料，以及領牌後未有維持該等處所，各有甚麼後果？
options: 未有提交會令申請被視為無效而不獲處理，並可能導致拒發牌照；未有維持則會導致暫時吊銷及／或撤銷牌照
兩者均可招致最高100萬元的罰款
兩者均只以書面警告處理
未有提交會延誤申請；未有維持則並無後果
tc.explain: 第4.7及4.11段訂明，就牌照或續期申請未有提交本地管理辦事處或存放紀錄地方的資料，會被視為無效申請而不獲香港海關處理，及／或導致拒發牌照；而未有維持該等處所，則會導致暫時吊銷及／或撤銷牌照。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.8段

en.q: Where another business is run on the same premises as the applicant's money service, what does the Licensing Guide require?
options: The money service business must be clearly partitioned and distinguished from the other business, and sharing premises with another MSO will not be accepted
The two businesses must be operated by the same legal entity
The other business must also hold an MSO licence
The premises must be at least a specified minimum floor area
en.explain: Paragraph 4.8 states that where other business is run on the same premises, the money service business of the MSO must be clearly partitioned and distinguished from the other business, and that sharing the premises with another MSO to operate money service business will not be accepted by the CCE.

tc.q: 如申請人的金錢服務與其他業務在同一處所經營，《牌照指引》有何規定？
options: 金錢服務業務必須與其他業務清楚間隔及區分；而與另一金錢服務經營者共用處所則不獲接受
兩項業務須由同一法律實體經營
該其他業務亦須持有金錢服務經營者牌照
該處所須達到指定的最低樓面面積
tc.explain: 第4.8段訂明，如同一處所經營其他業務，該金錢服務經營者的金錢服務業務必須與其他業務清楚間隔及區分；而與另一金錢服務經營者共用處所以經營金錢服務業務，不會獲海關關長接受。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.9段

en.q: An applicant omits from its application premises that are required to be registered. Which offence is engaged?
options: Section 52(2) of the AMLO — omitting a material particular knowing that, or being reckless as to whether, it is omitted
Section 29(1) — operating a money service without a licence
Section 40(1) — failing to notify a change in particulars
Section 38(1) — operating at premises not added to the licence
en.explain: Paragraph 4.9 states that section 52(2) makes it an offence for a person, in connection with an application for the grant or renewal of a licence, to omit a material particular knowing that or being reckless as to whether it is omitted, and that section 52(3) provides for a fine up to HK$50,000 and imprisonment for up to 6 months.

tc.q: 申請人在申請中遺漏須登記的處所。這觸犯哪一項罪行？
options: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52(2)條——遺漏要項，而知道或罔顧該要項是否被遺漏
第29(1)條——無牌經營金錢服務
第40(1)條——沒有通知詳情變更
第38(1)條——在未加入牌照的處所經營
tc.explain: 第4.9段訂明第52(2)條將下述行為訂為罪行：任何人就批出或續期牌照的申請遺漏要項，而知道或罔顧該要項是否被遺漏；第52(3)條則訂明可處最高罰款50,000港元及最高監禁6個月。

en.q: What must a local place for storage of books and records hold, and under whose control must it be?
options: The full set of books and records in respect of the MSO's money service transactions, under the control of the licensee so as to facilitate C&ED officers' access
A duplicate set of records, under the control of the licensee's auditor
Only records relating to transactions above $8,000, under the control of the CO
Original identification documents of customers, under the control of the MLRO
en.explain: Paragraph 4.11 states that the LPS is a physical place in Hong Kong for keeping the full set of books and records in respect of the MSO's money service transactions, and that it must be under the control of the licensee so as to facilitate the C&ED officer's access to them to perform functions under the AMLO.

tc.q: 本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方須存放甚麼？須由何人控制？
options: 該金錢服務經營者金錢服務交易的全套簿冊及紀錄，並須由持牌人控制，以便香港海關人員查閱
一套備份紀錄，由該持牌人的核數師控制
只限8,000元以上交易的紀錄，由合規主任控制
客戶身分證明文件正本，由打擊洗錢報告主任控制
tc.explain: 第4.11段訂明本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方是在香港的實體地方，用以存放該金錢服務經營者金錢服務交易的全套簿冊及紀錄；該地方須由持牌人控制，以便香港海關人員查閱以執行《打擊洗錢條例》下的職能。

en.q: Who is the “authorized person” referred to in the Licensing Guide's requirement for occupants' written consent?
options: Any person authorized by the CCE under section 9(12) of the AMLO
Any officer of the Customs and Excise Department
Any authorized officer appointed under section 46 of the AMLO
Any police officer accompanying a C&ED inspection
en.explain: Paragraph 4.12 states that an authorized person means any person authorized by the CCE under section 9(12) of the AMLO — the routine inspection power — as distinct from an authorized officer appointed under section 46 for Part 5 purposes.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》要求取得佔用人書面同意時所指的「獲授權人」是何人？
options: 海關關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》第9(12)條授權的任何人
香港海關的任何人員
根據《打擊洗錢條例》第46條委任的任何獲授權人員
陪同香港海關進行視察的任何警務人員
tc.explain: 第4.12段訂明「獲授權人」指海關關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》第9(12)條（即例行視察權力）授權的任何人；這有別於根據第46條為第5部目的而委任的獲授權人員。

en.q: Must the Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer be employees of the applicant?
options: Yes, under the Employment Ordinance definition, unless the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner is also the CO and MLRO
No — both may be engaged as external consultants
Yes, and they may never be the sole proprietor, partner or director
No — only the MLRO must be an employee
en.explain: Paragraph 4.15(a) states that except where the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the applicant is also the CO and MLRO, the CO and MLRO must be the applicant's employee under the definition of the Employment Ordinance, Cap. 57.

tc.q: 合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任是否必須是申請人的僱員？
options: 是，按《僱傭條例》的定義；除非該獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人同時擔任該兩個職位
否——兩者均可以外聘顧問身分受聘
是，而且他們永不可以是獨資經營者、合夥人或董事
否——只有打擊洗錢報告主任須為僱員
tc.explain: 第4.15(a)段訂明，除非申請人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人同時擔任合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任，否則該兩名主任必須是《僱傭條例》（第57章）定義下該申請人的僱員。

en.q: What are the respective roles of the CO and the MLRO as stated in the Licensing Guide?
options: The CO is the focal point for oversight of the AML/CFT systems and compliance measures; the MLRO is the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions
The CO reports suspicious transactions and the MLRO oversees systems
Both act solely as the point of contact with the C&ED
The CO handles licensing matters and the MLRO handles customer complaints
en.explain: Paragraph 4.15(a) requires an applicant to appoint a competent CO and MLRO to act respectively as the focal point for the oversight of the applicant's AML/CFT systems and compliance measures, and the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》訂明合規主任與打擊洗錢報告主任的角色分別為何？
options: 合規主任是監督打擊洗錢系統及合規措施的統籌點；打擊洗錢報告主任則是匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點
合規主任負責匯報可疑交易，打擊洗錢報告主任負責監督系統
兩者均只擔任與香港海關的聯絡點
合規主任處理發牌事宜，打擊洗錢報告主任處理客戶投訴
tc.explain: 第4.15(a)段規定申請人須委任稱職的合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任，分別擔任監督申請人打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集系統及合規措施的統籌點，以及匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點。

en.q: What is the consequence of an applicant or licensee not having a valid Business Registration Certificate?
options: The application will not be processed by C&ED, or if a licence has been granted, the licence will be subject to suspension and/or revocation
A pecuniary penalty of up to $1 million may be imposed
The licence will be granted subject to a condition requiring registration within 30 days
The applicant must apply to the Review Tribunal for a waiver
en.explain: Paragraph 4.15(c) states that any person carrying on business in Hong Kong must register under the Business Registration Ordinance, Cap. 310, and that an applicant or licensee must have a valid Business Registration Certificate; otherwise the application will not be processed, or if a licence has been granted it will be subject to suspension and/or revocation by the CCE.

tc.q: 申請人或持牌人並無有效商業登記證，有何後果？
options: 申請不會獲香港海關處理；如已批出牌照，該牌照會被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷
可施加最高100萬元的罰款
批出牌照但附加須於30日內登記的條件
申請人須向審裁處申請豁免
tc.explain: 第4.15(c)段訂明任何在香港經營業務的人均須根據《商業登記條例》（第310章）登記；申請人或持牌人必須持有有效商業登記證，否則申請不會獲香港海關處理；如已批出牌照，該牌照會被海關關長暫時吊銷及／或撤銷。

en.q: What is the stated purpose of requiring senior management to pass the Competence Assessment?
options: To ensure senior management has a clear understanding of the ML/TF risks to which the business is exposed and is capable of implementing effective AML/CFT systems to manage and mitigate them
To confirm that senior management holds a relevant academic qualification
To test senior management's knowledge of the Employment Ordinance
To verify senior management's proficiency in both official languages
en.explain: Paragraph 4.15(b) requires the sole proprietor, any one of the partners or directors to pass a Competence Assessment conducted by the C&ED, with a view to ensuring that senior management has a clear understanding of the ML/TF risks to which the business is exposed and is capable of implementing effective AML/CFT systems to adequately manage and mitigate those risks.

tc.q: 要求高級管理層通過能力評核的訂明目的為何？
options: 確保高級管理層清楚了解業務所面對的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並有能力實施有效系統加以管理及減低
確認高級管理層持有相關學歷
測試高級管理層對《僱傭條例》的認識
核實高級管理層兼通兩種法定語文
tc.explain: 第4.15(b)段規定獨資經營者、任何一名合夥人或董事須通過香港海關進行的能力評核，以確保申請人或持牌人的高級管理層清楚了解其所面對的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並有能力實施有效的相關系統，充分管理及減低所識別的風險。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.1段

en.q: Under the Licensing Guide's summary of section 30(3), whose fitness and propriety must be established where the applicant is a partnership?
options: Each partner and each ultimate owner in the partnership
The managing partner and the ultimate owner only
Any two partners nominated by the partnership
The partnership as an entity
en.explain: Paragraph 4.1 states that where the applicant is a partnership, the CCE may grant or renew a licence only if satisfied that each partner and each ultimate owner in the partnership is a fit and proper person to operate a money service.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》就第30(3)條的概述，如申請人是合夥，須確立何人的適當人選資格？
options: 該合夥的每名合夥人及每名最終擁有人
只限管理合夥人及最終擁有人
由該合夥提名的任何兩名合夥人
該合夥作為實體
tc.explain: 第4.1段訂明，如申請人是合夥，海關關長只有在信納該合夥的每名合夥人及每名最終擁有人均是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選時，方可批出或續期牌照。

en.q: How is the fit and proper person test fee charged?
options: It is a one-off fee for each applicant subject to the test
It is charged annually for the life of the licence
It is charged once per licence application, whatever the number of persons
It is charged only where the person has not previously been tested
en.explain: Paragraph 4.13 states that there is a one-off fee for each applicant subject to the fit and proper person test, and the Schedule 3 fee table charges $945 for each person who is subject to the test. Paragraph 4.14 confirms the fee is non-refundable.

tc.q: 適當人選測試費用如何收取？
options: 就每名須接受測試的申請人收取一次性費用
在牌照有效期內按年收取
每份牌照申請收取一次，不論人數多少
只就此前未接受過測試的人收取
tc.explain: 第4.13段訂明就每名須接受適當人選測試的申請人收取一次性費用；附表3費用表就每名須接受測試的人收取945元。第4.14段確認該費用不獲退還。

en.q: Which requirement applies to ALL applicants, whether or not they operate at particular premises?
options: All applicants are required to have a local place for storage of books and records
All applicants are required to have a local management office
All applicants must secure occupants' written consent
All applicants must display the original licence at their premises
en.explain: Paragraph 4.10 states that, in addition to the written consent requirement for premises in a mixed commercial and residential building, all applicants are required to have a local place for storage of books and records. The LMO requirement in paragraph 4.5 applies only where there are no particular premises.

tc.q: 哪一項規定適用於「所有」申請人，不論其是否在特定處所經營？
options: 所有申請人均須設有本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方
所有申請人均須設有本地管理辦事處
所有申請人均須取得佔用人的書面同意
所有申請人均須在其處所展示牌照正本
tc.explain: 第4.10段訂明，除商住混合樓宇處所的書面同意規定外，所有申請人均須設有本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方。第4.5段的本地管理辦事處規定則只適用於並無特定處所的情況。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: From what perspective does the C&ED consider the suitability of particular premises, beyond the statutory requirements?
options: From the perspective of the appropriateness and legitimacy of the licensee in operating a money service, for example without infringing consumers' rights under applicable laws
From the perspective of the rental value of the premises
From the perspective of the applicant's projected turnover
From the perspective of proximity to other licensed MSOs
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 states that, in addition to the relevant statutory requirement stipulated in the AMLO, C&ED will consider the suitability of particular premises from the perspective of appropriateness and legitimacy of the licensee in operating a money service — for example without infringing consumers' rights under applicable laws.

tc.q: 除法定規定外，香港海關從甚麼角度考慮特定處所的適合性？
options: 從持牌人經營金錢服務的恰當性及合法性角度，例如不侵犯適用法律下消費者的權利
從該處所的租值角度
從申請人的預期營業額角度
從與其他持牌金錢服務經營者距離遠近的角度
tc.explain: 第4.6段訂明，除《打擊洗錢條例》訂明的相關法定規定外，香港海關會從持牌人經營金錢服務的恰當性及合法性角度考慮特定處所的適合性，例如不侵犯適用法律下消費者的權利。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: Which two features are given as examples of premises SUITABLE for registration?
options: Being accessible by C&ED officers for carrying out their functions, and, where in a mixed commercial and residential building, the applicant having secured every occupant's written consent for entry
Being on a ground floor and having a street-facing signboard
Having a floor area of at least 50 square metres and a separate entrance
Being covered by a tenancy of at least two years and insured against fire
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 lists as suitable: particular premises accessible by C&ED officers for carrying out their functions under the MSO regulatory regime; and, where the premises are situated in a mixed commercial and residential building, the applicant having secured the written consent of every occupant for an authorized person of C&ED to enter to conduct inspection.

tc.q: 哪兩項特徵獲舉為「適合」登記的處所例子？
options: 香港海關人員可進入以執行其職能；以及如位於商住混合樓宇，申請人已取得每名佔用人的書面同意讓其進入
位於地下並設有面向街道的招牌
樓面面積至少50平方米並設有獨立入口
租期至少兩年並已投購火險
tc.explain: 第4.6段列為適合的包括：香港海關人員可進入該特定處所以執行其在金錢服務經營者監管制度下的職能；以及如處所位於商住混合樓宇，申請人已取得該處所每名佔用人的書面同意，讓香港海關的獲授權人進入該處所進行視察。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.7段

en.q: Why must an applicant operating without particular premises maintain a local management office?
options: To provide a local office and personnel of the licensee as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED for the effective supervision of the money service business
To satisfy the Business Registration Ordinance
To provide a place at which customers may be met
To store the full set of books and records
en.explain: Paragraph 4.7 explains that the LMO is a physical office which can be reached in person and by telephone by C&ED officers to perform functions under the AMLO and to receive documents such as circulars and notices, and that this is necessary to provide a local office and personnel of the licensee as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED for effective supervision. Storing books and records is the separate function of the LPS.

tc.q: 並非在特定處所經營的申請人，為何須維持本地管理辦事處？
options: 為提供該持牌人的本地辦事處及人員，作為與香港海關聯絡的接觸點，以有效監管其金錢服務業務
為符合《商業登記條例》
為提供會見客戶的地方
為存放全套簿冊及紀錄
tc.explain: 第4.7段解釋本地管理辦事處是實體辦事處，香港海關人員可親身及以電話聯絡，以執行《打擊洗錢條例》下的職能並接收通函及通知等文件；此舉是為提供該持牌人的本地辦事處及人員，作為與香港海關聯絡的接觸點，以有效監管其業務。存放簿冊及紀錄則是存放紀錄地方的另一職能。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.7段

en.q: When must a person apply for an MSO licence?
options: Before he or she operates a money service
Within one month of starting to operate a money service
Within 45 days of starting to operate a money service
At any time, provided operations cease pending the decision
en.explain: Paragraph 2.7 states that a person must apply for a licence from the CCE before he or she operates a money service. Operating without a licence is an offence under section 29(1) of the AMLO.

tc.q: 某人須於何時申請金錢服務經營者牌照？
options: 在其經營金錢服務之前
在開始經營金錢服務後一個月內
在開始經營金錢服務後45日內
任何時間均可，只要在決定作出前暫停營運
tc.explain: 第2.7段訂明任何人須在經營金錢服務之前，向海關關長申請牌照。無牌經營屬《打擊洗錢條例》第29(1)條所訂罪行。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第3.1段

en.q: On what condition are a licensed corporation, authorized insurer, insurance broker, insurance agent or SVF licensee exempt from the MSO licensing requirement?
options: Only where the money service they operate is ancillary to their principal business
Only where they notify the CCE annually
Only where their money service turnover is below a prescribed threshold
Unconditionally, by virtue of their existing licence
en.explain: Paragraph 3.1 lists these bodies as exempt where they operate a money service that is ancillary to their principal business. Authorized institutions and the Government are exempt without that qualification.

tc.q: 持牌法團、認可保險人、保險經紀、保險代理或儲值支付工具持牌人，在甚麼條件下獲豁免遵守金錢服務經營者發牌規定？
options: 只限其所經營的金錢服務附屬於其主要業務
只限其每年通知海關關長
只限其金錢服務營業額低於訂明門檻
無條件豁免，憑其現有牌照即可
tc.explain: 第3.1段將該等團體列為在其所經營的金錢服務附屬於其主要業務時獲豁免。認可機構及政府則無此附加條件而獲豁免。

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide describe an ultimate owner of a corporate applicant?
options: An individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly and including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital; or controls more than 25% of the voting rights at general meetings; or exercises ultimate control over the management
Any shareholder holding more than 10% of the shares
The corporation's holding company
Any director who is also a shareholder
en.explain: Paragraph 4.2.3 sets out the three limbs, mirroring the section 24 AMLO definition: ownership or control of more than 25% of the issued share capital including through a trust or bearer share holding; entitlement to exercise or control more than 25% of the voting rights at general meetings; or exercising ultimate control over the management.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何描述公司申請人的最終擁有人？
options: 直接或間接（包括透過信託或持有不記名股份）擁有或控制超過25%已發行股本的個人；或控制股東大會上超過25%投票權的個人；或對管理行使最終控制權的個人
持有超過10%股份的任何股東
該法團的控權公司
同時是股東的任何董事
tc.explain: 第4.2.3段列出三項條件，與《打擊洗錢條例》第24條的定義相對應：直接或間接（包括透過信託或持有不記名股份）擁有或控制超過25%已發行股本；有權行使或控制行使股東大會上超過25%的投票權；或對管理行使最終控制權。

en.q: Besides the five specified matters, what final item does the Licensing Guide list among the fit and proper considerations?
options: Any other matter that the CCE considers relevant
The applicant's projected profitability
The applicant's length of residence in Hong Kong
The applicant's membership of an industry association
en.explain: Paragraph 4.3 lists the section 30(4) matters and closes with paragraph (f), any other matter that the CCE considers relevant, and refers licence applicants and licensees to the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety and its Supplementary Guideline for further details.

tc.q: 除五項指明事項外，《牌照指引》在適當人選考慮因素中列出最後哪一項？
options: 海關關長認為相關的任何其他事項
申請人的預期盈利能力
申請人在香港居住的年期
申請人是否業界協會會員
tc.explain: 第4.3段列出第30(4)條的事項，並以(f)項「海關關長認為相關的任何其他事項」作結，並指引牌照申請人及持牌人參閱《有關適當人選準則的指引》及其《補充指引》以了解詳情。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.9段

en.q: Under which sections of the AMLO are the conditions endorsed on an MSO licence imposed or amended?
options: Sections 30, 31 or 32
Sections 34, 35 or 36
Sections 43, 44 or 45
Sections 38, 39 or 39A
en.explain: Paragraph 2.9 states that a licence must be endorsed with the conditions imposed or amended under section 30, 31 or 32 of the AMLO — the grant, renewal and amendment provisions respectively — and must specify the premises address or correspondence address and the validity period.

tc.q: 批註於金錢服務經營者牌照上的條件，是根據《打擊洗錢條例》哪些條文施加或修訂？
tc.explain: 第2.9段訂明牌照須批註根據《打擊洗錢條例》第30、31或32條（分別為批出、續期及修訂條文）施加或修訂的條件，並須指明處所地址或通訊地址及有效期。

en.q: Who is the ultimate owner in relation to an applicant or licensee that is an individual?
options: Another individual who ultimately owns or controls that individual's money service business; or, if the first individual acts on behalf of another person, that other person
The individual applicant themselves
The individual's spouse in every case
Any person who has lent money to the individual
en.explain: Paragraph 4.2.1 mirrors the section 24 definition: in relation to an individual, ultimate owner means another individual who ultimately owns or controls the money service business of the first-mentioned individual, or, if the first-mentioned individual is acting on behalf of another person, that other person.

tc.q: 就屬個人的申請人或持牌人而言，最終擁有人是誰？
options: 最終擁有或控制該個人金錢服務業務的另一名個人；或如該首述個人是代另一人行事，則為該另一人
該名個人申請人本身
在任何情況下均為該個人的配偶
曾向該個人借出款項的任何人
tc.explain: 第4.2.1段與第24條的定義相對應：就個人而言，最終擁有人指最終擁有或控制該首述個人的金錢服務業務的另一名個人；或如該首述個人是代另一人行事，則指該另一人。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第1.3段

en.q: To whom does the Licensing Guide apply?
options: An applicant for the grant or renewal of an MSO licence, or a licensee, as the case may be
Only to first-time applicants for a licence
Only to licensees whose licences are due for renewal
Only to corporate applicants and licensees
en.explain: Paragraph 1.3 states that the licensing guide applies to an applicant for grant or renewal of an MSO licence, or a licensee, as the case may be. Paragraph 1.2 adds that it is for individuals and corporations who operate or wish to operate money service in Hong Kong.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》適用於何人？
options: 申請批出或續期金錢服務經營者牌照的人，或持牌人（視屬何情況）
只限首次申請牌照的人
只限牌照即將到期續期的持牌人
只限公司申請人及持牌人
tc.explain: 第1.3段訂明本牌照指引適用於申請批出或續期金錢服務經營者牌照的人，或持牌人（視屬何情況）。第1.2段補充其供在香港經營或擬經營金錢服務的個人及法團使用。

en.q: For which premises must an applicant secure the written consent of every occupant for an authorized person to enter for routine inspection?
options: Premises belonging to a mixed commercial and residential building
All premises without exception
Only premises used as a local place for storage of books and records
Only premises shared with another business
en.explain: Paragraph 4.10 states that where the premises in respect of which an application is made belong to a mixed commercial and residential building, the applicant should secure the written consent of every occupant of the premises for any authorized person to enter the premises for routine inspection.

tc.q: 申請人須就哪類處所取得每名佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人進入進行例行視察？
options: 屬商住混合樓宇的處所
所有處所，並無例外
只限用作本地存放簿冊及紀錄的處所
只限與其他業務共用的處所
tc.explain: 第4.10段訂明，如申請所關乎的處所屬商住混合樓宇，申請人應取得該處所每名佔用人的書面同意，讓任何獲授權人進入該處所進行例行視察。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: Which documents must accompany a completed Form 1, supplementary information sheet and annex on a new licence application?
options: A Business Plan and AML/CFT policies, together with photocopies of the requisite supporting documents
Audited accounts for the preceding three years
A banker's reference and a solicitor's certificate
A police certificate of no criminal conviction for every director
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 requires the applicant to complete Form 1, the supplementary information sheet and the relevant annex and to submit a Business Plan and AML/CFT policies, together with photocopies of the requisite documents listed in the checklist of supporting documents in the application form.

tc.q: 新牌照申請中，已填妥的表格1、補充資料表及附件須連同哪些文件一併提交？
options: 業務計劃及打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策，連同所需證明文件的影印本
過去三個財政年度的經審計帳目
銀行證明書及律師證明書
每名董事的警方無犯罪紀錄證明書
tc.explain: 第5.1段規定申請人須填妥表格1、補充資料表及相關附件，並提交業務計劃及打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策，連同申請表格內證明文件核對表所列所需文件的影印本。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: In which language may an applicant complete the application form, supplementary information sheet and annex?
options: Either English or Chinese, or both if the case requires
English only
Chinese only
Whichever language the C&ED specifies in each case
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 states that the applicant may complete the form, supplementary information sheet and annex in either English or Chinese, or both if the case requires, and has to fill in all the parts applicable to the applicant.

tc.q: 申請人可以哪種語文填寫申請表格、補充資料表及附件？
options: 英文或中文均可；如情況需要，亦可兩者兼用
只限英文
只限中文
由香港海關就個別個案指定的語文
tc.explain: 第5.1段訂明申請人可以英文或中文填寫表格、補充資料表及附件；如情況需要，亦可兩者兼用，並須填妥所有適用於該申請人的部分。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: What photographs must accompany a new application to operate a money service at particular premises?
options: At least two photographs of 102x152 mm (4R) size, one showing the inner part such as the counter or office and one showing the outer part such as the signboard
A single photograph of the building exterior
Four photographs, one from each compass direction
Photographs are required only for premises in residential buildings
