en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 requires at least two photographs of size 102x152 mm (4R-size) to be attached, one showing the inner part such as the counter or office of the particular premises and another showing the outer part such as the signboard.

tc.q: 在特定處所經營金錢服務的新申請，須附上甚麼照片？
options: 至少兩張102x152毫米（4R）尺寸的照片，一張顯示內部（例如櫃檯或辦公室），另一張顯示外部（例如招牌）
一張顯示大廈外觀的照片
四張照片，分別從四個方向拍攝
只有位於住宅樓宇的處所才須附上照片
tc.explain: 第5.1段規定須附上至少兩張102x152毫米（4R尺寸）的照片，一張顯示該特定處所的內部（例如櫃檯或辦公室），另一張顯示外部（例如招牌）。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: What photograph requirement applies where an applicant has separate premises serving as an LPS or LMO?
options: At least two photographs for each additional LPS and/or LMO, subject to the same requirements as apply to particular premises
No photographs are required for an LPS or LMO
One photograph of the exterior only
Photographs are required only if the LPS and LMO are at different addresses
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 states that where an applicant also has separate premises which serve as LPS and/or LMO, at least two photographs should also be attached for each additional LPS and/or LMO, and that the photograph requirements for LPS and LMO are the same as those applicable to particular premises.

tc.q: 如申請人另有處所用作存放紀錄地方或本地管理辦事處，照片規定為何？
options: 每個額外的該等處所須附上至少兩張照片，規定與特定處所相同
該等處所無須附上照片
只需一張顯示外部的照片
只有在該兩個處所地址不同時才須附上照片
tc.explain: 第5.1段訂明，如申請人另有處所用作本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方及／或本地管理辦事處，每個該等額外處所亦須附上至少兩張照片；其照片規定與特定處所的規定相同。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.2段

en.q: Which components does the Licensing Guide say a Business Plan should comprehensively cover?
options: Detailed operation mode, organizational structure, payment system, target customer, staffing, and finance of the company
Only the projected revenue and expenditure
Only the identity and background of the directors
Only the products and services to be offered
en.explain: Paragraph 5.2 states that the Business Plan should be a comprehensive overview of the business, including but not limited to such components as detailed operation mode, organizational structure, payment system, target customer, staffing, and finance of the company.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》指出業務計劃應全面涵蓋哪些部分？
options: 詳細營運模式、組織架構、支付系統、目標客戶、人手編制及公司財務
只需預計收入及支出
只需董事的身分及背景
只需將提供的產品及服務
tc.explain: 第5.2段訂明業務計劃應是業務的全面概覽，包括但不限於詳細營運模式、組織架構、支付系統、目標客戶、人手編制及公司財務等部分。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.2段

en.q: Which two examples does the Licensing Guide give of matters an AML Policy must elaborate?
options: The company's payment or settlement system for remittance transactions, and its mechanism for sanction screening and screening of high-risk customers
The company's marketing plan and pricing structure
The company's staff appraisal system and bonus scheme
The company's insurance cover and disaster recovery plan
en.explain: Paragraph 5.2 states that the AML Policy should set out the applicant's own policies, procedures and controls in the relevant operational areas, giving as examples the requirement to elaborate the company's payment or settlement system for remittance transactions and its mechanism for sanction screening and screening of high-risk customers.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就打擊洗錢政策須詳述的事項舉出哪兩個例子？
options: 公司就匯款交易的支付／結算系統，以及其制裁篩查及高風險客戶篩查機制
公司的市場推廣計劃及定價結構
公司的員工評核制度及花紅計劃
公司的保險保障及災難復原計劃
tc.explain: 第5.2段訂明打擊洗錢政策應載明申請人在相關營運範疇的政策、程序及管控措施，並以須詳述公司就匯款交易的支付／結算系統，以及其制裁篩查及高風險客戶篩查機制為例。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What does an applicant receive once all the requisite documents have been submitted?
options: A notice for an interview, a demand note for the fees for the licence application and the fit and proper person test, and an invitation letter for nominating eligible persons to attend the Assessment
A provisional licence valid for three months
A written decision on the application
A certificate of exemption pending the interview
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that when all the requisite documents are submitted, the applicant will receive a notice for an interview together with a demand note for payment of the fees regarding the application for the grant of a licence and the fit and proper person test, and an invitation letter for nominating the eligible persons to attend the Assessment.

tc.q: 申請人在提交所有所需文件後會收到甚麼？
options: 面談通知、就牌照申請及適當人選測試費用的繳費通知書，以及提名合資格人士參加能力評核的邀請信
有效期三個月的臨時牌照
就該申請的書面決定
面談前的豁免證明書
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明，當所有所需文件已提交，申請人會收到面談通知，連同就批出牌照申請及適當人選測試費用的繳費通知書，以及提名合資格人士參加能力評核的邀請信。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What takes place during the licensing interview?
options: Original documents and the payment record are verified, the applicant signs the application in the presence of C&ED officers, clarifies its submitted documents, and is briefed on the statutory licensing and compliance requirements
The Competence Assessment is administered
The licence is issued on the spot if documents are in order
The applicant's premises are inspected
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that during the interview the original documents and the payment record will be verified, the applicant will sign the application in the presence of C&ED officers, will be required to clarify and elaborate any information in the submitted documents such as the Business Plan and AML Policy, and will be briefed on the statutory licensing and compliance requirements applicable to MSOs.

tc.q: 發牌面談期間會進行甚麼？
options: 核實文件正本及付款紀錄、申請人在香港海關人員面前簽署申請、澄清所提交的文件，並獲簡介法定發牌及合規規定
進行能力評核
如文件齊備即場發出牌照
視察申請人的處所
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明面談期間會核實文件正本及付款紀錄，申請人須在香港海關人員面前於金錢服務經營者牌照申請上簽署，並須就所提交的文件（例如業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策）澄清及闡述任何資料；申請人亦會獲簡介適用於金錢服務經營者的法定發牌及合規規定。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.5段

en.q: Who must attend the licensing interview where the applicant is a corporation?
options: The directors, or staff members of the applicant authorized in writing by the board of directors
Any one director, without further authorization
The company secretary
The compliance officer alone
en.explain: Paragraph 5.5 states that the person attending must be the sole proprietor for a sole proprietorship; the partners or staff members authorized in writing by every partner for a partnership; or the directors or staff members authorized in writing by the board of directors for a corporation.

tc.q: 如申請人是法團，何人須出席發牌面談？
options: 董事，或經董事會書面授權的申請人職員
任何一名董事，無須另行授權
公司秘書
只需合規主任
tc.explain: 第5.5段訂明出席面談的人必須是：如屬獨資經營，為該獨資經營者；如屬合夥，為合夥人或經每名合夥人書面授權的申請人職員；如屬法團，為董事或經董事會書面授權的申請人職員。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.5段

en.q: Where the applicant is a partnership, whose written authorization must a staff member attending the interview hold?
options: That of every partner
That of the managing partner only
That of a majority of the partners
That of the compliance officer
en.explain: Paragraph 5.5 requires, for a partnership, that the person attending be the partner or partners, or a staff member of the applicant authorized in writing by every partner. For a corporation the authorization comes from the board of directors.

tc.q: 如申請人是合夥，出席面談的職員須持有何人的書面授權？
options: 每名合夥人的授權
只需管理合夥人的授權
過半數合夥人的授權
合規主任的授權
tc.explain: 第5.5段就合夥規定，出席者須為合夥人，或經每名合夥人書面授權的申請人職員。就法團而言，授權則來自董事會。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.6段

en.q: Which factors does the Licensing Guide identify as affecting the time taken to process an application?
options: The time taken to collect requisite documents, on-site inspection at the business premises, obtaining records from other authorities for the fit and proper test, and completing the Assessment
The number of premises applied for, alone
The applicant's projected turnover
The season of the year in which the application is made
en.explain: Paragraph 5.6 states that the processing time may vary depending on various factors, including the time taken in collecting requisite documents from the applicant, on-site inspection at the business premises, the time required to obtain records from other authorities to perform a fit and proper person test, and the time taken for completing the Assessment.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》指出哪些因素會影響處理申請所需的時間？
options: 向申請人收集所需文件的時間、業務處所的實地視察、為進行適當人選測試而向其他當局索取紀錄所需時間，以及完成能力評核所需時間
僅取決於所申請的處所數目
申請人的預期營業額
提出申請的季節
tc.explain: 第5.6段訂明處理時間可能因多項因素而異，包括向申請人收集所需文件的時間、業務處所的實地視察、為進行適當人選測試而向其他當局索取紀錄所需的時間，以及完成能力評核所需的時間。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.8段

en.q: Which forms are used for the fit and proper person declaration?
options: Form 3A with Appendices I and II for an individual, and Form 3B for a corporation
Form 1 for an individual and Form 2 for a corporation
Form 4 for both individuals and corporations
Form 6 for an individual and Form 7 for a corporation
en.explain: Paragraph 5.8 states that the applicant needs to complete a Fit and Proper Person Declaration Form — Form 3A with Appendices I and II for an individual, and Form 3B for a corporation — and submit it together with supporting documents to C&ED.

tc.q: 適當人選聲明使用哪些表格？
options: 個人用表格3A連同附錄I及II，法團用表格3B
個人用表格1，法團用表格2
個人及法團均用表格4
個人用表格6，法團用表格7
tc.explain: 第5.8段訂明申請人須填寫適當人選聲明表格——個人為表格3A連同附錄I及II，法團為表格3B——並連同證明文件提交香港海關。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.8段

en.q: Before whom must the declarant sign Appendix I to Form 3A?
options: An authorized officer of the C&ED, a practising professional such as a solicitor, accountant or auditor, a notary public, or a Justice of the Peace
Any two adult witnesses
A director of the applicant company
An officer of the applicant's bank
en.explain: Paragraph 5.8 requires the declarant to sign Appendix I in the presence of a witness who is an authorized officer of the C&ED, a practising professional such as a solicitor, accountant or auditor, a notary public, or a Justice of the Peace.

tc.q: 聲明人須在何人面前簽署表格3A的附錄I？
options: 香港海關的獲授權人員、執業專業人士（例如律師、會計師或核數師）、公證人，或太平紳士
任何兩名成年見證人
申請人公司的一名董事
申請人往來銀行的職員
tc.explain: 第5.8段規定聲明人須在見證人面前簽署附錄I，該見證人須為香港海關的獲授權人員、執業專業人士（例如律師、會計師或核數師）、公證人，或太平紳士。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.8段

en.q: What must the witness to Appendix I of Form 3A certify?
options: That the personal particulars stated are true and correct, having checked them against the declarant's original identity documents, and that Appendix I was signed by the declarant in the witness's presence
That the declarant is a fit and proper person
That the declarant has no criminal record
That the declarant understands the AMLO
en.explain: Paragraph 5.8 states that the witness shall check the personal particulars in Appendix I against the original identity document or documents of the declarant and certify that the particulars stated are true and correct, and shall also certify that Appendix I was signed by the declarant in his or her presence.

tc.q: 表格3A附錄I的見證人須核證甚麼？
options: 已核對聲明人的身分證明文件正本，證明所述個人資料真實無誤；並核證附錄I是由聲明人在其面前簽署
證明該聲明人是適當人選
證明該聲明人並無犯罪紀錄
證明該聲明人明白《打擊洗錢條例》
tc.explain: 第5.8段訂明見證人須將附錄I所述的個人資料與聲明人的身分證明文件正本核對，並核證所述資料真實無誤；亦須核證附錄I是由聲明人在其面前簽署。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.9段

en.q: How does the CCE process a fit and proper person declaration form?
options: By undertaking checks to confirm the accuracy of the information, including vetting details against information held by the department, other government departments and law enforcement agencies
By accepting the declaration at face value unless challenged
By referring it to the Review Tribunal for verification
By requiring the declarant to attend a further interview in every case
en.explain: Paragraph 5.9 states that on receipt of a fit and proper person declaration form the CCE will undertake a number of checks to confirm the accuracy of the information provided, including vetting details against information held by the department, other government agencies and law enforcement agencies.

tc.q: 海關關長如何處理適當人選聲明表格？
options: 進行多項查核以確認所提供資料的準確性，包括將詳情與該部門、其他政府部門及執法機構所持有的資料核對
除非有人提出質疑，否則按表面接納該聲明
轉交審裁處核實
在任何情況下均要求聲明人再次出席面談
tc.explain: 第5.9段訂明海關關長在接獲適當人選聲明表格後，會進行多項查核以確認所提供資料的準確性，包括將詳情與該部門、其他政府部門及執法機構所持有的資料核對。

en.q: Which consent-related failure is listed as a ground on which the CCE may refuse to grant a licence?
options: The applicant cannot obtain the written consent of every occupant of particular premises situated in a mixed commercial and residential building for an authorized person to enter for routine inspection
The applicant has not obtained the landlord's consent to display a signboard
The applicant has not obtained its bank's consent to open an account
The applicant has not obtained the consent of neighbouring businesses
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(c) lists as a refusal ground that an applicant cannot obtain the written consent from every occupant of the particular premises which are situated in a mixed commercial and residential building to be used for the operation of a money service, for any authorized person to enter for routine inspection.

tc.q: 哪一項與同意有關的未能符合事項，列為海關關長可拒發牌照的理由？
options: 申請人未能就位於商住混合樓宇的擬用特定處所，取得每名佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人進入進行例行視察
申請人未取得業主同意展示招牌
申請人未取得銀行同意開立帳戶
申請人未取得鄰近商戶的同意
tc.explain: 第5.10(c)段將下述情況列為拒發理由：申請人未能就擬用作經營金錢服務、位於商住混合樓宇的特定處所，取得每名佔用人的書面同意，讓任何獲授權人進入進行例行視察。

en.q: Which documentary failure is listed as a ground for refusing to grant a licence?
options: An applicant fails to provide a Business Plan and AML Policy in accordance with the relevant guidelines promulgated by C&ED
An applicant fails to provide audited accounts
An applicant fails to provide a lease of at least two years
An applicant fails to provide references from two existing licensees
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(f) lists as a refusal ground that an applicant fails to provide a Business Plan and AML Policy in accordance with the relevant guidelines promulgated by C&ED — that is, the Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan and the Guidelines for Submission of AML Policy.

tc.q: 哪一項文件方面的缺失列為拒發牌照的理由？
options: 申請人未有按香港海關頒布的相關指引提供業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策
申請人未有提供經審計帳目
申請人未有提供至少兩年的租約
申請人未有提供兩名現有持牌人的推薦書
tc.explain: 第5.10(f)段將申請人未有按香港海關頒布的相關指引（即《遞交業務計劃的指引》及《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》）提供業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策，列為拒發理由。

en.q: Which appointment failure is listed as a ground for refusing to grant a licence?
options: An applicant fails to appoint a competent CO or MLRO
An applicant fails to appoint an external auditor
An applicant fails to appoint a company secretary
An applicant fails to appoint a local legal representative
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(g) lists as a refusal ground that an applicant fails to appoint a competent Compliance Officer or Money Laundering Reporting Officer. Paragraph 7.1(i) makes the same failure a ground for revocation or suspension after the licence is granted.

tc.q: 哪一項委任方面的缺失列為拒發牌照的理由？
options: 申請人未有委任稱職的合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任
申請人未有委任外部核數師
申請人未有委任公司秘書
申請人未有委任本地法律代表
tc.explain: 第5.10(g)段將申請人未有委任稱職的合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任列為拒發理由。第7.1(i)段則將同樣缺失列為批出牌照後撤銷或暫時吊銷的理由。

en.q: Which statutory exemption is listed as a ground on which the CCE may refuse to grant a licence?
options: The applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing regime by virtue of section 25 of the AMLO
The applicant has been exempted from business registration
The applicant has been exempted from the Competence Assessment
The applicant has been exempted from filing periodic returns
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(k) lists as a refusal ground that an applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing regime by virtue of section 25 of the AMLO. Paragraph 3.1 states correspondingly that the CCE will not accept an application from an exempt person.

tc.q: 哪一項法定豁免列為海關關長可拒發牌照的理由？
options: 申請人憑藉《打擊洗錢條例》第25條已獲豁免遵守金錢服務經營者發牌制度
申請人已獲豁免商業登記
申請人已獲豁免參加能力評核
申請人已獲豁免提交定期申報表
tc.explain: 第5.10(k)段將申請人憑藉《打擊洗錢條例》第25條已獲豁免遵守金錢服務經營者發牌制度，列為拒發理由。第3.1段亦相應訂明關長不會接受獲豁免人士的申請。

en.q: Within what period may an applicant appeal to the Review Tribunal against a refusal to grant a licence?
options: Within the period ending 21 days after the notice informing the applicant of the refusal
Within 30 days of the refusal decision
Within 45 days of the refusal decision
Within one month of the refusal decision
en.explain: Paragraph 5.11 states that the applicant may appeal against the CCE's decision to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal within the period ending 21 days after the notice informing the applicant of the refusal of grant of an MSO licence — mirroring section 59(1) of the AMLO.

tc.q: 申請人可於甚麼期限內就拒發牌照向審裁處提出上訴？
options: 於告知申請人拒發牌照的通知發出後21日內
於拒絕決定後30日內
於拒絕決定後45日內
於拒絕決定後一個月內
tc.explain: 第5.11段訂明申請人可於告知其拒發金錢服務經營者牌照的通知發出後21日內，就海關關長的決定向打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集審裁處提出上訴——與《打擊洗錢條例》第59(1)條相對應。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.2段

en.q: How far before the expiry of a licence does the C&ED send a renewal reminder, and what does it enclose?
options: 90 days before expiry, enclosing an invitation letter for nominating eligible persons to attend the Assessment
45 days before expiry, enclosing the renewal application form
30 days before expiry, enclosing a demand note for fees
One month before expiry, enclosing a draft renewed licence
en.explain: Paragraph 6.2 states that the department will send a reminder enclosing an invitation letter for nominating the eligible persons to attend the Assessment to each licensee 90 days before the expiry of the licence, but that it remains the licensee's legal responsibility to apply for renewal 45 days before expiry.

tc.q: 香港海關在牌照屆滿前多久發出續期提示？該提示附有甚麼？
options: 屆滿前90日，並附有提名合資格人士參加能力評核的邀請信
屆滿前45日，並附有續期申請表格
屆滿前30日，並附有費用繳費通知書
屆滿前一個月，並附有續期牌照草稿
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明該部門會在每個牌照屆滿前90日，向持牌人發出提示，並附有提名合資格人士參加能力評核的邀請信；但持牌人仍有法律責任在牌照屆滿前45日申請續期。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.2段

en.q: Within what period of receiving the invitation letter must a licensee nominate eligible persons for the Assessment, and within what period must they attend?
options: Nominate within seven days of receipt, and attend within 30 days of receipt
Nominate within 30 days and attend within 90 days
Nominate within one month and attend within two months
Nominate within 14 days and attend within 45 days
en.explain: Paragraph 6.2 states that the licensee is required to nominate the eligible persons for the Assessment within seven days upon receipt of the invitation letter, and that the eligible persons nominated will attend the Assessment within 30 days upon receipt of the invitation letter.

tc.q: 持牌人須於接獲邀請信後多久內提名合資格人士參加能力評核？該等人士須於多久內出席？
options: 接獲後七日內提名，並於接獲後30日內出席
30日內提名，90日內出席
一個月內提名，兩個月內出席
14日內提名，45日內出席
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明持牌人須於接獲邀請信後七日內提名合資格人士參加能力評核，而獲提名的合資格人士須於接獲邀請信後30日內出席評核。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段與第6.2段的比較

en.q: How does the consequence of failing to attend the Assessment differ between a grant application and a renewal application?
options: On a grant application, failure to attend may result in refusal of the application; on a renewal application, failure to attend will result in rejection of the corresponding application
The consequence is identical in both cases
Failure to attend has no consequence on renewal
Failure to attend on renewal results only in a warning
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that failure to attend the designated session of the Assessment may result in refusal of the licence application, while paragraph 6.2 states that on renewal, failure to attend will result in rejection of the corresponding application — a firmer formulation.

tc.q: 未有出席能力評核的後果，在批出申請與續期申請之間有何不同？
options: 就批出申請而言，未有出席「可能」導致申請被拒；就續期申請而言，未有出席「將會」導致有關申請被拒
兩種情況下的後果相同
續期時未有出席並無後果
續期時未有出席只會收到警告
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明未有出席指定場次的能力評核，可能導致牌照申請被拒；第6.2段則訂明在續期時，未有出席將會導致有關申請被拒——措辭較為肯定。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.3段

en.q: Which form is used for an application to renew an MSO licence, and what must accompany it?
options: Form 2, together with the supplementary information sheet, the relevant annex, fit and proper person declaration forms, the Business Plan, the AML Policy and photocopies of requisite documents
Form 1, together with the original licence
Form 4, together with a fit and proper declaration only
Form 6, together with updated particulars
en.explain: Paragraph 6.3 states that a licensee must submit its application for renewal (Form 2), the supplementary information sheet and the relevant annex together with the fit and proper person declaration forms, its Business Plan, AML Policy and photocopies of requisite documents, by post, in person or via the C&ED website.

tc.q: 續期金錢服務經營者牌照的申請使用哪一表格？須連同甚麼一併提交？
options: 表格2，連同補充資料表、相關附件、適當人選聲明表格、業務計劃、打擊洗錢政策及所需文件的影印本
表格1，連同牌照正本
表格4，只需連同適當人選聲明
表格6，連同更新的詳情
tc.explain: 第6.3段訂明持牌人須以郵遞、親身或經香港海關網站，提交續期申請（表格2）、補充資料表及相關附件，連同適當人選聲明表格、其業務計劃、打擊洗錢政策及所需文件的影印本。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.4段

en.q: Which three circumstances make a renewal application invalid so that C&ED will not process it further?
options: Failing to submit the completed Form 2 and accompanying documents 45 days before expiry; failing to produce outstanding supporting documents within the specified period after a reminder; or failing to nominate eligible persons for the Assessment within seven days of the invitation letter
Failing to pay the renewal fee; failing to display the licence; or failing to file a periodic return
Failing to attend the interview; failing to pass the Assessment; or failing to maintain an LPS
Failing to notify a change of address; failing to appoint a CO; or failing to keep records
en.explain: Paragraph 6.4 lists the three grounds on which a renewal application will be deemed invalid and not further processed: late submission of the duly completed Form 2, supplementary information sheet and annex; failure to produce all supporting documents within the specified period after a reminder; and failure to nominate any eligible persons for the Assessment within seven days of receipt of the invitation letter.

tc.q: 哪三種情況會令續期申請成為無效申請，使香港海關不作進一步處理？
options: 未能於屆滿前45日提交填妥的表格2及隨附文件；獲發提示後未能於指明期間內提交欠交的證明文件；或未能於接獲邀請信後七日內提名合資格人士參加評核
未有繳付續期費用；未有展示牌照；或未有提交定期申報表
未有出席面談；未能通過評核；或未有維持存放紀錄的地方
未有通知地址變更；未有委任合規主任；或未有保存紀錄
tc.explain: 第6.4段列出三項會令續期申請被視為無效而不獲進一步處理的理由：未能於牌照屆滿前45日向香港海關提交填妥的表格2、補充資料表及相關附件；在獲發提示後未能於指明期間內提交所有證明文件；或未能於接獲邀請信後七日內提名任何合資格人士參加評核。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.4段

en.q: What happens if a licensee submits an invalid renewal application that cannot be processed?
options: The existing licence lapses automatically upon expiry of its validity period, and the licensee must cease money service operation
The licence is extended until the application is corrected
The C&ED will process the application late on payment of a surcharge
The licence is suspended rather than lapsing
en.explain: Paragraph 6.4 states that if a licensee submits an invalid renewal application which cannot be processed by C&ED, the existing licence will lapse automatically upon the expiry of the validity period, the licensee must cease money service operation, and unlicensed operation of a money service is an offence.

tc.q: 如持牌人提交無效的續期申請而不獲處理，會有甚麼後果？
options: 現有牌照於其有效期屆滿時自動失效，該持牌人必須停止經營金錢服務
牌照延續至申請更正為止
繳付附加費後香港海關會逾期處理該申請
牌照會被暫時吊銷而非失效
tc.explain: 第6.4段訂明，如持牌人提交無效的續期申請而香港海關無法處理，現有牌照會於其有效期屆滿時自動失效；該持牌人必須停止經營金錢服務，而無牌經營金錢服務屬罪行。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What happens if an applicant fails to provide requisite information or documents within the specified period?
options: The application will be considered invalid and will not be processed by the C&ED
The application will be processed on the information available
The application will be suspended for six months
The applicant will be fined and the application processed
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that if the applicant fails to provide requisite information on the application form, annex and supplementary information sheet, or to produce the requisite documents including the Business Plan and AML Policy within a specified period, the application will be considered invalid and will not be processed by the C&ED.

tc.q: 如申請人未能於指明期間內提供所需資料或文件，會有甚麼後果？
options: 該申請會被視為無效，並不獲香港海關處理
該申請會按現有資料處理
該申請會暫緩六個月
申請人會被罰款，而申請仍會獲處理
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明，如申請人未能在申請表格、附件及補充資料表上提供所需資料，或未能於指明期間內提交所需文件（包括業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策），該申請會被視為無效，並不獲香港海關處理。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What weight does the Licensing Guide give to the result of the Competence Assessment?
options: It is one of the factors the CCE considers relevant in determining whether the applicant is fit and proper to operate a money service business
It is conclusive of the applicant's fitness and propriety
It is relevant only where the applicant has no previous licensing history
It is disregarded if the applicant passes the interview
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that the result of the Assessment will be one of the factors that the CCE considers relevant in determining whether the applicant is fit and proper to operate the business of a money service. Paragraph 6.2 applies the same formulation on renewal.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》賦予能力評核結果甚麼分量？
options: 屬海關關長在斷定申請人是否適合經營金錢服務業務時，認為相關的其中一項因素
是申請人適當人選資格的確證
只在申請人並無過往發牌紀錄時方屬相關
如申請人通過面談，則不予理會
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明評核結果是海關關長在斷定申請人是否適合經營金錢服務業務時，認為相關的其中一項因素。第6.2段就續期採用相同表述。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.3段

en.q: May an applicant submit a licence application by electronic means?
options: Yes — an applicant can access the C&ED's website and follow the instructions to submit the licence application
No — applications must be made by post or in person only
Yes, but only for renewal applications
Yes, but only with the CCE's prior written approval
en.explain: Paragraph 5.3 states that an applicant can access the C&ED's website and follow the instructions to submit the licence application, and refers applicants to Section XVI of the guide for the documents required in support. Paragraph 5.1 lists post, the website and in person as the submission channels.

tc.q: 申請人可否以電子方式提交牌照申請？
options: 可以——申請人可登入香港海關網站並按指示提交牌照申請
不可以——申請只可以郵遞或親身方式提出
可以，但只限續期申請
可以，但須事先取得海關關長書面批准
tc.explain: 第5.3段訂明申請人可登入香港海關網站並按指示提交牌照申請，並指引申請人參閱本指引第XVI節了解所需的證明文件。第5.1段列出郵遞、網站及親身提交為遞交途徑。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.7段

en.q: Where the applicant is a corporation, who must apply for the fit and proper person test?
options: Each director and each ultimate owner of the corporation to be associated with the business of operating a money service
The corporation itself as a legal person
The directors only, not the ultimate owners
The compliance officer and the money laundering reporting officer
en.explain: Paragraph 5.7 states that where the applicant is an individual, the individual and each ultimate owner; where a partnership, each partner and each ultimate owner; and where a corporation, each director and each ultimate owner of the corporation to be associated with the money service business, is required to apply for the fit and proper person test.

tc.q: 如申請人是法團，何人須申請適當人選測試？
options: 該法團的每名董事及每名將與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的最終擁有人
該法團本身，作為法人
只限董事，不包括最終擁有人
合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任
tc.explain: 第5.7段訂明：如申請人是個人，該個人及每名最終擁有人；如屬合夥，每名合夥人及每名最終擁有人；如屬法團，該法團的每名董事及每名將與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的最終擁有人，均須申請適當人選測試。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: To which office must a paper application be submitted in person or by post?
options: The Money Service Supervision Bureau, C&ED, Units 402-403, 4/F, Centre Parc, 11 Sheung Yuet Road, Kowloon Bay
The Licensing Control Division, Customs Headquarters, North Point
The Companies Registry, Queensway Government Offices
The Business Registration Office, Inland Revenue Department
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 states that the completed form, supplementary information sheet and annex must be submitted to the C&ED together with photocopies of the requisite documents by post, via C&ED's website, or in person to the Money Service Supervision Bureau, C&ED, Units 402-403, 4/F, Centre Parc, 11 Sheung Yuet Road, Kowloon Bay, Kowloon.

tc.q: 紙本申請須親身或以郵遞方式提交至哪一辦事處？
options: 九龍灣常悅道11號企業廣場4樓402-403室香港海關金錢服務監理科
北角海關總部牌照及事務管理科
金鐘政府合署公司註冊處
稅務局商業登記署
tc.explain: 第5.1段訂明填妥的表格、補充資料表及附件連同所需文件的影印本，須以郵遞、經香港海關網站或親身提交至九龍灣常悅道11號企業廣場4樓402-403室香港海關金錢服務監理科。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.3段

en.q: What does the C&ED issue when all requisite renewal documents are found to be in order?
options: A notice for an interview together with a demand note to the licensee for payment of respective fees, which are non-refundable
The renewed licence immediately
A provisional renewal valid for 90 days
A written confirmation that no interview is required
en.explain: Paragraph 6.3 states that when all the requisite documents are found to be in order, the CCE will issue a notice for an interview together with a demand note to the licensee for payment of the respective fees, which are non-refundable.

tc.q: 當所有所需的續期文件齊備妥當時，香港海關會發出甚麼？
options: 面談通知，連同向持牌人發出的繳費通知書（有關費用不獲退還）
即時發出續期牌照
有效期90日的臨時續期
書面確認無須面談
tc.explain: 第6.3段訂明，當所有所需文件齊備妥當時，海關關長會向持牌人發出面談通知，連同繳付有關費用的繳費通知書；該等費用不獲退還。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.3段

en.q: Do the photograph requirements apply to renewal applications as well as new applications?
options: Yes — at least two photographs of the same size and content are required for particular premises, and for each additional LPS and LMO
No — photographs are required only for new applications
Yes, but only one photograph of the exterior is required
Yes, but only where the premises have changed since the last application
en.explain: Paragraph 6.3 repeats the photograph requirement for renewal applications: at least two photographs of size 102x152 mm (4R-size), one showing the inner part and one the outer part, with the same requirements applying to each additional LPS and LMO.

tc.q: 照片規定是否同樣適用於續期申請及新申請？
options: 是——特定處所須附上至少兩張相同尺寸及內容的照片，每個額外的存放紀錄地方及本地管理辦事處亦然
否——只有新申請才須附上照片
是，但只需一張顯示外部的照片
是，但只限自上次申請以來處所已變更的情況
tc.explain: 第6.3段就續期申請重申照片規定：須附上至少兩張102x152毫米（4R尺寸）的照片，一張顯示內部，一張顯示外部；每個額外的存放紀錄地方及本地管理辦事處亦適用相同規定。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What does an applicant receive on the C&ED's receipt of a licence application?
options: An acknowledgment receipt of the application, with a reminder for outstanding documents issued where necessary
A provisional licence number
A date for the Competence Assessment
An invoice for the full fee immediately
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that on receipt of a licence application by C&ED, an applicant will have an acknowledgment receipt of the application, and a reminder for provision of any outstanding documents will be issued to the applicant where necessary.

tc.q: 香港海關接獲牌照申請後，申請人會收到甚麼？
options: 申請的收妥通知；如有需要，並會發出提示要求提交欠交的文件
臨時牌照號碼
能力評核的日期
即時發出的全額費用發票
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明香港海關接獲牌照申請後，申請人會收到申請的收妥通知；如有需要，並會向申請人發出提示，要求提交任何欠交的文件。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What must an applicant bring to the licensing interview?
options: The notice, the payment record, and the relevant original documents
Only the notice for interview
Only photocopies of the supporting documents
A cheque for the full licence fee
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that the applicant will be required to bring along the notice, payment record, and the relevant original documents when attending the interview at the allotted time with officers of the department.

tc.q: 申請人出席發牌面談時須攜帶甚麼？
options: 通知、付款紀錄，以及有關文件正本
只需面談通知
只需證明文件的影印本
全額牌照費用的支票
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明申請人須攜帶通知、付款紀錄及有關文件正本，於指定時間出席與該部門人員的面談。

en.q: Which procedural failure by an applicant is listed as a ground for refusing to grant a licence?
options: The applicant submits an incomplete or invalid application
The applicant submits the application by post rather than online
The applicant submits the application in Chinese only
The applicant submits the application more than six months before commencing business
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(h) lists as a refusal ground that an applicant submits an incomplete or invalid application. Paragraph 5.4 explains when an application is treated as invalid — where requisite information or documents are not provided within the specified period.

tc.q: 申請人哪一項程序上的缺失列為拒發牌照的理由？
options: 申請人提交不完整或無效的申請
申請人以郵遞而非網上方式提交申請
申請人只以中文提交申請
申請人在開業前超過六個月提交申請
tc.explain: 第5.10(h)段將申請人提交不完整或無效的申請列為拒發理由。第5.4段則說明何時申請會被視為無效——即未有於指明期間內提供所需資料或文件。

en.q: How do the LPS and LMO refusal grounds differ in scope?
options: Failure to provide LPS information is a ground for any applicant; failure to provide LMO information is a ground only for an applicant who chooses to operate without particular premises
Both apply only to applicants operating without particular premises
Both apply only to applicants operating at particular premises
Failure to provide LMO information applies to all applicants and LPS only to those without premises
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(d) lists failure to provide the information of an LPS as a refusal ground without qualification, consistent with paragraph 4.10 requiring all applicants to have an LPS. Paragraph 5.10(e) qualifies the LMO ground to an applicant who chooses to operate a money service without particular premises.

tc.q: 存放紀錄地方與本地管理辦事處這兩項拒發理由，適用範圍有何不同？
options: 未有提供存放紀錄地方資料，適用於任何申請人；未有提供本地管理辦事處資料，則只適用於選擇不設特定處所經營的申請人
兩者均只適用於不設特定處所經營的申請人
兩者均只適用於在特定處所經營的申請人
未有提供本地管理辦事處資料適用於所有申請人，存放紀錄地方則只適用於不設處所者
tc.explain: 第5.10(d)段將未有提供存放紀錄地方的資料列為拒發理由，並無附加條件，與第4.10段規定所有申請人均須設有該地方一致。第5.10(e)段則將本地管理辦事處的理由限於選擇不設特定處所經營金錢服務的申請人。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: From where may the application form, annex, supplementary information sheet and submission guidelines be obtained?
options: From the Money Service Supervision Bureau's office, or downloaded from the C&ED's website at the MSOS eServices address
Only from the Government Publications Centre
Only by written request to the Commissioner
Only from the Review Tribunal registry
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 states that the application form, annex, supplementary information sheet and guidelines for submission of Business Plan and AML Policy can be obtained from the Money Service Supervision Bureau's address or downloaded from C&ED's website at the MSOS eServices address.

tc.q: 申請表格、附件、補充資料表及遞交指引可從何處取得？
options: 金錢服務監理科辦事處，或從香港海關網站的金錢服務經營者牌照系統網址下載
只可從政府刊物銷售處取得
只可以書面向海關關長索取
只可從審裁處登記處取得
tc.explain: 第5.1段訂明申請表格、附件、補充資料表及《遞交業務計劃的指引》與《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》，可從金錢服務監理科的地址取得，或從香港海關網站的金錢服務經營者牌照系統網址下載。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.1段

en.q: By when must a licensee apply to renew its MSO licence?
options: Not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire
Not later than 90 days before the licence is due to expire
Not later than 30 days before the licence is due to expire
At any time before the licence expires
en.explain: Paragraph 6.1 states that a licensee is required to renew the MSO licence not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire, mirroring section 31(2)(a) of the AMLO. The 90-day period in paragraph 6.2 is when the department sends its reminder.

tc.q: 持牌人須於何時前申請續期金錢服務經營者牌照？
options: 於牌照到期屆滿前不少於45日
於牌照到期屆滿前不少於90日
於牌照到期屆滿前不少於30日
於牌照屆滿前任何時間
tc.explain: 第6.1段訂明持牌人須於牌照到期屆滿前不少於45日申請續期，與《打擊洗錢條例》第31(2)(a)條相對應。第6.2段的90日則是該部門發出提示的時間。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.2段

en.q: Whose legal responsibility is it to apply for renewal on time, notwithstanding the reminder sent by the department?
options: The licensee's — the reminder does not displace the licensee's own legal responsibility to apply 45 days before expiry
The department's, since it issues the reminder
The compliance officer's personally
The Review Tribunal's, on notification of expiry
en.explain: Paragraph 6.2 states that although the department will send a reminder 90 days before expiry, it is the licensee's legal responsibility to apply for renewal 45 days before the expiry of the licence.

tc.q: 即使該部門已發出提示，及時申請續期是何人的法律責任？
options: 持牌人的責任——該提示並不取代持牌人本身須於屆滿前45日申請的法律責任
該部門的責任，因提示由其發出
合規主任個人的責任
審裁處的責任，於接獲屆滿通知後
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明，雖然該部門會在牌照屆滿前90日發出提示，但持牌人仍有法律責任於牌照屆滿前45日申請續期。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.1段

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide describe its list of circumstances in which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence?
options: As a non-exhaustive list of examples
As an exhaustive statutory list
As applicable only to corporate licensees
As applicable only after a first written warning
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1 introduces the grounds as a non-exhaustive list of examples on which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence, and refers licensees to the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety and its Supplementary Guideline for more detail on the fit and proper criteria.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何描述其所列海關關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的情況？
options: 屬並非詳盡無遺的例子清單
屬詳盡無遺的法定清單
只適用於公司持牌人
只在首次書面警告後方適用
tc.explain: 第7.1段將該等理由列為並非詳盡無遺的例子清單，說明海關關長可據此撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照，並指引持牌人參閱《有關適當人選準則的指引》及其《補充指引》，以了解適當人選準則的詳情。

en.q: Which reporting failure is listed as a ground on which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence?
options: Where a licensee fails to submit a periodic return on time
Where a licensee fails to file audited accounts
Where a licensee fails to report a change of auditor
Where a licensee fails to publish its AML Policy
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(f) lists as a ground where a licensee fails to submit a periodic return on time. Paragraph 11.2 correspondingly warns that any failure to submit a periodic return on time may result in the suspension and/or revocation of the licence.

tc.q: 哪一項匯報缺失列為海關關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由？
options: 持牌人未有準時提交定期申報表
持牌人未有提交經審計帳目
持牌人未有匯報更換核數師
持牌人未有公開其打擊洗錢政策
tc.explain: 第7.1(f)段將持牌人未有準時提交定期申報表列為理由。第11.2段亦相應警告，未有準時提交定期申報表可能導致暫時吊銷及／或撤銷牌照。

en.q: Which example does the Licensing Guide give of a licensee's holding of a licence failing to fulfil the purpose for which it was issued?
options: A money service has never been provided by the licensee
The licensee has changed the currencies it deals in
The licensee has reduced its opening hours
The licensee has moved to smaller premises
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(g) lists as a revocation or suspension ground where a licensee's holding of the licence fails to fulfil the purpose — the provision of money service — for which the licence was issued, giving as an example that a money service has never been provided by the licensee. This mirrors paragraph 6(f) of the Supplementary F&P Guideline.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就持牌人持有牌照未能達致發牌目的，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 該持牌人從未提供任何金錢服務
該持牌人更改了其經營的貨幣種類
該持牌人縮減了營業時間
該持牌人遷往較小的處所
tc.explain: 第7.1(g)段將持牌人持有牌照未能達致發牌目的（即提供金錢服務）列為撤銷或暫時吊銷理由，並以該持牌人從未提供任何金錢服務為例。此與《適當人選補充指引》第6(f)段相對應。

en.q: Which appointment failure is listed as a ground for revoking or suspending a licence after it has been granted?
options: Where a licensee fails to appoint or maintain a competent CO or MLRO
Where a licensee fails to appoint a new director within 30 days of a vacancy
Where a licensee fails to appoint an internal auditor
Where a licensee fails to appoint a local legal representative
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(i) lists as a ground where a licensee fails to appoint or maintain a competent Compliance Officer or Money Laundering Reporting Officer. Note the word “maintain”: an appointment made at the licensing stage must be kept in place.

tc.q: 批出牌照後，哪一項委任缺失列為撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由？
options: 持牌人未有委任或維持稱職的合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任
持牌人未有於出缺後30日內委任新董事
持牌人未有委任內部核數師
持牌人未有委任本地法律代表
tc.explain: 第7.1(i)段將持牌人未有委任或維持稱職的合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任列為理由。留意「維持」一詞：在發牌階段作出的委任必須持續維持。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.2段

en.q: What procedural protection does a licensee have before its licence is revoked or suspended?
options: The CCE will inform the licensee by notice in writing and give the licensee an opportunity to be heard before revoking or suspending the licence
The licensee may require the matter to be referred to the Review Tribunal first
The licensee is entitled to 90 days' notice of the proposed action
The licensee may require an independent auditor's report to be obtained
en.explain: Paragraph 7.2 states that the CCE will inform the licensee of the revocation or suspension by notice in writing and give the licensee an opportunity to be heard before revoking or suspending the licence, reflecting section 34(3) of the AMLO.

tc.q: 在牌照被撤銷或暫時吊銷前，持牌人有甚麼程序保障？
options: 海關關長會以書面通知告知持牌人，並在撤銷或暫時吊銷前給予持牌人陳述機會
持牌人可要求先將事宜轉交審裁處
持牌人有權就擬採取的行動獲得90日通知
持牌人可要求取得獨立核數師報告
tc.explain: 第7.2段訂明海關關長會以書面通知告知持牌人有關撤銷或暫時吊銷事宜，並在撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照前給予持牌人陳述機會，反映《打擊洗錢條例》第34(3)條的規定。

en.q: Which form does a licensee use to seek the CCE's prior approval for a person proposing to become its director, ultimate owner or partner?
options: Form 4, with the proposing person submitting a fit and proper person declaration form
Form 5 in each case
Form 6, as a notification of change
Form 2, as part of the next renewal
en.explain: Paragraphs 8.1, 8.2 and 8.3 each state that the licensee needs to make an application in Form 4 and that the proposing director, ultimate owner or partner needs to submit the fit and proper person declaration form. Form 5 is used to add premises and Form 6 to notify changes in particulars.

tc.q: 持牌人就擬成為其董事、最終擁有人或合夥人的人尋求海關關長事先批准，須使用哪一表格？
options: 表格4，並由該擬任人士提交適當人選聲明表格
各情況均用表格5
表格6，作為變更通知
表格2，於下次續期時一併處理
tc.explain: 第8.1、8.2及8.3段均訂明持牌人須以表格4提出申請，而該擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人須提交適當人選聲明表格。表格5用於新增處所，表格6則用於通知詳情變更。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第8.4段

en.q: A licensee operating without particular premises wishes to change to operating at particular premises. What must it submit?
options: An application in Form 5, together with a Business Plan and an updated AML Policy to notify the CCE of the change in operation mode
Form 5 alone
Form 6 as a notification of change in particulars
A fresh licence application in Form 1
en.explain: Paragraph 8.4 states that if a licensee operating a money service without particular premises wishes to change to operation at particular premises, then apart from submitting an application in Form 5, the licensee needs to submit a Business Plan and updated AML Policy to notify the CCE of the change in operation mode of its money service.

tc.q: 並非在特定處所經營的持牌人擬改為在特定處所經營。它須提交甚麼？
options: 以表格5提出申請，並連同業務計劃及更新的打擊洗錢政策，通知海關關長其營運模式的改變
只需表格5
以表格6作為詳情變更通知
以表格1重新提出牌照申請
tc.explain: 第8.4段訂明，如並非在特定處所經營金錢服務的持牌人擬改為在特定處所經營，除須向香港海關提交表格5申請外，還須提交業務計劃及更新的打擊洗錢政策，以通知海關關長其金錢服務營運模式的改變。

en.q: Besides criminal sanction, what other consequences may follow a contravention of sections 35(1), 36(1), 37(1), 38(1), 39(1) or 39A(1)?
options: Disciplinary and/or administrative sanctions such as suspension and revocation of the licence
A requirement to re-sit the Competence Assessment
A mandatory increase in the licence fee
Referral of the matter to the Companies Registry
en.explain: Paragraph 8.10 states that apart from criminal sanction, a licensee who contravenes sections 35(1), 36(1), 37(1), 38(1), 39(1) or 39A(1) of the AMLO may also be subject to disciplinary and/or administrative sanctions such as suspension and revocation of licence.

options: 紀律及／或行政制裁，例如暫時吊銷及撤銷牌照
須重新參加能力評核
牌照費用強制上調
將事宜轉交公司註冊處
tc.explain: 第8.10段訂明，除刑事制裁外，違反《打擊洗錢條例》第35(1)、36(1)、37(1)、38(1)、39(1)或39A(1)條的持牌人，亦可能受到紀律及／或行政制裁，例如暫時吊銷及撤銷牌照。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.1段

en.q: Which form does a licensee use to notify the CCE of a change in particulars?
options: Form 6 — Notification of Change in Particulars
Form 4 — application for approval
Form 5 — application to add premises
Form 7 — Notification of Cessation of Business
en.explain: Paragraph 9.1 states that a licensee needs to notify the CCE of the listed changes by completing the Notification of Change in Particulars (Form 6). Form 7 is the Notification of Cessation of Business under paragraph 10.2.

tc.q: 持牌人以哪一表格通知海關關長詳情變更？
options: 表格6——詳情變更通知
表格4——批准申請
表格5——新增處所申請
表格7——停止營業通知
tc.explain: 第9.1段訂明持牌人須填寫「詳情變更通知」（表格6），將所列的變更通知海關關長。表格7則是第10.2段所指的停止營業通知。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.1段

en.q: Which of the following is listed among the changes in particulars that must be notified to the CCE?
options: Change in the local place for storage of books and records
Change in the licensee's insurance broker
Change in the licensee's external auditor
Change in the licensee's advertising agency
en.explain: Paragraph 9.1 lists fourteen categories, including change in business or corporation name, principal address, contact information, business premises information, telephone or fax number, information on other business run at the premises, occupants of mixed commercial and residential premises, particulars of and changes in sole proprietor, partners, directors and ultimate owners, fit and proper status, bank account, local management office, local place for storage of books and records, and CO or MLRO.

tc.q: 下列何者列於須通知海關關長的詳情變更之中？
options: 本地存放簿冊及紀錄地方的變更
持牌人保險經紀的變更
持牌人外部核數師的變更
持牌人廣告代理的變更
tc.explain: 第9.1段列出十四類變更，包括業務／公司名稱、主要（通訊）地址、聯絡資料、業務處所資料、業務處所電話或傳真號碼、處所內其他業務的資料、商住混合樓宇特定處所的佔用人、獨資經營者／合夥人／董事／最終擁有人的詳情及人選變更、適當人選狀況、營運金錢服務業務所用的銀行帳戶、本地管理辦事處、本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方，以及合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.1段

en.q: What warning does the Licensing Guide give about the effect of certain changes in particulars?
options: Some changes may result in a review of the validity of an MSO licence, for example changes in the fit and proper status of the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner
All changes automatically invalidate the licence
No change can affect the validity of a licence within its term
Only changes of business address affect validity
en.explain: Paragraph 9.1 warns that licensees should be aware that some changes in particulars may result in a review of the validity of an MSO licence, giving as an example changes in the fit and proper status of the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就某些詳情變更的影響作出甚麼提醒？
options: 某些變更可能導致金錢服務經營者牌照的有效性被檢視，例如獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的適當人選狀況變更
所有變更均自動令牌照失效
在牌照有效期內任何變更均不影響其有效性
只有業務地址變更會影響有效性
tc.explain: 第9.1段提醒持牌人注意，某些詳情變更可能導致金錢服務經營者牌照的有效性被檢視，並以獨資經營者／合夥人／董事／最終擁有人的適當人選狀況變更為例。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.4段

en.q: A licensee intends to change the legal entity through which it operates. What does the Licensing Guide require?
options: A fresh licence application, so that the CCE can consider whether the fit and proper status of the legal entity concerned meets the eligibility criteria
A notification in Form 6 within one month
An application in Form 4 for approval
An updated Business Plan only
en.explain: Paragraph 9.4 states that as far as the change of the legal entity is concerned, the licensee needs to submit a fresh licence application for the CCE to consider whether the fit and proper status of the legal entity concerned meets the eligibility criteria for the grant of an MSO licence.

tc.q: 持牌人擬更改其經營所用的法律實體。《牌照指引》有何規定？
options: 須重新提出牌照申請，使海關關長可考慮有關法律實體的適當人選狀況是否符合資格準則
於一個月內以表格6作出通知
以表格4申請批准
只需提交更新的業務計劃
tc.explain: 第9.4段訂明，就法律實體的變更而言，持牌人須重新提出牌照申請，以便海關關長考慮有關法律實體的適當人選狀況，是否符合批出金錢服務經營者牌照的資格準則。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.4段

en.q: A licensee wishes to change the nature of its money service business, for example from money changing to remittance. What must it file?
options: A written submission with the CCE including the updated Business Plan and AML Policy and any relevant supporting documents, for a review of its fit and proper status for the proposed service
A fresh licence application in Form 1
An application in Form 5
Nothing, provided the change is notified at the next renewal
en.explain: Paragraph 9.4 states that if a licensee wishes to change the nature of the money service business — for example money changing service to remittance service or vice versa — the licensee is required to file a written submission with the CCE, including the updated Business Plan and AML Policy as well as any relevant supporting documents deemed necessary, for a review of its fit and proper status for the provision of the proposed money service.

tc.q: 持牌人擬更改其金錢服務業務的性質，例如由貨幣兌換改為匯款。它須提交甚麼？
options: 向海關關長提交書面呈交，包括更新的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策，以及任何相關證明文件，以便檢視其就擬提供服務的適當人選狀況
以表格1重新提出牌照申請
以表格5提出申請
無須提交，只要在下次續期時通知即可
tc.explain: 第9.4段訂明，如持牌人擬更改金錢服務業務的性質（例如由貨幣兌換服務改為匯款服務或相反），須向海關關長提交書面呈交，包括更新的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策，以及任何被認為必需的相關證明文件，以便檢視其就提供擬議金錢服務的適當人選狀況。

en.q: A licensee operating at particular premises wishes to change to operating without particular premises. What must it do?
options: Notify the CCE of the cessation of its existing business and submit a new application for a licence to operate a money service without particular premises
Submit an application in Form 5 only
Notify the change in Form 6 within one month
Surrender the licence and await the CCE's direction
en.explain: Paragraph 10.1 states that if a licensee operating a money service at particular premises wishes to change to operation without particular premises, the licensee needs to submit an application to notify the CCE of the cessation of its existing business and submit a new application to apply for a licence to operate a money service without particular premises.

tc.q: 在特定處所經營的持牌人擬改為不設特定處所經營。它須怎樣做？
options: 通知海關關長停止其現有業務，並重新提出申請，申領在無特定處所下經營金錢服務的牌照
只需以表格5提出申請
於一個月內以表格6通知變更
交回牌照並等候關長指示
tc.explain: 第10.1段訂明，如在特定處所經營金錢服務的持牌人擬改為不設特定處所經營，該持牌人須提交申請通知海關關長停止其現有業務，並重新提出申請，申領在無特定處所下經營金錢服務的牌照。

en.q: Which form is used to notify the CCE of a cessation of business, and what must be returned?
options: Form 7, and the valid or expired licence must be returned to the CCE for cancellation within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation or expiry
Form 6, and no return of the licence is required
Form 4, and the licence must be returned within one month
Form 2, and the licence must be retained by the licensee
en.explain: Paragraph 10.2 requires the licensee to notify the CCE before the date of cessation, including expiry of the licence, by completing the Notification of Cessation of Business (Form 7), and to return the valid or expired licence to the CCE for cancellation within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation or expiry as the case may be.

tc.q: 通知海關關長停止營業使用哪一表格？須交回甚麼？
options: 表格7；並須自停止營業或屆滿日期起計7日內，將有效或已屆滿的牌照交回關長註銷
表格6；無須交回牌照
表格4；並須於一個月內交回牌照
表格2；牌照由持牌人自行保留
tc.explain: 第10.2段規定持牌人須於停止營業日期（包括牌照屆滿）前，填寫「停止營業通知」（表格7）通知海關關長；並須自停止營業或屆滿日期（視屬何情況）起計7日內，將有效或已屆滿的牌照交回關長註銷。

en.q: If a licensee cancels its licence within the validity period, is any part of the fees paid refunded?
options: No
Yes, in proportion to the unexpired period
Yes, but only the fit and proper test fee
Yes, but only if cancellation is within the first six months
en.explain: Paragraph 10.3 answers the question with a simple “No”, consistent with section 34(7) and section 41(3) of the AMLO, under which no licence fee paid in respect of the grant or renewal is refunded where a licence is revoked, suspended or returned for cancellation.

tc.q: 如持牌人在牌照有效期內註銷牌照，已繳費用是否有任何部分獲退還？
options: 否
是，按未屆滿期間按比例退還
是，但只退還適當人選測試費用
是，但只限首六個月內註銷
tc.explain: 第10.3段以「否」作答，與《打擊洗錢條例》第34(7)及41(3)條一致；據該等條文，牌照被撤銷、暫時吊銷或交回註銷時，就批出或續期而繳付的牌照費用概不退還。

en.q: Besides the criminal penalty, what further consequence does the Licensing Guide identify for contravening the cessation notification requirement?
options: The contravention will adversely affect the fitness and propriety of the person concerned to operate a money service or to be associated with the business
The licence is automatically reinstated pending investigation
The licensee must pay a surcharge equal to the renewal fee
The matter is referred to the Review Tribunal for determination
en.explain: Paragraph 10.4 sets out the section 41 obligations and the section 41(4) fine of HK$50,000, and adds that such contravention will adversely affect the fitness and propriety of the person concerned to operate a money service or to be associated with the business of operating a money service, and that the CCE may also take disciplinary and/or administrative sanctions.

tc.q: 除刑事罰則外，《牌照指引》就違反停業通知規定指出甚麼進一步後果？
options: 該項違反會對有關人士經營金錢服務或與該業務有聯繫的適當人選資格造成不利影響
牌照在調查期間自動恢復
持牌人須繳付相當於續期費用的附加費
事宜會轉交審裁處裁定
tc.explain: 第10.4段列出第41條的責任及第41(4)條的50,000港元罰款，並補充該項違反會對有關人士經營金錢服務或與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的適當人選資格造成不利影響；海關關長亦可就該項違反採取紀律及／或行政制裁。

en.q: Which continuing obligation does the Licensing Guide impose on the individual, partners, directors and ultimate owners in relation to a licensee?
options: They must remain fit and proper at all times
They must each attend the Competence Assessment annually
They must each be resident in Hong Kong
They must each hold a separate approval from the CCE every two years
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(c) lists among a licensee's obligations that the individual, any partner, any director and ultimate owner in relation to a licensee must remain fit and proper at all times — the continuing counterpart to the section 30(3) entry test and the basis for the section 34 revocation power.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就與持牌人有關的個人、合夥人、董事及最終擁有人，施加甚麼持續責任？
options: 他們須時刻保持適當人選資格
他們須每年各自參加能力評核
他們須各自為香港居民
他們須每兩年各自取得海關關長的獨立批准
tc.explain: 第11.1(c)段在持牌人的責任中列明，與持牌人有關的個人、任何合夥人、任何董事及最終擁有人，須時刻保持適當人選資格——這是第30(3)條入場測試的持續對應要求，亦是第34條撤銷權力的基礎。

en.q: What continuing obligation does the Licensing Guide impose in relation to the Competence Assessment?
options: A licensee must ensure at least one of the members of its senior management — the sole proprietor, partner or director — has attended the Assessment
Every member of senior management must have passed the Assessment
The compliance officer must have attended the Assessment
All staff must attend the Assessment within one year of appointment
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(h) lists among a licensee's obligations that it must ensure at least one of the members of the senior management — that is, the sole proprietor, partner or director — has attended the Assessment.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就能力評核施加甚麼持續責任？
options: 持牌人須確保其高級管理層中至少一名成員（獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）曾參加能力評核
高級管理層每名成員均須通過評核
合規主任須曾參加評核
所有員工均須於獲聘後一年內參加評核
tc.explain: 第11.1(h)段在持牌人的責任中列明，持牌人須確保其高級管理層中至少一名成員（即獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）曾參加能力評核。

en.q: In whose name must a bank account used for operating the money service business be held?
options: The licensee's company, or the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the licensee
Any person nominated by the licensee in writing
The compliance officer of the licensee
A trust account operated by the licensee's solicitors
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(j) states that where a bank account is used for operation of the money service business, the account must be in the name of the licensee's company, the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the licensee. The Business Plan guideline reinforces this by prohibiting third party bank accounts.

tc.q: 用於營運金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶須以何人名義開立？
options: 持牌人的公司，或該持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人
持牌人以書面提名的任何人
持牌人的合規主任
由持牌人的律師行經營的信託帳戶
tc.explain: 第11.1(j)段訂明，凡使用銀行帳戶營運金錢服務業務，該帳戶必須以持牌人的公司，或該持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的名義開立。《遞交業務計劃的指引》禁止第三方銀行帳戶，亦印證此點。

en.q: What must a licensee operating without particular premises ensure about its local management office?
options: That it maintains the LMO and that the LMO can serve as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED
That the LMO is open to the public during business hours
That the LMO is located in the same district as its bank
That the LMO is registered separately under the Business Registration Ordinance
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(g) lists among a licensee's obligations that, where a licensee operates a money service without particular premises, the licensee must maintain an LMO and ensure the LMO can serve as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED.

tc.q: 並非在特定處所經營的持牌人，須就其本地管理辦事處確保甚麼？
options: 維持該辦事處，並確保其能作為與香港海關聯絡的接觸點
該辦事處在營業時間內對公眾開放
該辦事處與其往來銀行位於同一區域
該辦事處另行根據《商業登記條例》登記
tc.explain: 第11.1(g)段在持牌人的責任中列明，如持牌人在無特定處所下經營金錢服務，須維持本地管理辦事處，並確保該辦事處能作為與香港海關聯絡的接觸點。

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide characterise the list of licensee's obligations it sets out?
options: As a non-exhaustive list, the licensee being obliged to comply with all applicable provisions of the AMLO and guidelines issued by the CCE
As a complete statement of every obligation a licensee owes
As applying only to licensees operating at particular premises
As applying only until the first renewal of the licence
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1 states that a licensee is obliged to comply with all the applicable provisions of the AMLO and guidelines issued by the CCE, and that what follows is a non-exhaustive list of obligations.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何描述其所列的持牌人責任清單？
options: 屬並非詳盡無遺的清單；持牌人有責任遵從《打擊洗錢條例》所有適用條文及海關關長發出的指引
屬持牌人所負每項責任的完整陳述
只適用於在特定處所經營的持牌人
只適用至牌照首次續期為止
tc.explain: 第11.1段訂明持牌人有責任遵從《打擊洗錢條例》所有適用條文及海關關長發出的指引，而其後所列的責任清單並非詳盡無遺。

en.q: Why does the C&ED require a licensee to submit supplementary information forms?
options: To notify the C&ED of the appointment of a CO and an MLRO to act respectively as the focal point for oversight of compliance measures and the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions
To report the licensee's quarterly turnover
To update the licensee's list of customers
To confirm the licensee's compliance with the Employment Ordinance
en.explain: Paragraph 11.3 explains that a licensee is required to notify the C&ED of the appointment of a CO and an MLRO to act respectively as the focal point for the oversight of compliance measures and the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions, as required by the AML Guideline.

tc.q: 香港海關為何要求持牌人提交補充資料表？
options: 以通知香港海關委任合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任，分別擔任監督合規措施的統籌點及匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點
以匯報持牌人的季度營業額
以更新持牌人的客戶名單
以確認持牌人遵從《僱傭條例》
tc.explain: 第11.3段解釋，按《打擊洗錢指引》的規定，持牌人須通知香港海關其委任合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任，分別擔任監督合規措施的統籌點及匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點。

en.q: Which statutory and regulatory requirement does the Assessment requirement for senior management give effect to?
options: The requirement on senior management oversight prescribed under the AMLO and guidelines issued by the CCE
The requirement for continuing professional development under the Employment Ordinance
The requirement for directors' training under the Companies Ordinance
The requirement for staff certification under the Business Registration Ordinance
en.explain: Paragraph 11.4 explains that the requirement for senior management to attend the Assessment gives effect to the relevant statutory and regulatory AML/CFT requirement on senior management oversight prescribed under the AMLO and guidelines issued by the CCE.

tc.q: 高級管理層須參加能力評核的規定，是為落實哪一項法定及監管規定？
options: 《打擊洗錢條例》及海關關長發出的指引所訂明關於高級管理層監督的規定
《僱傭條例》下的持續專業進修規定
《公司條例》下的董事培訓規定
《商業登記條例》下的員工認證規定
tc.explain: 第11.4段解釋，高級管理層須參加能力評核的規定，是為落實《打擊洗錢條例》及海關關長發出的指引所訂明、關於高級管理層監督的相關法定及監管打擊洗錢規定。

en.q: In what form and manner must a periodic return be submitted?
options: In the form and manner specified by the CCE
In any form the licensee considers appropriate
In the form prescribed by regulation under section 51
In the same form as the original licence application
en.explain: Paragraph 11.2 states that a licensee shall lodge a periodic return to the CCE within 2 weeks beginning from each half year unless specified by the CCE by notice in writing, and that the periodic return must be submitted in the form and manner specified by the CCE.

tc.q: 定期申報表須以甚麼格式及方式提交？
options: 按海關關長指明的格式及方式
持牌人認為適當的任何格式
根據第51條的規例訂明的格式
與原有牌照申請相同的格式
tc.explain: 第11.2段訂明持牌人須在每半年開始起計兩星期內向海關關長提交定期申報表（除非關長以書面通知另作指明），而該申報表須按關長指明的格式及方式提交。

en.q: Which consent obligation continues to bind a licensee after the licence is granted?
options: Securing the written consent of the occupants of premises situated in a mixed commercial and residential building for an authorized person to conduct routine inspection
Securing the consent of neighbouring businesses to the display of a signboard
Securing the consent of customers to the retention of their records
Securing the consent of the landlord to each renewal application
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(d) lists among a licensee's continuing obligations that it must secure the written consent of the occupants in premises situated in a mixed commercial and residential building for an authorized person to conduct routine inspection — the obligation whose breakdown is a revocation ground under paragraphs 7.1(b) and (c).

tc.q: 哪一項同意責任在批出牌照後仍持續約束持牌人？
options: 就位於商住混合樓宇的處所，取得佔用人的書面同意讓獲授權人進行例行視察
取得鄰近商戶同意展示招牌
取得客戶同意保存其紀錄
就每次續期申請取得業主同意
tc.explain: 第11.1(d)段在持牌人的持續責任中列明，持牌人須就位於商住混合樓宇的處所，取得佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人進行例行視察——該項責任一旦失效，即構成第7.1(b)及(c)段的撤銷理由。

en.q: Which two AML-related obligations head the Licensing Guide's list of licensee's obligations?
options: Reporting suspicious transactions, and developing and maintaining an effective AML Policy to mitigate ML/TF risks
Screening every customer against sanctions lists, and filing quarterly statistics
Training all staff annually, and appointing an external auditor
Retaining records for ten years, and insuring against fraud
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1 opens its non-exhaustive list with (a) a licensee must report on suspicious transactions, and (b) a licensee must develop and maintain an effective AML Policy to mitigate ML/TF risks.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》持牌人責任清單以哪兩項與打擊洗錢有關的責任開首？
options: 匯報可疑交易；以及制定及維持有效的打擊洗錢政策以減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
就制裁名單篩查每名客戶；以及提交季度統計
每年培訓所有員工；以及委任外部核數師
保存紀錄十年；以及就欺詐投購保險
tc.explain: 第11.1段的非詳盡清單以下列兩項開首：(a)持牌人必須匯報可疑交易；及(b)持牌人必須制定及維持有效的打擊洗錢政策，以減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.1(d)及(e)段

en.q: How do the LPS and LMO revocation grounds differ in their conditions?
options: The LPS ground applies where any licensee fails to maintain it or it falls foul of the guide's requirements; the LMO ground applies only where the licensee operates without particular premises
Both apply only to licensees operating at particular premises
Both apply only where the premises have been inspected and found wanting
The LMO ground applies to all licensees and the LPS ground only to those without premises
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(d) applies where the licensee fails to maintain an LPS or the LPS falls foul of the requirements in the guide, without qualification. Paragraph 7.1(e) is expressly limited to the case where a licensee operates a money service without particular premises.

tc.q: 存放紀錄地方與本地管理辦事處這兩項撤銷理由，條件有何不同？
options: 存放紀錄地方一項適用於任何持牌人未有維持該地方或該地方不符指引規定的情況；本地管理辦事處一項則只適用於不設特定處所經營的持牌人
兩者均只適用於在特定處所經營的持牌人
兩者均只適用於處所經視察後被認為不合格的情況
本地管理辦事處一項適用於所有持牌人，存放紀錄地方一項則只適用於不設處所者
tc.explain: 第7.1(d)段適用於持牌人未有維持本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方，或該地方不符本指引所載規定的情況，並無附加條件。第7.1(e)段則明文限於持牌人在無特定處所下經營金錢服務的情況。

en.q: Which broad compliance failure is listed as a ground for revoking or suspending a licence?
options: Where a licensee fails to comply with any requirements provided under the AMLO, including requirements stipulated in Part 5
Where a licensee fails to comply with the Companies Ordinance
Where a licensee fails to comply with its own internal policies
Where a licensee fails to comply with industry best practice
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(h) lists as a ground where a licensee fails to comply with any requirements provided under the AMLO, including requirements stipulated in Part 5 of the AMLO — a catch-all alongside the specific grounds listed.

tc.q: 哪一項廣泛的合規缺失列為撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由？
options: 持牌人未有遵從《打擊洗錢條例》下的任何規定，包括該條例第5部所訂明的規定
持牌人未有遵從《公司條例》
持牌人未有遵從其本身的內部政策
持牌人未有遵從業界最佳常規
tc.explain: 第7.1(h)段將持牌人未有遵從《打擊洗錢條例》下的任何規定（包括該條例第5部所訂明的規定）列為理由——這是與其他具體理由並列的概括條文。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.3段

en.q: Within what period may a licensee appeal against a revocation or suspension decision?
options: Within the period ending 21 days after the notice informing the licensee of the decision has been sent
Within 21 days after the decision takes effect
Within 30 days after the notice is received
Within 45 days after the decision is made
en.explain: Paragraph 7.3 states that the licensee may appeal against the CCE's decision to the Review Tribunal within the period ending 21 days after the notice informing the licensee of the decision has been sent — the period running from despatch of the notice, as under section 59(1) of the AMLO.

tc.q: 持牌人可於甚麼期限內就撤銷或暫時吊銷決定提出上訴？
options: 於告知持牌人該決定的通知發出後21日內
於該決定生效後21日內
於接獲通知後30日內
於該決定作出後45日內
tc.explain: 第7.3段訂明持牌人可於告知其該決定的通知發出後21日內，就海關關長的決定向審裁處提出上訴——該期間自通知發出時起計，與《打擊洗錢條例》第59(1)條相同。

en.q: Within what period must a licensee notify the CCE of a change in particulars, and from when does it run?
options: Within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place
Within one month of the licensee becoming aware of the change
Within 45 days of the change
Within 7 days of the change
en.explain: Paragraphs 9.2 and 9.3 both state that the licensee must notify the CCE in writing of the change within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place, reflecting section 40(1) of the AMLO. The clock runs from the change itself, not from the licensee's awareness of it.

tc.q: 持牌人須於甚麼期限內將詳情變更通知海關關長？該期間自何時起計？
options: 自變更發生之日起計一個月內
自持牌人知悉該變更起計一個月內
自變更起計45日內
自變更起計7日內
tc.explain: 第9.2及9.3段均訂明持牌人須自變更發生之日起計一個月內，以書面將變更通知海關關長，反映《打擊洗錢條例》第40(1)條的規定。計時自變更本身起計，而非自持牌人知悉起計。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.3段

en.q: Besides the fine, what further consequence follows a licensee's failure to notify a change in particulars?
options: The licensee may also be subject to disciplinary and/or administrative sanctions such as suspension and revocation of licence
The change is deemed not to have taken effect
The licence is automatically suspended for one month
The licensee must re-apply for the licence
en.explain: Paragraph 9.3 sets out the section 40(1) duty and the section 40(4) fine of HK$50,000, and adds that apart from criminal sanction, a licensee who contravenes section 40(1) may also be subject to disciplinary and/or administrative sanctions such as suspension and revocation of licence.

tc.q: 除罰款外，持牌人未有通知詳情變更還會招致甚麼後果？
options: 該持牌人亦可能受到紀律及／或行政制裁，例如暫時吊銷及撤銷牌照
該項變更視為並未生效
牌照自動暫時吊銷一個月
該持牌人須重新申領牌照
tc.explain: 第9.3段列出第40(1)條的責任及第40(4)條的50,000港元罰款，並補充除刑事制裁外，違反第40(1)條的持牌人亦可能受到紀律及／或行政制裁，例如暫時吊銷及撤銷牌照。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第8.4段

en.q: Which form must a licensee use to apply to add premises at which to operate a money service?
options: Form 5
Form 4
Form 6
Form 7
en.explain: Paragraph 8.4 states that if a licensee wishes to add premises to operate a money service, the licensee needs to make an application in Form 5 to add the premises. Form 4 is for approvals of directors, ultimate owners and partners; Form 6 notifies changes; Form 7 notifies cessation.

tc.q: 持牌人申請新增經營金錢服務的處所，須使用哪一表格？
options: 表格5
表格4
表格6
表格7
tc.explain: 第8.4段訂明，如持牌人擬新增經營金錢服務的處所，須以表格5提出申請新增該處所。表格4用於董事、最終擁有人及合夥人的批准；表格6用於通知變更；表格7則用於通知停止營業。

en.q: What penalty does the Licensing Guide state for contravening the prior-approval requirements in sections 35(1) to 39(1)?
options: A fine of HK$50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months on conviction, with disciplinary action also available under section 43(1)(c)
A fine of HK$100,000 and imprisonment for 12 months
A pecuniary penalty of up to HK$1,000,000 only
A written warning for a first contravention
en.explain: Paragraphs 8.5 to 8.9 each state that a person who without reasonable excuse contravenes the relevant subsection commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine of HK$50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months, and that the CCE may also take disciplinary action under section 43(1)(c). The $50,000 figure corresponds to a fine at level 5 in the AMLO's wording.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就違反第35(1)至39(1)條的事先批准規定，訂明甚麼刑罰？
options: 一經定罪可處罰款50,000港元及監禁6個月；並可根據第43(1)(c)條採取紀律行動
罰款100,000港元及監禁12個月
只可處最高1,000,000港元的罰款
首次違反只發書面警告
tc.explain: 第8.5至8.9段均訂明，任何人無合理辯解而違反有關條款即屬犯罪，一經定罪可處罰款50,000港元及監禁6個月；海關關長亦可根據第43(1)(c)條採取紀律行動。該50,000元相當於《打擊洗錢條例》表述的第5級罰款。

en.q: Must a licensee notify the CCE if it ceases to operate a money service at only some of the premises specified in its licence?
options: Yes — the notification duty covers cessation of business and cessation of operating a money service at any specified premises
No — notification is required only on complete cessation of business
No — a Form 6 notification of change suffices for individual premises
Yes, but only if the premises were the principal premises
en.explain: Paragraph 10.1 states that the licensee needs to notify the CCE of the cessation of business or the cessation of operating a money service at any specified premises, mirroring section 41(1) of the AMLO which covers both situations.

tc.q: 如持牌人只是停止在牌照指明處所中的部分處所經營金錢服務，是否須通知海關關長？
options: 須通知——通知責任涵蓋停止營業及停止在任何指明處所經營金錢服務
無須——只有完全停止營業才須通知
無須——個別處所以表格6作變更通知即可
須通知，但只限該處所為主要處所的情況
tc.explain: 第10.1段訂明持牌人須將停止營業或停止在任何指明處所經營金錢服務一事通知海關關長，與《打擊洗錢條例》第41(1)條涵蓋兩種情況相對應。

en.q: Does the cessation notification requirement extend to the expiry of a licence?
options: Yes — the licensee must notify the CCE before the date of cessation, including expiry of the licence, and return the valid or expired licence within 7 days
No — expiry is automatic and requires no notification or return
Yes, but only where the licensee does not intend to re-apply
No — only voluntary cessation requires notification
en.explain: Paragraph 10.2 states that the licensee must notify the CCE before the date of cessation, expressly including expiry of the licence, by completing Form 7, and must return the valid or expired licence for cancellation within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation or expiry as the case may be.

tc.q: 停業通知規定是否延伸至牌照屆滿的情況？
options: 是——持牌人須於停止營業日期（包括牌照屆滿）前通知海關關長，並於7日內交回有效或已屆滿的牌照
否——屆滿屬自動生效，無須通知或交回
是，但只限持牌人不擬重新申請的情況
否——只有自願停業才須通知
tc.explain: 第10.2段訂明持牌人須於停止營業日期（明文包括牌照屆滿）前填寫表格7通知海關關長，並須自停止營業或屆滿日期（視屬何情況）起計7日內交回有效或已屆滿的牌照以作註銷。

en.q: Which record-storage obligation applies to every licensee, whether or not it operates at particular premises?
options: A licensee must maintain a local place for storage of books and records
A licensee must maintain a local management office
A licensee must store records at its principal business premises
A licensee must lodge copies of its records with the C&ED
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(f) lists among a licensee's obligations that a licensee must maintain an LPS, without qualification. The LMO obligation in paragraph 11.1(g) applies only where the licensee operates without particular premises.

tc.q: 哪一項紀錄存放責任適用於每名持牌人，不論其是否在特定處所經營？
options: 持牌人須維持本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方
持牌人須維持本地管理辦事處
持牌人須將紀錄存放於其主要業務處所
持牌人須向香港海關存放紀錄副本
tc.explain: 第11.1(f)段在持牌人的責任中列明持牌人須維持本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方，並無附加條件。第11.1(g)段的本地管理辦事處責任，則只適用於在無特定處所下經營的持牌人。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.1(b)及(c)段

en.q: Which two consent-related events are listed as grounds for revoking or suspending a licence?
options: Any occupant revoking written consent previously given for an authorized officer to enter for routine inspection, and any new occupant refusing to give such consent
The landlord withdrawing permission to use the premises, and the licensee's bank closing its account
The licensee withdrawing consent to inspection, and the CO resigning
A customer withdrawing consent to the retention of their records, and a staff member resigning
en.explain: Paragraphs 7.1(b) and (c) list as grounds where any occupant of the premises revokes his or her written consent previously given for any authorized officer to enter the premises for routine inspection, and where any new occupant of the premises refuses to give such a written consent — mirroring section 34(1)(b) of the AMLO.

tc.q: 哪兩項與同意有關的事件列為撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由？
options: 任何佔用人撤回其先前給予、讓獲授權人員進入處所進行例行視察的書面同意；以及任何新佔用人拒絕給予該書面同意
業主撤回使用處所的許可；以及持牌人的銀行結束其帳戶
持牌人撤回接受視察的同意；以及合規主任辭職
客戶撤回保存其紀錄的同意；以及員工辭職
tc.explain: 第7.1(b)及(c)段將下列情況列為理由：處所的任何佔用人撤回其先前給予、讓任何獲授權人員進入處所進行例行視察的書面同意；以及處所的任何新佔用人拒絕給予該書面同意——與《打擊洗錢條例》第34(1)(b)條相對應。

en.q: Who makes the application for approval, and who submits the fit and proper person declaration, when a new director, ultimate owner or partner is proposed?
options: The licensee makes the application in Form 4; the proposing person submits the fit and proper person declaration form
The proposing person does both
The licensee does both
The C&ED initiates the process on notification
en.explain: Paragraphs 8.1 to 8.3 each state that the licensee needs to make an application in Form 4 and that the proposing director, ultimate owner or partner needs to submit the fit and proper person declaration form — the same split of responsibility as under sections 35(1) to 37(1) of the AMLO, where the application is made by the licensee.

tc.q: 擬委任新董事、最終擁有人或合夥人時，由何人提出批准申請？由何人提交適當人選聲明？
options: 由持牌人以表格4提出申請；由該擬任人士提交適當人選聲明表格
兩者均由該擬任人士辦理
兩者均由持牌人辦理
由香港海關在接獲通知後展開程序
tc.explain: 第8.1至8.3段均訂明持牌人須以表格4提出申請，而該擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人須提交適當人選聲明表格——與《打擊洗錢條例》第35(1)至37(1)條的責任分工相同，即申請由持牌人提出。

en.q: Whose loss of fit and proper status is listed first among the grounds for revoking or suspending a licence?
options: The licensee, the individual, any partner, any director and any ultimate owner in relation to the licensee, after the grant of a licence
Only the sole proprietor or, for a corporation, the managing director
Only the ultimate owner
Only the compliance officer and money laundering reporting officer
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(a) lists as the first ground that the licensee, the individual, any partner, any director and any ultimate owner in relation to the licensee is no longer a fit and proper person to operate a money service or to be associated with the business of operating a money service after the grant of a licence.

tc.q: 在撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由中，何人喪失適當人選資格被列為首項？
options: 批出牌照後，與該持牌人有關的持牌人、個人、任何合夥人、任何董事及任何最終擁有人
只限獨資經營者；如屬法團，則只限董事總經理
只限最終擁有人
只限合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任
tc.explain: 第7.1(a)段將下述情況列為首項理由：在批出牌照後，與該持牌人有關的持牌人、個人、任何合夥人、任何董事及任何最終擁有人，不再是適合經營金錢服務或適合與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的適當人選。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶1.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第1.1段

en.q: What is the stated aim of implementing the Competence Assessment?
options: To ensure the senior management of a licensed MSO has fundamental knowledge and a clear understanding of AML/CFT to duly oversee all aspects of the AML/CFT systems
To standardise the qualifications of all money service industry staff
To replace the fit and proper person test
To generate revenue for the licensing regime
en.explain: Paragraph 1.1 states that the implementation of the Assessment aims at ensuring that the senior management of a licensed MSO has a fundamental knowledge and clear understanding of AML/CFT to duly oversee all aspects of the AML/CFT systems set out for operating the money service business, with a view to effectively mitigating ML/TF risks and complying with the statutory and regulatory requirements.

tc.q: 推行能力評核的訂明目的為何？
options: 確保持牌金錢服務經營者的高級管理層具備打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的基本知識及清晰理解，以妥善監督相關系統的各方面
統一金錢服務業所有員工的資格
取代適當人選測試
為發牌制度帶來收入
tc.explain: 第1.1段訂明推行評核旨在確保持牌金錢服務經營者的高級管理層具備打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的基本知識及清晰理解，以妥善監督為經營金錢服務業務而設的相關系統各方面，從而有效減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並遵從法定及監管規定。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶1.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第1.1段

en.q: Beyond the individual MSO, what wider purpose does the Guidance Notes say the Assessment serves?
options: Uplifting the compliance level of the MSO sector and safeguarding the integrity of the AML/CFT regime under the AMLO
Increasing competition among licensed MSOs
Reducing the number of licensed MSOs in Hong Kong
Aligning Hong Kong's regime with that of a particular overseas jurisdiction
en.explain: Paragraph 1.1 states that the Assessment is conducive to uplifting the compliance level of the MSO sector and safeguarding the integrity of the AML/CFT regime under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, Chapter 615.

tc.q: 除個別金錢服務經營者外，《須知》指出評核還具備甚麼更廣泛目的？
options: 提升金錢服務經營者業界的合規水平，並維護《打擊洗錢條例》下打擊洗錢制度的健全性
加劇持牌金錢服務經營者之間的競爭
減少香港持牌金錢服務經營者的數目
使香港制度與某一特定海外司法管轄區看齊
tc.explain: 第1.1段訂明評核有助提升金錢服務經營者業界的合規水平，並維護《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》（第615章）下打擊洗錢制度的健全性。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶3.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第3.1段

en.q: What weight does the Guidance Notes say the Assessment result carries in the licensing decision?
options: It constitutes a substantial weighting in the evaluation of the overall fit and proper person status and is one of the factors the CCE has regard to
It is determinative of the licensing decision on its own
It is taken into account only where other factors are evenly balanced
It carries no weight beyond confirming attendance
en.explain: Paragraph 3.1 states that the result of the Assessment will constitute a substantial weighting in the evaluation of the overall F&P person status and thus be one of the factors that the CCE will have regard to in considering the grant or renewal of an MSO licence, and that failure to attend or pass may result in refusal of the licence application.

tc.q: 《須知》指出評核結果在發牌決定中佔有甚麼分量？
options: 在評估整體適當人選資格時佔重要比重，並為海關關長須顧及的其中一項因素
本身即可決定發牌結果
只在其他因素旗鼓相當時方予考慮
除確認出席外並無分量
tc.explain: 第3.1段訂明評核結果在評估整體適當人選資格時佔重要比重，因而成為海關關長在考慮批出或續期金錢服務經營者牌照時須顧及的其中一項因素；牌照申請人／持牌人未有出席或未能通過評核，可能導致牌照申請被拒。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶3.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第3.1段

en.q: Which version of the Licensing Guide first provided that at least one member of senior management must pass the Assessment?
options: The updated version of March 2021
The original version of April 2012
The version of December 2019
The version of May 2026
en.explain: Paragraph 3.1 states that the Licensing Guide is promulgated by the CCE to set out the licensing requirements for an MSO licence under the AMLO, and that its updated version in March 2021 provides that at least one member of the senior management of a licence applicant or licensee must pass the Assessment.

tc.q: 哪一版本的《牌照指引》首次訂明至少一名高級管理層成員須通過能力評核？
options: 2021年3月的更新版本
2012年4月的原有版本
2019年12月的版本
2026年5月的版本
tc.explain: 第3.1段訂明《牌照指引》由海關關長頒布，以載述《打擊洗錢條例》下金錢服務經營者牌照的發牌規定；其2021年3月的更新版本訂明牌照申請人／持牌人的高級管理層中，至少一名成員須通過評核。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.1段

en.q: Which three criteria must an eligible person for the Assessment satisfy?
options: Being senior management overseeing the money service business, having direct involvement in deciding company policy and governance arrangements, and being held accountable in the compliance functions and systems
Holding a professional qualification, having five years' experience, and being a Hong Kong resident
Being a director, being a shareholder, and being resident at the business premises
Being nominated by the CCE, passing a preliminary test, and paying the assessment fee
en.explain: Paragraph 4.1 defines an eligible person as one who must be the senior management of the licence applicant or licensee in overseeing the operation of the money service business; has a direct involvement in making decisions on company policy and governance arrangements; and is held accountable in the compliance functions and systems of the company.

tc.q: 參加評核的合資格人士須符合哪三項準則？
options: 屬監督金錢服務業務營運的高級管理層、直接參與制定公司政策及管治安排的決策，以及就公司的合規職能及系統負責
持有專業資格、擁有五年經驗，並為香港居民
擔任董事、持有股份，並居於業務處所
由海關關長提名、通過預備測試，並繳付評核費用
tc.explain: 第4.1段界定合資格人士為：必須是牌照申請人／持牌人中監督金錢服務業務營運的高級管理層；直接參與制定公司政策及管治安排的決策；並就公司的合規職能及系統負責。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.2段

en.q: Where the MSO licence applicant or licensee is a partnership, how many partners may be nominated to participate in the Assessment?
options: Not more than three partners
Only one partner
All partners must participate
Any number, at the partnership's discretion
en.explain: Paragraph 4.2(i) defines senior management, where the applicant or licensee is a natural person, as the sole proprietor or the partners in the partnership, with not more than three partners able to be nominated to participate in the Assessment. The same limit of three applies to directors of a corporation under paragraph 4.2(ii).

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者牌照申請人／持牌人是合夥，可提名多少名合夥人參加評核？
options: 不多於三名合夥人
只限一名合夥人
所有合夥人均須參加
任何數目，由該合夥自行決定
tc.explain: 第4.2(i)段界定，如申請人／持牌人是自然人，高級管理層指獨資經營者或合夥的合夥人，而可獲提名參加評核的合夥人不多於三名。第4.2(ii)段就法團董事訂有相同的三名上限。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.3段

en.q: Because the Assessment is conducted on a company basis, what follows for candidates from the same company?
options: They must attend the same session of the Assessment in all circumstances
They may choose different sessions to spread the risk
They must attend on consecutive days
They must sit at adjacent desks
en.explain: Paragraph 4.3 states that, given the Assessment is conducted on a company basis, the candidates of the same company or corporation under an application or an MSO licence must attend the same session of the Assessment in all circumstances.

tc.q: 由於評核以公司為單位進行，同一公司的考生須怎樣做？
options: 在任何情況下均須出席同一場次的評核
可選擇不同場次以分散風險
須於連續數日出席
須坐於相鄰座位
tc.explain: 第4.3段訂明，由於評核以公司為單位進行，同一申請／金錢服務經營者牌照下同一公司／法團的考生，在任何情況下均須出席同一場次的評核。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.4
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.4段

en.q: In which three circumstances may a licence applicant or licensee nominate eligible persons to attend the Assessment?
options: When a new licence application is filed; within 90 days before licence expiry where no eligible person has passed; and upon notification of the deletion of the only eligible person who has passed
At any time the applicant or licensee chooses
Only when a new licence application is filed
Once every two years, regardless of circumstances
en.explain: Paragraph 4.4 states that nomination would be made only once and in the following circumstances: a new licence application is filed; within 90 days before the expiry of the licence where the licensee has no eligible person who has passed the Assessment; and upon notification by a licensee of the deletion of the only eligible person who has passed.

tc.q: 牌照申請人／持牌人可在哪三種情況下提名合資格人士參加評核？
