options: 提交新牌照申請時；在牌照屆滿前90日內而並無已通過評核的合資格人士時；以及通知刪除唯一已通過評核的合資格人士時
申請人／持牌人選擇的任何時間
只限提交新牌照申請時
每兩年一次，不論情況為何
tc.explain: 第4.4段訂明提名只會作出一次，並限於下列情況：提交新牌照申請時；在牌照屆滿前90日內而該持牌人並無已通過評核的合資格人士時；以及持牌人通知刪除唯一已通過評核的合資格人士時。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.5
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.5段

en.q: For the grant of a licence, within what period must the eligible persons attend the Assessment?
options: Within 30 days upon attending the interview with C&ED officers
Within 30 days of submitting the application
Within 90 days of the interview
Within 45 days of paying the application fee
en.explain: Paragraph 4.5 states that for granting an MSO licence, the eligible persons of the licence applicant shall attend the Assessment within 30 days upon attending the interview with the officers of the C&ED.

tc.q: 就批出牌照而言，合資格人士須於甚麼期限內參加評核？
options: 於出席與香港海關人員的面談後30日內
於提交申請後30日內
於面談後90日內
於繳付申請費用後45日內
tc.explain: 第4.5段訂明就批出金錢服務經營者牌照而言，牌照申請人的合資格人士須於出席與香港海關人員的面談後30日內參加評核。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.5
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.5段

en.q: If the eligible persons of a licence applicant fail the Assessment, when may they re-take it?
options: After 30 days upon notification of the result
Immediately, at the next available session
After 90 days upon notification of the result
Only at the next renewal cycle
en.explain: Paragraph 4.5 states that if the eligible persons of the applicant fail the Assessment, the applicant will be given another opportunity to arrange the eligible persons to re-take the Assessment after 30 days upon the notification of result, and that the licence application could be refused where the CCE considers the applicant not fit and proper.

tc.q: 如牌照申請人的合資格人士未能通過評核，何時可以重考？
options: 在獲通知結果後30日後
即時，在下一個可供的場次
在獲通知結果後90日後
只可在下一個續期周期
tc.explain: 第4.5段訂明如申請人的合資格人士未能通過評核，申請人會獲另一次機會，安排合資格人士在獲通知結果後30日後重考；如海關關長認為該申請人並非適合經營金錢服務業務的適當人選，有關牌照申請可被拒絕。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.6
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.6段

en.q: For renewing a licence, from what event does the 30-day period for attending the Assessment run?
options: The issue of the reminder letter, which is delivered to each licensee 90 days before the expiry of the licence
The submission of the renewal application
The interview with C&ED officers
The expiry of the existing licence
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 states that for renewing an MSO licence, the eligible persons of the licensee shall attend the Assessment within 30 days upon the issue of the reminder letter, which would be delivered to each licensee 90 days before the expiry of the licence.

tc.q: 就續期牌照而言，出席評核的30日期間自哪一事件起計？
options: 提示信發出之時；該信會在牌照屆滿前90日送達每名持牌人
提交續期申請之時
與香港海關人員面談之時
現有牌照屆滿之時
tc.explain: 第4.6段訂明就續期金錢服務經營者牌照而言，持牌人的合資格人士須於提示信發出後30日內參加評核；該提示信會在牌照屆滿前90日送達每名持牌人。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.6
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.6段

en.q: On a renewal, by when must any re-take of the Assessment occur?
options: After 30 days upon notification of the result and before the expiry of the licence
Within 30 days of the first attempt, whatever the expiry date
At any time within twelve months of the first attempt
Only after the licence has expired and a fresh application is made
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 states that if the eligible persons of the licensee fail, the licensee will be given another opportunity to arrange them to re-take the Assessment after 30 days upon notification of result and before the expiry of the licence, and that if all still fail before expiry the renewal application could be refused.

tc.q: 就續期而言，重考評核須於何時進行？
options: 在獲通知結果後30日後，並須在牌照屆滿之前
在首次應考後30日內，不論屆滿日期為何
在首次應考後十二個月內任何時間
只可在牌照屆滿並重新提出申請後
tc.explain: 第4.6段訂明如持牌人的合資格人士未能通過評核，持牌人會獲另一次機會，安排他們在獲通知結果後30日後、並在牌照屆滿之前重考；如所有合資格人士在牌照屆滿前仍未能通過，有關續期申請可被拒絕。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶5.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第5.1段

en.q: How many questions does the Assessment comprise, and how long is allowed?
options: 35 multiple-choice questions, to be completed in 1 hour and 15 minutes
40 multiple-choice questions in 2 hours
35 multiple-choice questions in 1 hour
50 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 states that the Assessment comprises 35 multiple-choice questions in Chinese or English, with only one correct answer for each question, and that candidates are required to complete the Assessment in 1 hour and 15 minutes.

tc.q: 評核由多少條題目組成？限時多久？
options: 35條多項選擇題，須於1小時15分鐘內完成
40條多項選擇題，限時2小時
35條多項選擇題，限時1小時
50條多項選擇題，限時90分鐘
tc.explain: 第5.1段訂明評核由35條中文或英文多項選擇題組成，每題只有一個正確答案；考生須於1小時15分鐘內完成評核。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶5.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第5.3段

en.q: What are the two requirements a candidate must satisfy to obtain a pass?
options: Not more than two mistakes in each module, and a total score of 25 or above for the entire paper
A total score of 25 or above only
Not more than five mistakes in total
A total score of 28 or above, with no module requirement
en.explain: Paragraph 5.3 states that to obtain a pass the candidate must not make more than two mistakes in each module and must attain a total score of 25 or above for the entire Assessment paper. Both conditions must be met.

tc.q: 考生須符合哪兩項要求方可取得及格？
options: 每個單元錯題不多於兩題，且全卷總分達25分或以上
只需全卷總分達25分或以上
總錯題不多於五題
總分達28分或以上，並無單元要求
tc.explain: 第5.3段訂明考生須在每個單元錯題不多於兩題，並在整份評核試卷取得25分或以上的總分，方可取得及格。兩項條件必須同時符合。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶5.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第5.2段

en.q: How is the Assessment structured across modules?
options: Seven modules, each consisting of five multiple-choice questions
Five modules of seven questions each
Seven modules of varying length
Three modules of approximately twelve questions each
en.explain: Paragraph 5.2 states that the Assessment is composed of seven modules and each module consists of five multiple-choice questions, and then lists the seven modules by name.

tc.q: 評核在單元方面如何編排？
options: 七個單元，每個單元五條多項選擇題
五個單元，每個單元七條題目
七個單元，長度不一
三個單元，每個約十二條題目
tc.explain: 第5.2段訂明評核由七個單元組成，每個單元包含五條多項選擇題，並隨後逐一列出七個單元的名稱。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶5.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第5.2段

en.q: Which of the following is one of the seven modules of the Assessment?
options: MSO's systems and controls (iii): demonstrating and monitoring compliance
The law of contract as it applies to money service
International sanctions law and practice
Accounting standards for money service operators
en.explain: Paragraph 5.2 lists the seven modules: general knowledge on AML/CFT and counter proliferation financing; Parts 1–7 of the AMLO; Schedules to the AMLO; guidelines promulgated by the C&ED; and MSO's systems and controls (i) institutional governance and strategy, (ii) AML/CFT control areas, and (iii) demonstrating and monitoring compliance.

tc.q: 下列何者屬評核七個單元之一？
options: 金錢服務經營者的系統及監控（三）：展示及監察合規情況
適用於金錢服務的合約法
國際制裁法律及實務
金錢服務經營者的會計準則
tc.explain: 第5.2段列出七個單元：打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的一般知識；《打擊洗錢條例》第1至7部；《打擊洗錢條例》附表；香港海關頒布的指引；以及金錢服務經營者的系統及監控（一）機構管治及策略、（二）打擊洗錢監控範疇、（三）展示及監察合規情況。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶6.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第6.1段

en.q: On which publicly available materials are the Assessment questions mainly based?
options: The AMLO; the AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs; the Licensing Guide; guidelines issued by the C&ED to MSOs; and circulars issued by the C&ED to MSOs
Textbooks published by professional bodies
The FATF Recommendations and mutual evaluation reports
Past examination papers released by the C&ED
en.explain: Paragraph 6.1 states that all the multiple-choice questions are set mainly based on five publicly available sources: the AMLO (Cap. 615); the Guideline on AML/CFT for MSOs promulgated by C&ED; the Licensing Guide issued by C&ED to MSOs; guidelines issued by C&ED to MSOs; and circulars issued by C&ED to MSOs.

tc.q: 評核題目主要根據哪些公開資料擬定？
options: 《打擊洗錢條例》；為金錢服務經營者發出的《打擊洗錢指引》；《牌照指引》；香港海關向金錢服務經營者發出的指引；以及香港海關向金錢服務經營者發出的通函
專業團體出版的教科書
財務行動特別組織的建議及相互評估報告
香港海關公開的歷屆試題
tc.explain: 第6.1段訂明所有多項選擇題主要根據五類公開資料擬定：《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》（第615章）；香港海關頒布的《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引（適用於金錢服務經營者）》；香港海關向金錢服務經營者發出的《牌照指引》；香港海關向金錢服務經營者發出的指引；以及香港海關向金錢服務經營者發出的通函。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.1段

en.q: How does the CCE characterise a pass in the Assessment?
options: As a company-based qualification, which is also one of the fit and proper person statuses to be associated with the business of operating a money service
As a personal qualification belonging to the individual candidate
As a licence in its own right
As a qualification valid for five years from the date of the result
en.explain: Paragraph 8.1 states that a pass in the Assessment is considered by the CCE to be a company-based qualification which is also one of the F&P person statuses to be associated with the business of operating a money service.

tc.q: 海關關長如何界定通過評核的性質？
options: 屬以公司為單位的資格，亦是與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的其中一項適當人選資格
屬個別考生的個人資格
本身即屬一種牌照
屬自結果日期起計五年內有效的資格
tc.explain: 第8.1段訂明海關關長視通過評核為以公司為單位的資格，該資格亦是與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的其中一項適當人選資格。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.2段

en.q: When does the validity of the company-based Assessment qualification become void automatically?
options: When the licensee no longer has at least one member of senior management — sole proprietor, partner or director — who passed the Assessment
Two years after the date of the result
When the licensee changes its business name
When the licensee opens additional business premises
en.explain: Paragraph 8.2 states that when the licensee no longer has at least one member of the senior management — that is, the sole proprietor, partner or director — who passed the Assessment, the validity of this company-based qualification will be void automatically.

tc.q: 以公司為單位的評核資格何時自動失效？
options: 當該持牌人不再有至少一名已通過評核的高級管理層成員（獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）
結果日期起計兩年後
當該持牌人更改業務名稱
當該持牌人開設額外業務處所
tc.explain: 第8.2段訂明，當持牌人不再有至少一名已通過評核的高級管理層成員（即獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）時，該以公司為單位的資格會自動失效。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.2段

en.q: Which type of licensee is NOT given a further opportunity to arrange eligible persons to sit the Assessment when the qualification becomes void?
options: A licensee belonging to a sole proprietorship
A licensee belonging to a partnership
A licensee that is a corporation
All licensees are given a further opportunity
en.explain: Paragraph 8.2 states that, except for the licensee belonging to sole proprietorship, a licensee belonging to partnership or corporation will be given an opportunity to arrange any eligible persons of its senior management to take the Assessment within 30 days upon notification to the C&ED of the change in partnership or directorship.

tc.q: 當該資格失效時，哪一類持牌人不獲另一次安排合資格人士應考的機會？
options: 屬獨資經營的持牌人
屬合夥的持牌人
屬法團的持牌人
所有持牌人均獲另一次機會
tc.explain: 第8.2段訂明，除屬獨資經營的持牌人外，屬合夥及法團的持牌人會獲機會，於向香港海關通知合夥或董事變動後30日內，安排其高級管理層的任何合資格人士參加評核。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.2段

en.q: Which arrangement applies where a licensee whose qualification has become void is due for renewal within 180 days?
options: The Assessment arrangement will follow paragraph 4.6, relating to the renewal of a licence
The licence is suspended pending a fresh Assessment
The licensee must submit a fresh licence application
The 30-day period is extended to 90 days
en.explain: Paragraph 8.2 states that for licensees that are due for renewal within 180 days, the Assessment arrangement will follow paragraph 4.6 — the renewal timetable running from the issue of the reminder letter 90 days before expiry.

tc.q: 如資格已失效的持牌人須於180日內續期，適用甚麼安排？
options: 評核安排會依照第4.6段（關乎牌照續期）辦理
牌照暫時吊銷，直至重新完成評核
該持牌人須重新提出牌照申請
該30日期間延長至90日
tc.explain: 第8.2段訂明，就須於180日內續期的持牌人而言，評核安排會依照第4.6段辦理——即自牌照屆滿前90日發出提示信起計的續期時間表。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.3段

en.q: May the CCE allow a licensee to continue its money service business where none of its eligible persons has passed the Assessment?
options: Yes — having considered the merits of each case, the CCE may exercise discretion to do so, imposing licensing conditions deemed appropriate and necessary
No — the licence must be revoked in every such case
Yes, but only for a maximum of 30 days
Yes, but only where the licensee is a sole proprietorship
en.explain: Paragraph 8.3 states that, having considered the merits of each case, the CCE may exercise discretion to allow the licensee to continue its money service business when none of its eligible persons passed the Assessment, and in granting the exemption will impose relevant licensing conditions deemed appropriate and necessary to ensure the licensee has the capability to operate with effective AML/CFT systems.

tc.q: 如持牌人並無合資格人士通過評核，海關關長可否准許其繼續經營金錢服務業務？
options: 可以——關長在考慮每宗個案的具體情況後，可行使酌情權准許，並施加其認為恰當及必需的發牌條件
不可以——在該等情況下必須撤銷牌照
可以，但最長只限30日
可以，但只限屬獨資經營的持牌人
tc.explain: 第8.3段訂明海關關長在考慮每宗個案的具體情況後，可行使酌情權，在持牌人並無合資格人士通過評核時准許其繼續經營金錢服務業務；關長在給予豁免時，會施加其認為恰當及必需的相關發牌條件，以確保該持牌人有能力以有效的打擊洗錢系統經營業務。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶9.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第9.1段

en.q: Which documents must a candidate present for inspection when attending the Assessment?
options: A Hong Kong Identity Card or alternative identification document with photo, an authorization letter (for partnerships and corporations only), and the Assessment invitation letter
Only the invitation letter
Only a Hong Kong Identity Card
The licence and the Business Registration Certificate
en.explain: Paragraph 9.1 requires candidates to present a Hong Kong Identity Card or an alternative identification document with photo such as a valid travel document; an authorization letter, only for a partnership company and corporation; and the Assessment invitation letter. Paragraph 9.2 states that a candidate unable to present these will not be allowed to attend.

tc.q: 考生出席評核時須出示哪些文件以供查驗？
options: 香港身分證或附有相片的替代身分證明文件、授權書（只限合夥公司及法團），以及評核邀請信
只需邀請信
只需香港身分證
牌照及商業登記證
tc.explain: 第9.1段規定考生須出示香港身分證或附有相片的替代身分證明文件（例如有效旅行證件）；授權書（只限合夥公司及法團）；以及評核邀請信。第9.2段訂明未能出示上述文件的考生不獲准出席評核。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶9.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第9.3段

en.q: What does the Guidance Notes say about damaged or defaced identification documents?
options: The candidate may not be allowed to attend, and candidates are recommended to inspect their documents carefully before the Assessment
A photocopy will be accepted instead
The candidate may attend but must produce a replacement within seven days
The invigilator may verify identity by other means
en.explain: Paragraph 9.3 states that if the identification document presented by a candidate is damaged or defaced, the candidate may not be allowed to attend the Assessment, and candidates are therefore recommended to carefully inspect their identification documents before the Assessment.

tc.q: 《須知》就損毀或污損的身分證明文件有何說明？
options: 該考生可能不獲准出席，故建議考生在評核前小心檢查其身分證明文件
可改為接受影印本
該考生可出席，但須於七日內補交替代文件
監考員可以其他方式核實身分
tc.explain: 第9.3段訂明，如考生出示的身分證明文件已損毀或污損，該考生可能不獲准出席評核；因此建議考生在評核前小心檢查其身分證明文件。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第10.1段

en.q: What is the consequence of violating the rules or acting dishonestly during the Assessment?
options: The candidate is liable to be disqualified and may be requested to leave the Assessment centre immediately
The candidate receives a written warning and may continue
The candidate's score is reduced by five marks
The candidate must re-sit at the next available session
en.explain: Paragraph 10.1 states that candidates must follow the rules in the Guidance Notes and the instructions of the invigilators, and that anyone who violates the rules or acts dishonestly in any way during the Assessment is liable to be disqualified and may also be requested to leave the Assessment centre immediately.

tc.q: 在評核期間違反規則或以任何方式作出不誠實行為，有何後果？
options: 該考生可被取消資格，並可能被要求即時離開評核中心
該考生會收到書面警告並可繼續應考
該考生的分數會被扣減五分
該考生須於下一個可供場次重考
tc.explain: 第10.1段訂明考生必須遵守《須知》所載規則及監考員的指示；任何人在評核期間違反規則或以任何方式作出不誠實行為，均可被取消資格，並可能被要求即時離開評核中心。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第10.2段

en.q: What is the position on requests to change the Assessment date, time or centre, and on late arrival?
options: Requests for change will not be considered, and once the Assessment has started a candidate will not be allowed to enter the premises
Requests for change are considered on payment of a fee
Late arrivals are admitted within the first fifteen minutes
Changes are permitted once per candidate
en.explain: Paragraph 10.2 states that candidates must take the Assessment at the time and place specified in the invitation letter, that any request for change of Assessment date, time or centre will not be considered, and that once the Assessment has started a candidate will not be allowed to enter the premises to take it.

tc.q: 就更改評核日期、時間或中心的要求，以及遲到，有何規定？
options: 更改要求不獲考慮；評核一經開始，考生不獲准進入該處所
繳付費用後可考慮更改要求
遲到考生可於首十五分鐘內入場
每名考生可更改一次
tc.explain: 第10.2段訂明考生必須在邀請信指明的時間及地點應考；任何更改評核日期／時間／中心的要求均不獲考慮；評核一經開始，考生不獲准進入該處所應考。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.6
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第10.6段

en.q: What are candidates strictly forbidden to do in relation to the question book and answer sheet?
options: To take away any question book or answer sheet, whether used or unused, out of the Assessment centre
To write on the question book
To read the question book before the Assessment starts
To return the answer sheet before the time expires
en.explain: Paragraph 10.6 states that candidates must not leave the Assessment centre without permission, that early leavers must ensure their answer scripts and related materials have been collected by the invigilator on the spot, and that candidates are strictly forbidden to take away any question book or answer sheet, whether used or unused, out of the Assessment centre.

tc.q: 就試題冊及答題紙，考生被嚴格禁止作出甚麼？
options: 將任何試題冊或答題紙（不論已用或未用）攜離評核中心
在試題冊上書寫
在評核開始前閱讀試題冊
在時限屆滿前交回答題紙
tc.explain: 第10.6段訂明考生未經監考員准許不得離開評核中心；提早離場者須確保答題紙及相關材料已由監考員即場收回；並嚴禁考生將任何試題冊或答題紙（不論已用或未用）攜離評核中心。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.7
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第10.7段

en.q: What must a candidate do with a mobile phone during the Assessment?
options: Place it under the chair, uncovered and clearly visible to the invigilators, and switched off
Hand it to the invigilator at the entrance
Leave it outside the Assessment centre
Keep it switched to silent mode in a pocket
en.explain: Paragraph 10.7 requires all personal belongings, including electronic devices, to be put under the candidate's chair; states that mobile phones must not be covered by anything and should be clearly seen by the invigilators; and requires mobile phones and other devices that can emit sound to be switched off throughout the examination.

tc.q: 考生在評核期間須如何處理流動電話？
options: 放於座椅下，不得遮蓋，並須讓監考員清楚看見，且須關掉
於入口交予監考員
留在評核中心外
調校至靜音模式並放於口袋內
tc.explain: 第10.7段規定所有個人物品（包括電子裝置）須放於考生座椅下；流動電話不得被任何物件遮蓋，並應讓監考員清楚看見；流動電話及其他可發出聲響的裝置在整個考試期間必須關掉。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.9
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第10.9段

en.q: Where must a candidate mark answers, and what is the consequence of marking them elsewhere?
options: On the multiple-choice answer sheet provided; answers not written on that sheet will not be marked
On the question book, which is collected and marked
On either the question book or the answer sheet, at the candidate's choice
On the invitation letter, which is collected with the script
en.explain: Paragraph 10.9 states that candidates must mark the answers on the multiple-choice answer sheet provided, that answers not written on the answer sheet will not be marked, and that candidates must not copy anything from the question book onto the invitation letter, personal belongings or parts of their body.

tc.q: 考生須在何處填寫答案？在其他地方填寫有何後果？
options: 須在所提供的多項選擇答題紙上填寫；並非寫在該答題紙上的答案不予評分
在試題冊上填寫，該試題冊會被收回評分
可由考生自行選擇寫在試題冊或答題紙上
在邀請信上填寫，該信會連同答卷一併收回
tc.explain: 第10.9段訂明考生必須在所提供的多項選擇答題紙上填寫答案；並非寫在答題紙上的答案不予評分；考生亦不得將試題冊上的任何內容抄寫到邀請信、個人物品或身體任何部位上。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶11.5
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第11.5段

en.q: What happens if a candidate marks two or more answers to the same question?
options: No marks will be scored for that question
The first answer marked is taken
The question is treated as unanswered but does not count against the module limit
Half a mark is awarded
en.explain: Paragraph 11.5 states that a candidate will score no marks for marking two or more answers to the same question. Paragraph 11.4 requires wrong answers to be erased thoroughly and the answer sheet not to be folded.

tc.q: 如考生就同一題填寫兩個或以上的答案，會有甚麼後果？
options: 該題不獲任何分數
以最先填寫的答案為準
該題視為未作答，但不計入單元錯題上限
獲給予半分
tc.explain: 第11.5段訂明考生就同一題填寫兩個或以上的答案，該題不獲任何分數。第11.4段規定須徹底擦去錯誤答案，並不得摺疊答題紙。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶11.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第11.2段

en.q: Which particulars must a candidate write on the multiple-choice answer sheet before starting the questions?
options: Name of company, application number, name of candidate, status of candidate, date of Assessment and signature
Only the candidate's name and signature
Only the application number and the date
The candidate's identity card number and residential address
en.explain: Paragraph 11.2 requires the candidate to write on the answer sheet the name of the company in block letters, the application number from the invitation letter, the candidate's full name in block letters, the candidate's position in the company, the date of the Assessment, and the candidate's signature.

tc.q: 考生在作答前須在多項選擇答題紙上填寫哪些個人資料？
options: 公司名稱、申請編號、考生姓名、考生職位、評核日期及簽署
只需考生姓名及簽署
只需申請編號及日期
考生的身分證號碼及住址
tc.explain: 第11.2段規定考生須在答題紙上以正楷填寫公司全名、邀請信上所示的申請編號、以正楷填寫考生全名、其在公司的職位、應考評核的日期，以及考生簽署。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶12.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第12.1段

en.q: How and within what period are candidates notified of the Assessment result?
options: By e-mail only, within 14 days after the Assessment
By post, within 30 days after the Assessment
By telephone, within 7 days after the Assessment
In person at the Assessment centre on the day
en.explain: Paragraph 12.1 states that candidates will only be notified of the results — that is, PASS or FAIL — by e-mail only, within 14 days after the Assessment, and that the notification should be kept as a certification of the result.

tc.q: 考生會以何種方式及在多久內獲通知評核結果？
options: 只以電郵通知，並於評核後14日內
以郵遞方式，於評核後30日內
以電話通知，於評核後7日內
於評核當日在評核中心即場通知
tc.explain: 第12.1段訂明考生只會以電郵獲通知結果（即及格或不及格），並於評核後14日內通知；該通知應保留作為評核結果的證明。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶12.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第12.2段

en.q: Within what period may a candidate dissatisfied with the result request a re-checking, and what happens to late requests?
options: Within seven days after the date of issuance of the result notification; late submissions will not be considered
Within 14 days; late requests are considered on payment of a fee
Within 30 days; late requests are considered at the CCE's discretion
There is no time limit for requesting a re-checking
en.explain: Paragraph 12.2 states that candidates not satisfied with their results may, within seven days after the date of issuance of the result notification, write to the Licensing Control Division or e-mail the enquiry address for re-checking, and that late submission will not be considered.

tc.q: 對結果不滿的考生可於多久內要求覆核？逾期提出的要求會如何處理？
options: 於結果通知發出日期後七日內；逾期提交的要求不獲考慮
14日內；逾期要求繳費後可獲考慮
30日內；逾期要求由海關關長酌情考慮
要求覆核並無時限
tc.explain: 第12.2段訂明對評核結果不滿的考生，可於結果通知發出日期後七日內，致函牌照及事務管理科或以電郵向查詢電郵地址要求覆核；逾期提交者不獲考慮。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶12.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第12.3段

en.q: What does the re-checking of an answer sheet involve, and within what period is the result sent?
options: Re-checking the candidate's answers for technical errors such as incorrect mark entries and data inconsistencies, with the result sent in writing within 14 days of receipt of the request
A full re-marking by a different examiner, with the result sent within 30 days
A review of the question paper for errors, with the result sent within 7 days
An interview with the candidate, followed by a written decision within one month
en.explain: Paragraph 12.3 states that the C&ED will re-check the candidate's answers on the answer sheet and send the result in writing within 14 days after receipt of the re-checking request, and that the answer sheet will be re-checked for technical errors such as incorrect mark entries and data inconsistencies.

tc.q: 覆核答題紙涉及甚麼？結果會於多久內發出？
options: 就填錯答案格及數據不一致等技術錯誤覆核考生的答案，並於接獲覆核要求後14日內以書面發出結果
由另一名評卷員全面重新評卷，並於30日內發出結果
檢查試卷是否有錯誤，並於7日內發出結果
與考生面談，其後於一個月內作出書面決定
tc.explain: 第12.3段訂明香港海關會覆核考生在答題紙上的答案，並於接獲覆核要求後14日內以書面將結果送交有關考生；答題紙的覆核只針對技術錯誤，例如填錯答案格及數據不一致。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶12.4
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第12.4段

en.q: What does the C&ED say about disclosing exact scores, questions and correct answers?
options: The result of the re-checking is final, and the C&ED will not disclose the exact scores, the Assessment questions or the corresponding correct answers in any case
Exact scores are disclosed on request after re-checking
Questions and answers are published annually
Scores are disclosed but questions are not
en.explain: Paragraph 12.4 states that the result of the re-checking is final and that the C&ED will not disclose the exact scores, the Assessment questions and the corresponding correct answers in any case.

tc.q: 香港海關就披露確實分數、試題及正確答案有何說明？
options: 覆核結果為最終決定；香港海關在任何情況下均不會披露確實分數、評核試題及相應的正確答案
覆核後可應要求披露確實分數
試題及答案每年公開
會披露分數，但不會披露試題
tc.explain: 第12.4段訂明覆核結果為最終決定；香港海關在任何情況下均不會披露確實分數、評核試題及相應的正確答案。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶12.5
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第12.5段

en.q: What does the Guidance Notes emphasise about the relationship between passing the Assessment and obtaining a licence?
options: A pass does not necessarily mean the candidate is eligible for a licence; applicants must also meet the licensing requirements in the AMLO and the Licensing Guide
A pass guarantees the grant of a licence
A pass exempts the applicant from the fit and proper person test
A pass entitles the applicant to a provisional licence
en.explain: Paragraph 12.5 is marked VERY IMPORTANT and states that a pass in the Assessment does not necessarily mean the candidate is eligible for a licence, because for granting a licence applicants are also required to meet the licensing requirements stipulated in the AMLO and the licensing guide promulgated by the C&ED.

tc.q: 《須知》就通過評核與取得牌照的關係強調甚麼？
options: 通過評核並不必然表示該考生符合取得牌照的資格；申請人亦須符合《打擊洗錢條例》及《牌照指引》所訂的發牌規定
通過評核即保證獲批牌照
通過評核可豁免適當人選測試
通過評核可獲發臨時牌照
tc.explain: 第12.5段標明「非常重要」，訂明通過評核並不必然表示該考生符合取得牌照的資格；因為就批出牌照而言，申請人亦須符合《打擊洗錢條例》及香港海關頒布的《牌照指引》所訂明的發牌規定。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶13.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第13.1段

en.q: Under which severe weather conditions will the Assessment be suspended?
options: Where typhoon signal No. 8 or above, and/or the black rainstorm warning, is still hoisted at or after 8:00 a.m. on the scheduled date
Where typhoon signal No. 3 is hoisted at any time on the scheduled date
Where the amber rainstorm warning is issued
Where any typhoon signal is hoisted the evening before
en.explain: Paragraph 13.1 states that as a general rule the Assessment will be held as scheduled when typhoon signal No. 3 or lower, and/or rainstorm signal amber or red, is issued, but that if typhoon signal No. 8 or above and/or the black rainstorm warning is still hoisted at or after 8:00 a.m. on the scheduled date, the Assessment will be suspended.

tc.q: 在哪種惡劣天氣情況下評核會暫停？
options: 在原定日期上午8時或之後，8號或以上颱風信號及／或黑色暴雨警告仍然生效
原定日期任何時間懸掛3號颱風信號
發出黃色暴雨警告
前一晚懸掛任何颱風信號
tc.explain: 第13.1段訂明一般而言，如發出3號或以下颱風信號及／或黃色或紅色暴雨警告信號，評核會如期舉行；但如在原定日期上午8時或之後，8號或以上颱風信號及／或黑色暴雨警告仍然生效，評核會暫停。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶14.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第14.1段

en.q: What does the Guidance Notes say about the significance of receiving an invitation to the Assessment?
options: It does not imply that a candidate has fully met the licensing requirements, as the vetting process is still in progress
It confirms that the applicant has satisfied the fit and proper test
It guarantees an interview with C&ED officers
It confirms that the premises have been approved
en.explain: Paragraph 14.1 states that the invitation to the Assessment does not imply that a candidate has fully met the licensing requirements as the vetting process is still in progress, and that applicants or licensees who do not meet the licensing requirements will not be further considered irrespective of their Assessment results.

tc.q: 《須知》就獲邀參加評核的意義有何說明？
options: 並不表示該考生已完全符合發牌規定，因審核程序仍在進行中
確認該申請人已通過適當人選測試
保證可與香港海關人員面談
確認其處所已獲批准
tc.explain: 第14.1段訂明獲邀參加評核並不表示考生已完全符合發牌規定，因審核程序仍在進行中；不符合發牌規定的申請人／持牌人，不論其評核結果如何，均不會獲進一步考慮。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶14.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第14.3段

en.q: What arrangement is available for candidates with disabilities?
options: Candidates may contact the C&ED for enquiries, and the C&ED may require medical proof to confirm the disability in order to make suitable arrangements
No special arrangements are available
Arrangements are made automatically on the basis of the application form
Candidates must apply to the Review Tribunal for accommodations
en.explain: Paragraph 14.3 states that as regards facilitating arrangements available for persons with disabilities, candidates may contact the C&ED for enquiries, and that the C&ED may require, as appropriate, candidates to produce medical proof to confirm their disabilities in order to make suitable arrangements.

tc.q: 殘疾考生可獲甚麼安排？
options: 考生可致電香港海關查詢；海關可視情況要求考生提交醫學證明以確認其殘疾，以便作出合適安排
並無特別安排
按申請表格自動作出安排
考生須向審裁處申請便利安排
tc.explain: 第14.3段訂明就殘疾人士可獲的便利安排，考生可致電香港海關查詢；香港海關可視乎情況要求考生提交醫學證明以確認其殘疾，以便作出合適安排。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶2.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第2.2段

en.q: Which fitness-and-propriety criterion does the Guidance Notes quote as the link between the F&P Guidelines and the Assessment?
options: Whether the person is equipped with the skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism necessary to perform the business's functions efficiently and effectively
Whether the person has adequate financial resources
Whether the person has been convicted of a specified offence
Whether the person maintains a local place for storage of books and records
en.explain: Paragraph 2.2 quotes from the F&P Guidelines the criterion of whether the person is equipped with the skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism necessary to perform the business's functions efficiently and effectively, noting the example of a person who did not take or failed to pass the relevant test conducted by the C&ED.

tc.q: 《須知》引述哪一項適當人選準則，作為適當人選指引與評核之間的連繫？
options: 該人是否具備有效率及有效地履行業務職能所需的技能、知識、經驗及專業水平
該人是否具備足夠財政資源
該人有否被裁定犯指明罪行
該人有否維持本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方
tc.explain: 第2.2段引述適當人選指引中的準則：該人是否具備有效率及有效地履行業務職能所需的技能、知識、經驗及專業水平；並舉出未有參加或未能通過香港海關進行的有關測試的人為例。

en.q: Where may a member of the public inspect the Register of Licensees?
options: At the office of the C&ED at Units 402-403, 4/F, Centre Parc, 11 Sheung Yuet Road, Kowloon Bay, and through the C&ED's MSOS eServices website
Only at the Companies Registry
Only by written application to the Commissioner
Only at the premises of each licensee
en.explain: Paragraph 12.2 states that the register is available for inspection by members of the public at the office of the C&ED at Units 402-403, 4/F, Centre Parc, 11 Sheung Yuet Road, Kowloon Bay, Kowloon, and is accessible through the C&ED's website at the MSOS eServices address.

tc.q: 公眾人士可在何處查閱持牌人登記冊？
options: 九龍灣常悅道11號企業廣場4樓402-403室香港海關辦事處，以及透過香港海關的金錢服務經營者牌照系統網站
只可在公司註冊處
只可以書面向海關關長申請
只可在每名持牌人的處所
tc.explain: 第12.2段訂明登記冊可供公眾人士在九龍灣常悅道11號企業廣場4樓402-403室香港海關辦事處查閱，亦可透過香港海關的金錢服務經營者牌照系統網站查閱。

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide distinguish the two disciplinary regimes it describes?
options: Section 21(2) applies where a financial institution contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11); section 43(2) applies where an MSO licensee commits an act referred to in section 43(1)
Section 21(2) applies to individuals and section 43(2) to corporations
Section 21(2) applies to first offences and section 43(2) to repeat offences
The two regimes are alternatives at the CCE's election
en.explain: Paragraph 13.1 sets out the section 21(2) powers, which arise where a financial institution contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11), and separately the section 43(2) powers, which arise where an MSO licensee commits an act referred to in section 43(1).

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何區分其所述的兩套紀律制度？
options: 第21(2)條適用於金融機構違反第5(11)條所界定的指明條文；第43(2)條則適用於金錢服務經營者持牌人作出第43(1)條所述的作為
第21(2)條適用於個人，第43(2)條適用於法團
第21(2)條適用於初犯，第43(2)條適用於再犯
兩套制度由海關關長選擇適用其一
tc.explain: 第13.1段列出第21(2)條的權力（於金融機構違反第5(11)條所界定的指明條文時產生），以及另行列出第43(2)條的權力（於金錢服務經營者持牌人作出第43(1)條所述的作為時產生）。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第XIV節費用表

en.q: How does the fee for each additional business premises differ between a grant application and a renewal application?
options: $2,440 on a grant application, and $410 on a renewal application
$2,440 in both cases
$410 in both cases
$945 on a grant and $2,440 on a renewal
en.explain: The Licensing Guide's fee schedule, matching Schedule 3 as amended from 15 May 2026, charges $2,440 for each additional business premises on an application for the grant of a licence, and $410 for each additional business premises on an application for renewal.

tc.q: 每個額外業務處所的費用，在批出申請與續期申請之間有何不同？
options: 批出申請為2,440元，續期申請為410元
兩者均為2,440元
兩者均為410元
批出為945元，續期為2,440元
tc.explain: 《牌照指引》的費用表（與自2026年5月15日起修訂的附表3一致）訂明：批出牌照的申請就每個額外業務處所收取2,440元；續期申請就每個額外業務處所則收取410元。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第XIV節費用表

en.q: How is the fit and proper person test fee charged on both grant and renewal applications?
options: $945 for each person who is subject to the fit and proper person test, on both types of application
$945 per application, whatever the number of persons
$945 on a grant and $410 on a renewal
It is charged only on a grant application
en.explain: The fee schedule charges $945 for each person who is subject to the fit and proper person test, and that figure applies identically to an application for the grant and for the renewal of a licence — unlike the base fee and the additional-premises fee, which differ between the two.

tc.q: 適當人選測試費用在批出及續期申請中如何收取？
options: 兩類申請均就每名須接受適當人選測試的人收取945元
每份申請945元，不論人數多少
批出為945元，續期為410元
只在批出申請時收取
tc.explain: 費用表就每名須接受適當人選測試的人收取945元；該數額在批出及續期牌照的申請中相同——有別於基本費用及額外處所費用，該兩項在兩類申請中並不相同。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）

en.q: How many fees under the MSO licensing regime were revised by the Notice gazetted on 13 March 2026?
en.explain: The circular of 13 March 2026 states that the government gazetted the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Amendment of Schedule 3) Notice 2026 to revise 12 fees under the licensing regime for Money Service Operators Licence, with the new fees taking effect on 15 May.

tc.q: 2026年3月13日刊憲的公告修訂了金錢服務經營者發牌制度下多少項費用？
options: 7項
5項
tc.explain: 2026年3月13日的通函訂明政府當日刊憲頒布《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例（修訂附表3）公告2026》，修訂金錢服務經營者牌照發牌制度下的12項費用，新費用於5月15日生效。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）

en.q: On what policy principle does the C&ED say government fees should generally be set?
options: The user-pays principle, so that fees are set at levels adequate to recover the full cost of the public services provided
The ability-to-pay principle, so that fees vary with the size of the licensee
A flat-rate principle, so that all licensees pay the same
A cost-plus principle, so that fees generate a surplus for the Government
en.explain: The circular states that in line with the user-pays principle, it is the Government's policy that fees charged by the Government should in general be set at levels adequate to recover the full cost of the public services provided.

tc.q: 香港海關指出政府費用一般應按甚麼政策原則釐定？
options: 用者自付原則，使費用水平足以收回所提供公共服務的全部成本
按負擔能力原則，使費用隨持牌人規模而異
劃一收費原則，使所有持牌人繳付相同費用
成本加成原則，使費用為政府帶來盈餘
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，按照用者自付原則，政府的政策是政府所收取的費用一般應訂於足以收回所提供公共服務全部成本的水平。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）

en.q: What commitment does Hong Kong Customs give alongside the fee revision?
options: To continue to enhance efficiency and streamline procedures so as to contain the costs of providing the services
To freeze fees for the following five years
To refund the difference to licensees who paid the old fees
To review the fees again within twelve months
en.explain: The circular states that Hong Kong Customs will continue to enhance efficiency and streamline procedures so as to contain the costs of providing the services, immediately after setting out the user-pays rationale for the revision.

tc.q: 香港海關在調整費用的同時作出甚麼承諾？
options: 繼續提升效率及簡化程序，以控制提供服務的成本
於其後五年凍結費用
向已繳付舊費用的持牌人退還差額
於十二個月內再次檢討費用
tc.explain: 該通函在闡述調整費用的用者自付理據後，隨即訂明香港海關會繼續提升效率及簡化程序，以控制提供服務的成本。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_03/2026（2026年5月15日）

en.q: What did the circular of 15 May 2026 tell MSOs about the revised Licensing Guide?
options: The revised Licensing Guide comes into immediate effect and applies to an applicant for grant or renewal of an MSO licence or a licensee, as the case may be
The revised Licensing Guide takes effect three months later
The revised Licensing Guide applies only to new applicants
The revised Licensing Guide is a consultation draft
en.explain: The circular of 15 May 2026 states that the new fees under the licensing regime came into effect on 15 May 2026, that the revised Licensing Guide comes into immediate effect, and that it applies to an applicant for grant or renewal of an MSO licence or a licensee as the case may be.

tc.q: 2026年5月15日的通函就經修訂的《牌照指引》向金錢服務經營者說明甚麼？
options: 經修訂的《牌照指引》即時生效，並適用於申請批出或續期金錢服務經營者牌照的人或持牌人（視屬何情況）
經修訂的《牌照指引》於三個月後生效
經修訂的《牌照指引》只適用於新申請人
經修訂的《牌照指引》屬諮詢文件草稿
tc.explain: 2026年5月15日的通函訂明金錢服務經營者發牌制度下的新費用已於2026年5月15日生效；經修訂的《牌照指引》即時生效，並適用於申請批出或續期金錢服務經營者牌照的人或持牌人（視屬何情況）。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）——費用表

en.q: By how much did the fee for an application for the grant of a licence rise on 15 May 2026?
options: From $860 to $945
From $790 to $910
en.explain: The circular's fee table shows the application for the grant of a licence rising from $3,310 to $3,810. The other figures listed are the additional business premises fee on a grant ($2,220 to $2,440), the fit and proper person test fee ($860 to $945) and the renewal fee ($790 to $910).

tc.q: 批出牌照申請的費用於2026年5月15日調升了多少？
options: 由860元增至945元
由790元增至910元
tc.explain: 該通函的費用表顯示批出牌照的申請費由3,310元增至3,810元。其他所列數字為批出時的額外業務處所費用（2,220元增至2,440元）、適當人選測試費用（860元增至945元）及續期費用（790元增至910元）。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）——費用表

en.q: How did the fee for providing an uncertified copy of an entry in, or extract from, the register change?
options: From $1 per page or portion of a page to $1.5 per page or portion of a page
From $160 per copy to $180 per copy
From $1.5 to $2 per page
It was unchanged
en.explain: The circular's fee table shows the fee for providing an uncertified copy of an entry in, or extract from, the register rising from $1 per page or portion of a page to $1.5 per page or portion of a page — the smallest of the twelve revised fees.

tc.q: 提供登記冊記項或摘錄的未經核證副本的費用有何變動？
options: 由每頁或每部分頁1元增至每頁或每部分頁1.5元
由每份160元增至每份180元
由每頁1.5元增至2元
並無變動
tc.explain: 該通函的費用表顯示，提供登記冊記項或摘錄未經核證副本的費用，由每頁或每部分頁1元增至每頁或每部分頁1.5元——是十二項經修訂費用中最小的一項。

en.q: How must supporting documents be presented when submitted with a licence application?
options: Stamped with the applicant's company chop, together with the completed application form, annex and supplementary information sheet
Certified as true copies by a solicitor
Notarised and translated into English
Bound and paginated in a single volume
en.explain: Paragraph 16.1 states that to facilitate the application for grant and renewal of an MSO licence, the applicant is required to submit the listed documents stamped with the applicant's company chop, together with the completed application form — Form 1 or 2 — the annex and the supplementary information sheet.

tc.q: 隨牌照申請提交的證明文件須如何呈交？
options: 加蓋申請人的公司印章，並連同填妥的申請表格、附件及補充資料表一併提交
由律師核證為真確副本
經公證並翻譯成英文
裝訂成單一冊並編上頁碼
tc.explain: 第16.1段訂明，為便利批出及續期金錢服務經營者牌照的申請，申請人須提交加蓋申請人公司印章的所列文件，連同填妥的申請表格（表格1或2）、附件及補充資料表。

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide describe its checklist of supporting documents?
options: Not exhaustive — the C&ED may require other supporting documents to determine the applicant's fitness and propriety and the suitability of the premises
Exhaustive, so that no further documents may be required
Applicable only to first-time applicants
Applicable only where the applicant is a corporation
en.explain: Paragraph 16.2 states that the list is not exhaustive, and that with a view to determining the fitness and propriety of the applicant and the suitability of the premises in accordance with the licensing requirements, the C&ED may require the applicant to produce other supporting documents in processing the application.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何描述其證明文件核對表？
options: 並非詳盡無遺——香港海關可要求提交其他證明文件，以斷定申請人的適當人選資格及處所的適合性
屬詳盡無遺，故不可再要求其他文件
只適用於首次申請人
只適用於申請人是法團的情況
tc.explain: 第16.2段訂明該清單並非詳盡無遺；為按發牌規定斷定申請人的適當人選資格及處所的適合性，香港海關在處理申請時可要求申請人提交其他證明文件。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第XVI節核對表

en.q: Which supporting document is listed in relation to each premises?
options: A floor plan of the premises
A valuation report for the premises
A fire safety certificate
A photograph of the landlord's identity card
en.explain: The checklist in Section XVI lists, under supporting documents of particulars of each premises, a floor plan of the premises, alongside documents such as a valid Business Registration Certificate. Photographs of the inner and outer parts are required separately under paragraphs 5.1 and 6.3.

tc.q: 就每個處所，核對表列出哪一項證明文件？
options: 該處所的樓面平面圖
該處所的估值報告
消防安全證明書
業主身分證的照片
tc.explain: 第XVI節核對表在「每個處所詳情的證明文件」項下列出該處所的樓面平面圖，以及有效商業登記證等文件。內部及外部照片則按第5.1及6.3段另行規定提交。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第XVI節核對表

en.q: Which documents are listed for a corporate applicant that are not required for a partnership?
options: A copy of the Certificate of Incorporation and a copy of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
A copy of the valid Business Registration Certificate
A floor plan of the premises
An authorization letter
en.explain: The checklist requires a copy of a valid Business Registration Certificate for both partnerships and corporations, but adds for corporations a copy of the Certificate of Incorporation and a copy of the Memorandum and Articles of Association.

tc.q: 核對表就公司申請人列出哪些合夥無須提交的文件？
options: 公司註冊證明書副本及組織章程大綱及細則副本
有效商業登記證副本
處所的樓面平面圖
授權書
tc.explain: 核對表就合夥及法團均要求提交有效商業登記證副本；但就法團另加要求提交公司註冊證明書副本，以及組織章程大綱及細則副本。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第XVI節核對表

en.q: Whose Hong Kong Identity Card copies does the checklist require in relation to the compliance function?
options: Those of the CO and the MLRO
Those of every employee handling customer transactions
Those of the external auditor
Those of the company secretary
en.explain: The checklist lists, among the other requisite documents specified in the Licensing Guide, a copy of the Hong Kong Identity Card of the CO and MLRO — reflecting the paragraph 4.15(a) requirement to appoint both officers and the paragraph 11.3 requirement to notify their appointment.

tc.q: 就合規職能而言，核對表要求提交何人的香港身分證副本？
options: 合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任的身分證副本
每名處理客戶交易的僱員的身分證副本
外部核數師的身分證副本
公司秘書的身分證副本
tc.explain: 核對表在《牌照指引》指明的其他所需文件中，列出合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任的香港身分證副本——反映第4.15(a)段須委任該兩名主任的規定，以及第11.3段須通知其委任的規定。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第XV節查詢

en.q: During what hours is the C&ED's licensing enquiry telephone line available?
options: Office hours from Monday to Friday, except public holidays
24 hours a day, seven days a week
Monday to Saturday, including public holidays
Office hours from Monday to Saturday
en.explain: Paragraph 15.1 states that enquiries on licensing related matters may be made by phone at 3742 7742 during office hours from Monday to Friday except public holidays, or by post, fax at 3742 7758, or email to the MSO enquiry address.

tc.q: 香港海關的發牌查詢電話熱線在甚麼時間服務？
options: 星期一至星期五辦公時間（公眾假期除外）
每日24小時，一星期七天
星期一至星期六，包括公眾假期
星期一至星期六辦公時間
tc.explain: 第15.1段訂明有關發牌事宜的查詢，可於星期一至五辦公時間（公眾假期除外）致電3742 7742，亦可以郵遞、傳真3742 7758或電郵至金錢服務經營者查詢電郵地址提出。

en.q: What does the Register of Licensees contain for a licensee that is NOT licensed to operate at specified premises?
options: The correspondence address of the licensee
No address at all
The residential address of the sole proprietor
The address of the local place for storage of books and records
en.explain: Paragraph 12.1 states that the register contains the name of every licensee and, where the licensee is licensed to operate at specified premises, the address of every such premises; in any other case, the correspondence address of the licensee. This mirrors section 27(1) of the AMLO.

tc.q: 就並非獲發牌在指明處所經營的持牌人，持牌人登記冊載有甚麼？
options: 該持牌人的通訊地址
並無任何地址
該獨資經營者的住址
本地存放簿冊及紀錄地方的地址
tc.explain: 第12.1段訂明登記冊載有每名持牌人的名稱；如該持牌人獲發牌在指明處所經營，則載有每個該等處所的地址；在其他情況下，則載有該持牌人的通訊地址。此與《打擊洗錢條例》第27(1)條相對應。

en.q: A licensed MSO contravenes a specified provision of Schedule 2 and, separately, a condition of its licence. Which pecuniary penalty caps apply?
options: The greater of $10 million or three times the profit gained for the Schedule 2 contravention under section 21, and $1,000,000 for the licence condition breach under section 43
$1,000,000 for both
The greater of $10 million or three times the profit for both
$1,000,000 for the Schedule 2 contravention and $10 million for the licence condition breach
en.explain: Paragraph 13.1 of the Licensing Guide sets out both regimes: section 21(2)(c) caps the penalty for a financial institution contravening a specified provision at the greater of $10,000,000 or three times the profit gained or costs avoided; section 43(2)(c) caps the penalty for an MSO licensee committing a section 43(1) act at $1,000,000.

tc.q: 某持牌金錢服務經營者違反附表2的指明條文，另又違反其牌照條件。適用哪些罰款上限？
options: 就附表2的違反，第21條上限為1,000萬元或所獲利潤的三倍（以較高者為準）；就違反牌照條件，第43條上限為1,000,000元
兩者均為1,000萬元或所獲利潤的三倍
附表2違反為1,000,000元，牌照條件違反為1,000萬元
tc.explain: 《牌照指引》第13.1段列出兩套制度：第21(2)(c)條就金融機構違反指明條文，將罰款上限訂為1,000萬元或所獲利潤／所避免成本的三倍（以較高者為準）；第43(2)(c)條就金錢服務經營者持牌人作出第43(1)條所述作為，將罰款上限訂為1,000,000元。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.15(b)段；《能力評核須知》第4.2段

en.q: How do the Licensing Guide and the Guidance Notes together describe who must sit and pass the Assessment?
options: The sole proprietor, or any one of the partners or directors, must pass; and not more than three partners or directors may be nominated to participate
Every partner and director must pass
Only the sole proprietor may sit the Assessment
The compliance officer must sit and pass on the company's behalf
en.explain: Paragraph 4.15(b) of the Licensing Guide requires the sole proprietor, any one of the partners or directors of an applicant or licensee to pass the Assessment. Paragraph 4.2 of the Guidance Notes limits nominations to not more than three partners, or not more than three directors, for participation.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》與《能力評核須知》合起來如何說明何人須應考及通過評核？
options: 獨資經營者，或任何一名合夥人或董事，須通過評核；而可獲提名參加的合夥人或董事不多於三名
每名合夥人及董事均須通過
只有獨資經營者可應考評核
須由合規主任代表公司應考及通過
tc.explain: 《牌照指引》第4.15(b)段規定申請人／持牌人的獨資經營者，或任何一名合夥人或董事須通過評核。《能力評核須知》第4.2段則將可獲提名參加的人數限於不多於三名合夥人或不多於三名董事。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.1(i)段與第5.10(g)段的比較

en.q: How does the CO/MLRO requirement operate differently before and after a licence is granted?
options: Before grant, failure to appoint a competent CO or MLRO is a ground for refusing the licence; after grant, failure to appoint or maintain one is a ground for revocation or suspension
It applies only before the licence is granted
It applies only after the licence is granted
The requirement is identical at both stages
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(g) makes failure to appoint a competent CO or MLRO a ground on which the CCE may refuse to grant a licence. Paragraph 7.1(i) makes failure to appoint or maintain a competent CO or MLRO a ground on which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence after grant — the word maintain marking the continuing nature of the obligation.

tc.q: 合規主任／打擊洗錢報告主任的規定，在批出牌照前後有何不同運作？
options: 批出前，未有委任稱職的該等主任是拒發牌照的理由；批出後，未有委任或維持該等主任則是撤銷或暫時吊銷的理由
只在批出牌照前適用
只在批出牌照後適用
兩個階段的規定完全相同
tc.explain: 第5.10(g)段將未有委任稱職的合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任列為海關關長可拒發牌照的理由。第7.1(i)段則將未有委任或維持該等主任列為批出後可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由——「維持」一詞標示該責任的持續性質。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.11段與第7.3段的比較

en.q: What do the appeal provisions for a refusal to grant and for a revocation or suspension have in common?
options: Both provide for an appeal to the Review Tribunal within the period ending 21 days after the relevant notice
Both require the leave of the Court of Appeal
Both allow 30 days for the appeal
Both require the licensee to cease operations pending the appeal
en.explain: Paragraph 5.11 allows an appeal against refusal of a grant within the period ending 21 days after the notice informing the applicant of the refusal, and paragraph 7.3 allows an appeal against revocation or suspension within the period ending 21 days after the notice informing the licensee of the decision has been sent. Both reflect section 59(1) of the AMLO.

tc.q: 拒發牌照與撤銷／暫時吊銷牌照的上訴條文有何共通之處？
options: 兩者均訂明可於有關通知發出後21日內向審裁處提出上訴
兩者均須取得上訴法庭許可
兩者均給予30日上訴期
兩者均要求持牌人在上訴期間停止營運
tc.explain: 第5.11段准許就拒發牌照於告知申請人拒發的通知發出後21日內提出上訴；第7.3段准許就撤銷或暫時吊銷於告知持牌人該決定的通知發出後21日內提出上訴。兩者均反映《打擊洗錢條例》第59(1)條。

en.q: How do the Licensing Guide's two bank account provisions work together?
options: The account must be in the name of the licensee's company, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner; and any change in the bank account used must be notified in Form 6 within one month
The account may be in any name provided a change is notified
No notification is required if the account remains with the same bank
The account must be approved in advance in Form 4
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(j) requires any bank account used for operating the money service business to be in the name of the licensee's company, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner. Paragraph 9.1(k) lists change in the bank account used for operating the money service business among the changes that must be notified in Form 6 within one month under paragraph 9.2.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就銀行帳戶的兩項規定如何配合運作？
options: 該帳戶須以持牌人的公司、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的名義開立；而所用銀行帳戶如有變更，須於一個月內以表格6通知
只要通知變更，該帳戶可以任何名義開立
如仍屬同一銀行則無須通知
該帳戶須事先以表格4取得批准
tc.explain: 第11.1(j)段規定用於營運金錢服務業務的任何銀行帳戶，須以持牌人的公司、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的名義開立。第9.1(k)段則將營運金錢服務業務所用銀行帳戶的變更，列入須按第9.2段於一個月內以表格6通知的變更之中。

en.q: How must a change of Compliance Officer or Money Laundering Reporting Officer be handled?
options: It is a change in particulars that must be notified to the CCE in Form 6 within one month of the change
It requires prior approval in Form 4
It requires a fresh licence application
It need only be recorded internally
en.explain: Paragraph 9.1(n) lists change in CO or MLRO among the changes in particulars that must be notified by completing Form 6, and paragraph 9.2 requires notification within one month beginning on the date the change takes place. Prior approval in Form 4 is required only for directors, ultimate owners and partners.

tc.q: 合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任的變更須如何處理？
options: 屬詳情變更，須自變更起計一個月內以表格6通知海關關長
須以表格4事先取得批准
須重新提出牌照申請
只須在內部記錄
tc.explain: 第9.1(n)段將合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任的變更列入須填寫表格6通知的詳情變更之中；第9.2段則規定須自變更發生之日起計一個月內通知。以表格4事先取得批准，只適用於董事、最終擁有人及合夥人。

en.q: Why must a change in the occupants of particular premises situated in a mixed commercial and residential building be notified?
options: Because the licensee's continuing obligation is to hold every occupant's written consent to routine inspection, and a new occupant's refusal is a ground for revocation or suspension
Because the C&ED maintains a register of occupants
Because occupants must be approved in Form 4
Because rent apportionment must be recalculated
en.explain: Paragraph 9.1(g) lists change in occupants of particular premises in a mixed commercial and residential building as a notifiable change. Paragraph 11.1(d) makes securing occupants' written consent a continuing obligation, and paragraphs 7.1(b) and (c) make revocation of consent or a new occupant's refusal grounds for revocation or suspension.

tc.q: 為何位於商住混合樓宇的特定處所的佔用人變更須予通知？
options: 因持牌人的持續責任是持有每名佔用人同意例行視察的書面同意，而新佔用人拒絕給予同意即構成撤銷或暫時吊銷的理由
因香港海關備存佔用人登記冊
因佔用人須以表格4取得批准
因須重新計算租金分攤
tc.explain: 第9.1(g)段將商住混合樓宇特定處所的佔用人變更列為須通知的變更。第11.1(d)段將取得佔用人書面同意訂為持續責任；第7.1(b)及(c)段則將撤回同意或新佔用人拒絕給予同意列為撤銷或暫時吊銷的理由。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.10段；《打擊洗錢條例》第42條

en.q: Besides the normal two-year term, in which three circumstances does the Licensing Guide say a licence ceases to be valid?
options: On the death of an individual licensee, on the dissolution of a partnership, or on the commencement of winding up of a corporation
On the licensee ceasing to trade, on a change of directors, or on a change of premises
On non-payment of fees, on failure to file a return, or on a change of bank
On the sale of the business, on relocation, or on a change of business name
en.explain: Paragraph 2.10 states that normally a licence is valid for 2 years, and that in any other cases a licence ceases to be valid on the death of an individual licensee, on the dissolution of a partnership, or on the commencement of winding up of a corporation — reproducing section 42 of the AMLO.

tc.q: 除一般兩年有效期外，《牌照指引》指出牌照在哪三種情況下停止有效？
options: 個人持牌人去世時、合夥解散時，或法團展開清盤時
持牌人停止營業時、董事變更時，或處所變更時
未有繳費時、未有提交申報表時，或更換銀行時
出售業務時、遷址時，或更改業務名稱時
tc.explain: 第2.10段訂明牌照一般有效期為2年；在其他情況下，牌照於個人持牌人去世時、合夥解散時，或法團展開清盤時停止有效——即轉載《打擊洗錢條例》第42條。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段與第4.8段的比較

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide treat premises shared with another business as against premises shared with another MSO?
options: Shared with another business, the money service must be clearly partitioned and distinguished; shared with another MSO, the arrangement will not be accepted at all
Both arrangements are acceptable if partitioned
Both arrangements are refused outright
Sharing with another MSO is acceptable but sharing with another business is not
en.explain: Paragraph 4.8 requires that where another business is run on the same premises, the money service business must be clearly partitioned and distinguished from it, and states that sharing the premises with another MSO to operate money service business will not be accepted by the CCE. Paragraph 4.6 separately treats premises already used or declared by another MSO as not suitable.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何區別對待與其他業務共用處所，以及與另一金錢服務經營者共用處所？
options: 與其他業務共用時，金錢服務須清楚間隔及區分；與另一金錢服務經營者共用則完全不獲接受
兩種安排只要有間隔均可接受
兩種安排均一律拒絕
與另一金錢服務經營者共用可接受，與其他業務共用則不可
tc.explain: 第4.8段規定如同一處所經營其他業務，金錢服務業務必須與之清楚間隔及區分；並訂明與另一金錢服務經營者共用處所以經營金錢服務業務，不會獲海關關長接受。第4.6段亦另行將已由其他金錢服務經營者使用或申報的處所列為不適合。

source.tc: 《適當人選補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(g)段；《牌照指引》第4.15(a)段

en.q: How do the Supplementary F&P Guideline and the Licensing Guide together describe the compliance officer requirement?
options: The CO must be competent, of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the licensee, and — unless also the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner — an employee under the Employment Ordinance
The CO may be an external consultant in all cases
The CO must hold a professional accounting qualification
The CO must be approved in advance by the CCE in Form 4
en.explain: Paragraph 6(g) of the Supplementary F&P Guideline requires a competent compliance officer of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the licensee to oversee the establishment and maintenance of the AML/CFT systems. Paragraph 4.15(a) of the Licensing Guide requires the CO to be the applicant's employee under the Employment Ordinance unless the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner is also the CO.

tc.q: 《適當人選補充指引》與《牌照指引》合起來如何描述合規主任的規定？
options: 合規主任須稱職、在持牌人內具備足夠資歷及權限；除非同時是獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人，否則須為《僱傭條例》下的僱員
在任何情況下合規主任均可為外聘顧問
合規主任須持有專業會計資格
合規主任須以表格4事先取得海關關長批准
tc.explain: 《適當人選補充指引》第6(g)段要求在持牌人內設有具備足夠資歷及權限的稱職合規主任，監督打擊洗錢系統的建立及維持。《牌照指引》第4.15(a)段則規定除非獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人同時擔任合規主任，否則該主任須為《僱傭條例》下申請人的僱員。

en.q: What are the two limbs of the periodic return requirement in the Licensing Guide?
options: A return must be lodged within 2 weeks beginning from each half year unless the CCE specifies otherwise by notice in writing; and any failure to submit on time may result in suspension and/or revocation of the licence
A return must be lodged annually, and late submission attracts a fixed penalty
A return must be lodged quarterly, and late submission is an offence
A return must be lodged on demand, and failure results in prosecution
en.explain: Paragraph 11.2 requires a licensee to lodge a periodic return within 2 weeks beginning from each half year unless specified by the CCE by notice in writing, in the form and manner specified, and states that any failure to submit on time may result in suspension and/or revocation of the licence — a consequence repeated at paragraph 7.1(f).

tc.q: 《牌照指引》定期申報表規定的兩個部分是甚麼？
options: 須在每半年開始起計兩星期內提交申報表（除非海關關長以書面通知另作指明）；而未有準時提交可能導致暫時吊銷及／或撤銷牌照
須每年提交，逾期提交會被定額罰款
須每季提交，逾期提交屬罪行
須應要求提交，未有提交會被檢控
tc.explain: 第11.2段規定持牌人須在每半年開始起計兩星期內（除非海關關長以書面通知另作指明），按指明格式及方式提交定期申報表；並訂明未有準時提交可能導致暫時吊銷及／或撤銷牌照——第7.1(f)段亦重申此後果。

en.q: An applicant deliberately omits one of its business premises from the licence application. What two consequences may follow?
options: A section 52(2) offence punishable by a fine up to HK$50,000 and imprisonment up to 6 months, and refusal of the licence as an incomplete or invalid application
Only a warning letter from the C&ED
Only a delay in processing the application
Automatic revocation of any licence subsequently granted
en.explain: Paragraph 4.9 explains that omitting a material particular knowing that or being reckless as to whether it is omitted is an offence under section 52(2), punishable under section 52(3) by a fine up to HK$50,000 and imprisonment up to 6 months. Paragraph 5.10(h) separately makes an incomplete or invalid application a ground for refusing the licence.

tc.q: 申請人在牌照申請中故意遺漏其中一個業務處所。可能招致哪兩項後果？
options: 第52(2)條所訂罪行，可處最高罰款50,000港元及最高監禁6個月；以及因申請不完整或無效而被拒發牌照
只會收到香港海關的警告信
只會延誤申請處理
其後獲批的任何牌照均自動被撤銷
tc.explain: 第4.9段解釋，遺漏要項而知道或罔顧該要項是否被遺漏，屬第52(2)條所訂罪行，根據第52(3)條可處最高罰款50,000港元及最高監禁6個月。第5.10(h)段則另行將不完整或無效的申請列為拒發牌照的理由。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》第4.4(ii)段；《牌照指引》第6.2段

en.q: Both the Guidance Notes and the Licensing Guide use a 90-day period in the renewal context. What does each refer to?
options: The Guidance Notes refer to the window within which nomination may be made where no eligible person has passed; the Licensing Guide refers to when the department sends the reminder letter before expiry
Both refer to the deadline for submitting the renewal application
Both refer to the period within which the Assessment must be attended
The Guidance Notes refer to the reminder and the Licensing Guide to the application deadline
en.explain: Paragraph 4.4(ii) of the Guidance Notes permits nomination within 90 days before the expiry of the licence where the licensee has no eligible person who has passed the Assessment. Paragraph 6.2 of the Licensing Guide states that the reminder enclosing the invitation letter is delivered to each licensee 90 days before expiry.

tc.q: 《能力評核須知》及《牌照指引》在續期情境中均使用90日期間。各自所指為何？
options: 《須知》指在並無合資格人士通過評核的情況下可作提名的期間；《牌照指引》則指該部門在屆滿前發出提示信的時間
兩者均指提交續期申請的期限
兩者均指須出席評核的期間
《須知》指提示信，《牌照指引》指申請期限
tc.explain: 《能力評核須知》第4.4(ii)段准許在持牌人並無已通過評核的合資格人士時，於牌照屆滿前90日內作出提名。《牌照指引》第6.2段則訂明附有邀請信的提示，會在牌照屆滿前90日送達每名持牌人。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第XIV節；《打擊洗錢條例》附表3

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide's fee schedule relate to Schedule 3 of the AMLO?
options: It reproduces the Schedule 3 fees as amended with effect from 15 May 2026
It sets fees independently of Schedule 3
It sets indicative fees which Schedule 3 may vary
It applies only where Schedule 3 is silent
en.explain: The Licensing Guide's Section XIV fee schedule lists the same figures as Schedule 3 to the AMLO as amended from 15 May 2026 — $3,810 for a grant, $910 for a renewal, $2,440 and $410 for additional premises respectively, $945 per person for the fit and proper test and for each approval, and $2,440 for each new or particular business premises.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》的費用表與《打擊洗錢條例》附表3有何關係？
options: 其轉載自2026年5月15日起經修訂的附表3費用
其獨立於附表3自行訂定費用
其訂定指示性費用，附表3可予更改
只在附表3並無規定時方適用
tc.explain: 《牌照指引》第XIV節的費用表所列數額，與自2026年5月15日起經修訂的《打擊洗錢條例》附表3相同——批出3,810元、續期910元、額外處所分別為2,440元及410元、適當人選測試及每項批准每人945元，以及每個新增或特定業務處所2,440元。

source.tc: 《適當人選準則指引》第5(d)段；《補充指引》第6(a)段

en.q: Which fitness-and-propriety factor appears in both the F&P Guideline and the Supplementary F&P Guideline?
options: Whether the person has failed to comply with any conditions imposed by the CCE on the licence
Whether the person has passed the Competence Assessment
Whether the person maintains a local management office
Whether the person has been censured by an overseas regulator
en.explain: Paragraph 5(d) of the F&P Guideline and paragraph 6(a) of the Supplementary F&P Guideline both make relevant whether the person has failed to comply with any conditions imposed by the CCE on the licence — the Supplementary Guideline repeating and then expanding on the original list.

tc.q: 哪一項適當人選因素同時出現於《適當人選準則指引》及《補充指引》？
options: 該人有否沒有遵從海關關長就牌照施加的任何條件
該人有否通過能力評核
該人有否維持本地管理辦事處
該人有否被海外監管機構譴責
tc.explain: 《適當人選準則指引》第5(d)段及《補充指引》第6(a)段均將該人有否沒有遵從海關關長就牌照施加的任何條件列為相關因素——《補充指引》先重申原有清單，繼而加以擴充。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》第5.1段；《牌照指引》第4.15(b)段

en.q: In which languages is the Assessment offered?
options: Chinese or English
English only
Chinese only
Chinese, English or Portuguese
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 of the Guidance Notes states that the Assessment comprises 35 multiple-choice questions in Chinese or English languages, with only one correct answer for each question.

tc.q: 評核以哪些語文提供？
options: 中文或英文
只限英文
只限中文
中文、英文或葡萄牙文
tc.explain: 《能力評核須知》第5.1段訂明評核由35條中文或英文的多項選擇題組成，每題只有一個正確答案。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》第10.5及10.7段

en.q: What is provided at the Assessment centre, and what may be placed on the desk?
options: Stationery is provided at the centre, and only necessary and permitted stationery may be put on the desk
Candidates must bring their own stationery, and calculators are permitted
Reference materials are provided, and notes may be placed on the desk
Nothing is provided, and candidates may keep personal items on the desk
en.explain: Paragraph 10.5 states that stationery will be provided at the Assessment centre. Paragraph 10.7 states that only necessary and permitted stationery can be put on the desk, and that all other personal belongings, including books, dictionaries, notes and electronic devices, must be put under the candidate's chair.

tc.q: 評核中心會提供甚麼？桌上可放置甚麼？
options: 中心會提供文具；桌上只可放置必需及獲准許的文具
考生須自備文具，並可使用計算機
中心提供參考資料，桌上可放置筆記
中心不提供任何物品，考生可將個人物品放於桌上
tc.explain: 第10.5段訂明評核中心會提供文具。第10.7段訂明桌上只可放置必需及獲准許的文具；所有其他個人物品（包括書籍、字典、筆記及電子裝置）均須放於考生座椅下。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》第10.8段

en.q: Which three things must a candidate NOT do during the Assessment under paragraph 10.8?
options: Communicate or attempt to communicate improperly with any person inside or outside the centre; disturb other candidates in any way; or take photographs or make audio or video recordings inside the centre
Ask the invigilator a question; leave early; or use the toilet
Write on the question book; check the time; or use an eraser
Arrive early; sit in a different seat; or bring water
en.explain: Paragraph 10.8 states that candidates must not communicate or attempt to communicate improperly with any person inside or outside the Assessment centre; disturb other candidates in whatever way; or take photographs, audio-record or video-record inside the Assessment centre.

tc.q: 根據第10.8段，考生在評核期間不得作出哪三項行為？
options: 與中心內外任何人不當地通訊或企圖通訊；以任何方式騷擾其他考生；或在中心內拍照、錄音或錄影
向監考員提問；提早離場；或使用洗手間
在試題冊上書寫；查看時間；或使用擦膠
提早到達；坐在不同座位；或攜帶飲用水
tc.explain: 第10.8段訂明考生不得與評核中心內外任何人不當地通訊或企圖通訊；不得以任何方式騷擾其他考生；亦不得在評核中心內拍照、錄音或錄影。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》第10.3及10.4段

en.q: What must a candidate bring for identity verification, and what happens if they cannot produce it?
options: A personal identification document such as a Hong Kong Identity Card or valid passport, and a printed copy of the invitation letter; without the identification document the candidate will not be allowed to sit the Assessment
Only the invitation letter; identity is verified from the nomination form
Only a business card; the company vouches for the candidate
Nothing; identity is verified by the invigilator against the candidate list
en.explain: Paragraph 10.4 states that candidates must bring their personal identification document, such as a Hong Kong Identity Card or valid local or foreign passport, and a printed copy of the invitation letter for identity verification, and that failure to produce the personal identification document means the candidate will not be allowed to sit the Assessment. Identity verification may be required at different stages.

tc.q: 考生須攜帶甚麼以核實身分？如未能出示會有甚麼後果？
options: 個人身分證明文件（例如香港身分證或有效護照）及邀請信的列印本；未能出示身分證明文件者不獲准應考
只需邀請信；身分按提名表格核實
只需名片；由公司為考生作保
無須攜帶；由監考員按考生名單核實身分
tc.explain: 第10.4段訂明考生必須攜帶個人身分證明文件（例如香港身分證或有效的本地／外國護照）及邀請信的列印本，以核實身分；未能出示個人身分證明文件者，不獲准應考。考生可能須在不同階段接受身分核實。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》第10.6段

en.q: What must a candidate who leaves the Assessment early ensure?
options: That the answer scripts and related materials have been collected by the invigilator on the spot
That the invigilator has recorded the time of departure
That another candidate witnesses the departure
That the question book is left face down on the desk
en.explain: Paragraph 10.6 states that candidates must not leave the Assessment centre without permission from the invigilator, and that early leavers must make sure the answer scripts and related materials have been collected by the invigilator on the spot.

tc.q: 提早離場的考生須確保甚麼？
options: 答題紙及相關材料已由監考員即場收回
監考員已記錄其離場時間
有另一名考生見證其離場
試題冊反轉放在桌上
tc.explain: 第10.6段訂明考生未經監考員准許不得離開評核中心；提早離場者必須確保答題紙及相關材料已由監考員即場收回。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》第11.4及11.6段

en.q: What practical instructions does the Guidance Notes give about completing the answer sheet?
options: Erase wrong answers thoroughly, do not fold the answer sheet, and check that you are answering the right question when filling in an answer
Use a pen rather than a pencil, and initial each correction
Complete the answers in order and do not skip questions
Write the answers in words rather than marking boxes
en.explain: Paragraph 11.4 requires wrong answers to be erased thoroughly and the answer sheet not to be folded. Paragraph 11.6 states that when filling in an answer the candidate should check to see that they are answering the right question, and that requests to amend answers beyond the Assessment time will not be considered.

tc.q: 《須知》就填寫答題紙給予甚麼實務指示？
options: 徹底擦去錯誤答案、不得摺疊答題紙，並在填寫答案時核對是否作答正確的題目
使用原子筆而非鉛筆，並在每處更正旁簽署縮寫
須依次序作答，不得跳題
以文字書寫答案而非填塗方格
tc.explain: 第11.4段規定須徹底擦去錯誤答案，並不得摺疊答題紙。第11.6段訂明填寫答案時，應核對是否正在作答正確的題目；超出評核時間後提出修改答案的要求，一概不獲考慮。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》第14.5段

en.q: What does the Guidance Notes say about disputes concerning the Assessment?
options: In case of any dispute, the decision made by the C&ED shall be final and conclusive
Disputes are referred to the Review Tribunal
Disputes are determined by an independent adjudicator
Disputes are resolved by arbitration under the Arbitration Ordinance
en.explain: Paragraph 14.5 states that in case of any dispute, the decision made by the C&ED shall be final and conclusive. This sits alongside paragraph 12.4, under which the result of a re-checking is final.

tc.q: 《須知》就有關評核的爭議有何說明？
options: 如有任何爭議，香港海關所作的決定為最終及不可推翻
爭議轉交審裁處處理
爭議由獨立裁決人裁定
爭議按《仲裁條例》以仲裁解決
tc.explain: 第14.5段訂明如有任何爭議，香港海關所作的決定為最終及不可推翻。此與第12.4段（覆核結果為最終決定）並行。

source.tc: 《能力評核須知》第14.2及13.1段

en.q: How are candidates informed of changes to Assessment arrangements, including after a weather suspension?
options: Candidates will be informed by email before the Assessment as soon as practicable where changes are required; alternative arrangements after a weather suspension are published on the MSOS website on the first working day that follows
By registered post within 14 days
By telephone from the Assessment centre
By notice in the Gazette
en.explain: Paragraph 14.2 states that where changes to the Assessment arrangements are required by C&ED, candidates will be informed by email before the Assessment as soon as practicable. Paragraph 13.1 states that where the Assessment is suspended for severe weather, alternative arrangements will be published on the website of the Money Service Operators Licensing System on the first working day that follows.

tc.q: 評核安排如有更改（包括因惡劣天氣暫停後），考生會如何獲通知？
options: 如香港海關須更改安排，會在評核前在切實可行範圍內盡快以電郵通知考生；因天氣暫停後的替代安排，會於其後首個工作天在金錢服務經營者牌照系統網站公布
以掛號郵遞於14日內通知
由評核中心以電話通知
以憲報公告通知
tc.explain: 第14.2段訂明如香港海關須更改評核安排，會在評核前在切實可行範圍內盡快以電郵通知考生。第13.1段訂明如評核因惡劣天氣暫停，替代安排（如有）會於其後首個工作天在金錢服務經營者牌照系統網站公布。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.1段

en.q: What does adopting a risk-based approach (RBA) to AML/CFT mean for an MSO?
options: Identifying, assessing and understanding its ML/TF risks and taking AML/CFT measures commensurate with those risks
Applying identical maximum-strength controls to every customer and transaction
Only serving customers assessed as low risk
Outsourcing all AML/CFT compliance work to an external consultant
en.explain: Under the RBA, an MSO identifies, assesses and understands the ML/TF risks it is exposed to and takes measures commensurate with those risks, allowing resources to be allocated effectively (¶2.1). The RBA is not about uniform maximum controls or refusing all higher-risk business.

tc.q: 對金錢服務經營者而言，採用風險為本的方法打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集是指甚麼？
options: 識別、評估和了解本身面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，繼而採取與有關風險相稱的措施
對所有客戶及交易一律採用最高強度的管控措施
只接納被評為低風險的客戶
將所有合規工作外判予外間顧問
tc.explain: 風險為本的方法要求金錢服務經營者識別、評估和了解本身面對的風險，繼而採取與風險相稱的措施，讓資源更有效分配（第2.1段）。風險為本並非劃一採用最嚴格管控，亦不是拒絕所有較高風險業務。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.2段

en.q: An MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment should cover risks in relation to all of the following EXCEPT:
options: The profitability of each customer to the MSO
Its customers
The countries or jurisdictions its customers are from or in
Its products, services, transactions and delivery channels
en.explain: ¶2.2 lists four dimensions: (a) customers; (b) countries/jurisdictions the customers are from or in; (c) countries/jurisdictions the MSO operates in; and (d) products, services, transactions and delivery channels. Customer profitability is a commercial matter, not part of the ML/TF risk assessment.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的機構層面洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估應涵蓋下列各項風險，但不包括：
options: 每名客戶為金錢服務經營者帶來的利潤
其客戶
其客戶所屬或所在的國家或司法管轄區
其產品、服務、交易及交付渠道
tc.explain: 第2.2段列明四個層面：(a)客戶；(b)客戶所屬或所在的國家或司法管轄區；(c)金錢服務經營者業務所在的國家或司法管轄區；及(d)產品、服務、交易及交付渠道。客戶利潤屬商業考慮，並非洗錢風險評估的一部分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.3段

en.q: Which of the following is among the appropriate steps for conducting the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: Obtaining senior management's approval of the risk assessment results
Publishing the risk assessment on the MSO's website
Submitting the risk assessment to the FATF annually
Having the assessment certified by an external lawyer
en.explain: ¶2.3 requires documenting the process, considering all relevant risk factors, obtaining senior management approval of the results, keeping the assessment up to date, and having mechanisms to provide it to the CCE when required. Publication, FATF submission and legal certification are not required.

tc.q: 下列哪項屬進行機構層面洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的適當步驟？
options: 取得高級管理層對風險評估結果的審批
將風險評估刊登於金錢服務經營者的網站
每年向財務行動特別組織提交風險評估
由外間律師核證風險評估
tc.explain: 第2.3段要求：記錄評估程序、考慮所有相關風險因素、取得高級管理層對評估結果的審批、確保評估反映現況，以及設有機制在關長要求時提供評估。刊登網站、提交特別組織或律師核證均非規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.9段

en.q: How often should an MSO conduct its institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: Every two years, and also upon trigger events material to its business and risk exposure
Only once, before commencing business
Every five years
Only when directed by the CCE
en.explain: ¶2.9: the institutional risk assessment should be conducted every two years and upon material trigger events (e.g. a significant breach of AML/CFT Systems, new customer segments or delivery channels, launch of new products, or significant changes to operations). Results are documented and approved by senior management.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應相隔多久進行一次機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估？
options: 每兩年一次，並在對業務及風險有顯著影響的觸發事件發生後覆核
開業前進行一次即可
每五年一次
只在關長指示時進行
tc.explain: 第2.9段：應每兩年進行一次評估，並在觸發事件（例如嚴重違反打擊洗錢制度、收購新客戶類別或交付渠道、推出新產品及服務、營運程序有重大改變）發生後覆核。結果應記錄在案並由高級管理層審批。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.9段

en.q: Which of the following is a “trigger event” that should prompt a review of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: The launch of new products and services by the MSO
The annual renewal of the office tenancy agreement
A change of the MSO's office decoration
Hiring an additional part-time cashier
en.explain: Trigger events include a significant breach of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, acquisition of new customer segments or delivery channels, launch of new products and services, or significant changes to operational processes, target customers and business counterparts (¶2.9). Routine administrative matters are not triggers.

tc.q: 下列哪項屬應觸發覆核機構層面風險評估的「觸發事件」？
options: 金錢服務經營者推出新的產品及服務
每年續簽辦公室租約
更改辦公室裝修
增聘一名兼職收銀員
tc.explain: 觸發事件包括嚴重違反打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度、收購新的客戶類別或交付渠道、推出新的產品及服務，或營運程序、目標客戶及交易對手有重大改變（第2.9段）。日常行政事務並非觸發事件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.5段

en.q: For a small MSO offering a very limited range of services to customers with a homogeneous risk profile, which statement about the institutional risk assessment is correct?
options: A simpler risk assessment approach might suffice, as the assessment should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the business
The assessment must be as sophisticated as that of a large bank
No institutional risk assessment is needed at all
The assessment may be skipped if the MSO has never had a suspicious transaction
en.explain: ¶2.5: the scale and scope of the assessment should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the business — a simpler approach may suffice for smaller, less complex MSOs. But every MSO must still conduct one.

tc.q: 對於一間服務種類非常有限、客戶風險狀況相近的小型金錢服務經營者，下列關於機構層面風險評估的說法哪項正確？
options: 可採用較簡單的風險評估方法，因為評估的規模與範圍應與業務性質、規模及複雜程度相稱
評估必須與大型銀行同樣精密
完全無須進行機構層面風險評估
如從未發現可疑交易便可豁免評估
tc.explain: 第2.5段：評估的規模及範圍應與業務性質、規模及複雜程度相稱——規模較小、業務較簡單的經營者可採用較簡單的方法，但仍必須進行評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.11至2.12段

en.q: When should an MSO assess the ML/TF risks of a new product, new business practice or new technology?
options: Prior to the launch or use, taking appropriate measures to manage and mitigate the risks identified
Within six months after launch
Only if the CCE raises concerns after launch
Only when the product proves commercially successful
en.explain: ¶2.12 requires the risk assessment to be undertaken before launching new products or business practices or using new or developing technologies, with appropriate mitigating measures. This applies to new technologies for both new and pre-existing products (¶2.11).

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應何時評估新產品、新經營方法或嶄新科技的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險？
options: 推出或使用前事先評估，並採取適當措施管理和減低已識別的風險
推出後六個月內
只在關長於推出後表示關注時
只在產品證實有商業成果時
tc.explain: 第2.12段規定須在推出新產品、新經營方法或使用嶄新或開發中的科技前事先進行風險評估，並採取適當的減低風險措施。此規定適用於新產品及既有產品使用嶄新科技的情況（第2.11段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.13段

en.q: What does the customer risk assessment conducted at the initial stage of the CDD process determine?
options: The extent of CDD measures to be applied — more information and stricter verification for higher risks, possibly simplified for lower risks
The commission rate to be charged to the customer
Whether the customer must be reported to the JFIU
The credit limit to be granted to the customer
en.explain: ¶2.13: the customer risk assessment determines the extent of CDD measures — the amount and type of information obtained and the extent of verification increase where risks are higher, and may be simplified where risks are lower. It is not about pricing, credit or automatic reporting.

tc.q: 在盡職審查程序初期進行的客戶風險評估決定甚麼？
options: 需採取何種程度的盡職審查措施——風險較高須索取更多資料及以更嚴謹方式核實；風險較低則可簡化
向客戶收取的佣金率
是否須向聯合財富情報組報告該客戶
批予客戶的信貸限額
tc.explain: 第2.13段：客戶風險評估決定需採取何種程度的盡職審查措施——風險較高便需索取數量及類別更多的資料並以更嚴謹方式核實；風險較低則可簡化。與收費、信貸或自動申報無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.14段

en.q: Which statement about the customer risk profile is correct?
options: It will change over time, so the MSO should review and update the customer risk assessment from time to time, particularly during ongoing monitoring
Once assigned at onboarding, it remains fixed for the life of the relationship
It only needs review if the customer requests it
It is determined solely by the customer's nationality
en.explain: ¶2.14: the customer risk profile will change over time; the MSO should review and update the assessment from time to time, particularly during ongoing monitoring. The finalised assessment also determines the level and type of ongoing monitoring.

tc.q: 關於客戶風險狀況，下列哪項正確？
options: 客戶風險狀況會隨時間轉變，金錢服務經營者應不時（尤其在持續監察期間）覆核及更新客戶風險評估
開戶時評定後，在整段業務關係內維持不變
只在客戶要求時才需覆核
僅由客戶的國籍決定
tc.explain: 第2.14段：客戶風險狀況會隨時間轉變，金錢服務經營者應不時覆核及更新評估，尤其在持續監察期間。敲定的評估結果亦決定持續監察的程度和類別。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶2.16; s.20(1)(b)(ii), Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.16段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(1)(b)(ii)條

en.q: Why should an MSO keep records of its customer risk assessments?
options: To demonstrate to the CCE how it assesses customers' ML/TF risks and that the extent of CDD and ongoing monitoring is appropriate to those risks
To calculate staff commission accurately
To share customer risk ratings with other MSOs in the industry
To publish aggregate risk statistics in its annual report
en.explain: ¶2.16: records of customer risk assessments enable the MSO to demonstrate to the CCE (a) how it assesses each customer's ML/TF risks and (b) that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on those risks.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者為何應就客戶風險評估備存紀錄？
options: 以便向關長證明它如何評估客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，以及所執行的盡職審查措施及持續監察程度屬合適
以準確計算職員佣金
與業內其他金錢服務經營者分享客戶風險評級
在年報刊登整體風險統計數字
tc.explain: 第2.16段：備存客戶風險評估紀錄，以便向關長證明(a)它如何評估客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險；及(b)基於該客戶的風險，所執行的盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是合適的。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶3.1; s.23, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.1段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第23條

en.q: Under section 23 of Schedule 2 to the AMLO, an MSO must take all reasonable measures to do what?
options: Ensure proper safeguards exist to mitigate ML/TF risks and to prevent contraventions of requirements under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2
Guarantee that no customer ever launders money through it
Report every cash transaction to the CCE
Refuse all transactions above HK$120,000
en.explain: s.23 of Schedule 2 requires all reasonable measures to (a) ensure proper safeguards exist to prevent contravention of Part 2 (CDD) and Part 3 (record-keeping) requirements, and (b) mitigate ML/TF risks (¶3.1). It is a duty of safeguards, not an absolute guarantee.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第23條，金錢服務經營者必須採取一切合理措施以達致甚麼目的？
options: 確保設有合適的保障措施，以減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，以及防止違反附表2第2或3部的任何規定
保證絕不會有客戶透過它清洗黑錢
向關長申報每宗現金交易
拒絕所有超過港幣120,000元的交易
tc.explain: 附表2第23條規定金錢服務經營者須採取一切合理措施：(a)確保設有合適的保障措施，防止違反附表2第2部（盡職審查）及第3部（備存紀錄）的規定；及(b)減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險（第3.1段）。這是設置保障措施的責任，並非絕對擔保。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.2段

en.q: An MSO's AML/CFT Systems (policies, procedures and controls) should be approved by whom?
options: The MSO's senior management
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise
The Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
An external auditor
