en.explain: ¶3.2: the MSO should have AML/CFT Systems approved by senior management, monitor their implementation, enhance them if necessary, and take enhanced measures where higher risks are identified. The CCE supervises compliance but does not pre-approve each MSO's systems.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度（政策、程序及管控措施）應由誰審批？
options: 金錢服務經營者的高級管理層
海關關長
聯合財富情報組
外聘核數師
tc.explain: 第3.2段：金錢服務經營者應備有經高級管理層審批的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，監察其推行情況並視乎需要優化，以及在識別出較高風險時採取更嚴格的措施。關長負責監督合規，但不會預先審批個別經營者的制度。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.3段

en.q: In which situation is an MSO NOT permitted to simplify its AML/CFT Systems?
options: Whenever there is a suspicion of ML/TF
When lower risks have been identified through an appropriate risk assessment
When the simplified systems have been approved by senior management
When the simplified systems are subject to review from time to time
en.explain: ¶3.3 allows simplification where statutory requirements are met, lower risks are identified through an appropriate risk assessment, and the simplified systems are senior-management-approved and reviewed. However, simplification is never permitted whenever there is a suspicion of ML/TF.

tc.q: 在哪種情況下，金錢服務經營者不准簡化其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度？
options: 懷疑有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的情況
已透過適當的風險評估識別出較低風險
簡化制度已經高級管理層審批
簡化制度會不時覆核
tc.explain: 第3.3段容許在符合法定規定、經適當風險評估識別出較低風險，且簡化制度經高級管理層審批並不時覆核的情況下簡化制度。但如懷疑有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的情況，一律不准簡化。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.4段

en.q: An MSO's AML/CFT Systems should include all of the following EXCEPT:
options: A profit-sharing scheme for compliance staff
Compliance management arrangements
An independent audit function
Employee screening procedures and an ongoing employee training programme
en.explain: ¶3.4 lists four components: (a) compliance management arrangements; (b) an independent audit function; (c) employee screening procedures; and (d) an ongoing employee training programme. Remuneration schemes are not part of the required AML/CFT Systems.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度應包括下列各項，但不包括：
options: 合規職員的分紅計劃
合規管理安排
獨立的審核職能
僱員甄選程序及持續的僱員培訓計劃
tc.explain: 第3.4段列明四個組成部分：(a)合規管理安排；(b)獨立的審核職能；(c)僱員甄選程序；及(d)持續的僱員培訓計劃。薪酬分紅安排並非制度的規定組成部分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.5段

en.q: At a minimum, an MSO's compliance management arrangements should include which of the following?
options: Oversight by senior management, and appointment of a Compliance Officer (CO) and a Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)
A dedicated compliance department of at least five staff
A board committee chaired by an independent non-executive director
Quarterly compliance meetings with the CCE
en.explain: ¶3.5: compliance management arrangements should, at a minimum, include senior management oversight and the appointment of a CO and an MLRO. No particular headcount, committee structure or meeting schedule with the regulator is prescribed.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的合規管理安排最低限度應包括下列哪項？
options: 由高級管理層監督，以及委任一名合規主任及一名洗錢報告主任
一個至少五人的專責合規部門
一個由獨立非執行董事主持的董事會委員會
與關長每季舉行合規會議
tc.explain: 第3.5段：合規管理安排最低限度應包括由高級管理層監督，以及委任一名合規主任及一名洗錢報告主任。指引並無規定人手數目、委員會架構或定期與監管機構會面。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.7段

en.q: Which statement correctly describes the appointments senior management should make under the Guideline?
options: A Compliance Officer at the management level with overall responsibility for the AML/CFT Systems, and a senior staff member as MLRO to act as the central reference point for suspicious transaction reporting
A junior clerk as CO and any available staff member as MLRO
An external consultant as CO and the receptionist as MLRO
A CO based overseas and an MLRO who reports only to the CCE
en.explain: ¶3.7: senior management should appoint a CO at the management level with overall responsibility for establishing and maintaining the AML/CFT Systems, and a senior staff member as MLRO — the central reference point for STR reporting. Both should normally be based in Hong Kong (¶3.8(c)).

tc.q: 下列哪項正確描述高級管理層根據指引應作出的委任？
options: 委任一名屬管理層的合規主任，全面負責建立及維持打擊洗錢制度；並委任一名高級職員擔任洗錢報告主任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點
委任一名初級文員為合規主任，並委任任何有空的職員為洗錢報告主任
委任外間顧問為合規主任，並委任接待員為洗錢報告主任
委任一名長駐海外的合規主任，以及一名只向關長匯報的洗錢報告主任
tc.explain: 第3.7段：高級管理層應委任一名屬管理層的合規主任，全面負責建立及維持打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度；並委任一名高級職員擔任洗錢報告主任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點。兩者通常應長駐香港（第3.8(c)段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.7段註9

en.q: May the functions of the Compliance Officer and the Money Laundering Reporting Officer be performed by the same person?
options: Yes — depending on the size of the MSO, the same person may perform both functions
No — the two roles must always be held by different individuals
Yes, but only with the prior written approval of the CCE
Yes, but only in MSOs with more than 50 employees
en.explain: Footnote 9 to ¶3.7 confirms that, depending on the size of the MSO, the functions of CO and MLRO may be performed by the same person. No CCE approval is needed, and it is smaller (not larger) MSOs where combining the roles is most likely appropriate.

tc.q: 合規主任與洗錢報告主任的職能可否由同一人執行？
options: 可以——視乎金錢服務經營者的規模而定，兩項職能可由同一人執行
不可以——兩個職位必須由不同的人擔任
可以，但須事先取得關長書面批准
可以，但只限僱員超過50人的金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 第3.7段註9確認：視乎金錢服務經營者的規模，合規主任及洗錢報告主任的職能可由同一人執行。無須關長批准；規模較小的經營者才較可能適合由一人兼任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8段

en.q: To enable the CO and MLRO to discharge their responsibilities effectively, senior management should, as far as practicable, ensure they are:
options: Independent of all operational and business functions (subject to the MSO's size), normally based in Hong Kong, with timely access to all available information and an appropriate deputy for absences
Rotated to a different role every six months
Prevented from contacting senior management directly
Kept unaware of CDD records to preserve their independence
en.explain: ¶3.8: the CO/MLRO should be appropriately qualified, independent of operational functions (subject to size constraints), normally based in Hong Kong, sufficiently senior, with regular and direct access to senior management, timely access to internal and external information (e.g. CDD records, CCE circulars), and sufficient resources including a deputy of the same status where practicable.

tc.q: 為使合規主任及洗錢報告主任能有效履行職責，高級管理層應在切實可行範圍內確保他們：
options: 獨立於所有營運及業務職能（視乎規模限制）、通常長駐香港、能及時取得一切可得資料，並有適當的替補人選
每六個月調任其他職位
不得直接聯絡高級管理層
為保持獨立而不得查閱盡職審查紀錄
tc.explain: 第3.8段：合規主任及洗錢報告主任應具合適資格、獨立於營運及業務職能（視乎規模限制）、通常長駐香港、具一定資歷及權力、能定期及直接聯絡高級管理層、及時取得內部（如盡職審查紀錄）及外部（如關長通函）資料，並配備充足資源，包括在切實可行時設有具相同地位的替補人選。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.10段

en.q: Which of the following is a principal function of the MLRO?
options: Reviewing internal disclosures and exception reports and determining, in light of all available information, whether a report to the JFIU is necessary
Approving the MSO's annual budget
Negotiating correspondent agreements with overseas partners
Setting the exchange rates offered to customers
en.explain: ¶3.10: the MLRO is the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and the main contact with the JFIU and law enforcement. Principal functions include reviewing internal disclosures and exception reports and deciding whether a JFIU report is necessary, maintaining records of internal reviews, and giving guidance on avoiding tipping off.

tc.q: 下列哪項屬洗錢報告主任的主要職能？
options: 覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，並根據一切知悉的資料，決定是否有需要向聯合財富情報組作出報告
審批金錢服務經營者的年度預算
與海外夥伴商討代理協議
釐定向客戶提供的匯率
tc.explain: 第3.10段：洗錢報告主任是報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點，亦是與聯合財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點。主要職能包括覆核內部披露及例外情況報告並決定是否須向財富情報組報告、備存內部覆核紀錄，以及提供如何避免「通風報訊」的導引。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶3.18–3.19; s.22, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.18至3.19段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22條

en.q: A Hong Kong-incorporated MSO has an overseas branch in a jurisdiction whose AML/CFT requirements are laxer than Hong Kong's. What should the MSO do?
options: Require the branch to apply the higher of the two sets of requirements; if local law does not permit this, inform the CCE and take additional risk-mitigation measures
Simply follow the local (laxer) requirements
Close the branch immediately
Apply Hong Kong requirements only to customers who are Hong Kong residents
en.explain: ¶3.18: the branch should apply the higher of the two sets of requirements to the extent local law permits. If local law does not permit it (¶3.19, s.22(2) Sch. 2), the MSO must inform the CCE of the failure and take additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risks.

tc.q: 一間在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者，其外地分行位處打擊洗錢規定較香港寬鬆的司法管轄區。該經營者應怎樣做？
options: 規定分行執行兩者中較嚴格的規定；如當地法律不准許，則須通知關長並採取額外的減低風險措施
直接跟從當地（較寬鬆的）規定
立即結束該分行
只對香港居民客戶採用香港的規定
tc.explain: 第3.18段：分行應在當地法律准許的範圍內執行兩者中較嚴格的規定。如當地法律不准許（第3.19段；附表2第22(2)條），金錢服務經營者須將不能遵從的情況通知關長，並採取額外措施減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.1段

en.q: What practical benefit does the Guideline say a risk-based approach brings to an MSO?
options: It allows the MSO to allocate its resources more effectively and apply preventive measures commensurate with the nature and level of risks
It permits the MSO to dispense with customer due diligence for low-risk customers
It reduces the MSO's licence fee
It transfers responsibility for risk assessment to the CCE
en.explain: ¶2.1 states that the RBA allows an MSO to allocate its resources more effectively and apply preventive measures that are commensurate with the nature and level of risks, in order to focus its AML/CFT efforts in the most effective way.

tc.q: 本指引指出風險為本方式為金錢服務經營者帶來甚麼實際好處？
options: 使該經營者能更有效地分配資源，並採取與風險性質及程度相稱的預防措施
准許該經營者就低風險客戶免除客戶盡職審查
減低該經營者的牌照費用
將風險評估的責任轉予海關關長
tc.explain: 第2.1段訂明風險為本方式使金錢服務經營者能更有效地分配資源，並採取與風險性質及程度相稱的預防措施，從而以最有效的方式集中其打擊洗錢工作。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.2段

en.q: What role does the institutional ML/TF risk assessment play in the risk-based approach?
options: It forms the basis of the RBA, enabling the MSO to understand how and to what extent it is vulnerable to ML/TF
It replaces the need for customer risk assessments
It is required only where the MSO operates internationally
It is prepared by the CCE and issued to each MSO
en.explain: ¶2.2 states that the institutional ML/TF risk assessment forms the basis of the RBA, enabling an MSO to understand how and to what extent it is vulnerable to ML/TF, and that the MSO should conduct it in relation to its customers, the countries or jurisdictions its customers are from or in, the countries it operates in, and its products, services, transactions and delivery channels.

tc.q: 機構層面的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估，在風險為本方式中擔當甚麼角色？
options: 構成風險為本方式的基礎，使該經營者了解其在何種方式及何等程度上易受洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集所影響
取代進行客戶風險評估的需要
只在該經營者於國際間經營時方須進行
由海關關長編製並發給每名金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 第2.2段訂明機構層面的風險評估構成風險為本方式的基礎，使金錢服務經營者了解其在何種方式及何等程度上易受洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集所影響；該經營者應就其客戶、客戶來自或身處的國家或司法管轄區、其本身有業務的國家或司法管轄區，以及其產品、服務、交易及交付渠道進行評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.3(c)段

en.q: Whose approval must be obtained on the results of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: Senior management's
The CCE's
The external auditor's
The compliance officer's alone
en.explain: ¶2.3(c) lists among the appropriate steps obtaining the approval of senior management on the risk assessment results. ¶2.9 similarly requires the results of a review to be documented and approved by senior management.

tc.q: 機構層面風險評估的結果須取得何人的批准？
options: 高級管理層
海關關長
外部核數師
只需合規主任
tc.explain: 第2.3(c)段在適當步驟中列明須就風險評估結果取得高級管理層的批准。第2.9段同樣規定檢視結果須以文件記錄並經高級管理層批准。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.3(e)段

en.q: What mechanism must an MSO have in place in relation to the CCE and its risk assessment?
options: Appropriate mechanisms to provide the risk assessment to the CCE when required to do so
A mechanism to obtain the CCE's prior approval of the assessment
A mechanism to publish the assessment on its website
A mechanism to lodge the assessment with the CCE annually
en.explain: ¶2.3(e) lists among the appropriate steps having appropriate mechanisms to provide the risk assessment to the CCE when required to do so — a readiness requirement rather than a routine filing obligation.

tc.q: 就海關關長及其風險評估，金錢服務經營者須設有甚麼機制？
options: 適當機制，以在被要求時向海關關長提供該風險評估
取得關長事先批准該評估的機制
在其網站公開該評估的機制
每年向關長存檔該評估的機制
tc.explain: 第2.3(e)段在適當步驟中列明須設有適當機制，以在被要求時向海關關長提供該風險評估——屬備妥待索的規定，而非例行呈交的責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.3(a)段

en.q: How must the risk assessment process itself be supported and recorded?
options: Documented, with the identification and assessment of relevant risks supported by qualitative and quantitative analysis and information from relevant internal and external sources
Recorded orally at a management meeting
Supported by quantitative analysis alone
Supported by information from external sources only
en.explain: ¶2.3(a) requires documenting the risk assessment process, which includes the identification and assessment of relevant risks supported by qualitative and quantitative analysis and information obtained from relevant internal and external sources.

tc.q: 風險評估過程本身須如何佐證及記錄？
options: 須以文件記錄；相關風險的識別及評估須有定性及定量分析，以及從相關內部及外部來源取得的資料支持
在管理層會議上以口頭記錄
只須有定量分析支持
只須有外部來源的資料支持
tc.explain: 第2.3(a)段規定須以文件記錄風險評估過程，當中包括識別及評估相關風險，並須有定性及定量分析，以及從相關內部及外部來源取得的資料支持。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(b)段

en.q: Which of the following is listed as a country risk factor in the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: The prevalence of corruption, organised crime or terrorist financing in a jurisdiction
The exchange rate volatility of a jurisdiction's currency
The number of MSOs licensed in a jurisdiction
The average income level in a jurisdiction
en.explain: ¶2.4(b) lists country risk factors including the prevalence of corruption, organised crime or TF; the general level and quality of the jurisdiction's AML/CFT law enforcement efforts; the effectiveness of AML/CFT regulatory regimes and controls; and transparency of beneficial ownership.

tc.q: 下列何者列為機構層面風險評估中的國家風險因素？
options: 某司法管轄區貪污、有組織罪行或恐怖分子資金籌集的普遍程度
某司法管轄區貨幣的匯率波動
某司法管轄區持牌金錢服務經營者的數目
某司法管轄區的平均收入水平
tc.explain: 第2.4(b)段列出的國家風險因素包括：貪污、有組織罪行或恐怖分子資金籌集的普遍程度；該司法管轄區在打擊洗錢方面執法工作的整體水平及質素；打擊洗錢監管制度及管控措施的成效；以及實益擁有權的透明度。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(b)段註腳3

en.q: What does the Guideline mean by “credible sources” when identifying jurisdictions of greater vulnerability?
options: Information produced by reputable and universally recognised international organisations and other bodies that make it publicly and widely available, such as the FATF, the IMF, the World Bank and the Egmont Group
Information from any published news source
Information supplied by the MSO's overseas agents
Information available only to law enforcement agencies
en.explain: Footnote 3 explains that credible sources refers to information produced by reputable and universally recognised international organisations and other bodies that make such information publicly and widely available, including the FATF and FATF-style regional bodies, the IMF, the World Bank, the Egmont Group, and relevant national government bodies and non-government organisations.

tc.q: 在識別較易受影響的司法管轄區時，本指引所指的「可信來源」是甚麼？
options: 由信譽良好且獲普遍公認的國際組織及其他團體所編製、並公開廣泛提供的資料，例如財務行動特別組織、國際貨幣基金組織、世界銀行及埃格蒙特集團
任何已刊登的新聞來源的資料
該經營者海外代理提供的資料
只供執法機構取得的資料
tc.explain: 註腳3解釋「可信來源」指由信譽良好且獲普遍公認的國際組織及其他團體所編製、並公開廣泛提供的資料，包括財務行動特別組織及其區域組織、國際貨幣基金組織、世界銀行、埃格蒙特財富情報組集團，以及相關國家政府機構及非政府組織。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(c)段

en.q: Which of the following is listed as a product, service or transaction risk factor?
options: Whether the products or services may inherently favour anonymity
The profitability of each product line
The length of time each product has been offered
The number of staff assigned to each product line
en.explain: ¶2.4(c) lists product, service or transaction risk factors including the nature, scale, diversity and complexity of the business; the characteristics of products and services and their vulnerability to ML/TF abuse; whether transaction volume and size are in line with usual activity and the customer profile; the extent of technology use; and whether products or services may inherently favour anonymity.

tc.q: 下列何者列為產品、服務或交易風險因素？
options: 有關產品或服務是否本質上有利於匿名
每條產品線的盈利能力
每項產品已提供的時間長短
每條產品線所編配的員工人數
tc.explain: 第2.4(c)段列出的產品、服務或交易風險因素包括：業務的性質、規模、多元程度及複雜程度；產品及服務的特性及其易被用於洗錢的程度；交易數量及規模是否與該經營者的一般活動及客戶狀況相符；使用科技的程度；以及有關產品或服務是否本質上有利於匿名。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(d)段

en.q: Which of the following is listed as a delivery or distribution channel risk factor?
options: The complexity of the payment chain and the settlement systems used among operators in the payment chain
The number of business premises the MSO operates
The opening hours of the MSO's counters
The languages in which the MSO advertises
en.explain: ¶2.4(d) lists delivery or distribution channel risk factors including the extent to which the MSO deals directly with the customer and the extent to which it relies on third parties to conduct CDD; the extent to which agent or counterpart networks are used; and the complexity of the payment chain and the settlement systems used among operators in the payment chain.

tc.q: 下列何者列為交付或分銷渠道風險因素？
options: 付款鏈的複雜程度，以及付款鏈上各營運者所使用的結算系統
該經營者經營的業務處所數目
該經營者櫃檯的營業時間
該經營者宣傳所用的語文
tc.explain: 第2.4(d)段列出的交付或分銷渠道風險因素包括：該經營者直接與客戶往來的程度，以及其倚賴（或獲准倚賴）第三方進行客戶盡職審查的程度；使用代理或對手網絡的程度；以及付款鏈的複雜程度及付款鏈上各營運者所使用的結算系統。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(e)段

en.q: Which of the following is listed among the “other risk factors” in the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: Compliance and regulatory findings, and the results of internal or external audits
The MSO's market share
The MSO's advertising expenditure
The MSO's customer satisfaction ratings
en.explain: ¶2.4(e) lists other risk factors including the nature, scale and quality of available ML/TF risk management resources — including appropriately qualified staff with access to ongoing AML/CFT training and development — compliance and regulatory findings, and the results of internal or external audits.

tc.q: 下列何者列於機構層面風險評估的「其他風險因素」之中？
options: 合規及監管方面的發現，以及內部或外部審計的結果
該經營者的市場佔有率
該經營者的廣告開支
該經營者的客戶滿意度評分
tc.explain: 第2.4(e)段列出的其他風險因素包括：可動用的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險管理資源的性質、規模及質素（包括具備適當資格並可接受持續培訓及發展的員工）；合規及監管方面的發現；以及內部或外部審計的結果。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.6段

en.q: Which external assessments should an MSO consider in its institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: Relevant risk assessments and guidance by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities, including Hong Kong's jurisdiction-wide ML/TF risk assessment and any higher risks notified by the CCE
Only the MSO's own internal audit reports
Only assessments published by the MSO's overseas agents
Only credit rating agency reports on the jurisdictions concerned
en.explain: ¶2.6 states that the assessment should consider quantitative and qualitative information from relevant internal and external sources, which may include relevant risk assessments and guidance by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities from time to time, including Hong Kong's jurisdiction-wide ML/TF risk assessment and any higher risks notified to MSOs by the CCE.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者在機構層面風險評估中應考慮哪些外部評估？
options: 財務行動特別組織、跨政府組織、政府及當局的相關風險評估及指引，包括香港的全面洗錢風險評估，以及海關關長通知的任何較高風險
只需該經營者本身的內部審計報告
只需其海外代理發布的評估
只需信貸評級機構就有關司法管轄區發表的報告
tc.explain: 第2.6段訂明該評估應考慮從相關內部及外部來源取得的定量及定性資料，當中可包括財務行動特別組織、跨政府組織、政府及當局不時作出的相關風險評估及指引，包括香港的全面洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估，以及海關關長通知金錢服務經營者的任何較高風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.7段

en.q: What additional assessment should a locally-incorporated MSO with branches or subsidiaries perform?
options: A group-wide ML/TF risk assessment
A separate assessment for each customer segment
An assessment of each branch's profitability
An assessment by an external consultant in every case
en.explain: ¶2.7 states that a locally-incorporated MSO with branches or subsidiaries, including those located outside Hong Kong, should perform a group-wide ML/TF risk assessment.

tc.q: 在本地註冊成立而設有分支機構或附屬公司的金錢服務經營者，須另行進行甚麼評估？
options: 集團層面的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估
就每個客戶分部分別進行的評估
就每間分支機構盈利能力的評估
在任何情況下均由外部顧問進行的評估
tc.explain: 第2.7段訂明在本地註冊成立而設有分支機構或附屬公司（包括位於香港以外者）的金錢服務經營者，應進行集團層面的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.8段

en.q: On what condition may an MSO that is part of a financial group rely on a group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: Provided the assessments adequately reflect the ML/TF risks posed to the MSO in the local context
Provided the group is headquartered in a FATF member jurisdiction
Provided the assessment is less than five years old
Provided the CCE has approved the group assessment
en.explain: ¶2.8 states that if an MSO is part of a financial group and a group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment has been conducted, it may make reference to or rely on those assessments provided that the assessments adequately reflect ML/TF risks posed to the MSO in the local context.

tc.q: 屬金融集團一部分的金錢服務經營者，在甚麼條件下可倚賴集團層面或區域性的風險評估？
options: 前提是該等評估充分反映該經營者在本地情境下所面對的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
前提是該集團總部設於財務行動特別組織成員司法管轄區
前提是該評估的日期不超過五年
前提是海關關長已批准該集團評估
tc.explain: 第2.8段訂明，如金錢服務經營者屬金融集團的一部分，而已進行集團層面或區域性的風險評估，該經營者可參照或倚賴該等評估，前提是該等評估充分反映該經營者在本地情境下所面對的風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.10段

en.q: Which three matters must the records of an institutional ML/TF risk assessment include?
options: The risk factors identified and assessed, the information sources taken into account, and the evaluation made on the adequacy and appropriateness of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems
The names of the staff who conducted the assessment, the hours spent, and the cost
The customers reviewed, their transaction volumes, and their risk ratings
The date of the assessment, the date of the next review, and the approver's signature
en.explain: ¶2.10 requires an MSO to maintain records and relevant documents of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment, including the risk factors identified and assessed, the information sources taken into account, and the evaluation made on the adequacy and appropriateness of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems.

tc.q: 機構層面風險評估的紀錄須包括哪三項事宜？
options: 已識別及評估的風險因素、已考慮的資料來源，以及就該經營者打擊洗錢系統的充分性及適當性所作的評估
進行評估的員工姓名、所用時數及成本
已檢視的客戶、其交易量及風險評級
評估日期、下次檢視日期及批准人簽署
tc.explain: 第2.10段規定金錢服務經營者須備存機構層面風險評估的紀錄及相關文件，包括已識別及評估的風險因素、已考慮的資料來源，以及就該經營者打擊洗錢系統的充分性及適當性所作的評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.11段

en.q: In relation to which two matters should an MSO identify and assess ML/TF risks under ¶2.11?
options: The development of new products and new business practices including new delivery mechanisms, and the use of new or developing technologies for both new and pre-existing products
New customers and new jurisdictions only
New staff appointments and new premises
New agents and new bank accounts
en.explain: ¶2.11 requires an MSO to identify and assess the ML/TF risks that may arise in relation to the development of new products and new business practices, including new delivery mechanisms, and the use of new or developing technologies for both new and pre-existing products.

tc.q: 根據第2.11段，金錢服務經營者應就哪兩方面識別及評估洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險？
options: 新產品及新業務常規（包括新交付機制）的發展；以及就新產品及現有產品使用新或發展中的科技
只限新客戶及新司法管轄區
新員工委任及新處所
新代理及新銀行帳戶
tc.explain: 第2.11段規定金錢服務經營者須就下列兩方面識別及評估可能產生的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險：新產品及新業務常規（包括新交付機制）的發展；以及就新產品及現有產品使用新或發展中的科技。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.13段

en.q: How does the level of ML/TF risk affect the information obtained and verified in the CDD process?
options: The amount and type of information obtained, and the extent to which it is verified, should be increased where risks are higher and may be simplified where risks are lower
The same information is obtained in every case, and only the frequency of review varies
More information is obtained for lower risk customers, to establish why they are low risk
Verification is required only for higher risk customers; no information is obtained for lower risk ones
en.explain: ¶2.13 states that the assessment conducted at the initial stage of the CDD process determines the extent of CDD measures to be applied: the amount and type of information obtained, and the extent to which it is verified, should be increased where ML/TF risks are higher, and may also be simplified where they are lower.

tc.q: 洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的高低，如何影響客戶盡職審查過程中取得及核實的資料？
options: 風險較高時，所取得資料的數量及類型以及核實程度應予增加；風險較低時則可予簡化
在任何情況下均取得相同資料，只有檢視頻次不同
就低風險客戶取得更多資料，以確立其為何屬低風險
只就高風險客戶進行核實；低風險客戶則無須取得任何資料
tc.explain: 第2.13段訂明在客戶盡職審查過程初期所作的評估，決定須採取的客戶盡職審查措施的程度：如業務關係所涉風險較高，所取得資料的數量及類型以及核實該等資料的程度應予增加；如風險較低，則亦可予簡化。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.14段

en.q: What does the finalised customer risk assessment determine, and what decision does it support?
options: The level and type of ongoing monitoring, including ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring, and the decision whether to enter into, continue or terminate the business relationship
Only the frequency of transaction reporting to the CCE
Only the fees the MSO charges that customer
Only whether the customer may be served without face-to-face contact
en.explain: ¶2.14 states that, based on a holistic view of the information obtained in applying CDD measures, the MSO should be able to finalise the customer risk assessment, which determines the level and type of ongoing monitoring — including ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring — and supports the decision whether to enter into, continue or terminate the business relationship.

tc.q: 最終確定的客戶風險評估決定甚麼？並支持哪項決定？
options: 持續監察的程度及類型（包括持續客戶盡職審查及交易監察），以及是否建立、繼續或終止該業務關係的決定
只決定向海關關長匯報交易的頻次
只決定該經營者向該客戶收取的費用
只決定可否在無面對面接觸下為該客戶提供服務
tc.explain: 第2.14段訂明，金錢服務經營者應根據在採取客戶盡職審查措施過程中所取得資料的整體情況，最終確定客戶風險評估；該評估決定持續監察的程度及類型（包括持續客戶盡職審查及交易監察），並支持該經營者作出是否建立、繼續或終止業務關係的決定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.14段

en.q: When in particular should an MSO review and update a customer's risk assessment?
options: From time to time, and particularly during ongoing monitoring, since the customer risk profile will change over time
Only at the second anniversary of the relationship
Only when the customer requests a change of service
Only when the CCE requires it
en.explain: ¶2.14 states that as the customer risk profile will change over time, an MSO should review and update the risk assessment of a customer from time to time, particularly during ongoing monitoring.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應特別在何時檢視及更新客戶的風險評估？
options: 不時進行，尤其在持續監察期間，因客戶風險狀況會隨時間改變
只在關係建立兩周年時
只在客戶要求更改服務時
只在海關關長要求時
tc.explain: 第2.14段訂明由於客戶風險狀況會隨時間改變，金錢服務經營者應不時檢視及更新客戶的風險評估，尤其在持續監察期間。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.15段

en.q: On what should an MSO's customer risk assessment framework be based, and to what should its complexity be commensurate?
options: Based on the results of the MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment, with complexity commensurate with the nature and size of the MSO's business
Based on a model framework issued by the CCE, with uniform complexity across the sector
Based on the FATF Recommendations alone, with complexity set by the compliance officer
Based on the customer's own declaration, with complexity determined by the customer
en.explain: ¶2.15 states that an MSO should adopt an RBA in the design and implementation of its customer risk assessment framework, that the complexity of the framework should be commensurate with the nature and size of the MSO's business, and that it should be designed based on the results of the MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的客戶風險評估框架應以甚麼為基礎？其複雜程度應與甚麼相稱？
options: 以該經營者機構層面風險評估的結果為基礎，複雜程度應與其業務的性質及規模相稱
以海關關長發出的範本框架為基礎，全行複雜程度劃一
只以財務行動特別組織的建議為基礎，複雜程度由合規主任決定
以客戶本身的聲明為基礎，複雜程度由客戶決定
tc.explain: 第2.15段訂明金錢服務經營者在設計及實施其客戶風險評估框架時應採用風險為本方式；該框架的複雜程度應與該經營者業務的性質及規模相稱，並應根據其機構層面風險評估的結果設計。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.15段

en.q: Which categories of risk factor will a customer risk assessment framework generally include?
options: Customer risk factors; country risk factors; and product, service, transaction or delivery channel risk factors
Credit risk, liquidity risk and market risk factors
Only the customer's nationality and occupation
Only the transaction size and frequency
en.explain: ¶2.15 states that in general the customer risk assessment framework will include customer risk factors; country risk factors; and product, service, transaction or delivery channel risk factors — mirroring the categories used in the institutional assessment at ¶2.4.

tc.q: 客戶風險評估框架一般會包括哪些類別的風險因素？
options: 客戶風險因素；國家風險因素；以及產品、服務、交易或交付渠道風險因素
信貸風險、流動性風險及市場風險因素
只限客戶的國籍及職業
只限交易的金額及頻次
tc.explain: 第2.15段訂明客戶風險評估框架一般會包括客戶風險因素、國家風險因素，以及產品、服務、交易或交付渠道風險因素——與第2.4段機構層面評估所用的類別相對應。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.13段註腳6

en.q: What approach does the Guideline say an MSO should adopt when conducting customer risk assessments and applying CDD measures?
options: A balanced and common sense approach, which should not pose an unreasonable barrier to bona fide business and individuals accessing the MSO's services
The most restrictive approach available in every case
An approach that excludes all customers presenting any identified risk factor
An approach determined solely by the customer's transaction volume
en.explain: Footnote 6 to ¶2.13 states that an MSO should adopt a balanced and common sense approach when conducting a customer risk assessment and applying CDD measures, which should not pose an unreasonable barrier to bona fide business and individuals accessing services offered by the MSO.

tc.q: 本指引指出金錢服務經營者在進行客戶風險評估及採取客戶盡職審查措施時，應採取甚麼取態？
options: 平衡而合乎常理的取態，不應對真誠的商戶及個人使用該經營者所提供服務造成不合理障礙
在任何情況下均採取最嚴格的取態
將所有帶有任何已識別風險因素的客戶排除在外
純粹按客戶交易量而定的取態
tc.explain: 第2.13段註腳6訂明金錢服務經營者在進行客戶風險評估及採取客戶盡職審查措施時，應採取平衡而合乎常理的取態，不應對真誠的商戶及個人使用該經營者所提供的服務造成不合理障礙。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.14段註腳7

en.q: By what other name is the finalised customer risk assessment sometimes known?
options: A customer risk profile
A customer due diligence file
A know-your-customer certificate
A customer acceptance policy
en.explain: Footnote 7 to ¶2.14 notes that the finalised customer risk assessment is sometimes also called a customer risk profile. The term is used throughout the Guideline, for example in the ongoing monitoring provisions.

tc.q: 最終確定的客戶風險評估有時亦稱為甚麼？
options: 客戶風險狀況
客戶盡職審查檔案
認識你的客戶證明書
客戶接納政策
tc.explain: 第2.14段註腳7指出，最終確定的客戶風險評估有時亦稱為「客戶風險狀況」。該詞在本指引中通用，例如見於持續監察的條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.2(b)及(c)段

en.q: Besides having senior-management-approved AML/CFT Systems, what two further things should an MSO do under ¶3.2?
options: Monitor the implementation of those Systems and enhance them if necessary, and take enhanced measures to manage and mitigate risks where higher risks are identified
Publish the Systems on its website and file them with the CCE annually
Obtain an external audit of the Systems every year and report the result to customers
Insure against the failure of the Systems and set aside a contingency reserve
en.explain: ¶3.2 requires an MSO to have AML/CFT Systems approved by senior management to enable it to effectively manage and mitigate relevant risks; to monitor the implementation of those Systems and enhance them if necessary; and to take enhanced measures to manage and mitigate the risks where higher risks are identified.

tc.q: 除須設有經高級管理層批准的打擊洗錢系統外，第3.2段還要求金錢服務經營者作出哪兩項？
options: 監察該等系統的實施情況並在必要時加以強化；以及在識別出較高風險時採取加強措施管理及減低風險
在其網站公開該等系統，並每年向海關關長存檔
每年就該等系統取得外部審計，並向客戶報告結果
就系統失效投購保險並預留應急儲備
tc.explain: 第3.2段規定金錢服務經營者須設有經高級管理層批准的打擊洗錢系統，使其能有效管理及減低相關風險；監察該等系統的實施情況，並在必要時加以強化；以及在識別出較高風險時採取加強措施管理及減低風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.3段

en.q: Which three conditions must be satisfied before an MSO may simplify the nature, scale and complexity of its AML/CFT Systems?
options: Compliance with Schedule 2 and paragraphs 2.2, 2.3 and 3.2; identification of the lower risks through an appropriate risk assessment; and senior management approval of the simplified Systems, subject to review from time to time
Approval by the CCE; a written legal opinion; and an external audit
A turnover below a prescribed threshold; fewer than ten staff; and a single business premises
A clean compliance record for five years; no high-risk customers; and no overseas operations
en.explain: ¶3.3 permits simplification provided the MSO complies with the statutory requirements in Schedule 2 and the requirements in paragraphs 2.2, 2.3 and 3.2; the lower ML/TF risks forming the basis have been identified through an appropriate risk assessment; and the simplified Systems, approved by senior management, are subject to review from time to time.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須符合哪三項條件，方可簡化其打擊洗錢系統的性質、規模及複雜程度？
options: 遵從附表2及第2.2、2.3及3.2段的規定；透過適當的風險評估識別出作為依據的較低風險；以及經高級管理層批准的簡化系統須不時接受檢視
取得海關關長批准；書面法律意見；以及外部審計
營業額低於訂明門檻；員工少於十人；以及只有單一業務處所
五年並無違規紀錄；並無高風險客戶；以及並無海外業務
tc.explain: 第3.3段准許在下列條件下簡化：該經營者遵從附表2的法定規定及第2.2、2.3及3.2段的規定；作為依據的較低洗錢風險已透過適當的風險評估（例如機構層面風險評估）識別；以及經高級管理層批准的簡化系統須不時接受檢視。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.3段

en.q: In which circumstance are AML/CFT Systems never permitted to be simplified?
options: Whenever there is a suspicion of ML/TF
Whenever the customer is a corporation
Whenever the transaction exceeds $8,000
Whenever the MSO operates at more than one premises
en.explain: ¶3.3 concludes that, however the three conditions may be met, AML/CFT Systems are not permitted to be simplified whenever there is a suspicion of ML/TF. Schedule 2 takes the same approach in section 3(1)(d), which requires CDD on suspicion regardless of thresholds.

tc.q: 在甚麼情況下打擊洗錢系統絕不可簡化？
options: 凡有洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑時
凡客戶是法團時
凡交易超過8,000元時
凡該經營者在多於一個處所經營時
tc.explain: 第3.3段最後訂明，不論三項條件是否符合，凡有洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑時，打擊洗錢系統均不得簡化。附表2第3(1)(d)條採取相同取態，規定一有懷疑即須進行客戶盡職審查，不論門檻為何。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.5段

en.q: What is the stated purpose of an MSO's compliance management arrangements?
options: To facilitate the MSO to implement AML/CFT Systems to comply with relevant legal and regulatory obligations and to manage ML/TF risks effectively
To reduce the cost of compliance to a minimum
To centralise all customer records in a single department
To provide a defence to any future disciplinary proceedings
en.explain: ¶3.5 states that an MSO should have appropriate compliance management arrangements that facilitate the MSO to implement AML/CFT Systems to comply with relevant legal and regulatory obligations as well as to manage ML/TF risks effectively, and that these should at a minimum include senior management oversight and the appointment of a CO and an MLRO.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的合規管理安排，其訂明目的為何？
options: 促使該經營者實施打擊洗錢系統，以遵從相關法律及監管責任，並有效管理洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
將合規成本減至最低
將所有客戶紀錄集中於單一部門
為日後任何紀律程序提供抗辯理由
tc.explain: 第3.5段訂明金錢服務經營者應設有適當的合規管理安排，促使其實施打擊洗錢系統，以遵從相關法律及監管責任，並有效管理洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險；該等安排至少應包括高級管理層的監督，以及委任合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.6段

en.q: In what manner must management information on ML/TF risks and the AML/CFT Systems be communicated to the board and senior management?
options: In a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner, so that they are equipped to make informed decisions
In summary form only, to avoid overloading the board
Annually, in the audited financial statements
Only when a material breach has occurred
en.explain: ¶3.6 states that effective ML/TF risk management requires adequate governance arrangements, that the board of directors or its delegated committee and senior management should have a clear understanding of the ML/TF risks and ensure they are adequately managed, and that management information should be communicated to them in a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner so that they are equipped to make informed decisions.

tc.q: 有關洗錢風險及打擊洗錢系統的管理資訊，須以何種方式傳達予董事會及高級管理層？
options: 以及時、完整、易於理解及準確的方式傳達，使他們能作出知情的決定
只以摘要形式傳達，以免董事會負荷過重
每年於經審計財務報表中傳達
只在發生重大違規時傳達
tc.explain: 第3.6段訂明有效的洗錢風險管理須有充分的管治安排；董事會或其獲授權委員會（如適用）及高級管理層應清楚了解其洗錢風險並確保該等風險獲充分管理；有關管理資訊須以及時、完整、易於理解及準確的方式向他們傳達，使他們能作出知情的決定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8(b)段

en.q: What does the Guideline say about the independence of the CO and MLRO from operational and business functions?
options: They should be independent of all operational and business functions, subject to the constraint of the size of the MSO
They must always be wholly independent, whatever the size of the MSO
Independence is not required at all
They must be independent only where the MSO has more than ten employees
en.explain: ¶3.8(b) states that senior management should, as far as practicable, ensure that the CO and MLRO are, subject to constraint of size of the MSO, independent of all operational and business functions — recognising that a small MSO may not be able to achieve full separation.

tc.q: 本指引就合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任獨立於營運及業務職能一事有何說明？
options: 在該經營者規模的限制下，他們應獨立於所有營運及業務職能
不論該經營者規模如何，他們必須完全獨立
完全無須獨立
只有在該經營者僱員超過十人時方須獨立
tc.explain: 第3.8(b)段訂明高級管理層應在切實可行範圍內，確保合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任在該經營者規模的限制下，獨立於所有營運及業務職能——此表述顧及小型經營者未必能完全分隔職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8(c)及(h)段

en.q: Where should the CO and MLRO normally be based, and what cover should be provided for their absence?
options: Normally based in Hong Kong, with an alternate or deputy CO and MLRO who should, where practicable, have the same status
Anywhere within the group, with cover provided by the external auditor
Normally based in Hong Kong, with no cover required
At the group head office, with cover provided by group compliance
en.explain: ¶3.8(c) states that the CO and MLRO should normally be based in Hong Kong, and ¶3.8(h) requires them to be equipped with sufficient resources, including staff and appropriate cover for their absence — that is, an alternate or deputy CO and MLRO who should, where practicable, have the same status.

tc.q: 合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任通常應駐於何處？其缺席時應有甚麼替代安排？
options: 通常應駐於香港；並應設有署理或副合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任，而在切實可行範圍內應具備相同地位
可駐於集團內任何地方，缺席時由外部核數師代理
通常應駐於香港，無須替代安排
駐於集團總部，缺席時由集團合規部門代理
tc.explain: 第3.8(c)段訂明合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任通常應駐於香港；第3.8(h)段則規定須為其配備足夠資源，包括人手及其缺席時的適當替代安排——即署理或副合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任，而在切實可行範圍內應具備相同地位。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8(e)段

en.q: Why should the CO and MLRO have regular contact with, and when required direct access to, senior management?
options: So that senior management can satisfy itself that the statutory obligations are being met and that the business is taking sufficiently effective measures to protect itself against ML/TF risks
So that senior management can approve each suspicious transaction report
So that the CO and MLRO can be appraised for remuneration purposes
So that senior management can delegate its statutory duties to them
en.explain: ¶3.8(e) requires senior management to ensure the CO and MLRO are provided with regular contact with, and when required direct access to, senior management, to ensure that senior management is able to satisfy itself that the statutory obligations are being met and that the business is taking sufficiently effective measures to protect itself against the risks of ML/TF.

tc.q: 為何合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任應與高級管理層保持定期接觸，並在需要時可直接聯絡？
options: 使高級管理層能信納法定責任正獲履行，並信納該業務正採取足夠有效的措施以防範洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
使高級管理層可批准每份可疑交易報告
使該兩名主任可就薪酬事宜接受評核
使高級管理層可將其法定職責轉授予他們
tc.explain: 第3.8(e)段規定高級管理層須確保合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任可與高級管理層保持定期接觸，並在需要時直接聯絡，以確保高級管理層能信納法定責任正獲履行，並信納該業務正採取足夠有效的措施以防範洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8(g)段

en.q: What information access should the CO and MLRO have?
options: Timely access to all available information, both from internal sources such as CDD records and external sources such as circulars from the CCE
Access to internal CDD records only
Access to external circulars only
Access only to information relating to customers assessed as high risk
en.explain: ¶3.8(g) requires the CO and MLRO to be capable of accessing, on a timely basis, all available information — both from internal sources such as CDD records and external sources such as circulars from the CCE.

tc.q: 合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任應可取得甚麼資料？
options: 可及時取得所有可得資料，包括內部來源（例如客戶盡職審查紀錄）及外部來源（例如海關關長的通函）
只可取得內部客戶盡職審查紀錄
只可取得外部通函
只可取得與被評為高風險客戶有關的資料
tc.explain: 第3.8(g)段規定合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任須能及時取得所有可得資料，包括來自內部來源（例如客戶盡職審查紀錄）及外部來源（例如海關關長的通函）的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.9(a)段

en.q: Which responsibility of the Compliance Officer relates to keeping the AML/CFT Systems current?
options: Developing and continuously reviewing the Systems, including group-wide Systems for a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO, so they remain up-to-date, meet current requirements and are effective
Approving each new customer relationship
Reporting suspicious transactions to the JFIU
Conducting the annual independent audit
en.explain: ¶3.9(a) makes the CO responsible for developing and/or continuously reviewing the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, including any group-wide Systems in the case of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO, to ensure they remain up-to-date, meet current statutory and regulatory requirements, and are effective in managing the ML/TF risks arising from the business.

tc.q: 合規主任的哪一項職責關乎保持打擊洗錢系統與時並進？
options: 制定及持續檢視該等系統（就在香港註冊成立的經營者而言，包括集團層面系統），以確保其保持最新、符合現行規定並有效
批准每段新的客戶關係
向聯合財富情報組匯報可疑交易
進行年度獨立審計
tc.explain: 第3.9(a)段訂明合規主任須負責制定及／或持續檢視該經營者的打擊洗錢系統（就在香港註冊成立的經營者而言，包括任何集團層面系統），以確保其保持最新、符合現行法定及監管規定，並能有效管理其業務所產生的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.9(c)及(d)段

en.q: Which two further responsibilities does the Guideline assign to the Compliance Officer?
options: Communicating key AML/CFT issues with senior management, including significant compliance deficiencies where appropriate; and ensuring AML/CFT staff training is adequate, appropriate and effective
Approving all transactions above $120,000; and signing the annual accounts
Interviewing all new customers; and maintaining the sanctions database
Conducting the independent audit; and reporting to the CCE quarterly
en.explain: ¶3.9 lists the CO's responsibilities as developing and reviewing the Systems; overseeing all aspects of them including monitoring effectiveness and enhancing controls; communicating key AML/CFT issues with senior management including significant compliance deficiencies; and ensuring AML/CFT staff training is adequate, appropriate and effective.

tc.q: 本指引還賦予合規主任哪兩項職責？
options: 與高級管理層溝通打擊洗錢的關鍵事宜（在適當情況下包括重大合規缺失）；以及確保員工的打擊洗錢培訓充分、適當及有效
批准所有超過120,000元的交易；以及簽署周年帳目
面見所有新客戶；以及維護制裁資料庫
進行獨立審計；以及每季向海關關長匯報
tc.explain: 第3.9段列出合規主任的職責為：制定及檢視該等系統；監督該等系統的各方面，包括監察成效及在必要時強化管控措施及程序；與高級管理層溝通打擊洗錢的關鍵事宜，包括在適當情況下的重大合規缺失；以及確保員工的打擊洗錢培訓充分、適當及有效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.10段

en.q: Besides being the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions, what other role does the MLRO have?
options: The main point of contact with the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit and law enforcement agencies
The main point of contact with the MSO's bankers
The chair of the MSO's board risk committee
The custodian of the MSO's customer records
en.explain: ¶3.10 states that an MSO should appoint an MLRO as a central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and also as the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies, and that the MLRO should play an active role in the identification and reporting of suspicious transactions.

tc.q: 除擔任匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點外，打擊洗錢報告主任還有甚麼角色？
options: 與聯合財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點
與該經營者往來銀行的主要聯絡點
該經營者董事會風險委員會主席
該經營者客戶紀錄的保管人
tc.explain: 第3.10段訂明金錢服務經營者應委任打擊洗錢報告主任，擔任匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點，並擔任與聯合財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點；該主任應在識別及匯報可疑交易方面發揮積極作用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.10(c)段

en.q: Which guidance function is listed among the principal functions of the MLRO?
options: Provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off
Provision of guidance on customer pricing
Provision of guidance on staff recruitment
Provision of guidance on premises selection
en.explain: ¶3.10 lists the MLRO's principal functions as having oversight of the review of internal disclosures and exception reports and determining whether a report to the JFIU is necessary; maintenance of all records related to such internal reviews; and provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off.

tc.q: 打擊洗錢報告主任的主要職能中，列出哪一項指引職能？
options: 就如何避免洩密提供指引
就客戶定價提供指引
就員工招聘提供指引
就處所選址提供指引
tc.explain: 第3.10段列出打擊洗錢報告主任的主要職能為：監督內部披露及例外報告的檢視，並根據所有可得相關資料決定是否須向聯合財富情報組作出報告；備存所有與該等內部檢視有關的紀錄；以及就如何避免洩密提供指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.11段

en.q: What two features must an MSO's independent audit function have?
options: A direct line of communication to senior management, and sufficient expertise and resources to carry out its responsibilities including independent reviews of the AML/CFT Systems
An external auditor and a board seat
A separate budget and a right of veto over new products
A direct reporting line to the CCE and statutory immunity
en.explain: ¶3.11 states that an MSO should establish an independent audit function which should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO, and that the function should have sufficient expertise and resources to enable it to carry out its responsibilities, including independent reviews of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的獨立審計職能須具備哪兩項特徵？
options: 與高級管理層有直接溝通渠道；以及具備足夠專業知識及資源以履行其職責（包括獨立檢視打擊洗錢系統）
外部核數師及董事會席位
獨立預算及對新產品的否決權
直接向海關關長匯報及法定豁免權
tc.explain: 第3.11段訂明金錢服務經營者應設立獨立審計職能，該職能應與該經營者的高級管理層有直接溝通渠道；並應具備足夠的專業知識及資源，以履行其職責，包括獨立檢視該經營者的打擊洗錢系統。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.12段

en.q: Which four matters should the audit function's regular review of the AML/CFT Systems include?
options: Adequacy of the Systems, the ML/TF risk assessment framework and application of the RBA; effectiveness of suspicious transaction reporting systems; effectiveness of the compliance function; and the level of awareness of staff having AML/CFT responsibilities
Profitability, staffing levels, premises condition and customer numbers
Accuracy of the accounts, tax compliance, insurance cover and data privacy
Marketing effectiveness, pricing, competitor analysis and market share
en.explain: ¶3.12 states that the audit function should regularly review the AML/CFT Systems to ensure effectiveness, and that the review should include but not be limited to the adequacy of the Systems, the ML/TF risk assessment framework and application of the RBA; the effectiveness of suspicious transaction reporting systems; the effectiveness of the compliance function; and the level of awareness of staff having AML/CFT responsibilities.

tc.q: 審計職能對打擊洗錢系統的定期檢視，應包括哪四項事宜？
options: 該等系統、洗錢風險評估框架及風險為本方式應用的充分性；可疑交易匯報系統的成效；合規職能的成效；以及負有打擊洗錢職責員工的認知水平
盈利能力、人手水平、處所狀況及客戶數目
帳目準確性、稅務合規、保險保障及資料私隱
市場推廣成效、定價、競爭對手分析及市場佔有率
tc.explain: 第3.12段訂明審計職能應定期檢視打擊洗錢系統以確保其成效；檢視應包括但不限於：該經營者打擊洗錢系統、洗錢風險評估框架及風險為本方式應用的充分性；可疑交易匯報系統的成效；合規職能的成效；以及負有打擊洗錢職責員工的認知水平。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.13段

en.q: To what should the frequency and extent of the independent audit review be commensurate, and what further step may be appropriate?
options: Commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the business and the ML/TF risks arising from it; and where appropriate the MSO should also seek a review from external parties
Commensurate with the MSO's turnover; and the review must always be external
Fixed at once a year for all MSOs; and no external review is permitted
Determined by the CCE in each case; and external review requires the CCE's approval
en.explain: ¶3.13 states that the frequency and extent of the review should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's business and the ML/TF risks arising from those businesses, and that where appropriate the MSO should also seek a review from external parties.

tc.q: 獨立審計檢視的頻次及範圍應與甚麼相稱？還可採取甚麼進一步步驟？
options: 與業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，以及該等業務所產生的洗錢風險相稱；並在適當情況下亦應尋求外部人士進行檢視
與該經營者的營業額相稱；而檢視必須一律由外部進行
所有經營者一律每年一次；並不准許外部檢視
由海關關長就個別個案決定；外部檢視須經關長批准
tc.explain: 第3.13段訂明檢視的頻次及範圍應與該經營者業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，以及該等業務所產生的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱；在適當情況下，該經營者亦應尋求外部人士進行檢視。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.14段

en.q: What is the stated purpose of an MSO's employee screening procedures?
options: To ensure high standards when hiring employees
To verify employees' entitlement to work in Hong Kong
To assess employees' training needs
To determine employees' remuneration levels
en.explain: ¶3.14 states that an MSO should have adequate and appropriate screening procedures in order to ensure high standards when hiring employees. Employee screening procedures are one of the four components of AML/CFT Systems listed at ¶3.4.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者僱員甄別程序的訂明目的為何？
options: 確保在聘用僱員時維持高標準
核實僱員在香港工作的資格
評估僱員的培訓需要
釐定僱員的薪酬水平
tc.explain: 第3.14段訂明金錢服務經營者應設有充分及適當的甄別程序，以確保在聘用僱員時維持高標準。僱員甄別程序是第3.4段所列打擊洗錢系統四項組成部分之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.7段

en.q: At what level within the MSO should the CO be appointed, and what is the CO's overall responsibility?
options: At the management level, with overall responsibility for the establishment and maintenance of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems
At any level, with responsibility for reporting suspicious transactions
At board level only, with responsibility for approving new customers
At operational level, with responsibility for daily transaction checking
en.explain: ¶3.7 states that senior management is responsible for implementing effective AML/CFT Systems and, in particular, should appoint a CO at the management level to have the overall responsibility for the establishment and maintenance of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, and a senior staff member as the MLRO to act as the central reference point for suspicious transaction reporting.

tc.q: 合規主任應在該經營者的哪一層級獲委任？其整體職責為何？
options: 在管理層級獲委任，並就該經營者打擊洗錢系統的建立及維持負整體責任
在任何層級獲委任，並負責匯報可疑交易
只可在董事會層級獲委任，並負責批准新客戶
在營運層級獲委任，並負責每日交易查核
tc.explain: 第3.7段訂明高級管理層負責實施能充分管理所識別洗錢風險的有效打擊洗錢系統；尤其應在管理層級委任合規主任，就該經營者打擊洗錢系統的建立及維持負整體責任，並委任一名高級員工為打擊洗錢報告主任，擔任可疑交易匯報的中央聯絡點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.4段

en.q: Which four elements should an MSO's AML/CFT Systems include under ¶3.4?
options: Compliance management arrangements, an independent audit function, employee screening procedures, and an ongoing employee training programme
A board risk committee, an external auditor, a legal adviser and an insurance policy
A customer acceptance policy, a pricing policy, a complaints policy and a records policy
A sanctions database, a transaction monitoring system, a reporting hotline and a whistleblowing channel
en.explain: ¶3.4 states that an MSO should implement AML/CFT Systems having regard to the nature, size and complexity of its businesses and the ML/TF risks arising from those businesses, and that the Systems should include compliance management arrangements, an independent audit function, employee screening procedures, and an ongoing employee training programme.

tc.q: 根據第3.4段，金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢系統應包括哪四項要素？
options: 合規管理安排、獨立審計職能、僱員甄別程序，以及持續的僱員培訓計劃
董事會風險委員會、外部核數師、法律顧問及保險單
客戶接納政策、定價政策、投訴政策及紀錄政策
制裁資料庫、交易監察系統、舉報熱線及舉報渠道
tc.explain: 第3.4段訂明金錢服務經營者應顧及其業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，以及該等業務所產生的洗錢風險，實施打擊洗錢系統；該等系統應包括合規管理安排、獨立審計職能、僱員甄別程序，以及持續的僱員培訓計劃。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.7段註腳9

en.q: May the functions of the CO and the MLRO be performed by the same person?
options: Yes — depending on the size of the MSO, the functions may be performed by the same person
No — the two roles must always be held by different individuals
Yes, but only with the CCE's written approval
Yes, but only where the MSO has no overseas operations
en.explain: Footnote 9 to ¶3.7 states that, depending on the size of an MSO, the functions of CO and MLRO may be performed by the same person. The Licensing Guide at paragraph 4.15(a) contemplates the same, providing for the case where the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner is also the CO and MLRO.

tc.q: 合規主任與打擊洗錢報告主任的職能可否由同一人擔任？
options: 可以——視乎該經營者的規模，該兩項職能可由同一人擔任
不可以——兩個職位必須由不同人士出任
可以，但須取得海關關長書面批准
可以，但只限該經營者並無海外業務
tc.explain: 第3.7段註腳9訂明，視乎金錢服務經營者的規模，合規主任與打擊洗錢報告主任的職能可由同一人擔任。《牌照指引》第4.15(a)段亦有相同考量，訂明獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人同時擔任該兩個職位的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.15段

en.q: Which overseas entities must a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO cover with its group-wide AML/CFT Systems?
options: Its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as a financial institution as defined in the AMLO
Every company in which it holds any shareholding
Only its wholly owned overseas subsidiaries
Only overseas entities located in FATF member jurisdictions
en.explain: ¶3.15 states that, subject to ¶3.18 and ¶3.19, a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO with overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as a financial institution as defined in the AMLO should implement group-wide AML/CFT Systems applying the requirements of the Guideline to all of them, wherever those requirements are relevant and applicable.

tc.q: 在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者，其集團層面打擊洗錢系統須涵蓋哪些境外實體？
options: 其境外分支機構及經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的附屬企業
其持有任何股權的每一間公司
只限其全資擁有的境外附屬公司
只限位於財務行動特別組織成員司法管轄區的境外實體
tc.explain: 第3.15段訂明，在第3.18及3.19段的規限下，在香港註冊成立而設有境外分支機構或經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的附屬企業的金錢服務經營者，應實施集團層面打擊洗錢系統，在本指引的規定相關及適用之處，將該等規定適用於所有該等分支機構及附屬企業。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.16段

en.q: What must a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO ensure, through its group-wide Systems, about its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings?
options: That they have procedures in place to ensure compliance with CDD and record-keeping requirements similar to those under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2, to the extent permitted by the laws of that place
That they apply Hong Kong law in priority to local law
That they report directly to the CCE
That they use the same information technology systems as the Hong Kong entity
en.explain: ¶3.16 states that, in particular, a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO should through its group-wide AML/CFT Systems ensure that all of its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings carrying on the same business as an FI have procedures in place to ensure compliance with CDD and record-keeping requirements similar to those imposed under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2, to the extent permitted by the laws and regulations of that place.

tc.q: 在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者，須透過其集團層面系統確保其境外分支機構及附屬企業具備甚麼？
options: 設有程序，以在該地方法律准許的範圍內，確保遵從與附表2第2及3部類似的客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存規定
優先適用香港法律而非當地法律
直接向海關關長匯報
使用與香港實體相同的資訊科技系統
tc.explain: 第3.16段訂明在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者，尤其應透過其集團層面打擊洗錢系統，確保其所有經營與金融機構相同業務的境外分支機構及附屬企業，設有程序以在該地方法律及規例准許的範圍內，確保遵從與附表2第2及3部所施加者類似的客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.17段

en.q: Subject to what safeguards should a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO implement group-wide information-sharing measures?
options: Adequate safeguards on the protection of confidentiality and use of the information shared, including safeguards to prevent tipping off, and to the extent permitted by the laws of the jurisdictions involved
The written consent of each customer whose information is shared
The prior approval of the CCE for each transfer of information
A data-sharing agreement registered with the Privacy Commissioner
en.explain: ¶3.17 states that, to the extent permitted by the laws and regulations of the jurisdictions involved and subject to adequate safeguards on the protection of confidentiality and use of information being shared — including safeguards to prevent tipping off — a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO should implement group-wide measures for sharing information and for provision of information to group-level functions.

tc.q: 在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者實施集團層面資料分享措施時，須受哪些保障規限？
options: 就所分享資料的保密及使用設有充分保障（包括防止洩密的保障），並以所涉司法管轄區的法律准許者為限
每名其資料被分享的客戶的書面同意
每次傳送資料均須事先取得海關關長批准
向個人資料私隱專員登記的資料分享協議
tc.explain: 第3.17段訂明，在所涉司法管轄區的法律及規例准許的範圍內，並在就所分享資料的保密及使用設有充分保障（包括防止洩密的保障）的前提下，在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者應透過其集團層面系統實施資料分享及向集團層面職能提供資料的措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.17(b)段

en.q: What information should be provided to a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO's group-level compliance, audit or AML/CFT functions?
options: Customer, account and transaction information from its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings carrying on the same business as a financial institution, when necessary for AML/CFT purposes
Only aggregate statistical data
Only information relating to customers assessed as high risk
Only information that has already been reported to the JFIU
en.explain: ¶3.17(b) requires measures for provision to the MSO's group-level compliance, audit and/or AML/CFT functions of customer, account and transaction information from its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as an FI as defined in the AMLO, when necessary for AML/CFT purposes.

tc.q: 在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者，其集團層面合規、審計或打擊洗錢職能應獲提供甚麼資料？
options: 在打擊洗錢用途有需要時，來自其經營與金融機構相同業務的境外分支機構及附屬企業的客戶、帳戶及交易資料
只需匯總統計數據
只需被評為高風險客戶的資料
只需已向聯合財富情報組匯報的資料
tc.explain: 第3.17(b)段規定須設有措施，在打擊洗錢用途有需要時，向該經營者的集團層面合規、審計及／或打擊洗錢職能提供來自其經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的境外分支機構及附屬企業的客戶、帳戶及交易資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.17段註腳11

en.q: What may the information shared with group-level functions include, according to footnote 11?
options: Information and analysis of transactions or activities which appear unusual, and could include a suspicious transaction report, its underlying information, or the fact that one has been submitted
Only customer identification documents
Only records of completed transactions
Only the MSO's own internal audit findings
en.explain: Footnote 11 states that this should include information and analysis of transactions or activities which appear unusual, where such analysis was done, and could include a suspicious transaction report, its underlying information, or the fact that a suspicious transaction report has been submitted; branches and subsidiaries should similarly receive such information from group-level functions when relevant to risk management.

tc.q: 根據註腳11，與集團層面職能分享的資料可包括甚麼？
options: 看來屬不尋常的交易或活動的資料及分析；並可包括可疑交易報告、其所依據的資料，或已提交可疑交易報告一事
只限客戶身分識別文件
只限已完成交易的紀錄
只限該經營者本身的內部審計發現
tc.explain: 註腳11訂明此應包括看來屬不尋常的交易或活動的資料及分析（如已作出該等分析）；並可包括可疑交易報告、其所依據的資料，或已提交可疑交易報告一事。分支機構及附屬企業在與風險管理相關及適當時，亦應從集團層面職能接收該等資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.18段

en.q: Where the host jurisdiction's AML/CFT requirements differ from Hong Kong's, which set must the overseas branch or subsidiary apply?
options: The higher of the two sets of requirements, to the extent that the host jurisdiction's laws and regulations permit
The host jurisdiction's requirements in every case
Hong Kong's requirements in every case
Whichever set the group's head office selects
en.explain: ¶3.18 states that if the AML/CFT requirements in the host jurisdiction differ from those referred to in ¶3.15, the MSO should require that branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher of the two sets of requirements, to the extent that host jurisdiction's laws and regulations permit.

tc.q: 如所在地司法管轄區的打擊洗錢規定與香港的規定有異，該境外分支機構或附屬企業須適用哪一套規定？
options: 在該所在地司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍內，適用兩套規定中較高者
在任何情況下均適用所在地司法管轄區的規定
在任何情況下均適用香港的規定
由集團總部選定的一套
tc.explain: 第3.18段訂明，如所在地司法管轄區的打擊洗錢規定與第3.15段所述的相關規定有異，該經營者應要求該分支機構或附屬企業在該所在地司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍內，適用兩套規定中較高者。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.19段

en.q: Where host jurisdiction law does not permit an overseas branch to apply the higher AML/CFT requirements, what must the MSO do?
options: Inform the CCE of the failure, and take additional measures to effectively mitigate the ML/TF risks faced by the branch as a result
Close the branch immediately
Apply the Hong Kong requirements regardless of local law
Transfer the branch's customers to the Hong Kong entity
en.explain: ¶3.19 states that if the laws and regulations of the host jurisdiction do not permit the branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher AML/CFT requirements — particularly the CDD and record-keeping requirements under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2 — the MSO should inform the CCE of such failure and take additional measures to effectively mitigate the ML/TF risks faced as a result. This mirrors section 22(2) of Schedule 2.

tc.q: 如所在地司法管轄區的法律不准許境外分支機構適用較高的打擊洗錢規定，該經營者須怎樣做？
options: 將該情況通知海關關長，並採取額外措施有效減低該分支機構因此而面對的洗錢風險
立即結束該分支機構
不論當地法律如何，一律適用香港規定
將該分支機構的客戶轉移至香港實體
tc.explain: 第3.19段訂明，如所在地司法管轄區的法律及規例不准許該分支機構或附屬企業適用較高的打擊洗錢規定（尤其是附表2第2及3部所施加的客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存規定），該經營者應將該情況通知海關關長，並採取額外措施有效減低其因此而面對的洗錢風險。此與附表2第22(2)條相對應。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(3)條；《打擊洗錢指引》第3.2段

en.q: How does the statutory duty in section 19(3) of Schedule 2 relate to the Guideline's requirement for senior-management-approved AML/CFT Systems?
options: Section 19(3) requires effective procedures not inconsistent with the Ordinance for carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15 of Schedule 2; the Guideline requires those Systems to be approved by senior management and kept under review
Section 19(3) replaces the Guideline requirement
The Guideline requirement applies only where section 19(3) does not
The two impose identical obligations in identical terms
en.explain: Section 19(3) of Schedule 2 requires an institution, in respect of each kind of customer, business relationship, product and transaction, to establish and maintain effective procedures not inconsistent with the Ordinance for carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15. ¶3.2 of the Guideline adds that the AML/CFT Systems should be approved by senior management, monitored in implementation and enhanced if necessary.

tc.q: 附表2第19(3)條的法定責任，與本指引就經高級管理層批准的打擊洗錢系統的要求有何關係？
options: 第19(3)條規定須設有與本條例並無抵觸的有效程序，以履行附表2第3、4、5、9、10及15條的責任；本指引則要求該等系統須經高級管理層批准並持續檢視
第19(3)條取代本指引的要求
本指引的要求只在第19(3)條不適用時方適用
兩者以完全相同的措辭施加完全相同的責任
tc.explain: 附表2第19(3)條規定機構須就每種客戶、業務關係、產品及交易，建立及維持與本條例並無抵觸的有效程序，以履行第3、4、5、9、10及15條下的責任。本指引第3.2段則補充該等打擊洗錢系統須經高級管理層批准，並須監察其實施情況及在必要時加以強化。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(j)段

en.q: Which governance shortcoming does the Supplementary F&P Guideline treat as relevant to fitness and propriety?
options: Failure to establish an organizational structure and personnel that comply with the relevant legislative or regulatory requirements
Failure to achieve a target return on capital
Failure to adopt a written dividend policy
Failure to appoint a non-executive director
en.explain: Paragraph 6(j) of the Supplementary F&P Guideline makes relevant whether the person has failed to establish an organizational structure and personnel that comply with the relevant legislative or regulatory requirements — a governance criterion sitting alongside the internal control criterion in paragraph 6(k).

tc.q: 《適當人選補充指引》將哪一項管治缺失視為與適當人選資格有關？
options: 未有建立符合相關法例或監管規定的組織架構及人手編制
未有達到資本回報目標
未有採納書面股息政策
未有委任非執行董事
tc.explain: 《適當人選補充指引》第6(j)段將該人有否未有建立符合相關法例或監管規定的組織架構及人手編制列為相關因素——此管治準則與第6(k)段的內部監控準則並列。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 13
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第13項

en.q: Which governance element heads the list of matters the AML/CFT compliance function section of the policy must elaborate?
options: Management oversight
The compliance department's headcount
The compliance budget
The compliance software in use
en.explain: Item 13 of the AML/CFT Policy submission guidelines requires elaboration of the AML/CFT compliance function, giving as examples management oversight, the roles of the compliance department, any relevant committee or panel, and the duties and responsibilities of the compliance officer and compliance staff — management oversight coming first.

tc.q: 政策中打擊洗錢合規職能部分須詳述的事項，以哪一項管治要素為首？
options: 管理層監督
合規部門的人數
合規預算
所使用的合規軟件
tc.explain: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》第13項規定須詳述打擊洗錢合規職能，並以管理層監督、合規部門的角色、任何相關委員會／小組，以及合規主任及合規人員的職責為例；當中以管理層監督為首。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — Understanding of ML/TF risks
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——了解洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險

en.q: What governance step does the TBML circular require where multiple risk indicators are present on a customer?
options: Flagging and escalating the case to the MSO's senior management
Closing the customer's account without notice
Referring the case to the external auditor
Reporting the case to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: The circular states that particular attention should be given to flagging and escalating cases to MSOs' senior management where multiple risk indicators are present on customers, supported by adequate training and guidance to staff to facilitate sufficient ML/TF risk awareness in both the first and second lines of defence.

tc.q: 當客戶身上出現多項風險指標時，打擊以貿易進行洗錢活動的通函要求採取甚麼管治步驟？
options: 將個案標示並向該經營者的高級管理層呈報
不作通知即關閉該客戶帳戶
將個案轉交外部核數師
將個案向審裁處匯報
tc.explain: 該通函訂明，當客戶身上出現多項風險指標時，應特別注意將個案標示並向高級管理層呈報，並須以向員工提供足夠培訓及指引作支援，使第一及第二道防線均具備充分的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險意識。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.9段

en.q: What must happen to the results of a review of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: They should be documented and approved by the MSO's senior management
They should be submitted to the CCE within 30 days
They should be published on the MSO's website
They should be certified by an external auditor
en.explain: ¶2.9 requires an MSO to conduct its institutional ML/TF risk assessment every two years and upon material trigger events, and states that the results of the review should be documented and approved by the MSO's senior management.

tc.q: 機構層面洗錢風險評估的檢視結果須如何處理？
options: 須以文件記錄，並經該經營者的高級管理層批准
須於30日內提交海關關長
須在該經營者的網站公開
須由外部核數師核證
tc.explain: 第2.9段規定金錢服務經營者須每兩年並在出現重大觸發事件時進行機構層面風險評估，並訂明檢視結果須以文件記錄，並經該經營者的高級管理層批准。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.5段

en.q: What kind of risk assessment process is required where an MSO's products and services are more varied and complex, or its customers have more diverse risk profiles?
options: A more sophisticated risk assessment process
The same simple process, applied more frequently
A process designed by an external consultant
A process approved in advance by the CCE
en.explain: ¶2.5 states that the scale and scope of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's business: a simpler approach might suffice for smaller or less complex businesses, whereas where products and services are more varied and complex, or customers have more diverse risk profiles, a more sophisticated process will be required.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者的產品及服務較多元及複雜，或其客戶的風險狀況較多樣，須採用哪種風險評估程序？
options: 較精細的風險評估程序
相同的簡單程序，但更頻密地進行
由外部顧問設計的程序
事先經海關關長批准的程序
tc.explain: 第2.5段訂明機構層面風險評估的規模及範圍應與該經營者業務的性質、規模及複雜程度相稱：業務規模較小或性質較簡單者，較簡單的評估方式或已足夠；相反，如產品及服務較多元及複雜，或客戶的風險狀況較多樣，則須採用較精細的評估程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.12段

en.q: At what point must an MSO undertake the risk assessment for a new product, business practice or technology, and what must follow?
options: Prior to the launch or use, taking appropriate measures to manage and mitigate the risks identified
Within 30 days after launch, reporting the risks to the CCE
At the next scheduled institutional risk assessment
Only if the new product proves popular with customers
en.explain: ¶2.12 states that an MSO should undertake the risk assessment prior to the launch of the new products, new business practices, or the use of new or developing technologies, and should take appropriate measures to manage and mitigate the risks identified.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須於何時就新產品、新業務常規或新科技進行風險評估？其後須怎樣做？
options: 須在推出或使用之前進行，並採取適當措施管理及減低所識別的風險
推出後30日內進行，並向海關關長匯報有關風險
於下次定期機構層面風險評估時進行
只在該新產品受客戶歡迎時方須進行
tc.explain: 第2.12段訂明金錢服務經營者應在推出新產品、新業務常規或使用新或發展中科技之前進行風險評估，並應採取適當措施管理及減低所識別的風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.16段

en.q: What two things must an MSO be able to demonstrate to the CCE from its customer risk assessment records?
options: How it assesses the customer's ML/TF risks, and that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on those risks
The profitability of each customer and the fees charged
The identity of the staff member who approved each customer
The number of customers in each risk category
en.explain: ¶2.16 requires an MSO to keep records and relevant documents of its customer risk assessments so that it can demonstrate to the CCE, among others, how it assesses the customer's ML/TF risks, and that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on that customer's ML/TF risks.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須能從其客戶風險評估紀錄向海關關長證明哪兩項？
options: 其如何評估該客戶的洗錢風險；以及客戶盡職審查措施及持續監察的程度按該客戶的風險而言屬適當
每名客戶的盈利貢獻及所收取費用
批准每名客戶的員工身分
各風險級別的客戶數目
tc.explain: 第2.16段規定金錢服務經營者須備存其客戶風險評估的紀錄及相關文件，以便向海關關長證明（其中包括）：其如何評估該客戶的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險；以及客戶盡職審查措施及持續監察的程度，按該客戶的風險而言屬適當。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.13段註腳5

en.q: Does a risk-based approach permit an MSO to omit CDD measures for low-risk customers?
options: No — except for certain situations specified in Chapter 4, an MSO should always apply all the CDD measures and conduct ongoing monitoring of its customers
Yes — CDD may be omitted entirely for customers assessed as low risk
Yes, provided the omission is approved by senior management
Yes, provided the transaction is below $8,000
en.explain: Footnote 5 to ¶2.13 states, for the avoidance of doubt, that except for certain situations specified in Chapter 4, an MSO should always apply all the CDD measures set out in paragraph 4.1.3 and conduct ongoing monitoring of its customers. The RBA calibrates the extent of measures, not whether they are applied at all.

tc.q: 風險為本方式是否准許金錢服務經營者就低風險客戶省略客戶盡職審查措施？
options: 否——除第4章指明的若干情況外，該經營者應一律採取所有客戶盡職審查措施，並對其客戶進行持續監察
可以——就被評為低風險的客戶可完全省略客戶盡職審查
可以，只要該項省略經高級管理層批准
可以，只要交易低於8,000元
tc.explain: 第2.13段註腳5為免生疑問訂明，除第4章指明的若干情況外，金錢服務經營者應一律採取第4.1.3段所列的所有客戶盡職審查措施，並對其客戶進行持續監察。風險為本方式調校的是措施的程度，而非是否採取措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4段註腳2

en.q: Which FATF publication does the Guideline suggest MSOs may reference for risk indicators?
options: Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach for Money or Value Transfer Services, issued in February 2016
The FATF Recommendations 2012, as revised
The Trade-Based Money Laundering Risk Indicators paper
The FATF Mutual Evaluation Report on Hong Kong
en.explain: Footnote 2 to ¶2.4 states that MSOs may also make reference to Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach for Money or Value Transfer Services issued by the FATF in February 2016 for the list of risk indicators associated with the risk factors stated in paragraphs 2.4 and 2.15.

tc.q: 本指引建議金錢服務經營者可參考財務行動特別組織的哪一份刊物以了解風險指標？
options: 2016年2月發出的《金錢或價值轉移服務風險為本方式指引》
經修訂的2012年財務行動特別組織建議
《以貿易進行洗錢活動風險指標》文件
財務行動特別組織就香港的相互評估報告
tc.explain: 第2.4段註腳2訂明，就第2.4及2.15段所述風險因素相關的風險指標清單，金錢服務經營者亦可參考財務行動特別組織於2016年2月發出的《金錢或價值轉移服務風險為本方式指引》。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.1段

en.q: How does ¶3.1 link the statutory duty in section 23 of Schedule 2 to the risk-based approach?
options: To ensure compliance with the section 23 duty, the MSO should implement appropriate internal AML/CFT Systems following the RBA as stated in ¶2.1
Section 23 displaces the RBA where the two conflict
The RBA applies only where section 23 has been complied with
Section 23 applies only to MSOs that have adopted an RBA
en.explain: ¶3.1 states that an MSO must take all reasonable measures to ensure proper safeguards exist to mitigate ML/TF risks and to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2, and that to ensure compliance with this requirement the MSO should implement appropriate internal AML/CFT Systems following the RBA as stated in ¶2.1.

tc.q: 第3.1段如何將附表2第23條的法定責任與風險為本方式連繫起來？
options: 為確保遵從第23條的責任，該經營者應按第2.1段所述的風險為本方式，實施適當的內部打擊洗錢系統
如兩者有衝突，第23條凌駕風險為本方式
風險為本方式只在已遵從第23條後方適用
第23條只適用於已採用風險為本方式的經營者
tc.explain: 第3.1段訂明金錢服務經營者必須採取一切合理措施，確保設有適當防護措施以減低洗錢風險並防止違反附表2第2或3部下的任何規定；為確保遵從此項規定，該經營者應按第2.1段所述的風險為本方式，實施適當的內部打擊洗錢系統。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 1
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第1項

en.q: Which strategic approach must the policy's introduction state that the applicant adopts?
options: A risk-based approach in the design and implementation of the AML/CFT policies, with a view to managing and mitigating ML/TF risks
A zero-tolerance approach excluding all higher-risk customers
A rules-based approach applying identical measures to every customer
An approach determined annually by the external auditor
en.explain: Item 1 of the AML/CFT Policy submission guidelines requires the introduction to state that the applicant adopts a risk-based approach in the design and implementation of the AML/CFT policies with a view to managing and mitigating ML/TF risks, alongside the section 23 and section 19(3) duties and the appointment of a qualified CO and MLRO.

tc.q: 政策引言須訂明申請人採取哪一種策略取態？
options: 在設計及實施打擊洗錢政策時採用風險為本方式，以管理及減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
零容忍取態，將所有較高風險客戶排除在外
規則為本取態，對每名客戶採取完全相同的措施
由外部核數師每年決定的取態
tc.explain: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》第1項規定引言須訂明申請人在設計及實施打擊洗錢政策時採用風險為本方式，以管理及減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險；並須連同第23條及第19(3)條的責任，以及委任合資格合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任等事項一併載明。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 15
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第15項

en.q: By what means may the AML/CFT audit function described in the policy be discharged?
options: By an internal or external audit function, with relevant policy and procedures
By the compliance officer alone
By the CCE during routine inspection
By the MSO's bankers as part of their own review
en.explain: Item 15 of the AML/CFT Policy submission guidelines requires the applicant to elaborate its AML/CFT audit function to ensure its systems and programmes are commensurate with the up-to-date business risk profile, giving as examples an internal or external audit function and the relevant policy and procedures. ¶3.13 of the Guideline similarly contemplates external review where appropriate.

tc.q: 政策所述的打擊洗錢審計職能可以何種方式履行？
options: 以內部或外部審計職能履行，並配以相關政策及程序
只由合規主任履行
由海關關長在例行視察時履行
由該經營者的往來銀行在其本身檢視中履行
tc.explain: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》第15項規定申請人須詳述其打擊洗錢審計職能，以確保其系統及計劃與最新業務風險狀況相稱，並以內部／外部審計職能及相關政策及程序為例。本指引第3.13段亦同樣考量在適當情況下尋求外部檢視。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.9(b)段

en.q: What does the CO's oversight of all aspects of the AML/CFT Systems include?
options: Monitoring effectiveness and enhancing the controls and procedures where necessary
Approving each customer relationship personally
Conducting the independent audit
Reporting directly to the CCE on a quarterly basis
en.explain: ¶3.9(b) makes the CO responsible for overseeing all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, which include monitoring effectiveness and enhancing the controls and procedures where necessary. The independent audit is a separate function under ¶3.11.

tc.q: 合規主任監督打擊洗錢系統各方面的職責包括甚麼？
options: 監察成效，並在必要時強化管控措施及程序
親自批准每段客戶關係
進行獨立審計
每季直接向海關關長匯報
tc.explain: 第3.9(b)段訂明合規主任須負責監督該經營者打擊洗錢系統的各方面，包括監察成效及在必要時強化管控措施及程序。獨立審計則屬第3.11段下的另一職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.10(a)及(b)段

en.q: Which two record-related functions does the MLRO have oversight of?
options: Review of internal disclosures and exception reports and determining whether a report to the JFIU is necessary, and maintenance of all records related to such internal reviews
Maintenance of customer identification records and transaction records
Maintenance of the sanctions database and the training register
Review of the annual accounts and the audit report
en.explain: ¶3.10 lists the MLRO's principal functions as having oversight of the review of internal disclosures and exception reports and, in light of all available relevant information, determining whether it is necessary to make a report to the JFIU; the maintenance of all records related to such internal reviews; and the provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off.

tc.q: 打擊洗錢報告主任監督哪兩項與紀錄有關的職能？
options: 檢視內部披露及例外報告並決定是否須向聯合財富情報組作出報告；以及備存所有與該等內部檢視有關的紀錄
備存客戶身分識別紀錄及交易紀錄
備存制裁資料庫及培訓紀錄冊
檢視周年帳目及審計報告
tc.explain: 第3.10段列出打擊洗錢報告主任的主要職能包括監督：檢視內部披露及例外報告，並根據所有可得相關資料決定是否須向聯合財富情報組作出報告；備存所有與該等內部檢視有關的紀錄；以及就如何避免洩密提供指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8(a)及(f)段

en.q: What does the Guideline require of the CO's and MLRO's knowledge?
options: They should be appropriately qualified with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge, and fully conversant with the MSO's statutory and regulatory requirements and the ML/TF risks arising from its business
They should hold a university degree in law or finance
They should have passed the Competence Assessment personally
They should have at least five years' experience in an MSO
en.explain: ¶3.8(a) requires the CO and MLRO to be appropriately qualified with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge, and ¶3.8(f) requires them to be fully conversant with the MSO's statutory and regulatory requirements and the ML/TF risks arising from the MSO's business.

tc.q: 本指引就合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任的知識有何要求？
options: 他們應具備適當資格及足夠的打擊洗錢知識，並須充分熟悉該經營者的法定及監管規定，以及其業務所產生的洗錢風險
他們應持有法律或金融的大學學位
他們應親自通過能力評核
他們應在金錢服務經營者擁有至少五年經驗
tc.explain: 第3.8(a)段規定合規主任及打擊洗錢報告主任應具備適當資格及足夠的打擊洗錢知識；第3.8(f)段則規定他們須充分熟悉該經營者的法定及監管規定，以及其業務所產生的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(1)條；《打擊洗錢指引》第3.15段

en.q: How do section 22(1) of Schedule 2 and ¶3.15 of the Guideline align on overseas operations?
options: Both require a Hong Kong-incorporated institution to ensure its overseas branches and relevant subsidiary undertakings have procedures to comply with requirements similar to those in Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2, to the extent local law permits
Section 22(1) applies to branches and ¶3.15 to subsidiaries only
Section 22(1) applies only where the MSO is part of a financial group
The Guideline imposes a stricter standard that displaces section 22(1)
en.explain: Section 22(1) of Schedule 2 requires a Hong Kong-incorporated financial institution to ensure its branches and subsidiary undertakings carrying on the same business outside Hong Kong have procedures to ensure compliance, to the extent permitted by local law, with requirements similar to Parts 2 and 3. ¶3.15 and ¶3.16 of the Guideline express the same obligation through group-wide AML/CFT Systems.

tc.q: 附表2第22(1)條與本指引第3.15段就境外業務如何相互配合？
options: 兩者均規定在香港註冊成立的機構須確保其境外分支機構及相關附屬企業，在當地法律准許的範圍內設有程序，以遵從與附表2第2及3部類似的規定
第22(1)條適用於分支機構，第3.15段只適用於附屬公司
第22(1)條只在該經營者屬金融集團一部分時方適用
本指引施加更嚴格的標準，並取代第22(1)條
tc.explain: 附表2第22(1)條規定在香港註冊成立的金融機構須確保其在香港以外經營相同業務的分支機構及附屬企業，設有程序以在當地法律准許的範圍內確保遵從與第2及3部類似的規定。本指引第3.15及3.16段則透過集團層面打擊洗錢系統表述同一責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.9段

en.q: Which of the following is given as an example of a trigger event requiring a review of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: The acquisition of new customer segments or delivery channels
An increase in the MSO's turnover of more than 10 per cent
The retirement of a member of staff
A change in the MSO's banking arrangements
en.explain: ¶2.9 states that trigger events may include a significant breach of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, the acquisition of new customer segments or delivery channels, the launch of new products and services, or any significant changes of the MSO's operational processes, target customers and business counterparts.

tc.q: 下列何者獲舉為須檢視機構層面洗錢風險評估的觸發事件例子？
options: 取得新客戶分部或新交付渠道
該經營者營業額增加超過一成
一名員工退休
該經營者銀行安排的變動
tc.explain: 第2.9段訂明觸發事件可包括該經營者打擊洗錢系統的重大違規、取得新客戶分部或新交付渠道、推出新產品及服務，或該經營者的營運流程、目標客戶及業務對手出現任何重大變動。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(a)段

en.q: Which two customer risk factors are given as examples in the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: The MSO's target market and customer segments, and the number and proportion of customers identified as high risk
The average age and occupation of customers
The customers' preferred languages and payment methods
The customers' average account balances and transaction sizes
en.explain: ¶2.4(a) gives as examples of customer risk factors the MSO's target market and customer segments, and the number and proportion of customers identified as high risk.

tc.q: 機構層面風險評估就客戶風險因素舉出哪兩個例子？
options: 該經營者的目標市場及客戶分部，以及被識別為高風險的客戶數目及比例
客戶的平均年齡及職業
客戶偏好的語言及付款方式
客戶的平均帳戶結餘及交易金額
tc.explain: 第2.4(a)段就客戶風險因素舉出的例子為：該經營者的目標市場及客戶分部，以及被識別為高風險的客戶數目及比例。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.3(b)及(d)段

en.q: Which two further steps does ¶2.3 require in conducting the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: Considering all relevant risk factors before determining the overall risk level and the appropriate level and type of mitigation, and having a process by which the assessment is kept up-to-date
Obtaining an external opinion and filing the assessment with the CCE
Benchmarking against competitors and publishing a summary
Insuring against the identified risks and setting aside a reserve
en.explain: ¶2.3 lists the appropriate steps as documenting the process; considering all the relevant risk factors before determining what the level of overall risk is and the appropriate level and type of mitigation to be applied; obtaining senior management approval; having a process by which the assessment is kept up-to-date; and having mechanisms to provide it to the CCE when required.

tc.q: 第2.3段就進行機構層面風險評估，還要求哪兩項步驟？
options: 在決定整體風險水平及應採取的緩減措施的適當程度及類型前，考慮所有相關風險因素；以及設有使該評估保持最新的程序
取得外部意見並向海關關長存檔該評估
與競爭對手比較基準並公開摘要
就已識別風險投購保險並預留儲備
tc.explain: 第2.3段列出的適當步驟包括：以文件記錄該過程；在決定整體風險水平及應採取的緩減措施的適當程度及類型前，考慮所有相關風險因素；取得高級管理層批准；設有使該評估保持最新的程序；以及設有適當機制在被要求時向海關關長提供該評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.6段
