en.explain: ¶4.12.2 states that trigger events may include the re-activation of a dormant account or a change in the beneficial ownership or control of the account, but that the MSO will need to consider other trigger events specific to their own customers and business — so the examples are illustrative rather than exhaustive.

tc.q: 第4.12.2段舉出哪些觸發事件的例子，並補充了甚麼？
options: 重新啟用停用帳戶或帳戶實益擁有權或控制權出現變動——並補充該經營者須考慮其本身客戶及業務所特有的其他觸發事件
僅重新啟用停用帳戶，且屬詳盡清單
僅客戶通訊地址變更，並無其他
僅任何超過8,000元的交易，並無其他
tc.explain: 第4.12.2段訂明觸發事件可包括重新啟用停用帳戶，或該帳戶的實益擁有權或控制權出現變動；但該經營者須考慮其本身客戶及業務所特有的其他觸發事件——故該等例子屬示例而非詳盡清單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.12.3段

en.q: Do the ongoing monitoring requirements under section 5 of Schedule 2 apply to pre-existing customers?
options: Yes — ¶4.12.3 expressly states that they also apply to pre-existing customers
No — ongoing monitoring applies only to relationships established on or after 1 April 2012
Only where the pre-existing customer is assessed as high risk
Only once a ¶4.12.1 trigger event has occurred
en.explain: ¶4.12.3 states that an MSO should note that the requirements for ongoing monitoring under section 5 of Schedule 2 also apply to pre-existing customers, cross-referring to Chapter 5. The ¶4.12.1 triggers govern when full CDD must be performed; they do not switch ongoing monitoring on or off.

tc.q: 附表2第5條的持續監察規定是否適用於既有客戶？
options: 適用——第4.12.3段明文訂明該等規定同樣適用於既有客戶
不適用——持續監察只適用於2012年4月1日或之後建立的業務關係
只在該既有客戶被評為高風險時適用
只在出現第4.12.1段的觸發事件後方適用
tc.explain: 第4.12.3段訂明該經營者應注意，附表2第5條的持續監察規定同樣適用於既有客戶，並參照第5章。第4.12.1段的觸發情況只規範何時須進行全面客戶盡職審查，並不影響持續監察的適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.13.1段

en.q: Which requirements in ¶4.13.1 must an MSO be unable to comply with before the prohibition on establishing a relationship bites?
options: The CDD requirements in Chapter 4 or the ongoing due diligence requirements in Chapter 5
The CDD requirements in Chapter 4 only
The record-keeping requirements in Chapter 8 only
The staff training requirements in Chapter 9 only
en.explain: ¶4.13.1 applies where the MSO is unable to comply with the relevant CDD requirements set out in Chapter 4 and the ongoing due diligence requirements set out in Chapter 5 — so a failure at the ongoing monitoring stage, not merely at onboarding, engages the paragraph.

tc.q: 在禁止建立業務關係的規定生效前，金錢服務經營者須是無法遵從第4.13.1段所指的哪些規定？
options: 第4章所載的客戶盡職審查規定，或第5章所載的持續盡職審查規定
僅第4章所載的客戶盡職審查規定
僅第8章所載的備存紀錄規定
僅第9章所載的員工培訓規定
tc.explain: 第4.13.1段適用於該經營者無法遵從第4章所載相關客戶盡職審查規定及第5章所載持續盡職審查規定的情況——故在持續監察階段（而非僅在開立客戶階段）出現的失誤，同樣會觸發該段。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.13.1段

en.q: Where an MSO cannot satisfactorily complete CDD on an existing customer, how quickly should the business relationship be terminated?
options: As soon as reasonably practicable, where applicable
Within 24 hours in every case
At the end of the current calendar month
Only after the CCE has given written approval
en.explain: ¶4.13.1 provides that where the MSO is unable to comply with the relevant CDD and ongoing due diligence requirements it must not establish a business relationship or carry out any occasional transaction with that customer, or must terminate the business relationship as soon as reasonably practicable where applicable, and where there is relevant knowledge or suspicion should make an STR to the JFIU.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者未能就現有客戶圓滿完成客戶盡職審查，應多快終止該業務關係？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止（如適用）
在任何情況下均須於24小時內終止
於本曆月月底終止
須待海關關長書面批准後方可終止
tc.explain: 第4.13.1段訂明，如該經營者無法遵從相關客戶盡職審查及持續盡職審查規定，則不得與該客戶建立業務關係或進行任何單一宗交易；或（如適用）須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止業務關係；如有相關知悉或懷疑，則應向聯合財富情報組作出可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.13.1段

en.q: Does terminating a relationship for failed CDD automatically require an STR?
options: No — an STR should be made where there is relevant knowledge or suspicion; termination alone is not the test
Yes — every termination for failed CDD requires an STR
No — an STR is never required in these circumstances
Yes — but only if the customer disputes the termination
en.explain: ¶4.13.1 couples the prohibition and termination duty with the words 'where there is relevant knowledge or suspicion, should make an STR to the JFIU'. The reporting duty therefore turns on knowledge or suspicion, not on the fact of termination, although the circumstances that defeated CDD will often themselves give rise to suspicion.

tc.q: 因客戶盡職審查未能完成而終止業務關係，是否自動須作出可疑交易報告？
options: 否——只在有相關知悉或懷疑時方須作出可疑交易報告；終止本身並非判斷準則
是——每宗因客戶盡職審查失敗而終止的個案均須作出報告
否——在此情況下從不須作出報告
是——但只在該客戶就終止提出爭議時
tc.explain: 第4.13.1段將禁止及終止的責任與「如有相關知悉或懷疑，則應向聯合財富情報組作出可疑交易報告」一併訂明。故報告責任取決於知悉或懷疑，而非取決於是否終止關係；惟導致客戶盡職審查無法完成的情況本身往往亦足以構成懷疑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5、10.6、10.9及11.3段

en.q: A customer asks an MSO to wire the equivalent of HK$9,000 in United States dollars. Does the $8,000 threshold apply?
options: Yes — the wire transfer and remittance thresholds are expressed as $8,000 or an equivalent amount in any other currency, so a transfer worth more than that in another currency is caught
No — the thresholds apply only to transfers denominated in Hong Kong dollars
No — foreign currency transfers are governed by the $120,000 threshold instead
Yes — but only if the customer chooses to settle in Hong Kong dollars
en.explain: ¶10.5, ¶10.6, ¶10.9 and ¶11.3 each express the threshold as an amount equal to or above $8,000 'or an equivalent amount in any other currency'. The currency in which a transfer is denominated therefore does not affect whether the information, accuracy and verification requirements apply.

tc.q: 某客戶要求金錢服務經營者以美元電匯相當於港幣9,000元的款項。8,000元的門檻是否適用？
options: 適用——電匯及匯款的門檻表述為8,000元或任何其他貨幣的等值款額，故以另一種貨幣計值而價值高於此數的轉帳同受規限
不適用——該等門檻只適用於以港元計值的轉帳
不適用——外幣轉帳改為受120,000元門檻規限
適用——但只限該客戶選擇以港元結算的情況
tc.explain: 第10.5、10.6、10.9及11.3段均將門檻表述為相等於或高於8,000元「或任何其他貨幣的等值款額」。因此，轉帳以何種貨幣計值，並不影響資料、準確性及核實身分等規定是否適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段註腳49

en.q: What is a numbered account, as described in the Guideline?
options: An account where the name of the customer and/or the beneficial owner is known to the MSO but is substituted by an account number or code name in subsequent documentation
An account for which no customer name has ever been obtained
An account identified only by the customer's identity document number
An account held jointly by several unnamed persons
en.explain: Footnote 49 to ¶4.14.1 explains that in respect of a numbered account, the name of the customer and/or the beneficial owner is known to the MSO but is substituted by an account number or code name in subsequent documentation. That is what distinguishes it from a prohibited anonymous account.

tc.q: 按本指引所述，何謂「編號帳戶」？
options: 該經營者知悉客戶及／或實益擁有人的姓名，但在其後的文件中以帳戶號碼或代號取代該姓名的帳戶
從未取得任何客戶姓名的帳戶
僅以客戶身分證明文件號碼識別的帳戶
由多名不具名人士聯名持有的帳戶
tc.explain: 第4.14.1段註腳49解釋，就編號帳戶而言，該經營者知悉客戶（及／或實益擁有人）的姓名，但在其後的文件中以帳戶號碼或代號取代該姓名。此點正是編號帳戶有別於被禁止的匿名帳戶之處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段

en.q: What standard of CDD and control applies to a confidential numbered account?
options: Exactly the same CDD and control measures as all other business relationships
A reduced set of measures reflecting the account's confidentiality
Enhanced measures in every case, regardless of risk
No measures, since the account is identified by a code
en.explain: ¶4.14.1 states that confidential numbered accounts should not function as anonymous accounts; rather they should be subject to exactly the same CDD and control measures as all other business relationships. Confidentiality affects how the customer is referred to in documentation, not the substance of the due diligence.

tc.q: 保密編號帳戶適用何種客戶盡職審查及管控標準？
options: 與所有其他業務關係完全相同的客戶盡職審查及管控措施
因帳戶具保密性而可採用較寬鬆的措施
不論風險高低，一律採用加強措施
無須任何措施，因該帳戶以代號識別
tc.explain: 第4.14.1段訂明保密編號帳戶不應以匿名帳戶的方式運作，而應受與所有其他業務關係完全相同的客戶盡職審查及管控措施規限。保密性只影響文件中如何稱呼該客戶，並不影響盡職審查的實質內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段

en.q: To how many staff must the identity of a numbered account holder be known?
options: A sufficient number of staff to facilitate effective CDD and ongoing monitoring
One designated staff member only, to preserve confidentiality
Every member of the MSO's front-line staff
The compliance officer only
en.explain: ¶4.14.1 states that while a numbered account can offer additional confidentiality for the customer, the identity of the customer must be verified by the MSO and known to a sufficient number of staff to facilitate effective CDD and ongoing monitoring — a balance between confidentiality and operational effectiveness.

tc.q: 編號帳戶持有人的身分須為多少員工所知悉？
options: 足夠數目的員工，以便有效進行客戶盡職審查及持續監察
為維持保密，只限一名指定員工
該經營者的每一名前線員工
只限合規主任
tc.explain: 第4.14.1段訂明，雖然編號帳戶可為客戶提供額外保密性，但該經營者必須核實該客戶的身分，且該身分須為足夠數目的員工所知悉，以便有效進行客戶盡職審查及持續監察——這是在保密與運作成效之間取得平衡。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段註腳50

en.q: Whose name must appear on a wire transfer or remittance made from a numbered account?
options: The real name of the account holder
The account number or code name used for the account
The name of the MSO carrying out the transfer
No name is required for numbered accounts
en.explain: Footnote 50 to ¶4.14.1 gives as an example of the same control measures that wire transfers, and remittance service, from numbered accounts must reflect the real name of the account holder. The code name may be used in the MSO's internal documentation but not in the payment message.

tc.q: 從編號帳戶作出的電匯或匯款，須顯示何人的姓名？
options: 該帳戶持有人的真實姓名
該帳戶所用的帳戶號碼或代號
進行該轉帳的金錢服務經營者的名稱
編號帳戶無須顯示任何姓名
tc.explain: 第4.14.1段註腳50以此為相同管控措施的例子：從編號帳戶作出的電匯及匯款服務，必須反映該帳戶持有人的真實姓名。代號可用於該經營者的內部文件，但不得用於付款訊息。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段

en.q: To whom must a customer's CDD record be available, whether or not the relationship involves a numbered account?
options: The CCE, other competent authorities, the CO, auditors, and other staff with appropriate authority
The CCE only
The CO and the auditors only
Any member of staff who asks to see it
en.explain: ¶4.14.1 states that in all cases, whether the relationship involves numbered accounts or not, the customer's CDD record must be available to the CCE, other competent authorities, the CO, auditors, and other staff with appropriate authority.

tc.q: 不論業務關係是否涉及編號帳戶，客戶的盡職審查紀錄須可供何人查閱？
options: 海關關長、其他主管當局、合規主任、審計師，以及具備適當權限的其他員工
只限海關關長
只限合規主任及審計師
任何提出要求的員工
tc.explain: 第4.14.1段訂明在所有情況下，不論業務關係是否涉及編號帳戶，客戶的盡職審查紀錄均須可供海關關長、其他主管當局、合規主任、審計師，以及具備適當權限的其他員工查閱。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.15.1段

en.q: To whom should EDD be applied where the FATF calls for it in respect of a jurisdiction?
options: Business relationships and transactions with natural and legal persons, including financial institutions, from that jurisdiction, proportionate to the risks
Only individual customers from that jurisdiction
Only financial institutions from that jurisdiction
Only customers who are also PEPs
en.explain: ¶4.15.1 states that an MSO should apply EDD measures, proportionate to the risks, to business relationships and transactions with natural and legal persons — including FIs — from jurisdictions for which this is called for by the FATF, in accordance with the guidance provided in ¶4.9.

tc.q: 如財務行動特別組織就某司法管轄區呼籲採取加強盡職審查，該措施應適用於何人？
options: 與來自該司法管轄區的自然人及法人（包括金融機構）的業務關係及交易，並與風險相稱
只限來自該司法管轄區的個人客戶
只限來自該司法管轄區的金融機構
只限同時屬政治人物的客戶
tc.explain: 第4.15.1段訂明該經營者應按照第4.9段所提供的指引，就與來自財務行動特別組織呼籲採取此等措施的司法管轄區的自然人及法人（包括金融機構）的業務關係及交易，採取與風險相稱的加強盡職審查措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.15.2段

en.q: By what means, and in what two forms, may the CCE act where mandatory EDD or countermeasures are called for?
options: Through a notice in writing, either imposing a general obligation to comply with section 15 of Schedule 2 or requiring MSOs to undertake specific countermeasures described in the notice
Through an oral direction to each licensee, or a press release
Through an amendment to Schedule 2, or a licence condition
Through a court order, or a direction to the JFIU
en.explain: ¶4.15.2 provides that where mandatory EDD or countermeasures are called for by the FATF, or in other circumstances independent of any FATF call but also considered higher risk, the CCE may, through a notice in writing, impose a general obligation on MSOs to comply with section 15 of Schedule 2, or require MSOs to undertake specific countermeasures described in the notice.

tc.q: 在須採取強制性加強盡職審查或反制措施的情況下，海關關長可透過甚麼方式、以哪兩種形式行事？
options: 透過書面通知，施加遵從附表2第15條的一般責任，或要求金錢服務經營者採取該通知所述的特定反制措施
透過向每名持牌人口頭指示，或發出新聞稿
透過修訂附表2，或施加牌照條件
透過法院命令，或向聯合財富情報組發出指示
tc.explain: 第4.15.2段訂明，如財務行動特別組織呼籲採取強制性加強盡職審查或反制措施，或在獨立於任何該等呼籲但同樣被視為較高風險的其他情況下，海關關長可透過書面通知：(a)向金錢服務經營者施加遵從附表2第15條規定的一般責任；或(b)要求金錢服務經營者採取該通知所述的特定反制措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.15.2段

en.q: How is the severity of measures imposed by the CCE under ¶4.15.2 calibrated?
options: They would be proportionate to the nature of the risks and/or deficiencies
They are set at the maximum level in every case
They are fixed by the FATF rather than the CCE
They are set by agreement with the affected MSOs
en.explain: ¶4.15.2 states that the type of measures in paragraphs (a) and (b) would be proportionate to the nature of the risks and/or deficiencies — the same proportionality principle that governs the EDD required under ¶4.15.1.

tc.q: 海關關長根據第4.15.2段施加的措施，其嚴格程度如何釐定？
options: 與有關風險及／或缺失的性質相稱
在任何情況下均按最高程度施加
由財務行動特別組織而非海關關長釐定
經與受影響的金錢服務經營者協議釐定
tc.explain: 第4.15.2段訂明(a)及(b)兩款所指措施的類型，會與有關風險及／或缺失的性質相稱——這與第4.15.1段所訂加強盡職審查的相稱原則一致。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.15.2段註腳51

en.q: In respect of which jurisdictions may the FATF recommend the application of countermeasures?
options: Jurisdictions with serious deficiencies in applying the FATF Recommendations where inadequate progress has been made to improve their positions
Any jurisdiction that is not a FATF member
Any jurisdiction that has not published a mutual evaluation report
Jurisdictions whose currency is not freely convertible
en.explain: Footnote 51 to ¶4.15.2 states that for jurisdictions with serious deficiencies in applying the FATF Recommendations, and where inadequate progress has been made to improve their positions, the FATF may recommend the application of countermeasures.

tc.q: 財務行動特別組織可就哪類司法管轄區建議實施反制措施？
options: 在實施財務行動特別組織建議方面存在嚴重缺失，且在改善其狀況方面進展不足的司法管轄區
任何並非財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區
任何未有公布相互評估報告的司法管轄區
貨幣不可自由兌換的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第4.15.2段註腳51訂明，就在實施財務行動特別組織建議方面存在嚴重缺失、且在改善其狀況方面進展不足的司法管轄區，該組織可建議實施反制措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.16.1段

en.q: How does the AMLO define an equivalent jurisdiction?
options: A jurisdiction that is a member of the FATF, other than Hong Kong; or a jurisdiction that imposes requirements similar to those imposed under Schedule 2
Any jurisdiction that is a member of the FATF, including Hong Kong
Any jurisdiction with which Hong Kong has a mutual legal assistance agreement
Any jurisdiction designated as such by the FATF
en.explain: ¶4.16.1 states that equivalent jurisdiction is defined in the AMLO as meaning a jurisdiction that is a member of the FATF, other than Hong Kong, or a jurisdiction that imposes requirements similar to those imposed under Schedule 2. The express carve-out of Hong Kong matters because the concept is used to describe jurisdictions other than the home one.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》如何界定「同等司法管轄區」？
options: 屬財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區（香港除外）；或施加與附表2所施加者類似的規定的司法管轄區
任何屬財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區，包括香港
任何與香港訂有相互法律協助安排的司法管轄區
任何獲財務行動特別組織如此指定的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第4.16.1段訂明《打擊洗錢條例》將同等司法管轄區界定為：(a)屬財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區（香港除外）；或(b)施加與附表2所施加者類似的規定的司法管轄區。明文剔除香港有其意義，因該概念是用以描述本地以外的司法管轄區。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.16.2段

en.q: Who evaluates whether a non-FATF-member jurisdiction applies requirements similar to Schedule 2?
options: The MSO itself, which may be required to evaluate and determine this for itself and should document its assessment
The CCE, which publishes a definitive list
The FATF, through its mutual evaluation reports
The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau
en.explain: ¶4.16.2 states that an MSO may therefore be required to evaluate and determine for itself which jurisdictions other than FATF members apply requirements similar to those imposed under Schedule 2 for jurisdictional equivalence purposes, and that the MSO should document its assessment of the jurisdiction.

tc.q: 由何人評估非財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區是否施加與附表2類似的規定？
options: 該金錢服務經營者本身；其可能須自行評估及斷定，並應將其評估記錄在案
海關關長，並由其公布權威名單
財務行動特別組織，透過其相互評估報告
財經事務及庫務局
tc.explain: 第4.16.2段訂明就司法管轄區同等性而言，該經營者可能須自行評估及斷定財務行動特別組織成員以外的哪些司法管轄區施加與附表2所施加者類似的規定；該經營者並應將其對該司法管轄區的評估記錄在案。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.16.2段

en.q: Which of the following is among the factors an MSO may consider in assessing jurisdictional equivalence?
options: Whether the jurisdiction is a member of FATF-style regional bodies and the recent mutual evaluation report published by those bodies
Whether the jurisdiction has a double taxation agreement with Hong Kong
The size of the jurisdiction's banking sector
Whether the jurisdiction's language is used in the MSO's documentation
en.explain: ¶4.16.2 lists the factors as: membership of FATF-style regional bodies and recent mutual evaluation reports published by them; whether the jurisdiction is identified by the FATF as having strategic AML/CFT deficiencies and its recent progress; any advisory circular issued by the CCE from time to time alerting MSOs to jurisdictions with poor AML/CFT controls; and any other AML/CFT-related publications by specialised national, international, non-governmental or commercial organisations.

tc.q: 下列何者屬金錢服務經營者在評估司法管轄區同等性時可考慮的因素？
options: 該司法管轄區是否財務行動特別組織式區域組織的成員，以及該等組織近期公布的相互評估報告
該司法管轄區是否與香港訂有避免雙重課稅協定
該司法管轄區銀行業的規模
該司法管轄區的語言是否用於該經營者的文件
tc.explain: 第4.16.2段列出的因素為：該司法管轄區是否財務行動特別組織式區域組織的成員及該等組織近期公布的相互評估報告；該司法管轄區有否被財務行動特別組織識別為在打擊洗錢方面存在策略性缺失及其近期改善進展；海關關長不時發出、提醒金錢服務經營者注意打擊洗錢管控欠佳的司法管轄區的通告；以及專門的國家、國際、非政府或商業組織所發表的其他相關刊物。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.16.3段

en.q: Why, and how often, should an MSO review its jurisdictional equivalence assessment?
options: Because the AML/CFT regime of a jurisdiction will change over time — on a regular basis and/or upon trigger events
Because the FATF requires it — once every five years
Because the CCE requires it — before each licence renewal
Because customers may object — whenever a customer complains
en.explain: ¶4.16.3 states that as the AML/CFT regime of a jurisdiction will change over time, an MSO should review the jurisdictional equivalence assessment on a regular basis and/or upon trigger events.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者為何、以及應多久檢視其司法管轄區同等性評估？
options: 因為司法管轄區的打擊洗錢制度會隨時間改變——應定期檢視及／或在出現觸發事件時檢視
因為財務行動特別組織有此要求——每五年一次
因為海關關長有此要求——每次續牌前
因為客戶可能提出反對——每當有客戶投訴時
tc.explain: 第4.16.3段訂明由於司法管轄區的打擊洗錢制度會隨時間改變，該經營者應定期及／或在出現觸發事件時檢視其司法管轄區同等性評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.1(a)段

en.q: What does the ongoing CDD limb of continuous monitoring require?
options: Reviewing from time to time the documents, data and information relating to the customer obtained for the purpose of complying with Part 2 of Schedule 2, to ensure they are up-to-date and relevant
Re-verifying the customer's identity every twelve months
Obtaining a fresh set of identification documents at each transaction
Re-performing the customer risk assessment at each transaction
en.explain: ¶5.1(a) defines ongoing CDD as reviewing from time to time documents, data and information relating to the customer that have been obtained by the MSO for the purpose of complying with the requirements imposed under Part 2 of Schedule 2, to ensure that they are up-to-date and relevant.

tc.q: 持續監察中的「持續客戶盡職審查」一環要求甚麼？
options: 不時檢視該經營者為遵從附表2第2部規定而就客戶取得的文件、數據及資料，以確保其為最新及相關
每十二個月重新核實客戶身分一次
於每宗交易時取得一套全新的身分證明文件
於每宗交易時重新進行客戶風險評估
tc.explain: 第5.1(a)段將持續客戶盡職審查界定為：不時檢視該經營者為遵從附表2第2部所施加規定而就該客戶取得的文件、數據及資料，以確保該等文件、數據及資料為最新及相關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.1(b)(ii)段

en.q: Which two elements must both be present before a transaction falls within ¶5.1(b)(ii), and what must the MSO then do?
options: The transaction is complex, unusually large in amount or of an unusual pattern, AND has no apparent economic or lawful purpose; the MSO must examine the background and purposes and set out the findings in writing
The transaction exceeds $120,000 AND involves a foreign counterparty; the MSO must file an STR
The transaction is in cash AND involves a new customer; the MSO must decline it
The transaction is complex OR unusually large; the MSO must obtain senior management approval
en.explain: ¶5.1(b)(ii) requires the MSO to identify transactions that (A) are complex, unusually large in amount or of an unusual pattern, and (B) have no apparent economic or lawful purpose — both limbs — and to examine the background and purposes of those transactions and set out the findings in writing.

tc.q: 交易須同時具備哪兩項要素方屬第5.1(b)(ii)段所指者？該經營者其後須怎樣做？
options: 該交易屬複雜、款額異常龐大或模式不尋常，且並無明顯的經濟或合法目的；該經營者須審查其背景及目的，並以書面列明結果
該交易超過120,000元且涉及境外對手方；該經營者須提交可疑交易報告
該交易以現金進行且涉及新客戶；該經營者須拒絕該交易
該交易屬複雜或款額異常龐大；該經營者須取得高級管理層批准
tc.explain: 第5.1(b)(ii)段規定該經營者須識別同時符合以下兩項的交易：(A)屬複雜、款額異常龐大或模式不尋常；及(B)並無明顯的經濟或合法目的；並須審查該等交易的背景及目的，以及以書面列明審查結果。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.2段

en.q: On what two matters does ¶5.2 say clear policies and procedures should especially be developed?
options: The frequency of periodic review, and what constitutes a trigger event
The identity of the reviewing officer, and the retention period for review records
The format of the review report, and its distribution list
The threshold for escalation, and the penalty for non-compliance
en.explain: ¶5.2 states that to ensure documents, data and information obtained are up-to-date and relevant, an MSO should undertake reviews of existing CDD records of customers on a regular basis and/or upon trigger events, and that clear policies and procedures should be developed, especially on the frequency of periodic review or what constitutes a trigger event.

tc.q: 第5.2段指出應特別就哪兩方面制訂清晰的政策及程序？
options: 定期檢視的頻次，以及何謂觸發事件
負責檢視的人員身分，以及檢視紀錄的保存期限
檢視報告的格式，以及其傳閱名單
呈報的門檻，以及不合規的罰則
tc.explain: 第5.2段訂明為確保就客戶取得的文件、數據及資料為最新及相關，該經營者應定期及／或在出現觸發事件時檢視現有客戶盡職審查紀錄；並應制訂清晰的政策及程序，尤其是就定期檢視的頻次或何謂觸發事件而言。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.2段註腳52

en.q: Does keeping CDD information up-to-date require an MSO to re-verify identities it has already verified?
options: No — unless doubts arise as to the veracity or adequacy of the information previously obtained for customer identification and verification
Yes — identities must be re-verified at each periodic review
Yes — but only for customers assessed as high risk
No — in no circumstances may an identity be re-verified
en.explain: Footnote 52 to ¶5.2 states that keeping the CDD information up-to-date and relevant does not mean that an MSO has to re-verify identities that have been verified, unless doubts arise as to the veracity or adequacy of the information previously obtained for the purposes of customer identification and verification.

tc.q: 保持客戶盡職審查資料為最新，是否要求金錢服務經營者重新核實已核實的身分？
options: 否——除非對此前為識別及核實客戶身分而取得的資料的真確性或充分性產生疑問
是——每次定期檢視時均須重新核實身分
是——但只限被評為高風險的客戶
否——在任何情況下均不得重新核實身分
tc.explain: 第5.2段註腳52訂明，保持客戶盡職審查資料為最新及相關，並不表示該經營者須重新核實已核實的身分；除非對此前為識別及核實客戶身分而取得的資料的真確性或充分性產生疑問。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.2段註腳53

en.q: How should an MSO treat the CDD records of a dormant customer?
options: Regular review is not necessary, but a review should be conducted upon reactivation of the relationship, and the MSO should define clearly in its policies what constitutes a dormant customer
The records should be reviewed more frequently than those of active customers
The records may be destroyed once the customer becomes dormant
The customer must be reported to the CCE as dormant
en.explain: Footnote 53 to ¶5.2 states that while it is not necessary to regularly review the existing CDD records of a dormant customer, an MSO should conduct a review upon reactivation of the relationship, and should define clearly what constitutes a dormant customer in its policies and procedures.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應如何處理停用客戶的盡職審查紀錄？
options: 無須定期檢視，但應在重新啟用該關係時進行檢視；並應在其政策及程序中清楚界定何謂停用客戶
應較活躍客戶的紀錄更頻密檢視
客戶一旦停用即可銷毀有關紀錄
須向海關關長報告該客戶已停用
tc.explain: 第5.2段註腳53訂明，雖然無須定期檢視停用客戶的現有客戶盡職審查紀錄，但該經營者應在該關係重新啟用時進行檢視；並應在其政策及程序中清楚界定何謂停用客戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.3段

en.q: What is the minimum review frequency for customers presenting high ML/TF risks?
options: A minimum of an annual review, or more frequent reviews if deemed necessary by the MSO
A minimum of a review every two years
A minimum of a review every six months in all cases
There is no minimum; the frequency is entirely at the MSO's discretion
en.explain: ¶5.3 states that all customers that present high ML/TF risks should be subject to a minimum of an annual review, or more frequent reviews if deemed necessary by the MSO, to ensure the CDD information retained remains up-to-date and relevant.

tc.q: 就構成高洗錢風險的客戶，檢視的最低頻次為何？
options: 最少每年檢視一次；如該經營者認為有需要，則須更頻密檢視
最少每兩年檢視一次
在所有情況下最少每六個月檢視一次
並無最低頻次，完全由該經營者酌情決定
tc.explain: 第5.3段訂明所有構成高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的客戶，應最少每年接受檢視一次；如該經營者認為有需要，則須更頻密檢視，以確保所保存的客戶盡職審查資料維持為最新及相關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.4段

en.q: Which factor is NOT among those to which the design and degree of automation of transaction monitoring systems should have regard?
options: The number of years the MSO has held its licence
The size and complexity of the MSO's business
The ML/TF risks arising from the MSO's business
The nature of the products and services provided, including the means of delivery or communication
en.explain: ¶5.4 lists the factors as the size and complexity of the business; the ML/TF risks arising from the business; the nature of its systems and controls; the monitoring procedures that already exist to satisfy other business needs; and the nature of the products and services provided, which includes the means of delivery or communication. The length of time the licence has been held is not among them.

tc.q: 下列何者並非設計交易監察系統及其自動化程度時須顧及的因素？
options: 該經營者持牌年期的長短
該經營者業務的規模及複雜程度
該經營者業務所產生的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
所提供產品及服務的性質（包括交付或通訊方式）
tc.explain: 第5.4段列出的因素為：其業務的規模及複雜程度；其業務所產生的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險；其系統及管控的性質；為滿足其他業務需要而已存在的監察程序；以及所提供產品及服務的性質（包括交付或通訊方式）。持牌年期並不在其列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.5段

en.q: What must an MSO's transaction monitoring systems provide to the staff tasked with monitoring and investigation?
options: Timely and sufficient information required to identify, analyse and effectively monitor customers' transactions
Automated conclusions as to whether an STR should be filed
Direct access to the JFIU reporting portal
A monthly summary of all transactions above $8,000
en.explain: ¶5.5 states that an MSO should ensure that the transaction monitoring systems and processes can provide all relevant staff who are tasked with conducting transaction monitoring and investigation with timely and sufficient information required to identify, analyse and effectively monitor customers' transactions.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的交易監察系統須向負責監察及調查的員工提供甚麼？
options: 及時而充分的資料，以識別、分析及有效監察客戶的交易
關於是否須提交可疑交易報告的自動化結論
聯合財富情報組舉報平台的直接存取權
所有超過8,000元交易的每月摘要
tc.explain: 第5.5段訂明該經營者應確保其交易監察系統及程序，能向所有負責進行交易監察及調查的相關員工，提供識別、分析及有效監察客戶交易所需的及時而充分的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.6段

en.q: Which approach to ongoing monitoring does ¶5.6 say an MSO should preferably adopt?
options: A relationship-based approach rather than a transaction-by-transaction basis, supporting holistic monitoring across a customer's multiple accounts and related customers' accounts
A transaction-by-transaction approach, to ensure each transaction is separately assessed
An account-by-account approach, with no aggregation across accounts
A branch-by-branch approach, with monitoring confined to each premises
en.explain: ¶5.6 states that transaction monitoring systems and processes should support the ongoing monitoring of a business relationship in a holistic approach, which may include monitoring activities of a customer's multiple accounts within or across lines of businesses and related customers' accounts, meaning that preferably the MSO adopts a relationship-based approach rather than a transaction-by-transaction basis.

tc.q: 第5.6段指出金錢服務經營者宜採用哪種持續監察方式？
options: 以關係為本而非逐宗交易的方式，以支援跨越客戶多個帳戶及相關客戶帳戶的整體監察
逐宗交易的方式，以確保每宗交易獲個別評估
逐個帳戶的方式，不作跨帳戶匯總
逐間分行的方式，監察只限於各處所
tc.explain: 第5.6段訂明交易監察系統及程序應以整體方式支援業務關係的持續監察，可包括監察客戶在同一業務線內或跨業務線的多個帳戶，以及相關客戶的帳戶活動；即該經營者宜採用以關係為本的方式，而非按逐宗交易的方式進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.7段

en.q: Which transaction characteristic does ¶5.7 illustrate with the example of structuring a single transaction into a number of cash deposits?
options: The nature of a series of transactions
The nature and type of transactions
The counterparties of transactions
The geographical origin or destination of a payment or receipt
en.explain: ¶5.7 lists the transaction characteristics to be taken into account when setting parameters and thresholds: the nature and type of transactions (e.g. abnormal size or frequency); the nature of a series of transactions (e.g. structuring a single transaction into a number of cash deposits); the counterparties of transactions; the geographical origin/destination of a payment or receipt; and the customer's normal account activity or turnover.

tc.q: 第5.7段以「將單一宗交易拆分為多筆現金存款」為例，說明哪一項交易特徵？
options: 一連串交易的性質
交易的性質及類型
交易的對手方
付款或收款的地域來源或目的地
tc.explain: 第5.7段列出設定參數及門檻時須顧及的交易特徵：交易的性質及類型（例如款額或頻次異常）；一連串交易的性質（例如將單一宗交易拆分為多筆現金存款）；交易的對手方；付款或收款的地域來源／目的地；以及該客戶的正常帳戶活動或營業額。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.8段

en.q: What does ¶5.8 require of the parameters and thresholds adopted in a transaction monitoring system?
options: They should be properly documented and independently validated to ensure they are appropriate to the MSO's operations and context, with the adequacy and effectiveness of the systems regularly reviewed
They should be set by the system vendor and left unchanged
They should be kept confidential from the MSO's own auditors
They should be identical to those used by other MSOs of similar size
en.explain: ¶5.8 states that an MSO should regularly review the adequacy and effectiveness of its transaction monitoring systems and processes, including parameters and thresholds adopted, and that the parameters and thresholds should be properly documented and independently validated to ensure that they are appropriate to its operations and context.

tc.q: 第5.8段就交易監察系統所採用的參數及門檻有何要求？
options: 應妥為記錄並經獨立驗證，以確保其切合該經營者的營運及情況；並應定期檢視系統的充分性及有效性
應由系統供應商設定，其後不作更改
應對該經營者本身的審計師保密
應與規模相若的其他金錢服務經營者所用者完全相同
tc.explain: 第5.8段訂明該經營者應定期檢視其交易監察系統及程序（包括所採用的參數及門檻）的充分性及有效性；有關參數及門檻應妥為記錄並經獨立驗證，以確保其切合該經營者的營運及情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.9段

en.q: How should the extent of transaction monitoring vary under the risk-based approach?
options: It should be commensurate with the customer's ML/TF risk profile — enhanced where risks are high, and it may be reduced in low risk situations
It should be identical for all customers, to ensure consistency
It should depend on the customer's transaction volume alone
It should be enhanced for all customers and never reduced
en.explain: ¶5.9 states that an MSO should conduct transaction monitoring in relation to all business relationships following the RBA; the extent of monitoring, such as frequency and intensity, should be commensurate with the ML/TF risk profile of a customer; where the ML/TF risks are high the MSO should conduct enhanced transaction monitoring; and in low risk situations the MSO may reduce the extent of monitoring.

tc.q: 按風險為本方式，交易監察的程度應如何變化？
options: 應與客戶的洗錢風險狀況相稱——風險高則加強監察，風險低則可減省監察程度
應對所有客戶劃一，以確保一致性
應僅取決於該客戶的交易量
應對所有客戶一律加強，且不得減省
tc.explain: 第5.9段訂明該經營者應按風險為本方式，就所有業務關係進行交易監察；監察的程度（例如頻次及力度）應與客戶的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險狀況相稱；如風險屬高，該經營者應進行加強交易監察；在低風險情況下，該經營者可減省監察的程度。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.9段註腳54

en.q: Which examples of high ML/TF risk situations requiring enhanced transaction monitoring does footnote 54 give?
options: A customer or a beneficial owner of a customer being a non-Hong Kong PEP; and a business relationship presenting a high risk of ML/TF under section 15 of Schedule 2
Any customer who transacts in cash; and any customer using a numbered account
Any customer resident outside Hong Kong; and any corporate customer
Any newly onboarded customer; and any customer who has changed address
en.explain: Footnote 54 to ¶5.9 gives as examples of high ML/TF risk situations requiring enhanced transaction monitoring: a customer or a beneficial owner of a customer being a non-Hong Kong PEP; and a business relationship presenting a high risk of ML/TF under section 15 of Schedule 2.

tc.q: 註腳54就須加強交易監察的高風險情況舉出哪些例子？
options: 客戶或客戶的實益擁有人屬非香港政治人物；以及按附表2第15條屬構成高洗錢風險的業務關係
任何以現金交易的客戶；以及任何使用編號帳戶的客戶
任何在香港以外居住的客戶；以及任何法人客戶
任何新開立的客戶；以及任何已更改地址的客戶
tc.explain: 第5.9段註腳54就須加強交易監察的高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險情況舉例：(a)客戶或客戶的實益擁有人屬非香港政治人物；及(b)按附表2第15條屬構成高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的業務關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.10段

en.q: What appropriate steps does ¶5.10 suggest to identify whether there are grounds for suspicion?
options: Examining the background and purposes of the transactions, and making appropriate enquiries to or obtaining additional CDD information from the customer
Immediately filing an STR without further enquiry
Freezing the customer's funds pending investigation
Referring the matter to the MSO's external auditor
en.explain: ¶5.10 states that an MSO should take appropriate steps — for example examining the background and purposes of the transactions, or making appropriate enquiries to or obtaining additional CDD information from a customer — to identify if there are any grounds for suspicion, where the customer's transactions are inconsistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer, the customer's business, risk profile or source of funds, or where it identifies transactions falling within both limbs of ¶5.10(b).

tc.q: 第5.10段建議採取哪些適當步驟以識別是否有懷疑的理由？
options: 審查交易的背景及目的，以及向客戶作出適當查詢或取得額外的客戶盡職審查資料
立即提交可疑交易報告而不作進一步查詢
在調查期間凍結該客戶的資金
將事宜轉介該經營者的外聘審計師
tc.explain: 第5.10段訂明，如客戶的交易與該經營者對該客戶、其業務、風險狀況或資金來源的了解並不一致，或該經營者識別出符合第5.10(b)款兩項要素的交易，該經營者應採取適當步驟（例如審查交易的背景及目的；向客戶作出適當查詢或取得額外的客戶盡職審查資料），以識別是否有任何懷疑的理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.11段

en.q: Where an MSO obtains a satisfactory explanation of a transaction and concludes there are no grounds for suspicion, what should it still consider?
options: Updating the customer risk profile based on any relevant information obtained
Filing a precautionary STR in any event
Reducing the customer's transaction limits
Reporting the enquiry to the CCE
en.explain: ¶5.11 states that where an MSO conducts enquiries and obtains what it considers to be a satisfactory explanation of the transaction or activity, it may conclude that there are no grounds for suspicion and take no further action; but that even if no suspicion is identified, the MSO should consider updating the customer risk profile based on any relevant information obtained.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者就某交易取得圓滿解釋並認定並無懷疑理由，仍應考慮甚麼？
options: 按所取得的任何相關資料更新該客戶的風險狀況
無論如何仍提交預防性的可疑交易報告
調低該客戶的交易限額
向海關關長報告該次查詢
tc.explain: 第5.11段訂明，如該經營者作出查詢後取得其認為圓滿的交易或活動解釋，可認定並無懷疑的理由，因而無須採取進一步行動；但即使並未識別出懷疑，該經營者仍應考慮按所取得的任何相關資料更新該客戶的風險狀況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.12段

en.q: What follows where an MSO cannot obtain a satisfactory explanation of a transaction or activity?
options: It may conclude that there are grounds for suspicion; and in any event where suspicion is identified during transaction monitoring, an STR should be made to the JFIU
It must terminate the relationship without reporting
It should defer any decision until the next periodic review
It should refer the matter to the CCE for a determination
en.explain: ¶5.12 states that where the MSO cannot obtain a satisfactory explanation of the transaction or activity it may conclude that there are grounds for suspicion, and that in any event where there is any suspicion identified during transaction monitoring, an STR should be made to the JFIU.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者未能就某交易或活動取得圓滿解釋，會有甚麼結果？
options: 可認定有懷疑的理由；且在交易監察過程中一旦識別出任何懷疑，均應向聯合財富情報組作出可疑交易報告
須終止該業務關係而無須作出報告
應押後決定至下次定期檢視
應將事宜轉介海關關長裁定
tc.explain: 第5.12段訂明，如該經營者未能就該交易或活動取得圓滿解釋，可認定有懷疑的理由；且在交易監察過程中一旦識別出任何懷疑，均應向聯合財富情報組作出可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.13段

en.q: What should an MSO do if it reasonably believes that performing the CDD process will tip off the customer?
options: It may stop pursuing the process, but should document the basis for its assessment and file an STR to the JFIU
It must complete the CDD process regardless
It should complete the process but withhold the STR
It should ask the customer for consent before continuing
en.explain: ¶5.13 states that an MSO should be aware that making enquiries to customers, when conducted properly and in good faith, will not constitute tipping off; however, if the MSO reasonably believes that performing the CDD process will tip off the customer, it may stop pursuing the process, and should document the basis for its assessment and file an STR to the JFIU.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者合理地相信進行客戶盡職審查程序會向客戶通風報信，應怎樣做？
options: 可停止進行該程序，但應將其評估基礎記錄在案，並向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告
無論如何均須完成客戶盡職審查程序
應完成該程序但不提交可疑交易報告
應先徵得客戶同意方可繼續
tc.explain: 第5.13段訂明該經營者應知悉，如以恰當方式並真誠地向客戶作出查詢，並不構成通風報信；但如該經營者合理地相信進行客戶盡職審查程序會向該客戶通風報信，則可停止進行該程序；該經營者應將其評估的基礎記錄在案，並向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.14段

en.q: What must be documented in writing and made available to the CCE, other competent authorities and auditors under ¶5.14?
options: The findings and outcomes of the steps taken under ¶5.10, as well as the rationale of any decision made after taking those steps
Only the STRs eventually filed with the JFIU
Only the transactions that exceeded the system's thresholds
Only the identity of the staff member who conducted the review
en.explain: ¶5.14 states that the findings and outcomes of the steps taken by the MSO in ¶5.10, as well as the rationale of any decision made after taking these steps, should be properly documented in writing and be available to the CCE, other competent authorities and auditors. This covers decisions not to report as much as decisions to report.

tc.q: 根據第5.14段，甚麼須以書面妥為記錄，並可供海關關長、其他主管當局及審計師查閱？
options: 該經營者採取第5.10段所述步驟的結果及成效，以及採取該等步驟後所作任何決定的理據
只限最終向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告
只限超出系統門檻的交易
只限進行檢視的員工身分
tc.explain: 第5.14段訂明該經營者採取第5.10段所述步驟的結果及成效，以及在採取該等步驟後所作任何決定的理據，均應以書面妥為記錄，並可供海關關長、其他主管當局及審計師查閱。此既涵蓋作出報告的決定，亦涵蓋不作報告的決定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.1段

en.q: What is the essential difference in focus between money laundering and terrorist financing?
options: ML focuses on the handling of criminal proceeds, so the source of the property is what matters, whereas TF focuses on the destination or use of property, which may have derived from legitimate sources
ML involves cash and TF involves wire transfers
ML is a domestic offence and TF is an international one
ML concerns individuals and TF concerns organisations
en.explain: ¶6.1 explains that TF is the financing of terrorist acts, and of terrorists and terrorist organisations, and that different from ML — the focus of which is on the handling of criminal proceeds, i.e. the source of property is what matters — the focus of TF is on the destination or use of property, which may have derived from legitimate sources.

tc.q: 洗錢與恐怖分子資金籌集在焦點上的根本分別為何？
options: 洗錢的焦點在於處理犯罪得益，即財產的來源至為關鍵；恐怖分子資金籌集的焦點則在於財產的去向或用途，而該等財產可能源自合法來源
洗錢涉及現金，恐怖分子資金籌集涉及電匯
洗錢屬本地罪行，恐怖分子資金籌集屬國際罪行
洗錢涉及個人，恐怖分子資金籌集涉及組織
tc.explain: 第6.1段解釋恐怖分子資金籌集指為恐怖活動、恐怖分子及恐怖組織提供資金；與洗錢不同——洗錢的焦點在於處理犯罪得益（即財產的來源至為關鍵）——恐怖分子資金籌集的焦點在於財產的去向或用途，而該等財產可能源自合法來源。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.1段

en.q: What does terrorist financing generally refer to, as described in ¶6.1?
options: Carrying out transactions involving property owned by terrorists or terrorist organisations, or that has been, or is intended to be, used to assist the commission of terrorist acts
Carrying out transactions in jurisdictions affected by armed conflict
Carrying out any transaction with a customer resident in a sanctioned jurisdiction
Carrying out transactions in cash above the statutory threshold
en.explain: ¶6.1 states that TF is the financing of terrorist acts, and of terrorists and terrorist organisations, and that it generally refers to the carrying out of transactions involving property owned by terrorists or terrorist organisations, or that has been, or is intended to be, used to assist the commission of terrorist acts.

tc.q: 按第6.1段所述，恐怖分子資金籌集一般指甚麼？
options: 進行涉及恐怖分子或恐怖組織所擁有財產，或已被用於或擬被用於協助進行恐怖活動的財產的交易
在受武裝衝突影響的司法管轄區進行交易
與居於受制裁司法管轄區的客戶進行任何交易
進行超過法定門檻的現金交易
tc.explain: 第6.1段訂明恐怖分子資金籌集指為恐怖活動、恐怖分子及恐怖組織提供資金；一般指進行涉及恐怖分子或恐怖組織所擁有的財產，或已被用於或擬被用於協助進行恐怖活動的財產的交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: What does UNSCR 1373 (2001) call on member states to do?
options: To act to prevent and suppress the financing of terrorist acts
To publish a national list of terrorist organisations
To criminalise the possession of weapons of mass destruction
To establish a financial intelligence unit
en.explain: ¶6.2 states that the UN Security Council has passed UNSCR 1373 (2001), which calls on all member states to act to prevent and suppress the financing of terrorist acts.

tc.q: 聯合國安全理事會第1373(2001)號決議呼籲成員國作甚麼？
options: 採取行動防止及制止為恐怖活動籌集資金
公布本國的恐怖組織名單
將管有大規模毀滅武器刑事化
設立財富情報機構
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明聯合國安全理事會通過第1373(2001)號決議，呼籲所有成員國採取行動，防止及制止為恐怖活動籌集資金。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: In relation to which groups has the UN published names of individuals and organisations under UNSCR 1267 (1999) and its successors?
options: Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Iran
Organised crime syndicates operating across Asia
Entities involved in the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction
en.explain: ¶6.2 states that the UN has published the names of individuals and organisations in relation to involvement with Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban under relevant UNSCRs, giving UNSCR 1267 (1999), 1988 (2011), 1989 (2011), 2253 (2015), 2368 (2017) and their successor resolutions as examples. DPRK and Iran are dealt with under the separate PF resolutions in ¶6.9.

tc.q: 聯合國根據第1267(1999)號決議及其後續決議，就哪些組織公布個人及組織名單？
options: 「基地」組織、伊斯蘭國（達伊沙）及塔利班
朝鮮民主主義人民共和國及伊朗
在亞洲各地活動的有組織罪犯集團
涉及擴散大規模毀滅武器的實體
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明聯合國已根據有關決議（例如第1267(1999)、1988(2011)、1989(2011)、2253(2015)、2368(2017)號決議及其後續決議），公布涉及「基地」組織、伊斯蘭國（達伊沙）及塔利班的個人及組織名單。朝鮮及伊朗則由第6.9段所述另一套擴散資金籌集決議處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: What two obligations are all UN member states required to discharge in respect of persons named in the UN terrorist lists?
options: To freeze any funds, other financial assets or economic resources of any person named, and to report any suspected name matches to the relevant authorities
To prosecute any person named, and to notify the UNSC of the outcome
To deny entry to any person named, and to cancel their travel documents
To publish the names locally, and to review them annually
en.explain: ¶6.2 states that all UN member states are required to freeze any funds, or other financial assets, or economic resources of any person(s) named in these lists, and to report any suspected name matches to the relevant authorities.

tc.q: 就聯合國恐怖分子名單所列人士，所有聯合國成員國須履行哪兩項責任？
options: 凍結名單所列任何人的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源；以及向有關當局報告任何懷疑的姓名配對
檢控名單所列任何人；以及將結果通知安全理事會
拒絕名單所列任何人入境；以及註銷其旅行證件
在本地公布該等姓名；以及每年檢視一次
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明所有聯合國成員國均須凍結該等名單所列任何人的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，並須向有關當局報告任何懷疑的姓名配對。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.3段

en.q: Which UNSCR decisions does the UNATMO implement, in addition to certain terrorism-related multilateral conventions and FATF Recommendations?
options: A decision under UNSCR 1373 (2001) on measures for prevention of terrorist acts, and a decision under UNSCR 2178 (2014) on preventing travel for the purpose of terrorist acts or terrorist training
Decisions under UNSCR 1718 (2006) and UNSCR 2231 (2015)
A decision under UNSCR 1540 (2004) on non-proliferation
Decisions under UNSCR 1267 (1999) only
en.explain: ¶6.3 states that the UNATMO is an ordinance to further implement a decision under UNSCR 1373 (2001) relating to measures for prevention of terrorist acts and a decision under UNSCR 2178 (2014) relating to the prevention of travel for the purpose of terrorist acts or terrorist training, as well as to implement certain terrorism-related multilateral conventions and certain FATF Recommendations.

tc.q: 除若干與恐怖主義有關的多邊公約及財務行動特別組織建議外，《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》還實施哪些安理會決議的決定？
options: 第1373(2001)號決議中有關防止恐怖活動措施的決定，以及第2178(2014)號決議中有關防止為恐怖活動或恐怖訓練而作出的旅行的決定
第1540(2004)號決議中有關防擴散的決定
僅第1267(1999)號決議的決定
tc.explain: 第6.3段訂明《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》旨在進一步實施第1373(2001)號決議中有關防止恐怖活動措施的決定，以及第2178(2014)號決議中有關防止為恐怖活動或恐怖訓練而作出的旅行的決定；並實施若干與恐怖主義有關的多邊公約及若干財務行動特別組織建議。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.4段

en.q: Under sections 4 and 5 of the UNATMO, by what two routes may a person or property be specified as a terrorist, terrorist associate or terrorist property?
options: By the Chief Executive publishing a notice in the Gazette where designation has been made by a UNSC Committee; or by the Chief Executive applying to the Court of First Instance for an order, which is also published in the Gazette
By the Secretary for Security issuing a freezing notice; or by the CCE issuing a circular
By the JFIU issuing a designation; or by a magistrate making an order
By the UNSC alone, with automatic effect in Hong Kong
en.explain: ¶6.4 states that where a person or property is designated by a UNSC Committee as a terrorist/terrorist associate or terrorist property, the Chief Executive may publish a notice in the Gazette under section 4 of the UNATMO; and that section 5 provides that the Chief Executive may apply to the Court of First Instance for an order specifying a person or property, which if made will also be published in the Gazette.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第4及5條，可透過哪兩個途徑將某人或財產指明為恐怖分子、恐怖分子聯繫者或恐怖分子財產？
options: 在安理會轄下委員會作出指定後，由行政長官在憲報刊登公告；或由行政長官向原訟法庭申請命令，如命令作出亦會在憲報刊登
由保安局局長發出凍結通知；或由海關關長發出通告
由聯合財富情報組作出指定；或由裁判官作出命令
僅由安全理事會作出，並在香港自動生效
tc.explain: 第6.4段訂明，如某人或財產獲根據有關決議設立的安理會轄下委員會指定為恐怖分子／恐怖分子聯繫者或恐怖分子財產，行政長官可根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第4條在憲報刊登公告指明該人的姓名或該財產；此外，第5條訂明行政長官可向原訟法庭申請命令，將某人或財產指明為恐怖分子／恐怖分子聯繫者或恐怖分子財產；如命令獲頒下，亦會在憲報刊登。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.4段註腳56

en.q: How does section 2 of the UNATMO define terrorist property?
options: The property of a terrorist or terrorist associate, or any other property that is intended to be used or was used to finance or assist the commission of terrorist acts
Any property located in a jurisdiction subject to a FATF call
Any property that is the proceeds of an indictable offence
Any property held in an anonymous or numbered account
en.explain: Footnote 56 to ¶6.4 states that according to section 2 of the UNATMO, terrorist property means the property of a terrorist or terrorist associate, or any other property that is intended to be used or was used to finance or assist the commission of terrorist acts.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第2條如何界定「恐怖分子財產」？
options: 恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者的財產，或擬用於或曾用於資助或協助進行恐怖活動的任何其他財產
位於受財務行動特別組織呼籲規限的司法管轄區的任何財產
屬可公訴罪行得益的任何財產
以匿名或編號帳戶持有的任何財產
tc.explain: 第6.4段註腳56訂明，根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第2條，恐怖分子財產指恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者的財產，或擬用於或曾用於資助或協助進行恐怖活動的任何其他財產。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(a)段

en.q: What power does section 6 of the UNATMO confer, and on whom?
options: It empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze suspected terrorist property
It empowers the Chief Executive to publish designations in the Gazette
It empowers the CCE to suspend an MSO's licence
It empowers the Court of First Instance to make a confiscation order
en.explain: ¶6.5(a) states that section 6 of the UNATMO empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze suspected terrorist property. It is the first of the five UNATMO provisions the Guideline identifies as of particular relevance to MSOs.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條授予何人甚麼權力？
options: 授權保安局局長凍結懷疑屬恐怖分子財產的財產
授權行政長官在憲報刊登指定
授權海關關長暫時吊銷金錢服務經營者的牌照
授權原訟法庭作出充公令
tc.explain: 第6.5(a)段訂明《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條授權保安局局長凍結懷疑屬恐怖分子財產的財產。此為本指引指出與金錢服務經營者特別相關的五項條文中的第一項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(b)及(c)段

en.q: What do sections 7 and 8 of the UNATMO respectively prohibit?
options: Section 7 prohibits the provision or collection of property for use to commit terrorist acts; section 8 prohibits making available, collecting or soliciting property or financial or related services for terrorists and terrorist associates
Section 7 prohibits dealing with specified terrorist property; section 8 prohibits financing terrorist travel
Section 7 prohibits tipping off; section 8 prohibits failing to report
Section 7 prohibits opening anonymous accounts; section 8 prohibits reliance on intermediaries
en.explain: ¶6.5(b) states that section 7 prohibits the provision or collection of property for use to commit terrorist acts, and ¶6.5(c) states that section 8 prohibits any person from making available or collecting or soliciting property or financial (or related) services for terrorists and terrorist associates.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第7及8條分別禁止甚麼？
options: 第7條禁止提供或收集財產以用作進行恐怖活動；第8條禁止任何人為恐怖分子及恐怖分子聯繫者提供、收集或募集財產或金融（或有關）服務
第7條禁止處理指明恐怖分子財產；第8條禁止資助恐怖分子旅行
第7條禁止通風報信；第8條禁止不作報告
第7條禁止開立匿名帳戶；第8條禁止倚賴中介人
tc.explain: 第6.5(b)段訂明第7條禁止提供或收集財產以用作進行恐怖活動；第6.5(c)段訂明第8條禁止任何人為恐怖分子及恐怖分子聯繫者提供或收集或募集財產或金融（或有關）服務。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(d)段

en.q: What mental element does section 8A of the UNATMO require in relation to dealing with property?
options: Knowing that, or being reckless as to whether, the property is specified terrorist property or property of a specified terrorist or terrorist associate
Intending to assist a terrorist act
Having reasonable grounds to believe the property is criminal proceeds
Negligence in failing to screen the property
en.explain: ¶6.5(d) states that section 8A prohibits any person from dealing with any property knowing that, or being reckless as to whether, the property is specified terrorist property or property of a specified terrorist or terrorist associate. Recklessness suffices; actual knowledge is not required.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第8A條就處理財產要求何種犯罪心態？
options: 知悉該財產屬指明恐怖分子財產或指明恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者的財產，或罔顧該財產是否屬此
意圖協助進行恐怖活動
有合理理由相信該財產屬犯罪得益
因疏忽而未有就該財產作出篩查
tc.explain: 第6.5(d)段訂明第8A條禁止任何人在知悉某財產屬指明恐怖分子財產或指明恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者的財產，或罔顧該財產是否屬此的情況下，處理該財產。罔顧已足以構成，無須實際知悉。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(e)段

en.q: Does an offence under section 11L of the UNATMO require a terrorist act actually to occur?
options: No — the prohibition on providing or collecting property to finance terrorist travel or training applies even if no terrorist act actually occurs
Yes — a terrorist act must be completed
Yes — an attempt must at least have been made
No — but only where the travel crosses into Hong Kong
en.explain: ¶6.5(e) states that section 11L prohibits any person from providing or collecting any property to finance the travel of a person between states with the intention or knowing that the travel will be for a specified purpose — the perpetration, planning or preparation of, or participation in, one or more terrorist acts (even if no terrorist act actually occurs), or the provision or receiving of training connected with such acts (even if no terrorist act actually occurs as a result of the training).

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第11L條下的罪行，是否須有恐怖活動實際發生？
options: 否——即使並無恐怖活動實際發生，禁止提供或收集財產以資助恐怖分子旅行或訓練的規定仍然適用
是——須有恐怖活動實際完成
是——最少須曾有企圖
否——但僅限旅行進入香港的情況
tc.explain: 第6.5(e)段訂明第11L條禁止任何人提供或收集任何財產，以資助某人在國與國之間的旅行，而其意圖或知悉該旅行是為指明目的，即進行、策劃或籌備一項或多於一項恐怖活動或參與其中（即使並無恐怖活動實際發生）；或提供或接受與進行、策劃或籌備一項或多於一項恐怖活動或參與其中有關的訓練（即使該訓練並無導致任何恐怖活動實際發生）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.6段

en.q: Who may licence exceptions to the UNATMO prohibitions, and to whom should an MSO write for such a licence?
options: The Secretary for Security, and the MSO should write to the Security Bureau
The Chief Executive, and the MSO should write to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The CCE, and the MSO should write to the Customs and Excise Department
The Court of First Instance, and the MSO should apply by summons
en.explain: ¶6.6 states that the S for S can licence exceptions to the prohibitions to enable frozen property to be unfrozen and to allow payments to be made to or for the benefit of a designated party under the UNATMO — for example reasonable living or legal expenses and payments liable to be made under the Employment Ordinance — and that an MSO seeking such a licence should write to the Security Bureau. Contrast ¶6.8, where UNSO licences come from the Chief Executive via the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau.

tc.q: 何人可就《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》的禁制發出豁免許可？金錢服務經營者應向何處申請？
options: 保安局局長；該經營者應致函保安局
行政長官；該經營者應致函商務及經濟發展局
海關關長；該經營者應致函香港海關
原訟法庭；該經營者應以傳票方式申請
tc.explain: 第6.6段訂明保安局局長可就有關禁制發出許可，以容許解除凍結財產，並容許向指定人士或為其利益作出付款（例如合理生活或法律開支，以及根據《僱傭條例》須支付的款項）；擬申請該等許可的金錢服務經營者應致函保安局。此與第6.8段有別——《聯合國制裁條例》下的許可由行政長官批出，並須致函商務及經濟發展局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段

en.q: What does the UNSO empower the Chief Executive to do, and how are designated persons specified?
options: To make regulations to implement sanctions decided by the UNSC, including targeted financial sanctions; designated persons and entities are specified by notice published in the Gazette or on the website of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
To freeze property directly without regulations; designations are notified to each MSO individually
To prosecute sanctions breaches; designations are published by the JFIU
To grant exemptions from the AMLO; designations are made by the CCE
en.explain: ¶6.7 states that the UNSO empowers the Chief Executive to make regulations to implement sanctions decided by the UNSC, including targeted financial sanctions against certain persons and entities such as those designated by the UNSC or its Committees, and that designated persons and entities are specified by notice published in the Gazette or on the website of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau.

tc.q: 《聯合國制裁條例》授權行政長官作甚麼？指定人士如何被指明？
options: 訂立規例以實施安理會決定的制裁，包括定向金融制裁；指定人士及實體以在憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站刊登的公告指明
直接凍結財產而無須訂立規例；指定會逐一通知各金錢服務經營者
檢控違反制裁的行為；指定由聯合財富情報組公布
批予《打擊洗錢條例》下的豁免；指定由海關關長作出
tc.explain: 第6.7段訂明《聯合國制裁條例》授權行政長官訂立規例，以實施聯合國安全理事會決定的制裁，包括針對若干人士及實體（例如獲安理會或其轄下委員會指定者）的定向金融制裁；指定人士及實體以在憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站刊登的公告指明。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段註腳57

en.q: What do targeted financial sanctions comprise?
options: Both asset freezing and prohibitions to prevent funds or other assets from being made available, directly or indirectly, for the benefit of designated persons and entities
Asset freezing only
Trade embargoes and export controls
Travel bans and diplomatic measures
en.explain: Footnote 57 to ¶6.7 states that targeted financial sanctions refer to both asset freezing and prohibitions to prevent funds or other assets from being made available, directly or indirectly, for the benefit of designated persons and entities — the two limbs then set out in ¶6.7(a) and (b).

tc.q: 定向金融制裁包括甚麼？
options: 資產凍結，以及防止任何資金或其他資產直接或間接供指定人士及實體使用或為其利益而提供的禁制，兩者兼備
僅資產凍結
貿易禁運及出口管制
旅遊禁令及外交措施
tc.explain: 第6.7段註腳57訂明定向金融制裁兼指資產凍結，以及防止任何資金或其他資產直接或間接供指定人士及實體使用或為其利益而提供的禁制——即第6.7(a)及(b)款所載的兩部分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7(a)段

en.q: Beyond designated persons and entities themselves, to whom is it an offence to make funds available under the applicable UNSO regulations?
options: Persons or entities acting on behalf of or at the direction of designated persons or entities, or owned or controlled by them; and entities owned by those persons or entities
Any person resident in the same jurisdiction as a designated person
Any counterparty to a transaction with a designated person in the past five years
Only the immediate family members of a designated person
en.explain: ¶6.7(a) makes it an offence, except under the authority of a licence granted by the Chief Executive, to make available directly or indirectly any funds, or other financial assets, or economic resources to or for the benefit of designated persons or entities; persons or entities acting on behalf of or at the direction of them, or owned or controlled by them; or entities owned by the aforementioned.

tc.q: 除指定人士及實體本身外，根據適用的《聯合國制裁條例》規例，向何人提供資金亦屬罪行？
options: 代指定人士或實體行事或按其指示行事，或由其擁有或控制的人士或實體；以及由上述人士或實體擁有的實體
與指定人士居於同一司法管轄區的任何人
過去五年內曾與指定人士交易的任何對手方
僅指定人士的直系家庭成員
tc.explain: 第6.7(a)段訂明，除非獲行政長官批出的許可授權，否則直接或間接向以下各方或為其利益提供任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，即屬犯罪：指定人士或實體；代其行事或按其指示行事，或由其擁有或控制的人士或實體；以及由上述人士或實體擁有的實體。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7(b)段

en.q: What second limb of prohibition does ¶6.7(b) create?
options: Dealing, directly or indirectly, with any funds, or other financial assets or economic resources belonging to, or owned or controlled by, such persons or entities
Advertising financial services in a sanctioned jurisdiction
Employing any person connected with a designated entity
Communicating with a designated person for any purpose
en.explain: ¶6.7(b) makes it an offence, except under the authority of a licence granted by the Chief Executive, to deal with, directly or indirectly, any funds, or other financial assets or economic resources belonging to, or owned or controlled by, the persons or entities described in ¶6.7(a).

tc.q: 第6.7(b)段訂立哪一項禁制？
options: 直接或間接處理屬於該等人士或實體所有，或由其擁有或控制的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源
在受制裁司法管轄區宣傳金融服務
僱用與指定實體有關連的任何人
為任何目的與指定人士通訊
tc.explain: 第6.7(b)段訂明，除非獲行政長官批出的許可授權，否則直接或間接處理屬於第6.7(a)款所述人士或實體所有，或由其擁有或控制的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，即屬犯罪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.8段

en.q: To which body should an MSO write when seeking a licence under the relevant UNSO regulation?
options: The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The Security Bureau
The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau
The Customs and Excise Department
en.explain: ¶6.8 states that the Chief Executive may grant a licence for making available funds or dealing with funds belonging to certain persons or entities under specified circumstances in accordance with the provisions of the relevant regulation made under the UNSO, and that an MSO seeking such a licence should write to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者擬申請有關《聯合國制裁條例》規例下的許可，應致函哪個機構？
options: 商務及經濟發展局
保安局
財經事務及庫務局
香港海關
tc.explain: 第6.8段訂明行政長官可按《聯合國制裁條例》下有關規例的條文，在指明情況下就向若干人士或實體提供資金，或處理屬於該等人士或實體所有或由其擁有或控制的資金，批出許可；擬申請該等許可的金錢服務經營者應致函商務及經濟發展局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: What is the UNSC's two-tiered approach to combating proliferation financing?
options: A global approach under UNSCR 1540 (2004) and its successors, and a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against Iran, and their successors
A regional approach and a sectoral approach
A voluntary tier for member states and a mandatory tier for FATF members
A financial tier administered by the UNSC and a trade tier administered by the WTO
en.explain: ¶6.9 states that to combat PF the UNSC adopts a two-tiered approach through resolutions made under Chapter VII of the UN Charter imposing mandatory obligations on UN member states: a global approach under UNSCR 1540 (2004) and its successor resolutions; and a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against Iran and their successor resolutions.

tc.q: 聯合國安全理事會打擊擴散資金籌集的雙層方針為何？
options: 第1540(2004)號決議及其後續決議所訂的全球性方針；以及針對朝鮮的第1718(2006)號決議及針對伊朗的第2231(2015)號決議及其後續決議所訂的針對特定國家方針
區域性方針及行業性方針
對成員國屬自願的一層，對財務行動特別組織成員屬強制的一層
由安理會執行的金融層面，以及由世界貿易組織執行的貿易層面
tc.explain: 第6.9段訂明為打擊擴散資金籌集，聯合國安全理事會透過根據《聯合國憲章》第七章作出、對聯合國成員國施加強制責任的決議，採取雙層方針：(a)第1540(2004)號決議及其後續決議所訂的全球性方針；及(b)針對朝鮮民主主義人民共和國的第1718(2006)號決議，以及針對伊朗伊斯蘭共和國的第2231(2015)號決議及其後續決議所訂的針對特定國家方針。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段

en.q: What alone can make lawful conduct that would otherwise be an offence under the applicable UNSO regulations?
options: The authority of a licence granted by the Chief Executive
The written consent of the designated person concerned
A determination by the CCE that the risk is low
Prior notification to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
en.explain: ¶6.7 provides that, except under the authority of a licence granted by the Chief Executive, it is an offence to make available funds or other financial assets or economic resources to or for the benefit of designated persons and entities, or to deal with funds belonging to or controlled by them. ¶6.8 adds that an MSO seeking such a licence should write to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau.

tc.q: 單憑甚麼可令原本違反適用《聯合國制裁條例》規例的行為變為合法？
options: 行政長官批出的許可的授權
有關指定人士的書面同意
海關關長裁定風險屬低
事先通知商務及經濟發展局
tc.explain: 第6.7段訂明，除非獲行政長官批出的許可授權，否則向指定人士及實體或為其利益提供資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，或處理屬於其所有或由其控制的資金，即屬犯罪。第6.8段補充，擬申請該等許可的金錢服務經營者應致函商務及經濟發展局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.10段

en.q: What test does section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O apply to the provision of services?
options: It prohibits a person from providing any services where he believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that those services may be connected to PF
It prohibits the provision of services to any person resident in the DPRK or Iran
It prohibits the provision of services without a licence from the Chief Executive
It prohibits the provision of services where the person knows they will be used for PF
en.explain: ¶6.10 states that section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O prohibits a person from providing any services where he believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that those services may be connected to PF. The threshold is reasonable belief or suspicion, not actual knowledge.

tc.q: 《武器擴散（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條就提供服務採用何種準則？
options: 禁止任何人在有合理理由相信或懷疑所提供服務可能與擴散資金籌集有關連的情況下提供該等服務
禁止向居於朝鮮或伊朗的任何人提供服務
禁止在未獲行政長官許可的情況下提供服務
禁止在明知服務將用於擴散資金籌集的情況下提供服務
tc.explain: 第6.10段訂明《武器擴散（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條禁止任何人在有合理理由相信或懷疑所提供的服務可能與擴散資金籌集有關連的情況下，提供該等服務。有關準則為合理相信或懷疑，而非實際知悉。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.4段

en.q: What standing duty does section 19(3) of Schedule 2 impose on an MSO in relation to transaction monitoring?
options: To establish and maintain adequate systems and processes to monitor transactions
To monitor every transaction manually before it is executed
To appoint an external service provider to monitor transactions
To report all transactions above $8,000 to the CCE monthly
en.explain: ¶5.4, citing section 19(3) of Schedule 2, states that an MSO should establish and maintain adequate systems and processes to monitor transactions, and that their design, degree of automation and sophistication should be developed appropriately having regard to the five factors it then lists.

tc.q: 就交易監察，附表2第19(3)條對金錢服務經營者施加甚麼持續責任？
options: 建立及維持足夠的系統及程序以監察交易
在每宗交易執行前以人手監察
委任外聘服務供應商監察交易
每月向海關關長報告所有8,000元以上的交易
tc.explain: 第5.4段引述附表2第19(3)條，訂明該經營者應建立及維持足夠的系統及程序以監察交易；該等系統及程序的設計、自動化及精密程度，應顧及其後所列的五項因素而適當地發展。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.11段

en.q: What is the position on unilateral sanctions imposed by authorities in other jurisdictions?
options: MSOs do not normally have any obligation under Hong Kong laws to have regard to them, but an MSO operating internationally will need to be aware of their scope and focus and should consider the implications and take appropriate measures
They have the same legal force in Hong Kong as UNSCR-based sanctions
They must be disregarded entirely, as applying them would breach Hong Kong law
They apply only where the MSO has an overseas branch
en.explain: ¶6.11 states that while MSOs do not normally have any obligation under Hong Kong laws to have regard to unilateral sanctions imposed by other organisations or authorities in other jurisdictions, an MSO operating internationally will need to be aware of the scope and focus of relevant sanctions regimes in those jurisdictions, and where these may affect its operations the MSO should consider what implications exist and take appropriate measures.

tc.q: 就其他司法管轄區的當局所施加的單方面制裁，立場為何？
options: 金錢服務經營者按香港法律通常並無責任顧及該等制裁，但在國際間營運的經營者須知悉其範圍及重點，並應考慮其影響及採取適當措施
該等制裁在香港具有與聯合國決議制裁相同的法律效力
須完全不予理會，因採用該等制裁會違反香港法律
只在該經營者設有海外分支機構時方適用
tc.explain: 第6.11段訂明，雖然金錢服務經營者按香港法律通常並無責任顧及其他司法管轄區的組織或當局所施加的單方面制裁，但在國際間營運的經營者須知悉該等司法管轄區有關制裁制度的範圍及重點；如該等制裁制度可能影響其營運，該經營者應考慮存在甚麼影響並採取適當措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.12段

en.q: What does ¶6.12 require of an MSO in relation to the TF, financial sanctions and PF regimes?
options: Effective policies, procedures and controls to ensure compliance, with the legal and regulatory obligations of the MSO and its staff well understood and adequate guidance and training provided to staff
A written legal opinion on each sanctions regime
An annual external audit of its sanctions controls
Notification to the CCE of each screening alert raised
en.explain: ¶6.12 states that an MSO should establish and maintain effective policies, procedures and controls to ensure compliance with the relevant regulations and legislation on TF, financial sanctions and PF, and that the legal and regulatory obligations of MSOs and those of their staff should be well understood, with adequate guidance and training provided to staff.

tc.q: 就恐怖分子資金籌集、金融制裁及擴散資金籌集制度，第6.12段對金錢服務經營者有何要求？
options: 建立及維持有效的政策、程序及管控以確保合規；該經營者及其員工的法律及監管責任須獲充分理解，並須向員工提供充分的指引及培訓
就每套制裁制度取得書面法律意見
每年就其制裁管控進行外部審計
將每宗篩查警示通知海關關長
tc.explain: 第6.12段訂明該經營者應建立及維持有效的政策、程序及管控，以確保遵從有關恐怖分子資金籌集、金融制裁及擴散資金籌集的相關規例及法例；金錢服務經營者及其員工的法律及監管責任應獲充分理解，並應向員工提供充分的指引及培訓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.13段

en.q: What database should an MSO maintain, and what alternative is permitted?
options: A database of names and particulars of terrorists and designated parties consolidating the various lists made known to it; alternatively it may subscribe to a third party service provider's database and take appropriate measures, such as periodic sample testing, to ensure completeness and accuracy
A database of its own customers only; no alternative is permitted
A database maintained jointly with other MSOs; alternatively a manual paper file
A database supplied by the CCE; no alternative is permitted
en.explain: ¶6.13 states that it is particularly vital that an MSO should be able to identify terrorist suspects and possible designated parties and detect prohibited transactions, and that to this end it should maintain a database of names and particulars of terrorists and designated parties consolidating the various lists made known to it; alternatively it may subscribe to such a database maintained by a third party service provider and take appropriate measures — for example conducting sample testing periodically — to ensure the completeness and accuracy of the database.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應維持甚麼資料庫？獲准採用甚麼替代方式？
options: 維持一個綜合各份已知悉名單的恐怖分子及指定人士姓名及詳情資料庫；或可訂用第三方服務供應商所維持的該等資料庫，並採取適當措施（例如定期進行抽樣測試）以確保其完整及準確
只維持其本身客戶的資料庫；不容許替代方式
與其他金錢服務經營者共同維持的資料庫；或以人手紙本檔案代替
由海關關長提供的資料庫；不容許替代方式
tc.explain: 第6.13段訂明該經營者必須能夠識別恐怖分子嫌疑人及可能的指定人士，並偵測受禁交易；為此應維持一個綜合各份已向其公布名單的恐怖分子及指定人士姓名及詳情的資料庫；或可訂用由第三方服務供應商維持的該等資料庫，並採取適當措施（例如定期進行抽樣測試）以確保該資料庫的完整及準確。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.14段

en.q: What legal significance may inclusion of a country, individual, entity or activity in a UNSCR or sanctions list have, even where that list has not been implemented through Hong Kong legislation?
options: It may constitute grounds for knowledge or suspicion for the purposes of relevant ML, TF and PF laws, thereby triggering statutory reporting obligations and offence provisions
It has no legal significance until implemented locally
It automatically makes any transaction void
It obliges the MSO to terminate the relationship immediately
en.explain: ¶6.14 states that whether or not a UNSCR or sanctions list has been implemented through Hong Kong legislation, there are offences under existing legislation relating to ML, TF and PF that are relevant, and that inclusion of a country, individual, entity or activity in the UNSCR or sanctions list may constitute grounds for knowledge or suspicion for the purposes of those laws, thereby triggering statutory (including reporting) obligations as well as offence provisions.

tc.q: 即使某份聯合國決議或制裁名單尚未透過香港法例實施，將某國家、個人、實體或活動列入其中可能有何法律意義？
options: 就有關洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的法律而言，可構成知悉或懷疑的理由，從而觸發法定（包括報告）責任及罪行條文
在本地實施前並無任何法律意義
自動令任何交易無效
令該經營者有責任立即終止該業務關係
tc.explain: 第6.14段訂明，不論某份聯合國決議或制裁名單有否透過香港法例實施，現行有關洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的法例下均有相關罪行；將某國家、個人、實體或活動列入該等名單，就該等法律而言可構成知悉或懷疑的理由，從而觸發法定（包括報告）責任及罪行條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.14段

en.q: How quickly must UNSCR and sanctions list entries be added to an MSO's database?
options: As soon as practicable after they are promulgated by the UNSC, and regardless of whether the relevant sanctions have been implemented by legislation in Hong Kong
Only once the relevant sanctions have been implemented by Hong Kong legislation
At the next scheduled quarterly database update
Within 30 days of the CCE drawing them to the MSO's attention
en.explain: ¶6.14 states that the CCE draws to the attention of MSOs from time to time whenever there are updates to UNSCRs or sanctions lists relating to terrorism, TF and PF promulgated by the UNSC, and that MSOs should ensure that countries, individuals and entities included in those lists are included in the database as soon as practicable after they are promulgated by the UNSC and regardless of whether the relevant sanctions have been implemented by legislation in Hong Kong.

tc.q: 聯合國決議及制裁名單的項目須多快加入金錢服務經營者的資料庫？
options: 在安理會公布後在切實可行範圍內盡快加入，且不論有關制裁有否已透過香港法例實施
待有關制裁已透過香港法例實施後方加入
於下次定期季度資料庫更新時加入
於海關關長提請該經營者注意後30日內加入
tc.explain: 第6.14段訂明，每當聯合國安全理事會公布與恐怖主義、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集有關的決議或制裁名單更新時，海關關長會不時提請金錢服務經營者注意；經營者應確保在安理會公布後，在切實可行範圍內盡快將該等名單所列的國家、個人及實體加入資料庫，且不論有關制裁有否已透過香港法例實施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.15段

en.q: Which two categories of list must an MSO include in its database under ¶6.15?
options: The lists published in the Gazette or on the website of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau; and the lists that the CCE draws to the attention of MSOs from time to time
The lists published by the FATF; and the lists published by its correspondent banks
The lists maintained by its third party database provider; and its own internal watchlist
The lists published by the JFIU; and the lists published by the Security Bureau
en.explain: ¶6.15 states that an MSO should include in its database the lists published in the Gazette or on the website of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau, and the lists that the CCE draws to the attention of MSOs from time to time.

tc.q: 根據第6.15段，金錢服務經營者須在其資料庫中納入哪兩類名單？
options: 在憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站刊登的名單；以及海關關長不時提請金錢服務經營者注意的名單
財務行動特別組織公布的名單；以及其代理銀行公布的名單
其第三方資料庫供應商所維持的名單；以及其本身的內部監察名單
聯合財富情報組公布的名單；以及保安局公布的名單
tc.explain: 第6.15段訂明該經營者應在其資料庫中納入：(a)在憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站刊登的名單；及(b)海關關長不時提請金錢服務經營者注意的名單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.15段

en.q: What two further requirements apply to the sanctions database itself?
options: It should be subject to timely update whenever there are changes, and should be made easily accessible by relevant staff
It should be backed up daily, and stored outside Hong Kong
It should be encrypted, and accessible only to the compliance officer
It should be audited annually, and certified by the CCE
en.explain: ¶6.15 states that the database should also be subject to timely update whenever there are changes, and should be made easily accessible by relevant staff. A database that is current but not usable by front-line staff does not serve the screening purpose in ¶6.16.

tc.q: 就制裁資料庫本身，另有哪兩項要求？
options: 每當有變動時須適時更新；並須讓相關員工易於查閱
須每日備份，並存放於香港以外
須加密，並只限合規主任查閱
須每年審計，並經海關關長核證
tc.explain: 第6.15段訂明該資料庫每當有變動時亦須適時更新，並須讓相關員工易於查閱。資料庫縱使是最新的，若前線員工無法使用，亦不能達到第6.16段的篩查目的。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.16段

en.q: Which three elements must an MSO's screening mechanism include?
options: Screening customers and beneficial owners against the current database at the establishment of the relationship; screening them against all new and updated designations as soon as practicable; and screening all relevant parties in a cross-border wire transfer, including a remittance transaction, before executing the transfer
Screening at onboarding, at each anniversary, and at termination
Screening customers only, at onboarding and annually
Screening high-risk customers at onboarding and before each transaction
en.explain: ¶6.16 requires an effective screening mechanism including: screening customers and any beneficial owners against the current database at the establishment of the relationship; screening them against all new and any updated designations to the database as soon as practicable; and screening all relevant parties in a cross-border / cross-boundary wire transfer, including remittance transactions, against the current database before executing the transfer.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的篩查機制須包括哪三項元素？
options: 在建立業務關係時，就客戶及其任何實益擁有人與現行資料庫作篩查；在切實可行範圍內盡快就所有新增及更新的指定作篩查；以及在執行跨境電匯（包括匯款交易）前，就所有相關方作篩查
在開立客戶時、每個周年日及終止關係時篩查
只就客戶在開立時及每年篩查
就高風險客戶在開立時及每宗交易前篩查
tc.explain: 第6.16段規定須實施有效的篩查機制，包括：(a)在建立業務關係時，就其客戶及客戶的任何實益擁有人與現行資料庫作篩查；(b)在切實可行範圍內盡快就資料庫所有新增及任何更新的指定作篩查；及(c)在執行跨境／跨界電匯（包括匯款交易）前，就所有相關方與現行資料庫作篩查。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.6段

en.q: Before a $20,000 remittance an MSO records the originator's name and identification document number, the currency and amount, the date and time of the instruction, and the recipient's name, address and method of delivery. Which required particular is missing?
options: The originator's address
The originator's occupation
The recipient's identification document number
The purpose of the remittance
en.explain: ¶11.6 requires five particulars: the originator's name; the originator's identification document number and, if it is a travel document, its place of issue; the originator's address; the currency and amount involved; and the date and time of receipt of the instruction, the recipient's name and address and the method of delivery. The originator's address is the one omitted here.

tc.q: 在一宗20,000元的匯款前，某金錢服務經營者記錄了匯款人的姓名及身分證明文件號碼、貨幣及款額、收到指示的日期及時間，以及收款人的姓名、地址及交付方式。欠缺了哪一項規定須記錄的詳情？
options: 匯款人的地址
匯款人的職業
收款人的身分證明文件號碼
該筆匯款的用途
tc.explain: 第11.6段規定五項詳情：匯款人的姓名；匯款人的身分證明文件號碼（如該文件是旅行證件，則另需其簽發地點）；匯款人的地址；所涉貨幣及款額；以及收到指示的日期及時間、收款人的姓名及地址，以及交付方式。此處遺漏的正是匯款人的地址。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.17段

en.q: To whom, beyond customers and beneficial owners, should the ¶6.16(a) and (b) screening requirements extend?
options: Connected parties as defined in ¶4.3.19 and persons purporting to act on behalf of a customer, using a risk-based approach
All counterparties to every transaction, without exception
The customer's bankers and professional advisers
Every employee of a corporate customer
en.explain: ¶6.17 states that the screening requirements set out in ¶6.16(a) and (b) should extend to connected parties as defined in ¶4.3.19 and PPTAs of a customer, using an RBA.

tc.q: 除客戶及實益擁有人外，第6.16(a)及(b)款的篩查規定應延伸至何人？
options: 第4.3.19段所界定的有關連人士，以及聲稱代客戶行事的人，並按風險為本方式進行
每宗交易的所有對手方，無一例外
該客戶的銀行及專業顧問
法人客戶的每一名僱員
tc.explain: 第6.17段訂明第6.16(a)及(b)款所載的篩查規定，應按風險為本方式延伸至第4.3.19段所界定的有關連人士及聲稱代客戶行事的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.18段

en.q: What should an MSO do when possible name matches are identified during screening?
options: Conduct enhanced checks to determine whether the possible matches are genuine hits; report to the JFIU in case of any suspicions of TF, PF or sanctions violations; and document the enhanced checking results together with all screening records
Treat every possible match as a genuine hit and freeze the funds
Ask the customer to confirm whether they are the listed person, and accept the answer
Refer the match to the CCE for determination before taking any action
en.explain: ¶6.18 states that when possible name matches are identified during screening, an MSO should conduct enhanced checks to determine whether the possible matches are genuine hits; that in case of any suspicions of TF, PF or sanctions violations it should make a report to the JFIU; and that records of enhanced checking results, together with all screening records, should be documented or recorded electronically.

tc.q: 在篩查過程中識別出可能的姓名配對時，金錢服務經營者應怎樣做？
options: 進行加強查核以斷定該等可能配對是否真正命中；如懷疑涉及恐怖分子資金籌集、擴散資金籌集或違反制裁，須向聯合財富情報組報告；並將加強查核結果連同所有篩查紀錄記錄在案
將每宗可能配對均視為真正命中並凍結有關資金
要求客戶確認其是否名單所列人士，並接納其答覆
在採取任何行動前先將該配對轉介海關關長裁定
tc.explain: 第6.18段訂明，在篩查過程中識別出可能的姓名配對時，該經營者應進行加強查核，以斷定該等可能配對是否真正命中；如懷疑涉及恐怖分子資金籌集、擴散資金籌集或違反制裁，該經營者應向聯合財富情報組作出報告；加強查核結果的紀錄連同所有篩查紀錄，均應以書面或電子方式記錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.19段

en.q: May an MSO rely on its overseas office to maintain the sanctions database or undertake screening?
options: Yes, but the ultimate responsibility for ensuring compliance with the relevant regulations and legislation on TF, financial sanctions and PF remains with the MSO
No — both functions must be performed in Hong Kong
Yes, and responsibility transfers to the overseas office
Only with the prior written approval of the CCE
en.explain: ¶6.19 states that an MSO may rely on its overseas office to maintain the database or to undertake the screening process, but that the MSO is reminded that the ultimate responsibility for ensuring compliance with the relevant regulations and legislation on TF, financial sanctions and PF remains with the MSO.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者可否倚賴其海外辦事處維持制裁資料庫或進行篩查？
options: 可以，但確保遵從有關恐怖分子資金籌集、金融制裁及擴散資金籌集的相關規例及法例的最終責任，仍由該經營者承擔
不可——兩項職能均須在香港履行
可以，且責任轉移至該海外辦事處
須事先取得海關關長書面批准
tc.explain: 第6.19段訂明該經營者可倚賴其海外辦事處維持該資料庫或進行篩查程序；但提醒該經營者，確保遵從有關恐怖分子資金籌集、金融制裁及擴散資金籌集的相關規例及法例的最終責任，仍由該經營者承擔。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.13段

en.q: What two capabilities does ¶6.13 identify as particularly vital for an MSO?
options: Being able to identify terrorist suspects and possible designated parties, and to detect prohibited transactions
Being able to freeze property and to prosecute offenders
Being able to license exceptions and to grant waivers
Being able to publish designations and to update the Gazette
en.explain: ¶6.13 states that it is particularly vital that an MSO should be able to identify terrorist suspects and possible designated parties, and detect prohibited transactions — and that it is to this end that the database requirement exists.

tc.q: 第6.13段指出金錢服務經營者具備哪兩項能力至為關鍵？
options: 能夠識別恐怖分子嫌疑人及可能的指定人士，以及偵測受禁交易
能夠凍結財產及檢控犯罪者
能夠批出豁免許可及給予寬免
能夠公布指定及更新憲報
tc.explain: 第6.13段訂明該經營者必須能夠識別恐怖分子嫌疑人及可能的指定人士，並偵測受禁交易——資料庫的規定正是為此而設。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.16段

en.q: At what point must the parties to a cross-border wire transfer be screened?
options: Before executing the transfer
Immediately after executing the transfer
Within one business day of the transfer
At the next periodic review of the customer
en.explain: ¶6.16(c) requires an MSO to screen all relevant parties in a cross-border / cross-boundary wire transfer, including a remittance transaction, against the current database before executing the transfer — screening after execution would not prevent the prohibited transaction.

tc.q: 跨境電匯的各方須在何時接受篩查？
options: 在執行該轉帳前
在執行該轉帳後隨即進行
在該轉帳後一個營業日內
在下次定期檢視該客戶時
tc.explain: 第6.16(c)款規定該經營者須在執行轉帳前，就跨境／跨界電匯（包括匯款交易）的所有相關方與現行資料庫作篩查——執行後才篩查並不能阻止受禁交易發生。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.16段

en.q: What is the stated purpose of the screening mechanism required by ¶6.16?
options: To avoid establishing a business relationship with, or providing any financial services to, any terrorist suspects and possible sanctioned parties included in UNSCRs and sanctions lists
To satisfy the CDD requirements in Schedule 2
To assess the customer's ML/TF risk rating
To satisfy the record-keeping requirements in Chapter 8
en.explain: ¶6.16 introduces the screening mechanism as being to avoid establishing business relationship with or providing any financial services to any terrorist suspects and possible sanctioned parties included in UNSCRs and sanctions lists, citing sections 8 and 8A of the UNATMO, section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O and the applicable UNSO regulations.

tc.q: 第6.16段所規定篩查機制的明訂目的為何？
options: 避免與聯合國決議及制裁名單所列的任何恐怖分子嫌疑人及可能受制裁人士建立業務關係或向其提供任何金融服務
符合附表2的客戶盡職審查規定
評估客戶的洗錢風險評級
符合第8章的備存紀錄規定
tc.explain: 第6.16段引述《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第8及8A條、《武器擴散（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條及適用的《聯合國制裁條例》規例，說明篩查機制旨在避免與聯合國決議及制裁名單所列的任何恐怖分子嫌疑人及可能受制裁人士建立業務關係，或向其提供任何金融服務。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.6段與第6.8段的比較

en.q: Which examples does the Guideline give of payments the Secretary for Security may licence under the UNATMO?
options: Reasonable living or legal expenses, and payments liable to be made under the Employment Ordinance
Payments of dividends and interest to shareholders
Payments for charitable donations and religious purposes
Payments of taxes and government fees
