en.explain: ¶6.6 states that the S for S can licence exceptions to the prohibitions to enable frozen property to be unfrozen and to allow payments to be made to or for the benefit of a designated party under the UNATMO, giving as examples reasonable living or legal expenses and payments liable to be made under the Employment Ordinance.

tc.q: 本指引就保安局局長根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》可許可的付款，舉出哪些例子？
options: 合理生活或法律開支，以及根據《僱傭條例》須支付的款項
向股東支付的股息及利息
慈善捐款及宗教用途的付款
稅款及政府費用的付款
tc.explain: 第6.6段訂明保安局局長可就有關禁制發出許可，以容許解除凍結財產，並容許根據該條例向指定人士或為其利益作出付款；並以合理生活／法律開支，以及根據《僱傭條例》須支付的款項為例。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: Under which part of the UN Charter are the resolutions imposing mandatory PF obligations on member states made?
options: Chapter VII
Chapter VI
Chapter IV
Chapter XI
en.explain: ¶6.9 states that to combat PF the UNSC adopts a two-tiered approach through resolutions made under Chapter VII of the UN Charter, imposing mandatory obligations on UN member states.

tc.q: 對成員國施加強制性擴散資金籌集責任的決議，是根據《聯合國憲章》哪一章作出？
options: 第七章
第六章
第四章
第十一章
tc.explain: 第6.9段訂明為打擊擴散資金籌集，聯合國安全理事會透過根據《聯合國憲章》第七章作出、對聯合國成員國施加強制責任的決議，採取雙層方針。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.18段

en.q: In what form must records of screening and enhanced checking be kept?
options: They should be documented, or recorded electronically
They must be kept in hard copy only
They must be kept on the third party provider's system
No records are required once a match is cleared
en.explain: ¶6.18 states that records of enhanced checking results, together with all screening records, should be documented, or recorded electronically. The obligation covers all screening records, not merely those that produced a genuine hit.

tc.q: 篩查及加強查核的紀錄須以何種形式保存？
options: 應以書面或電子方式記錄
只可以印本形式保存
須存放於第三方供應商的系統
一旦排除配對即無須保存紀錄
tc.explain: 第6.18段訂明加強查核結果的紀錄連同所有篩查紀錄，均應以書面或電子方式記錄。該項責任涵蓋所有篩查紀錄，而不限於產生真正命中的紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.1段

en.q: How is a wire transfer defined for the purposes of section 12 of Schedule 2?
options: A transaction carried out by an ordering institution on behalf of an originator by electronic means with a view to making an amount of money available to that person or another person at a beneficiary institution, whether or not intermediary institutions participate
Any transfer of money between two banks in different jurisdictions
Any electronic payment exceeding $8,000
Any transfer of money carried out otherwise than in cash
en.explain: ¶10.1 defines a wire transfer as a transaction carried out by an institution (the ordering institution) on behalf of a person (the originator) by electronic means with a view to making an amount of money available to that person or another person (the recipient) at an institution (the beneficiary institution), which may be the ordering institution or another institution, whether or not one or more other institutions (intermediary institutions) participate in completion of the transfer.

tc.q: 就附表2第12條而言，「電匯」如何界定？
options: 由某機構（匯款機構）代某人（匯款人）以電子方式進行的交易，目的是使某筆款項可由該人或另一人（收款人）在某機構（收款機構）取得，不論有否中介機構參與
任何在不同司法管轄區的兩家銀行之間的款項轉移
任何超過8,000元的電子付款
任何以現金以外方式進行的款項轉移
tc.explain: 第10.1段界定電匯為：由某機構（匯款機構）代某人（匯款人）以電子方式進行的交易，目的是使某筆款項可由該人或另一人（收款人）在某機構（收款機構，可以是該匯款機構或另一機構）取得，而不論有否一個或多於一個其他機構（中介機構）參與完成該款項的轉移。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.1段註腳67

en.q: What example does the Guideline give of a wire transfer in which the beneficiary institution is the ordering institution?
options: A wire transfer conducted between branches of the same MSO
A wire transfer between an MSO and its correspondent bank
A wire transfer between two customers of the same MSO
A wire transfer routed back to the originator after rejection
en.explain: Footnote 67 to ¶10.1 gives, as an example of a wire transfer where the beneficiary institution may be the ordering institution itself, a wire transfer conducted between branches of the same MSO.

tc.q: 本指引就收款機構同時是匯款機構的電匯，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 在同一金錢服務經營者的分行之間進行的電匯
金錢服務經營者與其代理銀行之間的電匯
同一金錢服務經營者的兩名客戶之間的電匯
被拒後退回匯款人的電匯
tc.explain: 第10.1段註腳67就收款機構可以是匯款機構本身的電匯舉例：在同一金錢服務經營者的分行之間進行的電匯。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.2段

en.q: What is the position where an MSO is itself the originator or the recipient of a wire transfer?
options: It is not acting as an ordering, intermediary or beneficiary institution and so is not required to comply with section 12 of Schedule 2 or Chapter 10 in respect of that transaction
It must comply with all the requirements as if it were the ordering institution
It must comply only with the record-keeping requirements
It must obtain the CCE's approval before carrying out the transfer
en.explain: ¶10.2 states that where an MSO is the originator or recipient of a wire transfer, it is not acting as an ordering institution, an intermediary institution or a beneficiary institution, and thus is not required to comply with the requirements under section 12 of Schedule 2 or Chapter 10 in respect of that transaction.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者本身是電匯的匯款人或收款人，情況如何？
options: 該經營者並非以匯款機構、中介機構或收款機構的身分行事，故就該宗交易無須遵從附表2第12條或第10章的規定
須猶如匯款機構般遵從所有規定
只須遵從備存紀錄的規定
須先取得海關關長批准方可進行該轉帳
tc.explain: 第10.2段訂明，如該經營者是電匯的匯款人或收款人，即並非以匯款機構、中介機構或收款機構的身分行事，故就該宗交易無須遵從附表2第12條或第10章的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.3段

en.q: Do the wire transfer requirements apply to transfers using a cover payment mechanism, such as MT202COV payments?
options: Yes — section 12 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 10 are also applicable to wire transfers using a cover payment mechanism
No — cover payments are excluded as inter-institution transfers
Only where the underlying transfer exceeds $120,000
Only where an intermediary institution is involved
en.explain: ¶10.3 states that the requirements set out in section 12 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 10 are also applicable to wire transfers using a cover payment mechanism, giving MT202COV payments as the example.

tc.q: 電匯的規定是否適用於使用補足付款機制（例如MT202COV付款）的轉帳？
options: 適用——附表2第12條及第10章的規定同樣適用於使用補足付款機制的電匯
不適用——補足付款屬機構間轉帳而獲豁除
只在相關轉帳超過120,000元時適用
只在有中介機構參與時適用
tc.explain: 第10.3段訂明附表2第12條及第10章所載的規定，同樣適用於使用補足付款機制的電匯（例如MT202COV付款）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.3段註腳68

en.q: Which two publications does the Guideline direct MSOs to on cover payment messages?
options: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision paper of May 2009 on due diligence and transparency regarding cover payment messages, and the HKMA guidance paper of February 2010
The FATF Recommendations and the Wolfsberg Principles
The UNSC resolutions and the CCE's circulars
The SWIFT message standards and the HKICL rules
en.explain: Footnote 68 to ¶10.3 states that reference should be made to the paper on due diligence and transparency regarding cover payment messages related to cross-border wire transfer published by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision in May 2009, and the guidance paper on cover payment messages related to cross-border wire transfers issued by the HKMA in February 2010.

tc.q: 本指引就補足付款訊息指引金錢服務經營者參考哪兩份刊物？
options: 巴塞爾銀行監管委員會於2009年5月發表有關補足付款訊息的盡職審查及透明度的文件，以及金融管理局於2010年2月發出的指導文件
財務行動特別組織建議及沃爾夫斯堡原則
聯合國安理會決議及海關關長的通告
環球銀行金融電信協會訊息標準及香港銀行同業結算的規則
tc.explain: 第10.3段註腳68訂明應參考巴塞爾銀行監管委員會於2009年5月發表有關跨境電匯補足付款訊息的盡職審查及透明度的文件，以及金融管理局於2010年2月發出有關跨境電匯補足付款訊息的指導文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.4(a)及(b)段

en.q: On what condition are wire transfers between an MSO and an FI, or between an MSO and a foreign institution, excluded from section 12 of Schedule 2?
options: If each of them acts on its own behalf
If the transfer is below $8,000
If the transfer is a domestic wire transfer
If both are supervised by the same regulator
en.explain: ¶10.4(a) and (b) exclude from section 12 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 10 a wire transfer between an MSO and an FI as defined in the AMLO, and a wire transfer between an MSO and a foreign institution, in each case if each of them acts on its own behalf. Where either acts for a customer, the exclusion does not apply.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者與金融機構之間，或與外地機構之間的電匯，在甚麼條件下獲豁除於附表2第12條之外？
options: 各方均為其本身行事
該轉帳低於8,000元
該轉帳屬本地電匯
雙方由同一監管機構監管
tc.explain: 第10.4(a)及(b)款將以下電匯豁除於附表2第12條及第10章之外：金錢服務經營者與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構之間的電匯，以及金錢服務經營者與外地機構之間的電匯——兩者均須各方為其本身行事。如任何一方是代客戶行事，則該豁除並不適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.4段註腳69

en.q: How is a foreign institution defined for the purposes of section 12 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 10?
options: An institution that is located in a place outside Hong Kong and that carries on a business similar to that carried on by an FI as defined in the AMLO
Any institution incorporated outside Hong Kong
Any institution licensed by a regulator in an equivalent jurisdiction
Any institution that is a member of a foreign banking group
en.explain: Footnote 69 to ¶10.4 states that for the purpose of section 12 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 10, 'foreign institution' means an institution that is located in a place outside Hong Kong and that carries on a business similar to that carried on by an FI as defined in the AMLO.

tc.q: 就附表2第12條及第10章而言，「外地機構」如何界定？
options: 位於香港以外地方，並經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構所經營者類似業務的機構
任何在香港以外註冊成立的機構
任何獲同等司法管轄區的監管機構發牌的機構
任何屬外地銀行集團成員的機構
tc.explain: 第10.4段註腳69訂明就附表2第12條及第10章而言，「外地機構」指位於香港以外地方，並經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構所經營者類似業務的機構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.4(c)段

en.q: Which three conditions must all be met for a card-related transaction to fall outside the wire transfer requirements?
options: The transfer arises from a transaction carried out using a credit, debit or prepaid card; the card is not used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer; and the card number or equivalent unique identifier is included in the message or payment form accompanying the transfer
The card is issued in Hong Kong; the transaction is below $8,000; and the cardholder is the originator
The card is a credit card; the merchant is in Hong Kong; and the transaction is in Hong Kong dollars
The card is used at an automated teller machine; the transaction is a cash withdrawal; and the account is held with the MSO
en.explain: ¶10.4(c) excludes a wire transfer if it arises from a transaction carried out using a credit card, debit card or prepaid card — such as an ATM withdrawal, a cash advance, or paying for goods or services — and the card is not used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer, and the card number or equivalent unique identifier is included in the message or payment form accompanying the transfer. All three limbs must be satisfied.

tc.q: 與卡有關的交易須同時符合哪三項條件，方可豁除於電匯規定之外？
options: 該轉帳源自使用信用卡、扣賬卡或預付卡進行的交易；該卡並非用作付款系統以進行人對人的轉帳；以及該卡的號碼或等同的獨有識別編號已載於伴隨該轉帳的訊息或付款表格內
該卡在香港發出；該交易低於8,000元；以及持卡人是匯款人
該卡是信用卡；商戶位於香港；以及該交易以港元進行
該卡在自動櫃員機使用；該交易是提取現金；以及該帳戶在該經營者處開立
tc.explain: 第10.4(c)款豁除以下電匯：源自使用信用卡、扣賬卡或預付卡進行的交易（例如以扣賬卡在自動櫃員機從銀行帳戶提款、以信用卡取得現金透支，或以信用卡、扣賬卡或預付卡支付貨品或服務）；該卡並非用作付款系統以進行人對人的轉帳；以及該卡的號碼（或等同的獨有識別編號）已載於伴隨該轉帳的訊息或付款表格內。三項條件須同時符合。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5段

en.q: Which piece of originator information is required for a wire transfer of $8,000 or above but NOT for one below that amount?
options: The originator's address, or customer identification number or identification document number, or (for an individual) date and place of birth
The originator's name
The number of the originator's account with the ordering institution
The recipient's name
en.explain: ¶10.5 requires five items for a transfer of $8,000 or above: the originator's name; the originator's account number or a unique reference number; the originator's address or customer identification number or identification document number or, for an individual, date and place of birth; the recipient's name; and the recipient's account number or a unique reference number. ¶10.6 requires only four for transfers below $8,000 — the third item is dropped.

tc.q: 哪一項匯款人資料是8,000元或以上的電匯所需，但低於該款額的電匯則不需？
options: 匯款人的地址，或客戶識別編號或身分證明文件號碼，或（如屬個人）出生日期及地點
匯款人的姓名
匯款人在匯款機構開立的帳戶號碼
收款人的姓名
tc.explain: 第10.5段就8,000元或以上的電匯規定五項資料：匯款人的姓名；匯款人的帳戶號碼或獨有參考編號；匯款人的地址，或客戶識別編號或身分證明文件號碼，或（如屬個人）出生日期及地點；收款人的姓名；以及收款人的帳戶號碼或獨有參考編號。第10.6段就低於8,000元的電匯只規定四項——第三項獲豁除。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5(b)段

en.q: What must accompany a wire transfer where the originator has no account with the ordering institution?
options: A unique reference number assigned by the ordering institution
The originator's identity card number in place of an account number
The account number of the ordering institution itself
Nothing — the account number field may be left blank
en.explain: ¶10.5(b) requires the number of the originator's account maintained with the ordering institution and from which the money for the wire transfer is paid or, in the absence of such an account, a unique reference number assigned by the ordering institution. ¶10.7 adds that the number should permit traceability of the wire transfer.

tc.q: 如匯款人在匯款機構並無帳戶，電匯須附有甚麼？
options: 由匯款機構編配的獨有參考編號
以匯款人的身分證號碼代替帳戶號碼
匯款機構本身的帳戶號碼
無須任何資料——帳戶號碼一欄可留空
tc.explain: 第10.5(b)款規定須附有匯款人在匯款機構開立、並從中支付該電匯款項的帳戶的號碼；如並無該等帳戶，則須附有由匯款機構編配的獨有參考編號。第10.7段補充該編號應能追查該宗電匯。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.7段

en.q: What must the unique reference number assigned by an ordering or beneficiary institution permit?
options: Traceability of the wire transfer
Identification of the currency of the transfer
Calculation of the fee charged
Reconciliation of the institution's daily settlement
en.explain: ¶10.7 states that the unique reference number assigned by the ordering institution or beneficiary institution referred to in ¶10.5 and ¶10.6 should permit traceability of the wire transfer — which is the purpose the number serves in place of an account number.

tc.q: 由匯款機構或收款機構編配的獨有參考編號須能達到甚麼？
options: 追查該宗電匯
識別該轉帳的貨幣
計算所收取的費用
核對該機構的每日結算
tc.explain: 第10.7段訂明第10.5及10.6段所指由匯款機構或收款機構編配的獨有參考編號，應能追查該宗電匯——這正是該編號在沒有帳戶號碼時所發揮的作用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5段註腳70

en.q: What must a customer identification number refer to, if it is used in place of the originator's address?
options: A record held by the originating institution containing at least one of the customer address, the identification document number, or the date and place of birth
A record held by the beneficiary institution containing the recipient's details
The customer's account statement for the preceding twelve months
A record held by the CCE
en.explain: Footnote 70 to ¶10.5 states that the customer identification number uniquely identifies the originator to the originating institution and is different from the unique transaction reference number in ¶10.7, and that it must refer to a record held by the originating institution which contains at least one of the following: the customer address, the identification document number, or the date and place of birth.

tc.q: 如以客戶識別編號代替匯款人的地址，該編號須指向甚麼？
options: 匯款機構所持有、至少載有客戶地址、身分證明文件號碼或出生日期及地點其中一項的紀錄
收款機構所持有、載有收款人詳情的紀錄
該客戶過去十二個月的帳戶結單
海關關長所持有的紀錄
tc.explain: 第10.5段註腳70訂明客戶識別編號指可令匯款機構獨有地識別該匯款人的編號，並有別於第10.7段所指的獨有交易參考編號；該客戶識別編號必須指向匯款機構所持有的紀錄，而該紀錄至少載有以下其中一項：客戶地址、身分證明文件號碼，或出生日期及地點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.8段

en.q: What additional quality requirement applies to originator information accompanying a wire transfer of $8,000 or above?
options: The ordering institution must ensure that the required originator information is accurate
The information must be certified by the originator in writing
The information must be translated into English
The information must be verified against a government database
en.explain: ¶10.8 states that for a wire transfer of an amount equal to or above $8,000, or an equivalent amount in any other currency, an ordering institution must ensure that the required originator information accompanying the wire transfer is accurate.

tc.q: 就8,000元或以上的電匯，伴隨的匯款人資料另有何素質要求？
options: 匯款機構須確保所需的匯款人資料屬準確
該等資料須由匯款人書面核證
該等資料須翻譯為英文
該等資料須與政府資料庫核對
tc.explain: 第10.8段訂明就款額相等於或高於8,000元（或任何其他貨幣的等值款額）的電匯，匯款機構須確保伴隨該電匯的所需匯款人資料屬準確。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.9段

en.q: Must an ordering institution verify the originator's identity for an occasional wire transfer of $8,000 or above?
options: Yes — for an occasional wire transfer involving an amount equal to or above $8,000, the ordering institution must verify the identity of the originator
No — verification is required only for business relationships
Only where the originator is not physically present
Only where the transfer is cross-border
en.explain: ¶10.9 states that for an occasional wire transfer involving an amount equal to or above $8,000, or an equivalent amount in any other currency, an ordering institution must verify the identity of the originator.

tc.q: 就8,000元或以上的單一宗電匯，匯款機構是否須核實匯款人的身分？
options: 須要——就涉及款額相等於或高於8,000元的單一宗電匯，匯款機構須核實匯款人的身分
無須——只有業務關係方須核實
只在匯款人並未親身到場時方須
只在該轉帳屬跨境時方須
tc.explain: 第10.9段訂明就涉及款額相等於或高於8,000元（或任何其他貨幣的等值款額）的單一宗電匯，匯款機構須核實匯款人的身分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.9段

en.q: In which two situations must an ordering institution verify the originator's identity even for an occasional wire transfer below $8,000?
options: Where several transactions are carried out which appear to the ordering institution to be linked and are equal to or above $8,000; or where there is a suspicion of ML/TF
Where the transfer is cross-border; or where the originator is a corporation
Where the originator has no account; or where the recipient is overseas
Where the transfer is in a foreign currency; or where the originator pays in cash
en.explain: ¶10.9 states that for an occasional wire transfer below $8,000 the ordering institution is in general not required to verify the originator's identity, except when several transactions are carried out which appear to the ordering institution to be linked and are equal to or above $8,000, or when there is a suspicion of ML/TF.

tc.q: 即使單一宗電匯低於8,000元，匯款機構在哪兩種情況下仍須核實匯款人身分？
options: 進行多宗交易而在匯款機構看來屬有關連，且合計相等於或高於8,000元；或有洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑
該轉帳屬跨境；或匯款人是法團
匯款人並無帳戶；或收款人身處海外
該轉帳以外幣進行；或匯款人以現金支付
tc.explain: 第10.9段訂明就低於8,000元（或任何其他貨幣的等值款額）的單一宗電匯，匯款機構一般無須核實匯款人的身分；但如進行多宗交易而在匯款機構看來屬有關連且合計相等於或高於8,000元，或有洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑，則屬例外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.10段

en.q: What may an ordering institution include in the individual wire transfers within a batch file to recipients outside Hong Kong, and what must the batch file itself contain?
options: Only the originator's account number or a unique reference number in the wire transfer, provided the batch file contains required and accurate originator information and required recipient information that is fully traceable within the recipient country
Only the originator's name in the wire transfer, with the batch file containing nothing further
The complete originator information in each wire transfer, with no batch file requirements
Nothing in the wire transfer, with all information held only by the ordering institution
en.explain: ¶10.10 states that an ordering institution may bundle a number of wire transfers from a single originator into a batch file for transmission to a recipient or recipients outside Hong Kong; in such cases it may only include the originator's account number or, in the absence of such an account, a unique reference number in the wire transfer, but the batch file should contain required and accurate originator information and required recipient information that is fully traceable within the recipient country.

tc.q: 就傳送至香港以外收款人的批次檔案，匯款機構可在個別電匯中只載列甚麼？該批次檔案本身須載有甚麼？
options: 電匯中可只載列匯款人的帳戶號碼或獨有參考編號；但該批次檔案須載有所需而準確的匯款人資料及所需的收款人資料，並在收款國家可完全追查
電匯中可只載列匯款人姓名；批次檔案無須載有其他資料
每宗電匯均須載列完整的匯款人資料；批次檔案並無規定
電匯中無須載列任何資料；所有資料只由匯款機構持有
tc.explain: 第10.10段訂明匯款機構可將來自同一匯款人的多宗電匯合併為批次檔案，以傳送予身處香港以外地方的一名或多於一名收款人；在此情況下，該機構在電匯中可只載列匯款人的帳戶號碼（如並無該等帳戶，則為獨有參考編號），但該批次檔案應載有所需而準確的匯款人資料及所需的收款人資料，並須在收款國家可完全追查。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.11段註腳71

en.q: How is a domestic wire transfer defined?
options: A wire transfer in which the ordering institution, the beneficiary institution and any intermediary institutions involved are all FIs as defined in the AMLO located in Hong Kong
A wire transfer denominated in Hong Kong dollars
A wire transfer between two customers who are both Hong Kong residents
A wire transfer that does not pass through any intermediary institution
en.explain: Footnote 71 to ¶10.11 defines a domestic wire transfer as a wire transfer in which the ordering institution and the beneficiary institution and, if one or more intermediary institutions are involved in the transfer, the intermediary institution or all the intermediary institutions are FIs as defined in the AMLO located in Hong Kong.

tc.q: 「本地電匯」如何界定？
options: 匯款機構、收款機構，以及（如有中介機構參與）該中介機構或所有中介機構，均為位於香港、《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構的電匯
以港元計值的電匯
匯款人與收款人均為香港居民的電匯
並無經任何中介機構的電匯
tc.explain: 第10.11段註腳71界定本地電匯為：匯款機構及收款機構，以及（如有一個或多於一個中介機構參與該轉帳）該中介機構或所有中介機構，均為位於香港、《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構的電匯。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.11段

en.q: What concession applies to an ordering institution in respect of a domestic wire transfer?
options: It may choose not to include the complete required originator information and include only the originator's account number or a unique reference number, provided that number permits traceability
It need not include any originator information at all
It need not include recipient information
It need not verify the originator's identity in any case
en.explain: ¶10.11 states that for a domestic wire transfer an ordering institution may choose not to include the complete required originator information in the wire transfer but only include the originator's account number or, in the absence of an account, a unique reference number, provided that the number permits traceability of the wire transfer.

tc.q: 就本地電匯，匯款機構獲甚麼寬免？
options: 可選擇不在電匯中載列完整的所需匯款人資料，而只載列匯款人的帳戶號碼或獨有參考編號，惟該編號須能追查該宗電匯
完全無須載列任何匯款人資料
無須載列收款人資料
在任何情況下均無須核實匯款人身分
tc.explain: 第10.11段訂明就本地電匯，匯款機構可選擇不在電匯中載列完整的所需匯款人資料，而只載列匯款人的帳戶號碼（如並無帳戶，則為獨有參考編號），惟該編號須能追查該宗電匯。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.12段

en.q: Within what period must an ordering institution that used the ¶10.11 concession supply complete originator information on request, and to whom?
options: Within 3 business days after the request is received, on the request of the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction or the CCE
Within 7 business days, on the request of the beneficiary institution only
Within 30 days, on the request of the CCE only
Immediately, on the request of any party to the transfer
en.explain: ¶10.12 states that if an ordering institution chooses not to include complete required originator information as stated in ¶10.11, it must, on the request of the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction or the CCE, provide complete required originator information within 3 business days after the request is received.

tc.q: 採用第10.11段寬免的匯款機構，須在多久內、應何人要求提供完整的匯款人資料？
options: 應接收其轉帳指示的機構或海關關長的要求，在收到要求後3個營業日內提供
應收款機構的要求，在7個營業日內提供
應海關關長的要求，在30日內提供
應該轉帳任何一方的要求，即時提供
tc.explain: 第10.12段訂明，如匯款機構按第10.11段選擇不載列完整的所需匯款人資料，則須應接收其轉帳指示的機構或海關關長的要求，在收到要求後3個營業日內提供完整的所需匯款人資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.12段

en.q: How quickly must such originator information be made available to law enforcement agencies?
options: Immediately upon request
Within 3 business days, as for other requests
Within 7 days of a written request
Only upon production of a court order
en.explain: ¶10.12 states that in addition to the 3-business-day period applying to a request from the institution receiving the transfer instruction or the CCE, such information should be made available to law enforcement agencies immediately upon request.

tc.q: 該等匯款人資料須多快提供予執法機關？
options: 應要求即時提供
一如其他要求，於3個營業日內提供
於書面要求後7日內提供
須出示法院命令方須提供
tc.explain: 第10.12段訂明，除適用於接收轉帳指示的機構或海關關長的3個營業日期限外，該等資料應應執法機關的要求即時提供。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.13(a)段

en.q: What example does the Guideline give of reasonable measures an ordering institution should take to identify outgoing transfers lacking required information?
options: Regular review or testing by the internal control or audit function to assess system capabilities
Post-event monitoring of completed transfers
Straight-through processing filters applied at the point of receipt
Annual certification by the correspondent bank
en.explain: ¶10.13(a) requires an ordering institution to take reasonable measures — giving as an example regular review or testing by the internal control or audit function to assess system capabilities — to identify whether domestic or cross-border wire transfers lack required originator information or required recipient information.

tc.q: 本指引就匯款機構識別欠缺所需資料的匯出轉帳，舉出哪一項合理措施的例子？
options: 由內部監控或審計職能定期檢視或測試，以評估系統能力
對已完成的轉帳進行事後監察
在接收時應用直通式處理的過濾機制
由代理銀行每年作出核證
tc.explain: 第10.13(a)款規定匯款機構須採取合理措施（例如由內部監控或審計職能定期檢視或測試，以評估系統能力），以識別本地或跨境電匯是否欠缺所需的匯款人資料或所需的收款人資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.13(b)段

en.q: Besides risk-based policies for handling deficient wire transfers, what further step does ¶10.13(b) require of an ordering institution?
options: Timely rectifying any control deficiencies identified
Reporting each deficient transfer to the JFIU
Notifying the CCE of each control deficiency
Suspending the affected payment channel
en.explain: ¶10.13(b) requires an ordering institution to have risk-based policies and procedures for handling wire transfers lacking required originator information or required recipient information, and to timely rectify any control deficiencies identified. The safeguards are meant to prevent non-compliant outgoing transfers being carried out at all.

tc.q: 除就資料不足的電匯訂立風險為本政策外，第10.13(b)款還要求匯款機構作甚麼？
options: 適時糾正所識別的任何管控缺失
將每宗資料不足的轉帳向聯合財富情報組報告
將每項管控缺失通知海關關長
暫停受影響的付款渠道
tc.explain: 第10.13(b)款規定匯款機構須就處理欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的電匯，訂有風險為本的政策及程序，並適時糾正所識別的任何管控缺失。該等保障措施旨在從根本上防止進行不符合規定的匯出轉帳。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.14段

en.q: What is the core duty of an intermediary institution under section 12(8) of Schedule 2?
options: To ensure that all originator and recipient information accompanying the wire transfer is retained with the transfer and is transmitted to the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction
To verify the identity of the originator before passing on the transfer
To screen the originator against its own customer database
To convert the information into the format used by the beneficiary institution
en.explain: ¶10.14 states that an intermediary institution must ensure that all originator and recipient information which accompanies the wire transfer is retained with the transfer and is transmitted to the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction.

tc.q: 根據附表2第12(8)條，中介機構的核心責任為何？
options: 確保伴隨該電匯的所有匯款人及收款人資料，均隨該轉帳保留，並傳送予接收其轉帳指示的機構
在轉遞該轉帳前核實匯款人的身分
將該匯款人與其本身的客戶資料庫作篩查
將該等資料轉換為收款機構所用的格式
tc.explain: 第10.14段訂明中介機構須確保伴隨該電匯的所有匯款人及收款人資料，均隨該轉帳保留，並傳送予接收其轉帳指示的機構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.15段

en.q: What must an intermediary institution do where technical limitations prevent the required information accompanying a cross-border wire transfer from remaining with a related domestic wire transfer?
options: Keep a record, for at least five years, of all the information received from the ordering institution or another intermediary institution
Reject the transfer and return the funds
Report the technical limitation to the CCE
Convert the transfer into a cross-border transfer
en.explain: ¶10.15 states that where technical limitations prevent the required originator or recipient information accompanying a cross-border wire transfer from remaining with a related domestic wire transfer, the intermediary institution should keep a record, for at least five years, of all the information received from the ordering institution or another intermediary institution — and that the requirement also applies in the reverse situation.

tc.q: 如技術限制令伴隨跨境電匯的所需資料無法隨相關的本地電匯保留，中介機構須怎樣做？
options: 就從匯款機構或另一中介機構所收到的所有資料，保存紀錄最少五年
拒絕該轉帳並退回款項
將該技術限制向海關關長報告
將該轉帳轉為跨境轉帳
tc.explain: 第10.15段訂明，如技術限制令伴隨跨境電匯的所需匯款人或收款人資料無法隨相關的本地電匯保留，中介機構應就從匯款機構或另一中介機構所收到的所有資料，保存紀錄最少五年；上述規定亦適用於技術限制令伴隨本地電匯的所需資料無法隨相關跨境電匯保留的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.16(a)段

en.q: With what must an intermediary institution's measures for identifying deficient incoming cross-border transfers be consistent?
options: Straight-through processing
Post-event monitoring
Manual review of every transfer
The beneficiary institution's own procedures
en.explain: ¶10.16(a) requires an intermediary institution to take reasonable measures, which are consistent with straight-through processing, to identify cross-border wire transfers that lack required originator information or required recipient information. By contrast ¶10.19(a) gives post-event monitoring as the example for a beneficiary institution.

tc.q: 中介機構識別資料不足的匯入跨境轉帳所採取的措施，須與甚麼一致？
options: 直通式處理
事後監察
對每宗轉帳作人手審核
收款機構本身的程序
tc.explain: 第10.16(a)款規定中介機構須採取與直通式處理一致的合理措施，以識別欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的跨境電匯。相對而言，第10.19(a)款就收款機構所舉的例子則是事後監察。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.16(b)段

en.q: What two matters must an intermediary institution's risk-based policies and procedures determine?
options: When to execute, reject, or suspend a wire transfer lacking required originator or recipient information; and the appropriate follow-up action
The fee to charge and the settlement currency
Whether to notify the originator and the recipient
Whether to file an STR and whether to freeze the funds
en.explain: ¶10.16(b) requires an intermediary institution to have risk-based policies and procedures for determining when to execute, reject, or suspend a wire transfer lacking required originator information or required recipient information, and the appropriate follow-up action.

tc.q: 中介機構的風險為本政策及程序須就哪兩方面作出決定？
options: 何時執行、拒絕或暫停欠缺所需匯款人或收款人資料的電匯；以及適當的跟進行動
收取的費用及結算貨幣
是否通知匯款人及收款人
是否提交可疑交易報告及是否凍結款項
tc.explain: 第10.16(b)款規定中介機構須訂有風險為本的政策及程序，以決定：(i)何時執行、拒絕或暫停欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的電匯；及(ii)適當的跟進行動。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.17段

en.q: From whom must an intermediary institution obtain missing originator or recipient information, and how quickly?
options: From the institution from which it receives the transfer instruction, as soon as reasonably practicable
From the originator directly, within 3 business days
From the beneficiary institution, before executing the transfer
From the CCE, upon written application
en.explain: ¶10.17 states that if a cross-border wire transfer is not accompanied by the required originator information or required recipient information, the intermediary institution must as soon as reasonably practicable obtain the missing information from the institution from which it receives the transfer instruction.

tc.q: 中介機構須向何人、多快取得欠缺的匯款人或收款人資料？
options: 向接收其轉帳指示的來源機構，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快取得
直接向匯款人，於3個營業日內取得
向收款機構，於執行該轉帳前取得
向海關關長，經書面申請取得
tc.explain: 第10.17段訂明，如跨境電匯並無附有所需的匯款人資料或所需的收款人資料，中介機構須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快，向其接收轉帳指示的來源機構取得欠缺的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.17段

en.q: What should an intermediary institution do if the missing information cannot be obtained?
options: Either consider restricting or terminating its business relationship with that institution, or take reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved
Execute the transfer and file an STR in every case
Return the funds to the originator without further action
Refer the matter to the CCE for a direction
en.explain: ¶10.17 states that if the missing information cannot be obtained, the intermediary institution should either consider restricting or terminating its business relationship with that institution, or take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of ML/TF involved.

tc.q: 如無法取得欠缺的資料，中介機構應怎樣做？
options: 考慮限制或終止其與該機構的業務關係，或採取合理措施減低所涉洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
一律執行該轉帳並提交可疑交易報告
將款項退回匯款人而不再採取任何行動
將事宜轉介海關關長以取得指示
tc.explain: 第10.17段訂明，如無法取得欠缺的資料，中介機構應考慮限制或終止其與該機構的業務關係，或採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.18段

en.q: What must an intermediary institution do if it is aware that the accompanying information purporting to be the required information is incomplete or meaningless?
options: Take reasonable measures as soon as reasonably practicable to mitigate the risk of ML/TF involved
Treat the transfer as compliant, since information was supplied
Reject the transfer automatically
Correct the information itself before passing it on
en.explain: ¶10.18 states that if the intermediary institution is aware that the accompanying information that purports to be the required originator information or required recipient information is incomplete or meaningless, it must as soon as reasonably practicable take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of ML/TF involved. Nominally complete but meaningless data is treated no better than missing data.

tc.q: 如中介機構知悉聲稱為所需資料的隨附資料並不完整或並無意義，須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
視該轉帳為符合規定，因已有提供資料
自動拒絕該轉帳
自行更正該等資料後再行轉遞
tc.explain: 第10.18段訂明，如中介機構知悉聲稱為所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的隨附資料並不完整或並無意義，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。表面完整但沒有意義的資料，與欠缺資料同等對待。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.19(a)段

en.q: Which transfers must a beneficiary institution take reasonable measures to identify as lacking required information, and what example is given?
options: Domestic or cross-border wire transfers, for example by post-event monitoring
Cross-border wire transfers only, by straight-through processing
Domestic wire transfers only, by manual inspection
Only transfers above $8,000, by pre-execution screening
en.explain: ¶10.19(a) requires a beneficiary institution to take reasonable measures — for example post-event monitoring — to identify domestic or cross-border wire transfers that lack required originator information or required recipient information. The intermediary institution's equivalent duty in ¶10.16(a) is confined to cross-border transfers.

tc.q: 收款機構須採取合理措施識別哪些欠缺所需資料的轉帳？所舉例子為何？
options: 本地或跨境電匯，例如透過事後監察
只限跨境電匯，透過直通式處理
只限本地電匯，透過人手查察
只限8,000元以上的轉帳，透過執行前篩查
tc.explain: 第10.19(a)款規定收款機構須採取合理措施（例如事後監察），以識別欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的本地或跨境電匯。第10.16(a)款所訂中介機構的相應責任則只限於跨境電匯。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.20段

en.q: For which transfers does the beneficiary institution's duty to obtain missing information arise?
options: A domestic or cross-border wire transfer not accompanied by the required originator or recipient information
Cross-border wire transfers only
Transfers of $8,000 or above only
Transfers where the originator is not a customer of the beneficiary institution
en.explain: ¶10.20 states that if a domestic or cross-border wire transfer is not accompanied by the required originator information or required recipient information, the beneficiary institution must as soon as reasonably practicable obtain the missing information from the institution from which it receives the transfer instruction, and that if it cannot be obtained it should consider restricting or terminating the relationship with that institution or take reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk.

tc.q: 收款機構取得欠缺資料的責任，就哪些轉帳而產生？
options: 並無附有所需匯款人或收款人資料的本地或跨境電匯
只限跨境電匯
只限8,000元或以上的轉帳
只限匯款人並非收款機構客戶的轉帳
tc.explain: 第10.20段訂明，如本地或跨境電匯並無附有所需的匯款人資料或所需的收款人資料，收款機構須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快，向其接收轉帳指示的來源機構取得欠缺的資料；如無法取得，則應考慮限制或終止其與該機構的業務關係，或採取合理措施減低所涉洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.22段

en.q: When should a beneficiary institution verify the identity of the recipient?
options: For a wire transfer of an amount equal to or above $8,000, if the identity has not been previously verified
For every wire transfer, regardless of amount
Only where the recipient has no account with the institution
Only where the transfer is cross-border
en.explain: ¶10.22 states that for a wire transfer of an amount equal to or above $8,000, or an equivalent amount in any other currency, a beneficiary institution should verify the identity of the recipient, if the identity has not been previously verified.

tc.q: 收款機構應在何時核實收款人的身分？
options: 就款額相等於或高於8,000元的電匯，如該身分此前未經核實
就每宗電匯，不論款額多少
只在該收款人於該機構並無帳戶時
只在該轉帳屬跨境時
tc.explain: 第10.22段訂明就款額相等於或高於8,000元（或任何其他貨幣的等值款額）的電匯，如收款人的身分此前未經核實，收款機構應核實其身分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.21段

en.q: How does a beneficiary institution's duty on incomplete or meaningless accompanying information compare with an intermediary institution's?
options: It is the same — it must as soon as reasonably practicable take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of ML/TF involved
It is stricter — it must reject the transfer outright
It is lighter — it need only record the deficiency
It does not arise — the duty falls only on the intermediary institution
en.explain: ¶10.21 imposes on a beneficiary institution the same duty as ¶10.18 imposes on an intermediary institution: if it is aware that the accompanying information purporting to be the required originator or recipient information is incomplete or meaningless, it must as soon as reasonably practicable take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of ML/TF involved.

tc.q: 就不完整或並無意義的隨附資料，收款機構的責任與中介機構的責任相比如何？
options: 兩者相同——均須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
更為嚴格——須直接拒絕該轉帳
較為寬鬆——只須記錄該項不足
並不產生——該責任只落在中介機構身上
tc.explain: 第10.21段對收款機構施加與第10.18段對中介機構相同的責任：如知悉聲稱為所需匯款人或收款人資料的隨附資料並不完整或並無意義，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.1段

en.q: Where an MSO operates in more than one jurisdiction, directly or through agents, which requirements should it follow in respect of its role in a wire transfer?
options: The relevant requirements set out in Chapter 10 in the jurisdictions in which it operates
Only the requirements of the jurisdiction in which the beneficiary institution is located
Only Hong Kong requirements, wherever it operates
Only the requirements of the jurisdiction where its head office is located
en.explain: ¶10.1 states that an MSO should follow the relevant requirements set out in Chapter 10 in the jurisdictions in which it operates, directly or through its agents, with regard to its role in a wire transfer.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者直接或透過其代理人在多於一個司法管轄區營運，就其在電匯中的角色應遵從哪些規定？
options: 其營運所在司法管轄區內、第10章所載的相關規定
只需收款機構所在司法管轄區的規定
不論在何處營運，只需香港的規定
只需其總辦事處所在司法管轄區的規定
tc.explain: 第10.1段訂明該經營者就其在電匯中的角色，應在其直接或透過代理人營運的司法管轄區內，遵從第10章所載的相關規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5及10.6段

en.q: Which recipient information is required for every wire transfer, irrespective of amount?
options: The recipient's name, and the number of the recipient's account with the beneficiary institution or a unique reference number assigned to the transfer by that institution
The recipient's name and address
The recipient's name and identification document number
The recipient's name, address and date of birth
en.explain: Both ¶10.5 (for transfers of $8,000 or above) and ¶10.6 (for transfers below that amount) require the recipient's name and the number of the recipient's account maintained with the beneficiary institution and to which the money is paid or, in the absence of such an account, a unique reference number assigned to the wire transfer by the beneficiary institution. The amount threshold affects only the originator information required.

tc.q: 不論款額多少，每宗電匯均須附有哪些收款人資料？
options: 收款人的姓名，以及收款人在收款機構開立的帳戶號碼，或由該機構就該電匯編配的獨有參考編號
收款人的姓名及地址
收款人的姓名及身分證明文件號碼
收款人的姓名、地址及出生日期
tc.explain: 第10.5段（8,000元或以上的轉帳）及第10.6段（低於該款額的轉帳）均規定須附有收款人的姓名，以及收款人在收款機構開立、並向其支付該筆款項的帳戶的號碼；如並無該等帳戶，則為由收款機構就該電匯編配的獨有參考編號。款額門檻只影響所需的匯款人資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.13段

en.q: What is the stated purpose of the effective procedures an ordering institution must establish under ¶10.13?
options: To ensure that proper safeguards exist to prevent carrying out outgoing wire transfers that do not comply with the relevant originator or recipient information requirements
To identify and handle incoming wire transfers that are deficient
To determine when to execute, reject or suspend an incoming transfer
To retain and transmit information received from other institutions
en.explain: ¶10.13 states that an ordering institution should establish and maintain effective procedures to ensure that proper safeguards exist to prevent carrying out outgoing wire transfers that do not comply with the relevant originator or recipient information requirements. The corresponding duties for incoming transfers fall on intermediary institutions under ¶10.16 and beneficiary institutions under ¶10.19.

tc.q: 第10.13段規定匯款機構建立有效程序的明訂目的為何？
options: 確保設有妥善保障措施，防止進行不符合相關匯款人或收款人資料規定的匯出電匯
識別及處理資料不足的匯入電匯
決定何時執行、拒絕或暫停匯入轉帳
保留及傳送從其他機構收到的資料
tc.explain: 第10.13段訂明匯款機構應建立及維持有效程序，以確保設有妥善保障措施，防止進行不符合相關匯款人或收款人資料規定的匯出電匯。就匯入轉帳的相應責任，則由第10.16段的中介機構及第10.19段的收款機構承擔。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.19(b)段

en.q: Which statutory provision of Schedule 2 underpins the requirement for a beneficiary institution to establish effective procedures for handling deficient incoming wire transfers?
options: Section 19(2)
Section 12(11)
Section 5(1)
Section 16
en.explain: The marginal citation to ¶10.19 is section 19(2) of Schedule 2 — the same provision cited for the equivalent procedures of ordering institutions in ¶10.13 and intermediary institutions in ¶10.16. Sections 12(9) and 12(10) are cited separately for the substantive steps in ¶10.20 and ¶10.21.

tc.q: 收款機構須就處理資料不足的匯入電匯建立有效程序，其依據為附表2哪一項條文？
options: 第16條
tc.explain: 第10.19段旁註所引條文為附表2第19(2)條——與第10.13段所訂匯款機構及第10.16段所訂中介機構的相應程序所引條文相同。第10.20及10.21段的實質步驟則另引第12(9)及12(10)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5段

en.q: An MSO acting as ordering institution executes a cross-border wire transfer of $9,000 for a walk-in customer with no account. Which combination satisfies ¶10.5?
options: The originator's name, a unique reference number assigned by the MSO, the originator's date and place of birth, the recipient's name, and the recipient's account number at the beneficiary institution
The originator's name and identity card number, and the recipient's name only
The originator's name and address, and a unique reference number only
A unique reference number and the recipient's name only
en.explain: For a transfer of $8,000 or above, ¶10.5 requires all five items. With no account, ¶10.5(b) is satisfied by a unique reference number assigned by the ordering institution that permits traceability; ¶10.5(c) may be satisfied for an individual by date and place of birth; and ¶10.5(d) and (e) require the recipient's name and account number or a unique reference number assigned by the beneficiary institution.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者以匯款機構身分，為一名並無帳戶的即場客戶執行一宗9,000元的跨境電匯。哪一組合符合第10.5段？
options: 匯款人姓名、由該經營者編配的獨有參考編號、匯款人的出生日期及地點、收款人姓名，以及收款人在收款機構的帳戶號碼
匯款人姓名及身分證號碼，以及收款人姓名
匯款人姓名及地址，以及一個獨有參考編號
一個獨有參考編號及收款人姓名
tc.explain: 就8,000元或以上的轉帳，第10.5段規定須具備全部五項資料。由於並無帳戶，第10.5(b)款可由匯款機構編配、能追查該轉帳的獨有參考編號滿足；第10.5(c)款就個人而言可由出生日期及地點滿足；第10.5(d)及(e)款則須具備收款人姓名及其帳戶號碼，或由收款機構編配的獨有參考編號。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.9段

en.q: A customer with no business relationship with an MSO makes three remittances of $3,000 each on the same day, which appear to the MSO to be linked. What follows?
options: The ordering institution must verify the originator's identity, because the linked transactions total $9,000, which is above the $8,000 threshold
No verification is required, because each transfer is below $8,000
Verification is required only for the third transfer
The MSO must decline the third transfer
en.explain: ¶10.9 states that for an occasional wire transfer below $8,000 the ordering institution is in general not required to verify the originator's identity, except when several transactions are carried out which appear to the ordering institution to be linked and are equal to or above $8,000, or when there is a suspicion of ML/TF. Three linked transfers totalling $9,000 fall within the exception.

tc.q: 某與金錢服務經營者並無業務關係的客戶，於同日作出三筆各3,000元的匯款，而在該經營者看來屬有關連。結果為何？
options: 匯款機構須核實匯款人的身分，因有關連交易合計9,000元，高於8,000元門檻
無須核實，因每宗轉帳均低於8,000元
只須就第三宗轉帳核實
該經營者須拒絕第三宗轉帳
tc.explain: 第10.9段訂明就低於8,000元的單一宗電匯，匯款機構一般無須核實匯款人身分；但如進行多宗交易而在匯款機構看來屬有關連且合計相等於或高於8,000元，或有洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑，則屬例外。三筆有關連而合計9,000元的轉帳落入該例外範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.4(c)段

en.q: Which of the following card transactions is NOT excluded from the wire transfer requirements?
options: A transfer between two individuals where the card is used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer
Withdrawing money from a bank account through an automated teller machine with a debit card
Obtaining a cash advance on a credit card
Paying for goods or services with a credit card, debit card or prepaid card
en.explain: ¶10.4(c) excludes card-based transactions such as ATM withdrawals, cash advances and payments for goods or services, but only where the card is not used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer and the card number is included in the accompanying message or payment form. A person-to-person transfer effected through a card therefore remains subject to the wire transfer requirements.

tc.q: 下列哪一項卡類交易並不獲豁除於電匯規定之外？
options: 兩名個人之間、以卡作為付款系統進行的人對人轉帳
以扣賬卡在自動櫃員機從銀行帳戶提取款項
以信用卡取得現金透支
以信用卡、扣賬卡或預付卡支付貨品或服務
tc.explain: 第10.4(c)款豁除以卡進行的交易（例如在自動櫃員機提款、現金透支及支付貨品或服務），但條件是該卡並非用作付款系統以進行人對人的轉帳，且該卡的號碼已載於隨附的訊息或付款表格內。因此，透過卡進行的人對人轉帳仍須遵從電匯的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.2段

en.q: How does the AMLO define a remittance transaction?
options: A transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong
Any transfer of money carried out by an MSO on behalf of a customer
Any transfer of money between two persons in Hong Kong
Any transaction carried out by electronic means for a customer
en.explain: ¶11.2 states that the AMLO defines a remittance transaction as a transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong, and prescribes the special requirements that must be completed by an MSO before carrying out such a transaction.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》如何界定「匯款交易」？
options: 將款項送往香港以外地方，或安排將款項送往香港以外地方的交易
金錢服務經營者代客戶進行的任何款項轉移
在香港兩人之間的任何款項轉移
為客戶以電子方式進行的任何交易
tc.explain: 第11.2段訂明《打擊洗錢條例》將匯款交易界定為將款項送往香港以外地方，或安排將款項送往香港以外地方的交易；並訂明金錢服務經營者在進行該等匯款交易前須完成的特別規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.2段

en.q: What do the section 13 special requirements for remittance transactions essentially amount to?
options: The identification and verification of the originator, and various record keeping requirements
Enhanced due diligence and senior management approval
Screening of the recipient and a report to the JFIU
Verification of the source of funds and the source of wealth
en.explain: ¶11.2 states that essentially the special requirements under section 13 of Schedule 2 amount to the identification and verification of the originator, as defined in ¶11.4, and various record keeping requirements.

tc.q: 第13條就匯款交易所訂的特別規定，實質上包括甚麼？
options: 識別匯款人及核實其身分，以及各項備存紀錄的規定
加強盡職審查及高級管理層批准
篩查收款人及向聯合財富情報組報告
核實資金來源及財富來源
tc.explain: 第11.2段訂明附表2第13條所訂的特別規定，實質上包括識別第11.4段所界定的匯款人及核實其身分，以及各項備存紀錄的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.2段

en.q: Where a transaction is a wire transfer, which requirements apply and which guidance should the MSO have regard to?
options: The special requirements under section 12 of Schedule 2, having regard to the guidance in Chapter 10
The special requirements under section 13 of Schedule 2, having regard to the guidance in Chapter 11
Both sections 12 and 13, having regard to Chapters 10 and 11 equally
Neither, since wire transfers are excluded from Schedule 2
en.explain: ¶11.2 stresses that a remittance transaction is different from a wire transfer, and states that where the transaction is a wire transfer an MSO should have regard to the guidance provided in Chapter 10 in complying with the special requirements under section 12 of Schedule 2. Section 13 applies to remittance transactions other than wire transfers.

tc.q: 如某交易屬電匯，適用哪些規定？該經營者應參考哪份指引？
options: 附表2第12條所訂的特別規定，並應參考第10章的指引
附表2第13條所訂的特別規定，並應參考第11章的指引
第12及13條同時適用，並須同等參考第10及11章
兩者均不適用，因電匯獲豁除於附表2之外
tc.explain: 第11.2段強調匯款交易有別於電匯，並訂明如該交易屬電匯，該經營者在遵從附表2第12條所訂的特別規定時，應參考第10章所提供的指引。第13條則適用於電匯以外的匯款交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.3段

en.q: For which remittance transactions must an MSO identify the originator and verify the originator's identity before carrying out the transaction?
options: A remittance transaction, other than a wire transfer, of $8,000 or above or an equivalent amount in any other currency
Every remittance transaction, regardless of amount
A remittance transaction of $120,000 or above
A remittance transaction to a jurisdiction subject to a FATF call
en.explain: ¶11.3 states that before carrying out a remittance transaction, other than a wire transfer, of $8,000 or above or of an equivalent amount in any other currency, an MSO is required to identify the originator and verify the identity of the originator.

tc.q: 就哪些匯款交易，金錢服務經營者須在進行前識別匯款人並核實其身分？
options: 款額為8,000元或以上（或任何其他貨幣的等值款額）而並非電匯的匯款交易
每宗匯款交易，不論款額多少
款額為120,000元或以上的匯款交易
匯往受財務行動特別組織呼籲規限的司法管轄區的匯款交易
tc.explain: 第11.3段訂明，在進行款額為8,000元或以上（或任何其他貨幣的等值款額）而並非電匯的匯款交易前，該經營者須識別匯款人並核實其身分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.9段

en.q: A walk-in customer makes a single occasional wire transfer of $5,000. Nothing suggests it is linked to other transactions and no suspicion of ML/TF arises. Must the ordering institution verify the originator's identity?
options: No — for an occasional wire transfer below $8,000 the ordering institution is in general not required to verify the originator's identity
Yes — verification is required for every occasional wire transfer
Yes — because the customer has no business relationship with the MSO
No — and the originator's name need not accompany the transfer either
en.explain: ¶10.9 states that for an occasional wire transfer below $8,000, or an equivalent amount in any other currency, the ordering institution is in general not required to verify the originator's identity, except where several transactions appear to be linked and are equal to or above $8,000, or where there is a suspicion of ML/TF. The ¶10.6 information requirements — including the originator's name — still apply.

tc.q: 某即場客戶進行一宗5,000元的單一宗電匯。並無跡象顯示其與其他交易有關連，亦無洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑。匯款機構是否須核實匯款人身分？
options: 無須——就低於8,000元的單一宗電匯，匯款機構一般無須核實匯款人的身分
須要——每宗單一宗電匯均須核實
須要——因該客戶與該經營者並無業務關係
無須——而匯款人的姓名亦無須隨該轉帳附上
tc.explain: 第10.9段訂明就低於8,000元（或任何其他貨幣的等值款額）的單一宗電匯，匯款機構一般無須核實匯款人的身分；但如多宗交易看似有關連且合計相等於或高於8,000元，或有洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑，則屬例外。第10.6段的資料規定（包括匯款人的姓名）則仍然適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.5段

en.q: By reference to what must an MSO identify and verify the identity of the originator of a remittance transaction?
options: The originator's identification document
A written declaration signed by the originator
A reference from another money service operator
The originator's bank statement
en.explain: ¶11.5 states that an MSO is required to identify and verify the identity of the originator of the transaction by reference to the originator's identification document, reflecting section 13(2)(a) and (b) of Schedule 2.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須參照甚麼，識別匯款交易的匯款人並核實其身分？
options: 該匯款人的身分證明文件
由該匯款人簽署的書面聲明
另一金錢服務經營者的推薦
該匯款人的銀行結單
tc.explain: 第11.5段訂明該經營者須參照匯款人的身分證明文件，識別該宗交易的匯款人並核實其身分；此反映附表2第13(2)(a)及(b)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.6段

en.q: Which of the following is NOT among the particulars an MSO must record before carrying out a remittance transaction of $8,000 or above?
options: The recipient's identification document number
The originator's name
The originator's address
The currency and amount involved
en.explain: ¶11.6 requires the MSO to record the originator's name; the originator's identification document number and, where the identification document is a travel document, its place of issue; the originator's address; the currency and amount involved; and the date and time of receipt of the instruction, the recipient's name and address and the method of delivery. The recipient's identification document number is not among them.

tc.q: 在進行8,000元或以上的匯款交易前，下列何者並非金錢服務經營者須記錄的詳情？
options: 收款人的身分證明文件號碼
匯款人的姓名
匯款人的地址
所涉貨幣及款額
tc.explain: 第11.6段規定該經營者須記錄：匯款人的姓名；匯款人的身分證明文件號碼（如該文件是旅行證件，則另需該證件的簽發地點）；匯款人的地址；所涉貨幣及款額；以及收到指示的日期及時間、收款人的姓名及地址，以及交付方式。收款人的身分證明文件號碼並不在其列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.6(b)段

en.q: What additional particular must be recorded where the originator's identification document is a travel document?
options: The place of issue of the travel document
The expiry date of the travel document
The nationality shown on the travel document
The date of the originator's last entry into Hong Kong
en.explain: ¶11.6(b) requires the MSO to record the originator's identification document number and, if the originator's identification document is a travel document, the place of issue of the travel document.

tc.q: 如匯款人的身分證明文件是旅行證件，須另行記錄甚麼詳情？
options: 該旅行證件的簽發地點
該旅行證件的屆滿日期
該旅行證件所示的國籍
該匯款人最近一次入境香港的日期
tc.explain: 第11.6(b)款規定該經營者須記錄匯款人的身分證明文件號碼；如該匯款人的身分證明文件是旅行證件，則須另行記錄該旅行證件的簽發地點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.6(e)段

en.q: Which three particulars are grouped together in ¶11.6(e)?
options: The date and time of receipt of the instruction, the recipient's name and address, and the method of delivery
The currency, the amount, and the exchange rate applied
The originator's name, address and occupation
The name of the beneficiary institution, its address and its country
en.explain: ¶11.6(e) requires the MSO to record the date and time of receipt of the instruction, the recipient's name and address, and the method of delivery.

tc.q: 第11.6(e)款將哪三項詳情歸為一組？
options: 收到指示的日期及時間、收款人的姓名及地址，以及交付方式
貨幣、款額及所採用的匯率
匯款人的姓名、地址及職業
收款機構的名稱、地址及所屬國家
tc.explain: 第11.6(e)款規定該經營者須記錄收到指示的日期及時間、收款人的姓名及地址，以及交付方式。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.6段

en.q: What must an MSO be able to justify in relation to remittance records, and for what purpose?
options: That it has taken steps in accordance with Chapter 8 to keep the record of the originator and the related transaction, with a view to making the information available to the CCE should the need arise
That it has destroyed the records after five years, to comply with data privacy
That it has transmitted the records to the beneficiary institution
That it has reported the records to the JFIU
en.explain: ¶11.6 states that an MSO should be able to justify that they have taken steps in accordance with Chapter 8 to keep the record of the originator and the related transaction with a view to making this information available to the CCE should the need arise.

tc.q: 就匯款紀錄，金錢服務經營者須能為甚麼作出解釋？其目的為何？
options: 能解釋其已按第8章採取步驟保存匯款人及相關交易的紀錄，以便在有需要時可向海關關長提供該等資料
能解釋其已於五年後銷毀紀錄，以符合資料私隱要求
能解釋其已將紀錄傳送予收款機構
能解釋其已將紀錄向聯合財富情報組報告
tc.explain: 第11.6段訂明該經營者應能解釋其已按第8章採取步驟，保存匯款人及相關交易的紀錄，以便在有需要時可向海關關長提供該等資料。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶1
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第1段

en.q: By reference to what should the identity of a Hong Kong resident always be identified or verified?
options: Their Hong Kong identity card or document of identity
Their valid travel document
Their driving licence bearing a photograph
Their birth certificate
en.explain: Appendix A ¶1 states that the identity of an individual physically present in Hong Kong should be verified by reference to their Hong Kong identity card or travel document, and that MSOs should always identify and/or verify a Hong Kong resident's identity by reference to their Hong Kong identity card or document of identity. A non-resident's identity should be verified by reference to their valid travel document.

tc.q: 香港居民的身分應一律參照甚麼作識別或核實？
options: 其香港身分證或身分證明書
其有效旅行證件
其載有照片的駕駛執照
其出生證明書
tc.explain: 附錄A第1段訂明身處香港的個人的身分，應參照其香港身分證或旅行證件核實；金錢服務經營者應一律參照香港居民的香港身分證或身分證明書識別及／或核實其身分。非居民的身分則應參照其有效旅行證件核實。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶2
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第2段

en.q: Which documents may an MSO use to identify or verify a non-resident individual who is not physically present in Hong Kong?
options: A valid international passport or other travel document; a current national identity card bearing the individual's photograph; or a current valid national driving licence incorporating photographic evidence of identity issued by a competent national or state authority
A utility bill and a bank statement
An employer's reference letter and a payslip
A photocopy of any government-issued document, certified or not
en.explain: Appendix A ¶2 lists, for non-resident individuals not physically present in Hong Kong, a valid international passport or other travel document; a current national (Government or State-issued) identity card bearing the photograph of the individual; or a current valid national (Government or State-issued) driving licence incorporating photographic evidence of the identity of the applicant, issued by a competent national or state authority.

tc.q: 就並未身處香港的非居民個人，金錢服務經營者可參照哪些文件識別或核實其身分？
options: 有效的國際護照或其他旅行證件；載有該個人照片的現行國家（即政府或國家發出）身分證；或由主管的國家或州當局發出、載有申請人身分照片證據的現行有效國家駕駛執照
水電費單及銀行結單
僱主推薦信及糧單
任何政府發出文件的影印本，不論有否核證
tc.explain: 附錄A第2段就並未身處香港的非居民個人列出：有效的國際護照或其他旅行證件；載有該個人照片的現行國家（即政府或國家發出）身分證；或由主管的國家或州當局發出、載有申請人身分照片證據的現行有效國家（即政府或國家發出）駕駛執照。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A footnote 72
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A註腳72

en.q: Are international drivers permits and licences acceptable for identity verification?
options: No — for the avoidance of doubt, they are not acceptable for this purpose
Yes — they rank equally with national driving licences
Yes, but only for non-residents
Yes, but only when accompanied by a passport
en.explain: Footnote 72 to Appendix A ¶2(c) states, for the avoidance of doubt, that international drivers permits and licences are not acceptable for this purpose. Only a current valid national driving licence issued by a competent national or state authority qualifies.

tc.q: 國際駕駛許可證及執照可否用作核實身分？
options: 不可——為免生疑問，該等證件不可用於此用途
可以——與國家駕駛執照地位相同
可以，但只限非居民
可以，但須連同護照一併出示
tc.explain: 附錄A第2(c)款註腳72為免生疑問訂明，國際駕駛許可證及執照不可用於此用途。只有由主管的國家或州當局發出的現行有效國家駕駛執照方符合資格。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶3
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第3段

en.q: How is a travel document defined in Appendix A?
options: A passport or some other document furnished with a photograph of the holder establishing the identity and nationality, domicile or place of permanent residence of the holder
Any document issued by an immigration authority
Any document permitting the holder to cross an international border
Any government-issued document bearing a photograph
en.explain: Appendix A ¶3 defines a travel document as a passport or some other document furnished with a photograph of the holder establishing the identity and nationality, domicile or place of permanent residence of the holder, and then lists seven documents that constitute travel documents for the purpose of identity verification.

tc.q: 附錄A如何界定「旅行證件」？
options: 護照或其他附有持證人照片、可確立持證人身分及國籍、居籍或永久居住地的文件
入境事務當局發出的任何文件
任何准許持證人跨越國境的文件
任何載有照片的政府發出文件
tc.explain: 附錄A第3段界定旅行證件為護照或其他附有持證人照片、可確立持證人身分及國籍、居籍或永久居住地的文件；其後並列出就核實身分而言構成旅行證件的七類文件。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶3
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第3段

en.q: Which of the following is listed in Appendix A as constituting a travel document for identity verification?
options: Permanent Resident Identity Card of the Macau Special Administrative Region
A Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card
An international driving permit
A national health insurance card
en.explain: Appendix A ¶3 lists as travel documents: the Permanent Resident Identity Card of Macau SAR; the Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents; the Seaman's Identity Document; the Taiwan Travel Permit for Mainland Residents; the Permit for residents of Macau issued by the Director of Immigration; the Exit-entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau for Official Purposes; and the Exit-entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau.

tc.q: 下列何者在附錄A中列為就核實身分而言構成旅行證件的文件？
options: 澳門特別行政區永久性居民身分證
香港永久性居民身分證
國際駕駛許可證
國民健康保險卡
tc.explain: 附錄A第3段列出的旅行證件包括：澳門特別行政區永久性居民身分證；台灣居民來往大陸通行證；海員身分證明文件；大陸居民往來台灣通行證；由入境事務處處長發出予澳門居民的通行證；因公往來香港澳門特別行政區通行證；以及往來港澳通行證。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶3(c)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第3(c)段

en.q: Under which international instrument must a Seaman's Identity Document be issued to count as a travel document?
options: The International Labour Organisation Convention / Seafarers Identity Document Convention 1958
The International Maritime Organization Convention 1974
The Convention on Facilitation of International Maritime Traffic 1965
The United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea 1982
en.explain: Appendix A ¶3(c) lists the Seaman's Identity Document issued under and in accordance with the International Labour Organisation Convention / Seafarers Identity Document Convention 1958 as a travel document for the purpose of identity verification.

tc.q: 海員身分證明文件須根據哪份國際文書發出，方可視為旅行證件？
options: 《國際勞工組織公約／1958年海員身分證件公約》
《1974年國際海事組織公約》
《1965年便利國際海上運輸公約》
《1982年聯合國海洋法公約》
tc.explain: 附錄A第3(c)款列出根據《國際勞工組織公約／1958年海員身分證件公約》並按其規定發出的海員身分證明文件，為就核實身分而言的旅行證件。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶4
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第4段

en.q: How should the identity of a minor born in Hong Kong who holds neither a valid travel document nor a Hong Kong identity card be verified?
options: By reference to the minor's Hong Kong birth certificate, and the identity of the parent or guardian representing or accompanying the minor should also be recorded and verified
By reference to a school record bearing a photograph
By reference to the parent's identity card alone
No verification is possible, so the relationship must be declined
en.explain: Appendix A ¶4 states that for minors born in Hong Kong who are not in possession of a valid travel document or Hong Kong identity card, their identity should be verified by reference to the minor's Hong Kong birth certificate, and that whenever establishing relations with a minor the identity of the minor's parent or guardian representing or accompanying the minor should also be recorded and verified in accordance with the above requirements.

tc.q: 在香港出生、既無有效旅行證件亦無香港身分證的未成年人，其身分應如何核實？
options: 參照該未成年人的香港出生證明書核實；並須按上述規定一併記錄及核實代表或陪同該未成年人的父母或監護人的身分
參照載有照片的學校紀錄核實
僅參照其父母的身分證核實
無法核實，故須拒絕建立該業務關係
tc.explain: 附錄A第4段訂明就在香港出生而並無持有有效旅行證件或香港身分證的未成年人，其身分應參照該未成年人的香港出生證明書核實；而每當與未成年人建立關係時，亦應按上述規定記錄及核實代表或陪同該未成年人的父母或監護人的身分。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A footnote 73
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A註腳73

en.q: How can a Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card be distinguished on its face, and from what age must Hong Kong residents register for an identity card?
options: It bears a capital letter 'A' underneath the individual's date of birth; residents aged 11 and above are required to register
It bears a capital letter 'P' in the top right corner; residents aged 15 and above are required to register
It is printed on a different colour of card; residents aged 18 and above are required to register
It bears the word 'Permanent' in red; residents aged 7 and above are required to register
en.explain: Footnote 73 to Appendix A ¶4 states that all residents of Hong Kong aged 11 and above are required to register for an identity card; that Hong Kong permanent residents will have a Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card; and that the identity card of a permanent resident will have on the front of the card a capital letter 'A' underneath the individual's date of birth.

tc.q: 香港永久性居民身分證的表面有何特徵？香港居民須由何歲起登記領取身分證？
options: 在該個人的出生日期下方載有大階英文字母「A」；11歲或以上的居民須登記
在右上角載有大階英文字母「P」；15歲或以上的居民須登記
以不同顏色的卡片印製；18歲或以上的居民須登記
以紅色印有「永久」二字；7歲或以上的居民須登記
tc.explain: 附錄A第4段註腳73訂明所有11歲或以上的香港居民均須登記領取身分證；香港永久性居民會持有香港永久性居民身分證；而永久性居民的身分證正面，會在該個人的出生日期下方載有大階英文字母「A」。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶5
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第5段

en.q: How may an MSO identify or verify a corporate customer, according to Appendix A?
options: By performing a company registry search in the place of incorporation and obtaining a full company search report confirming the current full company particulars, or the overseas equivalent
By obtaining a copy of the company's latest audited accounts
By obtaining a letter of good standing from the company's bank
By obtaining the identity documents of all its shareholders
en.explain: Appendix A ¶5 states that an MSO may identify and/or verify a corporate customer by performing a company registry search in the place of incorporation and obtaining a full company search report, which confirms the current reference to a full company particulars search, or the overseas equivalent.

tc.q: 按附錄A所述，金錢服務經營者可如何識別或核實法團客戶？
options: 在該公司註冊成立地進行公司登記冊查冊，並取得確認現行公司全部詳情的完整查冊報告（或海外的相應文件）
取得該公司最近期經審計帳目的副本
取得該公司銀行發出的良好信譽證明書
取得其所有股東的身分證明文件
tc.explain: 附錄A第5段訂明該經營者可在該公司註冊成立地進行公司登記冊查冊，並取得確認現行公司全部詳情查冊結果的完整公司查冊報告（或海外的相應文件），藉以識別及／或核實法團客戶。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶6
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第6段

en.q: What may an MSO do where a customer is from a jurisdiction without national ID cards and holds no travel document or photographic driving licence?
options: Exceptionally, and applying a risk-based approach, accept other documents as evidence of identity — wherever possible bearing a photograph of the individual
Accept the customer's own written declaration of identity without further evidence
Decline the relationship in every case
Accept a certified copy of any document without regard to its nature
en.explain: Appendix A ¶6 states that for jurisdictions that do not have national ID cards and where customers do not have a travel document or driving licence with a photograph, MSOs may, exceptionally and applying a risk-based approach, accept other documents as evidence of identity, and that wherever possible such documents should have a photograph of the individual.

tc.q: 如客戶來自並無國家身分證的司法管轄區，且並無旅行證件或載有照片的駕駛執照，金錢服務經營者可怎樣做？
options: 可在例外情況下按風險為本方式接受其他文件作為身分證據——並應盡可能採用載有該個人照片的文件
接受該客戶本身的書面身分聲明而無須其他證據
在任何情況下均須拒絕建立該關係
接受任何文件的核證副本，不論其性質為何
tc.explain: 附錄A第6段訂明就並無國家身分證的司法管轄區，如客戶並無載有照片的旅行證件或駕駛執照，金錢服務經營者可在例外情況下按風險為本方式接受其他文件作為身分證據；並應盡可能採用載有該個人照片的文件。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶7
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第7段

en.q: Against what risk does the use of an independent and appropriate certifier guard, and what is essential for certification to be effective?
options: The risk that documentation provided does not correspond to the customer whose identity is being verified; the certifier will need to have seen the original documentation
The risk that the customer's documents have expired; the certifier will need to check the expiry date
The risk of forgery of the certifier's signature; the certification must be notarised
The risk of data loss; the certification must be stored electronically
en.explain: Appendix A ¶7 states that use of an independent and appropriate person to certify verification of identification documents guards against the risk that documentation provided does not correspond to the customer whose identity is being verified, but that for certification to be effective the certifier will need to have seen the original documentation.

tc.q: 由獨立而適當的核證人核證，可防範甚麼風險？核證要有效，關鍵條件為何？
options: 防範所提供文件與被核實身分的客戶並不相符的風險；核證人必須曾親自查看文件正本
防範客戶文件已過期的風險；核證人須查核屆滿日期
防範核證人簽署被偽造的風險；核證須經公證
防範資料遺失的風險；核證須以電子方式儲存
tc.explain: 附錄A第7段訂明由獨立而適當的人核證身分證明文件的核實，可防範所提供文件與被核實身分的客戶並不相符的風險；但核證要有效，該核證人必須曾親自查看文件正本。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶8
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第8段

en.q: Which of the following is listed as an example of an appropriate person to certify verification of identification documents?
options: A Justice of the Peace
Any employee of the MSO who has met the customer
The customer's spouse
Any holder of a Hong Kong identity card
en.explain: Appendix A ¶8 gives a non-exhaustive list of appropriate certifiers: an intermediary specified in section 18(3) of Schedule 2; a member of the judiciary in an equivalent jurisdiction; an officer of an embassy, consulate or high commission of the country of issue of documentary verification of identity; a Justice of the Peace; and other professional persons such as a certified public accountant, lawyer, notary public and chartered secretary.

tc.q: 下列何者列為適合核證身分證明文件的人的例子？
options: 太平紳士
曾與該客戶會面的該經營者的任何僱員
該客戶的配偶
任何持有香港身分證的人
tc.explain: 附錄A第8段列出適當核證人的非詳盡例子：附表2第18(3)條指明的中介人；同等司法管轄區的司法人員；簽發身分核實文件的國家的大使館、領事館或高級專員公署的人員；太平紳士；以及其他專業人士，例如執業會計師、律師、公證人及特許秘書。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶8(c)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第8(c)段

en.q: Which embassy, consulate or high commission officer may act as certifier?
options: An officer of the mission of the country of issue of the documentary verification of identity
An officer of the mission of the country in which the customer is resident
An officer of the Hong Kong mission in the customer's country
An officer of any mission accredited to Hong Kong
en.explain: Appendix A ¶8(c) lists an officer of an embassy, consulate or high commission of the country of issue of documentary verification of identity — that is, the country that issued the identity document being certified.

tc.q: 哪一個大使館、領事館或高級專員公署的人員可擔任核證人？
options: 簽發該身分核實文件的國家的使領館人員
該客戶居住國家的使領館人員
香港駐該客戶所在國家的機構人員
任何獲香港接受的使領館人員
tc.explain: 附錄A第8(c)款列出簽發身分核實文件的國家（即簽發被核證身分證明文件的國家）的大使館、領事館或高級專員公署的人員。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶9
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第9段

en.q: What should a certifier do on the copy document?
options: Sign and date it, print their name clearly in capitals underneath, clearly indicate their position or capacity, and state that it is a true copy of the original or words to similar effect
Sign it only, since the date can be inferred from the file record
Affix a company chop without a signature
Attach a separate letter of certification, leaving the copy unmarked
en.explain: Appendix A ¶9 states that the certifier should sign and date the copy document, printing their name clearly in capitals underneath, and clearly indicate their position or capacity on it, and should state that it is a true copy of the original or words to similar effect.

tc.q: 核證人應在文件副本上作甚麼？
options: 簽署及註明日期，在下方以大階清楚正楷書寫姓名，清楚註明其職位或身分，並註明該副本是正本的真實副本（或具相若意思的字句）
只須簽署，因日期可從檔案紀錄推斷
只加蓋公司印章而無須簽署
另附核證函件，副本上不作任何標註
tc.explain: 附錄A第9段訂明核證人應在該文件副本上簽署及註明日期（並在下方以大階清楚正楷書寫其姓名），並在該副本上清楚註明其職位或身分；核證人並應註明該副本是正本的真實副本（或具相若意思的字句）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶10
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第10段

en.q: Why must an MSO exercise caution when accepting certified copy documents?
options: Because MSOs remain liable for failure to carry out prescribed CDD — especially where such documents originate from a country perceived to represent a high risk, or from unregulated entities in any jurisdiction
Because certified copies are never acceptable under the AMLO
Because certification transfers liability to the certifier
Because certified copies must be verified by the CCE
en.explain: Appendix A ¶10 states that MSOs remain liable for failure to carry out prescribed CDD and therefore must exercise caution when considering accepting certified copy documents, especially where such documents originate from a country perceived to represent a high risk, or from unregulated entities in any jurisdiction.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者接受核證副本文件時，為何須審慎行事？
options: 因該經營者仍須就未有進行訂明的客戶盡職審查承擔法律責任——尤其當該等文件來自被視為高風險的國家，或來自任何司法管轄區的不受監管實體
因《打擊洗錢條例》從不接受核證副本
因核證會將法律責任轉移予核證人
因核證副本須經海關關長核實
tc.explain: 附錄A第10段訂明金錢服務經營者仍須就未有進行訂明的客戶盡職審查承擔法律責任，故在考慮接受核證副本文件時必須審慎行事，尤其當該等文件來自被視為高風險的國家，或來自任何司法管轄區的不受監管實體。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶10
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第10段

en.q: What should an MSO do where it is unsure of the authenticity of certified documents, or that they relate to the customer?
options: Take additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk
Accept the documents but record the doubt on file
Report the certifier to the relevant professional body
Proceed on the basis that certification has been provided
en.explain: Appendix A ¶10 states that in any circumstances where an MSO is unsure of the authenticity of certified documents, or that the documents relate to the customer, MSOs should take additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者對核證文件的真確性，或對該等文件是否與該客戶有關存疑，應怎樣做？
options: 採取額外措施以減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
接受該等文件，但在檔案中記錄該疑問
向有關專業團體舉報該核證人
以已取得核證為依據繼續辦理
tc.explain: 附錄A第10段訂明，在任何情況下，如金錢服務經營者對核證文件的真確性，或對該等文件是否與該客戶有關存疑，均應採取額外措施以減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A footnote 74
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A註腳74

en.q: May copy documents be self-certified by the customer?
options: In general it is not sufficient; but an MSO may accept copies certified by a professional person within a legal person customer if that person is subject to the professional conduct requirements of a relevant professional body and has certified in their professional capacity
Yes — self-certification is always acceptable
No — self-certification is prohibited in all circumstances
Yes, provided the customer signs in the presence of MSO staff
en.explain: Footnote 74 to Appendix A ¶7 states that in general it is not sufficient for the copy documents to be self-certified by the customer, but that an MSO may accept copy documents certified by a professional person within a legal person customer if that professional person is subject to the professional conduct requirements of a relevant professional body and has certified the copy documents in his or her professional capacity.

tc.q: 文件副本可否由客戶自行核證？
options: 一般而言並不足夠；但如法人客戶內的專業人士受有關專業團體的專業操守規定所規限，並以其專業身分核證，該經營者可接受其核證的副本
可以——自行核證一律可接受
不可以——在任何情況下均禁止自行核證
可以，只要該客戶在該經營者員工面前簽署
tc.explain: 附錄A第7段註腳74訂明，一般而言由客戶自行核證文件副本並不足夠；但如法人客戶內的專業人士受有關專業團體的專業操守規定所規限，並以其專業身分核證該等文件副本，則該經營者可接受該等副本。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A footnote 75
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A註腳75

en.q: May an MSO accept a professional person not named in the Appendix A list as a certifier?
options: Yes — an MSO may accept another appropriate professional person, having due consideration to Appendix A ¶10 in the same manner as for other types of appropriate certifiers
No — the list in Appendix A ¶8 is exhaustive
Yes, but only with the prior approval of the CCE
Yes, but only where the customer is a legal person
en.explain: Footnote 75 to Appendix A ¶8(e) states that an MSO may accept another appropriate professional person as certifier, and that the MSO should have due consideration to paragraph 10 of Appendix A in a similar manner to other types of appropriate certifiers being used. Appendix A ¶8 itself describes the list as non-exhaustive.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者可否接受並非附錄A清單所列的專業人士擔任核證人？
options: 可以——該經營者可接受其他適當的專業人士，並須一如採用其他類別的適當核證人般，適當考慮附錄A第10段
不可以——附錄A第8段的清單屬詳盡清單
可以，但須事先取得海關關長批准
可以，但只限客戶屬法人的情況
tc.explain: 附錄A第8(e)款註腳75訂明該經營者可接受其他適當的專業人士擔任核證人；該經營者應一如採用其他類別的適當核證人般，適當考慮附錄A第10段。附錄A第8段本身亦述明該清單屬非詳盡清單。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A footnote 76
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A註腳76

en.q: What does chartered secretary mean for the purposes of the list of appropriate certifiers?
options: A person who is a current full member of the Institute of Chartered Secretaries and Administrators or its designated divisions
Any person employed as a company secretary
Any person registered as a company secretary with the Companies Registry
Any person holding a diploma in corporate governance
en.explain: Footnote 76 to Appendix A ¶8(e) states that a chartered secretary refers to a person who is a current full member of the Institute of Chartered Secretaries and Administrators or its designated divisions.

tc.q: 就適當核證人清單而言，「特許秘書」指甚麼？
options: 現為特許秘書及行政人員公會或其指定分部正式會員的人
任何受僱為公司秘書的人
任何在公司註冊處登記為公司秘書的人
任何持有企業管治文憑的人
tc.explain: 附錄A第8(e)款註腳76訂明，特許秘書指現為特許秘書及行政人員公會或其指定分部正式會員的人。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶8(a)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第8(a)段

en.q: Which statutory category of person is listed first among appropriate certifiers?
options: An intermediary specified in section 18(3) of Schedule 2
A member of the judiciary in an equivalent jurisdiction
A Justice of the Peace
A certified public accountant
en.explain: Appendix A ¶8 lists appropriate certifiers beginning with (a) an intermediary specified in section 18(3) of Schedule 2 — the same category of person on whom an MSO may rely to carry out CDD measures under ¶4.11.

tc.q: 適當核證人的清單中，首先列出哪一類法定人士？
options: 附表2第18(3)條指明的中介人
同等司法管轄區的司法人員
太平紳士
執業會計師
tc.explain: 附錄A第8段所列的適當核證人以(a)附表2第18(3)條指明的中介人為首——即第4.11段所指該經營者可倚賴其進行客戶盡職審查措施的同一類人士。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）詞彙表

en.q: What does the abbreviation PF stand for in the Guideline?
options: Financing of proliferation of weapons of mass destruction
Proliferation financing of firearms
Politically exposed financing
Payment facilitation
en.explain: The Glossary of key terms and abbreviations defines PF as the financing of proliferation of weapons of mass destruction. It is dealt with substantively in Chapter 6 alongside terrorist financing and financial sanctions.

tc.q: 在本指引中，縮寫「PF」指甚麼？
options: 大規模毀滅武器擴散的資金籌集
槍械擴散的資金籌集
政治人物的資金籌集
付款便利安排
tc.explain: 主要用語及縮寫詞彙表將PF界定為大規模毀滅武器擴散的資金籌集。第6章連同恐怖分子資金籌集及金融制裁一併作實質論述。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）詞彙表

en.q: Which definition of financial institution applies in the Guideline unless otherwise specified?
options: The definition set out in the FATF Recommendations, unless specified otherwise such as an FI as defined in the AMLO
The definition in the AMLO in every case
The definition in the Banking Ordinance
The definition used by the HKMA
en.explain: The Glossary note to FI(s) states that unless specified otherwise — for example an FI as defined in the AMLO — the term financial institutions has the same definition as set out in the FATF Recommendations. The distinction matters in provisions such as ¶10.4, which refers expressly to an FI as defined in the AMLO.

tc.q: 除另有指明外，本指引採用哪一個「金融機構」的定義？
options: 財務行動特別組織建議所載的定義；除另有指明者（例如《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構）外
一律採用《打擊洗錢條例》的定義
《銀行業條例》的定義
金融管理局所採用的定義
tc.explain: 詞彙表就「FI(s)」的註釋訂明，除另有指明外（例如《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構），「金融機構」一詞與財務行動特別組織建議所載的定義相同。此項區別在第10.4段等條文中尤為重要，該段明文提述《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）詞彙表

en.q: Which ordinance is cited in the Glossary as Cap. 526?
options: The Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance
The United Nations Sanctions Ordinance
The United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance
The Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance
en.explain: The Glossary lists WMD(CPS)O as the Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance (Cap. 526); UNSO as the United Nations Sanctions Ordinance (Cap. 537); UNATMO as the United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (Cap. 575); and OSCO as the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 455).

tc.q: 詞彙表中列為第526章的是哪一條條例？
options: 《武器擴散（提供服務的管制）條例》
《聯合國制裁條例》
《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》
《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》
tc.explain: 詞彙表載明WMD(CPS)O為《武器擴散（提供服務的管制）條例》（第526章）；UNSO為《聯合國制裁條例》（第537章）；UNATMO為《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》（第575章）；OSCO為《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》（第455章）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.3段與第10.9段的比較

en.q: An MSO sends $10,000 abroad for a walk-in customer by a non-electronic remittance arrangement. Which provision governs the identification requirement?
options: Section 13 of Schedule 2, as explained in Chapter 11, because the transaction is a remittance transaction other than a wire transfer
Section 12 of Schedule 2, as explained in Chapter 10, because the amount exceeds $8,000
Section 5 of Schedule 2, because ongoing monitoring applies
Neither, because the customer has no business relationship with the MSO
en.explain: ¶11.3 applies section 13 of Schedule 2 to a remittance transaction other than a wire transfer of $8,000 or above. A wire transfer is defined in ¶10.1 and ¶11.2 as being carried out by electronic means; a remittance sent otherwise falls to be dealt with under Chapter 11 instead of Chapter 10.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者以非電子方式的匯款安排，為一名即場客戶匯出10,000元至海外。哪一項條文規管其身分識別規定？
options: 附表2第13條（見第11章的說明），因該交易屬電匯以外的匯款交易
附表2第12條（見第10章的說明），因款額超過8,000元
附表2第5條，因持續監察適用
兩者均不適用，因該客戶與該經營者並無業務關係
tc.explain: 第11.3段就8,000元或以上而並非電匯的匯款交易適用附表2第13條。第10.1及11.2段界定電匯為以電子方式進行；以其他方式送出的匯款則由第11章而非第10章處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.1段

en.q: Under which provision of the AMLO are the special requirements for carrying out remittance transactions found?
options: Section 13 of Schedule 2
Section 12 of Schedule 2
Section 11 of Schedule 2
Section 14 of Schedule 2
