en.explain: ¶11.1 states that under section 13 in Schedule 2 of the AMLO there are special requirements for carrying out remittance transactions, and that it is important that MSOs should fully understand their obligations under those requirements.

tc.q: 進行匯款交易的特別規定載於《打擊洗錢條例》的哪一條文？
options: 附表2第13條
附表2第12條
附表2第11條
附表2第14條
tc.explain: 第11.1段訂明《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13條就進行匯款交易訂有特別規定；金錢服務經營者必須充分理解該等規定下的責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.4段

en.q: A customer holds an account with an MSO but asks an employee of their company to attend the counter and instruct a remittance from that account. Who is the originator?
options: The account holder, because the money for the remittance is paid from that person's account with the MSO
The employee, because that person gave the instruction
Both, jointly
Neither, until the transaction is completed
en.explain: ¶11.4 defines the originator as the person from whose account with the MSO the money for the remittance is paid; only in the absence of such an account is the originator the person who instructs the MSO to carry out the transaction. The account limb takes priority where an account exists.

tc.q: 某客戶在金錢服務經營者處持有帳戶，但著其公司僱員到櫃檯指示從該帳戶匯款。何人是匯款人？
options: 該帳戶持有人，因該筆匯款款項是從該人在該經營者開立的帳戶支付
該僱員，因該人作出指示
兩者共同
在交易完成前，兩者均不是
tc.explain: 第11.4段界定匯款人為該筆匯款款項從其在該經營者開立的帳戶支付的人；只有在並無該等帳戶的情況下，匯款人方為指示該經營者進行該交易的人。如有帳戶存在，則以帳戶一項為準。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶1
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第1段

en.q: A non-resident individual attends an MSO's premises in Hong Kong in person. By reference to what should their identity be verified?
options: Their valid travel document
A Hong Kong identity card, which every person in Hong Kong must hold
A national identity card of their home country
A driving licence bearing a photograph
en.explain: Appendix A ¶1 states that the identity of an individual physically present in Hong Kong should be verified by reference to their Hong Kong identity card or travel document, and specifically that the identity of a non-resident should be verified by reference to their valid travel document.

tc.q: 某非居民個人親身前往金錢服務經營者在香港的處所。其身分應參照甚麼核實？
options: 其有效旅行證件
香港身分證，因身處香港的每個人均須持有
其原居國家的國家身分證
載有照片的駕駛執照
tc.explain: 附錄A第1段訂明身處香港的個人的身分，應參照其香港身分證或旅行證件核實；並特別訂明非居民的身分應參照其有效旅行證件核實。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.6段

en.q: At what point must the ¶11.6 records be made?
options: Before carrying out the remittance transaction
Immediately after the funds have been despatched
Within three business days of the transaction
At the end of the month in which the transaction occurred
en.explain: ¶11.6 states that before carrying out a remittance transaction, other than a wire transfer, of $8,000 or above or of an equivalent amount in any other currency, an MSO is required to record the five specified particulars — the same timing as the identification and verification duty in ¶11.3.

tc.q: 第11.6段所指的紀錄須在何時作出？
options: 在進行該匯款交易前
在款項送出後隨即作出
在該交易後三個營業日內
在該交易發生當月月底
tc.explain: 第11.6段訂明，在進行款額為8,000元或以上（或任何其他貨幣的等值款額）而並非電匯的匯款交易前，該經營者須記錄五項指明詳情——與第11.3段的識別及核實責任時點相同。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) Appendix A ¶2(b)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）附錄A第2(b)段

en.q: What must a national identity card relied on for a non-resident not physically present in Hong Kong contain, and by whom must it be issued?
options: It must be current, bear the photograph of the individual, and be Government or State-issued
It must be current and bear the individual's signature, and may be issued by any public body
It must bear a photograph and be certified by a notary public
It must be current and issued by a member of the FATF
en.explain: Appendix A ¶2(b) refers to a current national — that is, Government or State-issued — identity card bearing the photograph of the individual, as one of the three documents by which a non-resident not physically present in Hong Kong may be identified or verified.

tc.q: 就並未身處香港的非居民而倚賴的國家身分證，須載有甚麼？須由何人發出？
options: 須為現行有效、載有該個人的照片，並由政府或國家發出
須為現行有效並載有該個人簽署，可由任何公營機構發出
須載有照片並經公證人核證
須為現行有效並由財務行動特別組織成員發出
tc.explain: 附錄A第2(b)款所指的是載有該個人照片的現行國家（即政府或國家發出）身分證，屬可用以識別或核實並未身處香港的非居民身分的三類文件之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.2段與第10.1段的比較

en.q: Which feature distinguishes a wire transfer from a remittance transaction as those terms are used in the Guideline?
options: A wire transfer is carried out by electronic means by an ordering institution on behalf of an originator, whereas a remittance transaction is any transaction for sending, or arranging the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong
A wire transfer is cross-border whereas a remittance transaction is domestic
A wire transfer is above $8,000 whereas a remittance transaction is below that amount
A wire transfer involves an intermediary institution whereas a remittance transaction does not
en.explain: ¶11.2 sets the two definitions side by side: a remittance transaction is a transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong, while a wire transfer, as defined in ¶10.1, is carried out by an ordering institution on behalf of an originator by electronic means to make money available to a recipient at a beneficiary institution. Where a transaction is a wire transfer, section 12 and Chapter 10 apply instead of section 13.

tc.q: 按本指引的用語，電匯與匯款交易的區別特徵為何？
options: 電匯是由匯款機構代匯款人以電子方式進行；匯款交易則指任何將款項送往香港以外地方，或安排將款項送往香港以外地方的交易
電匯屬跨境，匯款交易屬本地
電匯高於8,000元，匯款交易則低於該款額
電匯涉及中介機構，匯款交易則不涉及
tc.explain: 第11.2段將兩個定義並列：匯款交易指將款項送往香港以外地方或安排將款項送往香港以外地方的交易；電匯（見第10.1段）則指由匯款機構代匯款人以電子方式進行，使款項可由收款人在收款機構取得的交易。如某交易屬電匯，則適用第12條及第10章，而非第13條。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶7.1; s.25A(1) DTROP & OSCO, s.12(1) UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.1段；《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(1)條、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(1)條

en.q: A person who knows or suspects that property represents proceeds of drug trafficking or an indictable offence, or is terrorist property, must do what?
options: File a suspicious transaction report with the JFIU as soon as it is reasonable to do so, together with the matters on which the knowledge or suspicion is based
Notify the customer that their transaction looks suspicious
Wait until the transaction is completed, then inform the CCE
Freeze the customer's funds immediately without any report
en.explain: Under s.25A(1) DTROP/OSCO and s.12(1) UNATMO, the person must file an STR with the JFIU as soon as it is reasonable to do so, together with any matter on which the knowledge or suspicion is based (¶7.1). Failure to report carries up to 3 months' imprisonment and a $50,000 fine; telling the customer would be tipping off.

tc.q: 任何人知悉或懷疑某財產代表販毒或可公訴罪行的得益，或屬恐怖分子財產，必須怎樣做？
options: 在合理範圍內盡快向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，連同構成該知悉或懷疑的事宜
通知客戶其交易看來可疑
待交易完成後知會關長
毋須任何報告，立即凍結客戶資金
tc.explain: 根據《販毒條例》／《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(1)條及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(1)條，該人須在合理範圍內盡快向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，連同構成知悉或懷疑的事宜（第7.1段）。未有報告最高可判監禁3個月及罰款50,000元；告知客戶則屬「通風報訊」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.3至7.4段

en.q: Which statement about “suspicion” for the purposes of suspicious transaction reporting is CORRECT?
options: Suspicion is personal and subjective, and falls short of proof based on firm evidence — the person need not know the nature of the underlying criminal activity
Suspicion requires proof beyond reasonable doubt
Suspicion can only arise after a court has convicted the customer
Suspicion requires the MSO to first identify exactly which crime generated the funds
en.explain: ¶7.3: suspicion is personal, subjective and falls short of proof based on firm evidence. ¶7.4: the person does not need to know the nature of the underlying criminal activity or that the funds definitely arose from an offence — the same applies to TF.

tc.q: 就可疑交易報告而言，關於「懷疑」的說法哪項正確？
options: 懷疑屬個人及主觀判斷，毋須達到有確實證據支持的證明程度——該人亦無須知道背後犯罪活動的性質
懷疑須達到毫無合理疑點的證明標準
只有在法院裁定客戶罪成後才可產生懷疑
金錢服務經營者須先確定資金來自哪項罪行
tc.explain: 第7.3段：懷疑屬個人和主觀的判斷，毋須達到有確實證據支持的證明程度。第7.4段：該人無須知道洗錢背後犯罪活動的性質，亦無須肯定資金確實來自犯罪；恐怖分子資金籌集亦然。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5段及註60

en.q: Which statement about the obligation to file an STR is CORRECT?
options: An STR must be filed once suspicion is formed, irrespective of the amount involved and even where no transaction has been conducted — attempted transactions are also covered
STRs are only required for transactions of $120,000 or above
STRs are only required for completed transactions
An STR may be filed at the end of each month in a batch
en.explain: ¶7.5 and footnote 60: once knowledge or suspicion is formed, an STR should be filed even where no transaction has been conducted, and reporting obligations apply irrespective of the amount involved (they apply to “any property”), covering attempted transactions. The STR must be made as soon as reasonably practicable after the suspicion is first identified.

tc.q: 關於提交可疑交易報告的責任，下列哪項正確？
options: 一旦形成懷疑便須提交報告，不論涉及金額多少，即使未曾進行任何交易亦然——未遂交易同樣涵蓋在內
只有120,000元或以上的交易才須提交報告
只有已完成的交易才須提交報告
可每月月底一併分批提交報告
tc.explain: 第7.5段及註60：一旦形成知悉或懷疑，即使沒有透過金錢服務經營者進行任何交易，亦應提交可疑交易報告；報告責任適用於「任何財產」，不論金額多少，並涵蓋未遂交易。報告須在首次發現懷疑後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快作出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.6段

en.q: A teller tells a customer: “We have reported your transactions internally as suspicious — you should be careful.” No STR has yet been filed with the JFIU. Has an offence been committed?
options: Yes — tipping off covers circumstances where a suspicion has been raised internally within the MSO but not yet reported to the JFIU
No — tipping off only applies after an STR has been filed with the JFIU
No — telling the customer is part of good customer service
Only if the customer subsequently absconds
en.explain: ¶7.6: it is an offence to reveal information which might prejudice an investigation. The tipping-off provision expressly includes circumstances where a suspicion has been raised internally within the MSO but has not yet been reported to the JFIU.

tc.q: 櫃位職員向客戶說：「我們已在內部把你的交易列為可疑——你要小心。」此時尚未向聯合財富情報組提交報告。是否已干犯罪行？
options: 是——「通風報訊」涵蓋懷疑已在金錢服務經營者內部提出但尚未向財富情報組報告的情況
否——「通風報訊」只在已向財富情報組提交報告後才適用
否——告知客戶屬良好客戶服務
只有在客戶其後潛逃時才算犯罪
tc.explain: 第7.6段：向任何人披露可能損害調查的資料即屬犯罪。「通風報訊」條文明確包括懷疑已在金錢服務經營者內部提出、但尚未向財富情報組報告的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)段

en.q: A customer conducts many small remittances just below $8,000 each over a few days, where one large transaction would have served. Which red flag does this illustrate?
options: “Structuring” or “smurfing” — breaking amounts into many lower-value transactions to stay below CDD thresholds
A “U-turn” transaction
A trade-based money laundering indicator
Normal behaviour that raises no concern
en.explain: Structuring/smurfing means many lower-value transactions are conducted when one or a few large transactions could be used, typically to stay below CDD or record thresholds (¶7.10(a)(iii)-(iv)). It is a classic red flag that should prompt further enquiry and possibly an STR.

tc.q: 某客戶數天內多次進行每筆略低於8,000元的小額匯款，而其實一筆大額交易已可完成。這屬於哪種可疑交易警示？
options: 「分拆整合」或「化整為零」——將款項拆成多筆小額交易，使每筆低於盡職審查門檻
「掉頭式」交易
與貿易相關的洗錢警示
正常行為，無須關注
tc.explain: 「分拆整合」／「化整為零」指當大額款項可一次過或數次完成時，卻分成多項小額交易進行，通常為使每筆低於盡職審查或紀錄門檻（第7.10(a)(iii)至(iv)段）。這是典型警示，應進一步查究並考慮提交可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(v)段

en.q: Funds received from a company in a foreign jurisdiction are promptly remitted back to another person in the same foreign jurisdiction, with no apparent business reason. This is known as what?
options: A “U-turn” transaction — a recognised red flag indicator
An equivalent jurisdiction arrangement
A cover payment
Simplified due diligence
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(v): “U-turn” transactions — funds received from a person or company in a foreign jurisdiction are remitted to another person or company in the same foreign jurisdiction (or back to the sender's account in another jurisdiction) — are a red flag indicator of transactions that do not make economic sense.

tc.q: 從外地司法管轄區某公司匯入的款項，隨即匯往同一外地司法管轄區的另一人，且無明顯商業理由。這稱為甚麼？
options: 「掉頭式」交易——屬公認的可疑交易警示
對等司法管轄區安排
直接撥付
簡化盡職審查
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(v)段：「掉頭式」交易指從外地司法管轄區的某人或公司收取款項後，匯往同一外地司法管轄區的另一人或公司（或匯回匯款人在另一司法管轄區的帳戶），屬不合經濟原則交易的警示之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.11段

en.q: The JFIU promotes the “SAFE” approach for handling possible suspicious transactions. What do the four steps stand for?
options: Screen the account for suspicious indicators; Ask the customer appropriate questions; Find out the customer's records; Evaluate all the above information
Stop the transaction; Arrest the customer; File a report; Escalate to management
Save the evidence; Alert the police; Freeze the account; Exit the relationship
Screen the staff; Audit the accounts; File the records; Examine the systems
en.explain: ¶7.11: the SAFE approach comprises (a) Screening the account for suspicious indicators, (b) Asking the customer appropriate questions, (c) Finding out the customer's records, and (d) Evaluating all the above information. Details are on the JFIU website.

tc.q: 聯合財富情報組推廣以「SAFE」方法處理可能的可疑交易。四個步驟指甚麼？
options: 篩查戶口識別可疑交易指標；向客戶作出恰當提問；翻查客戶的已知紀錄；根據以上資料作出評估
停止交易；拘捕客戶；提交報告；上報管理層
保存證據；通知警方；凍結戶口；終止關係
甄選職員；審計帳目；歸檔紀錄；檢查系統
tc.explain: 第7.11段：「SAFE」方法包括(a)篩查戶口識別可疑交易指標；(b)向客戶作出恰當提問；(c)翻查客戶的已知紀錄；及(d)根據以上資料作出評估。詳情載於財富情報組網站。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.13段

en.q: Which statement about internal suspicious transaction reporting lines is CORRECT?
options: Reports raised by staff must never be filtered out by supervisors who have no responsibility for the ML reporting/compliance function; reporting lines should be as short as possible
A branch manager may screen out reports they consider unfounded before they reach the MLRO
Internal reports should pass through at least three levels of management for quality control
Staff should report directly to the JFIU, bypassing the MLRO
en.explain: ¶7.13: under no circumstances should staff reports be filtered out by supervisors or managers with no responsibility for the ML reporting/compliance function. Reporting lines should be as short as possible, with the minimum number of people between the staff member and the MLRO — ensuring speed, confidentiality and accessibility.

tc.q: 關於可疑交易的內部報告途徑，下列哪項正確？
options: 職員提出的報告絕不可被無洗錢報告／合規職責的主管過濾篩走；報告途徑應盡量簡短
分行經理可先篩走其認為無根據的報告，才轉交洗錢報告主任
內部報告應經過至少三層管理層審核以保證質素
職員應繞過洗錢報告主任，直接向財富情報組報告
tc.explain: 第7.13段：在任何情況下，職員提出的報告均不得被並無洗錢報告／合規職責的主管或經理過濾篩走。報告途徑應盡量簡短，職員與洗錢報告主任之間的中間人越少越好，以確保迅速、保密及易於聯繫。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶7.14; s.25A(4) DTROP & OSCO, s.12(4) UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.14段；《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(4)條、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(4)條

en.q: A front-line staff member reports a suspicion to the MLRO in accordance with the MSO's internal procedures. What is the staff member's remaining statutory reporting obligation?
options: None — once the suspicion is reported to the MLRO under the established procedures, the staff member's statutory obligation is fully satisfied
They must also personally file an STR with the JFIU
They must also notify the CCE within 7 days
They must obtain the customer's consent to the report
en.explain: ¶7.14: once a staff member has reported the suspicion to the MLRO in accordance with the MSO's established policies and procedures, the staff member's statutory obligation has been fully satisfied. It is then for the MLRO to evaluate and decide whether to file an STR with the JFIU.

tc.q: 一名前線職員已按金錢服務經營者的內部程序向洗錢報告主任報告懷疑。該職員還有甚麼法定報告責任？
options: 沒有——職員按既定程序向洗錢報告主任報告懷疑後，其法定責任已完全履行
仍須親自向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告
仍須於7日內通知關長
須取得客戶對報告的同意
tc.explain: 第7.14段：職員按金錢服務經營者就作出報告而設的政策及程序，向洗錢報告主任報告懷疑後，其法定責任已獲完全履行。其後由洗錢報告主任評估並決定是否向財富情報組提交報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.20段

en.q: After reviewing an internal report and all available information, the MLRO concludes in good faith that there is no suspicion and decides not to file an STR. Which statement is CORRECT?
options: Criminal liability for failing to report is unlikely, but the MLRO must keep proper records of the deliberations and actions taken to demonstrate reasonable conduct
The MLRO is automatically criminally liable if the funds later prove to be criminal proceeds
The MLRO must always file an STR for every internal report received
The internal report should be destroyed to protect the customer's privacy
en.explain: ¶7.20: provided the MLRO acts in good faith in deciding not to file an STR after considering all available information, criminal liability for failing to report is unlikely. It is vital to keep proper records of the deliberations and actions to demonstrate the MLRO acted reasonably.

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任覆核內部報告及一切可得資料後，真誠地認為並無懷疑，決定不向財富情報組提交報告。下列哪項正確？
options: 未有報告不大可能構成刑事責任，但洗錢報告主任必須妥善備存其考量及所採取行動的紀錄，以證明其行事合理
若資金其後證實屬犯罪得益，洗錢報告主任即自動負上刑責
洗錢報告主任必須就每份內部報告向財富情報組提交報告
應銷毀內部報告以保障客戶私隱
tc.explain: 第7.20段：只要洗錢報告主任在考慮一切可得資料後真誠地決定不提交報告，未有報告不大可能引致刑事責任。惟必須妥善備存其考量及行動紀錄，以證明行事合理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.21段

en.q: A customer under apparent law-enforcement investigation suddenly instructs the MSO to move all funds and close the account. How should urgent reporting be handled?
options: Indicate the urgency in the STR, and in exceptional circumstances consider an initial notification to the JFIU by telephone
Wait for the next routine quarterly report to the CCE
Complete the customer's instruction first, then report within 30 days
Only report if the amount exceeds $120,000
en.explain: ¶7.21: where urgent reporting is required (e.g. instructions to move funds, close the account, or make cash available, particularly where the account is part of an ongoing law-enforcement investigation), the MSO should indicate this in the STR and, in exceptional circumstances, consider an initial notification to the JFIU by telephone.

tc.q: 一名顯然正受執法機構調查的客戶突然指示金錢服務經營者調走全部資金並結束帳戶。應如何處理緊急報告？
options: 在可疑交易報告中表明情況緊急；如情況特殊，考慮先以電話通知聯合財富情報組
待下次向關長提交例行季度報告時一併處理
先完成客戶指示，再於30日內報告
只有金額超過120,000元才須報告
tc.explain: 第7.21段：如須緊急報告（例如客戶指示調動資金、結束帳戶或提取現金，尤其帳戶涉及執法機構的調查），金錢服務經營者應在報告中表明；如情況特殊，應考慮先以電話向財富情報組作初步通知。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶7.25; s.25A(2) DTROP & OSCO, s.12(2) UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.25段；《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(2)條、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(2)條

en.q: Filing an STR provides an MSO with a statutory defence to ML/TF offences in respect of the disclosed acts, provided that:
options: The report is made before the acts and the acts are done with the JFIU's consent, or the report is made after the acts on the MSO's own initiative and as soon as reasonable
The report is filed within one year of the transaction
The customer consents to the report
The transaction is below the CDD threshold
en.explain: ¶7.25: the statutory defence applies where (a) the report is made before the disclosed acts and the acts are undertaken with the JFIU's consent; or (b) the report is made after the acts, on the MSO's own initiative and as soon as it is reasonable. Note the defence does not remove the legal, reputational or regulatory risks of continuing the account (¶7.26).

tc.q: 提交可疑交易報告可為金錢服務經營者就報告所披露的作為提供洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集罪行的法定免責辯護，條件是：
options: 報告在作出披露作為之前作出，而該作為獲財富情報組同意；或報告在作為之後由經營者主動並在合理範圍內盡快作出
報告在交易後一年內提交
客戶同意提交報告
交易低於盡職審查門檻
tc.explain: 第7.25段：法定免責辯護的條件為：(a)報告在作出所披露作為之前作出，且該作為（交易）獲財富情報組同意；或(b)報告在作為之後作出，由金錢服務經營者主動並在合理範圍內盡快作出。留意免責辯護不能消除繼續運作帳戶的法律、聲譽或監管風險（第7.26段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.26至7.27段

en.q: The JFIU gives “consent” in response to an MSO's pre-transaction STR. How should the MSO treat this consent?
options: Not as a “clean bill of health” — the MSO should still review the business relationship, apply risk-mitigating measures, and escalate to senior management if necessary
As confirmation that the account poses no risk and can be operated without further consideration
As permission to stop all monitoring of the customer
As a guarantee against any future regulatory action
en.explain: ¶7.26: a consent response should not be construed as a clean bill of health for the continued operation of the account. ¶7.27: the MSO should conduct an appropriate review of the relationship upon filing an STR, irrespective of JFIU feedback, and apply appropriate risk-mitigating measures — continuing the relationship without further consideration is not acceptable.

tc.q: 聯合財富情報組就金錢服務經營者交易前提交的報告給予「同意」。經營者應如何看待這項同意？
options: 不應視為「安全證明」——仍應檢視有關業務關係、採取減低風險措施，並在有需要時上報高級管理層
視為帳戶並無風險的確認，可如常運作而無須進一步考慮
視為可停止對該客戶的一切監察
視為日後不會受監管行動的保證
tc.explain: 第7.26段：財富情報組的「同意」回覆不應被解讀為帳戶可繼續運作的「安全證明」。第7.27段：提交報告後，不論財富情報組其後有何回饋，經營者均應適當檢視有關業務關係並採取適當的減低風險措施——提交報告後不加考慮便繼續維持關係並不可接受。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.28段

en.q: An MSO has already filed an STR about a customer. The same customer later conducts further suspicious transactions. What should happen?
options: The further suspicious transactions must continue to be reported to the MLRO, who should make further reports to the JFIU if appropriate
Nothing — one STR covers the customer permanently
The MSO should only report if the new transactions differ in nature from the earlier ones
The MSO should close the account without any further reports
en.explain: ¶7.28: reporting one suspicion does not remove the need to report further suspicious transactions or events for the same customer — whether of the same or a different nature. They must continue to be reported to the MLRO, with further STRs to the JFIU as appropriate.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者已就某客戶提交可疑交易報告。該客戶其後再進行可疑交易。應如何處理？
options: 其後的可疑交易必須繼續向洗錢報告主任報告，洗錢報告主任應在適當時再向財富情報組提交報告
毋須處理——一份報告已永久涵蓋該客戶
只有新交易與先前性質不同時才須報告
應直接結束帳戶，毋須再作報告
tc.explain: 第7.28段：就某宗交易或事件報告懷疑後，並不免除就同一客戶的其後可疑交易或事件作出報告的需要——不論性質與先前相同與否，均須繼續向洗錢報告主任報告，並在適當時再向財富情報組提交報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.29至7.30段

en.q: What records must an MSO maintain in relation to suspicious transaction reporting?
options: A record of all internal ML/TF reports made to the MLRO and a record of all STRs made to the JFIU, including dates, handlers/makers, assessment results and where the relevant papers are located
Only records of STRs that led to a prosecution
No records — STR records would breach the tipping-off prohibition
Only a count of the number of STRs filed each year
en.explain: ¶7.29–7.30: the MSO must maintain a record of all internal reports to the MLRO (date, handling staff, assessment results, whether an STR resulted, location of papers) and a record of all STRs to the JFIU (date, maker, location of papers). The two registers may be combined if appropriate.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須就可疑交易報告備存哪些紀錄？
options: 所有向洗錢報告主任作出的內部報告紀錄，以及所有向財富情報組提交的報告紀錄，包括日期、處理／提交人員、評估結果及相關文件的存放位置
只須備存導致檢控的報告紀錄
毋須備存——備存報告紀錄會違反「通風報訊」禁令
只須備存每年提交報告的數目
tc.explain: 第7.29至7.30段：金錢服務經營者必須備存所有向洗錢報告主任作出的內部報告紀錄（日期、其後處理的職員、評估結果、有否向財富情報組提交報告、相關文件位置），以及所有向財富情報組提交的報告紀錄（日期、提交人、文件位置）。兩份紀錄冊可在適當情況下合併。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶8.3; s.20, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20條

en.q: Which of the following should be included in an MSO's records under the record-keeping requirements?
options: Identification and verification documents for customers, beneficial owners and PPTAs; documents from CDD and ongoing monitoring (including SDD/EDD); account records and material business correspondence; and the results of any analysis of unusual transactions
Only the customer's name and telephone number
Only records of transactions above $120,000
Only records of customers who have been reported to the JFIU
en.explain: ¶8.3: records should include (a) identity documents/data for the customer, beneficial owner, beneficiary, PPTAs and connected parties; (b) documents obtained through CDD and ongoing monitoring including SDD and EDD; (c) purpose-and-intended-nature documents; (d) account records and material business correspondence; and (e) results of any analysis undertaken (e.g. on complex or unusually large transactions).

tc.q: 根據備存紀錄規定，下列哪項應包括在金錢服務經營者的紀錄內？
options: 客戶、實益擁有人及看似代表客戶行事的人的身分識別及核實文件；盡職審查及持續監察（包括簡化及更嚴格審查）過程中取得的文件；帳戶紀錄及重要業務通訊；以及對異常交易所作分析的結果
只須客戶的姓名及電話號碼
只須120,000元以上交易的紀錄
只須已向財富情報組舉報的客戶的紀錄
tc.explain: 第8.3段：紀錄應包括(a)識別及核實客戶、實益擁有人、受益人、看似代表客戶行事的人及有關連者身分的文件正本或副本及數據紀錄；(b)在盡職審查及持續監察程序（包括簡化及更嚴格的盡職審查）期間取得的其他文件及紀錄；(c)業務關係目的及擬具性質的文件；(d)帳戶紀錄及重要業務通訊；及(e)所作任何分析的結果（例如就複雜或異常龐大交易的查究）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶8.4, ¶8.6; s.20(2)-(3A), Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.4及8.6段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(2)至(3A)條

en.q: For how long must CDD documents and transaction records be kept?
options: Throughout the business relationship and for at least 5 years after it ends; for occasional transactions and completed transactions, at least 5 years after the transaction
1 year after the business relationship ends
10 years from account opening
Only until the customer requests deletion
en.explain: ¶8.4: CDD documents and records must be kept throughout the relationship and for at least five years after the end of the business relationship; for occasional transactions at or above the CDD thresholds, at least five years after the date of the transaction. ¶8.6: transaction records are kept at least five years after completion of the transaction, regardless of whether the relationship ends. The CCE may require a longer period by written notice (¶8.8).

tc.q: 盡職審查文件及交易紀錄須保存多久？
options: 在業務關係持續期間保存，並在關係結束後保存最少5年；非經常交易及已完成交易的紀錄，在交易後保存最少5年
業務關係結束後1年
開戶起計10年
客戶要求刪除前保存即可
tc.explain: 第8.4段：盡職審查文件及紀錄須在業務關係持續期間保存，並在業務關係結束後保存最少5年；達到盡職審查門檻的非經常交易，紀錄須在交易日期後保存最少5年。第8.6段：交易紀錄須在交易完成後保存最少5年，不論業務關係是否在期間結束。關長可以書面通知要求更長的保存期（第8.8段）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶8.8; s.20(4), Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.8段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(4)條

en.q: When may an MSO be required to keep records for LONGER than the standard five-year period?
options: When the CCE, by notice in writing, requires records of a specified transaction or customer to be kept for a longer specified period, e.g. because they are relevant to an ongoing investigation
Whenever the customer is a PEP — their records must be kept for 20 years
Never — five years is an absolute maximum
Whenever the transaction exceeds $1 million
en.explain: ¶8.8: the CCE may, by written notice, require an MSO to keep records relating to a specified transaction or customer for a period longer than the standard retention periods, where the records are relevant to an ongoing criminal or other investigation or other purposes specified in the notice.

tc.q: 在甚麼情況下，金錢服務經營者可被要求將紀錄保存超過標準的5年期？
options: 關長以書面通知要求就指明交易或客戶的紀錄保存較長的指明期間，例如因該等紀錄與進行中的調查有關
凡客戶屬政治人物——其紀錄須保存20年
絕無此情況——5年是絕對上限
凡交易超過100萬元
tc.explain: 第8.8段：如紀錄與關長正在進行的刑事或其他調查有關，或涉及通知內指明的其他目的，關長可以書面通知要求金錢服務經營者將指明交易或客戶的紀錄保存較第8.4及8.6段所述為長的指明期間。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.2及9.7段

en.q: Which statement about AML/CFT staff training is CORRECT?
options: New staff should attend initial training as soon as possible after being hired, refresher training should be provided regularly, and training records should be maintained for a minimum of 3 years
Training is only needed for the Compliance Officer and MLRO
One training session at hiring is sufficient for a staff member's entire career
Training records may be discarded once the staff member passes an internal test
en.explain: ¶9.2: new staff require initial training as soon as possible after hiring, plus regular refresher training; scope and frequency should be tailored to the MSO's risks and each staff member's job function. ¶9.7: records of who was trained, when, and the type of training must be maintained for a minimum of 3 years.

tc.q: 關於打擊洗錢職員培訓，下列哪項正確？
options: 新職員獲聘後應盡快接受初步培訓，並定期舉辦複修培訓；培訓紀錄須保存最少3年
只有合規主任及洗錢報告主任需要培訓
入職時受訓一次已足夠整個職業生涯
職員通過內部測試後便可銷毀培訓紀錄
tc.explain: 第9.2段：新職員獲聘用或委任後應盡快接受初步培訓，另應定期舉辦複修培訓；培訓的範圍及頻密程度應按經營者面對的特定風險及職員的職能、職責及經驗而定。第9.7段：須備存誰人受訓、受訓時間及培訓類別的紀錄，最少保存3年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.11至3.12段

en.q: How does the independent audit function help an MSO demonstrate and monitor its AML/CFT compliance?
options: It regularly and independently reviews the AML/CFT Systems — including the adequacy of the risk assessment framework, the effectiveness of STR systems and the compliance function, and staff awareness — with a direct line of communication to senior management
It replaces the need for a Compliance Officer
It files the MSO's STRs with the JFIU
It sets the MSO's exchange rates and fees
en.explain: ¶3.11–3.12: the independent audit function, with a direct line to senior management and sufficient expertise and resources, regularly reviews the AML/CFT Systems: adequacy of the systems, risk assessment framework and RBA application; effectiveness of STR systems; effectiveness of the compliance function; and staff AML/CFT awareness. External reviews should also be sought where appropriate (¶3.13).

tc.q: 獨立審核職能如何協助金錢服務經營者證明及監察其打擊洗錢合規情況？
options: 定期並獨立地覆核打擊洗錢制度——包括風險評估框架是否合適、報告可疑交易制度及合規職能是否有效，以及職員意識水平——並可與高級管理層直接溝通
它可取代合規主任
它負責向財富情報組提交可疑交易報告
它負責釐定匯率及收費
tc.explain: 第3.11至3.12段：獨立審核職能應能與高級管理層直接溝通，並具備充足專門知識及資源，定期覆核打擊洗錢制度：制度、風險評估框架及風險為本方法的應用是否合適；報告可疑交易制度是否有效；合規職能是否有效；以及職員對打擊洗錢職責的意識水平。適當時亦應尋求外界覆核（第3.13段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.1段

en.q: Under which statutory provisions does the obligation to file a suspicious transaction report arise?
options: Sections 25A(1) of the DTROP and the OSCO, and section 12(1) of the UNATMO
Section 5 of Schedule 2 to the AMLO alone
Section 25A of the AMLO
Section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O
en.explain: ¶7.1 states that it is a statutory obligation under sections 25A(1) of the DTROP and the OSCO, as well as section 12(1) of the UNATMO, that a person who knows or suspects that property falls within the specified descriptions shall as soon as it is reasonable for them to do so file an STR with the JFIU.

tc.q: 提交可疑交易報告的責任源自哪些法定條文？
options: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(1)條，以及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(1)條
僅《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5條
《打擊洗錢條例》第25A條
《武器擴散（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條
tc.explain: 第7.1段訂明，根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(1)條，以及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(1)條，任何人如知悉或懷疑任何財產屬指明的描述，均有法定責任在合理範圍內盡快向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.1段

en.q: Which three descriptions of property, in relation to drug trafficking or an indictable offence, trigger the reporting obligation?
options: Property that in whole or in part directly or indirectly represents any person's proceeds of; was used in connection with; or is intended to be used in connection with such conduct
Property that is held in cash; held overseas; or held in a numbered account
Property that has been frozen; confiscated; or forfeited
Property exceeding $8,000; $120,000; or any threshold set by the CCE
en.explain: ¶7.1 states that the obligation arises where a person knows or suspects that any property (a) in whole or in part directly or indirectly represents any person's proceeds of, (b) was used in connection with, or (c) is intended to be used in connection with drug trafficking or an indictable offence; or that any property is terrorist property.

tc.q: 就販毒或可公訴罪行而言，哪三種財產描述會觸發報告責任？
options: 全部或部分直接或間接代表任何人從該等行為所得的得益；曾用於與該等行為有關連的用途；或擬用於與該等行為有關連的用途
以現金持有；在海外持有；或以編號帳戶持有的財產
已被凍結；已被充公；或已被沒收的財產
超過8,000元；120,000元；或海關關長訂定的任何門檻的財產
tc.explain: 第7.1段訂明，如任何人知悉或懷疑任何財產：(a)全部或部分直接或間接代表任何人從販毒或可公訴罪行所得的得益；(b)曾用於與該等行為有關連的用途；或(c)擬用於與該等行為有關連的用途；或知悉或懷疑任何財產屬恐怖分子財產，即產生該項責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.1段

en.q: What must accompany an STR made to the JFIU?
options: Any matter on which the knowledge or suspicion is based
A legal opinion supporting the suspicion
The customer's written explanation of the transaction
A copy of the customer's identification document only
en.explain: ¶7.1 states that the STR should be made together with any matter on which the knowledge or suspicion is based. The underlying material is part of the report, not something supplied only on later request.

tc.q: 向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告須附有甚麼？
options: 構成該項知悉或懷疑的基礎的任何事宜
支持該項懷疑的法律意見
該客戶就該宗交易作出的書面解釋
僅該客戶身分證明文件的副本
tc.explain: 第7.1段訂明可疑交易報告應連同構成該項知悉或懷疑的基礎的任何事宜一併作出。有關基礎資料本身即屬報告的一部分，而非其後應要求方提供。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.1段

en.q: What is the maximum penalty for failure to report knowledge or suspicion under the DTROP, the OSCO and the UNATMO?
options: Imprisonment for three months and a fine of $50,000
Imprisonment for two years and a fine of $200,000
Imprisonment for seven years and a fine of $5,000,000
A fine of $1,000,000 only
en.explain: ¶7.1 states that under the DTROP, the OSCO and the UNATMO, failure to report knowledge or suspicion carries a maximum penalty of imprisonment for three months and a fine of $50,000.

tc.q: 根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，未有報告知悉或懷疑的最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁三個月及罰款50,000元
監禁兩年及罰款200,000元
監禁七年及罰款5,000,000元
tc.explain: 第7.1段訂明根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，未有報告知悉或懷疑的最高刑罰為監禁三個月及罰款50,000元。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.2段

en.q: What three things is knowledge likely to include, generally speaking?
options: Actual knowledge; knowledge of circumstances which would indicate facts to a reasonable person; and knowledge of circumstances which would put a reasonable person on inquiry
Actual knowledge only, since the test is subjective
Documentary proof; witness evidence; and a confession
Actual knowledge; hearsay; and rumour
en.explain: ¶7.2 states that generally speaking knowledge is likely to include actual knowledge; knowledge of circumstances which would indicate facts to a reasonable person; and knowledge of circumstances which would put a reasonable person on inquiry. The second and third limbs are objective.

tc.q: 一般而言，「知悉」相當可能包括哪三方面？
options: 實際知悉；知悉會向一個合理的人顯示某些事實的情況；以及知悉會令一個合理的人作出查究的情況
僅實際知悉，因該準則屬主觀
文件證據；證人證供；以及認罪
實際知悉；傳聞；以及傳言
tc.explain: 第7.2段訂明一般而言，知悉相當可能包括：實際知悉；知悉會向一個合理的人顯示某些事實的情況；以及知悉會令一個合理的人作出查究的情況。後兩項屬客觀準則。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.3段

en.q: How does the Guideline characterise suspicion as compared with knowledge?
options: Suspicion is more subjective; it is personal and falls short of proof based on firm evidence
Suspicion requires a higher standard of certainty than knowledge
Suspicion must be supported by documentary proof
Suspicion and knowledge are treated identically in law
en.explain: ¶7.3 states that suspicion is more subjective, that it is personal and falls short of proof based on firm evidence, and that where a transaction or series of transactions is not consistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer, or is unusual, the MSO should take appropriate steps to further examine the transactions and identify if there is any suspicion.

tc.q: 本指引如何形容「懷疑」與「知悉」的分別？
options: 懷疑較為主觀；屬個人的判斷，其程度未及以確鑿證據為據的證明
懷疑所需的肯定程度高於知悉
懷疑須有文件證據支持
法律上懷疑與知悉的處理完全相同
tc.explain: 第7.3段訂明懷疑較為主觀；懷疑屬個人的判斷，其程度未及以確鑿證據為據的證明。如客戶的某宗或一連串交易與該經營者對該客戶的了解並不一致，或屬不尋常，該經營者應採取適當步驟進一步審查該等交易，並識別是否有任何懷疑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.3段

en.q: To which paragraphs of the Guideline does ¶7.3 direct an MSO for the steps to take when a transaction is inconsistent or unusual?
options: Paragraphs 5.10 to 5.14, on transaction monitoring and review of transactions
Paragraphs 4.9.1 to 4.9.5, on enhanced due diligence
Paragraphs 6.16 to 6.19, on sanctions screening
Paragraphs 8.1 to 8.5, on record-keeping
en.explain: ¶7.3 cross-refers to ¶5.10 to ¶5.14 — the transaction monitoring provisions dealing with the steps to identify grounds for suspicion, the consequences of a satisfactory or unsatisfactory explanation, tipping off, and documentation of the review.

tc.q: 就交易並不一致或屬不尋常時應採取的步驟，第7.3段指引金錢服務經營者參閱哪些段落？
options: 第5.10至5.14段，有關交易監察及交易檢視
第4.9.1至4.9.5段，有關加強盡職審查
第6.16至6.19段，有關制裁篩查
第8.1至8.5段，有關備存紀錄
tc.explain: 第7.3段參照第5.10至5.14段——即有關交易監察的條文，涵蓋識別懷疑理由的步驟、取得或未能取得圓滿解釋的後果、通風報信，以及檢視過程的記錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.4段

en.q: Must a person know the nature of the underlying criminal activity before knowledge or suspicion arises?
options: No — a person need not know the nature of the criminal activity underlying the ML, or that the funds themselves definitely arose from the criminal offence; the same principle applies to TF
Yes — the predicate offence must be identified
Yes — at least the category of offence must be identified
No — but the amount involved must be established
en.explain: ¶7.4 states that for a person to have knowledge or suspicion, they do not need to know the nature of the criminal activity underlying the ML, or that the funds themselves definitely arose from the criminal offence, and that the same principle applies to TF.

tc.q: 在產生知悉或懷疑之前，是否必須知悉相關犯罪活動的性質？
options: 否——無須知悉洗錢背後犯罪活動的性質，亦無須確知該等資金必然源自該項罪行；同一原則適用於恐怖分子資金籌集
是——須識別出前置罪行
是——最少須識別出罪行的類別
否——但須確定所涉款額
tc.explain: 第7.4段訂明，就某人具有知悉或懷疑而言，該人無須知悉洗錢背後犯罪活動的性質，亦無須確知該等資金必然源自該項罪行；同一原則亦適用於恐怖分子資金籌集。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5(a)段

en.q: Must an STR be filed where no transaction has been conducted by or through the MSO?
options: Yes — once knowledge or suspicion has been formed, an MSO should file an STR even where no transaction has been conducted by or through it
No — a completed transaction is a precondition of reporting
No — an internal record suffices where no transaction occurred
Yes — but only where the customer has an existing business relationship
en.explain: ¶7.5(a) states that once knowledge or suspicion has been formed, an MSO should file an STR even where no transaction has been conducted by or through the MSO. Footnote 60 adds that the obligation applies whether or not a transaction was actually conducted, and also covers attempted transactions.

tc.q: 如並無任何交易經該金錢服務經營者或透過其進行，是否仍須提交可疑交易報告？
options: 須要——一旦形成知悉或懷疑，即使並無任何交易經該經營者或透過其進行，該經營者仍應提交可疑交易報告
無須——已完成的交易是報告的先決條件
無須——如並無交易發生，只需內部紀錄即可
須要——但只限該客戶已有現存業務關係
tc.explain: 第7.5(a)款訂明一旦形成知悉或懷疑，即使並無任何交易經該經營者或透過其進行，該經營者仍應提交可疑交易報告。註腳60補充該項責任不論交易是否實際進行均適用，並涵蓋未遂的交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5(b)段

en.q: By when must an STR be made once knowledge or suspicion has been formed?
options: As soon as reasonably practical after the suspicion was first identified
Within 24 hours of the transaction
Within 7 days of the end of the month in which the suspicion arose
Before the next periodic review of the customer
en.explain: ¶7.5(b) states that the STR must be made as soon as reasonably practical after the suspicion was first identified — the same timing standard as the statutory 'as soon as it is reasonable for him to do so' in ¶7.1.

tc.q: 一旦形成知悉或懷疑，可疑交易報告須在何時作出？
options: 在首次識別出該項懷疑後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快作出
於該交易後24小時內
於懷疑產生當月月底後7日內
於下次定期檢視該客戶之前
tc.explain: 第7.5(b)款訂明可疑交易報告須在首次識別出該項懷疑後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快作出——與第7.1段法定的「在合理範圍內盡快」時限標準一致。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5段註腳60

en.q: Does the reporting obligation extend to attempted transactions?
options: Yes — the obligation to report applies whether or not a transaction was actually conducted, and also covers attempted transactions
No — an executed transaction is required before the obligation arises
Yes — but only where the attempt was abandoned by the customer
No — attempted transactions need only be recorded internally
en.explain: Footnote 60 to ¶7.5 states that the reporting provisions establish a reporting obligation whenever a suspicion arises, without reference to transactions per se, and that thus the obligation to report applies whether or not a transaction was actually conducted and also covers attempted transactions.

tc.q: 報告責任是否延伸至未遂的交易？
options: 是——不論交易是否實際進行，報告責任均適用，並涵蓋未遂的交易
否——須有已執行的交易，該項責任方會產生
是——但只限該客戶主動放棄的企圖
否——未遂的交易只須作內部記錄
tc.explain: 第7.5段註腳60訂明有關報告條文在懷疑產生時即確立報告責任，而不以交易本身為依歸；因此，不論交易是否實際進行，報告責任均適用，並涵蓋未遂的交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5段註腳60

en.q: Is the reporting obligation subject to any monetary threshold?
options: No — the obligation requires a person to report suspicions of ML/TF irrespective of the amount involved, because the provisions apply to 'any property'
Yes — the $8,000 CDD threshold applies
Yes — the $120,000 occasional transaction threshold applies
Yes — a threshold set by the CCE from time to time applies
en.explain: Footnote 60 states that the reporting obligations require a person to report suspicions of ML/TF irrespective of the amount involved, that the obligations under section 25A(1) DTROP and OSCO and section 12(1) UNATMO apply to 'any property', and that these provisions establish a reporting obligation whenever a suspicion arises, without reference to transactions per se.

tc.q: 報告責任是否設有款額門檻？
options: 並無——不論所涉款額多少，任何人均須報告洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑，因有關條文適用於「任何財產」
有——適用8,000元的客戶盡職審查門檻
有——適用120,000元的單一宗交易門檻
有——適用海關關長不時訂定的門檻
tc.explain: 註腳60訂明不論所涉款額多少，報告責任均要求任何人報告洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑；《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(1)條及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(1)條的責任適用於「任何財產」；該等條文在懷疑產生時即確立報告責任，而不以交易本身為依歸。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5段註腳60

en.q: How is property defined for the purposes of the reporting obligation?
options: By reference to section 3 of the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance, Cap. 1, covering money, goods, choses in action and land, and obligations, easements and every description of estate, interest and profit arising out of or incident to such property
By reference to the definition in Schedule 1 to the AMLO
As money and negotiable instruments only
As any asset held with a financial institution
en.explain: Footnote 60 states that property includes both movable and immovable property within the meaning of section 3 of the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance, Cap. 1, and that as defined there property includes money, goods, choses in action and land; and obligations, easements and every description of estate, interest and profit, present or future, vested or contingent, arising out of or incident to that property.

tc.q: 就報告責任而言，「財產」如何界定？
options: 參照《釋義及通則條例》（第1章）第3條，涵蓋金錢、貨品、據法權產及土地，以及因該等財產而產生或附帶的義務、地役權及各類遺產、權益及利潤
參照《打擊洗錢條例》附表1的定義
僅指金錢及可流轉票據
指在金融機構持有的任何資產
tc.explain: 註腳60訂明財產包括《釋義及通則條例》（第1章）第3條所指的動產及不動產；按該條的定義，財產包括：(a)金錢、貨品、據法權產及土地；及(b)因(a)項所界定財產而產生或附帶的義務、地役權及現在或將來的、既得或或有的各類遺產、權益及利潤。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.6段

en.q: Does the tipping off offence apply where a suspicion has been raised internally but not yet reported to the JFIU?
options: Yes — the tipping-off provision includes circumstances where a suspicion has been raised internally within an MSO but has not yet been reported to the JFIU
No — the offence arises only after an STR has been filed
No — internal reports are not covered by the legislation
Yes — but only where the internal report has reached the MLRO
en.explain: ¶7.6 states that it is an offence to reveal to any person any information which might prejudice an investigation; that if a customer is told that a report has been made this would prejudice the investigation and an offence would be committed; and that the tipping-off provision includes circumstances where a suspicion has been raised internally within an MSO but has not yet been reported to the JFIU.

tc.q: 如懷疑已在內部提出但尚未向聯合財富情報組報告，通風報信罪行是否適用？
options: 適用——通風報信的條文涵蓋懷疑已在該經營者內部提出但尚未向聯合財富情報組報告的情況
不適用——該罪行只在提交可疑交易報告後方產生
不適用——內部報告不受該法例涵蓋
適用——但只限該內部報告已送達洗錢事務主任的情況
tc.explain: 第7.6段訂明向任何人透露可能損害調查的任何資料即屬犯罪（「通風報信」）；如告知客戶已作出報告，即會損害該調查並構成罪行；而通風報信的條文涵蓋懷疑已在該經營者內部提出但尚未向聯合財富情報組報告的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.7段

en.q: Which three elements should an MSO's AML/CFT Systems include in relation to suspicious transaction reporting?
options: Appointment of an MLRO; clear policies and procedures over internal reporting, reporting to the JFIU, post-reporting risk mitigation and prevention of tipping off; and keeping proper records of internal reports and STRs
Appointment of a compliance officer; an annual external audit; and a whistle-blowing hotline
A transaction monitoring system; a sanctions database; and a staff training programme
A reporting register; a legal adviser; and an escalation committee
en.explain: ¶7.7 states that an MSO should implement appropriate AML/CFT Systems to fulfil its statutory reporting obligations and properly manage and mitigate the risks associated with any customer or transaction involved in an STR, and that the systems should include the appointment of an MLRO; implementing clear policies and procedures over internal reporting, reporting to the JFIU, post-reporting risk mitigation and prevention of tipping off; and keeping proper records of internal reports and STRs.

tc.q: 就可疑交易報告，金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢系統應包括哪三項元素？
options: 委任洗錢事務主任；就內部報告、向聯合財富情報組報告、報告後的風險緩減及防止通風報信訂立清晰政策及程序；以及妥為保存內部報告及可疑交易報告的紀錄
委任合規主任；每年外部審計；以及舉報熱線
交易監察系統；制裁資料庫；以及員工培訓計劃
報告登記冊；法律顧問；以及呈報委員會
tc.explain: 第7.7段訂明該經營者應實施適當的打擊洗錢系統，以履行其法定報告責任，並妥善管理及減低與涉及可疑交易報告的任何客戶或交易相關的風險；該等系統應包括：委任洗錢事務主任；就內部報告、向聯合財富情報組報告、報告後的風險緩減及防止通風報信實施清晰的政策及程序；以及妥為保存內部報告及可疑交易報告的紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.8段

en.q: How should the type and extent of the measures checking an MSO's reporting systems be determined?
options: They should be appropriate having regard to the risk of ML/TF as well as the nature and size of the MSO's business
They should be identical for all MSOs, as set by the CCE
They should be determined by the MLRO alone, without reference to business size
They should be the maximum practicable in every case
en.explain: ¶7.8 states that an MSO should have measures in place to check, on an ongoing basis, that its AML/CFT Systems in relation to suspicious transaction reporting comply with relevant legal and regulatory requirements and operate effectively, and that the type and extent of the measures to be taken should be appropriate having regard to the risk of ML/TF as well as the nature and size of its business.

tc.q: 查核金錢服務經營者報告系統的措施，其類型及程度應如何釐定？
options: 應顧及洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險，以及該經營者業務的性質及規模而屬適當
應由海關關長訂定，對所有經營者劃一
應僅由洗錢事務主任決定，而不顧及業務規模
在任何情況下均應採取切實可行的最高程度
tc.explain: 第7.8段訂明該經營者應設有措施，持續查核其就可疑交易報告的打擊洗錢系統是否符合相關法律及監管規定並有效運作；所採取措施的類型及程度，應顧及洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險以及其業務的性質及規模而屬適當。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.9段

en.q: What two roles does the MLRO fulfil under ¶7.9?
options: A central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions, and the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies
The compliance officer, and the internal auditor
The senior management representative, and the data protection officer
The training officer, and the customer complaints officer
en.explain: ¶7.9 states that an MSO should appoint an MLRO as a central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and also as the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies, and that the MLRO should play an active role in the identification and reporting of suspicious transactions.

tc.q: 根據第7.9段，洗錢事務主任擔當哪兩個角色？
options: 匯報可疑交易的中央參照點，以及與聯合財富情報組及執法機關的主要聯絡點
合規主任，以及內部審計師
高級管理層代表，以及資料保障主任
培訓主任，以及客戶投訴主任
tc.explain: 第7.9段訂明該經營者應委任洗錢事務主任，作為匯報可疑交易的中央參照點，以及與聯合財富情報組及執法機關的主要聯絡點；該主任並應在識別及匯報可疑交易方面發揮積極作用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.9段

en.q: Which of the following is among the MLRO's principal functions?
options: Provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off
Approval of all new customer relationships
Conduct of the annual independent audit
Setting the MSO's transaction limits
en.explain: ¶7.9 states that the MLRO's principal functions should include having oversight of: the review of internal disclosures and exception reports and, in light of all available relevant information, determination of whether or not it is necessary to make a report to the JFIU; the maintenance of all records related to such internal reviews; and the provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off.

tc.q: 下列何者屬洗錢事務主任的主要職能之一？
options: 就如何避免通風報信提供指引
批准所有新客戶關係
進行每年一次的獨立審計
訂定該經營者的交易限額
tc.explain: 第7.9段訂明洗錢事務主任的主要職能應包括監督：檢視內部披露及例外報告，並根據所有可得的相關資料決定是否有需要向聯合財富情報組作出報告；保存與該等內部檢視有關的所有紀錄；以及就如何避免通風報信提供指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10段

en.q: What should the guidance an MSO provides to staff and agents on recognising ML/TF/PF take into account?
options: The nature of the transactions and customer instructions that staff is likely to encounter, the type of product or service, and the means of delivery
The MSO's profitability targets for the year
The identity of the MSO's largest customers
The CCE's inspection schedule
en.explain: ¶7.10 states that an MSO should provide sufficient guidance to its staff and agents (if applicable) to enable them to form suspicion or to recognise the signs when ML/TF/PF is taking place, and that the guidance should take into account the nature of the transactions and customer instructions that staff is likely to encounter, the type of product or service and the means of delivery.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者向員工及代理人提供有關識別洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集的指引，應顧及甚麼？
options: 員工相當可能遇到的交易及客戶指示的性質、產品或服務的類型，以及交付方式
該經營者的年度盈利目標
該經營者最大客戶的身分
海關關長的巡查時間表
tc.explain: 第7.10段訂明該經營者應向其員工及代理人（如適用）提供充分指引，使其能形成懷疑或辨識洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集正在發生的徵兆；該指引應顧及員工相當可能遇到的交易及客戶指示的性質、產品或服務的類型，以及交付方式。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(iv)段

en.q: How does the Guideline describe 'structuring' or 'smurfing'?
options: Many lower value transactions conducted when one, or a few, large transactions could be used
Routing funds through several financial institutions without need
Sending funds back to the sender's own account in another jurisdiction
Exchanging small-denominated notes for higher denominations
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(iv) lists as a red flag indicator of transactions which do not make economic sense: 'structuring' or 'smurfing', that is many lower value transactions conducted when one, or a few, large transactions could be used.

tc.q: 本指引如何形容「拆分交易」或「螞蟻搬家」？
options: 在本可使用一宗或少數幾宗大額交易的情況下，卻進行大量較低價值的交易
在無需要的情況下將資金經多家金融機構轉遞
將資金匯回寄款人在另一司法管轄區的帳戶
將小面額鈔票兌換為較大面額
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(iv)段列出「在經濟上不合理的交易」的預警指標之一：「拆分交易」或「螞蟻搬家」，即在本可使用一宗或少數幾宗大額交易的情況下，卻進行大量較低價值的交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(ii)段

en.q: Which mismatch is given as an example of a transaction incompatible with the MSO's knowledge and experience of the customer?
options: A mismatch between the economic activity, place of origin, or person and the remittances received
A mismatch between the customer's stated and actual age
A mismatch between the currency requested and the currency delivered
A mismatch between the fee quoted and the fee charged
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(ii) lists transactions which are incompatible with the MSO's knowledge and experience of the customer in question or with the purpose of the relevant business transaction — for example, a mismatch between the economic activity, place of origin, or person and the remittances received.

tc.q: 哪一項不匹配的情況，被舉為與該經營者對客戶的了解及經驗不相容的交易例子？
options: 經濟活動、來源地或人物，與所收取匯款之間的不匹配
客戶所述年齡與實際年齡的不匹配
所要求貨幣與所交付貨幣的不匹配
所報價費用與所收取費用的不匹配
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(ii)段列出與該經營者對有關客戶的了解及經驗，或與該項業務交易目的不相容的交易；並以經濟活動、來源地或人物與所收取匯款之間的不匹配為例。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(iii)段

en.q: Which red flag describes executing frequent or several transactions each of which is below CDD thresholds?
options: Concealing or disguising significant transactions to avoid disclosure for record purposes
Unnecessary routing of funds through various financial institutions
Concentration of payments to a single individual's account
A lack of apparent relationship between the originator and the recipient
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(iii) lists as a red flag conduct that conceals or disguises significant transactions to avoid disclosure for record purposes, by executing frequent or several transactions such that each transaction by itself is below CDD thresholds.

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標描述進行頻密或多宗交易，而每宗均低於客戶盡職審查門檻？
options: 隱瞞或掩飾重大交易，以規避備存紀錄的披露
在無需要的情況下將資金經多家金融機構轉遞
付款集中匯入單一個人的帳戶
匯款人與收款人之間欠缺明顯關係
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(iii)段列出的預警指標為：藉進行頻密或多宗交易，使每宗交易本身均低於客戶盡職審查門檻，從而隱瞞或掩飾重大交易，以規避備存紀錄的披露。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(vii)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns a substantial increase in a customer's activity, and what aggravates it?
options: Substantial increases in the number, frequency or amounts of transactions without apparent cause — especially if remittances are made to a destination or person not normally associated with the customer
A gradual decline in transaction volume — especially at the end of a financial year
A change in the customer's preferred branch — especially if it is further from their address
A request for a fee discount — especially if the customer threatens to leave
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(vii) lists substantial increase(s) in the number of transactions, frequency or amounts by a customer without apparent cause, especially if remittances are made to a destination or person not normally associated with the customer.

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及客戶活動大幅增加？何種情況會令其更為可疑？
options: 客戶的交易數目、頻次或款額在並無明顯原因下大幅增加——尤其如匯款是匯往通常與該客戶無關連的目的地或人物
交易量逐步下降——尤其在財政年度末
客戶改用另一分行——尤其如該分行距其地址較遠
客戶要求費用折扣——尤其如客戶威脅轉用他家
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(vii)段列出客戶的交易數目／頻次／款額在並無明顯原因下大幅增加，尤其如匯款是匯往通常與該客戶並無關連的目的地或人物。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(viii)段

en.q: What does the red flag 'concentration of payments' describe?
options: Multiple senders transferring funds to a single individual's account
A single sender transferring funds to multiple recipients
Payments concentrated in a single currency
Payments concentrated at a single branch
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(viii) lists as a red flag concentration of payments where multiple senders transfer funds to a single individual's account.

tc.q: 「付款集中」這項預警指標描述甚麼？
options: 多名寄款人將資金轉入單一個人的帳戶
單一寄款人將資金轉予多名收款人
付款集中於單一貨幣
付款集中於單一分行
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(viii)段列出的預警指標為付款集中，即多名寄款人將資金轉入單一個人的帳戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(ix)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns the relationship between the parties and the destination of a personal remittance?
options: A lack of apparent relationship between the originator and recipient, personal remittances to jurisdictions with no apparent family or business link, or a customer with no relation to the jurisdiction who cannot sufficiently explain the transfer
A remittance to a family member in an equivalent jurisdiction
A remittance to a business counterparty disclosed at onboarding
A remittance to a jurisdiction where the customer holds a bank account
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(ix) lists a lack of apparent relationship between the originator and the recipient of funds, and/or personal remittances sent to jurisdictions that have no apparent family or business link to the customer, and/or the customer having no relation to the jurisdiction where he or she sends or receives the money and being unable sufficiently to explain why money is sent to or received from there.

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及各方之間的關係及個人匯款的目的地？
options: 匯款人與收款人之間欠缺明顯關係；個人匯款匯往與客戶並無明顯親屬或業務聯繫的司法管轄區；或客戶與其收發款項的司法管轄區並無關係且未能充分解釋原因
匯款予身處同等司法管轄區的家庭成員
匯款予開立客戶時已披露的業務對手方
匯款至該客戶持有銀行帳戶的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(ix)段列出匯款人與收款人之間欠缺明顯關係；及／或個人匯款匯往與該客戶並無明顯親屬或業務聯繫的司法管轄區；及／或該客戶與其收發款項的司法管轄區並無關係，且未能充分解釋款項為何匯往或來自該處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(b)(iii)段

en.q: Which cash-related red flag involves the denomination and currency of notes?
options: Exchanging an unusually large amount of small-denominated notes for those of higher denomination in a different currency
Requesting payment in the smallest available denomination
Refusing to accept notes issued before a certain year
Requesting a mix of currencies for a single transaction
en.explain: ¶7.10(b)(iii) lists among cash intensive transactions with abnormal patterns the exchanging of an unusually large amount of small-denominated notes for those of higher denomination in a different currency.

tc.q: 哪一項與現金有關的預警指標涉及鈔票面額及貨幣？
options: 將數量異常龐大的小面額鈔票，兌換為另一種貨幣的較大面額鈔票
要求以最小可得面額付款
拒絕接受某年份前發行的鈔票
就單一宗交易要求多種貨幣組合
tc.explain: 第7.10(b)(iii)段在「模式異常的現金密集交易」中列出：將數量異常龐大的小面額鈔票兌換為另一種貨幣的較大面額鈔票。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(b)(iv)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns numerous individually modest transactions over a short period?
options: Numerous transactions by a customer, especially over a short period, each below the CDD threshold or not substantial, but whose cumulative total is substantial or exceeds the threshold
A single large transaction conducted at the start of a business relationship
Transactions conducted only at month end
Transactions conducted through more than one delivery channel
en.explain: ¶7.10(b)(iv) lists numerous transactions by a customer, especially over a short period of time, where the amount of each transaction is below the CDD threshold or not substantial but the cumulative total is substantial or exceeds the threshold.

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及在短時間內進行大量個別金額不大的交易？
options: 客戶進行大量交易（尤其在短時間內），每宗金額均低於客戶盡職審查門檻或並不龐大，但累計總額龐大或超出該門檻
在業務關係開始時進行單一宗大額交易
只在月底進行交易
透過多於一個交付渠道進行交易
tc.explain: 第7.10(b)(iv)段列出客戶進行大量交易（尤其在短時間內），而每宗交易的金額低於客戶盡職審查門檻或並不龐大，但累計總額龐大或超出該門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(b)(v)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns customers and the MSO's branch network?
options: Customers who together, and simultaneously, use separate branches to conduct large cash transactions
Customers who always use the same branch for every transaction
Customers who ask which branch is least busy
Customers who use a branch outside their home district
en.explain: ¶7.10(b)(v) lists as a cash-related red flag customers who together, and simultaneously, use separate branches to conduct large cash transactions.

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及客戶與該經營者的分行網絡？
options: 多名客戶一同並同時使用不同分行進行大額（現金）交易
客戶每次交易均使用同一分行
客戶查詢哪間分行較少人
客戶使用其居住地區以外的分行
tc.explain: 第7.10(b)(v)段列出的現金相關預警指標為：多名客戶一同並同時使用不同分行進行大額（現金）交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(c)段註腳62

en.q: What examples does the Guideline give of commodity types designated as higher risk for ML/TF/PF activities?
options: High-value, low-volume goods such as consumer electronics, and dual-use goods which have high turnover rates and present valuation difficulties
Perishable foodstuffs and agricultural produce
Bulk raw materials such as coal and iron ore
Second-hand furniture and household goods
en.explain: Footnote 62 to ¶7.10(c)(ii) gives as examples of higher-risk commodity types high-value, low-volume goods such as consumer electronics, and dual-use goods which have high turnover rates and present valuation difficulties.

tc.q: 本指引就被列為洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集較高風險的商品類型，舉出哪些例子？
options: 高價值、低體積的貨品（例如消費電子產品），以及周轉率高且估值困難的軍民兩用貨品
易腐食品及農產品
煤及鐵礦石等大宗原材料
二手傢俬及家居用品
tc.explain: 第7.10(c)(ii)段註腳62就較高風險商品類型舉例：高價值、低體積的貨品（例如消費電子產品），以及周轉率高且估值困難的軍民兩用貨品。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(c)(iii)及(iv)段

en.q: Which two discrepancies are listed as trade-based red flags?
options: Significant discrepancies between the description of the commodity on the bill of lading or invoice and the actual commodity shipped; and between the value reported on the invoice and the commodity's fair market value
Discrepancies between the shipping date and the invoice date; and between the port of loading and the port of discharge
Discrepancies between the buyer's and seller's addresses; and between their bank details
Discrepancies between the freight cost and the insurance premium; and between the currency and the country
en.explain: ¶7.10(c)(iii) lists significant discrepancies between the description of the commodity on the bill of lading or invoice and the actual commodity shipped, and ¶7.10(c)(iv) lists significant discrepancies between the value of the commodity reported on the invoice and the commodity's fair market value.

tc.q: 哪兩項差異被列為與貿易有關的預警指標？
options: 提單或發票上的商品描述與實際付運商品之間的重大差異；以及發票所報商品價值與該商品公平市值之間的重大差異
付運日期與發票日期之間的差異；以及裝貨港與卸貨港之間的差異
買賣雙方地址之間的差異；以及其銀行資料之間的差異
運費與保費之間的差異；以及貨幣與國家之間的差異
tc.explain: 第7.10(c)(iii)段列出提單或發票上的商品描述與實際付運商品之間出現重大差異；第7.10(c)(iv)段則列出發票所報商品價值與該商品公平市值之間出現重大差異。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(c)(vi)段註腳63

en.q: What example is given of a method of payment inconsistent with the risk characteristics of a trade transaction?
options: The use of an advance payment for a shipment from a new supplier in a high-risk jurisdiction
Payment by documentary letter of credit for an established supplier
Payment on delivery for a domestic shipment
Payment in instalments over an agreed credit period
en.explain: Footnote 63 to ¶7.10(c)(vi) gives as an example of a method of payment appearing inconsistent with the risk characteristics of the transaction the use of an advance payment for a shipment from a new supplier in a high-risk jurisdiction.

tc.q: 就付款方式與貿易交易風險特徵不相符，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 就來自高風險司法管轄區的新供應商的付運，採用預先付款
就已建立關係的供應商採用跟單信用證付款
就本地付運採用貨到付款
按議定的信貸期分期付款
tc.explain: 第7.10(c)(vi)段註腳63就付款方式與該交易的風險特徵看似不相符舉例：就來自高風險司法管轄區的新供應商的付運採用預先付款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(c)(viii)及(ix)段

en.q: Which two features of a trade transaction are listed as red flags?
options: The use of repeatedly amended or frequently extended letters of credit; and the use of front or shell companies
The use of a documentary collection; and the use of a freight forwarder
The use of a standby letter of credit; and the use of marine insurance
The use of a bill of exchange; and the use of a customs broker
en.explain: ¶7.10(c)(viii) lists transactions involving the use of repeatedly amended or frequently extended letters of credit, and ¶7.10(c)(ix) lists transactions involving the use of front (or shell) companies.

tc.q: 貿易交易的哪兩項特徵被列為預警指標？
options: 使用一再修改或頻繁延期的信用證；以及使用門面（或空殼）公司
使用跟單託收；以及使用貨運代理
使用備用信用證；以及使用海上保險
使用匯票；以及使用報關代理
tc.explain: 第7.10(c)(viii)段列出交易涉及使用一再修改或頻繁延期的信用證；第7.10(c)(ix)段則列出交易涉及使用門面（或空殼）公司。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(d)(iv)段

en.q: Which charitable red flag is listed under other types of transactions?
options: Donation to a charity or non-profit organisation located in a conflict zone or a jurisdiction reported to have terrorist activities or terrorist groups
Any donation to a charity exceeding $8,000
Any donation made anonymously
Any donation made by a corporate customer
en.explain: ¶7.10(d)(iv) lists as a red flag a donation to a charity or non-profit organisation (NPO) located in a conflict zone or a jurisdiction reported to have terrorist activities or terrorist groups.

tc.q: 在「其他類型交易」中，列出哪一項與慈善有關的預警指標？
options: 向位於衝突地區，或據報有恐怖活動／恐怖組織的司法管轄區的慈善機構或非牟利組織捐款
任何超過8,000元的慈善捐款
任何匿名作出的捐款
任何由法團客戶作出的捐款
tc.explain: 第7.10(d)(iv)段列出的預警指標為：向位於衝突地區或據報有恐怖活動／恐怖組織的司法管轄區的慈善機構或非牟利組織捐款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(d)(v)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns the identification process itself?
options: False information given during the identification process, or the use of third parties to transfer funds aimed at concealing the sender and/or receiver of moneys
A customer who provides more information than requested
A customer who declines to give an email address
A customer whose identity document is due to expire shortly
en.explain: ¶7.10(d)(v) lists false information during the identification process, or the use of third parties to transfer funds aimed at concealing the sender and/or receiver of moneys.

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及身分識別過程本身？
options: 在身分識別過程中提供虛假資料，或利用第三方轉移資金以隱瞞款項的寄款人及／或收款人
客戶提供多於所要求的資料
客戶拒絕提供電郵地址
客戶的身分證明文件即將屆滿
tc.explain: 第7.10(d)(v)段列出在身分識別過程中提供虛假資料，或利用第三方轉移資金以隱瞞款項的寄款人及／或收款人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(d)(vi)段

en.q: What does the Guideline note about the size of amounts in payments to or from tax havens or high-risk crime jurisdictions?
options: Amounts transacted are not necessarily to be large
Only amounts exceeding $120,000 are relevant
Only amounts exceeding the CDD threshold are relevant
The size of the amount is the sole determinant
en.explain: ¶7.10(d)(vi) lists customers who send or receive regular payments from jurisdictions regarded as tax havens or likely to be exposed to serious crimes or high risk business such as drug trafficking, TF, smuggling, gambling or adult entertainments, and expressly adds that amounts transacted are not necessarily to be large.

tc.q: 就與避稅天堂或高風險罪案司法管轄區之間的付款，本指引就款額大小有何說明？
options: 交易款額不一定龐大
只有超過120,000元的款額方屬相關
只有超過客戶盡職審查門檻的款額方屬相關
款額大小是唯一的判斷準則
tc.explain: 第7.10(d)(vi)段列出客戶向被視為「避稅天堂」，或相當可能涉及嚴重罪行或高風險行業（例如販毒、恐怖分子資金籌集、走私、賭博或成人娛樂）的司法管轄區寄出或收取（經常性）付款；並明文補充交易款額不一定龐大。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(e)(iii)段

en.q: What is meant by an identification that 'evolves', as listed among red flags concerning agents or counterparts?
options: Some parts of the identification change while other parts remain the same, across a large volume of transactions for the same customer
The identity document is renewed on expiry
The customer changes their legal name by deed poll
The customer's photograph is updated periodically
en.explain: ¶7.10(e)(iii) lists a large volume of transactions for the same customer with multiple instances of using different name spellings, false addresses or an identification that 'evolves' — that is, some parts of the identification change while other parts remain the same.

tc.q: 在有關代理人或對手方的預警指標中，所謂身分識別資料「逐步變化」是指甚麼？
options: 就同一客戶的大量交易中，身分識別資料部分內容有所改變，而其他部分則維持不變
身分證明文件屆滿後獲續期
客戶以契據更改其法定姓名
客戶的照片定期更新
tc.explain: 第7.10(e)(iii)段列出就同一客戶進行大量交易，並多次出現使用不同姓名拼法、虛假地址，或身分識別資料「逐步變化」（即部分內容有所改變，而其他部分維持不變）的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(e)(iv)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns a customer's use of multiple agent locations?
options: Transmission of funds by the same customer on the same day to several agent or counterpart locations, to purportedly the same or different recipients
Use of a single agent location for all transactions
Use of an agent located outside Hong Kong
Use of an agent recommended by another customer
en.explain: ¶7.10(e)(iv) lists the transmission of funds by the same customer on the same day to several agents or counterparts of MSO locations to purportedly same or different recipients.

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及客戶使用多個代理點？
options: 同一客戶在同一日向多個代理人或對手方地點發出匯款，聲稱交予相同或不同的收款人
所有交易均使用單一代理點
使用位於香港以外的代理人
使用另一客戶推薦的代理人
tc.explain: 第7.10(e)(iv)段列出同一客戶在同一日向該經營者的多個代理人或對手方地點發出匯款，聲稱交予相同或不同的收款人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(f)段

en.q: Which of the following is listed as a customer behaviour red flag?
options: The customer shows no interest in comparing the costs or exchange rates offered by MSOs
The customer asks detailed questions about the exchange rate
The customer requests a written receipt
The customer arrives shortly before closing time
en.explain: ¶7.10(f) lists customer behaviour red flags including: the customer being accompanied by others who keep a low profile or stay just outside the premises, or appearing to be in doubt when asked for further details; being in a hurry to complete the transaction with promises to provide supporting information retrospectively; showing no interest in comparing costs or exchange rates offered by MSOs; multiple customers appearing to work together to break one transaction into two or more below the threshold; and failing reasonably to justify the purpose of a transaction on enquiry.

tc.q: 下列何者列為客戶行為方面的預警指標？
options: 客戶對比較各金錢服務經營者所提供的費用及／或匯率毫無興趣
客戶就匯率提出詳細查詢
客戶要求書面收據
客戶在接近關門時間前到達
tc.explain: 第7.10(f)段列出的客戶行為預警指標包括：客戶由他人陪同而該等人保持低調或只逗留在處所外，或客戶在被問及進一步詳情時顯得猶豫；客戶急於完成交易並承諾事後補交佐證資料；客戶對比較各經營者所提供的費用及／或匯率毫無興趣；多名客戶看似合力將一宗交易拆分為兩宗或以上低於門檻的交易以規避報告規定；以及客戶在該經營者查詢時未能合理說明交易目的或提供正當理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10段

en.q: What should the detection of a relevant red flag prompt an MSO to do?
options: Prompt further investigations and act as a catalyst towards making at least initial enquiries about the source of funds and requesting additional documentary support for CDD
File an STR immediately, without further enquiry
Terminate the business relationship without further consideration
Record the indicator and take no action unless a second indicator appears
en.explain: ¶7.10 closes by stating that the list is not exhaustive, that while each individual indicator may not be sufficient to establish an ML/TF/PF activity a combination of several situations may be indicative of a suspicious transaction, and that the detection of any relevant red flag should prompt further investigations and be a catalyst towards making at least initial enquiries about the source of funds and requesting additional documentary support for CDD.

tc.q: 偵測到相關預警指標時，金錢服務經營者應怎樣做？
options: 進行進一步調查，並以此為契機，最少就資金來源作初步查詢及索取額外的客戶盡職審查佐證文件
立即提交可疑交易報告而不作進一步查詢
不再作任何考慮即終止該業務關係
記錄該指標，除非出現第二項指標，否則不採取行動
tc.explain: 第7.10段最後訂明該清單並非詳盡無遺；雖然個別指標未必足以確立洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集活動，但多種情況同時出現則可能顯示交易屬可疑；而該經營者一旦偵測到任何相關預警指標，應進行進一步調查，並以此為契機，最少就資金來源作初步查詢及索取額外的客戶盡職審查佐證文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10段註腳61

en.q: Which additional sources of red flag indicators does the Guideline point MSOs to?
options: FATF guidance including 'Money Laundering through Money Remittance and Currency Exchange Providers' (June 2010) and 'Guidance for Financial Institutions in Detecting Terrorist Financing' (April 2002), and the APG's Yearly ML/TF Typologies Report
The JFIU's quarterly report only
The CCE's disciplinary decisions
The Basel Committee's cover payment paper
en.explain: Footnote 61 to ¶7.10 states that for more red flag indicators reference can be made to relevant guidance issued by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities from time to time, including 'Money Laundering through Money Remittance and Currency Exchange Providers' and 'Guidance for Financial Institutions in Detecting Terrorist Financing' issued by the FATF in June 2010 and April 2002 respectively, as well as the Yearly ML/TF Typologies Report issued by the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering.

tc.q: 本指引指引金錢服務經營者參考哪些額外的預警指標來源？
options: 財務行動特別組織的指引，包括2010年6月的《透過匯款及貨幣兌換服務供應商進行的洗錢活動》及2002年4月的《金融機構偵測恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以及亞太反洗錢組織的《年度洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集類型報告》
僅聯合財富情報組的季度報告
海關關長的紀律處分決定
巴塞爾委員會的補足付款文件
tc.explain: 第7.10段註腳61訂明如需更多可疑交易及活動的預警指標，可參考財務行動特別組織、政府間組織、各國政府及當局不時發出的相關指引，包括該組織分別於2010年6月及2002年4月發出的《透過匯款及貨幣兌換服務供應商進行的洗錢活動》及《金融機構偵測恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以及亞太反洗錢組織發表的《年度洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集類型報告》。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.11段

en.q: In the JFIU's SAFE approach, what does the third step, 'F', require?
options: Finding out the customer's records
Filing a report with the JFIU
Freezing the funds pending review
Forwarding the matter to senior management
en.explain: ¶7.11 states that an MSO may adopt, where applicable, the SAFE approach promoted by the JFIU, which includes screening the account for suspicious indicators; asking the customer appropriate questions; finding out the customer's records; and evaluating all the above information.

tc.q: 在聯合財富情報組的「SAFE」方針中，第三步「F」要求甚麼？
options: 查閱該客戶的紀錄
向聯合財富情報組提交報告
在檢視期間凍結有關資金
將事宜轉呈高級管理層
tc.explain: 第7.11段訂明該經營者可在適用情況下採用聯合財富情報組推廣的「SAFE」方針，包括：就可疑指標篩查帳戶；向客戶提出適當問題；查閱該客戶的紀錄；以及評估上述所有資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.12段

en.q: What two matters must an MSO's clear policies and procedures on internal reporting ensure?
options: That all staff are made aware of the identity of the MLRO and of the procedures to follow when making an internal report; and that all internal reports reach the MLRO without undue delay
That all staff are trained annually; and that all reports are made in writing
That all reports are approved by a supervisor; and that all reports are filed within 24 hours
That all staff sign a confidentiality undertaking; and that reports are anonymised
en.explain: ¶7.12 states that an MSO should establish and maintain clear policies and procedures to ensure that all staff are made aware of the identity of the MLRO and of the procedures to follow when making an internal report, and that all internal reports must reach the MLRO without undue delay.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者就內部報告的清晰政策及程序，須確保哪兩方面？
options: 所有員工均知悉洗錢事務主任的身分及作出內部報告時應遵循的程序；以及所有內部報告均毫不無理延誤地送達該主任
所有員工每年接受培訓；以及所有報告均以書面作出
所有報告均經主管批准；以及所有報告均於24小時內提交
所有員工簽署保密承諾；以及報告經匿名處理
tc.explain: 第7.12段訂明該經營者應建立及維持清晰的政策及程序，以確保：(a)所有員工均知悉洗錢事務主任的身分，以及作出內部報告時應遵循的程序；及(b)所有內部報告均須毫不無理延誤地送達該主任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.13段

en.q: May a supervisor or manager filter out a report raised by staff before it reaches the MLRO?
options: Under no circumstances, where that supervisor or manager has no responsibility for the money laundering reporting or compliance function
Yes, provided the supervisor documents the reasons
Yes, where the supervisor considers the suspicion unfounded
Yes, where the transaction is below the CDD threshold
en.explain: ¶7.13 states that while an MSO may wish to set up internal systems allowing staff to consult supervisors or managers before sending a report to the MLRO, under no circumstances should reports raised by staff be filtered out by supervisors or managers who have no responsibility for the money laundering reporting or compliance function.

tc.q: 主管或經理可否在員工提出的報告送達洗錢事務主任前將其篩走？
options: 在任何情況下均不可，如該主管或經理並不負責洗錢報告或合規職能
可以，只要該主管將理由記錄在案
可以，如該主管認為該項懷疑並無根據
可以，如該交易低於客戶盡職審查門檻
tc.explain: 第7.13段訂明，雖然該經營者可設立內部制度，容許員工在向洗錢事務主任提交報告前諮詢主管或經理，但在任何情況下，均不得由並不負責洗錢報告／合規職能的主管或經理將員工提出的報告篩走。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.13段

en.q: Why should internal reporting lines be as short as possible?
options: Because the legal obligation is to report as soon as it is reasonable to do so — short lines ensure speed, confidentiality and accessibility to the MLRO
Because shorter lines reduce administrative cost
Because the CCE prescribes a maximum number of reviewers
Because staff prefer to deal directly with senior management
en.explain: ¶7.13 states that the legal obligation is to report as soon as it is reasonable to do so, so reporting lines should be as short as possible with the minimum number of people between the staff with the suspicion and the MLRO, and that this ensures speed, confidentiality and accessibility to the MLRO.

tc.q: 內部報告的層級為何應盡可能簡短？
options: 因法律責任是在合理範圍內盡快報告——簡短的層級可確保迅速、保密及易於接觸洗錢事務主任
因較短的層級可減低行政成本
因海關關長訂明審核人數上限
因員工傾向直接與高級管理層接觸
tc.explain: 第7.13段訂明法律責任是在合理範圍內盡快報告，故報告層級應盡可能簡短，令產生懷疑的員工與洗錢事務主任之間的人數減至最少；此舉可確保迅速、保密及易於接觸該主任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.14段

en.q: When is a staff member's own statutory reporting obligation fully satisfied?
options: Once the staff member has reported the suspicion to the MLRO in accordance with the policies and procedures established by the MSO for making such reports
Only once the MLRO has filed an STR with the JFIU
Only once the JFIU has acknowledged receipt
Only once the customer relationship has been reviewed
en.explain: ¶7.14 states that once a staff member of an MSO has reported suspicion to the MLRO in accordance with the policies and procedures established by the MSO for the making of such reports, the statutory obligation of the staff has been fully satisfied. This reflects section 25A(4) of the DTROP and the OSCO and section 12(4) of the UNATMO.

tc.q: 員工本身的法定報告責任在何時方屬完全履行？
options: 員工按該經營者為作出該等報告而訂立的政策及程序，向洗錢事務主任報告該項懷疑之時
須待洗錢事務主任向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告後
須待聯合財富情報組確認收到報告後
須待該客戶關係已經檢視後
tc.explain: 第7.14段訂明，該經營者的員工一旦按該經營者為作出該等報告而訂立的政策及程序，向洗錢事務主任報告懷疑，該員工的法定責任即已完全履行。此反映《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(4)條及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(4)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.15段

en.q: What should an internal report contain?
options: Sufficient details of the customer concerned and the information giving rise to the suspicion
The reporting staff member's assessment of whether an STR should be filed
A copy of every document held on the customer's file
The customer's explanation of the transaction, obtained beforehand
en.explain: ¶7.15 states that the internal report should include sufficient details of the customer concerned and the information giving rise to the suspicion. Evaluating that information and deciding whether to report to the JFIU is the MLRO's function under ¶7.9 and ¶7.17.

tc.q: 內部報告應載有甚麼？
options: 有關客戶的充分詳情，以及引致該項懷疑的資料
作出報告的員工就是否應提交可疑交易報告的評估
該客戶檔案內每份文件的副本
事先取得的該客戶就該宗交易的解釋
tc.explain: 第7.15段訂明內部報告應載有有關客戶的充分詳情，以及引致該項懷疑的資料。評估該等資料並決定是否向聯合財富情報組報告，屬第7.9及7.17段所訂洗錢事務主任的職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.16段

en.q: What two things should the MLRO do upon receiving an internal report?
options: Acknowledge receipt of the internal report, and provide the reporting staff with a reminder of the obligation regarding tipping off
Acknowledge receipt, and inform the reporting staff of the outcome of the JFIU's assessment
Notify the customer, and suspend the account
Notify senior management, and refer the matter to the auditors
en.explain: ¶7.16 states that the MLRO should acknowledge receipt of an internal report and provide a reminder of the obligation regarding tipping off to the reporting staff upon internal reporting.

tc.q: 洗錢事務主任在收到內部報告時應作哪兩件事？
options: 確認收到該內部報告，並向作出報告的員工提醒有關通風報信的責任
確認收到報告，並將聯合財富情報組的評估結果告知該員工
通知該客戶，並暫停該帳戶
通知高級管理層，並將事宜轉介審計師
tc.explain: 第7.16段訂明洗錢事務主任應在收到內部報告時確認收到該報告，並向作出報告的員工提醒有關通風報信的責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.17段

en.q: What must the MLRO consider when evaluating an internal report?
options: All relevant information, including CDD and ongoing monitoring information available within or to the MSO concerning the entities to which the report relates
Only the information contained in the internal report itself
Only the transaction that triggered the report
Only information that the reporting staff member can verify
en.explain: ¶7.17 states that when evaluating an internal report the MLRO must take reasonable steps to consider all relevant information, including CDD and ongoing monitoring information available within or to the MSO concerning the entities to which the report relates.

tc.q: 洗錢事務主任在評估內部報告時，須考慮甚麼？
options: 所有相關資料，包括該經營者內部或可取得的、有關該報告所涉實體的客戶盡職審查及持續監察資料
只需該內部報告本身所載的資料
只需觸發該報告的該宗交易
只需作出報告的員工能核實的資料
tc.explain: 第7.17段訂明洗錢事務主任在評估內部報告時，須採取合理步驟考慮所有相關資料，包括該經營者內部或可取得的、有關該報告所涉實體的客戶盡職審查及持續監察資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.17(a)段

en.q: Which approach should the MLRO preferably adopt when reviewing transaction patterns and volumes through connected accounts?
options: A relationship-based approach rather than a transaction-by-transaction basis
A transaction-by-transaction basis, to ensure each is assessed individually
An account-by-account basis, without aggregation
A branch-by-branch basis
en.explain: ¶7.17(a) states that the MLRO's evaluation may include making a review of other transaction patterns and volumes through connected accounts, preferably adopting a relationship-based approach rather than on a transaction-by-transaction basis — the same preference expressed for transaction monitoring systems in ¶5.6.

tc.q: 洗錢事務主任在檢視相連帳戶的交易模式及交易量時，宜採用哪種方式？
options: 以關係為本的方式，而非按逐宗交易的方式
按逐宗交易的方式，以確保每宗獲個別評估
按逐個帳戶的方式，不作匯總
按逐間分行的方式
tc.explain: 第7.17(a)款訂明洗錢事務主任的評估可包括檢視經相連帳戶進行的其他交易模式及交易量，並宜採用以關係為本的方式，而非按逐宗交易的方式——與第5.6段就交易監察系統所表達的取向一致。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.17(b)段

en.q: Which historical matters should the MLRO refer to when evaluating an internal report?
options: Any previous patterns of instructions, the length of the business relationship, and CDD and ongoing monitoring information and documentation
The customer's credit history and payment record
The MSO's previous STRs concerning other customers
The customer's dealings with other money service operators
en.explain: ¶7.17(b) states that the MLRO's evaluation may include making reference to any previous patterns of instructions, the length of the business relationship, and CDD and ongoing monitoring information and documentation.

tc.q: 洗錢事務主任在評估內部報告時，應參考哪些過往事項？
options: 過往任何指示模式、該業務關係的長短，以及客戶盡職審查及持續監察的資料及文件
該客戶的信貸歷史及還款紀錄
該經營者過往就其他客戶提交的可疑交易報告
該客戶與其他金錢服務經營者的往來
tc.explain: 第7.17(b)款訂明洗錢事務主任的評估可包括參考過往任何指示模式、該業務關係的長短，以及客戶盡職審查及持續監察的資料及文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.18段

en.q: What balance must an MSO strike when searching for information concerning connected accounts or relationships?
options: A balance between the statutory requirement to make a timely STR to the JFIU and any delays that might arise in searching for more relevant information
A balance between the cost of the search and its likely benefit
A balance between the customer's privacy and the MSO's commercial interests
A balance between the MLRO's workload and the volume of reports
en.explain: ¶7.18 states that the need to search for information concerning connected accounts or relationships should strike an appropriate balance between the statutory requirement to make a timely STR to the JFIU and any delays that might arise in searching for more relevant information concerning connected accounts or relationships.

tc.q: 在搜尋有關相連帳戶或關係的資料時，金錢服務經營者須在甚麼之間取得平衡？
options: 適時向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告的法定規定，與搜尋更多相關資料可能引致的延誤之間
搜尋成本與其可能效益之間
客戶私隱與該經營者商業利益之間
洗錢事務主任的工作量與報告數量之間
tc.explain: 第7.18段訂明搜尋有關相連帳戶或關係的資料的需要，應在適時向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告的法定規定，與搜尋有關相連帳戶或關係的更多相關資料可能引致的延誤之間，取得適當平衡。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.18段

en.q: What must be documented in relation to the MLRO's evaluation of an internal report?
options: The review process, together with any conclusions drawn
Only the decision whether or not to file an STR
Only the identity of the staff who conducted the review
Only those reviews that resulted in an STR
