en.explain: ¶7.18 states that the review process should be documented, together with any conclusions drawn. ¶7.21 reinforces the point in relation to a decision not to file, where records of the deliberations and actions taken are vital to demonstrate that the MLRO acted reasonably.

tc.q: 就洗錢事務主任對內部報告的評估，須記錄甚麼？
options: 檢視過程，連同所得的任何結論
只需是否提交可疑交易報告的決定
只需進行檢視的員工身分
只需最終導致提交報告的檢視
tc.explain: 第7.18段訂明檢視過程應連同所得的任何結論一併記錄在案。第7.21段就決定不作報告的情況進一步強調此點：保存商議及所採取行動的紀錄，對證明該主任行事合理至為重要。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.19段

en.q: When may an STR be made in relation to the timing of the underlying transaction?
options: Either before a suspicious transaction or activity occurs — whether the intended transaction ultimately takes place or not — or after it has been completed
Only after the transaction has been completed
Only before the transaction is executed
Only where the transaction has been declined
en.explain: ¶7.19 states that if after completing the review of the internal report an MLRO decides there are grounds for knowledge or suspicion, he should disclose the information to the JFIU as soon as it is reasonable to do so after his evaluation is complete, together with the information on which that knowledge or suspicion is based; and that dependent on when knowledge or suspicion arises, an STR may be made either before a suspicious transaction or activity occurs (whether the intended transaction ultimately takes place or not), or after it has been completed.

tc.q: 就相關交易的時序而言，可疑交易報告可在何時作出？
options: 可在可疑交易或活動發生前作出（不論該擬進行的交易最終有否進行），或在其完成後作出
只可在該交易完成後作出
只可在該交易執行前作出
只可在該交易已被拒絕的情況下作出
tc.explain: 第7.19段訂明，如洗錢事務主任在完成檢視內部報告後認為有知悉或懷疑的理由，應在其評估完成後在合理範圍內盡快向聯合財富情報組披露該等資料，連同構成該項知悉或懷疑的基礎的資料；視乎知悉或懷疑產生的時間，可疑交易報告可在可疑交易或活動發生前作出（不論該擬進行的交易最終有否進行），或在交易或活動完成後作出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.20段

en.q: What should an MSO that controls both the ordering and the beneficiary sides of a suspicious wire transfer do?
options: File an STR in any jurisdiction affected by the suspicious wire transfer, and make relevant transaction information available to the Financial Intelligence Unit
File an STR in Hong Kong only, as the home jurisdiction
File an STR only in the jurisdiction of the beneficiary institution
Refer the matter to the correspondent bank for reporting
en.explain: ¶7.20 states that in the case of an MSO that controls both the ordering and the beneficiary sides of a wire transfer, the MSO should also file an STR in any jurisdiction affected by the suspicious wire transfer, and make relevant transaction information available to the Financial Intelligence Unit.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者同時控制可疑電匯的匯款方及收款方，應怎樣做？
options: 在受該可疑電匯影響的任何司法管轄區提交可疑交易報告，並向財富情報機構提供相關交易資料
只在香港（即本地司法管轄區）提交報告
只在收款機構所在司法管轄區提交報告
將事宜交由代理銀行代為報告
tc.explain: 第7.20段訂明，如某金錢服務經營者同時控制電匯的匯款方及收款方，該經營者亦應在受該可疑電匯影響的任何司法管轄區提交可疑交易報告，並向財富情報機構提供相關交易資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.21段

en.q: What is the position on criminal liability where an MLRO decides in good faith not to file an STR?
options: It is unlikely that there will be any criminal liability for failing to report if the MLRO concludes there is no suspicion after taking into account all available information
Criminal liability attaches automatically to any decision not to report
Liability depends solely on whether the customer is later prosecuted
The MLRO must obtain the CCE's confirmation before deciding not to report
en.explain: ¶7.21 states that providing an MLRO acts in good faith in deciding not to file an STR with the JFIU, it is unlikely that there will be any criminal liability for failing to report if the MLRO concludes that there is no suspicion after taking into account all available information.

tc.q: 如洗錢事務主任真誠地決定不提交可疑交易報告，刑事責任的情況如何？
options: 如該主任在考慮所有可得資料後認為並無懷疑，則相當可能不會因未有報告而負上任何刑事責任
任何不作報告的決定均自動負上刑事責任
責任僅取決於該客戶其後有否被檢控
該主任決定不作報告前須取得海關關長確認
tc.explain: 第7.21段訂明，只要洗錢事務主任真誠地作出不向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告的決定，且在考慮所有可得資料後認為並無懷疑，則相當可能不會因未有報告而負上任何刑事責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.21段

en.q: Why is it vital for the MLRO to keep proper records of deliberations and actions taken?
options: To demonstrate that he has acted in a reasonable manner
To satisfy the record-keeping requirement in section 13 of Schedule 2
To provide evidence for the customer if the account is later closed
To support an application to the JFIU for consent
en.explain: ¶7.21 states that it is vital for the MLRO to keep proper records of the deliberations and actions taken to demonstrate that he has acted in a reasonable manner — the evidential basis on which the good-faith position in the same paragraph rests.

tc.q: 洗錢事務主任為何必須妥為保存商議及所採取行動的紀錄？
options: 以證明其行事合理
以符合附表2第13條的備存紀錄規定
以便在帳戶其後被關閉時為該客戶提供證據
以支持向聯合財富情報組申請同意
tc.explain: 第7.21段訂明洗錢事務主任必須妥為保存商議及所採取行動的紀錄，以證明其行事合理——這正是同段所述真誠行事立場的證據基礎。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.22段

en.q: Which circumstances does the Guideline give as examples of when urgent reporting is required?
options: Where a customer has instructed the MSO to move funds or other property, close the account, make cash available for collection, or carry out significant changes to the business relationship
Where the transaction exceeds $120,000
Where the customer is a non-Hong Kong PEP
Where the customer has complained about the MSO's service
en.explain: ¶7.22 states that in the event that urgent reporting is required — for example where a customer has instructed the MSO to move funds or other property, close the account, make cash available for collection, or carry out significant changes to the business relationship — particularly when the account is part of an ongoing investigation by a law enforcement agency, an MSO should indicate this in the STR.

tc.q: 本指引就何時需要緊急報告，舉出哪些情況為例？
options: 客戶指示該經營者轉移資金或其他財產、關閉帳戶、備妥現金以供提取，或對業務關係作出重大改動
交易超過120,000元
該客戶是非香港政治人物
該客戶就該經營者的服務作出投訴
tc.explain: 第7.22段訂明，如需要緊急報告（例如客戶指示該經營者轉移資金或其他財產、關閉帳戶、備妥現金以供提取，或對業務關係作出重大改動等），尤其當該帳戶屬執法機關正在進行的調查的一部分時，該經營者應在可疑交易報告中註明此點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.22段

en.q: What should be considered where exceptional circumstances exist in relation to an urgent report?
options: An initial notification by telephone to the JFIU
Delivery of the report to the JFIU by hand
Notification of the CCE in the first instance
Suspension of the customer's account pending a written report
en.explain: ¶7.22 states that where exceptional circumstances exist in relation to an urgent reporting, an initial notification by telephone to the JFIU should be considered — in addition to indicating the urgency in the STR itself.

tc.q: 如緊急報告涉及特殊情況，應考慮甚麼？
options: 先以電話向聯合財富情報組作初步通知
將報告親自遞交聯合財富情報組
先行通知海關關長
在書面報告提交前暫停該客戶的帳戶
tc.explain: 第7.22段訂明如緊急報告涉及特殊情況，應考慮先以電話向聯合財富情報組作初步通知——此外仍須在可疑交易報告本身註明其緊急性。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.23段

en.q: What is an MSO recommended to indicate in its initial STR to the JFIU?
options: Any intention to terminate the business relationship
The date on which the account will next be reviewed
The identity of the staff member who raised the internal report
The amount of any fees earned from the customer
en.explain: ¶7.23 states that an MSO is recommended to indicate any intention to terminate a business relationship in its initial STR to the JFIU.

tc.q: 本指引建議金錢服務經營者在其初次向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告中註明甚麼？
options: 終止該業務關係的任何意向
該帳戶下次檢視的日期
提出內部報告的員工身分
從該客戶所賺取的費用金額
tc.explain: 第7.23段訂明建議該經營者在其初次向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告中，註明終止業務關係的任何意向。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.24段註腳65

en.q: What does the JFIU's quarterly report consist of, and how may an MSO obtain access?
options: Analysis of STRs, and matters of interest and feedback; it is available in a secure area of the JFIU's website, for which MSOs can apply for a login name and password
Statistics on prosecutions, and a list of designated persons; it is published in the Gazette
A summary of court decisions, and sanctions updates; it is circulated by the CCE
Typologies from the FATF, and enforcement news; it is sent to MSOs by post
en.explain: Footnote 65 to ¶7.24 states that the purpose of the quarterly report, relevant to all financial sectors, is to raise AML/CFT awareness; that it consists of two parts, analysis of STRs and matters of interest and feedback; and that it is available at a secure area of the JFIU's website, with MSOs able to apply for a login name and password by completing the registration form on the website or contacting the JFIU directly.

tc.q: 聯合財富情報組的季度報告包含甚麼？金錢服務經營者可如何取得？
options: 可疑交易報告分析，以及值得關注的事項及回饋；載於該組網站的保安區，經營者可申請登入名稱及密碼
檢控統計數字及指定人士名單；於憲報刊登
法院判決摘要及制裁更新；由海關關長傳閱
財務行動特別組織的類型分析及執法消息；以郵遞方式寄予經營者
tc.explain: 第7.24段註腳65訂明該季度報告與所有金融界別相關，旨在提高打擊洗錢的意識；報告分為兩部分，即(i)可疑交易報告分析及(ii)值得關注的事項及回饋；報告載於聯合財富情報組網站的保安區，金錢服務經營者可填妥該網站的登記表格或直接聯絡該組，申請登入名稱及密碼。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.24段

en.q: Whose feedback and guidance should an MSO take into account to ensure STRs are of high quality?
options: The JFIU, in its quarterly report, and the CCE from time to time
The FATF and the APG
Its external auditors and legal advisers
Its correspondent banks
en.explain: ¶7.24 states that an MSO should ensure STRs filed to the JFIU are of high quality, taking into account feedback and guidance provided by the JFIU in its quarterly report and the CCE from time to time.

tc.q: 為確保可疑交易報告質素良好，金錢服務經營者應顧及何人的回饋及指引？
options: 聯合財富情報組於其季度報告所提供者，以及海關關長不時提供者
財務行動特別組織及亞太反洗錢組織
其外聘審計師及法律顧問
其代理銀行
tc.explain: 第7.24段訂明該經營者應顧及聯合財富情報組於其季度報告，以及海關關長不時提供的回饋及指引，確保向該組提交的可疑交易報告質素良好。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.25段

en.q: When will the JFIU usually give consent for an MSO to operate the account after an STR?
options: Where there is no need for imminent action, such as the issue of a restraint order on the account
In every case, as a matter of course
Only after the investigation has been concluded
Only where the MSO applies for consent in writing
en.explain: ¶7.25 states that the JFIU will acknowledge receipt of an STR made under section 25A of both the DTROP and the OSCO and section 12 of the UNATMO, and that if there is no need for imminent action — for example the issue of a restraint order on an account — consent will usually be given for the MSO to operate the account under section 25A(2)(a) of the DTROP and the OSCO and section 12(2B)(a) of the UNATMO; otherwise the MSO should take appropriate action and seek legal advice where necessary.

tc.q: 在提交可疑交易報告後，聯合財富情報組通常在甚麼情況下同意該經營者操作有關帳戶？
options: 在無需即時採取行動（例如就該帳戶發出限制令）的情況下
在所有情況下均會例行同意
須待調查完結後
須待該經營者以書面申請同意
tc.explain: 第7.25段訂明聯合財富情報組會確認收到根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A條及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12條提交的可疑交易報告；如無需即時採取行動（例如就帳戶發出限制令），該組通常會根據該兩條例第25A(2)(a)條及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(2B)(a)條，同意該經營者操作有關帳戶；否則該經營者應採取適當行動，並在有需要時尋求法律意見。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.25段

en.q: On what conditions does filing an STR provide a statutory defence to the offence of ML/TF in respect of the acts disclosed?
options: Either the report is made before the acts are undertaken and they are undertaken with the JFIU's consent; or the report is made after the acts, on the MSO's own initiative and as soon as it is reasonable for the MSO to do so
The report is made at any time before the MSO is charged
The report is made within 30 days of the transaction
The report is made and the customer's account is closed
en.explain: ¶7.25 states that filing an STR to the JFIU provides an MSO with a statutory defence to the offence of ML/TF in respect of the acts disclosed in the report, provided the report is made before the MSO undertakes the disclosed acts and the transactions are undertaken with the consent of the JFIU; or the report is made after the MSO has performed the disclosed acts and the report is made on the MSO's own initiative and as soon as it is reasonable for the MSO to do so.

tc.q: 就報告所披露的作為，提交可疑交易報告在甚麼條件下可提供洗錢罪行的法定免責辯護？
options: 報告在該經營者作出所披露作為之前提交，且該等作為經聯合財富情報組同意而作出；或報告在該經營者作出該等作為之後，由該經營者主動並在合理範圍內盡快提交
在該經營者被落案控告前任何時間提交報告
於交易後30日內提交報告
提交報告並關閉該客戶的帳戶
tc.explain: 第7.25段訂明向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，可就報告所披露的作為為該經營者提供洗錢罪行的法定免責辯護，惟須符合：(a)報告在該經營者作出所披露作為之前提交，且該等作為（交易）經該組同意而作出；或(b)報告在該經營者作出所披露作為之後提交，且該報告由該經營者主動並在合理範圍內盡快作出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.26段

en.q: What does the statutory defence in ¶7.25 NOT do?
options: It does not absolve an MSO from the legal, reputational or regulatory risks associated with the account's continued operation
It does not apply to reports made before a transaction
It does not apply where the JFIU has given consent
It does not apply to terrorist financing offences
en.explain: ¶7.26 states that the statutory defence stated in ¶7.25 does not absolve an MSO from the legal, reputational or regulatory risks associated with the account's continued operation.

tc.q: 第7.25段所述的法定免責辯護不能達到甚麼效果？
options: 不能免除該經營者因繼續操作該帳戶而承受的法律、聲譽或監管風險
不適用於在交易前作出的報告
不適用於聯合財富情報組已給予同意的情況
不適用於恐怖分子資金籌集罪行
tc.explain: 第7.26段訂明第7.25段所述的法定免責辯護，並不能免除該經營者因繼續操作該帳戶而承受的法律、聲譽或監管風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.26段

en.q: How should a 'consent' response from the JFIU to a pre-transaction report be understood?
options: It should not be construed as a clean bill of health for the continued operation of the account, or as an indication that the account does not pose a risk to the MSO
It confirms that the account carries no ML/TF risk
It removes the need for any further review of the relationship
It obliges the MSO to continue the relationship
en.explain: ¶7.26 states that an MSO should be aware that a 'consent' response from the JFIU to a pre-transaction report should not be construed as a 'clean bill of health' for the continued operation of the account or an indication that the account does not pose a risk to the MSO.

tc.q: 聯合財富情報組就交易前報告作出的「同意」回應，應如何理解？
options: 不應理解為繼續操作該帳戶的「無風險證明」，亦不表示該帳戶對該經營者不構成風險
確認該帳戶並無洗錢風險
免除對該業務關係作進一步檢視的需要
令該經營者有責任繼續該業務關係
tc.explain: 第7.26段訂明該經營者應知悉，聯合財富情報組就交易前報告作出的「同意」回應，不應理解為繼續操作該帳戶的「無風險證明」，亦不表示該帳戶對該經營者不構成風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.27段

en.q: What review should an MSO conduct upon filing an STR, and does it depend on the JFIU's response?
options: An appropriate review of the business relationship, irrespective of any subsequent feedback provided by the JFIU, applying appropriate risk mitigating measures
A review only if the JFIU withholds consent
A review only at the next scheduled periodic review date
No review, since the matter is now with the JFIU
en.explain: ¶7.27 states that an MSO should conduct an appropriate review of a business relationship upon the filing of an STR to the JFIU, irrespective of any subsequent feedback provided by the JFIU, and apply appropriate risk mitigating measures.

tc.q: 提交可疑交易報告後，金錢服務經營者應進行甚麼檢視？該檢視是否取決於聯合財富情報組的回應？
options: 應對該業務關係進行適當檢視，不論該組其後有否提供回饋，並採取適當的風險緩減措施
只在該組不給予同意時方作檢視
只在下次定期檢視日期方作檢視
無須檢視，因事宜已交由該組處理
tc.explain: 第7.27段訂明該經營者應在向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告後，對該業務關係進行適當檢視，不論該組其後有否提供任何回饋，並採取適當的風險緩減措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.27段

en.q: What practice does ¶7.27 expressly state is not acceptable?
options: Filing a report with the JFIU and continuing to operate the relationship without any further consideration of the risks and the imposition of appropriate controls to mitigate the risks identified
Terminating the relationship immediately after filing an STR
Escalating the matter to senior management
Filing further STRs about the same customer
en.explain: ¶7.27 states that filing a report with the JFIU and continuing to operate the relationship without any further consideration of the risks and the imposition of appropriate controls to mitigate the risks identified is not acceptable, and that if necessary the issue should be escalated to the MSO's senior management.

tc.q: 第7.27段明文指出哪一種做法並不可接受？
options: 向聯合財富情報組提交報告後繼續經營該業務關係，卻不再進一步考慮有關風險，亦不施加適當管控以減低所識別的風險
在提交可疑交易報告後立即終止該業務關係
將事宜呈報高級管理層
就同一客戶提交進一步的可疑交易報告
tc.explain: 第7.27段訂明，向聯合財富情報組提交報告後繼續經營該業務關係，卻不再進一步考慮有關風險，亦不施加適當管控以減低所識別的風險，此做法並不可接受；如有需要，應將事宜呈報該經營者的高級管理層。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.27段

en.q: On what basis should senior management determine how to handle a relationship escalated to it after an STR?
options: In line with the MSO's business objectives and its capacity to mitigate the risks identified, so as to mitigate any potential legal or reputational risks posed by the relationship
Solely on the profitability of the relationship
Solely on the JFIU's consent decision
Solely on the length of the business relationship
en.explain: ¶7.27 states that if necessary the issue should be escalated to the MSO's senior management to determine how to handle the relationship concerned to mitigate any potential legal or reputational risks posed by the relationship, in line with the MSO's business objectives and its capacity to mitigate the risks identified.

tc.q: 就提交可疑交易報告後呈報上來的業務關係，高級管理層應按甚麼基礎決定如何處理？
options: 按該經營者的業務目標及其減低所識別風險的能力，以減低該關係可能構成的法律或聲譽風險
僅按該業務關係的盈利能力
僅按聯合財富情報組的同意決定
僅按該業務關係的長短
tc.explain: 第7.27段訂明如有需要，應將事宜呈報該經營者的高級管理層，按該經營者的業務目標及其減低所識別風險的能力，決定如何處理有關業務關係，以減低該關係可能構成的任何法律或聲譽風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.28段

en.q: Does reporting a suspicion about one transaction remove the need to report further suspicions about the same customer?
options: No — further suspicious transactions or events, whether of the same nature as the previous suspicion or different, must continue to be reported to the MLRO, who should make further reports to the JFIU if appropriate
Yes — one STR per customer is sufficient
Yes — unless the further transactions are of a different nature
No — but further reports go directly to the JFIU without the MLRO
en.explain: ¶7.28 states that an MSO should be aware that the reporting of a suspicion in respect of a transaction or event does not remove the need to report further suspicious transactions or events in respect of the same customer, and that further suspicious transactions or events, whether of the same nature or different to the previous suspicion, must continue to be reported to the MLRO who should make further reports to the JFIU if appropriate.

tc.q: 就某宗交易報告懷疑後，是否仍須就同一客戶的進一步懷疑作出報告？
options: 仍須——不論進一步的可疑交易或事件與先前的懷疑性質相同或不同，均須繼續向洗錢事務主任報告；該主任並應在適當時向聯合財富情報組作進一步報告
無須——每名客戶提交一份可疑交易報告已足夠
無須——除非進一步的交易性質不同
仍須——但進一步的報告可越過洗錢事務主任直接提交該組
tc.explain: 第7.28段訂明該經營者應知悉，就某宗交易或事件報告懷疑，並不免除就同一客戶報告進一步可疑交易或事件的需要；不論進一步的可疑交易或事件與先前的懷疑性質相同或不同，均須繼續向洗錢事務主任報告，該主任並應在適當時向聯合財富情報組作進一步報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.29段

en.q: What should the record of ML/TF reports made to the MLRO include?
options: The date the report was made, the staff members subsequently handling the report, the results of the assessment, whether the internal report resulted in an STR to the JFIU, and information to allow the relevant papers to be located
Only those internal reports that resulted in an STR
Only the date and the name of the reporting staff member
Only the customer's name and account number
en.explain: ¶7.29 states that an MSO must establish and maintain a record of all ML/TF reports made to the MLRO, and that the record should include details of the date the report was made, the staff members subsequently handling the report, the results of the assessment, whether the internal report resulted in an STR to the JFIU, and information to allow the papers relevant to the report to be located.

tc.q: 向洗錢事務主任作出的洗錢報告紀錄應載有甚麼？
options: 作出報告的日期、其後處理該報告的員工、評估結果、該內部報告有否導致向聯合財富情報組提交報告，以及可據以找出相關文件的資料
只需最終導致提交可疑交易報告的內部報告
只需日期及作出報告的員工姓名
只需該客戶的姓名及帳戶號碼
tc.explain: 第7.29段訂明該經營者須建立及維持所有向洗錢事務主任作出的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集報告的紀錄；該紀錄應載有作出報告的日期、其後處理該報告的員工、評估結果、該內部報告有否導致向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，以及可據以找出與該報告有關文件的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.30段

en.q: What should the register of STRs made to the JFIU include, and may it be combined with the internal report register?
options: The date of the STR, the person who made it, and information to allow the relevant papers to be located; and the register may be combined with the register of internal reports if considered appropriate
The date and the customer's name only; and the two registers must be kept separate
The full text of each STR; and the two registers must be kept separate
The JFIU's reference number only; and the registers must be combined
en.explain: ¶7.30 states that an MSO must establish and maintain a record of all STRs made to the JFIU, that the record should include details of the date of the STR, the person who made the STR, and information to allow the papers relevant to the STR to be located, and that this register may be combined with the register of internal reports if considered appropriate.

tc.q: 向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告登記冊應載有甚麼？可否與內部報告登記冊合併？
options: 提交報告的日期、提交報告的人，以及可據以找出相關文件的資料；如認為適當，該登記冊可與內部報告登記冊合併
只需日期及客戶姓名；兩份登記冊須分開保存
每份報告的全文；兩份登記冊須分開保存
只需該組的檔案編號；兩份登記冊須合併
tc.explain: 第7.30段訂明該經營者須建立及維持所有向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告的紀錄；該紀錄應載有提交報告的日期、提交報告的人，以及可據以找出與該報告有關文件的資料；如認為適當，該登記冊可與內部報告登記冊合併。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.31段

en.q: Which court documents may an MSO be served with by law enforcement agencies?
options: Search warrants, production orders, restraint orders or confiscation orders
Injunctions and winding-up petitions
Summonses and subpoenas only
Licence suspension notices issued by the CCE
en.explain: ¶7.31 states that an MSO may be served with various court documents from law enforcement agencies — for example search warrants, production orders, restraint orders or confiscation orders — pursuant to relevant legislation in Hong Kong, and that these documents are crucial to aid law enforcement agencies to carry out investigations as well as restrain and confiscate illicit proceeds.

tc.q: 執法機關可向金錢服務經營者送達哪些法庭文件？
options: 搜查令、交出物料令、限制令或充公令
禁制令及清盤呈請
僅傳票及證人傳票
海關關長發出的暫時吊銷牌照通知
tc.explain: 第7.31段訂明該經營者可能會依據香港的相關法例，獲執法機關送達各類法庭文件，例如搜查令、交出物料令、限制令或充公令；該等文件對協助執法機關進行調查，以及限制及充公非法得益至為重要。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.31段

en.q: What should an MSO's policies and procedures for handling court documents include?
options: Provision of accurate information, allocation of sufficient resources, and appointing a staff member as the main point of contact with law enforcement agencies
Referral of every document to external legal counsel
Notification of the customer concerned before responding
Notification of the CCE before responding
en.explain: ¶7.31 states that an MSO should establish clear policies and procedures to handle court documents in an effective and timely manner, including provision of accurate information, allocation of sufficient resources and appointing a staff as the main point of contact with law enforcement agencies.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者處理法庭文件的政策及程序應包括甚麼？
options: 提供準確資料、調配足夠資源，以及委派一名員工作為與執法機關的主要聯絡點
將每份文件轉交外聘法律顧問
在回覆前通知有關客戶
在回覆前通知海關關長
tc.explain: 第7.31段訂明該經營者應建立清晰的政策及程序，以有效及適時地處理該等法庭文件，包括提供準確資料、調配足夠資源，以及委派一名員工作為與執法機關的主要聯絡點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.32段

en.q: How must an MSO respond to a search warrant or production order, and what should it do if it cannot meet the timeframe?
options: Respond within the required time limit by providing all information or material falling within the scope of the document; and where it encounters difficulty, contact the officer-in-charge of the investigation at the earliest opportunity for further guidance
Respond only to the extent it considers relevant; and apply to the court for an extension
Respond within 30 days in every case; and notify the CCE of any delay
Respond only after obtaining legal advice; and inform the customer of the request
en.explain: ¶7.32 states that an MSO must respond to any search warrant and production order within the required time limit by providing all the information or material that fall within the scope of the court document, and that where an MSO encounters difficulty in complying with the timeframes stipulated it should at the earliest opportunity contact the officer-in-charge of the investigation for further guidance.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須如何回應搜查令或交出物料令？如未能符合時限應怎樣做？
options: 須在所需時限內提供屬該法庭文件範圍內的所有資料或物料；如遇困難，應盡早聯絡負責該調查的主管人員以取得進一步指引
只須就其認為相關的部分回應；並向法院申請延期
在任何情況下均須於30日內回應；並將任何延誤通知海關關長
須先取得法律意見方回應；並將該要求告知該客戶
tc.explain: 第7.32段訂明該經營者須在所需時限內回應任何搜查令及交出物料令，提供屬該法庭文件範圍內的所有資料或物料；如該經營者在遵守所訂時限方面遇到困難，應盡早聯絡負責該調查的主管人員以取得進一步指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.33段

en.q: What does a restraint order do, and what must an MSO ensure?
options: It prohibits dealing with particular funds or property pending the outcome of an investigation; the MSO must ensure it is able to withhold the relevant property that is the subject of the order
It confiscates the property permanently; the MSO must transfer it to the court
It closes the customer's account; the MSO must return any balance to the customer
It requires the MSO to report all future transactions; the MSO must notify the JFIU monthly
en.explain: ¶7.33 states that during a law-enforcement investigation an MSO may be served with a restraint order, which prohibits the dealing with particular funds or property pending the outcome of an investigation, and that the MSO must ensure that it is able to withhold the relevant property that is the subject of the order.

tc.q: 限制令有何作用？金錢服務經營者須確保甚麼？
options: 禁止在調查有結果前處理某些資金或財產；該經營者須確保其能扣起該命令所針對的有關財產
永久充公該財產；該經營者須將其轉交法院
關閉該客戶的帳戶；該經營者須將餘額退回客戶
要求該經營者報告日後所有交易；該經營者須每月通知聯合財富情報組
tc.explain: 第7.33段訂明在執法調查期間，該經營者可能獲送達限制令，禁止在調查有結果前處理某些資金或財產；該經營者須確保其能扣起該命令所針對的有關財產。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.33段

en.q: Does a restraint order necessarily apply to all funds or property in a business relationship?
options: No — the order may not apply to all funds or property involved within a particular business relationship, and the MSO should consider what, if any, funds or property may be utilised subject to the law of Hong Kong
Yes — the whole relationship is frozen automatically
Yes — unless the customer applies to the court
No — the MSO decides for itself which funds to restrain
en.explain: ¶7.33 states that it should be noted that the restraint order may not apply to all funds or property involved within a particular business relationship, and that the MSO should consider what, if any, funds or property may be utilised subject to the law of Hong Kong.

tc.q: 限制令是否必然適用於某業務關係中的所有資金或財產？
options: 否——該命令未必適用於某特定業務關係中的所有資金或財產；該經營者應在符合香港法律的前提下，考慮哪些（如有）資金或財產仍可動用
是——整段業務關係會自動被凍結
是——除非該客戶向法院提出申請
否——由該經營者自行決定限制哪些資金
tc.explain: 第7.33段訂明應注意該限制令未必適用於某特定業務關係中的所有資金或財產；該經營者應在符合香港法律的前提下，考慮哪些（如有）資金或財產仍可動用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.34段

en.q: When may an MSO be served with a confiscation order, and what may a court order in respect of terrorist property?
options: Upon the conviction of a defendant, where the MSO holds funds or other property belonging to that defendant deemed by the court to represent their benefit from the crime; and a court may also order the forfeiture of property where satisfied that it is terrorist property
Before charges are laid, where the MSO suspects the funds are criminal proceeds; and a court may order a permanent freeze
Upon the filing of an STR; and a court may order the account closed
Upon the CCE's direction; and a court may order the funds paid to the Government
en.explain: ¶7.34 states that upon the conviction of a defendant a court may order the confiscation of his criminal proceeds, and an MSO may be served with a confiscation order in the event that it holds funds or other property belonging to that defendant that are deemed by the court to represent his benefit from the crime; and that a court may also order the forfeiture of property where it is satisfied that the property is terrorist property.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者可在何時獲送達充公令？法院就恐怖分子財產可作出甚麼命令？
options: 在被告人被定罪後，如該經營者持有屬該被告人所有、並經法院裁定代表其從犯罪所得利益的資金或其他財產；法院亦可在信納某財產屬恐怖分子財產時，命令沒收該財產
在落案控告前，如該經營者懷疑該等資金屬犯罪得益；法院可命令永久凍結
在提交可疑交易報告後；法院可命令關閉該帳戶
在海關關長指示後；法院可命令將款項繳交政府
tc.explain: 第7.34段訂明在被告人被定罪後，法院可命令充公其犯罪得益；如該經營者持有屬該被告人所有、並經法院裁定代表其從犯罪所得利益的資金或其他財產，可能會獲送達充公令。法院亦可在信納某財產屬恐怖分子財產時，命令沒收該財產。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.35段

en.q: What should an MSO do when served with a court document or a crime-related intelligence request relating to a particular customer?
options: Timely assess the risks involved and the need to conduct an appropriate review of the customer or business relationship to determine whether there is any suspicion
Terminate the business relationship immediately
File an STR automatically in every case
Await the outcome of the investigation before taking any step
en.explain: ¶7.35 states that when an MSO is served with a court document — for example a search warrant or production order — or crime-related intelligence requests from a law enforcement agency, such as a notification letter, in relation to a particular customer or business relationship, the MSO should timely assess the risks involved and the need to conduct an appropriate review on the customer or the business relationship to determine whether there is any suspicion.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者就某特定客戶獲送達法庭文件或與罪案有關的情報要求，應怎樣做？
options: 適時評估所涉風險，以及是否需要對該客戶或業務關係進行適當檢視，以斷定是否有任何懷疑
立即終止該業務關係
一律自動提交可疑交易報告
待調查有結果後方採取任何步驟
tc.explain: 第7.35段訂明，如該經營者就某特定客戶或業務關係獲送達法庭文件（例如搜查令或交出物料令），或收到執法機關與罪案有關的情報要求（例如通知信），該經營者應適時評估所涉風險，以及是否需要對該客戶或業務關係進行適當檢視，以斷定是否有任何懷疑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.35段

en.q: What should an MSO bear in mind about the customer to whom a court document relates?
options: That the customer can be a victim of crime
That the customer is presumed to be under investigation as a suspect
That the customer must be reported to the JFIU
That the customer's relationship must be closed
en.explain: ¶7.35 states that the MSO should also be aware that the customer to whom the court document relates can be a victim of crime — so service of a court document is a trigger for assessment and review, not an automatic finding of suspicion against the customer.

tc.q: 就法庭文件所涉的客戶，金錢服務經營者應注意甚麼？
options: 該客戶可能是罪行的受害人
應推定該客戶正以嫌疑人身分接受調查
須將該客戶向聯合財富情報組報告
須結束與該客戶的業務關係
tc.explain: 第7.35段訂明該經營者亦應知悉，法庭文件所涉的客戶可能是罪行的受害人——故獲送達法庭文件只是評估及檢視的觸發點，並不等同自動認定對該客戶存有懷疑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.19段

en.q: What must accompany the MLRO's disclosure to the JFIU?
options: The information on which the knowledge or suspicion is based
The MSO's internal risk assessment document
The customer's consent to the disclosure
A copy of the internal report register
en.explain: ¶7.19 states that if after completing the review of the internal report an MLRO decides that there are grounds for knowledge or suspicion, he should disclose the information to the JFIU as soon as it is reasonable to do so after his evaluation is complete, together with the information on which that knowledge or suspicion is based — mirroring the statutory requirement in ¶7.1.

tc.q: 洗錢事務主任向聯合財富情報組作出的披露，須附有甚麼？
options: 構成該項知悉或懷疑的基礎的資料
該經營者的內部風險評估文件
該客戶就該項披露的同意
內部報告登記冊的副本
tc.explain: 第7.19段訂明，如洗錢事務主任在完成檢視內部報告後認為有知悉或懷疑的理由，應在其評估完成後在合理範圍內盡快向聯合財富情報組披露該等資料，連同構成該項知悉或懷疑的基礎的資料——與第7.1段的法定規定一致。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.1段

en.q: How does the Guideline describe the role of record-keeping for investigating authorities?
options: It is an essential part of the audit trail for the detection, investigation and confiscation of criminal or terrorist property or funds, helping the authorities to establish a financial profile of a suspect and trace the property or funds
It is primarily a means of resolving customer disputes
It exists chiefly to support the MSO's accounting and tax obligations
It is required only where an STR has been filed
en.explain: ¶8.1 states that record-keeping is an essential part of the audit trail for the detection, investigation and confiscation of criminal or terrorist property or funds, and that it helps the investigating authorities to establish a financial profile of a suspect and trace the criminal or terrorist property or funds.

tc.q: 本指引如何形容備存紀錄對調查當局的作用？
options: 備存紀錄是偵測、調查及充公犯罪或恐怖分子財產或資金的審計線索的重要一環，有助調查當局建立嫌疑人的財務狀況及追查有關財產或資金
主要用作解決客戶爭議
主要為支援該經營者的會計及稅務責任
只在已提交可疑交易報告時方須備存
tc.explain: 第8.1段訂明備存紀錄是偵測、調查及充公犯罪或恐怖分子財產或資金的審計線索的重要一環；備存紀錄有助調查當局建立嫌疑人的財務狀況，並追查該等犯罪或恐怖分子財產或資金。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.1段

en.q: What two further purposes does record-keeping serve under ¶8.1?
options: Assisting the Court to examine all relevant past transactions to assess whether the property or funds are the proceeds of or relate to criminal or terrorist offences; and enabling the MSO to demonstrate compliance with the AMLO, the Guideline and other relevant guidance
Supporting the MSO's marketing analysis; and satisfying its shareholders
Enabling the JFIU to give consent; and enabling the customer to verify transactions
Supporting the MSO's insurance claims; and its audit fee negotiations
en.explain: ¶8.1 states that record-keeping assists the Court to examine all relevant past transactions to assess whether the property or funds are the proceeds of or relate to criminal or terrorist offences, and that it also enables an MSO to demonstrate compliance with the requirements set out in the AMLO, the Guideline and other relevant guidance promulgated by the CCE from time to time.

tc.q: 根據第8.1段，備存紀錄另有哪兩項作用？
options: 協助法院審視所有相關的過往交易，以評估有關財產或資金是否犯罪或恐怖分子罪行的得益或與之有關；以及使該經營者能證明其遵從《打擊洗錢條例》、本指引及其他相關指引
支援該經營者的市場分析；以及向股東交代
使聯合財富情報組能給予同意；以及使客戶能核對交易
支援該經營者的保險索償；以及審計費用議價
tc.explain: 第8.1段訂明備存紀錄協助法院審視所有相關的過往交易，以評估有關財產或資金是否犯罪或恐怖分子罪行的得益或與之有關；亦使該經營者能證明其遵從《打擊洗錢條例》、本指引及海關關長不時頒布的其他相關指引所載的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.2段

en.q: To what should the records an MSO maintains be appropriate?
options: The nature, size and complexity of its businesses, so as to meet the statutory and regulatory requirements
The volume of STRs it files each year
The number of branches it operates
The requirements of its correspondent banks
en.explain: ¶8.2 states that an MSO should maintain CDD information, transaction records and other records that are necessary and sufficient to meet the statutory and regulatory requirements that are appropriate to the nature, size and complexity of its businesses.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者所保存的紀錄應與甚麼相稱？
options: 其業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，以符合法定及監管規定
其每年提交的可疑交易報告數目
其經營的分行數目
其代理銀行的要求
tc.explain: 第8.2段訂明該經營者應保存客戶盡職審查資料、交易紀錄及其他紀錄，該等紀錄須為符合法定及監管規定所必需及充分，並與其業務的性質、規模及複雜程度相稱。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.2段

en.q: Which three matters must an MSO ensure under ¶8.2?
options: That the audit trail for funds moving through it is clear and complete; that all CDD information and transaction records are available swiftly to the CCE, other authorities and auditors upon appropriate authority; and that it can demonstrate compliance with the Guideline and other CCE guidelines
That records are stored offsite; that they are encrypted; and that they are destroyed after five years
That records are in English; that they are certified; and that they are audited annually
That records are shared with correspondent banks; that they are indexed; and that they are reconciled monthly
en.explain: ¶8.2 requires an MSO to ensure that the audit trail for funds moving through the MSO relating to any customer and, where appropriate, the beneficial owner of the customer, account or transaction is clear and complete; that all CDD information and transaction records are available swiftly to the CCE, other authorities and auditors upon appropriate authority; and that it can demonstrate compliance with any relevant requirements specified in other sections of the Guideline and other guidelines issued by the CCE.

tc.q: 根據第8.2段，金錢服務經營者須確保哪三方面？
options: 經其流轉的資金的審計線索清晰及完整；所有客戶盡職審查資料及交易紀錄可在具備適當授權下迅速提供予海關關長、其他當局及審計師；以及其能證明遵從本指引及海關關長發出的其他指引
紀錄異地存放；經加密；以及五年後銷毀
紀錄以英文書寫；經核證；以及每年審計
紀錄與代理銀行共享；已編制索引；以及每月核對
tc.explain: 第8.2段規定該經營者須確保：(a)與任何客戶（及在適當情況下該客戶、帳戶或交易的實益擁有人）有關而經該經營者流轉的資金的審計線索清晰及完整；(b)所有客戶盡職審查資料及交易紀錄可在具備適當授權下迅速提供予海關關長、其他當局及審計師；及(c)其能證明遵從本指引其他章節及海關關長發出的其他指引所訂明的任何相關規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3(a)段

en.q: Whose identification documents and data must an MSO keep under ¶8.3(a)?
options: The customer, and where applicable the beneficial owner, the beneficiary, persons who purport to act on behalf of the customer, and other connected parties to the customer
The customer only
The customer and the beneficial owner only
The customer and any person who attends the premises
en.explain: ¶8.3(a) requires an MSO to keep the original or a copy of the documents, and a record of the data and information, obtained in the course of identifying and, where applicable, verifying the identity of the customer and/or beneficial owner of the customer and/or beneficiary and/or persons who purport to act on behalf of the customer and/or other connected parties to the customer.

tc.q: 根據第8.3(a)款，金錢服務經營者須保存何人的身分證明文件及數據？
options: 客戶，以及（如適用）客戶的實益擁有人、受益人、聲稱代客戶行事的人，以及與客戶有關連的其他各方
只限客戶
只限客戶及實益擁有人
客戶及任何到訪處所的人
tc.explain: 第8.3(a)款規定該經營者須保存在識別及（如適用）核實客戶及／或客戶的實益擁有人及／或受益人及／或聲稱代客戶行事的人及／或與客戶有關連的其他各方的身分過程中，所取得文件的正本或副本，以及數據及資料的紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3(b)段

en.q: Which other documents and records must be kept under ¶8.3(b)?
options: Other documents and records obtained throughout the CDD and ongoing monitoring process, including SDD and EDD
Only documents obtained at the establishment of the relationship
Only documents relating to enhanced due diligence
Only documents relating to transactions above the CDD threshold
en.explain: ¶8.3(b) requires the MSO to keep other documents and records obtained throughout the CDD and ongoing monitoring process, including SDD and EDD — so simplified and enhanced due diligence material is caught as well as standard CDD.

tc.q: 根據第8.3(b)款，須保存哪些其他文件及紀錄？
options: 在整個客戶盡職審查及持續監察過程中取得的其他文件及紀錄，包括簡化及加強盡職審查
只限建立業務關係時所取得的文件
只限與加強盡職審查有關的文件
只限與超過客戶盡職審查門檻的交易有關的文件
tc.explain: 第8.3(b)款規定該經營者須保存在整個客戶盡職審查及持續監察過程中取得的其他文件及紀錄，包括簡化盡職審查及加強盡職審查——故簡化及加強盡職審查的資料與一般客戶盡職審查資料同樣須予保存。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3(d)段

en.q: What business correspondence must, at a minimum, be kept?
options: Business correspondence material to CDD measures or significant changes to the operation of the account
All emails exchanged with the customer
Only correspondence signed by the customer
Only correspondence concerning complaints
en.explain: ¶8.3(d) requires the original or a copy of records and documents relating to the customer's account — for example the account opening form or risk assessment form — and business correspondence with the customer and any beneficial owner, which at a minimum should include business correspondence material to CDD measures or significant changes to the operation of the account.

tc.q: 最低限度須保存哪些業務往來通訊？
options: 對客戶盡職審查措施或帳戶運作重大變動而言屬重要的業務往來通訊
與客戶往來的所有電郵
只限由客戶簽署的通訊
只限有關投訴的通訊
tc.explain: 第8.3(d)款規定須保存與該客戶帳戶有關的紀錄及文件的正本或副本（例如開立帳戶表格或風險評估表格），以及與該客戶及任何實益擁有人的業務往來通訊；最低限度應包括對客戶盡職審查措施或帳戶運作重大變動而言屬重要的業務往來通訊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3段註腳66

en.q: Is an MSO expected to keep every item of correspondence with a customer?
options: No — an MSO is not expected to keep each and every correspondence, such as a series of emails; the expectation is that sufficient correspondence is kept to demonstrate compliance with the AMLO
Yes — every communication must be retained
Yes — but only for high risk customers
No — correspondence need not be kept at all
en.explain: Footnote 66 to ¶8.3(d) states that an MSO is not expected to keep each and every correspondence, such as a series of emails with the customer, and that the expectation is that sufficient correspondence is kept to demonstrate compliance with the AMLO.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者是否須保存與客戶往來的每一項通訊？
options: 否——並不預期須保存每一項通訊（例如與客戶往來的一連串電郵）；所預期的是保存足夠通訊以證明遵從《打擊洗錢條例》
是——每項通訊均須保留
是——但只限高風險客戶
否——通訊完全無須保存
tc.explain: 第8.3(d)款註腳66訂明並不預期該經營者保存每一項通訊（例如與客戶往來的一連串電郵）；所預期的是保存足夠的通訊，以證明遵從《打擊洗錢條例》。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3(e)段

en.q: What example does ¶8.3(e) give of 'the results of any analysis undertaken'?
options: Inquiries to establish the background and purposes of transactions that are complex, unusually large in amount or of unusual pattern, and have no apparent economic or lawful purpose
The MSO's annual institutional risk assessment
The results of the MSO's independent audit
Market analysis of the MSO's competitors
en.explain: ¶8.3(e) requires the MSO to keep the results of any analysis undertaken, giving as the example inquiries to establish the background and purposes of transactions that are complex, unusually large in amount or of unusual pattern, and have no apparent economic or lawful purpose — the examination required by ¶5.1(b)(ii).

tc.q: 第8.3(e)款就「所進行任何分析的結果」舉出甚麼例子？
options: 為確立屬複雜、款額異常龐大或模式不尋常，且並無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易的背景及目的而作的查詢
該經營者的年度機構風險評估
該經營者獨立審計的結果
該經營者對競爭對手的市場分析
tc.explain: 第8.3(e)款規定該經營者須保存所進行任何分析的結果，並以此為例：為確立屬複雜、款額異常龐大或模式不尋常，且並無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易的背景及目的而作的查詢——即第5.1(b)(ii)段所規定的審查。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.4段

en.q: Which occasional transaction thresholds trigger the ¶8.4 five-year retention duty?
options: $8,000 for wire transfers and virtual asset transfers involving virtual assets, and $120,000 for other types of transactions
$8,000 for all types of transaction
$120,000 for all types of transaction
$50,000 for wire transfers and $250,000 for other transactions
en.explain: ¶8.4 states that for an occasional transaction equal to or exceeding the CDD threshold — that is $8,000 for wire transfers and virtual asset transfers involving virtual assets, and $120,000 for other types of transactions — an MSO should keep all documents and records mentioned in ¶8.3 for a period of at least five years after the date of the occasional transaction.

tc.q: 哪些單一宗交易門檻會觸發第8.4段的五年保存責任？
options: 電匯及涉及虛擬資產的虛擬資產轉移為8,000元；其他類型交易為120,000元
所有類型交易均為8,000元
所有類型交易均為120,000元
電匯為50,000元，其他交易為250,000元
tc.explain: 第8.4段訂明就相等於或超過客戶盡職審查門檻的單一宗交易（即電匯及涉及虛擬資產的虛擬資產轉移為8,000元，其他類型交易為120,000元），該經營者應在該單一宗交易日期後保存第8.3段所述的所有文件及紀錄最少五年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.4段

en.q: For how long must the ¶8.3 documents be kept in the case of a business relationship?
options: Throughout the continuance of the business relationship, and for a period of at least five years after the end of the business relationship
For five years from the date each document was obtained
For five years from the start of the business relationship
Until the next periodic review of the customer
en.explain: ¶8.4 states that all documents and records mentioned in ¶8.3 should be kept throughout the continuance of the business relationship with the customer and for a period of at least five years after the end of the business relationship.

tc.q: 就業務關係而言，第8.3段所述文件須保存多久？
options: 在該業務關係持續期間，並在該業務關係終止後最少五年
自取得每份文件之日起計五年
自該業務關係開始之日起計五年
直至下次定期檢視該客戶為止
tc.explain: 第8.4段訂明第8.3段所述的所有文件及紀錄，應在與該客戶的業務關係持續期間保存，並在該業務關係終止後保存最少五年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.5段

en.q: To what standard must transaction records be kept under ¶8.5?
options: Sufficient to permit reconstruction of individual transactions so as to provide, if necessary, evidence for prosecution of criminal activity
Sufficient to allow the customer to reconcile their own account
Sufficient to satisfy the MSO's external auditors
Sufficient to support the MSO's management accounts
en.explain: ¶8.5 states that an MSO should maintain the original or a copy of the documents, and a record of the data and information, obtained or generated in connection with each transaction it carries out, both domestic and international, which should be sufficient to permit reconstruction of individual transactions so as to provide, if necessary, evidence for prosecution of criminal activity.

tc.q: 根據第8.5段，交易紀錄須達到何種標準？
options: 足以重組個別交易，以便在有需要時就刑事罪行的檢控提供證據
足以讓客戶核對其本身帳目
足以令該經營者的外聘審計師滿意
足以支援該經營者的管理帳目
tc.explain: 第8.5段訂明該經營者應就其進行的每宗交易（不論本地或國際交易），保存所取得或產生的文件正本或副本，以及數據及資料的紀錄；該等紀錄應足以重組個別交易，以便在有需要時就刑事罪行的檢控提供證據。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.6段

en.q: For how long must transaction records be kept, and does the end of the business relationship shorten that period?
options: At least five years after the completion of a transaction, regardless of whether the business relationship ends during the period
At least five years after the end of the business relationship, whenever that occurs
At least three years after the completion of the transaction
Until the CCE confirms the records may be destroyed
en.explain: ¶8.6 states that all documents and records mentioned in ¶8.5 should be kept for a period of at least five years after the completion of a transaction, regardless of whether the business relationship ends during the period.

tc.q: 交易紀錄須保存多久？業務關係終止會否縮短該期限？
options: 在交易完成後最少五年；不論該業務關係有否在此期間終止
在該業務關係終止後最少五年，不論何時終止
在交易完成後最少三年
直至海關關長確認可銷毀該等紀錄
tc.explain: 第8.6段訂明第8.5段所述的所有文件及紀錄，應在交易完成後保存最少五年，而不論該業務關係有否在該期間終止。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.7段

en.q: In what form may records be retained under section 21 of Schedule 2?
options: If the record consists of a document, either the original or a copy kept on microfilm or in the database of a computer; if it consists of data or information, on microfilm or in the database of a computer
Only in original hard copy
Only in electronic form
Only in a form approved in advance by the CCE
en.explain: ¶8.7 states that if the record consists of a document, either the original of the document should be retained or a copy should be kept on microfilm or in the database of a computer; and that if the record consists of data or information, such record should be kept either on microfilm or in the database of a computer.

tc.q: 根據附表2第21條，紀錄可以何種形式保存？
options: 如紀錄由文件構成，可保存該文件正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫保存副本；如紀錄由數據或資料構成，則須以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫保存
只可保存印本正本
只可以電子形式保存
只可以海關關長事先批准的形式保存
tc.explain: 第8.7段訂明如紀錄由文件構成，應保存該文件的正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫保存該文件的副本；如紀錄由數據或資料構成，則該紀錄應以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫保存。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.8段

en.q: On what grounds may the CCE require records to be kept for longer than five years, and in what form must the requirement be made?
options: Where the records are relevant to an ongoing criminal or other investigation carried out by the CCE, or to any other purposes specified in the notice; by notice in writing to the MSO
Where the customer is a PEP; by oral direction during an inspection
Where the MSO has filed an STR; by publication in the Gazette
Where the records relate to a cross-border transaction; by a licence condition
en.explain: ¶8.8 states that the CCE may, by notice in writing to an MSO, require it to keep the records relating to a specified transaction or customer for a period specified by the CCE that is longer than those referred to in ¶8.4 and ¶8.6, where the records are relevant to an ongoing criminal or other investigation carried out by the CCE, or to any other purposes as specified in the notice.

tc.q: 海關關長可基於甚麼理由要求保存紀錄超過五年？該要求須以何種形式作出？
options: 如該等紀錄與海關關長正進行的刑事或其他調查有關，或與該通知所指明的任何其他目的有關；並須以書面通知該經營者作出
如該客戶是政治人物；於巡查時以口頭指示作出
如該經營者已提交可疑交易報告；以憲報刊登方式作出
如該等紀錄與跨境交易有關；以牌照條件方式作出
tc.explain: 第8.8段訂明，如有關紀錄與海關關長正進行的刑事或其他調查有關，或與通知所指明的任何其他目的有關，海關關長可書面通知該經營者，要求其就指明的交易或客戶保存有關紀錄，期限由海關關長指明，並較第8.4及8.6段所述者為長。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.9段

en.q: Does the location where CDD and transaction records are held affect the MSO's obligations?
options: No — irrespective of where the records are held, an MSO must comply with all legal and regulatory requirements in Hong Kong, especially Part 3 of Schedule 2
Yes — records held overseas are governed by the law of that place
Yes — records held by a group company are exempt
Yes — records held electronically are subject to lighter requirements
en.explain: ¶8.9 states that irrespective of where CDD and transaction records are held, an MSO is required to comply with all legal and regulatory requirements in Hong Kong, especially Part 3 of Schedule 2 — the record-keeping Part.

tc.q: 客戶盡職審查及交易紀錄的存放地點，會否影響該經營者的責任？
options: 不會——不論該等紀錄存放於何處，該經營者均須遵從香港所有法律及監管規定，尤其是附表2第3部
會——存放於海外的紀錄受當地法律規管
會——由集團公司保存的紀錄獲豁免
會——以電子方式保存的紀錄受較寬鬆規定規管
tc.explain: 第8.9段訂明不論客戶盡職審查及交易紀錄存放於何處，該經營者均須遵從香港所有法律及監管規定，尤其是附表2第3部（即備存紀錄的部分）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.10段

en.q: Where identification and verification documents are held by an intermediary relied on for CDD, who remains responsible for record-keeping compliance?
options: The MSO concerned remains responsible for compliance with all record-keeping requirements
The intermediary, once it has given written confirmation
Both share responsibility equally
Neither, until the CCE requests the records
en.explain: ¶8.10 states that where customer identification and verification documents are held by an intermediary on which an MSO is relying to carry out CDD measures, the MSO concerned remains responsible for compliance with all record-keeping requirements.

tc.q: 如身分識別及核實文件由該經營者所倚賴進行客戶盡職審查的中介人保存，何人仍須就備存紀錄的合規承擔責任？
options: 有關金錢服務經營者仍須就遵從所有備存紀錄規定承擔責任
該中介人，一旦其已作出書面確認
雙方同等分擔責任
在海關關長索取該等紀錄前，兩者均無責任
tc.explain: 第8.10段訂明，如客戶身分識別及核實文件由該經營者所倚賴進行客戶盡職審查措施的中介人保存，有關經營者仍須就遵從所有備存紀錄規定承擔責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.10段

en.q: What must an MSO ensure about an intermediary's record-keeping systems and responsiveness?
options: That the intermediary has systems in place to comply with all the record-keeping requirements under the AMLO and the Guideline, and that documents and records will be provided as soon as reasonably practicable after the intermediary receives the MSO's request
That the intermediary keeps records for at least three years
That the intermediary stores records in Hong Kong only
That the intermediary provides records within 3 business days in every case
en.explain: ¶8.10 states that the MSO should ensure that the intermediary being relied on has systems in place to comply with all the record-keeping requirements under the AMLO and the Guideline — including the requirements of ¶8.3 to ¶8.9 — and that documents and records will be provided by the intermediary as soon as reasonably practicable after the intermediary receives the request from the MSO.

tc.q: 就中介人的備存紀錄系統及回應速度，金錢服務經營者須確保甚麼？
options: 該中介人設有系統以遵從《打擊洗錢條例》及本指引下的所有備存紀錄規定；並會在收到該經營者要求後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快提供文件及紀錄
該中介人保存紀錄最少三年
該中介人只在香港存放紀錄
該中介人在所有情況下均於3個營業日內提供紀錄
tc.explain: 第8.10段訂明該經營者應確保所倚賴的中介人設有系統，以遵從《打擊洗錢條例》及本指引下的所有備存紀錄規定（包括第8.3至8.9段的規定）；並確保該中介人會在收到該經營者的要求後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快提供文件及紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.12段

en.q: What must an MSO ensure happens to documents and records upon termination of an intermediary's services?
options: That the intermediary will pass the documents and records to the MSO
That the intermediary will destroy the documents and records
That the intermediary will transfer them to the successor intermediary
That the intermediary will lodge them with the CCE
en.explain: ¶8.12 states that an MSO should ensure that an intermediary will pass the documents and records to the MSO upon termination of the services provided by the intermediary. This complements the ¶4.11.5 undertaking to supply copies where the intermediary is about to cease trading.

tc.q: 中介人所提供服務終止時，金錢服務經營者須確保文件及紀錄如何處理？
options: 該中介人會將文件及紀錄交予該經營者
該中介人會銷毀該等文件及紀錄
該中介人會將其轉交繼任的中介人
該中介人會將其送交海關關長存檔
tc.explain: 第8.12段訂明該經營者應確保在中介人所提供的服務終止時，該中介人會將文件及紀錄交予該經營者。此與第4.11.5段就中介人即將停業時提供副本的承諾互相補足。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.11段

en.q: What must an MSO relying on an intermediary for a CDD measure obtain immediately?
options: The data or the information that the intermediary has obtained in the course of carrying out that measure
Certified copies of every underlying document
A written report on the CDD performed
The intermediary's own internal policies
en.explain: ¶8.11 states, for the avoidance of doubt, that an MSO that relies on an intermediary for carrying out a CDD measure should immediately obtain data or the information that the intermediary has obtained in the course of carrying out that measure — the record-keeping counterpart of the requirement in ¶4.11.4.

tc.q: 倚賴中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施的金錢服務經營者，須即時取得甚麼？
options: 該中介人在進行該措施過程中所取得的數據或資料
每份相關文件的經核證副本
一份關於所進行客戶盡職審查的書面報告
該中介人本身的內部政策
tc.explain: 第8.11段為免生疑問訂明，倚賴中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施的該經營者，應即時取得該中介人在進行該措施過程中所取得的數據或資料——此為第4.11.4段規定在備存紀錄方面的對應條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.1段

en.q: Why does the Guideline treat ongoing staff training as important?
options: Because the effective implementation of even a well-designed internal control system can be compromised if staff using the system is not adequately trained
Because training is a licensing condition imposed by the CCE
Because trained staff reduce the MSO's insurance premiums
Because the FATF requires a minimum number of training hours
en.explain: ¶9.1 states that ongoing staff training is an important element of an effective system to prevent and detect ML/TF activities, and that the effective implementation of even a well-designed internal control system can be compromised if staff using the system is not adequately trained.

tc.q: 本指引為何視持續員工培訓為重要？
options: 因即使設計完善的內部監控制度，若使用該制度的員工未獲充分培訓，其有效實施仍可能受損
因培訓是海關關長施加的牌照條件
因受訓員工可減低該經營者的保費
因財務行動特別組織訂明最低培訓時數
tc.explain: 第9.1段訂明持續員工培訓是有效防止及偵測洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集活動的制度的重要一環；即使設計完善的內部監控制度，若使用該制度的員工未獲充分培訓，其有效實施仍可能受損。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.2段

en.q: How should the scope and frequency of training be determined?
options: Tailored to the specific risks faced by the MSO and pitched according to the job functions, responsibilities and experience of the staff
Set uniformly for all staff at a fixed number of hours per year
Determined by the training provider
Set by the CCE for each class of licensee
en.explain: ¶9.2 states that it is an MSO's responsibility to provide adequate training for its staff so that they are adequately trained to implement its AML/CFT Systems, and that the scope and frequency of training should be tailored to the specific risks faced by the MSO and pitched according to the job functions, responsibilities and experience of the staff.

tc.q: 培訓的範圍及頻次應如何釐定？
options: 按該經營者面對的特定風險量身設計，並按員工的工作職能、職責及經驗調整深淺
對所有員工劃一訂定每年固定時數
由培訓提供者決定
由海關關長就每類持牌人訂定
tc.explain: 第9.2段訂明該經營者有責任為其員工提供充分培訓，使其能充分實施該經營者的打擊洗錢系統；培訓的範圍及頻次應按該經營者面對的特定風險量身設計，並按員工的工作職能、職責及經驗調整深淺。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.2段

en.q: When should new staff attend initial training, and what should follow?
options: As soon as possible after being hired or appointed; and refresher training should be provided regularly so that staff are reminded of their responsibilities and kept informed of new developments related to ML/TF
Within the first year of employment; with no further requirement
Before the end of their probation period; followed by training only on promotion
Only when they are assigned to a customer-facing role; with annual testing
en.explain: ¶9.2 states that new staff should be required to attend initial training as soon as possible after being hired or appointed, and that apart from the initial training an MSO should also provide refresher training regularly to ensure that its staff are reminded of their responsibilities and are kept informed of new developments related to ML/TF.

tc.q: 新入職員工應在何時接受初次培訓？其後應有甚麼安排？
options: 在受僱或獲委任後盡快接受；其後應定期提供複修培訓，以確保員工獲提醒其職責，並掌握與洗錢有關的最新發展
於受僱首年內接受；其後並無其他要求
於試用期結束前接受；其後只在晉升時再培訓
只在獲派前線職位時接受；並每年測驗
tc.explain: 第9.2段訂明新員工應在受僱或獲委任後盡快接受初次培訓；除初次培訓外，該經營者亦應定期提供複修培訓，以確保員工獲提醒其職責，並掌握與洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集有關的最新發展。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.4(a)及(b)段

en.q: Whose obligations must staff be made aware of in relation to CDD, record-keeping and reporting?
options: Both their MSO's and their own personal statutory obligations, and the possible consequences of failure to comply
The MSO's obligations only, since staff are not personally liable
Their own obligations only
The obligations of the MLRO only
en.explain: ¶9.4(a) and (b) require staff to be made aware of their MSO's and their own personal statutory obligations, and the possible consequences for failure to comply with CDD and record-keeping requirements under the AMLO, and for failure to report suspicious transactions under the DTROP, the OSCO and the UNATMO.

tc.q: 就客戶盡職審查、備存紀錄及報告，員工須獲知悉何人的責任？
options: 該經營者及員工本身的法定責任，以及未有遵從的可能後果
只需該經營者的責任，因員工並無個人責任
只需員工本身的責任
只需洗錢事務主任的責任
tc.explain: 第9.4(a)及(b)款規定員工須獲知悉該經營者及其本身的法定責任，以及未有遵從《打擊洗錢條例》下客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定，和未有根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》報告可疑交易的可能後果。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.4(c)段

en.q: Which ordinances are named in ¶9.4(c) as the source of other statutory and regulatory obligations staff must be aware of?
options: The DTROP, the OSCO, the UNATMO, the UNSO, the WMD(CPS)O and the AMLO
The AMLO and the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance
The Banking Ordinance and the Securities and Futures Ordinance
The Companies Ordinance and the Trustee Ordinance
en.explain: ¶9.4(c) requires staff to be made aware of any other statutory and regulatory obligations that concern their MSOs and themselves under the DTROP, the OSCO, the UNATMO, the UNSO, the WMD(CPS)O and the AMLO, and the possible consequences of breaches of these obligations.

tc.q: 第9.4(c)款列明員工須知悉的其他法定及監管責任，源自哪些條例？
options: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》、《聯合國制裁條例》、《武器擴散（提供服務的管制）條例》及《打擊洗錢條例》
《打擊洗錢條例》及《個人資料（私隱）條例》
《銀行業條例》及《證券及期貨條例》
《公司條例》及《受託人條例》
tc.explain: 第9.4(c)款規定員工須知悉《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》、《聯合國制裁條例》、《武器擴散（提供服務的管制）條例》及《打擊洗錢條例》下，與該經營者及員工本身有關的任何其他法定及監管責任，以及違反該等責任的可能後果。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.4(e)段

en.q: To what extent must staff be made aware of new and emerging ML/TF techniques, methods and trends?
options: To the extent that such information is needed by the staff to carry out their particular roles in the MSO with respect to AML/CFT
To the fullest extent, for every member of staff equally
Only where the staff member is the MLRO
Only where the MSO has filed an STR in the preceding year
en.explain: ¶9.4(e) requires staff to be made aware of any new and emerging techniques, methods and trends in ML/TF to the extent that such information is needed by the staff to carry out their particular roles in the MSO with respect to AML/CFT.

tc.q: 員工須在何種程度上知悉新興的洗錢技巧、方法及趨勢？
options: 以員工履行其在該經營者內打擊洗錢方面的特定崗位所需的程度為限
須全面知悉，每名員工一律相同
只限該員工是洗錢事務主任的情況
只限該經營者於前一年曾提交可疑交易報告的情況
tc.explain: 第9.4(e)款規定員工須知悉洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的任何新興技巧、方法及趨勢，其程度以員工履行其在該經營者內打擊洗錢方面的特定崗位所需者為限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(a)段

en.q: Which training is appropriate for all new staff, irrespective of seniority?
options: An introduction to the background to ML/TF and the importance placed on it by the MSO; and the need for identifying and reporting suspicious transactions to the MLRO, and the offence of tipping off
Detailed training on transaction monitoring parameters and thresholds
Specific training on assessing internal reports and reporting to the JFIU
Higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime
en.explain: ¶9.5(a) states that for all new staff, irrespective of seniority, appropriate training includes an introduction to the background to ML/TF and the importance placed on ML/TF by the MSO, and the need for identifying and reporting of any suspicious transactions to the MLRO, and the offence of tipping off.

tc.q: 就所有新入職員工（不論職級），哪些培訓屬適當？
options: 介紹洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的背景，以及該經營者對此的重視；以及識別可疑交易並向洗錢事務主任報告的需要，和通風報信的罪行
有關交易監察參數及門檻的詳細培訓
有關評估內部報告及向聯合財富情報組報告的專門培訓
涵蓋該經營者打擊洗錢制度各方面的較高層次培訓
tc.explain: 第9.5(a)款訂明就所有新員工（不論職級），適當的培訓包括：介紹洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的背景，以及該經營者對此的重視；以及識別任何可疑交易並向洗錢事務主任報告的需要，和「通風報信」的罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(b)(i)段

en.q: How does the Guideline describe the role of front-line personnel in an MSO's ML/TF strategy?
options: As the first point of contact with potential money launderers
As the last line of defence after transaction monitoring
As the persons responsible for filing STRs with the JFIU
As the persons responsible for approving high risk relationships
en.explain: ¶9.5(b)(i) states that members of staff dealing directly with the public — for example front-line personnel — should be trained on the importance of their roles in the MSO's ML/TF strategy, as the first point of contact with potential money launderers.

tc.q: 本指引如何形容前線員工在該經營者打擊洗錢策略中的角色？
options: 作為與潛在洗錢者接觸的第一個接觸點
作為交易監察之後的最後防線
作為負責向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告的人
作為負責批准高風險業務關係的人
tc.explain: 第9.5(b)(i)款訂明直接與公眾接觸的員工（例如前線人員）應獲培訓，了解其在該經營者打擊洗錢策略中角色的重要性，因其為與潛在洗錢者接觸的第一個接觸點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(b)(iii)段

en.q: Which two matters, besides circumstances that may give rise to suspicion, should front-line staff training cover?
options: Lines of reporting, and when extra vigilance might be required
The MSO's pricing policy, and its complaint procedures
The JFIU's consent regime, and the statutory defence
The CCE's inspection powers, and the appeal process
en.explain: ¶9.5(b)(iii) states that staff dealing directly with the public should receive training in circumstances that may give rise to suspicion, and relevant policies and procedures, including for example lines of reporting and when extra vigilance might be required.

tc.q: 除可能引致懷疑的情況外，前線員工培訓還應涵蓋哪兩方面？
options: 報告層級，以及何時需要格外警覺
該經營者的定價政策，以及其投訴程序
聯合財富情報組的同意制度，以及法定免責辯護
海關關長的巡查權力，以及上訴程序
tc.explain: 第9.5(b)(iii)款訂明直接與公眾接觸的員工應接受培訓，了解可能引致懷疑的情況，以及相關政策及程序，例如報告層級，以及何時可能需要格外警覺。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(c)段

en.q: What should back-office staff be trained to recognise, depending on their roles?
options: Unusual activities including abnormal settlements, payments or delivery instructions, together with appropriate training on customer verification and relevant processing procedures
Customer complaints and service failures
Foreign exchange rate movements
Systems outages and processing errors
en.explain: ¶9.5(c) states that back-office staff, depending on their roles, should receive appropriate training on customer verification and relevant processing procedures, and on how to recognise unusual activities including abnormal settlements, payments or delivery instructions.

tc.q: 後勤員工按其崗位應獲培訓辨識甚麼？
options: 不尋常活動（包括異常的交收、付款或交付指示），並就客戶身分核實及相關處理程序接受適當培訓
客戶投訴及服務失誤
外匯匯率變動
系統故障及處理錯誤
tc.explain: 第9.5(c)款訂明後勤員工應按其崗位，就客戶身分核實及相關處理程序接受適當培訓，並學習如何辨識不尋常活動，包括異常的交收、付款或交付指示。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(d)段

en.q: Which staff should receive higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime?
options: Managerial staff, including internal audit officers and compliance officers
Front-line personnel only
All new staff, irrespective of seniority
Back-office staff only
en.explain: ¶9.5(d) states that managerial staff including internal audit officers and COs should receive higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime, and specific training in relation to their responsibilities for supervising or managing staff, auditing the system and performing random checks as well as reporting of suspicious transactions to the JFIU.

tc.q: 哪些員工應接受涵蓋該經營者打擊洗錢制度各方面的較高層次培訓？
options: 管理層員工，包括內部審計人員及合規主任
只限前線人員
所有新入職員工，不論職級
只限後勤員工
tc.explain: 第9.5(d)款訂明管理層員工（包括內部審計人員及合規主任）應接受涵蓋該經營者打擊洗錢制度各方面的較高層次培訓，以及就其監督或管理員工、審計該制度、進行隨機抽查，以及向聯合財富情報組報告可疑交易等職責的專門培訓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(e)段

en.q: Which two kinds of training are identified as appropriate for MLROs?
options: Specific training on their responsibilities for assessing suspicious transaction reports submitted to them and reporting to the JFIU; and training to keep abreast of AML/CFT requirements and developments generally
Training on customer service standards; and training on foreign exchange operations
Training on the MSO's business plan; and training on financial reporting
Training on branch management; and training on staff recruitment
en.explain: ¶9.5(e) states that MLROs should receive specific training in relation to their responsibilities for assessing suspicious transaction reports submitted to them and reporting of suspicious transactions to the JFIU, and training to keep abreast of AML/CFT requirements and developments generally.

tc.q: 本指引指出洗錢事務主任適合接受哪兩類培訓？
options: 就其評估提交予其的可疑交易報告及向聯合財富情報組報告的職責的專門培訓；以及使其掌握打擊洗錢規定及發展的培訓
客戶服務標準培訓；以及外匯業務培訓
該經營者業務計劃的培訓；以及財務報告培訓
分行管理培訓；以及員工招聘培訓
tc.explain: 第9.5(e)款訂明洗錢事務主任應接受就其評估提交予其的可疑交易報告，以及向聯合財富情報組報告可疑交易的職責的專門培訓；並接受使其掌握打擊洗錢的規定及發展的培訓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.6段

en.q: Which training techniques and tools does the Guideline suggest an MSO may use?
options: On-line learning systems, focused classroom training, relevant videos, and paper- or intranet-based procedures manuals
Classroom training only, so that attendance can be verified
External seminars only, delivered by accredited providers
On-the-job coaching only, to reflect actual work situations
en.explain: ¶9.6 states that an MSO is encouraged to consider using a mix of training techniques and tools depending on the available resources and learning needs of their staff, which may include on-line learning systems, focused classroom training, relevant videos as well as paper- or intranet-based procedures manuals.

tc.q: 本指引建議金錢服務經營者可採用哪些培訓方式及工具？
options: 網上學習系統、專題課堂培訓、相關影片，以及紙本或內聯網的程序手冊
只限課堂培訓，以便核實出席情況
只限由認可機構提供的外部研討會
只限在職指導，以反映實際工作情況
tc.explain: 第9.6段訂明鼓勵該經營者按可運用的資源及員工的學習需要，考慮混合採用多種培訓方式及工具，可包括網上學習系統、專題課堂培訓、相關影片，以及紙本或內聯網的程序手冊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.6段

en.q: What must an MSO be able to demonstrate to the CCE about its training materials?
options: That all materials are up-to-date and in line with current requirements and standards
That all materials were prepared by an external consultant
That all materials are available in both English and Chinese
That all materials have been approved by the CCE
en.explain: ¶9.6 states that an MSO may consider including available FATF papers and typologies as part of the training materials, and that the MSO should be able to demonstrate to the CCE that all materials are up-to-date and in line with current requirements and standards.

tc.q: 就其培訓教材，金錢服務經營者須能向海關關長證明甚麼？
options: 所有教材均為最新，並符合現行規定及標準
所有教材均由外聘顧問編製
所有教材均備有中英文版本
所有教材均經海關關長批准
tc.explain: 第9.6段訂明該經營者可考慮將可得的財務行動特別組織文件及類型分析納入培訓教材；並應能向海關關長證明所有教材均為最新，且符合現行規定及標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.7段

en.q: What training records must an MSO maintain, and for how long?
options: Records of who has been trained, when the staff received the training and the type of training provided; for a minimum of 3 years
Records of attendance only; for a minimum of 5 years
Records of test results only; for a minimum of 3 years
Records of the trainer's qualifications; for a minimum of 7 years
en.explain: ¶9.7 states that no matter which training approach is adopted, an MSO should monitor and maintain records of who have been trained, when the staff received the training and the type of the training provided, and that records should be maintained for a minimum of 3 years.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須保存哪些培訓紀錄？須保存多久？
options: 曾接受培訓者、員工接受培訓的時間，以及所提供培訓類型的紀錄；最少保存3年
只需出席紀錄；最少保存5年
只需測驗成績紀錄；最少保存3年
只需培訓導師的資歷紀錄；最少保存7年
tc.explain: 第9.7段訂明不論採用何種培訓方式，該經營者均應監察並保存曾接受培訓者、員工接受培訓的時間，以及所提供培訓類型的紀錄；有關紀錄應最少保存3年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.8(a)段

en.q: Which three things may be tested to monitor the effectiveness of training?
options: Staff's understanding of the MSO's policies and procedures to combat ML/TF, their understanding of their statutory and regulatory obligations, and their ability to recognise suspicious transactions
Staff's product knowledge, sales performance and customer feedback scores
Staff's attendance, punctuality and length of service
Staff's language proficiency, computer literacy and numeracy
en.explain: ¶9.8(a) states that an MSO should monitor the effectiveness of training, which may be achieved by testing staff's understanding of the MSO's policies and procedures to combat ML/TF, the understanding of their statutory and regulatory obligations, and also their ability to recognise suspicious transactions.

tc.q: 可測試哪三方面以監察培訓成效？
options: 員工對該經營者打擊洗錢政策及程序的理解、對其法定及監管責任的理解，以及其識別可疑交易的能力
員工的產品知識、銷售表現及客戶評分
員工的出席率、準時度及服務年資
員工的語文能力、電腦知識及計算能力
tc.explain: 第9.8(a)款訂明該經營者應監察培訓成效，方法可包括測試員工對該經營者打擊洗錢政策及程序的理解、對其法定及監管責任的理解，以及其識別可疑交易的能力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.8(b)段

en.q: What does monitoring the quality and quantity of internal reports help an MSO to do?
options: Identify further training needs so that appropriate action can be taken
Calculate the MLRO's workload for staffing purposes
Benchmark itself against other MSOs
Demonstrate to the JFIU that it reports often enough
en.explain: ¶9.8(b) states that the effectiveness of training may be monitored by monitoring the compliance of staff with the MSO's AML/CFT Systems as well as the quality and quantity of internal reports, so that further training needs may be identified and appropriate action can be taken.

tc.q: 監察內部報告的質與量有助金錢服務經營者做甚麼？
options: 識別進一步的培訓需要，以便採取適當行動
計算洗錢事務主任的工作量以作人手安排
與其他金錢服務經營者作比較
向聯合財富情報組證明其報告次數足夠
tc.explain: 第9.8(b)款訂明可透過監察員工遵從該經營者打擊洗錢系統的情況，以及內部報告的質與量，以監察培訓成效；從而識別進一步的培訓需要並採取適當行動。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.8(c)段

en.q: What third method of monitoring training effectiveness does ¶9.8 identify?
options: Monitoring attendance and following up with staff who miss such training without reasonable cause
Requiring staff to sign an annual declaration of competence
Sending staff to external certification examinations
Rotating staff between front-line and back-office roles
en.explain: ¶9.8(c) states that the effectiveness of training may be monitored by monitoring attendance and following up with staff who miss such training without reasonable cause.

tc.q: 第9.8段指出監察培訓成效的第三種方法為何？
options: 監察出席情況，並跟進無合理原因缺席該等培訓的員工
要求員工每年簽署能力聲明
安排員工參加外部認證考試
安排員工在前線與後勤崗位之間輪替
tc.explain: 第9.8(c)款訂明可透過監察出席情況，並跟進無合理原因缺席該等培訓的員工，以監察培訓成效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.3段

en.q: What does ¶9.3 require an MSO to implement in relation to training?
options: A clear and well articulated policy for ensuring that relevant staff receive adequate AML/CFT training
A minimum annual training budget expressed as a percentage of turnover
A contractual training commitment in every employment contract
A training committee chaired by a director
en.explain: ¶9.3 states that an MSO should implement a clear and well articulated policy for ensuring that relevant staff receive adequate AML/CFT training. The content of that training is then set out in ¶9.4 and ¶9.5.

tc.q: 第9.3段規定金錢服務經營者就培訓須實施甚麼？
options: 清晰而表述明確的政策，以確保相關員工接受充分的打擊洗錢培訓
以營業額百分比表示的最低年度培訓預算
在每份僱傭合約中訂明培訓承諾
由一名董事出任主席的培訓委員會
tc.explain: 第9.3段訂明該經營者應實施清晰而表述明確的政策，以確保相關員工接受充分的打擊洗錢培訓。該等培訓的內容則載於第9.4及9.5段。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.5段與第8.6段的比較

en.q: An MSO completes a transaction for a customer in year 1 and the business relationship ends in year 2. Until when must the transaction records be kept?
options: Until at least five years after the completion of the transaction, since the transaction retention period runs regardless of whether the business relationship ends during that period
Until five years after the end of the business relationship, because that is the later date in every case
Until the end of the business relationship only
Until five years after the transaction, or the end of the relationship, whichever is earlier
en.explain: ¶8.6 states that documents and records mentioned in ¶8.5 should be kept for at least five years after the completion of a transaction, regardless of whether the business relationship ends during the period. The separate CDD retention rule in ¶8.4 runs for at least five years after the end of the business relationship, so each set of records has its own clock.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者於第一年為客戶完成一宗交易，該業務關係於第二年終止。交易紀錄須保存至何時？
options: 至少保存至該交易完成後五年，因交易紀錄的保存期不論該業務關係有否在該期間終止均照樣計算
保存至該業務關係終止後五年，因在任何情況下該日期均較後
只須保存至該業務關係終止時
保存至該交易後五年或該業務關係終止兩者中較早者
tc.explain: 第8.6段訂明第8.5段所述的文件及紀錄應在交易完成後保存最少五年，而不論該業務關係有否在該期間終止。第8.4段就客戶盡職審查資料另訂的保存規則，則自業務關係終止後起計最少五年；故兩類紀錄各自按其時限計算。
